6150.name: slice of coeurl meat
6150.col_2: A bloody strip of extra-lean coeurl meat.

6151.name: bottle of cooking sherry
6151.col_2: Fine Lominsan white wine fortified with grape spirit to increase alcohol content and improve its aroma, making it perfect for a variety of culinary dishes.

6152.name: chunk of volcanic rock salt
6152.col_2: The red hue of this rock salt is said to come from the volcanic soil of O'Ghomoro.

6153.name: bottle of filtered water
6153.col_2: Water purified using a complex method of passing it through several layers of charcoal and rock.

6154.name: bottle of voidsent blood
6154.col_2: The bubbling blood of a voidsent. For some unknown reason, the humours will not coagulate.

6155.name: behemoth horn
6155.col_2: This giant sable horn is prized by furniture makers across the realm.

6158.name: Ifrit's horn
6158.col_2: Torn from the head of the Lord of the Inferno himself, this night-black horn is still hot to the touch.

6159.name: Inferno horn
6159.col_2: Torn from the head of the Lord of the Inferno himself, this night-black horn pulses with uncontrollably powerful fire-aspected energies.

6160.name: Garuda's feather
6160.col_2: Ripped from the wings of the Lady of the Vortex herself, this feather generates a powerful gust each time it is waved.

6161.name: Vortex feather
6161.col_2: Ripped from the wings of the Lady of the Vortex herself, this feather pulses with uncontrollably powerful wind-aspected energies.

6162.name: Titan's heart
6162.col_2: Drawn forth from the chest of the Lord of Crags himself, this small stone weighs more than a grown Lalafell.

6163.name: Crag heart
6163.col_2: Drawn forth from the chest of the Lord of Crags himself, this small stone pulses with uncontrollably powerful earth-aspected energies.

6164.name: Odin's mantle
6164.col_2: Removed from the back of the elder primal Odin, this heavy mantle is fit for a god.

6165.name: Cait Sith doll
6165.col_2: The ever-extended tail helps the kitten keep his balance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Cait Sith doll minion.

6166.name: baby behemoth
6166.col_2: We can only hope his mother doesn't come looking for him.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby behemoth minion.

6167.name: mammet #003L
6167.col_2: A fully operational clockwork puppet built for the Maelstrom.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mammet #003L minion.

6168.name: mammet #003G
6168.col_2: A fully operational clockwork puppet built for the Order of the Twin Adder.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mammet #003G minion.

6169.name: mammet #003U
6169.col_2: A fully operational clockwork puppet built for the Immortal Flames.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mammet #003U minion.

6170.name: storm hatchling
6170.col_2: Not more than a fortnight out of the shell, but his blood already runs Maelstrom red. Till sea swallows all!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the storm hatchling minion.

6171.name: serpent hatchling
6171.col_2: Not more than a fortnight out of the shell, but his blood already runs Twin Adder yellow.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the serpent hatchling minion.

6172.name: flame hatchling
6172.col_2: Not more than a fortnight out of the shell, but his blood already runs Immortal Flames black.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the flame hatchling minion.

6173.name: morbol seedling
6173.col_2: For the nonce, his breath is the worst of your problems.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the morbol seedling minion.

6174.name: tiny rat
6174.col_2: He may infest your granaries, and he may carry the plague, but he's <hex:021A020203>simply too adorable<hex:021A020103> to condemn to the life-ending jaws of a metal trap.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny rat minion.

6175.name: baby bun
6175.col_2: Tastes great on salads and in stews.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby bun minion.

6176.name: chigoe larva
6176.col_2: This tiny vilekin takes the blood pact with his master <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> seriously.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the chigoe larva minion.

6177.name: bluebird
6177.col_2: Known to retroactively bring good fortune to those who have already experienced good fortune.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bluebird minion.

6178.name: wide-eyed fawn
6178.col_2: His mother was either lost in a terrible hunting accident...or perhaps is just lost.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wide-eyed fawn minion.

6179.name: infant imp
6179.col_2: Hopes that one day, he will rule the seven hells. But for now, your backside will do.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the infant imp minion.

6180.name: coeurl kitten
6180.col_2: It will still be several summers before his trademark whiskers grow out.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the coeurl kitten minion.

6181.name: black coeurl
6181.col_2: Beware, for if one should cross your path, you will experience seven years of...AWWWWWW.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the black coeurl minion.

6183.name: gravel golem
6183.col_2: Only you stand between it and a hard place.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the gravel golem minion.

6184.name: wind-up tonberry
6184.col_2: Now with 100% less rancor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up tonberry minion.

6185.name: tiny tortoise
6185.col_2: Will not carry you to an underwater kingdom if you ride on its back.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny tortoise minion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

6186.name: baby raptor
6186.col_2: Luckily for you, his teeth haven't all grown in...yet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby raptor minion.

6187.name: baby bat
6187.col_2: Has yet to acquire a taste for blood.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby bat minion.

6188.name: tiny bulb
6188.col_2: Some questions, such as why this bulb can walk, are best left unanswered.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny bulb minion.

6189.name: dust bunny
6189.col_2: Despite the striking similarities, spriggans are not related to rabbits. But they have been known to eat them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the dust bunny minion.

6190.name: wind-up dullahan
6190.col_2: Warning: may contain sharp parts.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up dullahan minion.

6191.name: gigantpole
6191.col_2: Yes, it can survive for hours on end without any water, and yes, it can fly. Your argument is invalid.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the gigantpole minion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

6192.name: pudgy puk
6192.col_2: Don't ask what he has eaten to grow so plump.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the pudgy puk minion.

6193.name: buffalo calf
6193.col_2: Milk-fed until tender and juicy. Not that anyone would <hex:021A020203>ever<hex:021A020103> think of eating him.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the buffalo calf minion.

6194.name: cactuar cutting
6194.col_2: Take care not to suffer 1,000 points of damage...to your heart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the cactuar cutting minion.

6195.name: smallshell
6195.col_2: The mere sight of this wee wavekin may cause severe psychological trauma to those who spent years of their lives on faraway shores culling his relatives.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the smallshell minion.

6196.name: wolf pup
6196.col_2: Idolizes one Gaius van Baelsar for obvious reasons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wolf pup minion.

6197.name: beady eye
6197.col_2: That feeling you get sometimes that you are being watched? More often than not it is him.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the beady eye minion.

6198.name: fledgling dodo
6198.col_2: Properly trained not to eructate, regurgitate, expectorate, or flatulate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the fledgling dodo minion.

6199.name: coblyn larva
6199.col_2: Too dangerous to allow to grow any larger...too adorable to condemn to the furnace.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the coblyn larva minion.

6200.name: wind-up aldgoat
6200.col_2: No aldgoats were harmed in the making of this automaton.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up aldgoat minion.

6201.name: fledgling apkallu
6201.col_2: Will follow you until you give him a fish. Will continue to follow you after being given a fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the fledgling apkallu minion.

6202.name: goobbue sproutling
6202.col_2: Has been known to attack kittens for no apparent reason.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the goobbue sproutling minion.

6203.name: bite-sized pudding
6203.col_2: Though seemingly delicious, this spoonful of slime is not intended for consumption.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bite-sized pudding minion.

6204.name: model vanguard
6204.col_2: An exact 1:9 scale replica of a ceruleum-powered magitek vanguard (imperial pilot action figure not included).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the model vanguard minion.

6205.name: demon brick
6205.col_2: We are all better off not knowing what arcane magicks animate this ordinary stone block.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the demon brick minion.

6206.name: mini mole
6206.col_2: When not dining on a protein-rich diet of earthworms and grubs, he dreams of making mountains.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mini mole minion.

6207.name: tender lamb
6207.col_2: Mint jelly optional.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tender lamb minion.

6208.name: slime puddle
6208.col_2: Fun for the whole family.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the slime puddle minion.

6209.name: kidragora
6209.col_2: Even in space, everyone can hear this seedkin scream.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the kidragora minion.

6210.name: wind-up goblin
6210.col_2: Even this automaton's gobbiebag is bigger than yours.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up goblin minion.

6211.name: wind-up sylph
6211.col_2: If he could speak, it would be in the third person.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up sylph minion.

6212.name: wind-up cursor
6212.col_2: Modeled after the ivory glove of Oschon, the Wanderer, does this clockwork hand follow you...or guide you?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up cursor minion.

6213.name: wind-up airship
6213.col_2: A fully operational model of the legendary vessel, the <hex:021A020203>Invincible<hex:021A020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up airship minion.

6214.name: wind-up Qiqirn
6214.col_2: As adorable as the real thing, without the ratty odor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Qiqirn minion.

6215.name: black chocobo chick
6215.col_2: Rumors about her being able to fly are completely unfounded...or <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> they?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the black chocobo chick minion.

6216.name: wind-up Dalamud
6216.col_2: Do not attempt to pry open under any circumstances.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Dalamud minion.

6217.name: wind-up Shantotto
6217.col_2: If you fail to treat her right,<hex:02100103>she will set your pants alight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Shantotto minion.

6652.name: magitek reaper miniature
6652.col_2: A made-to-scale model of a magitek reaper, expertly crafted by Garlond Ironworks engineers.

6653.name: stuffed moogle
6653.col_2: He can't change your class, retrieve items from your delivery box, or manage your belongings, but he <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> cuddly.

6654.name: stuffed chocobo
6654.col_2: This stuffed baby chocobo is so lifelike, you could almost hear it cry “kweh!”

6655.name: drinking apkallu
6655.col_2: This little apkallu has an unquenchable thirst.

6656.name: Maelstrom banner
6656.col_2: Display your patriotic zeal with the Crimson Standard of the Maelstrom.

6657.name: Twin Adder banner
6657.col_2: Display your patriotic zeal with the Lily and Serpent of the Order of the Twin Adder.

6658.name: Immortal Flames banner
6658.col_2: Display your patriotic zeal with the Tipping Scales of the Immortal Flames.

6659.name: Lominsan cityscape
6659.col_2: A copy of the cityscape painting titled <hex:021A020203>The Navigator's Veil<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

6660.name: Gridanian cityscape
6660.col_2: A copy of the cityscape painting titled <hex:021A020203>Serenity, Purity, Sanctity<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

6661.name: Ul'dahn cityscape

6662.name: Eorzean map
6662.col_2: The map of Eorzea as charted by the famous explorer and cartographer Roddard Ironheart.

6663.name: galleass wheel
6663.col_2: Open up and say “arrr” with this wall-mounted galleass wheel. Galleass sold separately.

6664.name: demon wall sculpture
6664.col_2: A lifelike demon wall sculpture, for those who like their walls menacing.

6665.name: Inferno wall lamp
6665.col_2: A blazing wall-mounted lamp made using horns taken from the primal Ifrit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

6666.name: blazing Inferno wall lamp
6666.col_2: A blazing wall-mounted lamp made using horns taken from the primal Ifrit─now with more blaze!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

6670.name: Belah'dian crystal lantern

6671.name: wall chronometer

6672.name: behemoth wall trophy
6672.col_2: A wall-mounted trophy commemorating your triumph over the mighty behemoth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

6674.col_2: A fringed rug woven in the riviera fashion.

6687.name: Amalj'aa pavis shield
6687.col_2: A pavis shield of iron used by the Amalj'aa to fortify their strongholds.

6688.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 1 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 40 recommended.

6969.col_2: Cannot equip gear to legs and feet.

6984.name: wind-up Amalj'aa
6984.col_2: What is burnt may never burn, but rises again, harder and stronger.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Amalj'aa minion.

6985.name: wind-up brickman
6985.col_2: The brickman gets up and looks over as if it wants to join the party!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up brickman minion.

6986.name: wind-up Edvya
6986.col_2: Sometimes moonlights as a miller girl, much to her father the sultan's chagrin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Edvya minion.

6987.name: Minion of Light
6987.col_2: “When Darkness veils the world, three Minions of Light shall come.”<hex:02100103>─Unknown prophet<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire a Minion of Light.

6988.name: wind-up leader
6988.col_2: A leader who will follow you unquestioningly─for coin and country; for serenity, purity, sanctity─till sea swallows all.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up leader minion.

6989.name: princely hatchling
6989.col_2: The chocobo who would be king.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the princely hatchling minion.

6990.name: behemoth warhorn
6990.col_2: This imposing horn emits a thunderous tone that summons your mighty behemoth.

6991.name: drake horn
6991.col_2: This horn of bone emits a shrill tone that summons your cavalry drake, trained by the Brotherhood of Ash.

6992.name: laurel goobbue horn
6992.col_2: This polished horn emits a deep, bellowing tone that creates subtle vibrations in the land that carry for malms. While undetectable by most, goobbues can sense these mini tremblors which they often mistake for mating calls. Use to summon your laurel goobbue.

6993.name: gilded armor identification key
6993.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your gilded suit of magitek armor will magically bring the machine to life.

6994.name: nightmare whistle
6994.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary nightmare.

6995.name: set of sovereign barding
6995.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble that of a chocobo king of legend.

6996.name: prismatic heart (left)
6996.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces the left side of a heart.

6997.name: prismatic heart (right)
6997.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces the right side of a heart.

6998.name: bitter heart chocolate
6998.col_2: A heart-shaped morsel of bitter chocolate. Suitable for decorative purposes.

6999.name: pure heart chocolate
6999.col_2: A heart-shaped morsel of sweet chocolate. Suitable for decorative purposes.

7000.name: fragment of eternal ice
7000.col_2: A crystalline agglomeration infused with the power of ice, said to grant snowmen temporary life.

7001.name: Flamefang choker
7001.col_2: A fiery choker worn by members of the dreaded Flamefang Amalj'aa.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Amalj'aa society quests.

7002.name: proto armor identification key
7002.col_2: An identification key for a prototype suit of magitek armor. It is damaged beyond use.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in sylph society quests.

7003.name: Kafre's tusk
7003.col_2: A bloody tusk taken from the savage Kafre.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in sylph society quests.

7004.name: Rowena's token
7004.col_2: A note of promise received from Rowena for the delivery of beastman ritual tools. Can be redeemed for a superior weapon of your choice.

7005.name: Jandelaine's token
7005.col_2: A note of promise received from Jandelaine. Can be redeemed for a single visit from the aesthetician.

7006.name: Dimension Blade fragment
7006.col_2: A fragment of the Dimension Blade, Phlegethon's fell scimitar.

7007.name: Moggle Mog XII's whisker
7007.col_2: This regal whisker once belonged to Good King Moggle Mog, Twelfth of His Name.

7008.name: chunk of granite
7008.col_2: An extremely hard rock said to be formed of cooled magma.

7009.name: slab of cut stone
7009.col_2: A rectangular slab of stone commonly used in building construction.

7010.name: chunk of marble
7010.col_2: A chunk of marble with mesmerizing mottlings and streaks.

7011.name: bundle of bloodgrass
7011.col_2: A bundle of dried bloodgrass stalks for use in thatching.

7012.name: bundle of maiden grass
7012.col_2: A bundle of dried maiden grass stalks for use in thatching.

7014.name: crate of clinker bricks
7014.col_2: Partially vitrified bricks favored for their superior hardness and durability.

7015.name: roof tile
7015.col_2: A flat roof tile made of baked clay.

7016.name: pot of mortar
7016.col_2: A mixture used in construction to bond bricks or stones.

7017.name: pot of varnish
7017.col_2: A coating used to protect wooden surfaces and give them a clear and shiny finish.

7019.col_2: Steel nails used in crafting and construction.

7023.name: cobalt joint plate
7023.col_2: A plate of beaten cobalt used in crafting and construction.

7026.name: roll of linen canvas
7026.col_2: A roll of sturdy canvas woven from linen.

7028.name: roll of sylphic silk
7028.col_2: A roll of fine silk made with traditional sylphic weaving methods.

7029.name: island seedling
7029.col_2: A seedling that grows in the wilderness of Vylbrand.

7030.name: Shroud seedling
7030.col_2: A seedling that grows in the wilderness of the Black Shroud.

7031.name: desert seedling
7031.col_2: A seedling that grows in the wilderness of Thanalan.

7032.name: lotus leaf

7033.name: Ishgardian steel ingot

7034.name: carnivorous seedling

7035.name: dungeon seedling

7550.col_2: An egg-themed chocobo harness created in celebration of Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide.

7552.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Leviathan, the Lord of the Whorl.

7553.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone recognized by your fat chocobo as a feeding call.

7554.name: elbst horn
7554.col_2: This horn of bone emits a sonorous tone that summons your cavalry elbst, raised from an egg by Pahh of Novv's Clutch.

7555.name: bomb palanquin horn
7555.col_2: This horn of bone emits a deep tone that summons a bevy of bombs who will bear you in comfort upon a hovering palanquin.

7556.name: wind-up kobold
7556.col_2: With you, she will koboldly go where no kobold has gone before.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up kobold minion.

7557.name: wind-up Sahagin
7557.col_2: He's got a trident and he's not afraid to use it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Sahagin minion.

7558.name: wind-up moogle
7558.col_2: With its button nose and fluffy pom, this clockwork moogle will make you the envy of all your friends.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up moogle minion.

7559.name: plush cushion
7559.col_2: Ever ready to shield your buttocks from the hardest of places.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the plush cushion minion.

7560.name: wind-up sun
7560.col_2: With this minion, the sun will never go down on you. /poke to adjust elevation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up sun minion.

7561.name: wind-up Odin
7561.col_2: Guaranteed not to wipe out your entire party in one fell stroke.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Odin minion.

7562.name: wind-up Warrior of Light
7562.col_2: “Wheresoever thou goest, so too shall Light follow.”<hex:02100103>─Ancient benediction<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Warrior of Light minion.

7563.name: wind-up Bahamut
7563.col_2: This mysterious being emerged from within a broken wind-up Dalamud, and is nigh inseparable from its former prison.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Bahamut minion.

7564.name: baby opo-opo
7564.col_2: The only thing he loves more than you is a juicy sprite apple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby opo<hex:021F0103>opo minion.

7565.name: zu hatchling
7565.col_2: This newborn zu has yet to exhibit aggressive or territorial behavior, but when it gets bigger...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the zu hatchling minion.

7566.name: minute mindflayer
7566.col_2: This mindflayer young delights folk with its cuteness even as it fills them with an inexplicable sense of dread.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the minute mindflayer minion.

7567.name: tight-beaked parrot
7567.col_2: For best results, summon while wearing an eyepatch.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tight-beaked parrot minion.

7568.name: magic broom
7568.col_2: For safety reasons, do not fall asleep while it is at work.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the magic broom minion.

7569.col_2: Good for a single journey through the aetheryte network.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Collected in place of gil when using the Teleport command.]

7880.col_3: Sphere Scroll: The Veil of Wiyu

7881.name: sphere scroll: Omnilex
7881.col_2: A scroll bearing arcanima patterns of power for enhancing the relic grimoire the <hex:021A020203>Omnilex<hex:021A020103>.

7882.name: sphere scroll: Holy Shield
7882.col_2: A scroll bearing arcanima patterns of power for enhancing the relic Holy Shield.

7883.name: piece of alexandrite
7883.col_2: A variety of dark matter that possesses light-altering properties.

7884.name: mysterious map
7884.col_2: This bottle is holding what appears to be a timeworn map of unknown origin, bearing peculiar markings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 50 recommended.

7885.name: bottle of superior enchanted ink
7885.col_2: Ink originating from the Near East, boasting superior aetherial conductivity.

7886.name: Soul of the Ninja
7886.col_2: Upon the surface of this multi-aspected crystal are carved the myriad deeds of ninjas from eras past.

7888.name: pair of Yoshimitsu
7888.col_2: One of the fabled relic weapons.

7894.name: curiel root
7894.col_2: A parsnip-like tuber found growing on the windswept islands of the northern seas. While too bitter for most people's tastes, chocobos are known to enjoy the flavor, and thus the root is often used as fodder for the animals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases EXP earned by your chocobo companion.

7895.name: sylkis bud
7895.col_2: An artichoke-like flower found growing on a majority of the Cieldalaes. While too bitter for most people's tastes, chocobos are known to enjoy the flavor, and thus the meaty buds are often used as fodder for the animals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases your chocobo companion's attack potency.

7897.name: mimett gourd
7897.col_2: A large fleshy squash brought back from the New World by Lominsan explorers. While too sweet for most people's tastes, chocobos are known to enjoy the flavor, and thus the gourds are often used as fodder for the animals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases your chocobo companion's healing magic potency.

7898.name: tantalplant
7898.col_2: A vibrant purple vegetable commonly found growing in the Near East. While too bitter for most people's tastes, chocobos are known to enjoy the flavor, and thus these aubergines are often used as fodder for the animals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases your chocobo companion's maximum HP.

7900.name: pahsana fruit
7900.col_2: A bright-red tomato-like fruit brought back from the New World by Lominsan explorers. While too tangy for most people's tastes, chocobos are known to enjoy the flavor, and thus the fruits are often used as fodder for the animals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases your chocobo companion's enmity.

7901.name: blood-spattered mark log
7901.col_2: A list of elite marks slain by the log's owner...before the owner herself was slain. Though such documents were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

7902.name: cupfish
7902.col_2: A rare freshwater fish which spends the entirety of its life hiding in locations which rarely see the light of the sun.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

7903.name: meteor survivor
7903.col_2: A king among helmet crabs, and lord of the waters off the Salt Strand.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

7904.name: Joan of Trout
7904.col_2: A queen among trout, and lady of the waters of Fool Falls.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

7905.name: toramafish
7905.col_2: A king among coeurlfish, and lord of the waters of Oakwood.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

7906.name: Fingers
7906.col_2: A king among rock lobsters, and lord of the waters of Crescent Cove.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

7907.name: the Assassin
7907.col_2: A king among river crabs, and lord of the waters of the Sanctum of the Twelve.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

7908.name: Vip Viper
7908.col_2: A king among black eels, and lord of the waters of the upper Hathoeva River. Some claim that jerking up, up, down, down, left, right, left, and right on one's pole increases chances of landing this slippery specimen.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

7909.name: the Greatest Bream in the World

7909.col_2: A king among Bianaq bream, and lord of the waters off south Bloodshore.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
7909.col_3: The Greatest Bream in the World

7910.name: Dirty Herry

7923.col_2: An extremely rare amphibian that excretes a sweet-yet-toxic substance from its skin to teach would-be predators a deadly lesson.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

7924.name: Bombardfish
7924.col_2: A king among balloonfish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

7951.name: aetherlouse
7951.col_2: The recent discovery of this vilekin-like denizen of the deep has given rise to fantastical theories that all land-dwelling creatures on Hydaelyn may once have come from the seas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

7958.name: riviera wall shelf
7958.col_2: Wall-mounted shelves designed to complement riviera residences.

7963.col_2: Ice shards applied to the cooler's inner lining keep this bottle of Wineport's unfermented finest as cold as a Coerthan winter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 5)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 6)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

7964.name: full set of <hex:021A020203>The Five Ages<hex:021A020103>
7964.col_2: Impress your friends with these beautiful leather-bound replicas of Lewphon of Sharlayan's crowning achievement in the field of history, theology, and astrology. Just do not allow those friends to open any of the volumes, as they are all blank.

7965.name: stack of classified documents
7965.col_2: Need to convince a special someone that you are deeply involved in a tangled web of international intrigue, so that they might keep you company in your chambers on what most certainly could be your last night amongst the living? A couple of official-looking documents can only help your ignoble cause.

7966.name: stuffed goblin
7966.col_2: All attempts to remove the mask of this goblin replica have failed, so do not even consider trying it yourself.

7967.name: Ultima Weapon miniature
7967.col_2: An expertly crafted replica of the Ultima Weapon. (Miniature Gaius van Baelsar sold separately.)

7968.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Onus of an Engineer<hex:021A020103>
7968.col_2: A commissioned oil painting of Cid Garlond, former engineer for the Garlean Empire and founder of the Garlond Ironworks. Original artist unknown.

7969.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Enquire Within<hex:021A020103>
7969.col_2: A commissioned oil painting of realm-renowned agent of enquiry Hildibrand and his faithful assistant Nashu Mhakaracca. Original artist unknown.

7970.name: wall planter
7970.col_2: A simple wall-mounted planter, perfect for flowers or miniature shrubs.

7971.name: full set of the <hex:021A020203>Encyclopedia Eorzea<hex:021A020103>
7971.col_2: Impress your friends with these beautiful leather-bound replicas of naturalist Marcette Manne's comprehensive collection of knowledge. Just do not allow those friends to open any of the volumes, as they are all blank.

7972.name: open hearth
7972.col_2: A chimney-less hearth designed to resemble those popular in the Far East. Do not forget proper ventilation while using.

7973.name: riviera half partition
7973.col_2: A partition designed in the riviera fashion, but reaching only less than halfway to the ceiling so as to provide privacy without making the room feel smaller.

7974.name: potted umbrella fig
7974.col_2: A pruned and potted umbrella fig tree.

7975.name: potted dragon tree
7975.col_2: A pruned and potted dragon tree. It is said that anyone in the presence of this breed of flora is unable to tell a lie, though it might also be that anyone in the presence of a dragon tree is unable to ask the hard questions.

7976.name: model star globe
7976.col_2: A spherical map of the heavens based off of legendary Ishgardian astrologian Adaunel the Younger's lifetime of findings.

7977.name: tatami mat
7977.col_2: Woven from sweet-smelling rush grass, these rectangular floor mats are widely used in the Far Eastern land of Doma.

7978.name: corner counter
7978.col_2: A low counter-type table crafted in an L shape.

7979.name: planter partition
7979.col_2: A low partition outfitted with several planter pots.

7980.name: plasma lamp
7980.col_2: A stylish floor lamp crafted from a rare Levin orb.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

7981.name: Lord of Levin lamp
7981.col_2: A stylish floor lamp crafted from a large Levin orb─now with more snap, crackle, and pop!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

7982.name: the Emperor's throne
7982.col_2: Grant boons and make decrees in style while lounging in this near-perfect replica of Emperor Xande's throne.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

7983.name: riviera doormat
7983.col_2: A welcome mat designed to complement riviera residences. Don't tread on me.

7984.name: double feather bed
7984.col_2: Made from the feathers of forty-leven geese, this large bed can hold approximately eight children, four hound dogs, and a piggy stolen from the shed.

7985.name: chocobo pillar
7985.col_2: A decorative pillar designed to resemble a chocobo.

7986.name: riviera cushion
7986.col_2: A plush cushion upholstered in the riviera fashion.

7987.name: glade cushion
7987.col_2: A plush cushion upholstered in the glade fashion.

7988.name: oasis cushion
7988.col_2: A plush cushion upholstered in the oasis fashion.

7989.name: chocobo stable
7989.col_2: A simple stable large enough for keeping and raising as many chocobos as you can imagine (if 512 is the maximum number you can imagine).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

7990.name: Moonfire lantern
7990.col_2: An outdoor lantern traditionally placed outside one's home for the duration of the Moonfire Faire.

7991.name: stalk of ornamental bamboo
7991.col_2: People hailing from the Far East claim that wishes written on small slips of parchment and tied to the bamboo will come true. (Magical wish parchment sold separately.)

7992.name: rounded shrub
7992.col_2: This leafy shrub has been expertly pruned and trimmed into a perfect sphere.

7993.name: lattice planter
7993.col_2: A wooden garden partition outfitted with planter pots.

7994.name: pot of water lilies
7994.col_2: A ceramic pot filled with crystal-clear water and several water lilies.

7995.name: garden pond
7995.col_2: A decorative outdoor pond encircled by smooth stones.

7996.name: cast-iron cookpot
7996.col_2: A blackened pot perfect for hanging over a cookfire.

7997.name: stepladder
7997.col_2: Because sometimes there are things even a Roegadyn cannot reach.

7998.name: set of straight stepping stones
7998.col_2: Several flat smoothed stones arranged in a straight line.

7999.name: set of curved stepping stones
7999.col_2: Several flat smoothed stones arranged in a curving pattern.

8000.name: set of straight stepping stumps
8000.col_2: Several thinly cut cross sections of a massive tree trunk arranged to form a straight path.

8001.name: set of curved stepping stumps
8001.col_2: Several thinly cut cross sections of a massive tree trunk arranged to form a curved path.

8002.name: planter box
8002.col_2: A rectangular wooden box filled with blooming wildflowers.

8003.name: wooden bucket
8003.col_2: A wooden bucket filled with crystal-clear water. Families in the Far East use these receptacles to chill fruit during the hot summer moons.

8004.name: glade hedgewall
8004.col_2: A living fence designed to complement glade residences. Mix and match at your own peril.

8005.name: oasis fence
8005.col_2: A decorated stone fence designed to complement oasis residences. Mix and match at your own peril.

8006.name: riviera fence
8006.col_2: A pointed iron fence designed to complement riviera residences. Mix and match at your own peril.

8007.name: riviera flora interior wall
8007.col_2: A flora-themed interior wall designed to complement riviera residences.

8008.name: glade flora interior wall
8008.col_2: A flora-themed interior wall designed to complement glade residences.

8009.name: oasis flora interior wall
8009.col_2: A flora-themed interior wall designed to complement oasis residences.

8010.name: classic interior wall
8010.col_2: Experience luxury living with this interior wall which features an elegant pattern adored by the Ul'dahn elite.

8011.name: striped interior wall
8011.col_2: These striped walls are guaranteed to make your room appear thin...or fat.

8012.name: mosaic interior wall
8012.col_2: An intricate interior wall crafted from countless tiny pieces of ceramic fit together in breathtaking patterns.

8013.name: unit of bisque flooring
8013.col_2: Simple, yet stylish, bisque flooring is perfect for the modern adventurer.

8014.name: unit of marble flooring
8014.col_2: Carved from a single piece of beautiful marble, this floor is fit for a king (or queen).

8015.name: unit of ceramic tile flooring
8015.col_2: Specialty flooring that is cool to the touch and easy to clean.

8017.name: Bombard lamp

8018.name: throne gem
8018.col_2: A brilliant bauble pried from the Emperor Xande's colossal seat of rule.

8019.name: Levin orb

8020.name: large Levin orb
8020.col_2: A perfect sphere of overcharged lightning-aspected energies encased in a transparent receptacle of hyperfused silica.

8021.name: tuft of rush grass

8022.name: young water lily

8023.name: pearl roselle
8023.col_2: A milky white flower commonly found growing in the humid climes of the southern seas.

8024.name: waterfowl feather
8024.col_2: Unlike those of tree-dwelling cloudkin, waterfowl feathers are exceptional at trapping in heat while keeping out water.

8025.name: ball of floss silk
8025.col_2: Silk that has been spun into lightweight balls that bear the appearance of cotton.

8026.name: bolt of mist silk
8026.col_2: Each strand of mist silk is twice as thin as regular silk, making it much more difficult to work with.

8027.name: bolt of waterproof cotton cloth
8027.col_2: This soft cloth has been treated with a thin layer of resin to repel water.

8028.name: sheet of polarized glass
8028.col_2: Glass treated with a complex alchemical concoction to reduce glare.

8029.name: wolfram square
8029.col_2: A thin, tiny plate of hammered wolfram.

8030.name: antumbral rock

8031.name: redolent log
8031.col_2: An unforgettably pleasant-smelling log obtained in the Black Shroud.

8032.name: length of reinforced spruce plywood

8033.name: balanced darksteel hook
8033.col_2: A hook masterfully wrought from darksteel and shaped to bear weight equally regardless of the direction in which it is pulled.

8034.name: roll of reinforced darksteel wire
8034.col_2: A roll of wire painstakingly drawn out from darksteel and combined with a second length of wire to enhance strength.

8035.name: calibrated rose gold cog

8036.name: water-hardened hippogryph strap

8037.name: bolt of intricate silver brocade

8038.name: flask of concentrated spirits of salt
8038.description: flasks of concentrated spirits of salt
8038.col_2: An ultra-concentrated potent acid with myriad applications.

8039.name: bowl of rich tomato relish

8156.name: unhidden leather map
8156.col_2: A detailed map recovered from the treasure coffer in which it was hidden...officially rendering it no longer hidden.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 50 recommended.<hex:02100103>※Item level 70 recommended.

8157.name: Xelphatol apple
8157.col_2: A bitter fruit found growing in the Ixali homelands. While typically avoided by the Ixal themselves, it is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to deepen the red hues of their feathers.

8158.name: Doman plum
8158.col_2: A hard, bitter fruit found in the forests of Far Eastern Doma. It is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to lighten the red hues of their feathers.

8159.name: Mamook pear
8159.col_2: A bitter fruit found growing in the arid soils of Mamook. While typically avoided by the Mamool Ja themselves, it is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to deepen the green hues of their feathers.

8160.name: valfruit
8160.col_2: A bitter berry found growing on the distant Isle of Val. It is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to lighten the green hues of their feathers.

8161.name: bunch of O'Ghomoro berries
8161.col_2: A bitter fruit found growing on the volcanic soil of O'Ghomoro. While typically avoided by the kobolds, it is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to deepen the blue hues of their feathers.

8162.name: Cieldalaes pineapple
8162.col_2: A bitter fruit found growing on the Cieldalaes─a remote archipelago in the Rhotano Sea. It is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to lighten the blue hues of their feathers.

8163.name: Han lemon
8163.col_2: A foul, bitter fruit found growing on the Near Eastern island of Thavnair. While typically avoided by the residents of Radz-at-Han, it is a favorite amongst chocobos, and is known to restore feathers to their original hue.

8165.name: krakka root
8165.col_2: A bitter carrot-like root vegetable native to the Near East and a favorite amongst chocobos.

8166.name: Thavnairian onion
8166.col_2: A pungent, tear-inducing vegetable that thrives in the alkali sands of Near Eastern Thavnair. It is a favorite amongst chocobos.

8167.name: bag of pearl roselle seeds
8167.col_2: Pearl roselle seeds suitable for garden cultivation.

8168.name: magicked stable broom
8168.col_2: Why entrust the sweeping of chocobo dung to a coinless pleb with a sick wife and two starving children when you can toss a bewitched broom into your personal stables and be done?

8189.name: wind-up Ixal
8189.col_2: He believes he can fly. He believes he can touch the sky. Unfortunately he cannot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Ixal minion.

8190.name: wind-up succubus
8190.col_2: 100% anatomically correct. Handle with care.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up succubus minion.

8191.name: wind-up Gilgamesh
8191.col_2: Several arms appear to be missing, but that does not seem to otherwise hinder basic functionality.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Gilgamesh minion.

8192.name: Onion Prince
8192.col_2: He would die 4 U. Or possibly cry 4 U. Or most likely make U cry. 4 U.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Onion Prince minion.

8193.name: Eggplant Knight
8193.col_2: His childhood dream to become a wizard was frowned upon by his overbearing father.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Eggplant Knight minion.

8194.name: Garlic Jester
8194.col_2: Every breath you take will act as a reminder that your pungent pal is right behind you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Garlic Jester minion.

8195.name: Tomato King
8195.col_2: Has issued a royal decree for the public defenestration of any and all who mistakenly claim the king is a vegetable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Tomato King minion.

8196.name: Mandragora Queen
8196.col_2: Though wed to the Tomato King in a move to strengthen the bond of houses Tomato and Mandragora, the queen longs to steal away with her one true love─the Eggplant Knight. What will become of this forbidden romance!? Use item to acquire the Mandragora Queen minion and find out!

8197.name: wind-up onion knight
8197.col_2: An accurate representation of the soldiers who once made up the greater portion of the Allagan Imperial Army.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up onion knight minion.

8198.name: treasure box
8198.col_2: It is unknown what manner of spirit possesses this tiny treasure chest, but the fact that it will not hesitate to nip at the fingers of any who try and pry it open is painfully evident.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the treasure box minion.

8199.name: tiny tapir
8199.col_2: Natives of the New World claim that tapirs grow by devouring the dreams of their unsuspecting owners. And now you know what to expect.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny tapir minion.

8200.name: Nana bear
8200.col_2: Pundits claim bears to be the deadliest beasts in the realm. They obviously have never stared into this cute cub's nebulous eyes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Nana bear minion.

8201.name: miniature minecart
8201.col_2: Best when ridden in abandoned mines and temples of doom.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the miniature minecart minion.

8202.name: nutkin
8202.col_2: That nutkins are infamous for being shy and timid creatures shows that this brave beastkin comes complete with a pair of iron acorns on him.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the nutkin minion.

8203.name: wind-up Minfilia
8203.col_2: Unlike the real Minfilia, this one actually accompanies you on your adventures.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Minfilia minion.

8204.name: wind-up Thancred
8204.col_2: Two hundred percent more dreamy than previous models.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Thancred minion.

8205.name: naughty nanka
8205.col_2: Like its parent, the ninki nanka, this slippery wavekin will breed like a rabbit if left unsupervised.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the naughty nanka minion.

8206.name: panda cub
8206.col_2: Untrained in arts both martial and magical, but as scrumptiously adorable as chicken glazed in a tangy orange reduction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the panda cub minion.

8207.name: draught chocobo whistle
8207.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by a draught chocobo trained from birth to recognize and respond to the sound. Use to summon your personal draught chocobo.

8208.name: direwolf whistle
8208.col_2: A polished bone horn used to summon an Ixal-trained direwolf.

8209.name: storm warsteed horn
8209.col_2: A hollowed beastkin horn adorned in Maelstrom red that emits a deep bellowing tone which summons your Storm warsteed.

8210.name: serpent warsteed horn
8210.col_2: A hollowed beastkin horn adorned in Twin Adder yellow that emits a deep bellowing tone which summons your Serpent warsteed.

8211.name: flame warsteed horn
8211.col_2: A hollowed beastkin horn adorned in Immortal Flames black that emits a deep bellowing tone which summons your Flame warsteed.

8212.name: Markab whistle
8212.col_2: This tiny whistle emits a shrill tone which can only be heard by Markab, blessed steed of the Lord of Levin.

8213.name: aetheryte pendulum
8213.col_2: A shard of aetheryte which can be attuned to new adventurers, allowing for swift travel to their side in times of need.

8214.name: bottle of Realm Reborn red
8214.col_2: A special vintage of sparkling red wine prepared by master vintner Byrglaent of Wineport for the Rising, an annual celebration of Eorzea's rebirth.

8215.name: magicked prism (meteor survivor)
8215.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a radiant light that projects images of the lesser moon Dalamud.

8216.name: pinwheel
8216.col_2: A spinning firework popular in the Far East.

8217.name: magitek torch (red lotus)
8217.col_2: An original creation of the Garlond Ironworks, this handheld device harnesses the power of magitek to emit a sensuous red light.

8218.name: skyrocket
8218.col_2: This particular variety of firework resembles a comet when ignited. Why it is not then called a skycomet, only the Far Eastern inventor who conceived the item knows.

8222.name: Ixali oaknot promissory note
8222.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for Ixali oaknots─carved pieces of oak used as currency by the Ixal.

8575.name: eternity ring

8577.name: wind-up Violet
8577.col_2: Touched by a primal and corrupted to the core...yet adorable nonetheless.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Violet minion.

8578.name: wind-up founder
8578.col_2: Four score and many more years ago, the Amalj'aa founding fathers dreamed of a day when in their footsteps would walk adorable minions. That day has finally come.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up founder minion.

8579.name: wind-up Dezul Qualan
8579.col_2: It is said Ixali engineer Dezul Qualan began crafting war dirigibles after having a vision of ninety-nine red balloons floating over the Black Shroud.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Dezul Qualan minion.

8580.name: wind-up kobolder
8580.col_2: Bolder than a wind-up kobold, yet not any older.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up kobolder minion.

8581.name: wind-up Sea Devil
8581.col_2: A clockwork automaton expertly crafted to resemble the infamous Scarlet Sea Devil, leader of the Coral Tridents.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Sea Devil minion.

8693.name: promise of innocence
8693.col_2: This wristlet signifies a standard agreement between two individuals to form an everlasting spiritual union.

8694.name: promise of passion
8694.col_2: This wristlet signifies a gold-clad agreement between two individuals to form an everlasting spiritual union.

8695.name: promise of devotion
8695.col_2: This wristlet signifies a platinum-clad agreement between two individuals to form an everlasting spiritual union.

8697.name: flawless band
8697.col_2: From this simple ring, a lifelong bond begins.

8698.name: blank invitation
8698.col_2: The Ceremony of Eternal Bonding invitation from which all future invitations are born.

8699.name: ceremony invitation
8699.col_2: Allows admittance to a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding. Speak with Etoinelle at the Sanctum of the Twelve before using.

8701.name: demon box
8701.col_2: There is no better way to tell a special someone “Thank you for attending my Ceremony of Eternal Bonding” than by giving them a sentient box that may or may not devour their pets.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the demon box minion.

8702.name: ceremony chocobo whistle
8702.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by a ceremony chocobo trained from birth to recognize and respond to the sound. Use to summon your ceremony chocobo mount.

8716.name: demonic cookie
8716.col_2: Though this small baked treat provided by the Continental Circus <hex:021A020203>appears<hex:021A020103> to be a cookie, it is difficult to tell what on Hydaelyn it might contain. Consumption should probably be avoided.

8717.name: Ironworks fishing rod
8717.col_2: Rumor has that fishing enthusiast Biggs used the Garlond Ironworks crafting facilities after-hours to create this magitek-enhanced rod.

8718.name: set of eerie barding
8718.col_2: A purely decorative chocobo costume created for All Saints' Wake.

8719.name: model <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103>
8719.col_2: Designed to boldly go where you have gone before.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the model <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103> minion.

8720.name: wind-up delivery moogle
8720.col_2: For when you absolutely, positively require moogle accompaniment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up delivery moogle minion.

8721.name: wind-up Nanamo
8721.col_2: The automaton vehemently refuses to sit upon any shoulder but Raubahn's...and yours.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Nanamo minion.

8722.name: wind-up Y'shtola
8722.col_2: If we are to take her word for it, the Circle of Knowing Archon has seen but twenty-three summers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Y'shtola minion.

8723.name: wind-up Yda
8723.col_2: Comes complete with irremovable mask.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Yda minion.

8724.name: wind-up Papalymo
8724.col_2: Comes complete with irremovable smirk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Papalymo minion.

8725.name: wind-up Urianger
8725.col_2: When the senary moon did wane, there sounded a garrulous and convoluted monologue. A new minion had roused, one whose identity lieth within our ken.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Urianger minion.

8726.name: Sleipnir horn
8726.col_2: This ebon horn emits a somber tone that summons Odin's loyal steed from the elder primal's side to yours.

8727.name: Odin miniature
8727.col_2: An expertly crafted replica of the wandering elder primal Odin. (Miniature Sleipnir included.)

8728.name: Bahamut miniature
8728.col_2: An expertly crafted replica of the elder primal Bahamut. (Miniature Nael van Darnus sold separately.)

8729.name: stuffed tonberry
8729.col_2: This plush doll is rumored to be stuffed with countless strips of cloth covered in terrible curses. Slicing open the tonberry to find out what they entail is not recommended.

8730.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>A Northerly Wind<hex:021A020103>
8730.col_2: A commissioned portrait of Circle of Knowing Archon Louisoix Leveilleur entitled <hex:021A020203>A Northerly Wind<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

8731.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Antecedent<hex:021A020103>
8731.col_2: A commissioned portrait of Scions of the Seventh Dawn leader Minfilia entitled <hex:021A020203>The Antecedent<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

8753.col_3: The Old Man in the Sea

8754.name: Nepto Dragon
8754.col_2: Believed by Eorzean fisherfolk to be the spawn of Thalaos─legendary creator of seas. It is, however, more likely to be no more than an overgrown little Thalaos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8755.name: coelacanthus
8755.col_2: A king among coelacanths.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8756.name: endoceras
8756.col_2: An ancient sea-dweller with a body like a lance and a temper like the Fury's. Only few have ever seen this living legend, let alone landed one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8757.name: seahag
8757.col_2: A queen among dinichthys.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8758.name: ignus horn
8758.col_2: A king among ignus snails.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

8760.col_2: A champion among boxing plecos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8761.name: ninja betta
8761.col_2: A king among assassin betta.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

8763.name: Kuno the Killer
8763.col_2: A legendary white catfish rarely seen by even the eldest of fisherfolk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8764.name: Pirate's Bane
8764.col_2: A king among titanic saws.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8765.name: Ndendecki
8765.col_2: A king among soft-shelled snapping turtles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8766.name: bat-o'-nine-tails
8766.col_2: A king among vampire lamperns.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8767.name: wootz knifefish zenith
8767.col_2: A king among wootz knifefish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8768.name: helicoprion
8768.col_2: A legendary denizen of the sands, the helicoprion's maw is lined with long curved teeth that help it latch onto its airborne prey.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8769.name: Darkstar
8769.col_2: A king among angry pike.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8770.name: blue corpse
8770.col_2: A king among wandering sculpin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8771.name: Mahar
8771.col_2: A king among rhamphorhynchus.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8772.name: shonisaurus
8772.col_2: Within this legendary scalekin's body can be found a massive secondary bladder containing lighter-than-air gas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8773.name: magicked mushroom
8773.col_2: A king among mushroom crabs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

8774.name: giant takitaro
8774.col_2: A king among takitaro.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8775.name: namitaro
8775.col_2: This legendary freshwater fish cares not for those kings or queens who encroach upon his territory, and will turn to regicide to keep his waters his own.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

8776.name: blood red bonytongue
8776.col_2: A king among bonytongue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

8777.name: south seas armchair
8777.col_2: A plush chair designed in the south seas style.

8778.name: south seas couch
8778.col_2: An L-shaped couch designed in the south seas style.

8779.name: riviera canopy bed
8779.col_2: A luxurious canopied bed designed in the riviera style.

8780.name: glade canopy bed
8780.col_2: A luxurious canopied bed designed in the glade style.

8781.name: oasis canopy bed
8781.col_2: A luxurious canopied bed designed in the oasis style.

8782.name: potted oliphant's ear
8782.col_2: A broad-leafed perennial common on south seas islands such as the Cieldalaes. The shape of the leaf is said to resemble the ear of a legendary beast twice as tall as a Roegadyn and ten times as heavy.

8783.name: shower stand
8783.col_2: A simple indoor shower, perfect for cleansing the body and spirit after a long day of adventure.

8784.name: head of the dreadwyrm
8784.col_2: An impressive objet d'art depicting the head of the dreadwyrm, Bahamut.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

8785.name: Syrcus tower
8785.col_2: An expertly crafted representation of the ancient crystalline tower.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

8786.name: riviera stool
8786.col_2: A quaint round stool designed in the riviera fashion.

8787.name: glade stool
8787.col_2: A quaint round stool designed in the glade fashion.

8788.name: oasis stool
8788.col_2: A quaint round stool designed in the oasis fashion.

8789.name: armoire
8789.col_2: A large wooden wardrobe in which sets of special gear may be stored.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

8790.name: masonwork stove
8790.col_2: A handcrafted stone stove similar to the ones found in the homes of the realm's smallfolk.

8791.name: eternity cake
8791.col_2: A family of four tended their gristmill for a full three turns of the sun to create enough flour to bake this massive tower cake.

8792.name: stack of empty twinkleboxes
8792.col_2: A twinklebox without a present is like a child without a smile.

8793.name: riviera open-shelf bookcase
8793.col_2: A backless bookshelf designed in the riviera fashion.

8794.name: glade open-shelf bookcase
8794.col_2: A backless bookshelf designed in the glade fashion.

8795.name: oasis open-shelf bookcase
8795.col_2: A backless bookshelf designed in the oasis fashion.

8796.name: shipping crate
8796.col_2: A sturdy wooden box once used to import exotics from across the boundless seas.

8797.name: wine barrel
8797.col_2: A wooden barrel once used to mature wine.

8798.name: incensory
8798.col_2: A ceramic censer into which aromatic herbs and oils are inserted and then heated to produce a fragrant smoke.

8799.name: pair of sheep dolls
8799.col_2: Two stuffed sheep─husband and wife─dressed in traditional Far Eastern garb.

8800.name: stack of hard rice cakes
8800.col_2: Known in the Far East as “kagami mochi,” these cakes are not traditionally eaten, but displayed before and during Heavensturn.

8801.name: stuffed Qiqirn
8801.col_2: A handmade doll crafted to resemble a Qiqirn, and dressed in a festive Starlight Celebration outfit.

8802.name: Starlight dodo
8802.col_2: A whole dodo stuffed with savory vegetables and slow-roasted on a spit. Often prepared near the end of the year as an offering to the Twelve.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 3)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +1<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

8803.name: pumpkin basket
8803.col_2: A pumpkin-shaped basket filled with All Saints' Wake goodies.

8804.name: Starlight cake
8804.col_2: Conceived by Bismarck chefs with far too much time on their hands, the Starlight cake is composed of layer after layer after layer...after layer of sweet, decadent heaven.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +1<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

8805.name: wall lantern
8805.col_2: A rectangular oil lamp for indoor use.

8806.name: manor sofa
8806.col_2: An extravagant sofa crafted from the rarest wood and finest cloth obtainable; no expense was spared for this Haukke Manor original.

8807.name: stuffed Mazlaya marlin
8807.col_2: As magnificent as the day it was caught, but without the unpleasant stench of decay.

8808.name: set of megalodon jaws
8808.col_2: The sheer size of these jawbones adds credit to rumors that megalodons enjoy feeding on unwary swimmers, and will swallow them whole so as not to saturate the surrounding waters with blood, thereby alerting other nearby predators.

8809.name: stuffed takitaro
8809.col_2: No more half-hearted tales about the one that got away. This legend of this rare, elusive fish will live on in style above your mantle or in your den.

8810.name: Starlight wreath
8810.col_2: A simple circle of evergreen branches hung on doors during the Starlight Celebration. While the tradition is fairly new, there already exist several theories as to how the practice started. Some believe the circle represents the symbolic beginning and end of a year, and in turn, our lives, while others claim it is merely easier to hang a ring than it is a straight branch.

8811.name: towel hanger
8811.col_2: Without a hanger, where would towels hang?

8812.name: set of Adventurers' Guild aduyses
8812.col_2: A semi-complete collection of notices and timetables, warnings and wanted posters, found in Eorzea's many Adventurers' Guilds.

8813.name: glade doormat
8813.col_2: A lawn-green welcome mat designed to complement glade residences.

8814.name: oasis doormat
8814.col_2: A welcome mat designed to complement oasis residences.

8815.name: large woven rug
8815.col_2: Try not to wipe your well-traveled feet on this luxurious import.

8816.name: large planter box
8816.col_2: A deep rectangular box for planting flowers or vegetables.

8817.name: riviera path light
8817.col_2: A small crystal-powered lantern designed in the riviera style used outdoors to light walkways.

8818.name: glade path light
8818.col_2: A small crystal-powered lantern designed in the glade style used outdoors to light walkways.

8819.name: oasis path light
8819.col_2: A small crystal-powered lantern designed in the oasis style used outdoors to light walkways.

8820.name: glade lamppost
8820.col_2: A lamppost of steel such as one might see lining a Gridanian street.

8821.name: oasis lamppost
8821.col_2: A lamppost of steel such as one might see lining an Ul'dahn street.

8822.name: pumpkin candlestand
8822.col_2: A decorated lamppost displayed during All Saints' Wake.

8823.name: star-topped Starlight sentinel
8823.col_2: A potted fir, decorated with a star-shaped ornament at its apex.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only one Starlight sentinel may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

8824.name: moon-topped Starlight sentinel
8824.col_2: A potted fir, decorated with a crescent moon-shaped ornament at its apex.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only one Starlight sentinel may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

8825.name: sun-topped Starlight sentinel
8825.col_2: A potted fir, decorated with a sun-shaped ornament at its apex.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only one Starlight sentinel may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

8826.name: snowman
8826.col_2: Garlean scholars have conducted extensive studies on the subject of why Eorzean snowmen are constructed of only two balls of snow rather than three─the number of choice throughout Ilsabard. The prevailing theory is that extensive studies should not have been conducted on said subject.

8827.name: stack of empty gift boxes
8827.col_2: A box without a gift is like a bird without a song.

8828.name: kadomatsu
8828.col_2: A mini-tower of sliced bamboo and pine branches─the kadomatsu is a Far Eastern oddity traditionally displayed at homes and in temples for the duration of Heavensturn.

8829.name: roll of eerie wallpaper
8829.col_2: Ready your estate for All Saints' Wake with this frightening-yet-festive interior wall covering.

8830.name: Starlight interior wall
8830.col_2: This wall bears a festive design certain to bring joy and cheer to all...until you finally get around to taking it down six moons later.

8831.name: masonwork interior wall
8831.col_2: A sturdy wall of locally quarried stones.

8832.name: unit of masonwork flooring
8832.col_2: A smooth stone floor guaranteed to stay cool in the summer and toe-numbingly cold in the winter.

8833.name: unit of checkered flooring
8833.col_2: Give your estate a modern feel with this quality flooring's contemporary pattern.

8834.name: unit of iron plate flooring
8834.col_2: Hammered steel flooring for those seeking an imperial feel to their residence.

8835.name: ice chandelier
8835.col_2: A breathtaking ceiling fixture crafted using tears taken from the Lady of Frost herself.

8836.name: diamond chandelier
8836.col_2: An awe-inspiring ceiling fixture crafted using tears taken from the Lady of Frost herself and imbued with magicks ancient and forbidden.

8837.name: expansion of duties permit
8837.col_2: An amendment to existing retainer employment contracts allowing for dispatchment on privately owned properties.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cottage, house, and mansion gardens can accommodate 1, 2, and 3 retainers, respectively.

8838.name: level 1 aetherial wheel stand
8838.col_2: A metal stand upon which aetherial wheels are placed and spun to charge. Holds one grade 1 wheel.<hex:02100103>※One stand per estate only.

8839.name: Soul of the Dark Knight
8839.col_2: Upon the surface of this multi-aspected crystal are carved the myriad deeds of dark knights from eras past.

8840.name: Soul of the Astrologian
8840.col_2: Upon the surface of this multi-aspected crystal are carved the myriad deeds of astrologians from eras past.

8841.name: phial of retainer Fantasia
8841.col_2: Legend states that any who drink this mysterious liquid before lying down for the evening will awaken a new man (or woman).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Grants you a single opportunity to edit your retainer's appearance when speaking to a retainer vocate.

8844.name: grade 1 wheel of confrontation
8844.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action The Heat of Battle (increased EXP earned through battle).

8845.name: grade 1 wheel of productivity
8845.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Earth and Water (increased EXP earned through gathering).

8846.name: grade 1 wheel of industry
8846.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Helping Hand (increased EXP earned through crafting).

8847.name: grade 1 wheel of longeing
8847.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action A Man's Best Friend (increased EXP earned by companions).

8848.name: grade 1 wheel of rivalry
8848.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Mark Up (increased Wolf Marks).

8849.name: grade 1 wheel of company
8849.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Seal Sweetener (increased company seals).

8850.name: grade 1 wheel of initiation
8850.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Brave New World (increased attributes for all Disciple of War or Magic members under level 25).

8851.name: grade 1 wheel of capacity
8851.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Live off the Land (increased Gathering).

8852.name: grade 1 wheel of observation
8852.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action What You See (increased Perception).

8853.name: grade 1 wheel of efficiency
8853.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Eat from the Hand (increased Craftsmanship).

8854.name: grade 1 wheel of precision
8854.col_2: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action In Control (increased Control).

Often referred to as black diamonds, the eggs are a delicacy that can only be afforded by the wealthiest of connoisseurs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)
