9348.col_2: This particular yeti is content in knowing that bigger is not always necessarily better.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Littlefoot minion.

9349.name: mummy's little mummy
9349.col_2: While as cute as a button, remember, mummies are ultimately embalmed corpses damned to eternal thralldom in the land of the living. Have fun.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mummy's little mummy minion.

9350.name: assassin fry
9350.col_2: There was an old betta who swallowed a fry. No one knows why it swallowed the fry, but for some reason, the fry can now fly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the assassin fry minion.

9351.name: water imp
9351.col_2: Legend states these strange creatures can only survive on land as long as the plate atop their heads remains wet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the water imp minion.

9352.name: wind-up Louisoix
9352.col_2: The Seventh Astral Era is secure as long as the Archon is ever at our sides.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Louisoix minion.

9353.name: parade chocobo whistle
9353.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by a chocobo trained from birth to recognize and respond to the sound. Use to summon your parade chocobo.

9354.name: Boreas whistle
9354.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon Boreas, the steed of legend.

9355.name: set of ice barding
9355.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Lady of Frost, Shiva.

9356.name: block of quick-hardening sealant
9356.col_2: A powerful adhesive developed and used by the Ehcatl Nine.

9357.name: bottle of Xelphatol spring water
9357.col_2: Slightly effervescent water bottled at a spring located deep in the heart of the Ixali homeland, Xelphatol. It has a light-blue tint and a distinctly metallic flavor.

9358.name: wootz ingot
9358.col_2: An ingot of smelted wootz alloy.

9359.name: platinum nugget
9359.col_2: A small nugget of impure platinum.

9361.name: circle of Kirimu leather
9361.col_2: A large piece of cured skin from the chimerical monstrosity Kirimu.

9362.name: bolt of Arachne velveteen
9362.col_2: Thick cloth woven from the web of the chimerical monstrosity Arachne.

9363.name: Allagan wootz nugget
9363.col_2: A small chunk of the alloy used by the Allagan Empire to craft heavy armor.

9364.name: circle of Allagan leather
9364.col_2: A large piece of treated chimerical leather used by the Allagan Empire to craft light armor.

9365.name: spindle of Allagan silk
9365.col_2: A spool of thick chimerical silk used by the Allagan Empire to craft mage robes.

9366.name: cluster of borax
9366.col_2: This soft lusterless crystal is believed to stay the hands of corruption and is used in the preservation of organics.

9367.name: Arachne web
9367.col_2: The wire-like web of the Allagan chimerical miscreation, Arachne.

9368.name: chunk of wootz ore
9368.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing naturally occurring wootz alloy.

9369.name: phial of Raziqsap
9369.col_2: Developed by a Near Eastern alchemist, this powder is used to harden platinum.

9370.name: pot of dubbin
9370.col_2: A greasy mixture of wax, oil, and tallow used for waterproofing and softening leather, while helping maintain its luster.

9371.name: rasher of smoked bacon
9371.col_2: A large side of boar, cured and then smoked. It is widely accepted across Eorzea that “everything goes better” with this flavorful meat.

9372.name: sack of roasted coffee beans
9372.col_2: Seeds harvested from the coffee plants which grow in volcanic mountainous soils, and then slow-roasted over an indirect flame for several bells to remove bitterness and bring out flavor.

9373.name: bottle of enchanted platinum ink
9373.col_2: Ink fortified with platinum sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

9374.name: pair of bloody knife blades
9374.col_2: A pair of blood-soaked blades retrieved from the site of a gruesome battle.

9375.name: pair of mossy stone daggers
9375.col_2: A pair of daggers crafted from giantsgall, a type of stone found on Thavnair. They are so covered in moss as to be rendered unusable.

9376.name: Allagan catalyst
9376.col_2: Dubbed a “god in the machina” by those who first discovered it, modern scholars have yet to discover not only what the catalytic agent contains, but exactly how it functions, understanding only that the substance is required to strengthen the properties of certain materials.

9377.name: ice tear
9377.col_2: A glass-like shard retrieved from the fallen Lady of Frost.

9378.name: diamond tear
9378.col_2: A glass-like shard retrieved from the fallen Lady of Frost. It pulses with uncontrollably powerful ice-aspected energies.

9379.name: Syrcus shard
9379.col_2: A remarkably transparent piece of Syrcus Tower's outer wall.

9380.name: burning auricle
9380.col_2: A crystallized fragment of the dreadwyrm Bahamut's burning heart.

9383.name: Rowena's token (poetics)
9383.col_2: A note of promise received from Rowena for the delivery of Allagan tomestones of poetics. However, due to the House of Splendors changing its policies, it is now worth less than the paper on which it is scribed.

9384.name: encrypted tomestone
9384.col_2: While Garlond Ironworks engineers insist tomestones contain reams of invaluable information gathered by the lost Allagan Empire, even they are at a loss how to decipher the content of this particular one. This variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

9385.name: flask of carboncoat
9385.col_2: Born of Allagan ingenuity, this aetherochemical concoction is said to increase a gem's hardness. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

9386.name: loop of carbontwine
9386.col_2: Born of Allagan ingenuity, this aetherochemically engineered fiber can be used to improve the durability of almost anything. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

9387.name: antique helm
9387.col_2: While this headpiece is far too old and dented to survive any further battles, collectors have been known to pay sizable sums for similar pieces.

9388.name: suit of antique mail
9388.col_2: While this suit is far too old and battered to survive any further battles, collectors have been known to pay sizable sums for similar pieces.

9389.name: pair of antique gauntlets
9389.col_2: While these gauntlets are far too old and rusted to survive any further battles, collectors have been known to pay sizable sums for similar pieces.

9390.name: pair of antique breeches
9390.col_2: While this legwear is far too old and moth-eaten to survive any further battles, collectors have been known to pay sizable sums for similar pieces.

9391.name: pair of antique sollerets
9391.col_2: While this footwear is far too old and worn to survive any further battles, collectors have been known to pay sizable sums for similar pieces.

9392.name: set of antique tassets
9392.col_2: Collectors were once known to pay sizable sums for similar pieces. Alas, advancements in trouser technology have rendered these worthless.

9461.name: pair of misericorde blades
9461.col_2: Deadly darksteel blades used in the creation of misericordes.

9462.name: level 2 aetherial wheel stand
9462.col_2: A metal stand upon which aetherial wheels are placed and spun to charge. Holds one grade 1 and one grade 2 wheel.<hex:02100103>※One stand per estate only.

9463.name: level 3 aetherial wheel stand
9463.col_2: A metal stand upon which aetherial wheels are placed and spun to charge. Holds one grade 1, one grade 2, and one grade 3 wheel.<hex:02100103>※One stand per estate only.

9464.name: level 4 aetherial wheel stand
9464.col_2: A metal stand upon which aetherial wheels are placed and spun to charge. Holds two grade 1, one grade 2, and one grade 3 wheel.<hex:02100103>※One stand per estate only.

9465.name: level 5 aetherial wheel stand
9465.col_2: A metal stand upon which aetherial wheels are placed and spun to charge. Holds two grade 1, two grade 2, and one grade 3 wheel.<hex:02100103>※One stand per estate only.

9466.name: level 6 aetherial wheel stand
9466.col_2: A metal stand upon which aetherial wheels are placed and spun to charge. Holds three grade 1, two grade 2, and one grade 3 wheel.<hex:02100103>※One stand per estate only.

9491.col_2: One of the weapons wielded by the legendary Zodiac Braves.

9492.name: pair of Kaiser Knuckles
9492.col_2: One of the weapons wielded by the legendary Zodiac Braves.

9500.name: Aegis Shield
9500.col_2: One of the shields borne by the legendary Zodiac Braves.

9501.name: pair of Sasuke's blades
9501.col_2: Two of the weapons wielded by the legendary Zodiac Braves.

9502.name: magicked prism (petals)
9502.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a shower of ephemeral flower petals.

9503.name: magicked prism (bubbles)
9503.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a shower of delicate bubbles certain to impress any Eorzean crab.

9504.name: magicked prism (balloon)
9504.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Releases a single lighter-than-air balloon.

9505.name: magicked prism (heart)
9505.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Releases a single romantic heart-shaped balloon.

9506.name: copy of the Book of Skylight
9506.description: copies of the Book of Skylight
9506.col_2: A sacred tome depicting the valorous deeds of the Zodiac Braves, legendary heroes from a bygone era. This volume provides detailed descriptions of the mythical arms the men and women wielded.

9507.name: pinch of zodium
9507.col_2: As with dark matter, zodium has the faculty to assimilate with other forms of matter, effectively restoring them to their original condition. However, unlike dark matter, which will bond only with certain materials depending on its purity, zodium appears to bond with almost everything, leading one to entertain the notion that this substance mayhap serves as one of the building blocks of all creation.

9508.name: Zodiac scroll
9508.col_2: A sphere scroll designed to act as a receptacle for the soul energy stored within a relic weapon nexus.

9509.name: piece of flawless alexandrite
9509.col_2: A variety of dark matter that possesses light-altering properties. A quick inspection reveals not a single impurity.

9510.name: furnace ring
9510.col_2: Fitted with a powerful eye of fire gemstone, this magicked band can instantly produce a white-hot flame at the command of its wearer.

9511.name: bundle of perfect firewood
9511.col_2: This expertly dried cypress exhibits a high pitch content which significantly improves its ability to burn long and hot.

9512.name: perfect mortar
9512.col_2: Despite the fact this mortar has been carefully crafted to withstand the creation of highly volatile zodium, chances are it will not survive the process.

9513.name: perfect pestle
9513.col_2: Despite the fact this pestle has been carefully crafted to withstand the creation of highly volatile zodium, chances are it will not survive the process.

9514.name: page of perfect vellum
9514.col_2: Meticulous pouncing has ensured that any ink applied to this dried calfskin will adhere without fail.

9515.name: pinch of perfect pounce
9515.col_2: An alchemical powder of a highly resinous texture used to not only prevent ink from spreading when applied to vellum, but to also maintain a high level of aetherial conductivity.

9516.name: tailor-made eel pie
9516.col_2: The acetic odor emitted by this specially crafted pastry will turn away all but the most loyal of eel pie enthusiasts.

9517.name: piece of perfect cloth
9517.col_2: A better balance of warp and weft has not been seen for centuries.

9518.name: cypress log
9518.col_2: A rough-cut log of cypress timber.

9519.name: piece of pumice
9519.col_2: Volcanic rock riddled with countless tiny holes which make the stone remarkably lighter than it appears. Parchment makers rub the pieces on vellum to prepare the pages for receiving ink.

9521.name: piece of Belah'dian silver
9521.col_2: Discovered buried deep within Belah'dian ruins, this surprisingly heat-resistant silver appears to have been tempered using a technique now lost to modern goldsmiths.

9522.name: aged eye of fire
9522.col_2: A stone sphere elementally aspected to fire. A good polishing will be required to restore it to its former luster.

9523.name: aged spear shaft
9523.col_2: Seasoned over countless years of use, this worn shaft may no longer be suitable for use in battle, but it will most definitely burn nicely in a fire.

9524.name: collection of aged mortar pieces
9524.col_2: A beautiful mortar that has, unfortunately, been split into several pieces. It is, however, not beyond repair─a testament to the skill of the original crafter.

9525.name: collection of aged pestle pieces
9525.col_2: A beautiful pestle that has, unfortunately, been split into several pieces. It is, however, not beyond repair─a testament to the skill of the original crafter.

9526.name: page of aged vellum
9526.col_2: A single sheet of what appears to be magicked uterine vellum torn from a quire bound within an ancient tome.

9527.name: pinch of dried ether
9527.col_2: Dry, flaky residue found at the bottom of a bottle of evaporated ether.

9528.name: onze of vintage cooking sherry
9528.col_2: Fine Lominsan white wine fortified with grape spirit and allowed to mature to the point of perfection, though the flavor may be too strong for weaker palates.

9529.name: piece of stained cloth
9529.col_2: A beautiful piece of cloth that appears to have been dragged through the mud, dipped in sheep offal, and then forgotten in a latrine.

9530.name: aged ring
9530.col_2: An antiquated ring of unknown origin.

9531.name: aged spear
9531.col_2: An antiquated spear of unknown origin.

9532.name: aged mortar
9532.col_2: An antiquated mortar of unknown origin.

9533.name: aged pestle
9533.col_2: An antiquated pestle of unknown origin.

9534.name: aged grimoire
9534.col_2: An antiquated grimoire of unknown origin.

9535.name: aged phial
9535.col_2: An antiquated phial of unknown origin.

9536.name: aged decanter
9536.col_2: An antiquated decanter of unknown origin.

9537.name: aged robe
9537.col_2: An antiquated robe of unknown origin.

9538.name: Bronze Lake crystal
9538.col_2: Discovered growing on the floor of Bronze Lake, this heretofore unseen aetherial formation appears to be impossibly aspected to two different elements─wind and water.

9539.name: Bombard core
9539.col_2: Gathered from the smoldering carcass of a Bombard during the most recent invasion and carefully stored in an underground cellar, this core remains red-hot despite being long removed from its owner.

9540.name: bottle of sacred spring water
9540.col_2: Bottled from a spring found atop one of the Far East's holiest peaks, this water is believed to contain a vast amount of highly concentrated aetherial energy.

9541.name: magicked prism (wings)
9541.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a pair of seraphic wings.

9542.name: lump of Allagan resin
9542.col_2: A multi-purpose aetherochemical concoction devised by the Allagans for use in many of their creations.

9543.name: handful of furite sand
9543.col_2: Midnight black sand consisting of tiny grains of the rare ore furite.

9544.name: brass kettle
9544.col_2: A stunning teapot─neither too short, nor too stout─forged by master craftsman Gerolt in his never-ending pursuit of the perfect kettle.

9545.name: promise of innocence (standard)
9545.col_2: This wristlet signifies a standard agreement between two individuals to form an everlasting spiritual union. To use, both individuals must equip their promise wristlets, form a two-member party, and then speak with ceremony planner Claribel at the Sanctum of the Twelve.

9546.name: promise of passion (gold)
9546.col_2: This wristlet signifies a gold-clad agreement between two individuals to form an everlasting spiritual union. To use, both individuals must equip their promise wristlets, form a two-member party, and then speak with ceremony planner Claribel at the Sanctum of the Twelve.

9547.name: promise of devotion (platinum)
9547.col_2: This wristlet signifies a platinum-clad agreement between two individuals to form an everlasting spiritual union. To use, both individuals must equip their promise wristlets, form a two-member party, and then speak with ceremony planner Claribel at the Sanctum of the Twelve.

9559.name: piece of diamond dust
9559.col_2: An icy crystal that harbors the power of the Lady of Frost.

9560.name: proof of covering
9560.col_2: An official deed documenting the covering of two select breeding chocobos, and granting ownership of the fledgling born of said coupling. The fledgling can be collected after the date specified above.

9717.name: pine bonsai
9717.col_2: While some view this traditional Doman gardening technique as naught more than a reflection of man's arrogance in believing nature can be bent to his will, most simply find it a beautiful and calming form of art.

9718.name: longcase chronometer
9718.col_2: A precision instrument for telling time. Its towering silhouette adds a touch of gravitas to the ambience of any room.

9719.name: oriental bathtub
9719.col_2: A large bathtub designed in the Doman fashion.

9720.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Frolicking Beasts<hex:021A020103>
9720.col_2: A folding partition commonly found in Far East nations. Upon one side is a reproduction of an ancient Doman wall painting depicting a variety of beastkin in their natural habitat.

9722.name: kotatsu table
9722.col_2: A table designed in the Doman fashion. The underside has been treated with strange Eastern magicks to emit heat during the winter months.

9723.name: crate of wax vegetables
9723.col_2: While far less nutritious than real vegetables, these wax replicas will look nicer in your pantry.

9724.name: guildleve counter
9724.col_2: A counter designed to replicate those found in Adventurers' Guilds across Eorzea. This model comes complete with a built-in light that can be used to illuminate leve plates.

9726.name: glade tea set
9726.col_2: For the denizens of the Twelveswood, the consumption of tea is a means of relaxing the mind, allowing for uninhibited communion with nature.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 7)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9727.name: riviera supper
9727.col_2: While for most La Nosceans supper consists of huddling around a fire pit while sopping up a splash of rancid fish stew with a hunk of moldy bread, those who have found their fortune on the seas prefer a multiple-course extravaganza certain to leave even the most wealthy Ul'dahn speechless.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 4)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 5)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9728.name: oasis breakfast
9728.col_2: Considered the most important of the day's seven meals (preceding both pre-midday mead and eleventh bell tarts), the Ul'dahn elite rarely miss this opportunity to gorge themselves before moving on to the next opportunity to gorge themselves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 21)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 13)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9729.name: assortment of scattered documents
9729.col_2: This pile of parchment appears to be pages taken from <hex:021A020203>The Last Paean<hex:021A020103>─a detailed account of the life and times of a legendary bard who traveled the realm bringing joy to all he met. Strewn across one's bureau, the documents give any library or study a heightened air of sophistication.

9730.name: oriental altar
9730.col_2: A miniature wooden altar hung in Doman houses, allowing people to worship the gods within the privacy of their own homes.

9731.name: oriental wall scroll
9731.col_2: Upon this ornamental scroll is painted the Doman character “jin,” meaning “mankind.”

9732.name: oriental partition
9732.col_2: A partition designed in the Doman fashion, reaching to the ceiling and so sturdy that it may as well be a wall.

9733.name: dead man's chest
9733.col_2: “If the <hex:021A020203>man<hex:021A020103> who once owned the <hex:021A020203>chest<hex:021A020103> is now <hex:021A020203>dead<hex:021A020103>, he won't mind anyone else using it.” Such was the logic employed when removing this sturdy treasure coffer from Sastasha.

9734.name: oak low barrel planter
9734.col_2: A barrel planter crafted from oak.

9735.name: Valentione's cake
9735.col_2: A decadent chocolate cake emblazoned with the House Valentione coat of arms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 18)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9736.name: royal partition
9736.col_2: A luxurious partition designed to resemble those used in the sultana's palace.

9737.name: Order of Nald'thal lectern
9737.col_2: A carved wooden podium not unlike the ones used by the Order of Nald'thal to deliver their sermons.

9738.name: green tea set
9738.col_2: Far more bitter than its black counterpart, green tea is by far the beverage of choice in Far Eastern Doma. To offset the sharpness of its flavor, it is oft accompanied by something sweet, such as sticky rice cakes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 13)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9739.name: dried well
9739.col_2: Have you dreamed of owning your very own well, but are plagued by one or more of the following psychological ailments: acrophobia, claustrophobia, aquaphobia, bathophobia, or cleithrophobia? Well fear no longer. This quality stone well, manufactured in Eorzea with 100% Eorzean materials, requires no hole to be dug, no ground to be sanctified, and no chain letters to be passed along to your dearest enemies.

9740.name: oriental striking dummy
9740.col_2: A striking dummy designed in the Doman fashion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

9741.name: Eastern cherry tree
9741.col_2: A variety of cherry tree from the Far East modified through generations of grafting and crossbreeding to bloom perpetually.

9742.name: crimson felt mat
9742.col_2: A square sheet of crimson-colored felt upon which dolls are displayed for Little Ladies' Day.

9743.name: flame of passion
9743.col_2: Outdoor lighting certain to heat up any relationship.

9744.name: wild banana tree
9744.col_2: A green, leafy tree transplanted from an island in the Cieldalaes. The word “banana” is actually a bastardization of “pamama,” the term used in the fruit's native habitat.

9745.name: personal astroscope
9745.col_2: A miniature astroscope used by aspiring astrologians to peer into the farthest reaches of the firmament.

9746.name: riviera garden table set
9746.col_2: A round outdoor table and matching chairs designed in the riviera fashion.

9747.name: dodo's nest
9747.col_2: Though their beady eyes and awkward walk give them an air of unintelligence, dodos are actually quite clever creatures. A mother dodo will, when creating a nest, first dry grass in the sun for several days before adding it to the pile, so as to prevent the growth of molds harmful to her offspring.

9748.name: retainer cartonnier
9748.col_2: A wooden receptacle for use by retainers to store goods entrusted for sale while protecting them from the elements.<hex:02100103>※Can only be placed outdoors.

9749.name: retainer counter
9749.col_2: A wooden counter for use by retainers.<hex:02100103>※Can only be placed outdoors.

9766.name: spotted interior wall
9766.col_2: An interior wall bespeckled with a hypnotically random pattern of colorful dots certain to drive any sane man to his wit's end.

9767.name: wavy interior wall
9767.col_2: An interior wall covered from top to bottom in colorful wavy lines certain to induce seasickness in even the most hardened sailor.

9768.name: unit of tatami flooring
9768.col_2: Woven from sweet-smelling rush grass, tatami flooring is the perfect complement to any home furnished in the Doman fashion.

9769.name: unit of monochrome flooring
9769.col_2: Marble floor tiling alternately colored black and white.

9770.name: unit of oasis cobble flooring
9770.col_2: Cobbles commonly used in Ul'dahn roadways and plazas.

9771.name: star chandelier
9771.col_2: Ceiling-mounted lighting expertly crafted to resemble the moon and stars.

10071.name: model magitek bit
10071.col_2: An exact 1:9 scale replica of a ceruleum-powered magitek bit (Ultima Weapon action figure not included).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the model magitek bit minion.

10072.name: puff of Darkness
10072.col_2: When standing nearby, prithee refrain from coughing, sneezing, waving, flailing, or performing any other means of wild gesticulation, lest the puff be lost for eternity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the puff of Darkness minion.

10073.name: wind-up gentleman
10073.col_2: If “clockwork Hildibrand” doesn't quite roll off the tongue, both “minion of enquiry” and “mammet extraordinaire” are acceptable alternatives.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up gentleman minion.

10074.name: wind-up Alphinaud
10074.col_2: Perfect for international summits, family get-togethers, pre- or post-battle gatherings, or any other occasion where the recapitulation of past occurrences is absolutely, positively necessary.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Alphinaud minion.

10075.name: wind-up Alisaie
10075.col_2: For those who believe the better half deserves more time in the spotlight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Alisaie minion.

10076.name: Enkidu
10076.col_2: That green is not coming out, even with multiple washings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Enkidu minion.

10077.name: platinum Triad card
10077.col_2: One of twelve unbelievably high rarity Triple Triad cards.

10078.name: adamantoise whistle
10078.col_2: A small polished whistle carved from thick turtle shell. Emits a low-pitched tone which summons an adamantoise mount to your side.

10079.name: Fenrir horn
10079.col_2: A gilded horn that, when blown, summons a purebred Abalathian hoarhound mount named after its pack's legendary leader.

10080.name: Kirin fife
10080.col_2: A magicked pipe that, when blown, summons the mythical Kirin to your side.

10081.name: logistics system identification key
10081.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your reprogrammed logistics system will magically bring the machine to life.

10082.name: set of paramour barding
10082.col_2: A gaudy suit of chocobo armor designed for use during Valentione's Day celebrations.

10083.name: set of gambler barding
10083.col_2: Chocobo armor designed to replicate the lavish accoutrements of a legendary gambler.

10084.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Ponytails<hex:021A020103>
10084.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques on tying the perfect ponytail.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

10085.name: Gold Saucer ticket
10085.col_2: Redeem for one free play at any of the Manderville Gold Saucer mini attractions (Jumbo Cactpot, Mini Cactpot, chocobo racing, and Triple Triad not included).

10086.name: phial of tinker's calm
10086.col_2: A tonic commonly used by Disciples of the Hand to increase focus, allowing for enhanced results when deconstructing complex creations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10m

10087.name: lucky egg
10087.col_2: A plain white Archon egg believed to bring its bearer good luck as long as it remains uncracked.

10088.name: Nanapasi's Happy Smile Super Wish Bag
10088.description: Nanapasi's Happy Smile Super Wish Bags
10088.col_2: Nanapasi originally wished to name his gift-filled sack the “Happy Smile Super Challenge Family Wish Bag,” but it would not fit neatly on one line, forcing him to compromise.
10088.col_3: Nanapasi's Happy Smile Super Wish Bag

10089.name: sack of moth-eaten doll parts
10089.col_2: A collection of antique dolls dating back to the Thorne Dynasty. The miniature costumes are in a sorry state, most being moth-eaten and threadbare.

10090.name: splintered chest
10090.col_2: This chest, rumored to have once been stored aboard the <hex:021A020203>Haar<hex:021A020103>─the flagship of the dread pirate Mistbeard─appears to have been not-so-gently pried open with a headsman's axe.

10091.name: wild banana shoot
10091.col_2: Under the proper conditions, this seedling will grow into a tree almost ten fulms high, and produce upwards of four score bananas per season.

10092.name: slab of black limestone
10092.col_2: When polished, this rare form of limestone closely resembles marble.

10093.name: virgin basilisk egg
10093.col_2: While all eggs a basilisk lays contain traces of rare ore, the first egg laid in life is thought to contain the highest concentration, making it highly sought after by potion mixers and alchemists.

10094.name: little worm
10094.col_2: While commonly used as bait by fishers across the realm, little worms also make fine chocobo feed, providing a good source of protein for growing birds.

10095.name: gregarious worm
10095.col_2: A rare form of earthworm, these fat invertebrates also make fine chocobo feed, providing an excellent source of protein for growing birds.

10096.name: sprig of rosemary
10096.col_2: A savory herb treasured for its ability to enhance focus and concentration.

10097.name: tuft of Yafaemi wildgrass
10097.col_2: After gysahl greens, there's no other verdure a race chocobo would rather sink its beak into.

10098.name: bunch of Mazlaya greens
10098.col_2: Once found growing all across the island of Mazlaya, this bright-green plant was almost completely wiped out when chocobos brought to the island by farmers devoured nearly every one they could find.

10099.name: unaspected crystal
10099.col_2: For reasons unknown to you, this crystal has completely lost its elemental charge.

10100.name: petrified orb
10100.col_2: A perfect sphere carved from a petrified tree and polished to enhance its natural luster.

10101.name: pair of mummer's daggers
10101.col_2: A decorated pair of knives used by mummers in their traveling grotesqueries. The blades have been dulled to prevent injury.

10102.name: lapdog collar bell
10102.col_2: A tiny copper bell commonly affixed to the collars of Ul'dahn lapdogs to inform owners the location of their precious pets.

10103.name: fluorite lens
10103.col_2: Carved from a shard of clear fluorite, this lens exhibits higher optical performance than a normal glass lens.

10104.name: circle of patent leather
10104.col_2: Saurian leather that has been treated with linseed oil to give it a glossy black finish.

10105.name: length of camlet
10105.col_2: An expensive fabric woven from camel hair. Imitations are common, though this piece appears to be legitimate.

10106.name: vial of enchanted quicksilver
10106.col_2: This sample of hydrargyrum has been imbued with powerful magicks.

10107.name: pot of duck broth
10107.col_2: While this broth can be made by simply boiling down the bones of a duck, true culinarians make it a point to brown the bones before adding them to a mixture of savory vegetables and fresh spring water.

10108.name: Talan's seal of mining mastery
10108.col_2: A document bearing master crafter Talan's personal seal. Can be presented in exchange for unparalleled mining equipment.

10109.name: Talan's seal of botany mastery
10109.col_2: A document bearing master crafter Talan's personal seal. Can be presented in exchange for unparalleled botanist's equipment.

10110.name: Talan's seal of fishing mastery
10110.col_2: A document bearing master crafter Talan's personal seal. Can be presented in exchange for unparalleled fishing equipment.

10112.name: pot of urushi
10112.col_2: Made from the caustic sap of lacquer trees native to the Far East, urushi is used to protect wood by giving it a hard, glossy finish.

10113.name: composite whetstone
10113.col_2: A heavy whetstone that appears to be man-made, rather than carved from naturally occurring rock.

10114.name: pot of heat-resistant plaster
10114.col_2: Due to its heat-resistant properties, this plaster is oft used to create molds for metalworking.

10115.name: clear fluorite
10115.col_2: A rare form of fluorite completely devoid of any interior flaws.

10116.name: pot of lampblack linseed oil
10116.col_2: Linseed oil mixed with soot collected from oil lamps to give it a deep-black color.

10117.name: tuft of camel hair
10117.col_2: Thick, brown hair of a Near Eastern monstrosity known as the camel. Dubious reports from sailors claim the beast stands thrice as high as a chocobo, can speak the tongues of man, and has massive humps upon its back which may contain water, wine, or even gold.

10118.name: onze of black cinnabar
10118.col_2: A form of cinnabar known to contain traces of quicksilver.

10119.name: pile of duck bones
10119.col_2: It is an oft-forgotten fact that Frandelont Raimdelle, famed naturalist, father of modern taxonomy, and author of the Raimdelle Codex, tried multiple times (without success) to classify the common duck─most obviously a cloudkin─as a spoken, believing their incessant quackings to be a highly developed language beyond the comprehension of mankind.

10120.name: piece of magicked oilcloth
10120.col_2: Linen cloth treated with magicked oil. When wrapped about ore or metal, it prevents the slow yet gradual diffusion of elemental charge from the material.

10121.name: sheet of bamboo paper
10121.col_2: Thinly sliced bamboo used to preserve the aroma of rare fragrant wood.

10122.name: glacier crystal
10122.col_2: A crystal aspected to both ice and water. House chefs for wealthy and noble families will oft use these rare specimens to chill ales and white wines during the summer moons.

10123.name: gigant clam
10123.col_2: An especially large giant clam. Local fisher estimates put the age of this wavekin at over five score years.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

10124.name: moonstone
10124.col_2: A type of mineral that, when polished, emits an eerie blue glow not unlike the moon while under the influence of Thaliak.

10127.name: unstained mark log
10127.col_2: A list of elite marks slain by the log's owner...before the owner herself...fled the battlefield to hunt another day. Though such documents were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

10128.name: bronze Triad card
10128.col_2: One of fifteen low rarity Triple Triad cards.

10129.name: silver Triad card
10129.col_2: One of fourteen medium rarity Triple Triad cards.

10130.name: gold Triad card
10130.col_2: One of fifteen high rarity Triple Triad cards.

10131.name: MGP voucher
10131.col_2: Redeemable for 100 Manderville Gold Saucer points (MGP).

10146.name: better crowned pie
10146.col_2: A galette-style pie decorated with a golden crown and served at Ishgardian festivals. Baked using Talan's own special recipe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

10147.name: sack of grade 2 feed - special speed blend
10147.description: sacks of grade 2 feed - special speed blend
10147.col_2: A secret blend of cereals and leafy greens believed to improve a race chocobo's maximum speed.

10148.name: sack of grade 2 feed - special acceleration blend
10148.description: sacks of grade 2 feed - special acceleration blend
10148.col_2: A secret blend of cereals and leafy greens believed to improve a race chocobo's acceleration.

10149.name: sack of grade 2 feed - special balance blend
10149.description: sacks of grade 2 feed - special balance blend
10149.col_2: A secret blend of cereals and leafy greens believed to improve a race chocobo's cunning.

10150.name: sack of grade 2 feed - special endurance blend
10150.description: sacks of grade 2 feed - special endurance blend
10150.col_2: A secret blend of cereals and leafy greens believed to improve a race chocobo's endurance.

10151.name: sack of grade 2 feed - special stamina blend
10151.description: sacks of grade 2 feed - special stamina blend
10151.col_2: A secret blend of cereals and leafy greens believed to improve a race chocobo's stamina.

10155.name: tank of ceruleum
10155.col_2: Airship-grade refined ceruleum. Required to fuel vessels traveling to the Sea of Clouds on exploratory voyages. Can also be used in submersibles on subaquatic voyages.

10156.name: Bronco-type hull
10156.col_2: A reliable hull used in most Highwind Skyways airships.

10157.name: Invincible-type hull
10157.col_2: A large hull adapted from those used in seafaring galleys.

10158.name: Enterprise-type hull
10158.col_2: A hull designed by Cid for use in his personal airship the <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103>.

10159.name: Invincible II-type hull
10159.col_2: A modified version of the Invincible-type hull, redesigned to reduce wind resistance.

10160.name: Odyssey-type hull
10160.col_2: The reinforced keel of this unique airship is specially tailored to long voyages.

10161.name: Tatanora-type hull
10161.col_2: Named after the “father” of propeller-powered airships, the design used in this hull is certain to invoke a sense of inspiring nostalgia.

10162.name: Bronco-type sail
10162.col_2: A simple yet highly durable sheet of thick canvas designed to serve both as a receptacle for lighter-than-air ceruleum gas, as well as a sail to assist propulsion.

10163.name: set of Invincible-type propellers
10163.col_2: Airship lift is achieved by the rapid spinning of ceruleum-powered propellers mounted atop masts placed around the fore and aft decks.

10164.name: Enterprise-type bladder
10164.col_2: The unique shape of this ceruleum gas bladder directs the flow of air around it, reducing wind resistance.

10165.name: set of Invincible II-type propellers
10165.col_2: Speed and flight stability have been increased by adding auxiliary propulsive wings to the ship's masts.

10166.name: pair of Odyssey-type bladders
10166.col_2: Separate gas regulation control over each bladder allows for increased navigational efficiency.

10167.name: set of Tatanora-type propellers
10167.col_2: Taking inspiration from the aether-manipulating flying fish found in the Sea of Clouds, these radical new propellers have been treated with wind-aspected crystals, allowing for increased lift.

10168.name: Bronco-type forecastle
10168.col_2: The simply crafted front half of a Bronco-type airship, including the main deck and bowsprit.

10169.name: Invincible-type forecastle
10169.col_2: The sturdily built front half of an Invincible-type airship, including the main deck, bowsprit, and a towering foremast.

10170.name: Enterprise-type forecastle
10170.col_2: The front half of an Enterprise-type airship, including the main deck, bowsprit, and extra lighting to improve nighttime navigation.

10171.name: Invincible II-type forecastle
10171.col_2: The front half of an Invincible II-type airship, including the main deck, bowsprit, and a towering foremast. Wooden parts have been replaced with lightweight metal to improve vessel durability.

10172.name: Odyssey-type forecastle
10172.col_2: The front half of an Odyssey-type airship, including the main deck, bowsprit, an extended hold, and specially designed cooling pipes.

10173.name: Tatanora-type forecastle
10173.col_2: The front half of a Tatanora-type airship, including the main deck, bowsprit, and banks for extra propellers.

10174.name: Bronco-type aftcastle
10174.col_2: The simply crafted rear half of a Bronco-type airship, including the poop deck, ceruleum engine, tiller, and rudder.

10175.name: Invincible-type aftcastle
10175.col_2: The sturdily built rear half of an Invincible-type airship, including the quarter and poop decks, tiller, rudder, ceruleum engine, and two propeller masts.

10176.name: Enterprise-type aftcastle
10176.col_2: The rear half of an Enterprise-type airship, including the quarter and poop decks, tiller, rudder, ceruleum engine, and an all-purpose crane for extracting items, or on rare occasions, people in distress.

10177.name: Invincible II-type aftcastle
10177.col_2: The rear half of an Invincible II-type airship, including the quarter and poop decks, tiller, rudder, ceruleum engine, and an all-purpose crane equipped with powerful claws.

10178.name: Odyssey-type aftcastle
10178.col_2: The rear half of an Odyssey-type airship, including the poop deck, tiller, rudder, and an experimental aetherial propulsion engine.

10179.name: Tatanora-type aftcastle
10179.col_2: The rear half of a Tatanora-type airship, including the quarter and poop decks, tiller, rudder, ceruleum engine, and tailplane for improved maneuverability.

10202.description: pairs of antiquated aoidos' shoulder gloves

10207.description: pairs of antiquated orison fingerless gloves

10222.description: pairs of antiquated savant's aethercell gloves

10307.name: Centurio Seal
10307.col_2: Currency minted by Clan Centurio and distributed as requital for the successful completion of Clan Hunt bills.

10308.name: blue crafters' scrip
10308.col_2: Currency paid to Disciples of the Hand by Rowena's House of Splendors in exchange for services rendered. Can be used to purchase items from the aforementioned establishment. Not valid anywhere else on Hydaelyn.

10309.name: red crafters' scrip
10309.col_2: Currency paid to Disciples of the Hand by Rowena's House of Splendors in exchange for services rendered. Can be used to purchase items from the aforementioned establishment. Not valid anywhere else on Hydaelyn.

10310.name: blue gatherers' scrip
10310.col_2: Currency paid to Disciples of the Land by Rowena's House of Splendors in exchange for services rendered. Can be used to purchase items from the aforementioned establishment. Not valid anywhere else on Hydaelyn.

10311.name: red gatherers' scrip
10311.col_2: Currency paid to Disciples of the Land by Rowena's House of Splendors in exchange for services rendered. Can be used to purchase items from the aforementioned establishment. Not valid anywhere else on Hydaelyn.

10322.name: Doman whetstone
10322.col_2: A smooth black stone used in the Far East to sharpen blades. Recommended for the upkeep of Doman weapons. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

10323.name: pot of Doman urushi
10323.col_2: A thick black resin used in the Far East to treat wood and metal. Recommended for the upkeep of Doman battle gear. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

10324.name: pot of raw Doman urushi
10324.col_2: A thick amber resin used in the Far East to treat wood and metal. Recommended for the upkeep of Doman accessories. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

10325.name: flask of Illuminati gobdip
10325.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of the realm's more daring blacksmiths have applied the unnaturally viscous substance to a variety of weapons and found that it heightens the attributes of certain ancient martial artifacts. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

10326.name: loop of Illuminati gobtwine
10326.col_2: An alchemical thread woven in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of the realm's more daring weavers have applied the unnaturally pliable substance to a variety of vestments and found that it heightens the attributes of certain ancient martial artifacts. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

10327.name: flask of Illuminati gobcoat
10327.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of the realm's more daring goldsmiths have applied the unnaturally illuminated substance to a variety of gems and found that it heightens the attributes of certain ancient martial artifacts. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

10332.name: serving of battered fish
10332.col_2: Deep-fried and accompanied by a generous portion of thick cut popotoes. Most delicious when sprinkled with a dash of malt vinegar.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

10333.name: Faire voucher MMXV
10333.col_2: Currency minted and distributed by the Adventurers' Guild for use during the Moonfire Faire.

10335.name: dark matter cluster
10335.col_2: This substance of unknown origin has the faculty to assimilate with other forms of matter, effectively restoring them to their original condition. Pieces this large are quite rare.

10336.name: Soul of the Crafter
10336.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of crafters from eras past.

10337.name: Soul of the Carpenter
10337.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of carpenters from eras past.

10338.name: Soul of the Blacksmith
10338.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of blacksmiths from eras past.

10339.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of armorers from eras past.

10340.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of goldsmiths from eras past.

10341.name: Soul of the Leatherworker

10342.name: Soul of the Weaver
10342.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of weavers from eras past.

10343.name: Soul of the Alchemist
10343.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of alchemists from eras past.

10344.name: Soul of the Culinarian
10344.col_2: Upon the back of this crystal plaque are engraved the myriad creations of culinarians from eras past.

10345.name: MGS interior wall
10345.col_2: An interior wall of the same design as those used to furnish the Manderville Gold Saucer.

10346.name: stained crystal interior wall
10346.col_2: An interior wall fitted with countless colorful stained crystal panels.

10347.name: set of MGS flooring
10347.col_2: Floorboards and carpeting of the same colorful design as those used to furnish the Manderville Gold Saucer.

10348.name: set of monochrome MGS flooring
10348.col_2: Black-and-white floorboards and carpeting of the same design as those used to furnish the Manderville Gold Saucer.

10349.name: magnificent mogdelier
10349.col_2: Marvelously majestic lighting worthy of a moogle king.

10350.name: Hive ceiling fan
10350.col_2: A ceiling-mounted fan created with the wings of the Gnathic primal Ravana.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

10351.name: deep Hive ceiling fan
10351.col_2: A ceiling-mounted fan created with the wings of the Gnathic primal Ravana. It literally hums with the Lord of the Hive's untamed power.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

10361.name: set of small merchant's walls
10361.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into an item shop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

10362.name: set of medium merchant's walls
10362.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into an item shop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

10363.name: set of large merchant's walls
10363.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into an item shop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

10364.name: set of small eatery walls
10364.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a restaurant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

10365.name: set of medium eatery walls
10365.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a restaurant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

10366.name: set of large eatery walls
10366.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a restaurant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

10367.name: set of small outfitter's walls
10367.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a gear shop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

12040.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Bomb Dance<hex:021A020103>
12040.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Bomb Dance<hex:021A020103>
12040.col_2: An illustrated manual of the various steps that comprise the festive bomb dance. Use to learn the /bombdance emote.

12041.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Improper Greetings<hex:021A020103>
12041.col_2: An illustrated manual of vulgar greeting customs from faraway lands. Use to learn the /fistbump emote.

12042.name: heavenscracker
12042.col_2: An unexpected by-product of the Skysteel Manufactory's recent endeavors to develop a more volatile variety of firesand. Happy Moonfire Faire!

12044.name: set of Primogs
12044.col_2: The <hex:021A020203>only<hex:021A020103> mechanical musicians this side of Black Tea Brook...making them the <hex:021A020203>greatest<hex:021A020103> mechanical musicians this side of Black Tea Brook.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Primogs minion.

12045.name: chocobo chick courier
12045.col_2: It may not be in your best interest to entrust him with any important missives just yet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the chocobo chick courier minion.

12046.name: wind-up Kain
12046.col_2: A few moments may be needed to allow him to regain control of himself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Kain minion.

12047.name: wind-up Tataru
12047.col_2: Prepare to have your heart melt.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Tataru minion.

12048.name: wind-up Cid
12048.col_2: When asked, if he had a granddaughter, what would he like to see her named, the Ironworks founder replied, “Gertrude.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Cid minion.

12049.name: unicolt
12049.col_2: Because two horns are not always better than one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the unicolt minion.

12050.name: wind-up Gundu warrior
12050.col_2: He weighs far less than he appears.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Gundu warrior minion.

12051.name: atrophied Atomos
12051.col_2: Putting money where this voidsent's mouth is merely results in devoured money.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the atrophied Atomos minion.

12052.name: owlet
12052.col_2: Who needs eyes in the back of their head when you can spin your head full circle?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the owlet minion.

12053.name: ugly duckling
12053.col_2: Will he turn into a graceful swan? Inquiring minds want to know.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the ugly duckling minion.

12054.name: gaelikitten
12054.col_2: Rumors that the gods kill one of these adorable creatures every time a young man thinks pleasurable thoughts are unfounded.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the gaelikitten minion.

12055.name: clockwork barrow
12055.col_2: Take a load off your shoulders. You deserve it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the clockwork barrow minion.

12056.name: lesser panda
12056.col_2: Lesser only in size to normal pandas. And in life expectancy. And intelligence. And fluffiness. Well, perhaps not fluffiness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the lesser panda minion.

12057.name: page 63
12057.col_2: A detailed recapitulation of the preceding sixty-two pages is not necessary to fully enjoy the content of the sixty-third.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the page 63 minion.

12058.name: iron dwarf
12058.col_2: He prefers the term “little iron person.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the iron dwarf minion.

12059.name: griffin hatchling
12059.col_2: Not to be confused with a gryphon hatchling, a griffon hatchling, a gryfon hatchling, or a gryphus hatchling.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the griffin hatchling minion.

12060.name: wind-up Iceheart
12060.col_2: Too hot to handle, too cold to hold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Iceheart minion.

12061.name: Gestahl
12061.col_2: He's a cute puppy dog. Yes, he is. Yes, he is a cute puppy dog. A cute puppy dog, yes, he is. Awww, such a cute puppy dog... Yes...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Gestahl minion.

12062.name: steam-powered gobwalker G-VII
12062.col_2: Gobwalker exhaust can be used to steam hams.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the steam-powered gobwalker G-VII minion.

12063.name: behemoth heir
12063.col_2: Currently forty-seventh in line to the behemoth throne.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the behemoth heir minion.

12064.name: accompaniment node
12064.col_2: Marvel at the advanced accompaniment technology of the Allagan Empire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the accompaniment node minion.

12065.name: wind-up Yugiri
12065.col_2: Her mask may significantly hold far less mystery than it once did.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Yugiri minion.

12066.name: Peridot Carbuncle
12066.col_2: If ever unfaithful, return for a full refund.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Peridot Carbuncle minion.

12067.name: Heliodor Carbuncle
12067.col_2: If ever unfaithful, return for a full refund.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Heliodor Carbuncle minion.

12069.name: gold rush minecart
12069.col_2: Unsurprisingly void of gold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the gold rush minecart minion.

12071.name: sanuwa horn
12071.col_2: A small bone whistle that, when blown, emits a piercing tone that resembles the cry of a sanuwa fledgling. Use to summon your sanuwa mount.

12072.name: griffin horn
12072.col_2: A large curved horn that emits a tone so deep, it is undetectable by the ears of man. Griffins however can hear the somber note from hundreds of malms away, and will be immediately drawn to the sound.

12073.name: manacutter key
12073.col_2: An iron key that completes the circuit connecting a manacutter's steering mechanism with its engine.

12074.name: panther bell
12074.col_2: When rung, this brass bell will summon a single black war panther, trained to serve his master, and his master only.

12075.name: black chocobo whistle
12075.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by a black chocobo trained from birth to recognize and respond to the sound. Use to summon your personal black chocobo.

12076.name: gobwalker gear
12076.col_2: An oddly shaped metal cog that has been removed from an Illuminati-constructed gobwalker. Using it should restore the machine's controls.

12077.name: set of Ishgardian half barding
12077.col_2: A lightweight suit of Ishgardian chocobo armor.

12078.name: set of Ishgardian barding
12078.col_2: A full-plate suit of Ishgardian chocobo armor.

12080.name: set of noble barding
12080.col_2: A lavishly decorated suit of armor crafted for the riding chocobos of Ishgardian nobles.

12081.name: set of highland barding
12081.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor outfitted with multiple layers of leather and fur to protect its wearer from the elements.

12082.name: set of Expanse barding
12082.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Bismarck, the Lord of the Mists.

12083.name: set of Hive barding
12083.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Ravana, the Lord of the Hive.

12084.name: alpine chair
12084.col_2: A simple chair designed in the alpine style.

12085.name: alpine round table
12085.col_2: A round table designed in the alpine fashion. Will seat twelve, but with some difficulty.

12086.name: alpine tea set
12086.col_2: Add an air of nobility to your residence with this set of antique pewter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 19)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 26)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12087.name: stuffed Carbuncle
12087.col_2: The right paw of this plush Carbuncle is raised to beckon fortune into a household or place of commerce. Effectiveness varies.

12088.name: oriental breakfast
12088.col_2: The Domans break their fast with a simple, yet balanced meal consisting of rice and several small side dishes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 28)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 26)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12089.name: nameday cake
12089.col_2: While not common amongst the poorer classes, many Eorzean highborn practice the custom of decorating a cake for family members celebrating their namedays.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 28)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 26)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12090.name: cake tray
12090.col_2: A multi-tiered tray stacked with several varieties of luscious sweetcakes and tarts.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Direct Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 28)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 26)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12091.name: oriental supper
12091.col_2: Rather than large portions of one or two dishes, Doman suppers consist of one or two bites of several painstakingly prepared culinary creations served with a bowl of steamed rice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 19)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 26)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12092.name: riviera lunch
12092.col_2: A freshly prepared lunch, complete with portions large enough to satisfy the meanest of appetites.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Tenacity Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 28)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 26)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12093.name: oriental wind chime
12093.col_2: This small glass bell has a slip of parchment attached to its clapper which, when blown by the wind, causes the clapper to strike the rim.

12094.name: toy box
12094.col_2: A toy box that is opened by sliding several interlocking pieces of wood.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

12095.name: glade half partition
12095.col_2: A partition designed in the glade fashion, but reaching only less than halfway to the ceiling so as to provide privacy without making the room feel smaller.

12096.name: oasis half partition
12096.col_2: A partition designed in the oasis fashion, but reaching only less than halfway to the ceiling so as to provide privacy without making the room feel smaller.

12097.name: cask rack
12097.col_2: A rack allowing for the horizontal storage of multiple ale kegs or wine barrels.

12098.name: display stand
12098.col_2: A cylindrical stand designed for displaying various objets d'art and spoils of war.

12099.name: miniature Gold Saucer
12099.col_2: A scale model of the Manderville Gold Saucer.

12100.name: royal plotting table
12100.col_2: A replica of the table used in the Ul'dahn royal war room to conceive and confirm battle strategies.

12101.name: round banquet table
12101.col_2: A large round table suitable for banquets, reunions, bacchanals, and other manner of large-scale social gatherings. Easily sits twelve to thirteen knights.

12102.name: Gold Saucer corner counter
12102.col_2: A low L-shaped counter-type table used in the Manderville Gold Saucer.

12103.name: bearskin rug
12103.col_2: For maximum romantic effect, place rug directly in front of a fireplace, light a few candles, and crack open a bottle of aged Ishgardian brandy.

12104.name: Gordian bureau
12104.col_2: A writing desk crafted from gears found inside the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

12105.name: savage Gordian bureau
12105.col_2: A writing desk crafted from gears found inside the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander. Magicks imbued within the furnishing cause the bureau to emit a soft glow that, while no one can see, all believe is there.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

12106.name: Gordian chair
12106.col_2: A chair crafted from gears found within the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

12107.name: savage Gordian chair

12232.name: length of cassia lumber
12232.col_2: Processed cassia lumber. Even with its bark removed, the wood still harbors a faint sweet scent.

12236.col_2: A tiny vilekin unlike any currently found in Eorzea is trapped within this rock-solid piece of dried tree sap. Collectors will pay large sums for these rare treasures.

12237.name: flight credit
12237.col_2: Permission issued by the three Grand Companies, allowing flight of privately owned airships over public airspace. Depending on airship size, and number of airships in possession, multiple credits may be required to register a new vehicle.

12238.name: tome of geological folklore - Coerthas
