12575.col_2: The curved canine of a Coerthan yeti. You shudder to think how many throats were ripped open by this nail-like tooth.

12576.name: dragon fang
12576.col_2: The rapier-like fang of an ancient dragon. Some naturalists believe that the age of a dragon can be determined by horizontally slicing its tooth and counting the rings within.

12577.name: griffin talon
12577.col_2: The sharp curved talon of a griffin.

12578.name: dark chestnut log
12578.col_2: A rough-cut log of dark chestnut timber.

12579.name: birch log
12579.col_2: A rough-cut log of birch lumber.

12580.name: length of holy cedar lumber
12580.col_2: Processed cedar lumber purified with holy water.

12582.name: length of hallowed chestnut lumber
12582.col_2: Processed dark chestnut lumber purified with hallowed water.

12584.name: length of astral birch lumber
12584.col_2: Processed birch lumber treated so that its elemental aspect tips towards astral.

12585.name: dark chestnut branch
12585.col_2: The thick branch of a dark chestnut tree.

12586.name: birch branch
12586.col_2: The thin branch of a birch tree.

12587.name: piece of wattle bark
12587.col_2: This bark, when boiled down, produces large amounts of tannin─a substance used by leatherworkers to tan hides.

12588.name: bolt of rainbow cloth
12588.col_2: Several yalms of undyed rainbow cloth wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12589.name: bolt of holy rainbow cloth
12589.col_2: Several yalms of rainbow cloth purified with holy water and wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12590.name: bolt of ramie cloth
12590.col_2: Several yalms of undyed ramie cloth wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12591.name: bolt of hallowed ramie cloth
12591.col_2: Several yalms of ramie cloth purified with holy water and wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12592.name: bolt of chimerical felt
12592.col_2: Several yalms of soft undyed felt created by matting down several layers of hair taken from chimera manes.

12593.name: bolt of astral silk
12593.col_2: Several yalms of silk treated so that its elemental aspect would tip slightly towards astral.

12594.name: spindle of rainbow thread
12594.col_2: Multicolored yarn spun from rainbow cotton.

12595.name: spindle of ramie thread
12595.col_2: Strong, absorbent yarn spun from ramie.

12596.name: spindle of crawler silk
12596.col_2: Silk gathered from crawler cocoons and spun into a thin lustrous thread.

12597.name: rainbow cotton boll
12597.col_2: A rare variety of cotton which produces fibers that change color depending on the angle at which light strikes them.

12598.name: stalk of ramie
12598.col_2: A variety of swift-growing grass native to the Near East. The stalks can be dried and processed into thin threads which, when spun together, can be woven into a cloth not unlike hemp.

12599.name: chimera mane
12599.col_2: The bristly mane of a biologically engineered monstrosity.

12600.name: crawler cocoon
12600.col_2: The sticky cocoon of a giant crawler.

12601.name: bottle of enchanted mythrite ink
12601.col_2: Ink fortified with mythrite sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

12602.name: bottle of enchanted hardsilver ink
12602.col_2: Ink fortified with hardsilver sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

12603.name: bottle of enchanted aurum regis ink
12603.description: bottles of enchanted aurum regis ink
12603.col_2: Ink fortified with aurum regis sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

12604.name: bottle of holy water
12604.col_2: Water blessed by an anointed Halonic Orthodox priest. Used to exorcise most evil spirits from worldly items.

12605.name: bottle of hallowed water
12605.col_2: Water blessed by an anointed Halonic Orthodox priest. Used to exorcise evil spirits from worldly items.

12606.name: bottle of astral oil
12606.col_2: Refined oil with an unbalanced elemental aspect tipping towards astral.

12607.name: bottle of growth formula epsilon
12607.col_2: This alchemically formulated potation accelerates the growth of foliage.

12608.name: bottle of growth formula zeta
12608.col_2: This alchemically formulated potation accelerates the growth of foliage.

12609.name: gobbet of bear fat
12609.col_2: This musky all-purpose oil is commonly used in tinctures as well as lamps.

12610.name: pane of crystal glass
12610.col_2: This exceptionally transparent glass does not actually contain any crystal, but earns its name for being as clear as crystallized aether.

12611.name: pinch of black firesand
12611.col_2: A higher concentration of saltpeter makes this flammable powder slightly more explosive than normal firesand.

12612.name: bottle of grade 1 strength dissolvent
12612.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12613.name: bottle of grade 1 dexterity dissolvent
12613.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12614.name: bottle of grade 1 vitality dissolvent
12614.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12615.name: bottle of grade 1 intelligence dissolvent
12615.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12616.name: bottle of grade 1 mind dissolvent
12616.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12617.name: bottle of grade 2 strength dissolvent
12617.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12618.name: bottle of grade 2 dexterity dissolvent
12618.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12619.name: bottle of grade 2 vitality dissolvent
12619.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12620.name: bottle of grade 2 intelligence dissolvent
12620.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12621.name: bottle of grade 2 mind dissolvent
12621.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12622.name: draconian potion of strength
12622.col_2: This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases strength.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

12623.name: draconian potion of dexterity
12623.col_2: This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases dexterity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

12624.name: draconian potion of vitality
12624.col_2: This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases vitality.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

12625.name: draconian potion of intelligence
12625.col_2: This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases intelligence.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

12626.name: draconian potion of mind
12626.col_2: This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases mind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

12627.name: dragon scale
12627.col_2: This rock-hard scale can withstand the blow of a Roegadyn-wielded battleaxe.

12628.name: phial of deepeye tears
12628.col_2: It would take at least twenty tears shed from a heartbroken Lalafellin maiden to equal the liquid volume of one deepeye tear.

12629.name: pot of dhalmel saliva
12629.col_2: The odor of dhalmel saliva has been likened to that of the bloated corpse of a blue cheese artisan drowned in a Grand Company camp latrine and left to sit in the hot sun for a sennight.

12630.name: bottle of dragon blood
12630.col_2: Most likely the blood of a dragon. For some unknown reason, the humours will not coagulate.

12631.name: bottle of Dravanian spring water
12631.col_2: Clear water taken from a spring in the foothills of Abalathia's Spine.

12632.name: bottle of Abalathian spring water
12632.col_2: Clear water taken from a spring on one of the many islets floating above Abalathia's Spine.

12633.name: bottle of skyspring water
12633.col_2: Crystal-clear water taken from a secluded spring located on a remote islet floating above the Sea of Clouds.

12634.name: seventh heaven
12634.col_2: A rare flower that has an elemental aspect tipped severely in the direction of astral.

12635.name: hunk of gelato flesh
12635.col_2: A quivering gelatinous lump of voidsent flesh neither cold nor sweet. Consumption is not recommended, even during times of starvation.

12636.name: wyvern wing
12636.col_2: The thick leathery wing of a wyvern.

12637.name: icetrap leaf
12637.col_2: The thin, twitching leaf of an icetrap.

12638.name: coneflower
12638.col_2: Brought back from the New World in the west, this plant bearing large, horn-shaped flowers has been recently discovered to be effective in curing several different ailments.

12639.name: cow bitter
12639.col_2: This sweet-smelling perennial can be found growing in all of the Three Great Continents.

12640.name: dandelion
12640.col_2: This common flower produces a globe of lightweight seeds that are carried remarkable distances when blown in the wind. While the stalk is filled with a toxic milky substance, the leaves and roots can be dried and brewed into medicinal infusions.

12641.name: bunch of gaelicatnip
12641.col_2: A relative to pepper- and spearmint, gaelicatnip is an aromatic herb often brewed into teas. The oil contained in the leaves is known to cause gaelicats and other normally aggressive feline beastkin to exhibit excessively playful behavior.

12642.name: sprig of rue
12642.col_2: A low-growing shrub recognizable by its tiny yellow flowers and faint odor. The leaves contain a mild irritant that, when rubbed against the skin, may cause minor reddening and swelling.

12643.name: sprig of coriander
12643.col_2: A highly fragrant herb. The leaves can be harvested and used in salads, or the plant can be allowed to bolt and the seeds gathered and used to spice ale.

12644.name: aurum regis cylinder
12644.col_2: This small music box cylinder is studded with myriad pins arranged in a queer pattern. When placed in a music box and attached to the motor, the cylinder will rotate, causing the pins to strike the box's comb, creating music.

12645.name: circle of Thavnairian leather
12645.col_2: This leather has been tanned and treated using techniques from the Near Eastern island of Thavnair.

12646.name: spindle of Thavnairian silk
12646.col_2: This silk has been spun from thread created by a worm found only on the Near Eastern island of Thavnair.

12647.name: gobbet of Atomos corpulence
12647.col_2: A small piece of throbbing flesh sliced from the devourer of worlds, Atomos.

12648.name: steel mainspring
12648.col_2: A coiled ribbon of steel commonly used in clockwork creations to perpetuate motion.

12649.name: steel wheel bearing
12649.col_2: Several steel balls set into a polished metal ring. It is used to reduce friction, allowing a wheel to spin with little resistance.

12650.name: lupin seedling
12650.col_2: Its name meaning “wolf,” the lupin is a hardy plant resistant to the cold winds of the Eorzean north.

12651.name: iron giant scrap
12651.col_2: A jagged sheet of plating fallen from the armor of an iron giant.

12652.name: square of gobwalker shielding
12652.col_2: Protective metal plating used in the fabrication of a magitek gobwalker G-VII.

12653.name: Far Eastern coin
12653.col_2: An oblong coin of gold commonly used in the Far East for bribes.

12654.name: toy box schema
12654.col_2: A detailed design document outlining the absurdly complex steps required to craft a toy box.

12655.name: pinch of fine alumen
12655.col_2: A yellowish mineral used by leatherworkers to tan animal hides. This particular variety exhibits some of the best deodorizing properties of all alumen.

12656.name: shrub seedling
12656.col_2: The seedling of a squat shrub favored by topiarists across the realm for its bright-green leaves and dense web of tiny branches.

12657.name: magnanimous mogcrown
12657.col_2: A gaudy moogle-sized crown crafted by moogles for use during moogle celebrations.

12658.name: circle of dusk leather
12658.col_2: An especially dark variety of leather often used in formalwear and uniforms.

12659.name: woodworking delineation
12659.col_2: A detailed outline of complex woodworking techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12660.name: blacksmithing delineation
12660.col_2: A detailed outline of complex blacksmithing techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12661.name: armoring delineation
12661.col_2: A detailed outline of complex armoring techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12662.name: goldsmithing delineation
12662.col_2: A detailed outline of complex goldsmithing techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12663.name: leatherworking delineation
12663.col_2: A detailed outline of complex leatherworking techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12664.name: weaving delineation
12664.col_2: A detailed outline of complex weaving techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12665.name: alchemy delineation
12665.col_2: A detailed outline of complex alchemy techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12666.name: cooking delineation
12666.col_2: A detailed outline of complex cooking techniques.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for all-purpose crafter's delineations.]

12667.name: commercial engineering manual
12667.col_2: This comprehensive manual, written by a disgruntled former employee of Rowena's House of Splendors, provides a detailed explanation of inhuman techniques forced upon consortium-hired Disciples of the Hand to increase their output. It is known to inspire (and frighten) all who read it, granting a temporary 150% boost to experience points earned from synthesis (up to a maximum of 1,750,000 points). Effect is halved at level 70 and above.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 18 hours

12668.name: commercial survival manual
12668.col_2: This comprehensive manual, written by a disgruntled former employee of Rowena's House of Splendors, provides a detailed explanation of inhuman techniques forced upon consortium-hired Disciples of the Land to increase their output. It is known to inspire (and frighten) all who read it, granting a temporary 150% boost to experience points earned from gathering activities (up to a maximum of 1,750,000 points). Effect is halved at level 70 and above.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 18 hours

12669.name: vial of hi-cordial
12669.col_2: A sweet, fermented concoction that instantly restores 400 GP.

12670.name: Old World striking dummy
12670.col_2: A striking dummy designed in the Sharlayan fashion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

12671.name: plot of sunflowers
12671.col_2: The stalks of these bright-yellow flowers have been known to grow to heights of two or three yalms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

12672.name: Expanse totem
12672.col_2: This wooden idol carved in the likeness of the primal Bismarck is used by Vanu Vanu priests during summoning ceremonies.

12673.name: Hive totem
12673.col_2: This steel idol resembling the primal Ravana is used by the Gnath during summoning ceremonies.

12674.name: tarnished Gordian lens
12674.col_2: A uniquely crafted lens discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two lenses can be traded for special headgear.

12675.name: tarnished Gordian shaft
12675.col_2: A uniquely crafted shaft discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four shafts can be traded for special body gear.

12676.name: tarnished Gordian crank
12676.col_2: A uniquely crafted crank discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two cranks can be traded for special arm gear.

12677.name: tarnished Gordian spring
12677.col_2: A uniquely crafted spring discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four springs can be traded for special leg gear.

12678.name: tarnished Gordian pedal
12678.col_2: A uniquely crafted pedal discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pedals can be traded for special foot gear.

12679.name: tarnished Gordian chain
12679.col_2: A uniquely crafted chain discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector. Alas, advancements in trouser technology have rendered it worthless.

12680.name: tarnished Gordian bolt
12680.col_2: A uniquely crafted bolt discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One bolt can be traded for a special accessory.

12681.name: first page of the <hex:021A020203>Gordian Manifesto<hex:021A020103>
12681.col_2: The opening page of the Illuminati's catechismal masterwork.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Manifesto pages of the same type can be traded for special gear or materials.

12682.name: second page of the <hex:021A020203>Gordian Manifesto<hex:021A020103>
12682.col_2: The second page of the Illuminati's catechismal masterwork.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Manifesto pages of the same type can be traded for special gear.

12683.name: third page of the <hex:021A020203>Gordian Manifesto<hex:021A020103>
12683.col_2: The third page of the Illuminati's catechismal masterwork.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Manifesto pages of the same type can be traded for special gear.

12684.name: fourth page of the <hex:021A020203>Gordian Manifesto<hex:021A020103>
12684.col_2: The fourth page of the Illuminati's catechismal masterwork.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Manifesto pages of the same type can be traded for special gear.

12698.name: tome of botanical folklore - Coerthas
12698.col_2: Tales gathered from local Coerthan botanists regarding the location of rare trees and herbs.

12699.name: tome of botanical folklore - Dravania
12699.col_2: Tales gathered from local Dravanian botanists regarding the location of rare trees and herbs.

12700.name: tome of botanical folklore - Abalathia's Spine
12700.description: tomes of botanical folklore - Abalathia's Spine
12700.col_2: Tales gathered from botanists newly arrived to the islets above the Sea of Clouds regarding the location of rare trees and herbs.
12700.col_3: Tome of Botanical Folklore - Abalathia's Spine

12701.name: tome of ichthyological folklore - Coerthas
12701.col_2: Tales gathered from local Coerthan fishers regarding the location of legendary fish.

12702.name: tome of ichthyological folklore - Dravania
12702.col_2: Tales gathered from local Dravanian fishers regarding the location of legendary fish.

12703.name: tome of ichthyological folklore - Abalathia's Spine
12703.description: tomes of ichthyological folklore - Abalathia's Spine
12703.col_2: Tales gathered from fishers newly arrived to the islets above the Sea of Clouds regarding the location of heretofore unseen fish.
12703.col_3: Tome of Ichthyological Folklore - Abalathia's Spine

12704.name: stonefly nymph
12704.col_2: Stonefly nymphs are constantly moving, making them easily discernible targets for poor-sighted fish. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

12705.name: purse web spider
12705.col_2: This lightweight spider can distribute its weight over a large surface area, allowing it to “walk” on water without sinking. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

12706.name: goblin jig
12706.col_2: A metal lure designed by goblin fishers to vibrate rapidly, thus making it more appealing to hungry fish.

12707.name: bladed steel jig
12707.col_2: An all-purpose fishing lure crafted by combining three smaller lures.

12708.name: red balloon
12708.col_2: A bright-red breed of balloon bug found floating at higher elevations than its duller cousins. Live bait for both skyfishing and cloudfishing. Up to nine hundred and ninety-nine red balloons can be stacked together.

12709.name: magma worm
12709.col_2: A small worm with a stone-like shell encasing its entire body, protecting it from the extreme temperatures of the molten lava in which it resides. Live bait for hellfishing.

12710.name: fiend worm
12710.col_2: Discovered almost simultaneously by three naturalists, this strange creature was also named the “demon worm” and the “goddess worm” until a best-two-out-of-three round of stone-parchment-shears settled the naming problem once and for all. Fiend worms are one of the few baits suitable for aetherfishing, as the vilekin will remain alive in the sludge even when submerged.

12711.name: brute leech
12711.col_2: A fat bloodsucking worm often found attached to large fish or the legs of wading fauna. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

12712.name: giant crane fly
12712.col_2: A mosquito-like vilekin with uncharacteristically long legs. Often utilized by anglers for both cloud and skyfishing.

12713.name: icepick
12713.col_2: A freshwater fish adapted to survive in the cold waters of Coerthas. It earns its name from its long, beak-like mouth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12714.name: piece of cloud coral
12714.col_2: A white, lightweight coral found growing on the floating islands above Eorzea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

12715.name: ice faerie
12715.col_2: A tiny “winged” slug commonly found in ice-ridden freshwater lakes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12716.name: skyworm
12716.col_2: A wingless worm that has somehow learned to fly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

12718.name: Coerthan crab
12718.col_2: A freshwater crustacean only found in the coldest of lakes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12719.name: fanged clam
12719.col_2: When closed, the shells of this freshwater bivalve mollusk form a demonic rictus that will haunt your nightmares until the end of time. Possibly beyond.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

12720.name: lake urchin
12720.col_2: A freshwater urchin which survives by eating the sparse algal blooms in Twinpools.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12721.name: Whilom catfish
12721.col_2: A small, red catfish native to the Whilom River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

12722.name: blueclaw shrimp
12722.col_2: A freshwater shrimp native to the Whilom River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

12723.name: starflower
12723.col_2: A flower-like mollusk found floating about the Sea of Clouds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12724.name: glacier core
12724.col_2: A spherical creature found flying in the icy northern reaches of the Sea of Clouds bordering the Coerthas western highlands.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

12725.name: ogre horn snail
12725.col_2: A freshwater mollusk with a twisted shell shaped like the horn of a voidsent ogre. Can only survive in warm temperatures, such as those found in hot springs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12726.name: sorcerer fish
12726.col_2: A freshwater fish believed by some to have the ability to wield fire spells.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

12727.name: hotrod
12727.col_2: A freshwater fish native to the freshwater runoff of Abalathia's Spine. It is easily distinguishable by its long, ever-twitching whiskers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

12728.name: maiboi
12728.col_2: A thin freshwater fish commonly found in the floating lakes above Abalathia.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

12729.name: three-lip carp
12729.col_2: A large freshwater fish covered in gil-sized silver scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

12730.name: bullfrog
12730.col_2: A stout, deep-voiced wavekin found throughout Abalathia's Spine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12731.name: cloudfish
12731.col_2: A semi-transparent freshwater fish native to the lakes of legendary Voor Sian Siran.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12732.name: mahu wai
12732.col_2: A cloud white mollusk found living on the underbelly of Abalathia's floating islets.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12733.name: rock mussel
12733.col_2: A tiny freshwater bivalve mollusk native to the lukewarm waters of the Whilom River in the Dravanian forelands.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12734.name: buoyant oviform
12734.col_2: The expression “when eggs fly” was commonly used throughout Eorzea to express the impossibility of something...that is until the discovery of this strange creature floating about the Sea of Clouds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

12735.name: whiteloom

12842.name: cup of Ishgardian tea

12871.name: gastornis egg
12871.col_2: The hard-shelled egg of a gastornis.

12872.name: okeanis egg
12872.col_2: The soft-shelled, slime-covered, ever-so-slightly warm egg of an okeanis.

12873.name: slice of loaghtan chump
12873.col_2: A marbled piece of meat taken from the rump of a loaghtan where the leg meets the loin.

12874.name: slice of dhalmel meat
12874.col_2: A gristle-filled slice of meat that will require extensive simmering for it to be rendered palatable.

12875.name: okeanis tail
12875.col_2: When skinned, this slice of serpent-like meat almost appears edible.

12876.name: cockatrice thigh
12876.col_2: A lean slice of cockatrice meat good for flavorful broths.

12877.name: stalk of pearl sprouts
12877.col_2: Tiny cabbage-like vegetables native to the highlands of Coerthas.

12878.name: cyclops onion
12878.col_2: A giant yellow onion often found growing on Abalathia's Spine.

12879.name: handful of emerald beans
12879.col_2: A deep-green legume recently discovered growing on the floating islets above the Sea of Clouds.

12880.name: sheaf of highland wheat
12880.col_2: A variety of dark-colored wheat suited to the rocky soil, shorter days, and colder temperatures of the Coerthas highlands.

12881.name: bag of highland flour
12881.col_2: Finely milled highland wheat. It has a rich, earthy aroma.

12882.name: basket of Coerthan tea leaves
12882.col_2: Considerably smaller than Thanalan tea leaves, more than double the amount of Ishgardian tea leaves are required to brew a single cup of tea.

12883.name: sprig of mist dill
12883.col_2: A fragrant herb characterized by its thin leaves. It is used in both medicines and culinary dishes.

12884.name: bunch of chives
12884.col_2: A thin green onion used in many Ishgardian dishes.

12885.name: magma beet
12885.col_2: A sweet, easy-to-grow tuber native to Abalathia's Spine, these deep-red beets are a staple in Ishgardian culinary culture.

12886.name: box of heavenly kukuru powder
12886.col_2: A sweet, fragrant powder ground from high-quality kukuru beans imported from exotic lands at a great price. A delicacy only available to the Holy See's most privileged.

12887.name: pinch of sesame seeds
12887.col_2: A tiny seed rich in aromatic oil, sesame is native to Meracydia, and thought to have first been brought to Eorzea by migrating Miqo'te.

12888.name: can of yak milk
12888.col_2: The unique flavor of yak milk can be somewhat off-putting to those raised on cow or aldgoat milk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12889.name: heavens lemon
12889.col_2: Possibly due to the increased sunlight it receives growing above the clouds, heavens lemons lack the acidity of normal sun lemons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12890.name: pot of hollandaise sauce
12890.col_2: A rich sauce created with butter, egg yolks, and a hint of lemon.

12891.name: pot of birch sap
12891.col_2: A thin clear sap harvested from birch trees.

12892.name: pot of birch syrup
12892.col_2: Birch sap boiled down to a thick, sweet syrup.

12893.name: dark chestnut
12893.col_2: The spine-encased fruit of the dark chestnut tree.

12894.name: dollop of sour cream
12894.col_2: A thick cream created by fermenting yak milk.

12895.name: stick of fermented butter
12895.col_2: Slightly pungent butter allowed to ferment for several days after churning.

12896.name: Old World fig
12896.col_2: A symbol of long life and femininity, this autumn fruit was originally brought from their homeland to Eorzea by the Sharlayans.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12897.name: cloud banana
12897.col_2: Though it resembles a tree, cloud bananas actually grow from an oversized herb. That does not, however, make them any less sweet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12898.name: morel
12898.col_2: This rare mushroom with an oblong webbed cap is highly sought after by culinarians the realm over.

12899.name: porcini
12899.col_2: A large fragrant mushroom popular in Coerthan cuisine.

12900.name: bunch of chysahl greens
12900.col_2: Though nearly identical in shape and color to gysahl greens, chysahl greens have a deeper, earthier flavor that chocobos (and man) seem to prefer.

12901.name: chunk of Abalathian rock salt
12901.col_2: Mined from veins found in Abalathia's Spine, this pinkish salt has a high mineral content which adds depth to its flavor.

12902.name: handful of honeydew almonds
12902.col_2: A sweet variety of rare white almonds.

12903.name: Dravanian paprika
12903.col_2: A rare pepper that is more sweet than it is spicy.

12904.name: snurbleberry
12904.col_2: This sweet, yet tart red berry is covered in tiny soft hairs that can be removed by lightly rubbing the fruit between one's palms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12905.name: bouillon cube
12905.col_2: Animal broth that has been reduced down to a paste and hardened into cubes which will keep for an extended duration.

12906.name: pot of oriental soy sauce
12906.col_2: Similar to Mun-Tuy sauce, this Far Eastern seasoning is made by fermenting soybeans in salt and then pressing the beans to collect the remaining savory liquid.

12907.name: pot of oriental miso paste
12907.col_2: Similar to Mun-Tuy paste, this Far Eastern seasoning is made by fermenting soybeans in salt.

12908.name: bundle of vermicelli
12908.col_2: Thin noodles made with highland flour, eggs, water, and salt. These have been dried and will keep indefinitely.

12909.name: mossy stone greatsword
12909.col_2: A greatsword crafted from giantsgall, a type of stone found on Thavnair. It is so covered in moss as to be rendered unusable.

12910.name: mossy stone cannon
12910.col_2: A hand cannon crafted from giantsgall, a type of stone found on Thavnair. It is so covered in moss as to be rendered unusable.

12911.name: mossy stone globe
12911.col_2: A star globe crafted from giantsgall, a type of stone found on Thavnair. It is so covered in moss as to be rendered unusable.

12912.name: celestine
12912.col_2: A light-blue crystalline mineral which, when ground and added to any flammable material, will cause it to burn red.

12913.name: sheet of Garlond steel
12913.col_2: A lightweight form of steel developed by the eponymous chief engineer of the Garlond Ironworks.

12914.name: bottle of deep-red enchanted ink
12914.col_2: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals.

12915.name: bottle of superior deep-red enchanted ink
12915.description: bottles of superior deep-red enchanted ink
12915.col_2: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals. The concentration of this bottle's contents appears to be remarkably high.

12916.name: bottle of deep-green enchanted ink
12916.col_2: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals.

12917.name: bottle of superior deep-green enchanted ink
12917.description: bottles of superior deep-green enchanted ink
12917.col_2: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals. The concentration of this bottle's contents appears to be remarkably high.

12918.name: bottle of deep-blue enchanted ink
12918.col_2: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals.

12919.name: bottle of superior deep-blue enchanted ink
12919.description: bottles of superior deep-blue enchanted ink
12919.col_2: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals. The concentration of this bottle's contents appears to be remarkably high.

12920.name: sack of red clay
12920.col_2: Natural clay commonly used by potters and sculptors for its high malleability.

12921.name: sack of black clay
12921.col_2: A partially synthetic clay created by mixing ground stone with an alchemical reagent.

12922.name: bundle of synthetic resin
12922.col_2: A fully malleable synthetic resin created through the wonders of alchemy.

12923.name: strip of bamboo weave
12923.col_2: Thinly cut strips of bamboo used for creating simple models.

12924.name: piece of balsa wood scrap
12924.col_2: Unevenly cut pieces of light balsa wood. Can be used to create models.

12925.name: length of balsa wood lumber
12925.col_2: Processed balsa wood lumber. Optimal for creating large, detailed models.

12926.name: loop of synthetic fiber
12926.col_2: Alchemically crafted fiber both thin and durable. Used for holding together pieces when creating models.

12927.name: loop of aetherochemical fiber
12927.col_2: Super-strong fiber created using recently rediscovered Allagan aetherochemical techniques.

12928.name: empty crystal
12928.col_2: A transparent crystal almost completely devoid of elemental aspect.

12929.name: empty cluster
12929.col_2: A transparent crystal cluster almost completely devoid of elemental aspect.

12931.name: chunk of purified coke
12931.col_2: A hot-burning fuel created by destructively distilling raw coal. This particular piece contains very few impurities, allowing for longer, hotter combustion.

12932.name: pinch of Raziqcoat
12932.col_2: Developed by a Near Eastern alchemist, this powder is used to treat and harden aurum regis.

12933.name: lump of dryad sap
12933.col_2: A partially congealed ball of sticky sap extracted from a dryad.

12934.name: spindle of moonbeam silk
12934.col_2: A brilliant white silk spun by a rare breed of Eorzean spider.

12935.name: lump of odorless animal fat
12935.col_2: This gobbet of beastkin tissue does not exhibit the rancid odor most commonly associated with animal fat.

12936.name: handful of duskborne aethersand
12936.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced matter. This fine sand emits a weak glow indiscernible during the day.

12937.name: handful of dawnborne aethersand
12937.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced matter. This fine sand emits a brilliant light discernible even at midday.

12938.name: handful of landborne aethersand
12938.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced mineral matter.

12939.name: handful of leafborne aethersand
12939.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced floral matter.

12940.name: handful of seaborne aethersand
12940.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced sea life.

12941.name: chunk of chalcocite
12941.col_2: A black metallic ore containing copper and traces of iron and saltpeter.

12942.name: chunk of cuprite
12942.col_2: Though its appearance suggests it is a precious gem, this ore is actually a rare form of red translucent copper.

12943.name: sprig of Dravanian mistletoe
12943.col_2: A variety of parasitic plant found growing on trees in the Churning Mists.

12944.name: sprig of Abalathian mistletoe
12944.col_2: A variety of parasitic plant found growing on trees in the Sea of Clouds.

12945.name: pinch of red alumen
12945.col_2: A reddish variety of the mineral used by leatherworkers to tan animal hides. It lacks the deodorizing properties of its lighter counterpart.

12946.name: red ooid
12946.col_2: An egg-shaped stone composed of countless layers of reddish mineral deposits enveloping a tiny nucleus of rock or shell.

12947.name: green ooid
12947.col_2: An egg-shaped stone composed of countless layers of greenish mineral deposits enveloping a tiny nucleus of rock or shell.

12948.name: blue ooid
12948.col_2: An egg-shaped stone composed of countless layers of bluish mineral deposits enveloping a tiny nucleus of rock or shell.

12949.name: yellow ooid
12949.col_2: An egg-shaped stone composed of countless layers of yellowish mineral deposits enveloping a tiny nucleus of rock or shell.

12950.name: violet ooid
12950.col_2: An egg-shaped stone composed of countless layers of purplish mineral deposits enveloping a tiny nucleus of rock or shell.

12951.name: red roundstone
12951.col_2: A bright-red stone so perfectly spherical, it is difficult to believe it was not hand-carved.

12952.name: green roundstone
12952.col_2: A bright-green stone so perfectly spherical, it is difficult to believe it was not hand-carved.

12953.name: blue roundstone
12953.col_2: A bright-blue stone so perfectly spherical, it is difficult to believe it was not hand-carved.

12954.name: yellow roundstone
12954.col_2: A bright-yellow stone so perfectly spherical, it is difficult to believe it was not hand-carved.

12955.name: violet roundstone
12955.col_2: A bright-purple stone so perfectly spherical, it is difficult to believe it was not hand-carved.

12956.name: foxglove
12956.col_2: A poisonous herb native to the Coerthas highlands. Up to twenty purple finger-length flowers can bloom on a single stalk.

12957.name: sprig of bladeleaf
12957.col_2: This variety of wild grass native to the Dravanian forelands is characterized by long, serrated leaves which can leave lacerations on unprotected skin.

12958.name: wyvern's wart
12958.col_2: A mushroom so toxic that it is said a single bite can kill an adult wyvern.

12959.name: void nut
12959.col_2: Some of Eorzea's more superstitious smallfolk believe the pattern of grooves found upon the shell of this otherwise ordinary walnut to be proof that an evil voidsent has possessed the poor fruit.

12960.name: black swan feather
12960.col_2: The long, glossy feather of a common black swan.

12961.name: bitter foxglove

12963.name: dragon's wart
12963.col_2: A mushroom so toxic that it is said a single bite can kill an adult dragon.

12964.name: heavensnut

12965.name: mute swan feather
12965.col_2: The long, glossy feather of a rare mute swan.

12967.name: bright lightning rock
12967.col_2: An uncut, unpolished stone imbued with aetheric lightning energy.

12972.name: sprig of Furymint

12973.name: sprig of clary sage

12993.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by a rare amber draught chocobo trained from capture to recognize and respond to the sound. Use to summon your personal amber draught chocobo.

12994.name: gold chocobo feather
12994.col_2: A common symbol of friendship throughout the realm, these brilliant plumes can be exchanged at Calamity salvagers for special rewards.

12995.name: silver chocobo feather

13055.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of stewards on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

13060.name: lump of Fiend sap
13060.col_2: Left behind by the Fiend, this lump of sap appears to induce growth in living organisms.

13061.name: crystal bell

13062.name: stuffed succubus
13062.col_2: Take this All Saints' Wake-themed doll to bed at your own risk.

13063.name: pumpkin desk

13064.col_2: A wall decoration hung in homes during the Starlight Celebration.

13066.name: Starlight sentinel
13066.col_2: A potted conifer displayed in homes during the Starlight Celebration.

13077.name: funguar chair
13077.col_2: A low stool designed to resemble a mushroom.

13084.name: topiary chocobo

13085.name: Ultimate Kettle
13085.col_2: Unlike other kettles of legend, it cannot turn water to ale, nor is it bottomless. But it can boil water for tea in a count of sixty. <hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

13086.name: Ultimate Kettle Zenith
13086.col_2: It can boil water for a quality blend of tea in a count of thirty. And it glows with a strange light. Everyone knows that strangely glowing objects are likely made of legends. <hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

13087.name: Ultimate Kettle Nexus
13087.col_2: A true kettle of legend that shines with such brilliance that it is said even gods would beg for a sip of its contents. It can boil water for a premium blend of tea in a count of five. <hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

13091.name: Dravanian down tree
13091.col_2: A unique species of flora found only growing in the Sea of Clouds. As its seeds do not take in soil from the lower realm, the trees must be planted and raised on sky islets before being transplanted.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

13569.col_2: Formed during a battle waged in the Coerthas western highlands, this crystal's unusual luminosity is the result of a concentrated elemental charge.

13570.name: luminous wind crystal
13570.col_2: Formed during a battle waged in the Sea of Clouds, this crystal's unusual luminosity is the result of a concentrated elemental charge.

13571.name: luminous fire crystal

13572.name: luminous earth crystal

13573.name: luminous lightning crystal

13574.name: luminous water crystal
13574.col_2: Formed during a battle waged in the Dravanian hinterlands, this crystal's unusual luminosity is the result of a concentrated elemental charge.

13575.name: astral nodule
13575.col_2: A crystalline amalgamation of astrally charged crystals.

13576.name: umbral nodule
13576.col_2: A crystalline amalgamation of umbrally charged crystals.

13577.name: lump of enchanted rubber
13577.col_2: A variety of pliable rubber imbued with arcane magicks to improve aetherial conductivity.

13578.name: flask of fast-drying carboncoat
13578.col_2: Born of Allagan ingenuity, this aetherochemical concoction is said to rapidly increase a gem's hardness.

13579.name: bottle of divine water
13579.col_2: Water believed to be blessed by the Twelve. Used to exorcise powerful demons from worldly items.

13580.name: fast-acting Allagan catalyst
13580.col_2: Dubbed a “god in the machina” by those who first discovered it, modern scholars have yet to discover not only what the catalytic agent contains, but exactly how it functions, understanding only that the substance is required to quickly strengthen the properties of certain materials.

13581.name: precision Gordian bolt
13581.col_2: An expertly crafted bolt discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.

13582.name: unidentifiable bone
13582.col_2: This highly collectable bone appears to be from a creature not recorded in the Raimdelle Codex.

13583.name: precision Gordian lens
13583.col_2: An expertly crafted lens discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.

13584.name: unidentifiable shell
13584.col_2: This highly collectable shell appears to be from a creature not recorded in the Raimdelle Codex.

13585.name: precision Gordian spring
13585.col_2: An expertly crafted spring discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.

13586.name: chunk of unidentifiable ore
13586.col_2: This highly collectable variety of ore is undocumented in the extensive Amajina & Sons mining logs.

13587.name: precision Gordian shaft
13587.col_2: An expertly crafted shaft discovered in Alexander's Gordias sector.

13588.name: bag of unidentifiable seeds
13588.col_2: These highly collectable seeds appear to be from flora not recorded in the Raimdelle Codex.

13589.name: adamantite francesca
13589.col_2: A small throwing axe forged from adamantite.

13590.name: pterodactyl strap
13590.col_2: A thin leather strap cut from the cured hide of a pterodactyl.

13591.name: titanium alloy mirror
13591.col_2: The reflective surface on this mirror has been achieved through countless days of buffing and polishing.

13592.name: titanium alloy square
13592.col_2: A thin, tiny plate of hammered titanium alloy.

13593.name: dispelling arrow
13593.col_2: Not actually an arrow, but rather a warding charm carved into the shape of one.

13594.name: handful of blessed fletchings
13594.col_2: Arrow fletchings crafted from the large, rigid feathers of an eagle and then blessed by an anointed Halonic priest.

13595.name: kingcake
13595.col_2: A festive ring-shaped cake baked from brioche dough.

13596.name: moogle miniature
13596.col_2: A small ceramic figurine bearing the likeness of a plump moogle.

13625.name: Clan mark log
13625.col_2: A list of elite marks slain by the log's owner...before the owner himself vanished without a trace following an embarrassing defeat at the hands of a ladybug.

13626.name: Mhachi farthing
13626.col_2: A small coin of low denomination once used in the long-fallen nation of Mhach. Once actively sought by numismatists across Eorzea, the market soon became oversaturated, causing this ancient currency to lose its value entirely.

13627.name: Heavens' Ward helm fragment
13627.col_2: A small piece of steel salvaged from a helm worn by one of the Heavens' Ward.

13630.name: brass sky pirate spoil
13630.col_2: When sky pirates raiding in the Sea of Clouds board another vessel, it is tradition to claim a piece of the airship to serve as proof of the deadly deed. These objects of honor and bravery have also been known to be used as currency between the brigands.

13631.name: steel sky pirate spoil
13631.col_2: When sky pirates raiding in the Sea of Clouds board another vessel, it is tradition to claim a piece of the airship to serve as proof of the deadly deed. These objects of honor and bravery have also been known to be used as currency between the brigands.

13632.name: Vanu whitebone promissory note
13632.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for Vanu whitebones─tiny, bleached bones used as common currency amongst the many Vanu Vanu tribes.

13633.name: sylphic goldleaf promissory note
13633.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for sylphic goldleaves─golden, decaying leaves used as currency by the sylphs.

13634.name: steel Amalj'ok promissory note
13634.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for steel Amalj'ok─small, curved steel blades used as currency by the Amalj'aa.

13635.name: rainbowtide psashp promissory note
13635.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for rainbowtide psashp─colorful shells used as currency by the Sahagin.

13636.name: Titan cobaltpiece promissory note
13636.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for Titan cobaltpieces─crude pieces of flattened cobalt used as high-denomination currency by the kobolds of O'Ghomoro.

13637.name: max-potion
13637.col_2: This spiritous concoction instantly restores a considerable amount of HP.

13638.name: vial of max-ether
13638.col_2: Processed via the alchemical extraction of aetheric essence occurring in elemental crystals, the contents of this vial instantly restore a considerable amount of MP.

13726.col_2: A short piece of iron loosely affixed to the inside of a bell, causing it to ring when the clapper strikes the bell's wall.

13727.name: functional proto-hropken
13727.col_2: A remarkably developed manlike fish living in the aetherochemical pools of Azys Lla.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

13728.name: Coerthan clione
13728.col_2: Though believed by scholars to be a distant cousin of the snail, this tiny transparent mollusk does not have a shell.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

13729.name: Dravanian smelt
13729.col_2: A tiny freshwater fish native to the lakes fed by runoff from the Slate Mountains.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

13730.name: piece of heavens coral
13730.col_2: A lightweight, sky blue coral found growing on the floating islands above Eorzea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

13731.name: sunsail
13731.col_2: A flying fish found in the skies near the Landlord Colony.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

13732.name: goblin bass
13732.col_2: Introduced to the Thaliak River by goblins, this variety of voracious bass has driven native species to the brink of extinction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

13733.name: pterodactyl
13733.col_2: A winged scalekin native to the Diadem.

13734.name: eurhinosaur
13734.col_2: A rare scalekin that utilizes its highly developed air bladder to float above the Sea of Clouds.

13736.name: gem marimo
13736.col_2: A bright-green variety of aquatic moss found on the bottom of lakes. Slight currents cause the moss to gather and form into a ball as it grows.

13737.name: crown trout
13737.col_2: A freshwater fish native to the Diadem.

13738.name: retribution staff
13738.col_2: A large freshwater fish native to the Diadem.

13739.name: thief betta
13739.col_2: An aggressive freshwater fish native to the Diadem.

13740.name: goldsmith crab
13740.col_2: A tiny freshwater crustacean native to the Diadem.

13741.name: certificate of collaboration MMXVI
13741.col_2: A small, square slip of parchment stamped with the Ul'dahn royal seneschal's seal proving your aid in the very first promotion of the Songbirds.

13742.name: steamed staff
13742.col_2: Not actually a staff, but a dish made from steaming a freshwater fish known as a retribution staff─a long, thin wavekin believed to be the cause of storms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

13743.name: sesame cookie
13743.col_2: Tales of a blue monster who greedily devours these baked delights have frightened children across the realm for generations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

13744.name: bolt of wind silk
13744.col_2: This silk is exposed to aetherial turbulence in order to strengthen its aspect to wind.

13745.name: circle of dinosaur leather
13745.col_2: A large piece of cured dinosaur skin.

13746.name: bolt of falconer's hemp
13746.col_2: A double-weave variety of hemp used by falconers to protect themselves from the sharp talons of their raptors.

13747.name: titanium alloy ingot
13747.col_2: A durable alloy created by smelting titanium with zinc.

13748.name: bolt of cloud cloth
13748.col_2: Soft, light cotton woven from rare cloud cotton bolls.

13749.name: circle of pterodactyl leather
13749.col_2: A large piece of cured pterodactyl skin.

13750.name: chunk of sphalerite
13750.col_2: A semi-translucent mineral containing large amounts of zinc and iron.

13751.name: potters stone
13751.col_2: A hard clay found exclusively on the islets of the Diadem. When fired in a kiln, the result is a brilliant white pottery.

13752.name: sprig of royal mistletoe
13752.col_2: A parasitic plant that is only found growing on the trees of the Diadem.

13753.name: cloud cotton boll
13753.col_2: The cloud-like flower of a cotton plant native to the Diadem.

13754.name: blood pepper
13754.col_2: A deep red variety of dragon pepper so hot it is widely believed by Far Eastern cultures to drive away malignant spirits.

13755.name: bag of blood pepper seeds
13755.col_2: Blood pepper seeds suitable for garden cultivation.

13756.name: Dravanian mote
13756.col_2: This lighter-than-air flora is unique to the Churning Mists.

13757.name: tuft of oriental grass
13757.col_2: A tall variety of grass common in the Far East.

13758.name: cassia block
13758.col_2: An expertly cut cube of fragrant cassia lumber.

13759.name: piece of tektite
13759.col_2: A type of naturally occurring glass first discovered after the Calamity which ushered in the Seventh Umbral Era.

13760.name: piece of eventide jade
13760.col_2: A rare form of jade as red as a sunset.

13761.name: fossilized dragon bone
13761.col_2: There is much debate amongst Eorzean scholars as to how much time must pass before a bone becomes fossilized. Some say a mere generation will suffice, citing evidence such as the proliferation of petrification magicks. Others believe it may take upwards of a thousand thousand years, casting doubts on the theories which state Hydaelyn was created a mere twenty thousand summers past.

13762.name: bunch of periwinkle
13762.col_2: A mildly poisonous flower found across the Three Great Continents.

13763.name: cloud mushroom
13763.col_2: An aptly named fungus commonly found in the Sea of Clouds, wind providing a means of spore distribution from one islet to the next.

13764.name: wind widow
13764.col_2: A tiny poisonous spider that weaves sail-like webs used by the vilekin to traverse the Sea of Clouds.

13765.description: bags of Old World fig seeds
13765.col_2: Old World fig seeds suitable for garden cultivation.

13773.col_2: Like a spring wind, the Zundu warrior is strong...until he winds down.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Zundu warrior minion.

13774.col_2: What isn't dead (or is recreated in a goldsmith's workshop) can never die.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Haurchefant minion.

14003.name: Viltgance-type hull
14003.col_2: A hull which utilizes a rigid, lightweight frame for a more stable flight.

14053.name: High House supper set
14053.col_2: An extravagant multiple-course meal enjoyed by the nobility of Ishgard on saint feast days and other ceremonious occasions. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 28)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 27)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14054.name: Senor Sabotender trophy
14054.col_2: Everybody loves a winner. And with this trophy you, too, can feel like a winner.

14055.name: riviera flowerpot
14055.col_2: A garden planter designed in the riviera style.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Small, medium, and large estates can hold 2, 3, and 4 planters, respectively. Private chambers and apartments can hold 2.

14056.name: glade flowerpot
14056.col_2: A garden planter designed in the glade style.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Small, medium, and large estates can hold 2, 3, and 4 planters, respectively. Private chambers and apartments can hold 2.

14057.name: oasis flowerpot
14057.col_2: A garden planter designed in the oasis style.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Small, medium, and large estates can hold 2, 3, and 4 planters, respectively. Private chambers and apartments can hold 2.

14058.name: dinosaur skull
14058.col_2: The crown of an ancient beast. While one may find it comical to stick his or her head in its mouth, collectors warn that its teeth are still razor-sharp and there have been unfortunate accidents.

14059.name: dinosaur skeleton
14059.col_2: The torso and legs of an ancient beast. Scholars are unsure why its modern cousins still have short arms, but they argue they must be of some merit in their hunting habits.

14060.name: dinosaur tailbone
14060.col_2: The tail of an ancient beast. Some believe that when struck with a mallet, the hollowed tailbones emit pleasant-sounding notes.

14061.name: topiary sabotender
14061.col_2: A specially bred shrub pruned to the shape of a scampering sabotender.

14062.name: Archon egg tower
14062.col_2: A Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide decoration with tiers of Archon eggs tirelessly hand-painted by the youngest of the Dreamers.

14063.name: plot of dandelions
14063.col_2: A tiny field of cheery dandelions that begs to be frolicked in.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

14064.name: living arch
14064.col_2: An aging stone bridge covered in ivy and moss. Perfect for the romantic rendezvous.

14065.name: shishi-odoshi
14065.col_2: A fountain from the Far East originally used to scare away creatures and neighbors come to nibble on garden patches. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to five may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

14066.name: Faust striking dummy
14066.col_2: A striking dummy created by the Illuminati to train their ranks for combat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

14067.name: Gnathic lamp tree
14067.col_2: Any Gnath would click contently beneath the gentle glow of this lamp tree.

14068.name: alpine chandelier
14068.col_2: A sumptuous chandelier designed to complement alpine residences.

14069.name: unit of alpine flooring
14069.col_2: Floorboards designed to complement alpine residences.

14070.name: alpine inner wall
14070.col_2: An interior wall designed in the alpine fashion.

14071.name: bouquet of red oldroses
14071.col_2: A bunch of red oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14072.name: bouquet of blue oldroses
14072.col_2: A bunch of blue oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14073.name: bouquet of yellow oldroses
14073.col_2: A bunch of yellow oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14074.name: bouquet of green oldroses
14074.col_2: A bunch of green oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14075.name: bouquet of orange oldroses
14075.col_2: A bunch of orange oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14076.name: bouquet of purple oldroses
14076.col_2: A bunch of purple oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14077.name: bouquet of white oldroses
14077.col_2: A bunch of white oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14078.name: bouquet of black oldroses
14078.col_2: A bunch of black oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14079.name: rainbow oldrose bouquet
14079.col_2: A bunch of multicolored oldroses, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

14080.name: set of Sephirotic barding
14080.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Sephirot, the Fiend.

14081.name: set of egg hunter barding
14081.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor equipped with a basket for hunting eggs during Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide.

14082.name: kongamato whistle
14082.col_2: A small, conch-like whistle used to summon a Gnath-trained kongamato.

14083.name: zu horn
14083.col_2: This horn of bone emits a howling blare that summons your trained zu mount.

14084.name: bennu horn
14084.col_2: This horn of bone emits a golden tone that summons a mythical bennu.

14085.name: white lanner whistle
14085.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary falcon of the mists.

14086.name: rose lanner whistle
14086.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary falcon of fury.

14087.name: round lanner whistle
14087.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary falcon of the heavens.

14088.name: warring lanner whistle
14088.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary falcon of catastrophe.

14089.name: Gloria ignition key
14089.col_2: This ignition key winds the gears of the Gloria-class airship. Remember to keep your balance.

14090.name: OFC whistle
14090.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a high-pitched tone recognized as a feeding call by the original fat chocobo.

14091.name: wind-up Gnath
14091.col_2: <click> <click> He will obey.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Gnath minion.

14092.name: wind-up Vath
14092.col_2: <click> <click> He seeks purpose. So he will follow you. Everywhere.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Vath minion.

14093.name: wind-up Garuda
14093.col_2: Hopefully she will not HEEHEE haha HEEE!!! too loudly in your ear.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Garuda minion.

14094.name: wind-up Titan
14094.col_2: Placing this wind-up Titan on an elevated surface may compel it to knock everything else to the ground. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Titan minion.

14095.name: wind-up Leviathan
14095.col_2: Your flesh cannot feed this minion of the deep. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Leviathan minion.

14096.name: wind-up Nero tol Scaeva
14096.col_2: Better engineered than the wind-up Cid. In every way. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Nero tol Scaeva minion.

14097.name: faustlet
14097.col_2: He will shelter you from the sturms. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the faustlet minion.

14098.name: Calca
14098.col_2: Whether she is cute or creepy has been oft debated, but all agree it is best not to leave her to her own devices.  <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Calca minion.

14099.name: Brina
14099.col_2: Collectors warn that one who wishes to complete the set should be well versed in the art of combat. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Brina minion.

14100.name: morpho
14100.col_2: With blue wings practically glowing, this butterfly feels almost like a spirit. Almost. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the morpho minion.

14101.name: Poro Roggo
14101.col_2: Enchanted familiar though it may be, kissing it will do nothing to alter its corporeal form. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Poro Roggo minion.

14102.name: spoony bard
14102.col_2: Although there are many different accounts of what was actually said during the famous altercation, all agree on the single utterance that became his legacy.  <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the spoony bard minion.

14103.name: Fenrir pup
14103.col_2: This stray hoarhound pup is as feisty as the leader of his pack, and just as aloof. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Fenrir pup minion.

14104.name: goblin cup
14104.col_2: Goblins fill these iron cups with rot-tea. It should probably be scoured before use.

14105.name: pair of goblin dice
14105.col_2: A pair of precisely carved and balanced dice used for goblin gambling games.

14116.name: handmaster's tool belt
14116.col_2: Before becoming obsolete due to advancements in tailoring, belts such as this were used for holding up trousers and the like.

14121.name: landmaster's survival belt
14121.col_2: Before becoming obsolete due to advancements in tailoring, belts such as this were used for holding up trousers and the like.

14126.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Carpenter IV<hex:021A020103>
14126.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced woodworking recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled carpenters.

14127.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Blacksmith IV<hex:021A020103>
14127.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced smithing recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled blacksmiths.

14128.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Armorer IV<hex:021A020103>
14128.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced armorcraft recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled armorers.

14129.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Goldsmith IV<hex:021A020103>
14129.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced goldsmithing recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled goldsmiths.

14130.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Leatherworker IV<hex:021A020103>
14130.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced leatherworking recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled leatherworkers.

14131.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Weaver IV<hex:021A020103>
14131.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced clothcraft recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled weavers.

14132.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Alchemist IV<hex:021A020103>
14132.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced alchemy recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled alchemists.

14133.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Culinarian IV<hex:021A020103>
14133.col_2: This esoteric tome─the fourth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced cooking recipes that can only be learned by highly skilled culinarians.

14134.name: jug of spiced cider
14134.col_2: A warmed jug filled with piquant apple juice mulled with zested ginger and cloves, complete with a stick of cinnamon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14135.name: apple strudel
14135.col_2: A handful of chopped apples glazed with birch syrup are thinly wrapped in a warm flaky crust, topped with just a sprinkling of cinnamon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14136.name: serving of peperoncino
14136.col_2: Noodles tossed in mature olive oil that has been infused with solstice garlic and dragon peppers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14137.name: serving of boscaiola
14137.col_2: A hearty dish of chewy noodles, heaped with a generous portion of seasonal mushrooms and drowned in tomato sauce.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14138.name: loaghtan steak
14138.col_2: A tough cut of loaghtan meat soaked in a marinade of paprika, sherry, and thyme and grilled over an open flame.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14139.name: serving of oyster confit
14139.col_2: A serving of succulent Coerthan oysters on the half shell, simmered in rich olive oil and seasoned with fresh spices.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14140.name: bowl of angler stew
14140.col_2: A thick, creamy stew brimming with tender chunks of fish, onions, and chives.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14141.name: serving of sweet gnomefish
14141.col_2: A gnomefish boiled in sweet birch syrup. The glaze preserves the fish for days after cooking.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14142.name: golden apple
14142.col_2: A mildly sweet apple with a tart aftertaste, this rare fruit is highly sought after amongst bakers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14143.name: bulb of solstice garlic
14143.col_2: Favored by chefs for leaving one's breath scant of odor after a meal, this zesty garlic is often used in gourmet dishes.

14144.name: bottle of mature olive oil
14144.col_2: A rich-tasting oil produced with pressed olives at the peak of ripeness.

14145.name: loaghtan fillet
14145.col_2: Taken from the upper loin of a domesticated loaghtan, this meat is tender enough that it does not require any preparation before cooking.

14148.name: chunk of lumythrite ore
14148.col_2: An uncut, unpolished stone containing what appears to be lumythrite.

14149.name: eikon iron ingot
14149.col_2: An ingot of smelted iron blessed by a primal.

14150.name: lump of eikon metal
14150.col_2: A heavy piece of unidentifiable metal blessed by a primal.

14151.name: chunk of smithsonite ore
14151.col_2: This slightly lustrous ore is characterized by its extremely high zinc content.

14152.name: bolt of eikon cloth
14152.col_2: Finely woven cloth blessed by a primal.

14153.name: spindle of eikon fiber
14153.col_2: Tightly spun thread blessed by a primal.

14154.name: frost cotton boll
14154.col_2: A soft and fluffy variety of cotton named for its resemblance to morning hoarfrost.

14155.name: circle of eikon leather
14155.col_2: A large piece of cured beastkin skin blessed by a primal.

14156.name: eikon hide
14156.col_2: The skin of a large, yet unidentifiable creature, blessed by a primal.

14157.name: length of treated camphorwood lumber
14157.col_2: A processed length of camphor lumber, treated with an alchemical agent to harden the wood.

14158.name: length of camphorwood lumber
14158.col_2: Processed camphor lumber. Its piquant aroma remains years after harvesting, making it a favorite for use in armoires and furnishings.

14159.name: camphorwood log
14159.col_2: A rough-cut log of camphorwood timber.

14160.name: camphorwood branch
14160.col_2: The thick branch of a camphorwood tree.

14161.name: sack of camphor
14161.col_2: The waxy, crystallized remnants of a liquid drawn from steamed bits of camphorwood.

14164.name: bundle of gobcraft resin
14164.col_2: A synthetic resin created by the goblins to protect leatherwork and carpentry from the elements.

14171.name: bottle of grade 3 strength dissolvent
14171.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

14211.name: amber salamander
14211.col_2: This freshwater amphibian is characterized by whorling patterns of deep amber across its moist skin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

14212.name: gnomefish
14212.col_2: A decidedly ugly freshwater fish commonly found in and around the Thaliak River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

14213.name: fleece stingray
14213.col_2: The white belly of this flying fish native to the skies above Coerthas is ofttimes mistaken for a cloud.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

14214.name: nyctosaur
14214.col_2: A tiny winged dragon only recently discovered in the Churning Mists.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

14215.name: lava snail
14215.col_2: The lumpy shell of the lava snail is extremely heat resistant, protecting its tiny resident from otherwise unbearable temperatures.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

14216.name: priestfish
14216.col_2: A distant cousin of the monkfish, this ravenous resident of the lakes and swamps of Coerthas also possesses a luminescent proboscis which it uses to attract prey.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

14217.name: Coerthan oyster
14217.col_2: A bivalve mollusk native to the lakes of Coerthas, and prized as a delicacy by Ishgardian nobles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

14218.name: oliphant's trunk
14218.col_2: Extended exposure to the unclassifiable aetherochemicals tainting the pools in which this fishlike creature lives has contributed to the abnormal development of its mouth and jaw.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

14219.name: mountain kraken
14219.col_2: A massive freshwater squid found in the lakes of Coerthas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

14220.name: armored catfish
14220.col_2: This large freshwater fish is covered in thick armor-like scales which protect it from the jaws of hungry bears and yetis.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

14298.name: Rowena's token (lore)

14299.name: high-capacity tomestone
14299.col_2: Ironworks experts insist these tomestones not only contain reams of invaluable information from the Allagan Empire, but compress a far greater wealth of knowledge within than the average tomestone. However, this particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

14300.name: Fiend totem
