14895.name: Midan gear
14895.col_2: A round cog removed from Alexander's Midas sector. Though such articles were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

14896.name: flask of Illuminati deep gobdip
14896.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of the realm's more daring blacksmiths have applied the unnaturally viscous substance to a variety of weapons and found that it heightens the attributes of eikon-inspired equipment. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

14897.name: loop of Illuminati taut gobtwine
14897.col_2: An alchemical thread woven in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of the realm's more daring weavers have applied the unnaturally pliable substance to a variety of vestments and found that it heightens the attributes of eikon-inspired equipment. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

14898.name: flask of Illuminati dark gobcoat
14898.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of the realm's more daring goldsmiths have applied the unnaturally illuminated substance to a variety of gems and found that it heightens the attributes of eikon-inspired equipment. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

14899.name: pot of aether oil
14899.col_2: Born of Allagan ingenuity, this aetherochemical oil can be applied to metal to lower its aetherial conductivity.

14900.name: stuffed Eggplant Knight
14900.col_2: Designed with the most complicated pattern of the plush Mandragoras, this knight will protect your castle by day, and woo the queen by night. (Mandragora Queen sold separately.)

14901.name: stuffed Garlic Jester
14901.col_2: This stuffed jester may fill your heart with childish glee, but too much cuddling and you will reek to high heavens.

14902.name: stuffed Tomato King
14902.col_2: Having no kingdom to call his own, this stuffed plush will be more than willing to rule your realm with his adorable little green fist.

14903.name: stuffed Mandragora Queen
14903.col_2: This adorable plush doll comes complete with a fabric flower and tiny hooks on the hands that can be attached to her secret lover. (Eggplant Knight sold separately.)

14931.name: antique rug
14931.col_2: Someone, many decades past, paid a considerable sum for this expertly woven floorpiece.

14932.name: circle of antique leather
14932.col_2: An attestation to its quality, this leather remains supple and uncracked despite its age.

14933.name: lump of tincalconite
14933.col_2: A pure white mineral closely related to borax.

14934.name: dinosaur fossil
14934.col_2: The lithified remains of a dinosaur long deceased.

14935.name: sheet of galvanized Garlond steel
14935.col_2: A lightweight form of steel developed by the eponymous chief engineer of the Garlond Ironworks. This particular sample has been treated to increase hardness.

14936.name: section of Faust armor plating
14936.col_2: A heavy square of body armor removed from the Illuminati-constructed battlemachina Faust.

14937.name: pinch of powdered merman horn
14937.col_2: This mysterious powder is claimed to have been ground from the horn of a merman, prompting the question, do mermen have horns? Regardless of its origins, the powder has been proven to be decidedly potent.

14938.name: black copper gil promissory note
14938.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for black copper gil which, at first glance, appears to be standard Eorzean currency. Until, that is, one notices the crooked stamping and texture of smelted scrap metal.

14944.name: chipped fortune egg
14944.col_2: A plain white Archon egg believed to bring its bearer good luck as long as it remains uncracked. While scholars still hotly debate whether “chipped” is synonymous to “cracked,” it may be safer to simply obtain a new egg.

14945.name: squadron enlistment manual
14945.col_2: Grand Company-issue literature outlining basic techniques used in soldier recruitment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases the chance a new recruit will request enlistment in your squadron. Effect ends upon recruit arrival.

14946.name: priority seal allowance
14946.col_2: A Grand Company-issue pass authorizing a temporary increase in payment for services rendered.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases number of company seals earned by completing Grand Company duties.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Seal Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +15%  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 120m<hex:02100103>Overwrites company actions with similar effects.

14947.name: Gold Saucer VIP card
14947.col_2: A Grand Company-issue pass for officers granting a temporary increase in MGP payouts at the Manderville Gold Saucer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Increases quantity of MGP earned by participating in Gold Saucer attractions.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>MGP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +15%  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 120m<hex:02100103>Overwrites company actions with similar effects.

14955.name: handful of lumythrite sand
14955.col_2: Glowing sand consisting of tiny grains of lumythrite.

14956.name: whitefrost cotton boll
14956.col_2: Despite their delicate appearance, the fibers of the whitefrost cotton flower are deceptively durable.

14957.name: old-growth camphorwood log
14957.col_2: A glance at a cross section of this log reveals that a mere glance isn't enough to count the hundreds, perhaps thousands, of rings present.

14958.name: golden sparkler
14958.col_2: Unsatisfied with the spark output of regular sparklers, Manderville & Manderville hired their own team of pyrotechnicians to create the perfect work of fire.

14959.name: deluxe heavenscracker
14959.col_2: An unexpected by-product of the Skysteel Manufactory's recent endeavors to develop a more volatile variety of firesand. Packs twice the amount of explosive punch as a regular heavenscracker.

14970.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Pulse<hex:021A020103>

15161.name: oriental deck

15162.name: pumpkin carriage

15195.col_2: He tends to take out his anger on passing vehicles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire Jibanyan.

15421.name: Horde totem
15421.col_2: This horn-carved idol resembling the wyrm Nidhogg is used by heretics during their bloody sacrament.

15422.name: Gelmorran potsherd
15422.col_2: A jagged piece of a pottery dating back to the early Sixth Astral Era.

15423.name: carved kupo nut promissory note
15423.col_2: A promissory note that can be exchanged for carved kupo nuts─inedible kupo nuts carved with a special symbol to denote use as moogle currency.

15424.name: Faire voucher MMXVI
15424.col_2: Currency minted and distributed by the Adventurers' Guild for use during the Moonfire Faire.

15425.name: cup of rolanberry shaved ice
15425.col_2: A heaping mound of the purest ice harvested from atop the mountains of Coerthas, shaved and drizzled in multicolored rolanberry syrup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

15427.name: set of Horde barding
15427.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the great wyrm Nidhogg.

15428.name: set of butlery barding
15428.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to fool the world into believing your chocobo is a man hired to answer your front door.

15429.name: bag of cloud mallow seeds
15429.col_2: A handful of seeds that, when scattered, immediately grow into full-sized cloud mallows.

15430.name: fat moogle bugle
15430.col_2: One toot on this shiny horn and any adventurer's lifelong dream to ride upon a wooden bench hauled about by a potbellied moogle will be answered.

15431.name: Whisper-go key
15431.col_2: It may simply be their imagination, but some say they can hear the sound of a thousand groans as the key turns the gears.

15432.name: dark lanner whistle
15432.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary falcon of rage.

15433.name: Astrope whistle
15433.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by Astrope.

15434.name: dress-up Y'shtola
15434.col_2: Now with more aetheric...enhancements?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the dress-up Y'shtola minion.

15435.name: wind-up dragonet
15435.col_2: For the adventurer who has always longed to be a mother of dragons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up dragonet minion.

15436.name: wind-up Ramuh
15436.col_2: He's silently judging you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Ramuh minion.

15437.name: wind-up Shiva
15437.col_2: Renounce the hatreds that consume you, and she will scatter them like sawdust into the wind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Shiva minion.

15438.name: Piggy
15438.col_2: Many have tried casting Esuna on what they thought was a struggling adventurer, only to find they had wasted their magic.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Piggy minion.

15439.name: magic bucket
15439.col_2: A fisherman's best friend. He sloshes instead of slobbers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the magic bucket minion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases, for some reason.]

15440.name: calamari
15440.col_2: Use item to acquire the calamari minion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>(Or is it a trap!?)

15441.name: baby brachiosaur
15441.col_2: The greatest adventure ever born.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby brachiosaur minion.

15442.name: wind-up cheerleader
15442.col_2: Oh, I think that you've found yourself a cheerleader.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up cheerleader minion.

15443.name: wind-up Krile
15443.col_2: She is terribly, terribly sorry to have kept you waiting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Krile minion.

15444.name: wind-up Aymeric

15933.name: disembodied head resonator
15933.col_2: A metal tuning fork that, when struck, emits a high-pitched tone which can animate inanimate objects possessing voidal properties─including your personal disembodied stone head.

15945.col_2: A fine powder ground from dried mountain daisies. The pungent smoke emitted when burned as an incense is believed to repel all manner of vilekin.

15946.name: Whisper A-go-go key
15946.col_2: It may just be their imagination, but some say they can hear the sound of a thousand groans and a single meow as the key winds the gears.

15947.name: Mhachi penny
15947.col_2: A small coin of low denomination once used in the long-fallen nation of Mhach. There are four Mhachi farthings in a penny. Once actively sought by numismatists across Eorzea, the market soon became oversaturated, causing this ancient currency to lose its value entirely.

15948.name: handful of Lover's laurel leaves

15949.name: handful of radiant astral moraine

15967.name: stuffed Calca
15967.col_2: What every impressionable toddler needs in her toy box. Psychosomatic trauma increased tenfold when paired with a stuffed Brina.

15968.name: stuffed Brina
15968.col_2: What every impressionable toddler needs in her toy box. Psychosomatic trauma increased tenfold when paired with a stuffed Calca.

15969.col_2: A stout table lantern designed to resemble an automaton mammet.

15970.name: mounted box shelf
15970.col_2: Several interconnected boxes hung on walls to store knickknacks, gewgaws, and other assorted miscellany.

15971.name: knightly round table
15971.col_2: A handcrafted replica of the table at which the Heavens' Ward hold conclave.

15973.name: bowl of pumpkin stew
15973.col_2: An All Saints' Wake culinary tradition, this rich, buttery soup is oft served in a hollowed-out pumpkin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>CP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +9% (Max 23)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>GP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 22)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

15974.name: mounted bookshelf

15975.name: Great Gubal floor lamp

15976.name: combed wool rug
15976.col_2: A plush throw rug so soft, it will have your guests swearing they tread upon the very Sea of Clouds.

15977.name: collection of spirits

15978.name: Starlight pillar

15979.name: Season Two Lone Wolf trophy
15979.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Two of the Feast.

15980.name: Season Two Pack Wolf trophy
15980.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Two of the Feast.

15981.name: autumnal maple tree

15982.name: autumnal ginkgo tree
15982.col_2: A young ginkgo tree transplanted at the moment its leaves began turning yellow, and magicked so that it might remain in this state for all eternity (or until the spell weakens).

15983.col_2: This near-perfect pile of meticulously gathered maple leaves simply begs passersby to throw all self-restraint to the wind and take the plunge.

15984.name: ginkgo leaf pile
15984.col_2: This near-perfect pile of meticulously gathered ginkgo leaves simply begs passersby to throw all self-restraint to the wind and take the plunge.

15985.name: snow drift

15986.name: firecrest trophy
15986.col_2: A stunning trophy crafted from an item believed to contain the soul of a legendary dragon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

15987.name: glass pumpkin trophy
15987.col_2: A stunning trophy crafted using a flawless crystal pumpkin believed to be imbued with arcane magicks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

15988.name: deluxe pumpkin basket
15988.col_2: A pumpkin-shaped basket filled with All Saints' Wake goodies. Decidedly better than last year's basket in ways far too numerous to list here.

15989.name: deluxe stuffed succubus
15989.col_2: Take this All Saints' Wake-themed doll to bed at your own risk. Decidedly better than last year's succubus in ways far too numerous to list here.

15990.name: deluxe pumpkin desk
15990.col_2: A pumpkin-themed desk designed with All Saints' Wake in mind. Decidedly better than last year's desk in ways far too numerous to list here.

15991.name: deluxe pumpkin chair
15991.col_2: The perfect partner for a pumpkin desk. Decidedly better than last year's chair in ways far too numerous to list here.

15992.name: stack of empty sparkleboxes
15992.col_2: A sparklebox without a present is like a twinklebox without a present is like a child without a smile.

15993.name: jumbo stuffed Qiqirn
15993.col_2: A handmade doll crafted to resemble a Qiqirn, and dressed in a festive Starlight Celebration outfit. The difference in size with a normal stuffed Qiqirn is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

15994.name: jumbo Starlight wreath
15994.col_2: A simple circle of evergreen branches hung on doors during the Starlight Celebration. While the tradition is fairly new, there already exist several theories as to how the practice started. Some believe the circle represents the symbolic beginning and end of a year, and in turn, our lives, while others claim it is merely easier to hang a ring than it is a straight branch. The difference in size with a normal Starlight wreath is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

15995.name: jumbo Starlight ornament
15995.col_2: A wall decoration hung in homes during the Starlight Celebration. The difference in size with a normal Starlight ornament is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

15996.name: jumbo twin star ornament
15996.col_2: A brilliant wall decoration hung in homes during the Starlight Celebration. The difference in size with a normal twin star ornament is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

15997.name: jumbo Starlight sentinel
15997.col_2: A potted conifer displayed in homes during the Starlight Celebration. The difference in size with a normal Starlight sentinel is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

15998.name: pair of jumbo sheep dolls
15998.col_2: Two stuffed sheep─husband and wife─dressed in traditional Far Eastern garb. The difference in size with normal sheep dolls is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

15999.name: stack of jumbo hard rice cakes
15999.description: stacks of jumbo hard rice cakes
15999.col_2: Known in the Far East as “kagami mochi,” these cakes are not traditionally eaten, but displayed before and during Heavensturn. The difference in size with normal hard rice cakes is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

16000.name: jumbo oriental orange basket
16000.col_2: Oriental oranges, while small, are far softer and sweeter than the oranges found growing in Eorzea. The difference in size with a normal oriental orange basket is indiscernible to all but the most observant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 6)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

16001.name: jumbo paissa doll
16001.col_2: A stuffed toy recently adopted for use in Heavensturn festivities. The difference in size with a normal paissa doll is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

16002.name: deluxe pumpkin candlestand
16002.col_2: A decorated lamppost displayed during All Saints' Wake. Decidedly better than last year's candlestand in ways far too numerous to list here.

16003.name: jumbo star-topped Starlight sentinel
16003.col_2: A potted fir, decorated with a star-shaped ornament at its apex. The difference in size with a normal star-topped Starlight sentinel is indiscernible to all but the most observant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only one Starlight sentinel may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

16004.name: jumbo moon-topped Starlight sentinel
16004.col_2: A potted fir, decorated with a crescent moon-shaped ornament at its apex. The difference in size with a normal moon-topped Starlight sentinel is indiscernible to all but the most observant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only one Starlight sentinel may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

16005.name: jumbo sun-topped Starlight sentinel
16005.col_2: A potted fir, decorated with a sun-shaped ornament at its apex. The difference in size with a normal sun-topped Starlight sentinel is indiscernible to all but the most observant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only one Starlight sentinel may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

16006.name: jumbo snowman
16006.col_2: Garlean scholars have conducted extensive studies on the subject of why Eorzean snowmen are constructed of only two balls of snow rather than three─the number of choice throughout Ilsabard. The prevailing theory is that extensive studies should not have been conducted on said subject. The difference in size with a normal snowman is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

16007.name: stack of empty present boxes
16007.col_2: A box without a present is like a box without a gift is like a bird without a song.

16008.name: jumbo kadomatsu
16008.col_2: A mini-tower of sliced bamboo and pine branches─the kadomatsu is a Far Eastern oddity traditionally displayed at homes and in temples for the duration of Heavensturn. The difference in size with a normal kadomatsu is indiscernible to all but the most observant.

16009.name: roll of deluxe eerie wallpaper
16009.col_2: Ready your estate for All Saints' Wake with this frightening-yet-festive interior wall covering. Decidedly better than last year's wallpaper in ways far too numerous to list here.

16010.name: deluxe Starlight interior wall
16010.col_2: This wall bears a festive design certain to bring joy and cheer to all...until you finally get around to taking it down six moons later. Decidedly more stellar than last year's walls in ways far too profound to explain here.

16013.name: crystal chandelier
16013.col_2: The aether contained within the crystals used to construct this magnificent lighting fixture emits an ethereal glow which enhances the mood of any hall or parlor.

16014.name: unit of Palace of the Dead flooring
16014.description: units of Palace of the Dead flooring
16014.col_2: Flooring designed using reports penned by those fortunate enough to return from their expeditionary missions into the Palace of the Dead...with their sanity intact.

16015.name: Palace of the Dead interior wall
16015.description: Palace of the Dead interior walls
16015.col_2: An interior wall designed using reports penned by those fortunate enough to return from their expeditionary missions into the Palace of the Dead...with their sanity intact.
16015.col_3: Palace of the Dead Interior Wall

16016.name: bag of viola seeds
16016.col_2: And there is pansies, that's for thoughts. And there is pansy seeds, that's for growing pansies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

16017.name: bouquet of red violas
16017.col_2: A bunch of red violas, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

16025.col_2: A bunch of multicolored violas, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

16026.name: bag of potting soil
16026.col_2: Standard-grade earth for growing plants and vegetables. Exhibits absolutely no standout properties.

16027.name: wind-up Yuna
16027.col_2: “My will is strong!” So is this automaton's resistance to rust.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Yuna minion.

16028.name: wind-up Rikku
16028.col_2: “Victory is ours!” This automaton is yours.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Rikku minion.

16029.name: wind-up Lulu
16029.col_2: “Magic has no limits.” Nor does the list of exciting things you can do with this automaton.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Lulu minion.

16030.name: Namingway
16030.col_2: Do not think this means you can now change your character's name.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Namingway minion.

16031.name: wind-up Bartz
16031.col_2: I like small Bartz and I cannot lie.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Bartz minion.

16032.name: wind-up red mage
16032.col_2: He'd rather be red than dead.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up red mage minion.

16037.name: Syldra horn
16037.col_2: A tar-stained horn that, when blown, emits a low, rumbling tone that can be heard even hundreds of yalms under the sea─the preferred breeding grounds of the legendary Syldra.

16039.name: pair of Ala Mhigan earrings
16039.col_2: Increases EXP earned by 30% when level 50 and below.

16040.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Zantetsuken<hex:021A020103>
16040.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to best cleave an enemy or acquaintance in twain. Use to learn the /zantetsuken emote.

16041.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Diamond Dust<hex:021A020103>
16041.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to dance like a snowflake on the wind. Use to learn the /iceheart emote.

16049.name: dream of the Fayth
16049.col_2: A slip of what appears to be parchment containing what appears to be some sort of foreign script.

16064.name: singing cluster
16064.col_2: A large crystal formation so charged with magicks that it literally hums.

16065.name: set of brooklet tank trimmings
16065.col_2: An assortment of items used to outfit an aquarium that it might resemble a babbling forest brooklet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[For use in any tier aquarium.]

16066.name: set of southern seas tank trimmings
16066.description: sets of southern seas tank trimmings
16066.col_2: An assortment of items used to outfit an aquarium that it might resemble the shallows of the tropical southern seas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[For use in any tier aquarium.]

16147.name: deluxe oriental wind chime
16147.col_2: This small glass bell has a slip of parchment attached to its clapper which, when blown by the wind, causes the clapper to strike the rim. Completely different than last year's chime, we promise.

16148.name: deluxe Bombard lamp
16148.col_2: A massive lamp designed to resemble the villain of the Moonfire Faire─the Bombard. Completely different than last year's lamp, we promise.

16149.name: deluxe Moonfire lantern
16149.col_2: An outdoor lantern traditionally placed outside one's home for the duration of the Moonfire Faire. Completely different than last year's lantern, we promise.

16150.name: stalk of deluxe ornamental bamboo
16150.col_2: People hailing from the Far East claim that wishes written on small slips of parchment and tied to the bamboo will come true. (Magical wish parchment sold separately.) Completely different than last year's bamboo, we promise.

16151.name: deluxe wooden bucket
16151.col_2: A wooden bucket filled with crystal-clear water. Families in the Far East use these receptacles to chill fruit during the hot summer moons. Completely different than last year's bucket, we promise.

16168.name: firecrest
16168.col_2: An ancient artifact believed to contain the soul of a legendary dragon.

16169.name: glass pumpkin
16169.col_2: A flawless crystal pumpkin believed to be imbued with arcane magicks.

16170.name: bronze-trimmed sack
16170.col_2: This heavy bag containing a portion of the Palace of the Dead's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only following an appraisal at the hands of a bishop trained in the dispelling of hexes can the seal be broken.

16541.name: micro tomestone
16541.col_2: Similar to the more common tomestones believed to store the lost knowledge of the Allagan Empire, yet at the fraction of the size, micro tomestones are highly sought by collectors and scholars alike. However, that was before the market became flooded with this particular variety, and as a result, it is no longer accepted as a viable bartering material.

16542.name: flask of Illuminati darkest gobcoat
16542.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of Idyllshire's goblin goldsmiths have applied the unnaturally viscous substance to a variety of precious stones and found that it heightens the attributes of the gear and accessories crafted in their workshops. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

16543.name: loop of Illuminati tautest gobtwine
16543.col_2: An alchemical thread woven in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of Idyllshire's goblin weavers have applied the unnaturally pliable substance to a variety of vestments and found that it heightens the attributes of gear woven in their looms. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

16544.name: flask of Illuminati deepest gobdip
16544.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted in the dark laboratoriums of the Illuminati. Some of Idyllshire's goblin smithies have applied the unnaturally illuminated substance to a variety of metals and found that it heightens the attributes of weapons crafted in their forges. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

16557.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Sophia, the Goddess.

16562.name: Sophic lanner whistle
16562.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a legendary falcon bred to serve the ancient Meracydian goddess, Sophia.

16563.col_2: A heavy gold key that, when inserted into the proper slot on the Arrhidaeus transport module, will power the superannuated device.

16564.col_2: A small ebon ocarina that, when played, emits a rainbow of sound that summons forth a night pegasus.

16565.name: Goten pipe
16565.col_2: An otherworldly flute that, when played, summons the armored Mado steed, Goten.

16713.col_2: Common fare of fisherfolk across Eorzea's southwestern coasts, the sauce used in this pasta dish consists of a wide variety of fresh local seafood─from fish to mollusk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

16721.name: star cotton boll
16721.col_2: A rare variety of cotton which produces nitid fibers that, when struck by light, coruscate like the very stars in the heavens.

16722.name: brown mushroom
16722.col_2: An earthen fungus that can commonly be found sprouting beneath trees growing in the Churning Mists.

16723.name: sprig of noble sage
16723.col_2: A fragrant herb used in medicines, perfumes, and cooking. Its deep blue flowers set it apart from its cousin, clary sage.

16724.name: chunk of tungstite
16724.col_2: A bright-yellow mineral formed by the weathering of scheelite.

16725.name: chunk of luminium ore
16725.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing the precious metal luminium.

16726.name: chunk of zeolite ore
16726.col_2: A porous silicate that adsorbs poisons, making it invaluable in myriad alchemical and medical concoctions.

16727.name: pinch of titanium carbide
16727.col_2: Titanium that has been ground to a powder and carbonized via extreme heat.

16728.name: scintillant nugget
16728.col_2: A small nugget of impure luminium.

16729.name: spindle of invisible silk
16729.col_2: Silk so thin, it is barely discernable with the naked eye, despite proving as tensile as normal silken thread. Only silkworms bred under strict conditions will produce such fiber.

16730.name: hemicyon hide
16730.col_2: The thick bristly hide of an ancient breed of canine believed unchanged for seven Astral Eras.

17016.name: paramour vase

17021.name: riviera breakfast

17521.description: sheets of Proto Ultima heat shielding
17521.col_2: A surprisingly light piece of metal that made up Proto Ultima's outer armor, protecting the machinery within from extreme temperatures.

17522.name: set of Zurvanite barding
17522.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Zurvan, the Demon.

17523.name: legendary Clan mark log
17523.col_2: A list of elite marks slain by the log's owner─a hunter so great, that her legendary exploits are almost too remarkable to believe. Though such documents were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

17524.name: pegasus colt
17524.col_2: Unfortunately does not emit rainbows from any of its orifices.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the pegasus colt minion.

17525.name: bullpup
17525.col_2: Runt of the canis pugnaces litter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bullpup minion.

17526.name: angel of mercy
17526.col_2: Come and save me tonight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the angel of mercy minion.

17527.name: wind-up Estinien
17527.col_2: Absolutely, positively not possessed by an evil dragon bent on ridding the world of mankind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Estinien minion.

17528.name: wind-up Hraesvelgr
17528.col_2: Comes complete with overhead nameplate to help with spelling.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Hraesvelgr minion.

17529.name: Gigi
17529.col_2: Also known as Vivi...but his secret is safe with you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Gigi minion.

17530.name: anima
17530.col_2: From your heart and from your hand. Finally people will understand your intentions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the anima minion.

17531.name: wind-up Scathach
17531.col_2: Surprisingly visible despite being a queen of the shadows.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Scathach minion.

17532.name: wind-up Nidhogg
17532.col_2: Now with more eyes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Nidhogg minion.

17533.name: hellpup
17533.col_2: Not all children are products of their environment. This one, however, is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the hellpup minion.

17534.name: faepup
17534.col_2: Every dog has its fae.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the faepup minion.

17535.name: wind-up Ohl Deeh
17535.col_2: 100% less subject to violent mood swings than its living counterpart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Ohl Deeh minion.

17536.name: wind-up moon
17536.col_2: /poke to adjust elevation. /point to inform others of its location. /blowkiss to get strange looks from passersby.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up moon minion.

17546.name: Shroud cherry sapling
17546.col_2: Looks so good, bring a tear to your eye.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

17547.name: cloud acorn sapling
17547.col_2: The humble beginnings of a mighty cloud oak.

17548.name: cloud acorn
17548.col_2: The Vanu Vanu will oft use these large seeds in the creation of sacred ornaments, or even armor.

17549.name: Near Eastern antique
17549.col_2: A piece of Radz-at-Han's illustrious history.

17550.name: Coerthan souvenir
17550.col_2: A novel item to remember the northern region by.

17551.name: piece of Maelstrom materiel
17551.col_2: A practical item handy in times of war <hex:021A020203>or<hex:021A020103> peace.

17552.name: heartfelt gift
17552.col_2: The best gifts are those that come from the heart.

17553.name: orphanage donation
17553.col_2: An everyday item necessary in the operation and upkeep of a public home for forsaken wastrels.

17554.name: Near Eastern antique component
17554.col_2: A component used to complete a Near Eastern antique.

17555.name: Coerthan souvenir component
17555.col_2: A component used to complete a Coerthan souvenir.

17556.name: Maelstrom materiel component
17556.col_2: A component used to complete a piece of Maelstrom materiel.

17557.name: dated Radz-at-Han coin
17557.col_2: Currency once used on the Near Eastern island of Thavnair, now only sought by numismatists and historians.

17558.name: ice stalagmite
17558.col_2: Ice stalactites <hex:021A020203>hold on tight<hex:021A020103> to the ceiling of a cave. This is not an ice stalactite.

17559.name: tuft of duskfall moss
17559.col_2: Infusions made with this hardy brown-black foliage are believed to restore vigor.

17560.name: glass eye
17560.col_2: A small bead of naturally formed glass that could pass off as an eye, if viewed from thirty paces...in the fog.

17561.name: lump of rainbow pigment
17561.col_2: Extracted from natural sources, this colorful powder can be prepared to create an equally colorful dye.

17562.name: Thavnairian leaf
17562.col_2: A freshwater fish originally native to the Near Eastern island of Thavnair. How they ultimately ended up in the upper Thaliak River remains an enigma.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

17563.name: ghost faerie
17563.col_2: An almost entirely transparent shell-less mollusk found solely in the waters of Clearpool.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

17564.name: piece of red sky coral
17564.col_2: A blood red species of coral found growing on the undersides of islands in the Sea of Clouds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17565.name: lovers' clam
17565.col_2: A tiny pinkish bivalve mollusk found primarily in Weston Waters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

17566.name: river shrimp
17566.col_2: A rare freshwater shrimp that typically makes its home beneath the rocks that produce the rapids near the Hundred Throes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

17567.name: cloud mythril ingot
17567.col_2: An ingot of smelted cloud mythril.

17568.name: bolt of stormcloud cotton cloth
17568.col_2: Several yalms of undyed stormcloud cotton cloth wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

17569.name: circle of peteinosaur leather
17569.col_2: A large piece of cured peteinosaur skin.

17570.name: chunk of cloud mythril ore
17570.col_2: Extended exposure to the extreme aetherial currents found on and near the Diadem have somehow altered the mythril contained in this piece of rock.

17571.name: stormcloud cotton boll
17571.col_2: Extended exposure to the extreme aetherial currents found on and near the Diadem have somehow altered the fibers of this otherwise ordinary cloud cotton.

17572.name: Zurvanite carapace fragment
17572.col_2: A blazing fragment retrieved from the protective armor of Zurvan, the Demon.

17573.name: fragment of void matter
17573.col_2: Little is known about this deceptively heavy substance save that its origins lie not in this world.

17574.name: bolt of flannel
17574.col_2: Sturdy cloth woven with two varieties of thread─wool and cotton.

17575.name: stuffed sabotender
17575.col_2: Because who hasn't dreamed of hugging a cactus?

17576.name: honey bun
17576.col_2: Most often found in markets located across the eastern and southern regions of Eorzea, this lightly glazed buttery brioche pastry will keep for several days (making it a fine companion for long journeys), but is best when freshly baked. Guaranteed to make life sweeter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17577.name: bishopfish
17577.col_2: An archbishop among priestfish, and lord of the waters of Clearpool.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17578.name: Captain Nemo
17578.col_2: A king among ammonites, and lord of the waters of Banepool.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

17579.name: paikiller
17579.col_2: A king among catkillers, and lord of the waters of the Eddies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17580.name: Ceti
17580.col_2: A king among oliphant's trunks, and lord of the skies near the Hyperstellar Downconverter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17581.name: crystal pigeon
17581.col_2: A king among stupendemys, and lord of the skies near the Habisphere.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17582.name: Thunderscale
17582.col_2: A king among amber salamanders, and lord of the waters of the Iron Feast.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17583.name: Riddle
17583.col_2: A king among magma lice, and lord of the magma flows in Anyx Old.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17584.name: the Lord of Lords
17584.col_2: A king among lavalords, and unquestioned ruler of the magma flows near Halo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17585.name: the Speaker
17585.col_2: A king among armored catfish, and lord of the waters of the upper Thaliak River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17586.name: thousand fin
17586.col_2: A king among hundred fins, and lord of the pools of Weston Waters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17587.name: Bloodchaser
17587.col_2: A king among storm chasers, and lord of the skies near Tharl Oom Khash.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17588.name: problematicus
17588.col_2: A colossal magma-dwelling fish and legend of the lava pools near Halo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17589.name: opabinia
17589.col_2: A rarely seen Allagan abomination rumored to dwell in the aetherochemical pools collecting on the Flagship in Azys Lla.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

17590.name: armor fish
17590.col_2: A massive glowing freshwater fish found living in the Thaliak River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

17591.name: sea butterfly
17591.col_2: Though oft referred to as king of the skies near Mok Oogl Island, to claim this floating mollusk is elusive would be a gross understatement.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

17592.name: Charibenet
17592.col_2: Lord of the waters of Clearpool, Charibenet is (was) one of the largest, most voracious ice faeries to ever be captured.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

17593.name: raimdellopterus
17593.col_2: The moogles of Moghome say that one can live his entire life without ever witnessing a raimdellopterus descend from the upper reaches of Tharl Oom Khash. They also say that some moogles spend a lot of their lives sleeping.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

17594.name: peteinosaur
17594.col_2: A winged scalekin recently discovered in the skies near the Diadem.

17595.name: Mhachi shilling
17595.col_2: A small coin of low denomination once used in the long-fallen nation of Mhach. There are twelve Mhachi pennies in a shilling. Once actively sought by numismatists across Eorzea, the market soon became oversaturated, causing this ancient currency to lose its value entirely.

17917.name: set of bustle materials
17917.col_2: All the materials necessary to sew an Ishgardian bustle dress. (Crystals not included.)

17918.name: elegant bustle
17918.col_2: A bustle dress of Ishgardian design, featuring extra hoops and springs to prevent unsightly sagging.

17919.name: set of spring dress materials
17919.col_2: All the materials necessary to sew a spring dress. (Crystals not included.)

17920.name: winsome spring dress
17920.col_2: A beautiful dress crafted with only the finest materials.

17921.name: set of bustier materials
17921.col_2: All the materials necessary to sew a figure-enhancing bustier. (Crystals not included.)

17922.name: seductive bustier
17922.col_2: A bustier of Thavnairian design, cut low to distract potential business clients, thus providing the upper hand in negotiations.

17923.name: set of hagoromo materials
17923.col_2: All the materials necessary to sew a Far Eastern robe known as a “hagoromo.” (Crystals not included.)

17924.name: tennyo hagoromo
17924.col_2: A billowy kimono of Far Eastern design named for angelic beings from Hingan folklore.

17925.name: set of electuary ingredients
17925.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to brew a potent performance-enhancing tonic. (Crystals not included.)

17926.name: intellectuary
17926.col_2: A sweetened tonic believed to improve cognition.

17927.name: set of juice ingredients
17927.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to brew a mean beverage. (Crystals not included.)

17928.name: bottle of twice-fermented Mun-Tuy juice
17928.col_2: Fermenting Mun-Tuy extract twice greatly lessens the beans' natural bitterness, resulting in a smoother aftertaste. Side effects of the beverage include a decided loosening of the tongue.

17929.name: set of luminol ingredients
17929.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to concoct a batch of blood-detecting luminol. (Crystals not included.)

17930.name: bottle of luminol
17930.col_2: When applied to an object that has recently been in contact with blood, this alchemical admixture will change color.

17931.name: set of dissolvent ingredients
17931.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to concoct a batch of highly acidic dissolvent. (Crystals not included.)

17932.name: vial of potent dissolvent
17932.col_2: Dissolvent so potent it will eat through almost anything.

17933.name: set of rice ball ingredients
17933.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to cook a rice ball─the Far Eastern treat. (Crystals not included.)

17934.name: set of Doman rice balls
17934.col_2: Simple triangular balls of steamed sticky rice sprinkled with naught but a pinch of sea salt so that one might appreciate the subtle flavors of the original ingredients.

17935.name: set of broth ingredients
17935.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to brew a simple fish stock─one of the pillars of Far Eastern cuisine. (Crystals not included.)

17936.name: bowl of Doman udon broth
17936.col_2: Golden savory stock taken by boiling flakes of a dried bonito. Used in many varieties of Far Eastern cuisine, including the noodle dish, udon.

17937.name: set of sushi ingredients
17937.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to create the traditional Far Eastern specialty─sushi. (Crystals not included.)

17938.name: plate of nigiri-zushi
17938.col_2: One of many types of sushi, nigiri-zushi is called such because chefs use their hands to grip (nigiri) and form small balls of vinegared rice onto which are placed various items such as vegetables or fish.

17939.name: set of sukiyaki ingredients
17939.col_2: All the ingredients necessary to create the (supposedly) traditional Far Eastern specialty─sukiyaki. (Crystals not included.)

17940.name: serving of Doman sukiyaki
17940.col_2: Originally introduced to Doma by Ala Mhigan merchants, sukiyaki is a popular dish that consists of thinly sliced meat and vegetables cooked in sweet and savory soy-based sauce.

17941.name: chunk of beggar's mythril ore
17941.col_2: Lower aetherial conductivity than regular mythril makes this a poor substitute for the precious green metal...unless low aetherial conductivity is what you require.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17942.name: chunk of feather iron ore
17942.col_2: Not technically as light as an actual feather, this rare variety of iron weighs slightly less than normal iron, making it a preferable alternative...if enough can be procured.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17943.name: chunk of serpentine
17943.col_2: This rare mineral, also known as lizardite, is still believed in some regions to be the lithified remains of a great scalekin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17944.name: chunk of pummelite
17944.col_2: This oddly named ore was dubbed such by early Gyr Abanian settlers who believed the chunks of colorful mineral to be pieces of a larger rock shattered by a single blow of the Destroyer's fist.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17945.name: wild popoto
17945.col_2: Allowed to grow unchecked in the wild, it only took a matter of generations for this transplant from the New World to become decidedly different than its farm-grown cousins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17946.name: Walker's popoto
17946.col_2: A variety of popoto bred by a botanist named Walker to withstand the harsh winds and rocky soil of southern La Noscea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17947.name: bundle of nanoriso
17947.col_2: This light brown seaweed with spiked “leaves” is quite common in the seas off Hingashi, and collected and dried for use in cuisine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17948.name: Rhalgr's streak
17948.col_2: Also known as Rhalgr's staff, this long-leafed medicinal herb is native to the highlands of Gyr Abania.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

17949.name: deep Velodyna carp
17949.col_2: This variety of Velodyna carp is not named for the deep river pools in which it hides from predators, but the dark coloring of its skin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

17950.name: harutsuge sprag
17950.col_2: A newly hatched fry of the brilliantly red harutsuge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

17951.name: dafangshi
17951.col_2: Rumored to be immortal by local villagers, this freshwater fish native to Yanxia is easily discernable by its countless facial “whiskers.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

17952.name: giant plesiosaur
17952.col_2: Few scholars will disagree that this enormous scalekin sits atop the oceanic food chain.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

17953.name: Carbuncle bed
17953.col_2: This quaint pallet will never <hex:021A020203>betray you<hex:021A020103> a good night's sleep.

17954.name: table orchestrion
17954.col_2: All the music from your world, all in the palm of your...table.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One orchestrion of any type per estate only.

17955.name: mounted flower vase
17955.col_2: Is your table cluttered with ashtrays, deathmouse pelts, or forbidden tomes, leaving little to no room to display those beautiful begonias? This wall-adorning vase would like a word with you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Select flowers can be displayed within.

17956.name: stuffed dhalmel
17956.col_2: One of the tallest beastkin known on Eorzea, the dhalmel is almost as majestic in your living room as it is in the wild. Almost.

17957.name: stuffed gagana
17957.col_2: A majestic gagana, gutted, tanned, and stuffed, so as not to wrinkle the noses of your houseguests.

17958.name: oriental pipe box
17958.col_2: A pipe box of Far Eastern design, complete with an ashtray and compartments for several varieties of tobacco.

17959.name: oriental dressing case
17959.col_2: A dressing case of Far Eastern design, featuring a large mirror of polished metal and countless compartments for jewelry and sundry maquillage.

17960.name: Doman partition
17960.col_2: A partition of traditional Doman design for use in both homes and places of business.

17961.name: Lakshmi miniature
17961.col_2: A statuette depicting the Lady of Bliss, Lakshmi. (Qalyana chieftainess unsurprisingly missing.)<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

17962.name: Susano miniature
17962.col_2: A statuette depicting the Lord of the Revel, Susano. (Legendary blade Ame-no-Murakumo included. Second “O” missing, and nowhere to be found.)<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

17963.name: Season Five Lone Wolf trophy
17963.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Five of the Feast.

17965.name: stuffed Edda
17965.col_2: Go ahead. Try and convince yourself that the reason this stuffed doll weighs considerably more than similar toys is because her heart is full to bursting with love.

17966.name: Rising balloon
17966.col_2: The bladder of some poor beast, colored with dye and filled with lighter-than-air gas to dazzle the young <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> the young at heart come the Rising.

17967.name: oriental sushi lunch
17967.col_2: An exotic Far Eastern dish of sweet, vinegared rice, raw fish, and marine flora prepared to stimulate not only the tongue, but the eyes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 35)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 36)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17968.name: oriental soba lunch
17968.col_2: An exotic Far Eastern dish of earthy buckwheat noodles eaten by dipping them into a chilled broth of soy sauce and fish stock.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 35)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 36)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17969.name: oriental udon lunch
17969.col_2: An exotic Far Eastern dish of thick flour noodles swimming in a hot broth of soy sauce and fish stock.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 34)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 36)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17970.name: oriental rice ball lunch
17970.col_2: A simple Far Eastern dish consisting of hand-shaped balls of lightly salted rice wrapped in dried seaweed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 35)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 36)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17971.name: easel
17971.col_2: A three-legged wooden frame upon which a painting may be placed to cozen your kith and kin into believing you were responsible for the masterpiece.

17972.name: elixir bottle
17972.col_2: An empty glass receptacle that dreams of being full once more.

17973.name: zabuton cushion
17973.col_2: A thin square pillow common in Hingashi where denizens of the Far Eastern nation prefer to sit upon the floor than employ chairs.

17974.name: white half partition
17974.col_2: An unadorned partition, reaching only less than halfway to the ceiling so as to provide privacy without making the room feel smaller.

17975.name: Moonfire Faire MMXIV advertisement
17975.col_2: A faithful depiction of summer's hottest festival so that you may feel the heat year-round.

17976.name: cup of evercold shaved ice
17976.col_2: Thinly shaved ice, generously heaped into an oversmall bowl and drizzled with sweet-yet-tangy rolanberry syrup. Why it never melts is a question best served cold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 11)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +1<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17977.name: unmoving maneki moogle
17977.col_2: This charming knickknack is designed after the maneki neko, a Far Eastern cat fetish whose uplifted paw is believed to beckon fortune to its owner's establishment.

17978.name: Matanga lamp
17978.col_2: Much like the maneki neko (or moogle, for that matter), the Matanga lamp is also believed to bring fortune to any and all who might place them inside their homes.

17979.name: stuffed Khloe
17979.col_2: A tiny rendition of the already tiny Khloe Aliapoh, seeker of a thousand tales.

17980.name: stuffed fox
17980.col_2: In the Far East, foxes are believed to be the most cunning of thieves. And once you find your heart missing, you will be a believer, too.

17981.name: Ixion trophy
17981.col_2: A slightly suggestive objet d'art that will ever remind you of your dominance over the mythic steed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

17982.name: Eastern pine
17982.col_2: A surprisingly old pine tree, meticulously trimmed for years by trained botanists to remain relatively small, yet maintain the air of a lofty sentinel.

17983.name: Eastern teahouse bench
17983.col_2: A wooden folding bench and accompanying papercraft umbrella similar to those found at Hingan teahouses.

17984.name: topiary Carbuncle
17984.col_2: A specially bred shrub pruned to the shape of a curious Carbuncle.

17985.name: moai statue
17985.col_2: A giant stone head carved to resemble drawings found in an unknown sailor's diary that one day washed up on the eastern shores of Othard.

17986.name: Dataqi standard
17986.col_2: A brightly dyed banner bearing the ancestral mark of the Dataq tribe.

17987.name: Gyr Abanian striking dummy
17987.col_2: A striking dummy designed in the Gyr Abanian fashion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

17988.name: Topmast interior wall
17988.col_2: An interior wall designed to complement Topmast apartments.

17989.name: Lily Hills interior wall
17989.col_2: An interior wall designed to complement Lily Hills apartments.

17990.name: Sultana's Breath interior wall
17990.col_2: An interior wall designed to complement Sultana's Breath apartments.

17991.name: unit of Topmast flooring
17991.col_2: Floorboards designed to complement Topmast apartments.

17992.name: unit of Lily Hills flooring
17992.col_2: Floorboards designed to complement Lily Hills apartments.

17993.name: unit of Sultana's Breath flooring
17993.col_2: Floorboards designed to complement Sultana's Breath apartments.

17994.name: House Fortemps chandelier
17994.col_2: A faithful replica of the grand chandelier found in Fortemps Manor.

17995.name: set of Ruby Sea tank trimmings
17995.description: sets of Ruby Sea tank trimmings
17995.col_2: An assortment of items used to outfit an aquarium that it might resemble the deadly waters of the Ruby Tide.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[For use in any tier aquarium.]

17996.name: bag of daisy seeds
17996.col_2: Daisy, Daisy. Give me your answer, do. Go half crazy waiting for these godsdamned seeds to bloom.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters (built for two).

17997.name: bouquet of red daisies
17997.col_2: A bunch of red daisies, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

17998.name: bouquet of blue daisies
17998.col_2: A bunch of blue daisies, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

17999.name: bouquet of yellow daisies
17999.col_2: A bunch of yellow daisies, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

18002.col_2: A bunch of purple daisies, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

18004.col_2: A bunch of black daisies, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

18005.name: rainbow daisy bouquet
18005.col_2: A bunch of multicolored daisies, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

19104.name: flask of lost Allagan roborant
19104.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted by mad scientists a thousand years dead. Some of the realm's more daring blacksmiths have applied the unnaturally viscous substance to a variety of weapons and found that it heightens the attributes of certain martial artifacts of ancient Allagan design. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

19105.name: spool of lost Allagan twine
19105.col_2: An alchemical thread woven by mad scientists a thousand years dead. Some of the realm's more daring weavers have applied the unnaturally pliable substance to a variety of vestments and found that it heightens the attributes of certain martial artifacts of ancient Allagan design. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

19106.name: flask of lost Allagan glaze
19106.col_2: An alchemical potion concocted by mad scientists a thousand years dead. Some of the realm's more daring goldsmiths have applied the unnaturally illuminated substance to a variety of gems and found that it heightens the attributes of certain martial artifacts of ancient Allagan design. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

19107.name: Rowena's token (creation)
19107.col_2: A note of promise received from Rowena for the delivery of Allagan tomestones of creation or poetics. However, due to the House of Splendors changing its policies, it is now worth less than the paper on which it is scribed.

19108.name: early model tomestone
19108.col_2: Though considerably different in construction, Garlond Ironworks engineers insist this bulky contraption serves the same purpose as a traditional tomestone, and is merely of an earlier, less efficient design. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

19109.name: Revel totem
19109.col_2: The Kojin carve, from shell, idols such as this one to present as offerings to their exalted Lord of the Revel, Susano.

19110.name: Bliss totem
19110.col_2: This pulsating metal idol forged in the likeness of the primal Lakshmi is thought to be employed by the Ananta in forbidden summoning ceremonies.

19111.name: Deltascape lens
19111.col_2: A uniquely crafted lens discovered in the Deltascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two lenses can be traded for special headgear.

19112.name: Deltascape shaft
19112.col_2: A uniquely crafted shaft discovered in the Deltascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four shafts can be traded for special body gear.

19113.name: Deltascape crank
19113.col_2: A uniquely crafted crank discovered in the Deltascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two cranks can be traded for special arm gear.

19114.name: Deltascape spring
19114.col_2: A uniquely crafted spring discovered in the Deltascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four springs can be traded for special leg gear.

19115.name: Deltascape pedal
19115.col_2: A uniquely crafted pedal discovered in the Deltascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pedals can be traded for special foot gear.

19116.name: Deltascape chain
19116.col_2: A uniquely crafted chain discovered in the Deltascape. Alas, advancements in trouser technology have rendered it worthless.

19117.name: Deltascape bolt
19117.col_2: A uniquely crafted bolt discovered in the Deltascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One bolt can be traded for a special accessory.

19123.name: blade of revelry
19123.col_2: The blade from a sword used by the Lord of the Revel himself. Despite being long removed from its hilt, the steel still shudders with unseen magicks.

19124.name: blissful shroud
19124.col_2: A long sheet of translucent cloth taken from the robes worn by the Lady of the Bliss. In addition with being unnaturally lightweight, the shroud tingles the skin when touched.

19834.description: bowls of miso soup with tofu
19834.col_2: A Far Eastern staple, often eaten multiple times a day, this soup is made by mixing miso paste with light fish stock. Bite-sized cubes of tofu are added near the end of preparation to ensure the pieces retain their shape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

A common dish in Far Eastern coastal settlements.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19836.col_2: This Far Eastern take on a campsite mainstay features thinly sliced pork belly and various root vegetables in a piping hot miso-based soup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19837.col_2: A simple stew commonly made of diced dzo chuck and whatever vegetables are readily available. A popular dish amongst the nomadic tribes of the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19838.name: serving of kasha
19838.col_2: Buckwheat kernels boiled in bouillon to form a soft, hearty porridge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19839.name: nomad meat pie
19839.col_2: Ground dzo chuck and various steppe vegetables wrapped in buttery dough and deep-fried in oil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19840.name: tea brick
19840.col_2: The fermenting of tea leaves is common practice in the Far East where tea is consumed multiple times a day. Fermentation is thought to enhance flavor while dulling the leaves' natural bitterness. Fermented leaves are pressed into bricks to save space when shipping.

19842.name: block of firm tofu
19842.col_2: A traditional source of protein in the Far East, tofu is made from curdled soy bean extract.

19843.name: bottle of rice vinegar
19843.col_2: One of Far Eastern cuisine's five main seasonings, rice vinegar is slightly more sweet and mild than Aldenard's vinegars of popoto or apple.

19844.name: pinch of beet sugar
19844.col_2: A sweetener made by juicing sugar beets and then boiling the extract down until all the water has evaporated, leaving only a fine, grey powder.

19845.name: bottle of cooking sake
19845.col_2: Far Eastern rice wine prepared with other ingredients for use in cooking. Often added to seafood dishes to remove unpleasant aromas.

19846.name: bottle of cottonseed oil
19846.col_2: Cooking oil pressed from ruby cotton seeds. Its high flash point and lack of odor make it ideal for deep-frying.

19847.name: pot of nigari
19847.col_2: A coagulant naturally found in seawater, commonly used in the Far East to make tofu.

19848.name: pinch of algae salt
19848.col_2: A briny salt harvested by sun-drying then burning sea algae.

19849.name: box of Koshu sticky rice
19849.col_2: Unlike the drier varieties common in Aldenard and Ilsabard, this particular strand of Far Eastern rice becomes extremely sticky when cooked.

19850.name: sack of buckwheat kernels
19850.col_2: A nutty grain that can be substituted for flour in breads and noodles. Found across the Three Great Continents, but grown in abundance in the heart of Gyr Abania.

19851.name: loquat
19851.col_2: A sweet yet slightly tangy fruit with a thin skin and a fleshy orange interior. Can be found in the warmer valleys of Gyr Abania.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19852.name: Othardian plum
19852.col_2: A greenish pink plum common across the eastern continent of Othard.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19853.name: kudzu root
19853.col_2: The root of the quick-growing kudzu vine is dug up and processed into kudzu powder which serves as a substitute for animal-based gelatins in Far Eastern desserts. It also is believed to exhibit healing properties, and can be found in most Hingan and Doman apothecaries.

19854.name: Doman eggplant
19854.col_2: While just as brilliantly purple, this Far Eastern cousin of the wizard eggplant is noticeably thinner, and thus requires less time to cook.

19855.name: daikon radish
19855.col_2: The spicy daikon radishes of Othard are known to grow as long and thick as a grown Hyur's forearm.

19856.name: sugar beet
19856.col_2: These tubers can be several times sweeter than most fruit, and as such are commonly processed into sugar for sweetening cakes and other confections.

19857.name: piece of jhammel ginger
19857.col_2: Jhammel ginger's bulbous, aromatic roots can be sliced fresh and added to stews and seafood dishes to remove gaminess, ground and steeped in hot water to cure head colds, or dried and ground into a powder to use as a spice for breads and cookies.

19858.name: Gyr Abanian carrot
19858.col_2: Gyr Abanian carrots are not only longer, but a far deeper orange─nay, crimson─than those grown in central and western Eorzea.

19859.name: green leek
19859.col_2: Similar to green onions in flavor, the leeks of Gyr Abania are several times thicker, and far more piquant.

19860.name: bamboo shoot
19860.col_2: If removed from the ground when less than a fulm in length, bamboo shoots can be peeled and the fleshy interior eaten. A popular ingredient in Far Eastern stews and stir-fries.

19861.name: mountain popoto
19861.col_2: Crisp mountain popotoes contain high quantities of starch that create a viscous paste when the tubers are ground. This paste can be eaten raw, fried into cakes, or added to stews for thickening.

19862.name: sack of soybeans
19862.col_2: These emerald legumes grow two to three beans per pod on stout bushes that are ready for harvest in the early fall. The beans are most often pressed into the milk which is used to make tofu, or fermented into various savory pastes and sauces.

19863.name: shiitake mushroom
19863.col_2: These fungi native to the Far East are rarely eaten raw, the majority of those harvested dried, then used to make soup stock.

19864.name: handful of cumin seeds
19864.col_2: A pungent spice that can be used in seed form, or ground into a powder, enhancing the aroma tenfold.

19865.name: lotus root
19865.col_2: Though they appear solid from the outside, the cylindrical root nodules of the lotus flower are riddled with holes, possibly to accommodate for the waterlogged environments in which the plant grows.

19866.name: sun cabbage
19866.col_2: The sweet, tightly packed leaves of Othardian sun cabbages are deceptively sweet, making them perfect in salads or stews.

19867.name: stalk of fennel
19867.col_2: With an aroma similar to licorice, both the stalks and the seeds of this Othardian herb can be used to enhance the flavor of exotic Far Eastern dishes.

19868.name: sheaf of Gyr Abanian wheat
19868.col_2: A close cousin to highland wheat, Gyr Abanian wheat has been improved by Ala Mhigan farmers over generations to increase both flavor and yield.

19869.name: persimmon
19869.col_2: A hard, orange fruit common in eastern Othard. It is well known that seven summers must pass before a newly planted persimmon tree will bear fruit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19870.name: persimmon leaf
19870.col_2: While not edible, the leaves of the persimmon tree are oft used in the preservation of other food.

19871.name: bottle of Gyr Abanian mineral water
19871.description: bottles of Gyr Abanian mineral water
19871.col_2: Clear water taken from a mountain spring on the eastern end of Abalathia's Spine.

19872.name: bottle of Crescent spring water
19872.col_2: Clear, odorless water taken from one of the many springs found on Othard's Fanged Crescent.

19873.name: slice of dzo chuck
19873.col_2: The unbearably tough shoulder meat of a steppe dzo.

19874.name: strip of hornbill tenderloin
19874.col_2: A lean piece of meat taken from under the short ribs of an Othardian hornbill.

19875.name: slice of jhammel haunch
19875.col_2: Heavy salting and spicing are methods commonly employed to remove the oft overpowering gaminess of this beastkin flesh.

19876.name: cut of Koshu pork
19876.col_2: A dark-haired variety of swine bred on Hingashi's Koshu island. Its carefully selected diet is believed to render its meat tender and its fat flavorful.

19877.name: gagana egg
19877.col_2: The massive egg of a gagana.

19878.name: bottle of steppe milk
19878.col_2: Compared to that of an aldgoat, marid, or deathmouse, the milk of a steppe dzo is high in fat and flavor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19879.name: basket of ama nori
19879.col_2: This edible seaweed can be consumed raw, or dried into paper-like squares and wrapped around sticky rice.

19880.name: strip of Ruby Tide kelp
19880.col_2: A distant cousin of malm kelp, Ruby Tide kelp is harvested and dried in the sun to enhance flavor. Squares of the seaweed are cut and steeped in boiling water to create one of the savory broths used in Hingan cuisine.

19881.name: bloom of gem algae
19881.col_2: A variety of algae found in the Ruby Sea, commonly harvested for its salt.

19882.name: cup of competent craftsman's tea
19882.col_2: This infusion brewed from the powdered horn of a powerful beastkin is believed to improve crafting efficiency.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15m

19883.name: cup of commanding craftsman's tea
19883.col_2: This infusion brewed from the powdered horn of a powerful beastkin is believed to improve crafting efficiency.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15m

19884.name: cup of cunning craftsman's tea
19884.col_2: This infusion brewed from the powdered horn of a powerful beastkin is believed to improve crafting efficiency.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15m

19885.name: potent spiritbond potion
19885.col_2: This sweet-smelling concoction enhances the rate at which your equipment gains spiritbond.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 180m

19886.name: infusion of strength
19886.col_2: This diluted brew temporarily increases strength, but for twice the duration of similar potions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s

19887.name: infusion of dexterity
19887.col_2: This diluted brew temporarily increases dexterity, but for twice the duration of similar potions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s

19888.name: infusion of vitality
19888.col_2: This diluted brew temporarily increases vitality, but for twice the duration of similar potions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s

19889.name: infusion of intelligence
19889.col_2: This diluted brew temporarily increases intelligence, but for twice the duration of similar potions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s

19890.name: infusion of mind
19890.col_2: This diluted brew temporarily increases mind, but for twice the duration of similar potions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s

19891.name: bottle of grade 1 reisui of strength
19891.description: bottles of grade 1 reisui of strength
19891.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

19892.name: bottle of grade 1 reisui of dexterity
19892.description: bottles of grade 1 reisui of dexterity
19892.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.
