21779.col_2: A uniquely crafted chain discovered in the Sigmascape. Alas, advancements in trouser technology have rendered it worthless.

21780.name: Sigmascape bolt
21780.col_2: A uniquely crafted bolt discovered in the Sigmascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One bolt can be traded for a special accessory.

21781.col_2: Detailed records of past battles waged in the Sigmascape.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Logs of the same type can be traded for special gear.

21785.name: Sigmascape crystalloid
21785.col_2: A remarkable crystalline fragment within which can be seen images from another world. Though such articles were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up, leaving them with little value as bartering materials.

21786.name: flask of ryumyaku solvent
21786.col_2: A dissolving agent concocted by Doman artisans that, when applied to certain weapons, heightens their attributes by removing impurities on their surface. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

21787.name: spool of ryumyaku twine
21787.col_2: A durable thread used by Doman artisans. When woven into certain armor, it is believed to heighten its attributes. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

21788.name: phial of ryumyaku polish
21788.col_2: A slightly corrosive paste concocted by Doman goldsmiths that, when applied to certain accessories, heightens their attributes by restoring their luster. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

21789.name: Rowena's token (mendacity)
21789.col_2: A note of promise received from Rowena for the delivery of Allagan tomestones of mendacity or poetics. However, due to the House of Splendors changing its policies, it is now worth less than the paper on which it is scribed.

21790.name: prototype tomestone
21790.col_2: Garlond Ironworks engineers believe this device to be an attempt by Allagan scientists to increase tomestone capacity, while keeping overall size relatively small. This may have become the next standard in tomestone data storage...had not their civilization been inconveniently wiped from the realm. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

21791.name: diamond weapon coffer (IL 375)
21791.col_2: A heavy chest containing a diamond weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 70. IL: 375. Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

21792.name: shark-class bow
21792.col_2: Comprising the front end of a shark-class submersible, this bow has been reinforced to double as a battering ram for subduing unruly sea creatures.

21793.name: shark-class bridge
21793.col_2: Comprising the top of a shark-class submersible, the bridge houses all of the equipment necessary for the vessel's crew to navigate the unplumbed depths of the Ruby Sea and beyond.

21794.name: shark-class pressure hull
21794.col_2: Comprising the center of a shark-class submersible, this ovoid hull is multi-walled to stabilize and maintain pressure within so that the vessel's crew does not succumb to the crushing weight of the waters it navigates. Several sturdy rudder fins serve to increase maneuverability.

21795.name: shark-class stern
21795.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a shark-class submersible, this stern contains the unique independent engine which propels the craft.

21796.name: unkiu-class bow
21796.col_2: Unlike the bows of most submersibles, the unkiu-class model is outfitted with rudder fins usually relegated to the stern.

21797.name: unkiu-class bridge
21797.col_2: Designed by the Onishishu─a collective of skilled Far Eastern craftsmen─this submersible bridge differs dramatically in build from those built in the West.

21798.name: unkiu-class pressure hull
21798.col_2: Comprising the center of an unkiu-class submersible, this ovoid hull is multi-walled to stabilize and maintain pressure within so that the vessel's crew does not succumb to the crushing weight of the waters it navigates. Supplemental propulsion engines have been affixed to the sides to increase underwater speed.

21799.name: unkiu-class stern
21799.col_2: Comprising the rear end of an unkiu-class submersible, this stern contains a double propeller engine.

21800.name: glamour prism
21800.col_2: This crystalline prism captures the likeness of a piece of equipment and projects it onto another object of comparable form and function.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Necessary to project glamours.]

21801.name: protean crystal
21801.col_2: The elemental energies of this unstable crystal are in a perpetual state of flux.

21802.name: Pazuzu's feather
21802.col_2: A foul feather plucked from the Eurekan nightmare, Pazuzu.

21803.name: Anemos crystal
21803.col_2: A crystal discovered in Eureka Anemos─a region where the elemental aspect leans heavily to wind.

21811.name: futon mattress
21811.col_2: Common in the Far East, futons are thin down-filled mattresses laid directly on the floor instead of upon a frame. After use, they are generally rolled up and stored in a closet until needed again.

21812.name: Hatching-tide banner
21812.col_2: An expertly woven tapestry displayed during Hatching-tide festivities.

21813.name: odder otter lantern
21813.col_2: An indoor lantern designed to resemble the oddest of otters.

21814.name: boar's head kadomatsu
21814.col_2: A Heavensturn decoration displayed at homes and places of business. The spinning umbrella is thought to bring fortune as long as an object remains atop.

21815.name: moogle wall chronometer
21815.col_2: When faced with the dilemma of adorning his wall with a normal chronometer or a chronometer carved in the adorable likeness of a moogle, it is said the dread (though most likely nonexistent) pirate Mustbeard replied with a hearty “arrr” and found room for both.

21816.name: Byakko sideboard
21816.col_2: A round desk carved to resemble Byakko, one of the mystic Four Lords of the Far East.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

21817.name: Byakko throne
21817.col_2: A regal throne, fit for a king...or emperor that also happens to be a giant white tiger.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

21818.name: stuffed spriggan
21818.col_2: So realistic is this stuffed spriggan that many a mage has lost face after sending one up in a gout of sorcerous flame.

21819.name: Season Six Lone Wolf trophy
21819.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Six of the Feast.

21820.name: Valentione's Day MMXIV advertisement
21820.col_2: Without proper advertisement, some may mistake Valentione's Day for any other day, albeit one with far more pink balloons.

21821.name: bunch of Valentione's Day balloons
21821.col_2: To create these festive balloons, the bladders of various flying fish caught in the Sea of Clouds were dried, colored, then stamped with the House Valentione coat of arms before being filled with heated air to keep them afloat.

21822.name: bread basket
21822.col_2: Aromatic loaves of freshly baked bread fill this wicker basket to the brim.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Tenacity Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 8)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

21823.name: stuffed Alpha
21823.col_2: A charming recreation of the chocobo Alpha, filled with the feathers of a fowl less fortunate.

21824.name: House Borel tea set
21824.col_2: A faithful replication of the selfsame set used every morning by Aymeric de Borel himself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 8)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

21825.name: royal dowager tea set
21825.col_2: The design used on this quaint porcelain tea set is based off a passage in an ancient literary work on Halicarnassus, Queen of Dimension Castle.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 8)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

21826.name: brick interior wall
21826.col_2: An interior wall built with genuine kiln-fired bricks.

21827.name: mounted cupboard
21827.col_2: A space-saving cupboard that can be mounted anywhere there is a wall.

21828.name: vegetable basket
21828.col_2: The vegetables contained within this basket have not been approved for consumption. Dine at your own risk.

21829.name: open partition
21829.col_2: A low partition cut with a hole to provide estates with the illusion of more space than actually exists.

21830.name: counter cart
21830.col_2: An island for kitchens designed to resemble those carts used by hawkers in city markets.

21831.name: Sharlayan cabinet
21831.col_2: A decorative cabinet designed in the Old World Sharlayan style.

21832.name: Sharlayan wardrobe
21832.col_2: A decorative wardrobe designed in the Old World Sharlayan style.

21833.name: Carbuncle bathtub
21833.col_2: A small tub crafted to resemble a summoner's best friend. Just large enough for two.

21834.name: set of chirurgeon's essentials
21834.col_2: From scalpels to saws, panaceas to placebos, this basic set of medical devices has everything the unlicensed surgeon needs.

21835.name: kitchen hanger
21835.col_2: Save space in your cupboards for liquor and fruitcake by hanging all your kitchen appliances from hooks.

21836.name: Hanya mask
21836.col_2: A frightening mask of Far Eastern design. Perfect for children's bedrooms and nurseries.

21838.name: sake set
21838.col_2: A set of Hingan bottles and cups perfect for taking one's evening refreshment with guests─though using it to take one's afternoon refreshment alone is not unheard of.

21839.name: stage panel
21839.col_2: A large white panel used by acting troupes as a simple backdrop for plays.

21840.name: stuffed Ananta
21840.col_2: Those without a deathly fear of snakes claim this plush doll to be one of the most beautiful ever crafted. Most ophidiophobes, however, would beg to differ.

21841.name: tier 1 metal aquarium
21841.col_2: A small, reinforced glass tank that, when filled with water, can serve as a home for select wavekin caught in the wild. The higher an aquarium's tier, the larger the specimens that can be kept within.<hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 aquariums, respectively.

21842.name: tier 2 metal aquarium
21842.col_2: A reinforced glass tank that, when filled with water, can serve as a home for select wavekin caught in the wild. The higher an aquarium's tier, the larger the specimens that can be kept within.<hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 aquariums, respectively.

21843.name: Eorzean lantern
21843.col_2: Not one to be humbled by craftsmen of the East, a prominent Eorzean lamp maker conceived this fixture he hopes will become the new standard in home and garden lighting.

21844.name: bomb stove
21844.col_2: A cast-iron wood stove designed after a fateful encounter with a voidsent bomb.

21845.name: Hingan pillar
21845.col_2: A decorative pillar designed in the Hingan fashion.

21846.name: stack of documents
21846.col_2: What better way to tell unwanted visitors, “can't you see I'm busy?” than by strewing stacks of important-looking documents all about your humble abode?

21847.name: set of mummer's maquillage
21847.col_2: Countless varieties of rouges, putties, and talcums commonly used by mummers to prepare themselves for their acts.

21848.name: dress hanger
21848.col_2: Because one wouldn't dare hang a dress on a coat hanger.

21849.name: mummer's wardrobe
21849.col_2: An oversized locker used by mummers to house not only their costumes, but their various tools of the trade.

21850.name: Far Eastern doll display
21850.col_2: A tiered dais used in the Far East to display dolls. Adapted in Eorzea for use on Little Ladies' Day.

21851.name: coat hanger
21851.col_2: Because one wouldn't dare hang a coat on a dress hanger.

21852.name: altar to Pazuzu
21852.col_2: Make profane offerings from the comfort of your home with this sinister altar to the high voidsent Pazuzu.

21854.name: Hokonin permit
21854.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Hingan servants known as “hokonin” on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21855.name: Allagan resupply node permit
21855.col_2: This permit allows the renting of Allagan resupply nodes on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21856.name: Allagan commerce node permit
21856.col_2: This permit allows the renting of Allagan commerce nodes on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21857.name: Allagan repair node permit
21857.col_2: This permit allows the renting of Allagan repair nodes on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21858.name: Allagan housekeeping node permit
21858.col_2: This permit allows the renting of Allagan housekeeping nodes on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21859.name: Ananta material supplier permit
21859.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Ananta material suppliers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21860.name: Ananta junkmonger permit
21860.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Ananta junkmongers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21861.name: Ananta mender permit
21861.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Ananta menders on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21862.name: Ananta maidservant permit
21862.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Ananta maidservants on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

21863.name: rose wagon
21863.col_2: A pushcart filled with thousands upon thousands of fragrant roses (give or take a few thousand).

21864.name: corner hedge partition
21864.col_2: A low-growing hedge, expertly pruned and trimmed into the shape of an L.

21865.name: bamboo copse
21865.col_2: A controlled cluster of bamboo cut from a Yanxian forest for display in private gardens.

21866.name: Hingan hot spring
21866.col_2: Scalding water tapped from the very bowels of the land, and collected in a quaint rock pool certain to draw the envy of neighbors.

21867.name: House Borel interior wall
21867.col_2: A wall that matches the design of those used in Aymeric de Borel's very manor.

21868.name: unit of white marble flooring
21868.col_2: Smooth, elegant floor tiling made of polished marble.

21869.name: classic chandelier
21869.col_2: A lavish light fixture that hearkens to days long past.

21870.name: melodious mogchestrion
21870.col_2: A fully functional moogle-themed orchestrion for the moogle-lover who has everything...but a fully functional moogle-themed orchestrion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One orchestrion of any type per estate only.

21906.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your magitek death claw will magically bring the machine to life.

21908.name: broken heart pendant (right)

21909.name: broken heart pendant (left)

21910.name: Typhon horn
21910.col_2: The sneeze-like blare of this horn summons Typhon, for reasons that no one knows and everyone refuses to find out.

21911.name: white whittret

21912.name: wind-up Kefka
21912.col_2: Just can't believe it? Believe it!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Kefka minion.

21913.name: wind-up Ananta
21913.col_2: Why did it have to be a snake?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Ananta minion.

21914.name: motley egg
21914.col_2: The tiny Archon inside is certain to kickstart your heart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the motley egg minion.

21915.name: wind-up Magnai
21915.col_2: Ever in search of true love.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Magnai minion.

21916.name: private moai
21916.col_2: It's watching you. Watching you. Watching you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the private moai minion.

21917.name: wind-up Mithra
21917.col_2: Opinions on how Miqo'te rate compared to their supposed ancestors are best kept to oneself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Mithra minion.

21918.name: wind-up Fafnir
21918.col_2: Protective eyewear highly recommended.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Fafnir minion.

21919.col_2: Cute and cudgely.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Prince of Anemos minion.

21921.col_2: Lighter than air─er...water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the aurelia polyp minion.

21922.col_2: Beckons you to enter his barrel of sin, but don't go in.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Gold Whisker minion.

22389.name: mirage mahi
22389.col_2: A sizable catch found primarily in the freshwater highland rivers of Gyr Abania.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

22390.name: triplespine
22390.col_2: A deadly saltwater breed that protects itself with a pair of needle-like fins and a nigh-impenetrable coat of translucent scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

22391.name: alligator snapping turtle
22391.col_2: This land turtle can easily be identified by both its pointed shell and its powerful bite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

22392.name: redtail
22392.col_2: A large freshwater fish that has─surprise─a distinct red tail fin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

22393.name: usuginu octopus
22393.col_2: This crafty cephalopod can be found all along the Ruby Sea coastline─usually in the belly of some Hingan fisher who has eaten the creature raw and with a splash of soy sauce and citrus.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

22394.name: saltmill
22394.col_2: The saltmill is believed to be an ancient sea specimen which adapted to life in hypersalinated waters after being transplanted into Loch Seld after the Sixth Umbral Calamity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

22395.name: bonsai fish
22395.col_2: From afar, this freshwater fish can appear to be a piece of floating woodland debris. Up close, it looks like a fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

22396.name: ribbon eel
22396.col_2: A unique petal-shaped maw and ribbon-like body distinguish this saltwater eel from more common varieties.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

22397.name: red prismfish
22397.col_2: The pale red glow emitted by this freshwater fish is believed to be caused by unbalanced levels of aspected aether in the wavekin's humours.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

22398.name: elder gourami
22398.col_2: Despite the beard-like ventral fins which give this freshwater wavekin an aged look, gourami only have an average lifespan of three to five summers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

22403.col_2: A less-than-fresh piece of rich milk chocolate resembling a rather more mottled House Valentione coat of arms.

22404.name: certificate of collaboration MMXVIII
22404.col_2: A small, square slip of parchment stamped with the Ul'dahn royal seneschal's seal proving your aid in the promotion of the Songbirds.

22405.name: authentic Hatching-tide banner
22405.col_2: An authentic reproduction of an expertly woven tapestry displayed during Hatching-tide festivities.

22406.name: authentic boar's head kadomatsu
22406.col_2: An authentic reproduction of the Heavensturn decoration displayed at homes and places of business.

22407.name: authentic Valentione's Day MMXIV advertisement
22407.col_2: An authentic reproduction of an official Valentione's Day announcement. Without proper advertisement, some may mistake Valentione's Day for any other day, albeit one with far more pink balloons.

22408.name: bunch of authentic Valentione's Day balloons
22408.description: bunches of authentic Valentione's Day balloons
22408.col_2: An authentic reproduction of festive Valentione's Day balloons created by drying, coloring, then stamping the bladders of various flying fish caught in the Sea of Clouds with the House Valentione coat of arms. The bladders are then filled with heated air to keep them afloat.

22409.name: authentic Far Eastern doll display
22409.col_2: An authentic reproduction of a tiered dais used in the Far East to display dolls. Adapted in Eorzea for use on Little Ladies' Day.

22410.name: authentic rose wagon
22410.col_2: An authentic reproduction of a pushcart filled with thousands upon thousands of fragrant roses (give or take a few thousand).

22411.name: magicked prism (Hatching-tide)
22411.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Used during Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide for celebratory purposes.

22412.name: lump of Thavnairian resin
22412.col_2: A long-lasting synthetic resin concocted by Radz-at-Han's finest alchemists. Used as both an adhesive as well as a varnish.

22413.name: pot of Thavnairian abrasive
22413.col_2: A coarse-grained abrasive concocted by Radz-at-Han's finest alchemists. Used to restore the luster of even the most corroded metals.

22414.name: bolt of Thavnairian cotton
22414.col_2: A traditional Near Eastern weave that keeps its wearer cool while protecting her from the harsh rays of the sun.

22415.name: pinch of Thavnairian alumen
22415.col_2: Quarried from Thavnair's towering sea cliffs, this mineral is prized by leatherworkers for its use in tanning hides.

22416.name: lump of Thavnairian adhesive
22416.col_2: Countless Hannish alchemists have chosen death over revealing the secret recipe of this odorless paste used in the creation of some of the island nation's most valuable armor.

22417.name: chunk of nightsteel ore
22417.col_2: Iron ore that has been exposed to the waters of a mineral spring, and undergone significant changes to both color and chemical makeup.

22418.name: chunk of silvergrace ore
22418.col_2: A sizable piece of rock containing traces of a precious metal known as silvergrace.

22419.name: black willow log
22419.col_2: A rough-cut log of black willow timber.

22420.name: clump of Hingan flax
22420.col_2: A distant cousin to the flax found in the highlands of Coerthas, the stalk of this fibrous plant is used to create a yarn known in Hingashi as “true linen.”

22421.name: ground sloth pelt
22421.col_2: The coarse, bristly hide of a giant ground sloth.

22422.name: bottle of grade 3 reisui of strength
22422.description: bottles of grade 3 reisui of strength
22422.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

22572.col_2: A deceptively realistic imitation of a standard Hingan paper portal.

22573.col_2: Candy kneaded into a variety of intricate shapes by a Doman artisan.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 8)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

22574.name: jellyfish lamp
22574.col_2: A lamp that resembles a luminous jellyfish in every way─except the painful ones.

22575.name: curry plate
22575.col_2: A Hingan twist on traditional Hannish curry, tailored to the Far Eastern palate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Direct Hit bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 8)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

22576.name: mosquito moogle
22576.col_2: A traditional Hingan ceramic incense burner used to ward off pests. Traditionally not crafted to resemble a moogle, however.

22577.name: Monster Toss machine
22577.col_2: Experience the extreme sensory overload of the Gold Saucer in your own home with this authentic Monster Toss machine.

22578.name: Cuff-a-Cur machine
22578.col_2: Experience the extreme sensory overload of the Gold Saucer in your own home with this authentic Cuff-a-Cur machine.

22579.name: odder otter bench
22579.col_2: A bench with an odder otter motif.

22580.name: picnic set
22580.col_2: A picnic basket packed with a sumptuous feast. Quilted blanket included. Antling repellent not.

22581.name: miniature Heaven-on-High
22581.col_2: Relive the adventure that you have relived over and over again...over again!

22582.name: odder otter andon lamp
22582.col_2: An outdoor lamp with an odder otter motif.

22583.name: BBQ spit
22583.col_2: Just what you need to cook meat. A must-have item for any hungry hunter. Of monsters. A monster hunter, you might even say.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Outdoor use only.

22584.name: Namazu effigy
22584.col_2: A towering and distinctly peculiar Namazu sculpture.

22585.name: Namazu material supplier permit
22585.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Namazu material suppliers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

22586.name: Namazu junkmonger permit
22586.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Namazu junkmongers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

22587.name: Namazu mender permit
22587.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Namazu menders on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

22588.name: Namazu manservant permit
22588.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Namazu manservants on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

22589.name: bag of dahlia bulbs
22589.col_2: Though commonly referred to as “bulbs,” these nascent dahlia plants are more akin to tubers. Despite currently looking like stunted popotoes, they will grow to produce lovely flowers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

22590.name: bouquet of red dahlias
22590.col_2: A bunch of red dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22591.name: bouquet of blue dahlias
22591.col_2: A bunch of blue dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22592.name: bouquet of yellow dahlias
22592.col_2: A bunch of yellow dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22593.name: bouquet of green dahlias
22593.col_2: A bunch of green dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22594.name: bouquet of orange dahlias
22594.col_2: A bunch of orange dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22595.name: bouquet of purple dahlias
22595.col_2: A bunch of purple dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22596.name: bouquet of white dahlias
22596.col_2: A bunch of white dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22597.name: bouquet of black dahlias
22597.col_2: A bunch of black dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22598.name: rainbow dahlia bouquet
22598.col_2: A bunch of multicolored dahlias, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

22599.name: Rathalos scale
22599.col_2: “Rathalos material. Mostly obtained by carving. Broadly used for many purposes.” - Words from a terse veteran tracker of beasts, as recorded in <hex:021A020203>Wisdom of the Hunters<hex:021A020103>.

22600.name: Rathalos whistle
22600.col_2: The resonant tone of this whistle carries far enough to summon your Rathalos from his distant homeland.

22601.name: Palico
22601.col_2: Very punny.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to hire a Palico minion.

22602.name: Poogie
22602.col_2: Beloved by hunters, though the feeling is not always mutual.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Poogie minion.

22603.name: <hex:021A020203>Cornerstone of the New World - Astera<hex:021A020103> orchestrion roll
22603.description: <hex:021A020203>Cornerstone of the New World - Astera<hex:021A020103> orchestrion rolls
22603.col_2: Music roll for <hex:021A020203>Cornerstone of the New World - Astera<hex:021A020103>. Use to add to your orchestrion list.
22603.col_3: Cornerstone of the New World - Astera Orchestrion Roll

22604.name: <hex:021A020203>Savage of the Ancient Forest<hex:021A020103> orchestrion roll
22604.description: <hex:021A020203>Savage of the Ancient Forest<hex:021A020103> orchestrion rolls
22604.col_2: Music roll for <hex:021A020203>Savage of the Ancient Forest<hex:021A020103>. Use to add to your orchestrion list.
22604.col_3: Savage of the Ancient Forest Orchestrion Roll

22605.name: <hex:021A020203>Proof of a Hero - Monster Hunter: World Version<hex:021A020103> orchestrion roll
22605.description: <hex:021A020203>Proof of a Hero - Monster Hunter: World Version<hex:021A020103> orchestrion rolls
22605.col_2: Music roll for <hex:021A020203>Proof of a Hero - Monster Hunter: World Version<hex:021A020103>. Use to add to your orchestrion list.
22605.col_3: Proof of a Hero - Monster Hunter: World Version Orchestrion Roll

22616.name: red malachite
22616.col_2: A crimson gemstone that, once ground, is useful in dyes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22617.name: skystone
22617.col_2: It is said that these large stones form the very foundation on which rest both mountains and sky above.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22618.name: pinch of dawn dust
22618.col_2: This rare variety of gold dust is named for its hue, reminiscent of a steppe sunrise.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22619.name: mondite
22619.col_2: A glassy stone that can be flaked to form lethally sharp edges.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22620.name: lava rock
22620.col_2: A plain stone known for its heat-resistant properties.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22621.name: chunk of steppe mica
22621.col_2: A glimmering mineral found on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22622.name: chunk of steppe rock salt
22622.col_2: Salt naturally occurring on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22623.name: steppe coal
22623.col_2: Raw coal mined from under the Azim Steppe. Unsurprisingly as flammable as most coal found elsewhere.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22624.name: pinch of pure white silex
22624.col_2: This finely ground silica is the purest the steppe has to offer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22625.name: chunk of steppe copper ore
22625.col_2: Low-quality copper ore abundant on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22626.name: steppe geode
22626.col_2: A dark grey stone. The minerals within may not be valuable, but they certainly appear so.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22627.name: raw azimite
22627.col_2: An uncut, unpolished gemstone found only on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22628.name: chunk of steppe clay
22628.col_2: Earthenware clay that can be easily shaped and fired.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22629.name: steppe whetstone
22629.col_2: A whetstone chipped from naturally occurring rock in the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22630.name: steppe soapstone
22630.col_2: This stone is unusually heat resistant, making it perfect for use in hearths.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22631.name: bottle of steppe spring water
22631.col_2: Clear water taken from a spring east of Mol Iloh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22632.name: chunk of steppe iron ore
22632.col_2: A chunk of rock from the Azim Steppe that contains a significant amount of iron.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22633.name: flat stone
22633.col_2: This stone's flat surface and pronounced edge make it ideal for scraping hides.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22634.name: onze of steppe cinnabar
22634.col_2: Cinnabar mined from the Azim Steppe. Very red. Very.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22635.name: piece of steppe jade
22635.col_2: An uncut, unpolished piece of jade mined from the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22636.name: chunk of crystal-clear rock salt
22636.col_2: The finest rock salt the steppe has to offer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22637.name: chunk of ultramarine ore
22637.col_2: The deep blue hue of this large piece of stone can be attributed to a high concentration of the mineral lazurite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22638.name: steppe slab
22638.col_2: A stone slab so massive that its removal has potentially created a dangerous pitfall on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22639.name: steppe mudstone whetstone
22639.col_2: A mudstone whetstone chipped from naturally occurring rock under the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22640.name: chunk of steppe obsidian
22640.col_2: A sharp, glossy stone found on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22641.name: vibrant steppe glowstone
22641.col_2: An unusually bright glowstone found on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22642.name: Azim strawberry
22642.col_2: A small, blood red fruit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22643.name: clump of scarlet flax
22643.col_2: A variety of flax that, when dried, turns a deep red.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22644.name: duskglow cocoon
22644.col_2: This variety of silkworm cocoon is prized by textile makers for its warm iridescence.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22645.name: straight shoot
22645.col_2: This thick stem is sturdy enough to be whittled into an arrow that will fly true.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22646.name: bundle of steppe sedge
22646.col_2: A perennial that proliferates through the grasslands of the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22647.name: bouquet of steppe safflowers
22647.col_2: A brightly colored flower that blooms across the Azim Steppe. Best known as a versatile dye that can produce red, yellow, or even purple hues.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22648.name: verdant branch
22648.col_2: The branch of a flowering evergreen tree.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22649.name: dry branch
22649.col_2: Seasoned to perfection, this brittle twig gathered on the Azim Steppe is certain to burn quick and hot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22650.name: piece of steppe rattan lumber
22650.col_2: Even a single piece of this lumber should serve to make a fair few Namazu uchiwa.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22651.name: steppe vine
22651.col_2: A pliable vine collected in the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22652.name: yol feather
22652.col_2: A colorful feather once belonging to a proud yol.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22653.name: steppe candyfruit
22653.col_2: Do not let its unappealing exterior fool you─this steppe delicacy is worth the effort of finding one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22654.name: edible bud
22654.col_2: A plant bud that, despite having been plucked somewhat at random in the Azim Steppe, is both safe and pleasant to eat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22655.name: sack of grazing grass
22655.col_2: A bag of the lush grass upon which Azim Steppe dzos are wont to graze.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22656.name: steppe onion
22656.col_2: A common and easily recognizable vegetable found growing wild on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22657.name: pod of fava beans
22657.col_2: A large green legume harvested from the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22658.name: bundle of steppe hay
22658.col_2: A heaping helping of hay wholly for horses.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22659.name: basket of steppe tea leaves
22659.col_2: Tannin-rich tea leaves sourced from the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22660.name: tuft of steppe wildgrass
22660.col_2: Wind-kissed wildgrass smooth enough for weaving.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22661.name: steppe radish
22661.col_2: An Azim Steppe root vegetable known for its unforgiving bite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22662.name: fragrant steppe herb
22662.col_2: This variety of steppe herb is so fragrant that its scent can travel more than a malm, potentially attracting uninvited guests to the homes of hapless cooks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22663.name: fibrous melon
22663.col_2: A tough-looking specimen harvested from near Mol Iloh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22664.name: sturdy vine
22664.col_2: A durable vine harvested on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22665.name: ripe steppe fruit
22665.col_2: This fruit's bright-orange color speaks to its ripeness...if it is indeed the type of fruit that turns orange when ripe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22666.name: sprig of steppe flatweed
22666.col_2: An edible yellow flower that bears a close visual resemblance to the dandelion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22667.name: tuft of fragrant steppe wildgrass
22667.col_2: Unusually fragrant wildgrass, rare even on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

22668.name: sunshell
22668.col_2: This creature's spiral shell can be carved to reveal a bright-red, lustrous interior.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22669.name: steppe barramundi
22669.col_2: A fish that thrives in the freshwater bodies of the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22670.name: water fan
22670.col_2: A bivalve mollusk named for its resemblance to an uchiwa fan.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22671.name: arrowhead snail
22671.col_2: A snail known for its sharply pointed shell.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22672.name: invisible catfish
22672.col_2: A fleshy fish that rarely shows itself to would-be predators.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22673.name: khaal crab
22673.col_2: A crustacean that thrives in the rivers of the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22674.name: fish offering
22674.col_2: A small fish suitable for ritual sacrifice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22675.name: fatty eel
22675.col_2: An eel that thrives on the Azim Steppe, replete with fatty oils for the harvesting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22676.name: crimson copperfish
22676.col_2: A freshwater fish named for the rich metallic hue of its scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22677.name: zagas a'khaal
22677.col_2: An exceedingly common fish that thrives (perhaps overmuch) in the rivers of the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22678.name: gigas catfish
22678.col_2: A catfish larger than any catfish ought to be.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22679.name: rainbow killifish
22679.col_2: A freshwater fish often sought by collectors for personal aquariums.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22680.name: steppe sweetfish
22680.col_2: Found in the freshwater bodies of the Azim Steppe, this fish is prized for its delectable flesh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22681.name: greasy strangler
22681.col_2: An oil-rich eel that thrives on the Azim Steppe. Subdues larger prey by wrapping its body about the victim until asphyxiation sets in.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22682.name: grass shrimp
22682.col_2: A minuscule shrimp found on the Azim Steppe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests. <hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22683.name: flagon clam
22683.col_2: A mollusk named for its physical resemblance to a flagon of ale.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

22684.name: moon oyster

23072.col_2: The protruding fangs of this freshwater fish are even sharper than those of a coeurl.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

23074.name: shirogane clam

23075.name: Illuminati mask

23097.name: grand chair
23097.col_2: An imposing chair with an ornately wrought chocobo motif.

23123.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your prototype conveyor will magically bring the machine to life.

23124.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your reprogrammed safeguard system will magically bring the machine to life.

23125.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your reprogrammed logistics node will magically bring the machine to life.

23127.description: pairs of replica Sudarshana Chakra Anemos
23127.col_2: ※Weapon appearance may take precedence over the display of hand gear.

23142.name: Pagos lockbox
23142.col_2: A firmly sealed box discovered deep in the Pagos wilds. Only a skilled picker of locks might grant you access to the treasure within.

23143.name: set of Gyr Abanian remedies
23143.col_2: An assortment of highly effective traditional medicines originating in Gyr Abania.

23144.name: anti-shark harpoon
23144.col_2: A harpoon particularly effective for warding off sharks...by stabbing them.

23145.name: set of Coerthan cold-weather gear
23145.col_2: Various items so effective against the cold that no Coerthan would leave home without them.

23146.name: Sui-no-Sato Special
23146.col_2: A new luxury product designed for the express purpose of representing Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato.

23147.name: cloud pearl
23147.col_2: A synthetic version of a rare treasure occasionally found in the Sea of Clouds.

23148.name: pinch of active ingredients
23148.col_2: Minerals that serve as the active ingredients in various Gyr Abanian remedies.

23149.name: harpoon head
23149.col_2: A sharp and sturdy harpoon head, well suited to shark stabbing.

23150.name: phial of thermal fluid
23150.col_2: This liquid can be applied, to great effect, as insulation.

23151.name: Shisui jewel
23151.col_2: A rare gem from beneath the waves of the Ruby Sea.

23152.name: cloudkin feather
23152.col_2: This feather could easily have come from one of any number of cloudkin.

23153.name: set of Gyr Abanian remedy components
23153.description: sets of Gyr Abanian remedy components
23153.col_2: A variety of components needed to create traditional Gyr Abanian remedies.

23154.name: set of harpoon components
23154.col_2: Several components needed to create a harpoon effective against sharks.

23155.name: set of cold-weather gear components
23155.col_2: A variety of components needed to create cold-weather gear of the sort favored by Coerthans.

23156.name: set of Sui-no-Sato Special components
23156.col_2: A variety of components necessary to create Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's new product.

23157.name: set of cloud pearl components
23157.col_2: A variety of components necessary to create a synthetic cloud pearl.

23158.name: sack of raw medicinal materials
23158.col_2: Assorted materials needed to create the components used in Gyr Abanian remedies.

23159.name: sack of raw harpoon materials
23159.col_2: Assorted materials needed to create the various components of a harpoon.

23160.name: sack of raw cold-weather gear materials
23160.description: sacks of raw cold-weather gear materials
23160.col_2: Assorted materials needed to create the various components of Coerthan cold-weather gear.

23161.name: sack of raw Sui-no-Sato Special materials
23161.description: sacks of raw Sui-no-Sato Special materials
23161.col_2: Assorted materials sourced from Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato that are needed to create components for the newly invented Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato Special.

23162.name: sack of raw cloud pearl materials
23162.description: sacks of raw cloud pearl materials
23162.col_2: Assorted materials needed to create the components used in synthesizing a cloud pearl.

23163.name: empyrean potion
23163.col_2: Grants the effect of Rehabilitation (HP regeneration) to yourself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s<hex:02100103>※Only available for use in Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High.

23164.name: empyrean potsherd
23164.col_2: A jagged piece of a pottery that defies all known methods of dating.

23165.name: aetherpool grip
23165.col_2: A sturdy grip designed for aetherpool arms.

23166.name: empyrean aetherpool grip
23166.col_2: A sturdy grip designed for empyrean aetherpool arms.

23167.name: super-potion
23167.col_2: This concentrated concoction instantly restores a significant amount of HP.

23168.name: vial of super-ether
23168.col_2: Processed via the alchemical extraction of aetheric essence occurring in elemental crystals, the contents of this vial instantly restore a significant amount of MP.

23169.name: sack of dubious dirt
23169.col_2: Both the nature and utility of this peculiar dirt are impossible to imagine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

23170.name: sprig of odd herb
23170.col_2: Both the nature and utility of this peculiar herb are impossible to imagine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

23171.name: fishy fish
23171.col_2: Both the nature and utility of this peculiar fish are impossible to imagine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

23172.name: set of elixir mixing paraphernalia materials
23172.description: sets of elixir mixing paraphernalia materials
23172.col_2: An assortment of materials required to craft tools and reagents required for the Namazu's revitalizing elixir.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

23173.name: set of elixir mixing paraphernalia
23173.col_2: Exactly what the Namazu apothecary needs to finish his reinvigorating elixir.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

23174.name: Gougan coin
23174.col_2: A small gold coin stamped with what you assume to be the Clockwork City of Goug's mint mark. Once considered to be of great historical significance, a sudden influx caused their value to plummet, rendering them almost worthless.

23175.name: Ultima totem
23175.col_2: This unsettling metal totem of unknown origin depicts the Ultima Weapon as if it were a god.

23176.name: doyen's Clan mark log
23176.col_2: A list of highly elite marks documented by the log's owner. It is unclear whether the marks within were ever slain by said owner, but the overuse of modifiers such as “ghastly,” “terrifying,” and “beyond all horrors that haunt the sleeping mind” in their descriptions suggests perhaps not. Though such documents were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

23177.name: empyrean reliquary
23177.col_2: A holy vessel discovered in Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High. The contents are doubtless of great value to the spiritually inclined...unless you have pulverized them by unceremoniously stowing the vessel in your bag, that is.

23178.name: pot of stormsap
23178.col_2: The chemical composition of this milky violet liquid is unknown, but its color─reminiscent of a thundercloud illuminated by lightning─has given rise to rumors surrounding its origins that have led to the unfortunate electrocution of many a scholar and profiteer alike.

23179.name: hawk's eye
23179.col_2: A blue-grey jewel consisting of many colored layers. When polished, it resembles the piercing eye of a raptor.

23180.name: lump of hardened veteran tree sap
23180.description: lumps of hardened veteran tree sap
23180.col_2: A partially congealed ball of sticky sap extracted from an aged tree.

23181.name: kingcraft demimateria
23181.col_2: A crystallized mass of residual spiritbond energies transferred to an article of weaponry or armor by its exceptionally skilled maker during the crafting process.

23182.name: handful of duskglow aethersand
23182.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced matter. This fine sand emits a crepuscular glow independent of ambient light.

23183.name: handful of hawk's eye sand
23183.col_2: Conversion of the mineral hawk's eye via an alchemical process is the only way to create this incomparably fine sand.

23184.name: bottle of veteran tree sap
23184.col_2: This sap has been reverted from hardened lumps to its original liquid state via an alchemical process.

23185.name: handful of konpeito
23185.col_2: Colorful clusters of crystalline sugar─a childhood treat for Hingans and Domans alike.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23186.name: serving of banh xeo
23186.col_2: A traditional Nagxian dish consisting of meat and vegetables swaddled in a thin shell of crispy fried batter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23187.name: cup of matcha
23187.col_2: A sophisticatedly bitter infusion prepared by whisking fine-ground tea leaves into piping hot water. Drinking it properly requires such finesse that Hingashi is home to many a school focused solely on perfecting the art.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23188.name: serving of ema datshi
23188.col_2: Rich, oozing cheese complements the seething bite of inferno-hot peppers in this Azim Steppe staple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23199.name: handking's tool belt
23199.col_2: Before becoming obsolete due to advancements in tailoring, belts such as this were used for holding up trousers and the like.

23204.name: landking's survival belt
23204.col_2: Before becoming obsolete due to advancements in tailoring, belts such as this were used for holding up trousers and the like.

23209.name: celestial kimono remnant
23209.col_2: This length of fabric was cut from the Lady of the Moon's own kimono.

23210.name: Resistance token
23210.col_2: Used by the Ala Mhigan Resistance to verify the submission of battle gear.

23213.name: wooden Hakutaku eye
23213.col_2: A ligneous eyeball of the legendary Hakutaku. Rumor has it that its sight will be restored when immersed in blood.

23214.name: burning Hakutaku eye
23214.col_2: A fiery eyeball of the legendary Hakutaku. Rumor has it that its sight will be restored when immersed in blood.

23215.name: earthen Hakutaku eye
23215.col_2: A soiled eyeball of the legendary Hakutaku. Rumor has it that its sight will be restored when immersed in blood.

23216.name: golden Hakutaku eye
23216.col_2: A lustrous eyeball of the legendary Hakutaku. Rumor has it that its sight will be restored when immersed in blood.

23217.name: damp Hakutaku eye
23217.col_2: A dripping eyeball of the legendary Hakutaku. Rumor has it that its sight will be restored when immersed in blood.

23218.name: Hakutaku eye cluster
23218.col_2: A cluster of eyes from a legendary beast, the Hakutaku. The eyes are slowly yet steadily growing in number as they divide via mitosis.

23219.name: speed belt
23219.col_2: Before becoming obsolete due to advancements in tailoring, belts such as this were used for holding up trousers and the like. This particular design, however, has retained some modicum of value, or so the Calamity salvagers appear to believe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be exchanged with Calamity salvagers for a blitzring.]

23221.name: sprig of Yanxian verbena
23221.col_2: A hearty plant that can proliferate on nearly any surface, including tree trunks. Its leaves release a pleasant scent when touched.

23222.name: lump of marine wax ester
23222.col_2: A saturated wax ester harvested from the fathomless abyss.

23223.name: silver-haloed sack
23223.col_2: This radiant bag containing a portion of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only an appraiser almost suspiciously well versed in the dispelling of hexes might be able to undo such a seal.

23224.name: gold-haloed sack
23224.col_2: This radiant bag containing a portion of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only an appraiser almost suspiciously well versed in the dispelling of hexes might be able to undo such a seal.

23225.col_2: This radiant bag containing a portion of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only an appraiser almost suspiciously well versed in the dispelling of hexes might be able to undo such a seal.

23227.name: empyrean pine log
23227.col_2: Though this was perhaps once a run-of-the-mill cutting of timber, it has since been warped in the oddest of ways by exposure to the powerful magicks of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High.

23228.name: sack of empyrean clay
23228.col_2: Though this was perhaps once unremarkable mud, it has since been warped in the oddest of ways by exposure to the powerful magicks of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High.

23229.name: stuffed happy bunny
23229.col_2: This plush rabbit is so realistic that it is rumored to bring fortune, just like a real happy bunny would, to all who come across it. All except those who are prone to allergies, anyway.

23230.name: journeyman salvager permit
23230.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of journeyman salvagers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

23309.name: frosted protean crystal
23309.col_2: Hastily forged from the aspected aether of slain beasts, this crystal quickly accumulated a fragile veneer of ice when exposed to the frigid air of Pagos. Its energies have yet to settle─if indeed they ever will.

23310.name: Whalaqee Off-guard totem
23310.col_2: An intricately carved wooden totem imbued with the secrets of a defense-shattering technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use by blue mages.

23336.col_3: Faded Copy of Under the Moonlight

23337.name: faded copy of ambient abyss
23337.col_2: Timeworn pages of sheet music containing a full panoply of the ambient melodies one might expect to hear under the sea.

23339.name: authentic Moonfire Faire MMXIV advertisement
23339.col_2: An authentic reprint of a faithful depiction of summer's hottest festival so that you may feel the heat year-round.

23340.name: cup of authentic evercold shaved ice
23340.description: cups of authentic evercold shaved ice
23340.col_2: Authentic thinly shaved ice, generously heaped into an authentic oversmall bowl and drizzled with sweet-yet-tangy rolanberry syrup...authentically. Why it never melts is a question best served cold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 11)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +1<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23341.name: authentic Rising balloon
23341.col_2: The bladder of some poor beast, colored with dye and filled with lighter-than-air gas to dazzle the young <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> the young at heart come the Rising. So authentic to the previous year's balloons that you can almost smell it.

23342.name: behemoth pelt
23342.col_2: The no longer glossy, yet still massive, coat of a behemoth.

23345.name: lizard tail
23345.col_2: In defiance of all logic and natural laws, this tail is still partly alive, and twitches occasionally. Delightful.

23346.name: reishi mushroom
23346.col_2: This rare mushroom is known for its high nutritive content...and not much else.

23347.name: bottle of Pagos spring water
23347.col_2: Clear, cool water taken from a spring in the Pagos region of Eureka.

23348.name: sprig of Pagos sage
23348.col_2: A fragrant herb that can be used medicinally or to add a pleasant flavor to cuisine. The variety found in Pagos is notably crisp and hearty.

23349.name: potion of harmony
23349.col_2: This innovative alchemical concoction assists the body in acclimating to Eureka's discordant aetheric environment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Elemental EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +10%  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 60m (if HQ, 90m)<hex:02100103>※Only available for use in the Forbidden Land, Eureka.

23361.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Box Step<hex:021A020103>
23361.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Box Step<hex:021A020103>
23361.col_2: An illustrated manual of the various steps that comprise the box step. Use to learn the /boxstep emote.

23362.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Side Step<hex:021A020103>
23362.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Side Step<hex:021A020103>
23362.col_2: An illustrated manual of the various steps that comprise the side step. Use to learn the /sidestep emote.

23363.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Ultima<hex:021A020103>
23363.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to obliterate your enemies in style when pushed to the brink of annihilation. Use to learn the /ultima emote.

23364.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Yol Dance<hex:021A020103>
23364.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Yol Dance<hex:021A020103>
23364.col_2: An illustrated manual of the various steps that comprise a traditional dance of the Oronir tribe. Use to learn the /yoldance emote.

23365.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Excessive Petticoats<hex:021A020103>
23365.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to cool oneself with at least some semblance of dignity after a rousing circuit of the dance floor. Use to learn the /sweat emote.

23366.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Insufficient Petticoats<hex:021A020103>
23366.col_2: An illustrated manual of how <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> to conduct oneself while trapped on the balcony with an indefatigable admirer in the evening hours. Use to learn the /shiver emote.

23367.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Stimulating Soliloquies<hex:021A020103>
23367.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to confidently explain a matter in excruciating detail, regardless of whether anyone asked. Use to learn the /elucidate emote.

23369.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Gyr Abanian Plait<hex:021A020103>
23369.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Gyr Abanian Plait<hex:021A020103>
23369.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques on braiding hair in the traditional Ala Mhigan fashion─a style that was popular until the imperial invasion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.

23370.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Fashionably Feathered<hex:021A020103>
23370.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for styling short hair using only a razor (and copious amounts of wax).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

23371.name: bolt of Oroniri cloth
23371.col_2: The dyeing techniques used to color this bolt of cloth are unique to the Oronir.

23372.name: bolt of Dotharli cloth
23372.col_2: The dyeing techniques used to color this bolt of cloth are unique to the Dotharl.

23375.name: bolt of cloth cointe quaint
23375.col_2: No <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> lady of fashion would be caught dead wearing a skirt or─heavens forfend─a dress made from anything else.

23376.name: circle of leather cointe quaint
23376.col_2: No <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> lady of fashion would be caught dead wearing a hat or─heavens forfend─shoes made from anything else.

23377.name: bolt of boutique batiste
23377.col_2: No <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> gentleman of fashion would be caught dead wearing a shirt or─heavens forfend─pants made from anything else.

23378.name: circle of boutique boarded leather
23378.col_2: No <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> gentleman of fashion would be caught dead wearing a hat or─heavens forfend─shoes made from anything else.

23379.name: cold-warped lockbox
23379.col_2: A firmly sealed box discovered deep in the Pagos wilds, its shape made irregular by prolonged exposure to the elements. Only a skilled picker of locks might grant you access to the treasure within.

23380.name: Endless Summer coffer
23380.col_2: A banded chest containing a complete set of Endless Summer attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

23381.name: Rising token MMXVIII
23381.col_2: An official voucher issued to participants in the Calamity Retold. Celebrate Eorzea's rebirth by trading for fabulous prizes!

23382.name: bottle of Thavnairian rain
23382.col_2: A highly concentrated elixir blended in the Near Eastern island nation of Radz-at-Han.

23383.name: Rathalos scale+
23383.col_2: “Rare Rathalos material. Mostly obtained by carving. Broadly used for many purposes.” - Words from an impressively terse tracker of beasts, as recorded in <hex:021A020203>Wisdom of the Hunters<hex:021A020103>.
