23846.name: mannequin
23846.col_2: Once the nightmare of shopkeeps alone, highly detailed models such as this one have gained popularity amongst adventurers as means of selling unneeded accoutrements, displaying hard-won ensembles, and unnerving unsuspecting visitors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can hold 4, 6, 8, and 10 facilities, respectively.

23854.name: magicked prism (hearts)
23854.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a shower of translucent hearts.

23855.name: magicked prism (glassy wings)
23855.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a pair of ethereal wings reminiscent of cathedral glass.

23856.name: chocobo round table
23856.col_2: A round table for all the chocobo- and food-lovers out there.

23857.name: chocobo chair
23857.col_2: A chair for all of (well, one of) the chocobo-lovers out there.

23858.name: odder otter round andon lamp
23858.col_2: A tall indoor lamp with an odder otter motif.

23859.name: chocobo dining table
23859.col_2: A large dining table for all the chocobo-, food-, and chocobo-as-food-lovers out there.

23860.name: Season Nine Lone Wolf trophy
23860.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Nine of the Feast.

23861.name: Season Ten Lone Wolf trophy
23861.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Ten of the Feast.

23862.name: pot of cream stew
23862.col_2: A warming dish of familiar vegetables simmered for bells in a rich sauce of thickened milk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23863.name: Suzaku wall hanging
23863.col_2: An elegant relief depicting one of the Four Lords, alive with dancing flame.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

23864.name: Doman dogwood
23864.col_2: A sizable potted tree, perpetually in bloom with redolent magenta flowers.

23865.name: enclave map
23865.col_2: An artistic ink rendering of the spectacularly reconstructed Doman Enclave.

23866.name: Heavensturn bounty
23866.col_2: A traditional Heavensturn decoration meant to beckon fortune through its depiction of a traditional bumper crop of rice, traditionally infested by mice.

23867.name: set of pumpkin party pennants
23867.col_2: A festive wall decoration dominated by All Saints' Wake motifs. If one did not know better than to suspect the troupe of trickery, one might think this “reward” merely a hastily assembled hodgepodge of spare party decorations.

23868.name: pumpkin pastry platter
23868.col_2: In the spirit of All Saints' Wake, each of these pastries is pumpkin-flavored...except for the pumpkin-shaped one, which was deemed thematically sufficient regardless. Also in the spirit of All Saints' Wake, there are more of them than is advisable to consume in one sitting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23869.name: set of familiar pawprints
23869.col_2: An adhesive wall decoration to make any witches in your company this All Saints' Wake feel at home.

23870.name: silver Starlight sentinel
23870.col_2: A potted conifer displayed in homes during the Starlight Celebration. Its snowy color will make your décor sumptuous─and your gatherings lively as you argue with friends and neighbors over whether it is superior to the more traditional green.

23871.name: basket of Starlight donuts
23871.col_2: Festive treats for those who prefer to express their Starlight spirit through eating until they lose consciousness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23872.name: evercold Starlight snowman
23872.col_2: This indoor frosty snowman will never melt away. He'll be there forever. Watching. Waiting.

23873.name: pile of opened twinkleboxes
23873.col_2: The detritus of many happy Starlight Celebration surprises.

23874.name: redoubtable rolanberry tart
23874.col_2: A flaky-crusted tart with a slight acidity that complements its pleasant sweetness, so enormous that it should only be served at parties. Of course, sometimes a party can be just one hungry homeowner and a clean fork. Or a dirty one. It doesn't really matter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Tenacity Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23875.name: crystal boule
23875.col_2: A mounted sample of the luminous euhedral crystals that grow uninhibited on the sea floor.

23876.name: Gridanian bouquet
23876.col_2: An elegant bouquet for romantic occasions, each bloom painstakingly selected by the florist Tanie.

23877.name: imitation shuttered window
23877.col_2: Unlike those attached to non-imitation windows, these louvered shutters will ever remain pristine as they add a touch of the rustic to your interior décor.

23878.name: little chef's playset
23878.col_2: This set for aspiring culinary artists includes soft, child-safe replicas of everything one might need in the kitchen, including a helpful Miqo'te poissonnier.

23879.name: wooden showcase
23879.col_2: Spare a thought for the poor carpenter who toiled to make this furnishing both simple and elegant as you inevitably pile as many objects as physically possible atop its shelves.

23880.name: unfinished shawl
23880.col_2: A knitter's work is never done. In this case, literally.

23881.name: adventuring pack
23881.col_2: An adventurer never leaves home without his compass! And his waterskin. And his lantern. And his potions. And his telescope. And his books. Really, an adventurer needs to learn to pack a bit lighter.

23882.name: spice rack
23882.col_2: This storage unit is packed with enough spices, herbs, oils, and other ingredients to satisfy even the most dedicated culinarian.

23883.name: bread rack
23883.col_2: One could raise an entire army of ducks with this much bread. Hypothetically.

23884.name: mahogany bunk bed
23884.col_2: For weary adults who have spent overmuch on alligator pears and cannot afford to live alone.

23885.name: handbasket
23885.col_2: A large and lovely woven vessel. Be advised that if a Lalafell fits in it, she will sits in it.

23886.name: pile of strewn smallclothes
23886.col_2: Home is where the heap of unfolded undergarments is.

23887.name: pile of strewn bottoms
23887.col_2: There's no better way to vaunt your wealth than buying three nearly identical pairs of trousers and refusing to wear any of them.

23888.name: set of glass jars
23888.col_2: Opaque vessels of assorted size, perhaps containing flour and sugar. Or cookies. Or bugs.

23889.name: stack of wooden plates
23889.col_2: Dishes for those with simple tastes and many friends.

23890.name: set of wooden cups
23890.col_2: A half-dozen goblets for fancy parties. Cupbearer not included.

23891.name: mounted plate rack
23891.col_2: A sturdy wooden display. For the <hex:021A020203>good<hex:021A020103> plates, not the <hex:021A020203>food<hex:021A020103> plates.

23892.name: verdant partition
23892.col_2: A lush partition covered floor-to-ceiling in ivy and assorted ferns.

23893.name: set of bathroom floor tiles
23893.col_2: A large square of cerulean tiling with a built-in drain.

23894.name: set of bathroom wall tiles
23894.col_2: A square of tiling used to prevent walls from becoming so waterlogged that the house slowly but surely collapses in on itself.

23895.name: set of towels
23895.col_2: Such neatly folded and extraordinarily fluffy towels can only have been purloined from an expensive inn.

23896.name: set of sofa cushions
23896.col_2: Does one truly require a sofa if he has this many pillows?

23897.name: birdbath
23897.col_2: An elegant two-tiered water feature. Perhaps doubting that potential purchasers would be patient enough to wait for real ones to appear, the sculptor helpfully attached model birds as well.

23898.name: square of garden gravel
23898.col_2: Myriad tiny rocks that await your landscaping pleasure.

23899.name: brick garden circle
23899.col_2: All these squares make a circle.

23900.name: roll of carpeting
23900.col_2: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet with a checkerboard pattern.

23901.name: divine chandelier
23901.col_2: A contemporary light fixture designed with the Twelve as its primary theme.

23902.name: unfinished interior wall
23902.col_2: An interior wall of pale unvarnished wood.

23903.name: coelacanth-class bow
23903.col_2: Comprising the front end of a coelacanth-class submersible, this streamlined bow is designed to allow a vessel to reach greater speeds underwater.

23904.name: coelacanth-class bridge
23904.col_2: Comprising the top of a coelacanth-class submersible, this bridge is expansive and equipped with amenities to enable longer voyages.

23905.name: coelacanth-class pressure hull
23905.col_2: Comprising the center of a coelacanth-class submersible, this ovoid hull is designed to be resilient against external water pressure and thereby raises maximum operating depth.

23906.name: coelacanth-class stern
23906.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a coelacanth-class submersible, this stern includes a hydrodynamic rudder for optimal lateral maneuverability.

23962.name: Suzaku totem
23962.col_2: It is unknown by whom or for what purpose this wooden idol carved in the likeness of the auspice Suzaku was created.

23963.name: Alphascape lens
23963.col_2: A uniquely crafted lens discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two lenses can be traded for special headgear.

23964.name: Alphascape shaft
23964.col_2: A uniquely crafted shaft discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four shafts can be traded for special body gear.

23965.name: Alphascape crank
23965.col_2: A uniquely crafted crank discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two cranks can be traded for special arm gear.

23966.name: Alphascape spring
23966.col_2: A uniquely crafted spring discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four springs can be traded for special leg gear.

23967.name: Alphascape pedal
23967.col_2: A uniquely crafted pedal discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pedals can be traded for special foot gear.

23968.name: Alphascape chain
23968.col_2: A uniquely crafted chain discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift. Alas, advancements in trouser technology have rendered it worthless.

23969.name: Alphascape bolt
23969.col_2: A uniquely crafted bolt discovered somewhere within the Interdimensional Rift.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One bolt can be traded for a special accessory.

23970.name: Alphascape datalog v1.0

23974.name: Alphascape crystalloid
23974.col_2: A remarkable crystalline fragment within which can be seen images from another world. Though such articles were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up, leaving them with little value as bartering materials.

23975.name: flask of Scaevan ester
23975.col_2: A lubricant concocted by a certain Garlond Ironworks consultant that, when applied to weapons of similar origin, heightens their attributes by smoothing interactions between their many interlocking parts. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

23976.name: spool of Scaevan twine
23976.col_2: A sturdy fiber devised by a certain Garlond Ironworks consultant for the purpose of heightening the attributes of armor of his own design. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

23977.name: phial of Scaevan shellac
23977.col_2: A fixing agent concocted by a certain Garlond Ironworks consultant that, when applied to accessories of similar origin, heightens their attributes by rebuffing vapor penetration and insulating delicate internal mechanisms. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

23978.name: Rowena's token (genesis)
23978.col_2: A note of promise received from Rowena for the delivery of Allagan tomestones of genesis or poetics. However, due to the House of Splendors changing its policies, it is now worth less than the paper on which it is scribed.

23979.name: military-grade tomestone
23979.col_2: The exacting specifications to which this tomestone was made, along with its half-deciphered contents, have led Ironworks engineers to believe that it was manufactured for exclusive use by the Allagan armed forces. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

23980.name: Omega weapon coffer (IL 405)
23980.col_2: A heavy chest containing an Omega weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 70. IL: 405. Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

23981.name: SDS Fenrir key
23981.col_2: A thin key that brings the beastly vehicle Fenrir roaring to life.

23982.name: Grani horn
23982.col_2: A stygian horn that, when blown, summons the otherworldly steed Grani.

23983.name: fatter cat bugle
23983.col_2: This horn emits a playful honk that calls a rotund-yet-sprightly feline to your side.

23984.name: euphonious kamuy fife
23984.col_2: The melodious song of this stout flute is said to summon a kamuy blessed by Lady Suzaku herself.

23985.name: Model O identification key
23985.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown alloy. Placing it near your Model O will magically bring the machine to life.

23986.name: magitek sky armor identification key
23986.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your magitek sky armor will magically bring the machine to life.

23987.name: magna roader identification key
23987.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your magna roader will bring it roaring terrifyingly to life.

23988.name: fat black chocobo whistle

23989.name: scarlet peacock

24230.name: Yanxia riding map

24234.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Styled for Hire<hex:021A020103>
24234.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Styled for Hire<hex:021A020103>
24234.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for trimming and coiffing one's way to the dashing look that's in vogue amongst sellswords across the Three Great Continents.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

24235.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Positively Prickly<hex:021A020103>
24235.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to imitate Senor Sabotender's whimsical motions. Please note that the publisher is not responsible for any deaths resulting from the improper use of techniques described in this volume. Use to learn the /sabotender emote.

24238.name: magicked prism (advent cakes)
24238.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Produces a festive stack of Heavensturn advent cakes.

24239.name: piece of cut mochi
24239.col_2: A perfectly proportioned rice cake deftly cleaved from a mass of sentient mochi. Perhaps, thus separated from its host, it has become just another tasty dessert. Or perhaps it still retains some awareness, wishing desperately for a mouth with which to scream.

24240.name: chunk of Gyr Abanian ore
24240.col_2: A naturally occurring chunk of lodestone.

24241.name: chunk of evergleam ore
24241.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing a rare natural alloy of iron and chromium.

24242.name: urunday log
24242.col_2: A rough-cut log of urunday timber.

24243.name: Yanxian cotton boll
24243.col_2: These whimsical cotton flowers, found only in Yanxia, glimmer faintly like stars in the night.

24244.name: procoptodon skin
24244.col_2: The tough hide of a long-extinct marsupial. Unnervingly, it has somehow survived the test of time.

24245.name: handful of Gyr Abanian carbon rods
24245.description: handfuls of Gyr Abanian carbon rods
24245.col_2: Pure carbon used in the manufacture of specialty steel.

24246.name: handful of tatara iron sand
24246.col_2: Fine metallic sand consisting of tiny grains of Doman iron, for use specifically in tatara smelting.

24247.name: spindle of stardust cotton yarn
24247.col_2: Glimmering yarn reminiscent of a comet's tail.

24248.name: lump of Gyr Abanian wax
24248.col_2: A uniquely Gyr Abanian wax that renders even the most decrepit of hides supple and lustrous when applied as part of the tanning process.

24249.name: pot of high-gloss urushi
24249.col_2: This black coating, made from the sap of the lacquer tree, is used to both color and preserve wooden crafts, and can be polished to an extraordinarily glossy sheen.

24250.name: chigusa ingot
24250.col_2: An ingot of tatara-smelted Doman steel.

24251.name: evergleam ingot
24251.col_2: An ingot of smelted evergleam steel.

24253.name: circle of procoptodon leather
24253.col_2: A large piece of cured procoptodon skin.

24254.name: bolt of stardust cotton cloth
24254.col_2: Several yalms of undyed stardust cotton wrapped around a short distaff.

24255.name: bottle of Azim spring water
24255.col_2: Water of uncommon clarity sourced from underground springs on the Azim Steppe.

24256.name: bottle of grade 4 reisui of strength
24256.description: bottles of grade 4 reisui of strength
24256.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

24266.col_2: This esoteric tome─the seventh in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced woodworking recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled carpenters.

24274.col_2: A healthful herbal tea known for its natural mellow sweetness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24276.name: serving of laghman
24276.col_2: A popular comfort food in Othard consisting of thick, chewy noodles and tender minced dzo in a wholesome broth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24277.name: serving of imam bayildi
24277.col_2: Miniature Doman eggplants stuffed to bursting with juicy marinated vegetables─and enough peppers to knock a trained Fist of Rhalgr monk out cold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24278.name: serving of papanasi
24278.col_2: Thick dough kneaded with soft cheese and fried into a hearty donut, slathered with yet more creamy cheese and a sweet-and-tart berry sauce.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24279.name: salmon muffin
24279.col_2: A buttery Ishgardian muffin topped with the winning combination of succulent fresh salmon, silky sliced alligator pear, and a drizzling of rich cheese.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24281.name: bag of rooibos leaves
24281.col_2: Red bush leaves whose prickly texture belies the marvelously velvety brew they can be steeped to create.

24282.name: cup of Reunion cheese
24282.col_2: A washed-rind cheese made possible by the fortuitous meeting of a Steppe cheesemaker and an itinerant winemaker. It possesses a creamy texture and nutty flavor─though one would be forgiven for being skeptical, given the smell.

24283.name: exclusive stuffed dog
24283.col_2: Said to bring a full twelvemoon of good fortune...or as much can be expected from a disturbingly realistic dog skin filled with sawdust and bittersweet memories. Perhaps this is related to why there are a limited number in circulation.

24284.name: certificate of good cheer MMXVIII
24284.description: expired certificates of good cheer MMXVIII
24284.col_2: A slip of parchment issued in recognition of efforts toward spreading Starlight spirit. Only valid for one year from date of issue─the better to encourage cheer-related efforts annually.

24285.name: pair of Lamebrix's dice
24285.col_2: A pair of precisely carved dice, subtly weighted for the purpose of cheating in goblin gambling games.

24286.name: piece of Ying-Yang's tissue
24286.col_2: An unsightly portion of veined membrane ripped from Ying-Yang's (hopefully vestigial) wings.

24287.name: Skoll's claw
24287.col_2: A gleaming, knifelike appendage torn from Skoll's frigid paw.

24344.name: Syldra-class bow
24344.col_2: Comprising the front end of a Syldra-class submersible, this unique bow resembles the head and neck of a legendary sea dragon.

24345.name: Syldra-class bridge
24345.col_2: Comprising the top of a Syldra-class submersible, this bridge is equipped with escape pods to be used in the event of an emergency.

24346.name: Syldra-class pressure hull
24346.col_2: Comprising the center of a Syldra-class submersible, this hydrodynamic finned hull is insusceptible to the pull of even the strongest currents.

24347.name: Syldra-class stern
24347.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a Syldra-class submersible, this stern is shaped so as to allow the craft to operate nigh silently, even at top speed.

24348.name: modified shark-class bow
24348.col_2: Comprising the front end of a shark-class submersible, this redesigned bow doubles as an exceptionally sturdy battering ram for subduing unruly sea creatures.

24349.name: modified shark-class bridge
24349.col_2: Comprising the top of a shark-class submersible, this bridge has been fully outfitted with any and all equipment that could possibly be necessary for exploring faraway seas.

24350.name: modified shark-class pressure hull
24350.col_2: Comprising the center of a shark-class submersible, this multi-walled ovoid hull and its sturdy rudder fins have been redesigned to provide additional stability while maneuvering through the depths.

24351.name: modified shark-class stern
24351.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a shark-class submersible, this stern contains a high-powered independent engine which propels the craft.

24352.name: modified unkiu-class bow
24352.col_2: Unkiu-class bows are outfitted with rudder fins, relegated to the stern on most submersibles─and this particular model's have been upgraded for additional durability.

24353.name: modified unkiu-class bridge
24353.col_2: But recently redesigned by the Onishishu─a collective of skilled Far Eastern craftsmen─this submersible bridge differs dramatically from those built in the West.

24354.name: modified unkiu-class pressure hull
24354.col_2: Comprising the center of an unkiu-class submersible, this ovoid hull is multi-walled to stabilize and maintain pressure within. Its supplemental propulsion engines have been upgraded to further increase underwater speed.

24355.name: modified unkiu-class stern
24355.col_2: Comprising the rear end of an unkiu-class submersible, this stern contains a new model of double propeller engine.

24356.name: modified whale-class bow
24356.col_2: Comprising the front end of a whale-class submersible, this specially reinforced bow will protect the vessel's interior even should it be caught directly in an undersea volcanic eruption.

24357.name: modified whale-class bridge
24357.col_2: Comprising the top of a whale-class submersible, this redesigned bridge improves even further on the depth rating of other models, allowing submersibles equipped with it to delve deeper than previously imagined possible.

24358.name: modified whale-class pressure hull
24358.col_2: Comprising the center of a whale-class submersible, this ovoid hull is equipped with two reinforced auxiliary propellers for superior maneuverability.

24359.name: modified whale-class stern
24359.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a whale-class submersible, this stern features a modern, energy-efficient propeller.

24360.name: modified coelacanth-class bow
24360.col_2: Comprising the front end of a coelacanth-class submersible, this bow has been further streamlined to allow the vessel to reach speeds greater than ever before.

24361.name: modified coelacanth-class bridge
24361.col_2: Comprising the top of a coelacanth-class submersible, this bridge has been altered to provide even more storage space and equipped with myriad amenities for longer voyages.

24362.name: modified coelacanth-class pressure hull
24362.col_2: Comprising the center of a coelacanth-class submersible, this ovoid hull has been redesigned to be even more resilient against external water pressure, thereby further raising maximum operating depth.

24363.name: modified coelacanth-class stern
24363.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a coelacanth-class submersible, this stern includes a streamlined hydrodynamic rudder that further enhances lateral maneuverability.

24364.name: modified Syldra-class bow
24364.col_2: Comprising the front end of a Syldra-class submersible, this unique bow still resembles the head and neck of a legendary sea dragon, but has been adjusted for greater stability.

24365.name: modified Syldra-class bridge
24365.col_2: Comprising the top of a Syldra-class submersible, this bridge has been redesigned to provide further defense against the dangers of the sea─though it remains equipped with escape pods to be used in the event of an emergency.

24366.name: modified Syldra-class pressure hull
24366.col_2: Comprising the center of a Syldra-class submersible, this hydrodynamic finned hull has been altered for even greater resistance to the pull of underwater currents.

24367.name: modified Syldra-class stern
24367.col_2: Comprising the rear end of a Syldra-class submersible, this stern has been streamlined so as to allow the craft to operate silently, even at top speed.

24488.col_2: As if the beastkin's physique simply does not beg to be reimagined as a convenient timepiece.

24489.name: paint can
24489.col_2: The size of this can is indicative of an ambitious home improvement project. The amount of paint remaining suggests that said project has proven more difficult than expected.

24490.name: emerald crystal boule
24490.col_2: A mounted sample of the luminous green crystals that grow uninhibited on the sea floor.

24491.name: mirific mogshelf
24491.col_2: A charming bookshelf topped with decorative moogles beckoning readers to the myriad worlds that come alive through the written word.

24492.name: tier 3 metal aquarium
24492.col_2: A large reinforced glass tank that, when filled with water, can serve as a home for select wavekin caught in the wild. The higher an aquarium's tier, the larger the specimens that can be kept within.<hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 aquariums, respectively.

24493.name: tier 4 metal aquarium
24493.col_2: A massive reinforced glass tank that, when filled with water, can serve as a home for select wavekin caught in the wild. The higher an aquarium's tier, the larger the specimens that can be kept within.<hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 aquariums, respectively.

24494.name: travel paint set
24494.col_2: A robust, portable set of art supplies for adventurous artists and artistic adventurers.

24495.name: Seiryu statuette
24495.col_2: An elegant carving of the venerable Seiryu. The geomantic orb in its claws reputedly fills one's home with auspicious energies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

24496.col_2: A sumptuous plate of boiled and buttered lobster. Comes complete with a heart-shaped pizza. 24499.col_2: A staggeringly sweet chocolate cake served with chocolate bunnies and what one can only hope are chocolate eggs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24501.name: small imitation window
24501.col_2: Despite its size─and the minor detail of it not being a real window─this plain would-be portal provides a surprising amount of light.

24502.name: bag of booty
24502.col_2: The shine of the historic coins contained within has been professionally restored with great care. Nevertheless, whether you tuck this bag safely away or wave it about while putting on a terrible faux-pirate accent is entirely up to you.

24503.name: pile of undersea spoils
24503.col_2: Not all that glitters is gold. This is, though.

24504.name: Level Checker replica
24504.col_2: A model of an advanced piece of technology described in the pages of a─rather eccentric─ancient tome.

24505.name: cerulean crystal boule
24505.col_2: A mounted sample of the luminous blue crystals that grow uninhibited on the sea floor.

24506.name: fat cat bank
24506.col_2: Presumably due to the resemblance in terms of rotundity, the fat cat has overtaken the pig as a popular motif for coin banks. Comes with a matching purse to better facilitate the spending of one's hard-earned savings.

24508.name: set of botanist's dried herbs
24508.col_2: An assortment of pleasant-smelling medicinal and culinary herbs verified to be nontoxic. Mostly.

24509.name: Steppe kitchen
24509.col_2: This cooking facility was fashioned after those used by the Xaela tribes of the Azim Steppe.

24510.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Four Lords<hex:021A020103>
24510.col_2: An evocative ink depiction of the Four Lords.

24511.name: wooden loft
24511.col_2: Create the perfect space for sleeping, reading, displays, or enjoying an insurmountable advantage in pillow fights with this wall-mounted platform.

24512.name: flight of wooden steps
24512.col_2: Useful in climbing up to lofts or removing rival heirs.

24513.name: wooden beam
24513.col_2: For use with the wooden loft, though beam enthusiasts are sure to enjoy it regardless.

24514.name: white rectangular partition
24514.col_2: Thus named despite the fact that none would fain expect a blue triangle.

24515.name: bowl of oden
24515.col_2: A heaping bowl of juicy fishcakes, tender daikon, hearty boiled eggs, and other savory ingredients steeped for hours in a warming broth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24516.name: fruit stall
24516.col_2: A two-tiered unit displaying assorted colorful fruit.

24517.name: vegetable stall
24517.col_2: A large shelf packed with artfully displayed vegetables.

24518.name: pastry cupboard
24518.col_2: Shelves lined with an assortment of pre-plated sweets to sell, share, or...not.

24519.name: mineral display
24519.col_2: Glittering gemstones meticulously arranged atop several tiers of shelving.

24520.name: fabric rack
24520.col_2: A neatly arranged collection of assorted fabrics and spindles of thread for sale.

24521.name: potion rack
24521.col_2: These shelves are packed with enough concoctions and extracts to run a full apothecary and still have some left over for what will doubtless be totally safe and ethical experimentation.

24522.name: prism pouch
24522.col_2: A pouch for many standard-sized prisms, or one extremely large one.

24523.name: marimo lamp
24523.col_2: The product of a skilled yet not particularly creative metalworker who took inspiration from the lamp marimo to create...a lamp containing lamp marimo.

24524.name: honey pot
24524.col_2: Keeping this much honey in the house is just asking for bear-related trouble.

24525.name: red carpet
24525.col_2: A slim length of carpeting to welcome honored guests.

24526.name: hanging planter shelf
24526.col_2: Various potted plants dangle from this wall-mounted shelf, leaving the space atop it free for other items. Or more plants.

24527.name: plush pile
24527.col_2: Stuffed moogles and tonberries and bears, oh my.

24529.name: enormous stuffed Alpha
24529.col_2: A fair flock of fowl's feathers were required to stuff this larger-than-life tribute to Garlond Ironworks' cutest─and yellowest─member.

24530.name: stuffed mammet
24530.col_2: All the cuddliness of a mammet with all the functionality of a plush doll.

24531.name: serving of festive chirashi-zushi
24531.col_2: Almost identical to normal chirashi-zushi, but with markedly more festivity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Direct Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24532.name: plate of festive sushi balls
24532.col_2: Off put by the oblongitudinal proportions of regular sushi? Well, your prayers have been answered. All the fresh fish and vinegared rice you love, ham-fisted into semi-sophisticated spheroids perfect for popping.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24533.name: Season Eleven Lone Wolf trophy
24533.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Eleven of the Feast.

24534.name: Season Twelve Lone Wolf trophy
24534.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Twelve of the Feast.

24535.name: simple treehouse
24535.col_2: No girls allowed. And while we're at it─no boys, either.

24536.name: botanist's garden
24536.col_2: A vegetable patch so lovingly tended that it could only have been cultivated by an expert.

24537.name: Big One festival float
24537.col_2: Though this towering vehicle is meant for use in parades celebrating the Big One, a modern Namazu, rather than said venerable ancestor, is depicted atop it. Is this a means of increasing its appeal among the common Namazu, or simply the result of Gyoshin's brethren refusing to allow him to melt down any more koban to make large golden fish statues? Those who do not purchase <hex:021A020203>A Meditation on the Metaphysics of Merrymaking<hex:021A020103> may never know.

24538.name: roll of teal blue carpeting
24538.col_2: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet in a soothing blue-green.

24539.name: black-and-white interior wall
24539.col_2: A wooden interior wall painted with a monochrome pattern of wide horizontal stripes.

24540.name: set of moonlit tank trimmings
24540.col_2: An assortment of items used to outfit an aquarium that it might resemble the moonlit eve upon which a nightbloom once flowered...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[For use in any tier aquarium.]

24541.name: bag of lily of the valley pips
24541.description: bags of lily of the valley pips
24541.col_2: Mature rootstalks that will grow and flower with sweet-smelling (though highly poisonous) bell-shaped blooms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

24542.name: bouquet of red lilies of the valley
24542.description: bouquets of red lilies of the valley
24542.col_2: A bunch of red lilies of the valley, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

24543.description: bouquets of blue lilies of the valley

24548.col_2: A bunch of white lilies of the valley, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

24550.description: rainbow lily of the valley bouquets
24550.col_2: A bunch of multicolored lilies of the valley, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

24557.name: northern oyster
24557.col_2: The shell of this bivalve mollusk mimics the jagged rocks found throughout the cold northern seas, making it almost impossible to find by anyone but the most keen-eyed of fishers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

24558.name: clump of ruby laver
24558.col_2: Though a brilliant red when in water, the thin leaves of this seaweed turn pitch black when removed from the sea and dried.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

24559.name: chakrafish
24559.col_2: This freshwater fish can be found throughout Gyr Abania, and is a staple amongst those monks who have chosen not to abstain from consuming the flesh of living creatures.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

24560.name: wicked wartfish
24560.col_2: This grotesque deep-sea dweller has adapted to the warm waters off the volcanic isle of Hells' Lid, and thus cannot be found anywhere else in the world.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

24561.name: Othardian salmon
24561.col_2: As is the case with all salmon, this freshwater fish will migrate to the sea after hatching, only to return to the river in which it was spawned to die.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

24562.name: set of Ishgardian culinary essentials
24562.col_2: Cooking tools and ingredients without which the making of authentic Ishgardian cuisine is simply impossible─or so Ishgardian culinarians claim.

24563.name: bottle of fermented juice
24563.col_2: A now-alcoholic liquid ready to be distilled into a strong but tasty liquor.

24564.name: set of signature buuz cookware
24564.col_2: This assemblage of tools and ingredients strongly resembles that used by tribes of the Azim Steppe, but has been modified slightly for use in preparing a variety of buuz exclusive to the Hard Place.

24565.name: set of Hard Place decorative furnishings
24565.description: sets of Hard Place decorative furnishings
24565.col_2: Décor perfect for convincing customers that they don't have to go home─and they <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> stay here.

24566.name: arkhi brewing set
24566.col_2: An assortment of items for brewing the milk-based alcohol that is traditional on the Azim Steppe.

24567.name: sparkstone
24567.col_2: The burning aether contained within this volcanic stone allows for its use not only in striking fires, but also maintaining them at a consistent heat.

24568.name: chunk of malleable still material
24568.col_2: This flexible material is ideal for use in creating a home-brewing facility of one's very own.

24569.name: bottle of strong steppe spice
24569.col_2: This spice is so potent as to often go unused on the Azim Steppe itself, but after overhearing a patron state that buuz “tastes like wet sheep,” Adkiragh was inspired to add it to create a flavor more palatable to non-Xaela.

24570.name: box of Hard Place furnishing materials
24570.description: boxes of Hard Place furnishing materials
24570.col_2: A collection of items that look suitable for use in creating furnishings, and aren't <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> dirty.

24571.name: slab of sturdy vat material
24571.col_2: When fully assembled, an arkhi vat made with this material should be impermeable enough to prevent liquid escaping during the evaporation process and overly intoxicating hapless brewers.

24572.name: set of Ishgardian culinary materials
24572.col_2: Processed materials that still look like any other sort of materials, but are nevertheless ready to be combined into authentic Ishgardian cooking essentials.

24573.name: bundle of juice fermenting supplies
24573.col_2: Pulped fruit, yeast, and other prepared supplies necessary for fermenting juice into alcohol.

24574.name: set of signature buuz cookware materials
24574.description: sets of signature buuz cookware materials
24574.col_2: Processed materials that can be combined into the necessary components for cooking authentic buuz.

24575.name: set of decorative tavern furnishing materials
24575.description: sets of decorative tavern furnishing materials
24575.col_2: Processed materials that genuinely look as if they could be used to create stylish furnishings.

24576.name: bundle of arkhi brewing materials
24576.col_2: Processed materials that can be combined into the necessary components for brewing arkhi.

24577.name: bag of raw Ishgardian materials
24577.col_2: Unsorted and unrefined materials that look like any other sort of materials, but which you are assured are genuinely Ishgardian.

24578.name: bag of raw fermenting supplies
24578.col_2: Unsorted and unprocessed fruit, yeast, and other materials necessary for fermenting alcohol.

24579.name: bag of raw steppe cookware materials
24579.description: bags of raw steppe cookware materials
24579.col_2: Unsorted and unrefined materials from the Azim Steppe that you are assured can be used to create the necessary components for cooking authentic buuz.

24580.name: set of raw tavern furnishing materials
24580.description: sets of raw tavern furnishing materials
24580.col_2: Unsorted and unrefined materials that look as if they could be used to create stylish furnishings─if you squint.

24581.name: bag of raw steppe brewing materials
24581.description: bags of raw steppe brewing materials
24581.col_2: Unsorted and unrefined materials that you are assured can be used to assemble the necessary components for brewing arkhi.

24587.name: true blue attire coffer (IL 1)
24587.col_2: A banded chest containing a complete set of true blue attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

24588.name: magus's attire coffer (IL 130)
24588.col_2: A banded chest containing a complete set of magus's attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 50. IL: 130. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

24589.name: aetheryte earring
24589.col_2: Increases EXP earned by 30% when level 70 and below. Attributes and item level vary according to class/job and current level when equipped.

24601.name: pair of Far Eastern schoolboy's zori
24601.description: pairs of Far Eastern schoolboy's zori

24604.name: pair of Far Eastern schoolgirl's boots
24604.description: pairs of Far Eastern schoolgirl's boots

24617.name: set of Ananta metalworks
24617.col_2: A number of beautifully detailed, opulent golden vessels created in honor of Sri Lakshmi.

24618.name: Kojin material supplier permit
24618.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Kojin material suppliers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

24619.name: Kojin junkmonger permit
24619.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Kojin junkmongers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

24620.name: Kojin mender permit
24620.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Kojin menders on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

24621.name: Kojin manservant permit
24621.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Kojin manservants on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

24622.name: maxima roader identification key
24622.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your maxima roader will bring it roaring terrifyingly to life.

24623.name: hallowed kamuy fife
24623.col_2: The solemn song of this stout flute is said to summon a kamuy blessed by Lord Seiryu himself.

24624.name: Regalia Type-G title
24624.col_2: A deed certifying your ownership of a brand-new vehicle, embossed with the Regalia crest as a symbol of authenticity.

24625.name: fabled kamuy fife
24625.col_2: The lonely song of this stout flute is said to summon a long-lived auspice─Kamuy of the Nine Tails─rarely glimpsed by mortal eyes.

24626.name: Demi-Ozma
24626.col_2: This conveniently sized result of experimentation on the part of the Students of Baldesion may not be entirely stable enough to safely ride─but there's only one way to find out.

24627.name: magicked carpet
24627.col_2: With but a few magic words, this carpet will bear you upward to a whole new world─or at least a more elevated one.

24628.name: Sabotender Emperador horn
24628.col_2: This eccentric horn emits a thunderous toot that summons the Sabotender Emperador.

24629.name: war tiger horn
24629.col_2: This curved horn emits a roaring tone that summons your war tiger.

24630.name: Eurekan petrel horn
24630.col_2: A delicate shell horn that summons the beautiful and dangerous gastropod known as the Eurekan petrel.

24631.name: magitek avenger A1 identification key
24631.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your magitek avenger A1 will magically bring the machine to life.

24632.name: wind-up Fran
24632.col_2: Stilettos guaranteed not to impede progress through markedly rough terrain such as jungles, bogs, and abandoned monasteries serving as prisons for extra-dimensional forces of evil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Fran minion.

24633.name: wind-up Nu Mou
24633.col_2: So cuddlesome it hurts.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Nu Mou minion.

24634.name: Seitei
24634.col_2: Dragon-ness is in the eye of the beholder.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Seitei minion.

24635.name: Conditional Virtue
24635.col_2: Cuddle not to dullness; coddle not to elevation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Conditional Virtue minion.

24636.name: minitek conveyor
24636.col_2: The latest in miniature transport technology.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the minitek conveyor minion.

24637.name: wind-up Qalyana
24637.col_2: She may or may not break through the borderline.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Qalyana minion.

24638.name: wind-up Redback
24638.col_2: Don't tell mom the Kojin minion's red.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Redback minion.

24639.name: wind-up weapon
24639.col_2: Somewhat buggy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up weapon minion.

24640.name: yukinko snowflake
24640.col_2: Falling, falling, falling, falling, falling...falling on his head.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the yukinko snowflake minion.

24641.name: dress-up Tataru
24641.col_2: Say what you will─she wears it well.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the dress-up Tataru minion.

24642.name: baby gremlin
24642.col_2: Feeding after midnight may result in injury. Yours.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the baby gremlin minion.

24644.col_2: Eureka gear.<hex:02100103>※Weapon appearance may take precedence over the display of hand gear.

24797.name: Seiryu totem
24797.col_2: This wooden idol carved in the likeness of the auspice Seiryu was likely created by a devout islander in days long gone by.

24798.name: Mullondeis coin
24798.col_2: A small gold coin stamped with what you assume to be Mullonde's mint mark. Once considered to be of great historical significance, a sudden influx caused their value to plummet, rendering them almost worthless.

24799.name: set of Seiryu barding
24799.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Far Eastern auspice Seiryu.

24800.name: set of Yojimbo barding
24800.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the...colorful...bodyguard known to some as “Jim.”

24801.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Lexen-tails<hex:021A020103>
24801.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for imitating the Lexentale siblings' signature stage-ready styles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.

24802.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Lucian Locks<hex:021A020103>
24802.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques on becoming a suitably windswept protagonist.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to Hrothgar.

24803.name: Seiryu's scale
24803.col_2: A shimmering scale that once protected the body of the most venerable serpentine auspice.

24804.name: bolt of waterproof cloth
24804.col_2: This durable fabric is backed with a layer of rubber, making it far less permeable to water than typical garment materials.

24805.name: peerless Clan mark log
24805.col_2: A list of highly elite marks documented by the log's owner. Said owner may never have slain the marks, but he did achieve a remarkable level of detail in his entries─by unabashedly hiding in the bushes to observe the grisly deaths met by his fellow hunters. Though such documents were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

24806.name: crystalline scale
24806.col_2: A beautifully faceted scale that fell from the back of the Provenance Watcher.

24807.name: Hydatos crystal
24807.col_2: A crystal discovered in Eureka Hydatos─a region where the elemental aspect leans heavily to water.

24808.name: Eureka fragment
24808.col_2: Surprisingly heavy for its size, this cube contains a small portion of the aether that comprises the primal Eureka itself.

24809.name: obscure logogram
24809.col_2: Crystallized memory that likely contains knowledge of arts so specialized or ill-advised as to have been kept hidden from all but a select few.

24810.name: wisdom of the Breathtaker
24810.col_2: Crystallized memory that once belonged to a fleet-footed assassin of uncommon ingenuity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only available for use in the Forbidden Land, Eureka.

24811.name: Eagle Eye Shot L
24811.col_2: Crystallized memory of an esoteric technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only available for use in the Forbidden Land, Eureka.

24812.name: Double Edge L

24815.name: cryptic seal
24815.col_2: A small statuette engraved with inscrutable ancient pictographs.

24816.name: bolt of damascene cloth
24816.col_2: This cloth was woven using a long and complicated process. It is a traditional fabric from the south of Othard.

24817.name: Molech's horn
24817.col_2: A hulking horn that once adorned the head of the cruel Molech.

24818.name: Goldemar's horn
24818.col_2: As part of his efforts to project a sense of economic might, King Goldemar had even his own horns opulently engraved─not that it will do him much good now that you have torn this one from his head.

24819.name: Ceto's claw
24819.col_2: This was once the pointiest point on one of Ceto's lethally sharp appendages. Handle with care.

24820.name: aethertight flask
24820.col_2: An utterly impermeable vessel of Sharlayan design, created for the purpose of securely storing experimental alchemical concoctions.

24833.name: pair of replica Pyros knuckles
24833.col_2: ※Weapon appearance may take precedence over the display of hand gear.

24848.name: Hydatos lockbox
24848.col_2: A firmly sealed box discovered deep in the Hydatos wilds. Only a skilled picker of locks might grant you access to the treasure within.

24849.name: moisture-warped lockbox
24849.col_2: A firmly sealed box discovered deep in the Hydatos wilds, its shape made irregular by prolonged exposure to the elements. Only a skilled picker of locks might grant you access to the treasure within.

24881.col_2: A queen among Ala Mhigan ribbons, and lady of the waters of the Arms of Meed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

24882.name: the Vegetarian
24882.col_2: Fisher legend has there was once a mighty liopleurodon who, unsatisfied with a diet of Namazu, is said to have set its sights on plumper prey─namely a portly Lalafellin regent with a penchant for skinny dipping in the warm waters near Hells' Lid. However, the fish quickly learned the limits of its maw's gape, and crestfallen, abandoned the king, a crown-shaped scar on its upper lip its only prize. But rather than sulk, this beast from the deep spent the rest of its life devouring creatures far larger than it, and now, five thousand summers later, the descendant of that legendary pioneer polishes off Plainsfolk like they were popotoes, proving once and for all...life truly does find a way.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

24887.name: hermit's end

24888.name: Suiten Ippeki
24888.col_2: A king among lordly salmon, and lord of the waters near the mercantile docks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

24889.name: Axelrod
24889.col_2: A king among Yanxian barramundi, and lord of the waters of the One River (east).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

24990.name: xenacanthus
24990.col_2: This massive predator has haunted the nightmares of Gyr Abanians for generations as the legendary “impaler of Timmon Beck,” thanks to its centuries-old legacy of terrorizing smallfolk attempting to do their washing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

24991.name: drepanaspis
24991.col_2: Perhaps the greatest catch to be found at Grymm & Enid, the drepanaspis is so rare that, until now, no one was sure that one <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> be found at Grymm & Enid.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

24992.name: stethacanthus

24993.name: the Ruby Dragon
24993.col_2: This legendary king of the deep is known to all who have ever come near the Ruby Price─and yes, it is a <hex:021A020203>dragon<hex:021A020103>. Or at least it quite closely resembles one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

24994.name: Warden of the Seven Hues

24995.name: the Unconditional

As such, this catch might be best left unboasted of.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

26553.name: revised survival manual
26553.col_2: This comprehensive manual on survival techniques─now entirely rendered in modern languages and free of lacunae─contains knowledge amassed over centuries by trackers, hunters, and woodsmen. It is known to inspire all who read it, granting a temporary 150% boost to experience points earned from gathering activities (up to a maximum of 2,000,000 points). Effect is halved at level 80 and above.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 18 hours

26744.name: timeworn gliderskin map
26744.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 11 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 80 recommended.

26745.name: timeworn zonureskin map
26745.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 12 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 80 full party (eight players) recommended.

26746.name: eighteyes eel
26746.col_2: Named for the markings that run down each side of its head, although its circular maw lined with serrated teeth is perhaps more worthy of attention.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

26747.name: creamy oyster
26747.col_2: While the texture of many species of oyster could be described as “creamy,” there is only one specifically named for this quality.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

26748.name: brightmirror clam
26748.col_2: These rare bivalve mollusks are harvested more for their shells than for their meat, as the inner nacre can be used as a form of naturally occurring mirror.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

26749.name: Amber monkfish
26749.col_2: Fish can adapt to the most unlikely of environments, as this repulsive sand-dweller amply proves. It spends most of its adult life burrowing through the sands of Amh Araeng searching for moisture and snaring unsuspecting prey in its fearsome jaws.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

26750.name: calico trout
26750.col_2: The beautiful markings and coloration of this elusive species are known to cause pangs of guilt in those who catch one, shortly before they bash it over the head and gut it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

26751.name: prospero eel
26751.col_2: This species native to the Tempest is believed by locals to possess the ability to control the elements using some form of innate magic. This may, however, be no more than a ruse invented by the Ondo to keep intruders out of their waters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

26752.name: animal trace
26752.col_2: Will this specimen yield a breakthrough in the search for the samiel? Only time and effort will tell...

26753.name: pile of animal droppings
26753.col_2: “A steaming, fly-ridden pile of excrement is a veritable repository of knowledge.”<hex:02100103>─Qeshi-Rae

26754.name: pile of megafauna leftovers
26754.col_2: Whatever bit into this plant part can only be described as massive.

26755.name: megafauna trace
26755.col_2: The possibility cannot be denied: something massive this way came.

26756.name: shred of ancient animal skin
26756.col_2: Shed by what is believed to be an ancient creature, this shred of skin may well shed light on the samiel.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

26757.name: handful of black aethersand
26757.col_2: This aetherially charged sand is a key ingredient in the preparation of glamour dispellers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

26778.name: fae gwiber trumpet
26778.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons an elusive fae gwiber from its hiding place.

26779.name: skyslipper key
26779.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your skyslipper will activate the curious vehicle's propulsion unit.

26780.name: triceratops horn
26780.col_2: A rough-hewn horn of petrified bone that, when blown, emits a somber tone that summons a lumbering triceratops.

26781.name: ironfrog mover ignition key
26781.col_2: Inserting this small piece of painted iron will ignite the internal propulsion furnace of your dwarven ironfrog mover.

26782.name: magicked bed
26782.col_2: This flying furnishing eliminates the need to get up in the morning─or ever. Modern magic put to good use at last!

26783.name: innocent gwiber trumpet
26783.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons a light-touched innocent gwiber from its refuge.

26784.name: Circus resonator
26784.col_2: A metal tuning fork that, when struck, emits an almost comically eerie tone which opens a temporary rift in the void, allowing your Circus ahriman to pass through to this plane.

26785.name: brave new Y'shtola
26785.col_2: Not wont to run from her troubles─and couldn't get very far, anyway.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the brave new Y'shtola minion.

26786.name: wind-up Ryne
26786.col_2: Not merely a palette swap.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Ryne minion.

26787.name: black hayate
26787.col_2: Gaze upon the visage of a ruthless killer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the black hayate minion.

26788.name: chameleon
26788.col_2: Marvel as it melts into your surrounds...and then panic as you realize you cannot find it again.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the chameleon minion.

26789.name: wind-up Fuath
26789.col_2: Markedly less murderous than the real thing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Fuath minion.

26790.name: armadillo bowler
26790.col_2: Possessed of a superior sense of balance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the armadillo bowler minion.

26791.name: the Great Serpent of Ronka
26791.col_2: Tremble, child of man, for a creature of purest divinity wiggleth before thee.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Great Serpent of Ronka minion.

26792.name: micro gigantender
26792.col_2: Is it small or is it big? You be the judge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the micro gigantender minion.

26793.name: clionid larva
26793.col_2: Small on size but massive on appetite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the clionid larva minion.

26794.name: bitty duckbill
26794.col_2: Do not attempt to put on your feet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bitty duckbill minion.

26795.name: Eden Minor
26795.col_2: Free of sin, though not for lack of trying.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Eden Minor minion.

26796.name: giant beaver
26796.col_2: A mystery better left unsolved.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the giant beaver minion.

26797.name: wind-up Suzaku
26797.col_2: Complete with her flute and her senses.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Suzaku minion.

26798.name: wind-up Omega-M
26798.col_2: Irrational behavior detected. Further observation required.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Omega-M minion.

26799.name: wind-up Omega-F
26799.col_2: Combat role allocation test initiated. Analyzing...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Omega-F minion.

26800.name: tinker's bell
26800.col_2: Said to be named for a pixie...unless you ask the pixies, who adamantly deny that any of their kind would ever have borne such a ludicrous name.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tinker's bell minion.

26801.name: tiny echevore
26801.col_2: Its tail tastes like nectar...but you wouldn't know such things.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny echevore minion.

26802.name: sharksucker-class insubmersible
26802.col_2: Warning: do not immerse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the sharksucker-class insubmersible minion.

26803.name: shoebill
26803.col_2: An unflappable bird possessed of a regal air...or perhaps simply a condescending one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the shoebill minion.

27231.name: old pumpkin cookie MMXIX
27231.col_2: A devilish─though, admittedly, industrious─imp is thought to have made this slightly burnt biscuit shaped like a pumpkin head. One can only wonder what ingredients it contains, but as the people of Eorzea have been consuming these for years now with no ill effects beyond mild disappointment, they're probably not <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> horrific.

27232.name: pair of metal gauntlets
27232.col_2: A pair of sturdy-yet-flexible gauntlets, designed to protect the hands from amaro bites.

27233.name: metal worm jar
27233.col_2: A metal jar designed to keep worms fresh.

27234.name: metal trident
27234.col_2: A fearsome metal weapon ending in three deadly looking spikes.

27235.name: nullifying neckpiece
27235.col_2: An amulet imbued with magic-resisting properties.

27237.name: intricate censer
27237.col_2: A solid metal censer of exquisite design.

27238.col_2: A set of materials needed to forge an enchanting ring.

27239.name: enchanting ring
27239.col_2: This finely wrought ring gleams with an almost sorcerous sheen.

27240.name: set of canvas repair materials
27240.col_2: Materials for repairing the canvas of the painting of Dampsole, Lakeland.

27241.name: set of upholstery repair materials
27241.col_2: Materials for repairing the upholstery of the Voeburtite jewelry box.

27242.name: set of amaro barding repair materials
27242.description: sets of amaro barding repair materials
27242.col_2: Materials for repairing the inner lining of the antique amaro barding.

27243.name: set of lute repair materials
27243.col_2: Materials for repairing Harig's broken lute.

27244.name: set of workshop sign materials
27244.col_2: Materials for crafting the sign for Cherished Memories.

27245.name: workshop sign
27245.col_2: The sign for Cherished Memories, masterfully crafted by your good self.

27246.name: set of lute modification component materials
27246.description: sets of lute modification component materials
27246.col_2: Materials for crafting the modification component for Harig's lute.

27247.name: lute modification component
27247.col_2: The modification component that you hope will make Harig's lute sing as it once did.

27248.name: bowl of edible antidote
27248.col_2: A potent medicinal concoction mixed into a vegetable purée catering to amaro sensibilities.

27249.name: bowl of nutrient-rich porridge
27249.col_2: Wholesome and easily digestible food for delicate amaro stomachs.

27250.name: bowl of fortifying soup
27250.col_2: A comforting and invigorating vegetable and herb medley sure to have a restorative effect on both body and soul.

27251.name: serving of Berube feed
27251.col_2: This dish of assorted greens will be instantly recognizable to any Berube skipper as the feed it was raised on.

27252.name: sack of sweets ingredients
27252.col_2: Assorted ingredients for the preparation of desserts that will please the fae─such as sugar, sugar, and more sugar.

27253.name: offering of sweets
27253.col_2: A variety of colorful confections to excite and delight the fae.

27254.name: sack of Zun culinary components
27254.col_2: Assorted ingredients for the traditional amaro feed used by the Zun.

27255.name: serving of Zun-style amaro feed
27255.col_2: The traditional nutritious feed used by the Zun in raising healthy and happy amaro.

27268.name: walnut interior wall
27268.col_2: A rustic interior wall of simple wooden boards.

27269.name: unit of brick flooring
27269.col_2: Flooring of evenly laid red brick that calls to mind urban spaces.

27270.name: Crystarium chandelier
27270.col_2: A bright and elegant ceiling light identical to those found throughout the Crystarium.

27271.name: lily floor lamp
27271.col_2: This elegant lamp, its natural motifs rendered in polished and painted metal and glass, will make a master of white magic feel right at home.

27272.name: lily wall lamp
27272.col_2: The reason that the sight of one of these warmly glowing light fixtures puts those with a penchant for healing so very much at ease will ever remain a mystery to people not versed in the secrets of white magic.

27273.name: marble arch partition
27273.col_2: A large white partition with a marble-carved arch creating a portal through the center.

27274.name: simple curtain
27274.col_2: A yellow curtain gathered with a polished wooden fastener.

27276.name: butterfly specimen
27276.col_2: One of Il Mheg's many brilliant butterflies, mounted for display.

27277.name: grocery bag
27277.col_2: All manner of foodstuffs could be inside this plain brown shopping bag. ...Hopefully they did not require refrigeration.

27278.name: box of hunting supplies
27278.col_2: The requisite weapons and traps for a foray into the wilds.

27279.name: war chest
27279.col_2: The requisite defensive and offensive accoutrements for combat.

27280.name: imitation stained crystal pane
27280.col_2: Though this is neither real crystal nor a real windowpane, the rear lighting makes it appear sumptuous all the same.

27281.name: marble partition
27281.col_2: A cream-colored partition with a white marble baseboard.

27282.name: Crystarium bench
27282.col_2: A wrought-iron seat identical to those found throughout the Crystarium.

27283.name: potted orange tree
27283.col_2: A small citrus tree in an elegant wrought-iron vessel.

27284.name: Crystarium stove
27284.col_2: A warmly glowing iron kitchen stove.

27285.name: Crystarium kitchen hanger
27285.col_2: This wall-mounted hanger provides easy access to pots and pans for use in cooking or punctuating one's statements with loud clanging noises.

27286.name: Crystarium teapot
27286.col_2: This metal teapot comes with a serving tray, cup, and jar of tea leaves for your convenience.

27287.name: ruby crystal boule
27287.col_2: A mounted sample of the luminous red crystals that grow uninhibited on the sea floor.

27288.name: Crystarium wall chronometer
27288.col_2: Rather unfortunately for those attempting to get anywhere on time, this chronometer features a mesmerizing pattern and pendulum.

27289.name: Moonfire Faire MMXVIII advertisement
27289.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course.

27290.name: All Saints' Wake MMXV advertisement
27290.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the fantastical sorcery and spooks of All Saints' Wake.

27291.name: Crystarium mechanical till
27291.col_2: A convenient clockwork contraption for the counting and keeping of currency.

27292.name: stuffed Fuath
27292.col_2: The manufacturer of this plush toy assures you that the gleam in its button eye is “mischievous” rather than “murderous.”

27293.name: set of antique vessels
27293.col_2: These remarkably well-preserved vessels, retrieved from their lengthy slumber on the sea floor, probably belong in a museum. Oh well.

27294.name: decadent fruit platter
27294.col_2: A branching golden vessel harboring enough fruit to feed two Crystarium families or one Eulmoran hedonist for several days.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)
