28116.name: morbol horn
28116.col_2: This horn of bone emits a deep tone (and a retch-inducing odor) that will bring your morbol undulating to your side.

28117.name: portly porxie horn
28117.col_2: Wrought of clay, this horn emits a mellow sound and the aroma of cured meats to lure your portly porxie to your side.

28118.name: Epimetheus identification key
28118.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Epimetheus will bring the machine roaring alarmingly to life.

28119.name: Menoetius identification key
28119.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Menoetius will bring the machine roaring alarmingly to life. (Manufacturer not responsible for any acts of hubris committed by this vehicle or its operator.)

28120.name: Construct VII core
28120.col_2: Rumors that this core and the mechanical golem it activates are heavily based on an Ivalician design are entirely unfounded. Well, almost.

28121.name: shadow gwiber trumpet
28121.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons a dark-touched shadow gwiber from its refuge.

28122.name: spriggan stonecarrier horn
28122.col_2: The plangent honking of this horn summons your spriggan stonecarrier, eager to hoist you aloft and scamper away.

28123.name: forgiven reticence horn
28123.col_2: Thrumming with the power of Light, this horn emits a muted sound that summons forth your forgiven reticence.

28124.name: dhalmel whistle
28124.col_2: This appropriately lengthy wind pipe calls a dhalmel loping to your side.

28125.name: albino karakul horn
28125.col_2: This horn of carved...horn emits a tone to which your albino karakul is well attuned.

28126.name: Eulmoran inner wall
28126.col_2: A deep scarlet interior wall with a slightly rough texture for those estate owners who wish to recreate the opulence of Eulmore.

28127.name: unit of Eulmoran marble flooring
28127.col_2: Smooth, elegant floor tiling made of deep green marble.

28128.name: Eulmoran chandelier
28128.col_2: A bright and elegant ceiling light identical to those found throughout Eulmore.

28129.name: Starlight goobbue wreath
28129.col_2: A stuffed goobbue sits within a festive wreath, its mouth agape, ready to devour your soul.

28131.name: indoor oriental garden
28131.col_2: A miniaturized version of a traditional Far Eastern garden, complete with stone bridge, bamboo, and deer scarer.

28132.name: oriental chawan-mushi lunch
28132.col_2: A piping hot bowl of the classic Far Eastern dish, with a wealth of vegetables and other delicious ingredients hiding within the egg custard.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28133.name: oasis wall-mounted fountain
28133.col_2: A wall-mounted fountain that sends water tumbling into the decorative dish below, reminiscent of the desert abodes found throughout Thanalan.

28134.name: flooring mat
28134.col_2: A large, square mat made from long wooden planks, perfect for decorating interior floors. It can be dyed in a variety of colors to match any sort of décor.

28136.name: golden ewer
28136.col_2: A decorative metallic ewer that will bring a touch of decadence to any interior.

28137.name: set of dishware
28137.col_2: A full set of dishes, washed and all.

28139.name: imitation long window
28139.col_2: Its size and ability to illuminate your abode despite merely being mounted on your wall are sure to impress your guests.

28140.name: imposing Ishgardian shelf
28140.col_2: An exceedingly large frame that is so heavy it must be placed on the floor, rather than mounted on a wall. It features a striking image of Ishgard, so true to life that you can almost feel an icy chill exuding from the painting.

28141.name: stuffed Hraesvelgr
28141.col_2: As few homeowners have the space to accommodate a member of the first brood, this stuffed version of Hraesvelgr has been created especially for those who enjoy the sensation of an ancient dragon observing their every move.

28142.name: pair of misplaced mog slippers
28142.col_2: These delightful slippers can be placed─or misplaced─almost anywhere inside your home, allowing you to enjoy gazing at a prize pair of pom-poms whenever you please.

28143.name: basket of flowers
28143.col_2: A simple basket of blooms that will work wonders in brightening up your home, despite not requiring a great deal of space.

28144.name: Hades trophy
28144.col_2: An ominous reminder of an unforgettable encounter with Hades, featuring a hefty base and ever-ominous purple aura.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

28145.name: ale tap
28145.col_2: Despite being able to be placed on top of almost any interior surface, it is capable of producing a stream of delicious ale whenever you please.

28146.name: Allagan tomestone of frivolity
28146.col_2: While this particular tomestone does not appear to have any function whatsoever, it does add a dash of Allagan style to your interior. Be careful where you place it, however, as it will be even more useless if you accidentally step on it.

28147.name: tabletop hat stand
28147.col_2: Comes complete with its own orange, wide-brimmed hat, which unfortunately appears to be stuck to the stand with rather strong adhesive.

28148.name: vanity mirror
28148.col_2: This gold-framed mirror reflects your true self. Your true self apparently glows in a rather unsettling fashion.

28149.name: necklace display stand
28149.col_2: This stand can be placed on almost any surface, though it is only capable of displaying one type of necklace, which cannot be removed.

28150.name: pile of empty boxes
28150.col_2: Though they take up rather a lot of floor space, this pile of boxes gives the impression that you have a host of admirers willing to shower you with gifts─which is surely more than worth the increased difficulty of walking through your home.

28151.name: set of liquor bottles
28151.col_2: Having a comprehensive selection of unopened drinks is a sign of good taste and restraint. These seven bottles of varying colors and sizes will add a touch of class wherever you place them, except for beside your bed, perhaps.

28152.name: Starlight Celebration MMXVIII advertisement
28152.col_2: A commissioned painting which depicts the Starlight Celebration choir and their delighted audience.

28153.name: Starlight roll cake
28153.col_2: Two cream-filled sponge cakes complete with strawberries on top. While it may not be the most obvious choice for a festive treat, the color scheme certainly conjures up images of the Starlight Celebration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28154.name: log partition
28154.col_2: A partition designed in the style of a rustic cottage, reaching to the ceiling and so sturdy it may as well be a wall.

28155.name: stuffed giant beaver
28155.col_2: While not quite as gigantic as an actual giant beaver, its blank expression is equally disconcerting.

28156.name: stuffed porxie
28156.col_2: Although porxies are generally created from animated clay, and are akin to porcelain, this stuffed version is somehow far more rigid.

28157.name: handmade akabeko
28157.col_2: The year of the ox simply would be incomplete without a pair of nodding cattle in every home. May their nodding never cease, even after their appointed year comes to an end.

28158.name: chocolate fountain
28158.col_2: Complete with a range of fruit and other sweet treats. Just try not to get any chocolate on the upholstery.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28161.name: cedar tree
28161.col_2: A towering cedar tree that retains its vibrant green throughout the year.

28175.name: bag of campanula seeds
28175.col_2: These seeds grow into what are commonly known as “bellflowers,” which are said to be edible. Good to know if one were to find oneself with a lack of victuals but an abundance of these dainty blooms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

28181.col_2: A bunch of purple campanulas, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28182.col_2: A bunch of white campanulas, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28183.name: bouquet of black campanulas
28183.col_2: A bunch of black campanulas, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28184.name: rainbow campanula bouquet
28184.col_2: A bunch of multicolored campanulas, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28189.name: Laxan inkhorn
28189.col_2: A spiral-shaped mollusk that secretes a bizarre purple liquid.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28190.name: White Oil perch
28190.col_2: A docile freshwater wavekin that inhabits the plunge pool of White Oil Falls.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28191.name: faeshine clam
28191.col_2: This bivalve mollusk is believed to have been granted its pearlescent sheen by the pixies themselves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28192.name: Areng dire
28192.col_2: Those with the bravery to face its snapping jaws and the strength to prise open its thick shell are rewarded with a highly nutritious meal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

28193.name: Kholusian king crab
28193.col_2: Though few can deny its exquisite taste when cooked, some may feel that this species is rather lacking in king-like qualities.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

28194.name: flyer printing set
28194.col_2: Contains almost everything needed to make several bundles of flyers. Elbow grease not included.

28195.name: Kholusian cuisine set
28195.col_2: Contains all the seasonings, condiments, and utensils needed to produce a range of hearty, yet affordable, dishes. Meat of questionable origin, popotoes, and general greenery sold separately.

28196.name: case of honeybee trappings
28196.col_2: There are enough sequins, spangly things, and assorted frippery here to turn even the plainest of scullery maids into a dazzling songbird. Provided that she can actually sing, that is.

28197.name: crate of airship fittings
28197.col_2: To decorate an airship to the exacting standards of Eulmoran high society, only the finest of handcrafted ornamentation using the most opulent of materials will suffice. Provided that no one looks too closely, the contents of this crate should pass muster.

28198.name: Beehive souvenir
28198.col_2: These delightful trinkets serve as perfect conversation pieces, though the designs vary significantly depending on what random odds and ends happened to be available at the time of creation.

28199.name: lump of raven coal
28199.col_2: Once the dense coal has been ground into powder and mixed with water, it can be used as a substitute for ink. Be sure to keep it away from white clothing, as the stains are a bugger to get out.

28200.name: assortment of Amh Araeng seasonings
28200.col_2: This selection of rare varieties of salt and spices native to Amh Araeng can be used to add a dash of elegance and a pinch of class to even the most unappetizing of dishes.

28201.name: selection of clinquant stones
28201.col_2: Every region of Norvrandt is, for some reason, blessed with an astonishing variety of glittering, shimmering, sparkling, and otherwise shiny stones. Il Mheg is no exception, as is amply demonstrated by these fine specimens.

28202.name: assortment of airship fitting components
28202.col_2: In the hands of an artisan, these bits and pieces gathered from around Amh Araeng will eventually become the decorations used to adorn Eulmore's fleet of airships. In fact, it took another sort of artisan to even find them in the first place, having been forced to separate the proverbial wheat from the chaff in some of the desert's most perilous locations.

28203.name: package of Kholusian miscellany
28203.col_2: While not everything included in this assortment of locally sourced materials could be considered valuable, the various items combine to convey the very essence of Kholusia. This could, however, be attributed to the pungent oceanic odor they all seem to share.

28204.name: box of flyer printing materials
28204.col_2: Perhaps one day, these humble materials will fulfill their dream of being turned into flyers to advertise Eulmore's finest drinking and ogling establishment. With your help, this dream may very well come true.

28205.name: package of Kholusian cuisine paraphernalia
28205.col_2: An artisan's touch is required to turn this hodgepodge into something the Beehive's kitchen staff can use to produce its reasonably priced and reasonably tasty fare.

28206.name: bundle of honeybee trappings materials
28206.col_2: As sparkly and fabulous as these assorted materials may be, they have a long way to go before they can be added to the costume worn by the Beehive's songstress.

28207.name: assortment of airship fitting materials
28207.col_2: Few could envision that these rather uninspiring objects will eventually be soaring gracefully through the skies. Strictly speaking, it will be the airship to which they are attached that will be doing the flying, but it still counts.

28208.name: bag of Beehive souvenir materials
28208.col_2: As anyone who has had the dubious pleasure of visiting a seaside tourist trap can attest, the majority of the souvenirs sold are made from cheap and readily available materials, often found washed up on the shore along with the driftwood and dead jellyfish. The contents of this bag are─as is tradition─of similar ilk, clearly indicated by the dried seaweed with which most of the items are covered.

28613.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Feigning Fatigue<hex:021A020103>
28613.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to avoid the unwanted attention of would-be suitors, overbearing great-aunts, and other such dullards by pretending to have been overcome by a sudden bout of giddiness. Use to learn the /headache emote.

28614.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Cosmetics - A Wicked Wake<hex:021A020103>
28614.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Cosmetics - A Wicked Wake<hex:021A020103>
28614.col_2: The realm's premier publication on cosmetics─as well as dating advice and, for some reason, politics─this copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Cosmetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for painting an appropriately spooky All Saints' Wake pattern on one's cheek.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock new face paint at the aesthetician.

28615.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Modern Legend<hex:021A020103>
28615.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques on styling oneself to resemble the hero of the world's oldest fable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.

28616.name: set of Hades barding
28616.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to commemorate Hades.

28617.name: set of saintly barding
28617.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to spread festive cheer.

28618.name: bacon bits
28618.col_2: Tastes like bacon...if bacon and clay taste the same to you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bacon bits minion.

28619.name: wind-up pixie
28619.col_2: Won't make mischief at your expense─pixie's honor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up pixie minion.

28620.name: mystic weapon
28620.col_2: Only slightly cursed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mystic weapon minion.

28621.name: meerkat
28621.col_2: Keeps an eye out for danger while basking in the sun.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the meerkat minion.

28622.name: miniature white knight
28622.col_2: Aids in the purging of sickness. Or not.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the miniature white knight minion.

28623.name: Cute Justice
28623.col_2: Rocket Punch parts may present a choking hazard. Not for children under the age of two.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Cute Justice minion.

28624.name: domakin
28624.col_2: Close, but not a warrior with the body of a mortal and soul of a dragon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the domakin minion.

28625.name: dress-up Estinien
28625.col_2: Sun-dried squid not included.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the dress-up Estinien minion.

28626.name: little leannan
28626.col_2: Doesn't see you as food. Yet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the little leannan minion.

28627.name: wind-up hobgoblin
28627.col_2: Crafted in the likeness of your mother...or so certain dwarves would say.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up hobgoblin minion.

28628.name: Cerberpup
28628.col_2: With three wet little noses and three sets of adorable staring eyes, what's not to love? Aside from all of the teeth, obviously.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Cerberpup minion.

28629.name: pod 054
28629.col_2: The perfect assistant for adventuring...or it would be, if it worked properly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the pod 054 minion.

28630.name: pod 316
28630.col_2: The perfect assistant for adventuring...or it would be, if it worked properly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the pod 316 minion.

28631.name: fragment of Hades's auracite
28631.col_2: A small chip of the auracite in which Hades was sealed. May you keep it close, and ever remember.

28632.name: manufactured coin
28632.col_2: A dented artifact collected from the Copied Factory. At one time, avid and eccentric collectors would have paid a king's ransom for it, but such numismatic baubles have fallen out of style. Glory to mankind.

28633.name: colossus totem
28633.col_2: This gleaming idol of unknown provenance is carved in the shape of a very, very, very small Alexander.

28634.name: metal spinner
28634.col_2: This particularly clever invention relies on a fish's natural tendency to snag its face on spinning, jagged objects.

28635.name: Greatwood planter
28635.col_2: Botanists would no doubt be fascinated and confused in equal measure by this inexplicably effervescent potted plant.

28636.name: shirt display rack
28636.col_2: The shirts placed upon this shelf are perfectly folded, and woe betide he who disturbs them in the name of trying one on.

28637.name: Lakeland chair
28637.col_2: A chair in the classical elven style.

28638.name: Lakeland table
28638.col_2: A table in the classical elven style.

28639.name: leather sofa
28639.col_2: This sofa is so luxurious that you will never want to get up─and nor will you be able to on those particularly warm days when your skin practically fuses to it.

28640.name: Il Mheg flower lamp
28640.col_2: A softly glowing light fixture crafted to resemble one of the many lovely flowers in the pixies' home.

28641.name: macaron cushion
28641.col_2: A cute cushion designed to resemble a popular pastry.

28642.name: wooden deck
28642.col_2: A large, rectangular section of wooden decking, complete with low fences, flower baskets, and a table laid with tea for two.

28643.name: Whalaqee Revenge Blast totem
28643.col_2: An intricately carved wooden totem imbued with the secrets of a vengeful technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use by blue mages.

28644.name: Whalaqee Angel Whisper totem
28644.col_2: An intricately carved wooden totem imbued with the secrets of a resurrective technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use by blue mages.

28645.name: <hex:021A020203>Nail of the Heavens<hex:021A020103> orchestrion roll
28645.col_2: Music roll for <hex:021A020203>Nail of the Heavens<hex:021A020103>. Use to add to your orchestrion list.
28645.col_3: Nail of the Heavens Orchestrion Roll

28646.name: <hex:021A020203>Imperium<hex:021A020103> orchestrion roll

28648.name: irregular tomestone of soldiery
28648.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains myriad explanations of military tactics and stratagems certain to confound one's enemies with their complexity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

28649.name: certificate of good cheer
28649.col_2: A slip of parchment issued in recognition of efforts toward spreading Starlight spirit.

28650.name: Valentione's Day chocolate MMXX
28650.col_2: A bite-sized piece of rich milk chocolate resembling the coat of arms for House Valentione.

28714.name: alumina whetstone
28714.col_2: A whestone carved from alumina. Used for sharpening metal or stone blades.

28715.name: loop of pliable glass fiber
28715.col_2: This thinly spun glass is remarkably resistant to breakage, even when handled by a particularly clumsy craftsman.

28716.name: lump of sandalwood sap
28716.col_2: A partially congealed ball of sticky sap extracted from a sandalwood tree.

28717.name: chunk of beryllium ore
28717.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing the precious metal beryllium.

28718.name: phial of sublime solution
28718.col_2: Whatever it does, it does it sublimely.

28719.name: sweetmeat mussel
28719.col_2: A variety of mussel with coloring so stygian that it appears almost to have been steeped in shadow. A mussel of darkness, if you will.<hex:02100103>...Become what you mussel.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28720.name: serving of mejillones al ajillo
28720.col_2: A sumptuous serving of delectable mussels smothered in an oily garlic sauce, each one a perfectly bite-sized burst of flavor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28721.name: serving of arros negre
28721.col_2: Though the squid ink makes for an unusual appearance, its contribution to this dish's flavor profile is undeniable─ it blends with several herbs and spices to complement the buttery mussels and hearty rice for an immensely satisfying culinary experience.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28722.name: bottle of Kholusian rain
28722.col_2: A highly concentrated elixir blended on the island of Kholusia.

28723.name: Eulmoran certificate of import
28723.col_2: A note of promise received for the delivery of facet equipment.

28724.name: crafter's delineation
28724.col_2: A detailed outline of complex crafting techniques. One delineation is consumed when using a specialist action.

28725.name: length of skybuilders' plywood
28725.col_2: Sturdy enough to support the weight of several large Roegadyn. Until it isn't.

28726.name: chunk of skybuilders' alloy
28726.col_2: At this stage, it is anyone's guess what this alloy will become. If it is extremely lucky, it may even end up as a door knocker.

28727.name: skybuilders' steel plate
28727.col_2: Unless a skilled blacksmith or armorer can intervene, this steel is doomed to spend eternity as a useless metal square.

28728.name: skybuilders' ingot
28728.col_2: Even the skybuilders themselves are not quite sure what goes into these ingots, although the general consensus is that it is nothing valuable.

28729.name: circle of skybuilders' leather
28729.col_2: Leather made <hex:021A020203>for<hex:021A020103> skybuilders, not <hex:021A020203>from<hex:021A020103> them. Apparently.

28730.name: length of skybuilders' rope
28730.col_2: How long is a length of rope? In this particular rope's case, this long.

28731.name: bottle of skybuilders' ink
28731.col_2: Used for writing in ledgers to keep track of who is owed what. Considering the scale of the Ishgardian restoration, it is expected that a fair few bottles will be exhausted before the work is completed.

28732.name: bottle of skybuilders' hemp milk
28732.col_2: By all accounts, this plant-based milk has a pleasant enough taste, though Ishgardian culinarians have yet to succeed in efforts to turn it into cheese.

28733.name: skybuilders' wain
28733.col_2: Surprisingly maneuverable, even when loaded with bricks and such.

28734.name: handful of skybuilders' nails
28734.col_2: Thankfully, this is a handful of <hex:021A020203>metal<hex:021A020103> nails, not ones grown from the fingers of the skybuilders themselves. That would be far less pleasant.

28735.name: handful of skybuilders' rivets
28735.col_2: Those with a penchant for having little bits of metal sticking out from every surface in sight will be delighted to receive these carefully crafted metal studs.

28736.name: handful of skybuilders' rings
28736.col_2: An object without a clear purpose but will “probably come in handy one day,” as hoarders of useless junk are wont to say.

28737.name: bundle of skybuilders' leather straps
28737.col_2: Can be attached to the handles of tools to allow them to be hung from belts and so forth, though care should be taken while walking to avoid having them flailing around wildly.

28738.name: bolt of skybuilders' cloth
28738.col_2: It seems this cloth is destined to become part of a comfortable couch, or perhaps a nice set of drapes.

28739.name: phial of skybuilders' plant oil
28739.col_2: Used in the preparation of several varieties of Ishgardian cooking and, on some occasions, as a condiment.

28740.name: portion of skybuilders' uncooked pasta
28740.col_2: Uncooked pasta that is perfect for eating during construction. If you like uncooked pasta.

28741.name: skybuilders' barrel
28741.col_2: The expression “a barrel of laughs” was never meant to be taken literally, though if it were, one could fit a fair few in this voluminous wooden container.

28742.name: skybuilders' hammer
28742.col_2: In days to come, this most versatile of tools will become the bane of every nail that dared to stick out. And the occasional thumb.

28743.name: skybuilders' cooking pot
28743.col_2: In times of war, this metallic item of cookware can double as a makeshift helmet, provided the wearer has an unnaturally large head.

28744.name: skybuilders' candelabra
28744.col_2: It almost seems a shame to cover this in layers of melted wax, though sadder still would be a candelabra without a candle.

28745.name: skybuilders' rug
28745.col_2: The eventual owner of this majestic piece of thick cloth will be as snug as a bug in a rug. Or on a rug, to be precise.

28746.name: skybuilders' broom
28746.col_2: As the saying goes, “A new broom sweeps clean,” though the person wielding said broom is also due at least some of the credit for any increase in cleanliness that may result.

28747.name: handful of skybuilders' charcoal
28747.col_2: The recipients of the other items in your inventory would probably prefer that you refrained from carrying loose pieces of charcoal about your person.

28748.name: cup of skybuilders' tea
28748.col_2: As is tradition with tea brewed for builders, it contains enough sugar to make the spoon stand on end.

28749.name: skybuilders' pedestal
28749.col_2: Though one should avoid putting other people on a pedestal, the placement of inanimate objects should not pose any problems.

28750.name: skybuilders' crosscut saw
28750.col_2: It is not only double-edged blades that cut both ways.

28751.name: skybuilders' counter
28751.col_2: Considering that it lacks the ability to count anything whatsoever, “counter” seems to be something of a misnomer.

28752.name: skybuilders' stone
28752.col_2: If the time you have spent in Ishgard has taught you anything, it is that the locals <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> like stone.

28753.name: pair of skybuilders' longboots
28753.col_2: Ideal for leaping from scaffold to scaffold as one merrily frolics about the construction site, while others go about their backbreaking labor.

28754.name: pair of skybuilders' gloves
28754.col_2: Any Ishgardian with any sense will already own a pair of gloves, but for those who do not, these will be a welcome gift.

28755.name: bar of skybuilders' soap
28755.col_2: Be careful to whom you give this. They may think you are trying to tell them something.

28756.name: skybuilders' all-purpose infusion
28756.col_2: Though the recipe states that this mysterious concoction can cure any ailment, one must remember that it will under no circumstances reattach dismembered fingers, which is a remarkably common complaint among the skybuilders.

28757.name: skybuilders' bed
28757.col_2: Children who fail to heed the word of their parents will be sent here without any supper.

28758.name: skybuilders' oven
28758.col_2: In many Ishgardian residences, the oven doubles as a means of heating the house, with the occupants finding themselves subconsciously drawn to the kitchen during the colder months. Which is all of them.

28759.name: skybuilders' lamppost
28759.col_2: Of all the items you have managed to stow about your person, this surely ranks as one of the largest and most cumbersome. Even the most proficient of aetherochemists would be baffled by the unsolved mystery of your impossibly deep pockets.

28760.name: skybuilders' brazier
28760.col_2: Not only can this be used for the cooking of various dishes, it also works wonders in the prevention of frostbite, as many residents of the Brume will attest.

28761.name: set of skybuilders' overalls
28761.col_2: Designed to be worn on top of other layers of clothing to protect them from dust and dirt and provide additional protection against the cold. Since Ishgardians tend to wear several layers of clothing to begin with, these overalls are cut much larger than those worn in warmer climes.

28762.name: skybuilders' waterproof sheet
28762.col_2: Serves to keep out not only water, but wind as well, though the cold inevitably finds a way through eventually.

28763.name: phial of skybuilders' alchemic
28763.col_2: One of many concoctions that serves little purpose on its own, but can be mixed with others for a variety of effects upon consumption, the large majority being some sort of agonizing death.

28764.name: pot of skybuilders' stew
28764.col_2: One unfortunate rail was left to stew in its own juices after finding its way into the pot. Literally.

28765.name: skybuilders' yew log
28765.col_2: The distinct lack of trees is one of many problems the first people to settle in Ishgard chose to ignore, making this otherwise commonplace material─sourced from the East Shroud─extremely valuable.

28766.name: chunk of skybuilders' iron ore
28766.col_2: While this may look much like any other iron ore found in middle La Noscea, there are subtle differences that only an expert in the field will recognize. The name, for one, is considerably longer.

28767.name: pinch of skybuilders' fine sand
28767.col_2: This sand gathered in central Thanalan is not only fine, but extremely well-behaved, choosing to stay in one closely knit lump while jostling alongside the rest of your possessions.

28768.name: tuft of skybuilders' hemp
28768.col_2: Though this hardy plant can grow almost anywhere, the snow-blasted precipices of Ishgard have so far proven too steep a challenge for it to overcome. This particular specimen was harvested in lower La Noscea, an environment far more conducive to plant life─or any sort of life, for that matter.

28769.name: skybuilders' ash log
28769.col_2: Ash! A-Ah! Savior of the Firmament!♪

28770.name: pinch of skybuilders' rock salt
28770.col_2: Although upper La Noscea seems rather a distant location from which to source something as simple as salt, the Ishgardians are nothing if not particular in their tastes.

28771.name: chunk of skybuilders' electrum ore
28771.col_2: The electrum ore found in upper La Noscea is believed to be far better suited to the skybuilders' needs than any other variety. Were anyone to ask them why, they would, in most cases be met with a response along the line of, “Because it just is.”

28772.name: pinch of skybuilders' iron sand
28772.col_2: The tradition of measuring powdered substances in units of “pinches” has been the cause of many arguments, largely due to differences in finger size between the various races. Folk in eastern Thanalan, where this sample was gathered, have been known to ask Lalafells to measure when selling, and Roegadyn when buying, for obvious reasons.

28773.name: clump of skybuilders' flax
28773.col_2: It is a well known fact among botanists that the flax in the South Shroud is superior to every other kind, for reasons far too complicated and boring for anyone else to care about.

28774.name: bottle of skybuilders' spring water
28774.col_2: Having only traveled the relatively short distance from the Coerthas central highlands to Ishgard, this spring water is still remarkably fresh, though the icy chill threatens to freeze it inside the bottle.

28775.name: skybuilders' camphorwood log
28775.col_2: Few members of the mortal races are equipped to make the perilous journey to the Churning Mists, and those who do normally hope to have more than a log or two to show for their troubles.

28776.name: bundle of skybuilders' straw
28776.col_2: Why the skybuilders would specify that their straw be brought from the Dravanian forelands is anyone's guess. Perhaps the smell helps their chocobos sleep more peacefully?

28777.name: chunk of skybuilders' hardsilver ore
28777.col_2: The time spent mining this ore in the Dravanian hinterlands would perhaps have seemed less arduous if you had the faintest idea how the skybuilders plan to use it.

28778.name: pinch of skybuilders' mythrite sand
28778.col_2: You have a sneaking suspicion that you may have lost some of the sand during the return journey from the Sea of Clouds, though the amount you have in your possession should still suffice.

28779.name: basket of skybuilders' tea leaves
28779.col_2: The thought of happy skybuilders drinking delicious tea was the only motivation you needed as you risked life and limb gathering these leaves in the Sea of Clouds.

28780.name: bottle of skybuilders' Dravanian spring water
28780.description: bottles of skybuilders' Dravanian spring water
28780.col_2: There are easier places to collect spring water than the Dravanian forelands, though it seems your personal safety is not especially high on the skybuilders' list of concerns.

28781.name: skybuilders' urunday log
28781.col_2: Compared to most places in Gyr Abania, the Peaks has more than its fair share of trees, so who would object to you taking a few logs? Bloodthirsty Qiqirn and rampaging ruud suuds, that's who. Or perhaps they just see you as an easy meal?

28782.name: chunk of skybuilders' nightsteel ore
28782.col_2: The Ruby Sea is not especially well known as a prime location for mining, though those who are nautically minded can uncover all sorts of rare and unique treasures. Whether the skybuilders choose to turn this into fine jewelry or something more mundane, like a tea strainer, remains to be seen.

28783.name: skybuilders' adder
28783.col_2: Venomous snakes are something of a rarity in Ishgard, so the skybuilders have ordered that some be delivered from the Azim Steppe to help improve morale. Workers displaying a lack of enthusiasm will be given some time in “the pit” to rediscover their commitment to the cause.

28784.name: chunk of skybuilders' molybdenum ore
28784.col_2: While the Lochs are better known as a source of salt, the rich veins of ore are drawing in miners from far and wide.

28785.name: clump of skybuilders' horsetail
28785.col_2: Yanxia is rich in both flora and fauna, and horsetail forms a major part of the diet of many grazing creatures.

28786.name: pinch of skybuilders' Ala Mhigan rock salt
28786.description: pinches of skybuilders' Ala Mhigan rock salt
28786.col_2: When an Ishgardian culinarian stated that her latest dish needed a pinch of salt, the skybuilders sought out the very best, though perhaps more than a single pinch would be required to make the lengthy journey to the Lochs worthwhile.

28787.name: bottle of skybuilders' Ruby Sea water
28787.description: bottles of skybuilders' Ruby Sea water
28787.col_2: While water from the Ruby Sea may not sound particularly appealing, this was actually brought from a small freshwater spring on one of the surrounding islands. Drinking this is unlikely to result in life-threatening dehydration.

28788.name: pinch of skybuilders' durium sand
28788.col_2: A pinch of anything tends not to be an awful lot, though this particular sand from the Azim Steppe is apparently worth more than its weight in gold.

28789.name: skybuilders' vine
28789.col_2: Quite why a particular type of vine that can only be found in the Azim Steppe is necessary to the skybuilders' plans has yet to be explained. Perhaps they are planning to surprise you with a work of surpassing genius? Or perhaps not.

28790.name: skybuilders' white ash log
28790.col_2: Obviously, none of the skybuilders has even heard of the Rak'tika Greatwood, though the specific qualities they seek in their timber can most easily be found in the white ash trees that grow there.

28791.name: chunk of skybuilders' reef rock
28791.col_2: If a porous rock from the bottom of the ocean is required in the rebuilding of Ishgard, then so be it. Your job is to mine, not question the reasoning behind such dubious demands.

28792.name: chunk of skybuilders' truegold ore
28792.col_2: Why submit a boring chunk of gold ore when you can bring one all the way from Il Mheg instead?

28793.name: skybuilders' cotton boll
28793.col_2: This cotton must be very special indeed for you to bring it all the way from Lakeland in the First. You can only hope that the skybuilders appreciate you going the extra malm. And traveling to another world.

28794.name: skybuilders' dawn lizard
28794.col_2: One day, this poor lizard is chasing other, smaller scurrying creatures across the desert plains of Amh Araeng, and the next, it is being transported to another world and dragged lashing and kicking to Ishgard. The chances of the cold-blooded scalekin being content in its frozen new surroundings are slim at best, and you can only hope that the skybuilders are grateful to you for supplying a miserable and motionless lizard.

28795.name: sheaf of skybuilders' wheat
28795.col_2: Were the other contributors to hear that you traveled to Amh Araeng in the First simply to procure wheat, they would think you are just trying to show off.

28796.name: pinch of skybuilders' truegold sand
28796.col_2: The isle of Kholusia is known by the inhabitants of Norvrandt to have the very finest of gold sand. Whether this is up to the impossibly high standards of the skybuilders will only become apparent when it is submitted for inspection.

28797.name: bottle of skybuilders' highland spring water
28797.description: bottles of skybuilders' highland spring water
28797.col_2: Any water gathered from Il Mheg is likely to have been enchanted by either the pixies or the Fuath, though that is a problem for the skybuilders, not you, to worry about.

28798.name: lump of skybuilders' resin
28798.col_2: Thankfully, the resin appears to have suffered no ill effects during your return from the Rak'tika Greatwood, meaning that it is still a gelatinous blob with seemingly no practical application whatsoever.

28904.name: faded copy of <hex:021A020203>Invincible<hex:021A020103>
28904.col_2: Timeworn pages of sheet music containing the full score for Hades's theme, <hex:021A020203>Invincible<hex:021A020103>.

28905.name: circle of shell leather
28905.col_2: A particularly glossy and durable variety of leather, the production of which is no mean feat.

28906.name: Skysteel ingot
28906.col_2: The most advanced technology of the Skysteel Manufactory went into the creation of this block of metal. According to Biggs, equipment made from this material will allow its user to see around corners.

28907.name: circle of Skysteel leather
28907.col_2: The most advanced technology of the Skysteel Manufactory went into the creation of this piece of leather. According to Biggs, equipment made from this material will allow its user to hear sounds before they are made.

28908.name: bolt of Skysteel cloth
28908.col_2: The most advanced technology of the Skysteel Manufactory went into the creation of this bolt of cloth. According to Biggs, equipment made from this material will allow its user to smell a person's thoughts from a malm away.

28909.name: skybuilders' cocoon
28909.col_2: While there seems to be an endless supply of these in Yanxia, why anyone would actually want them is unclear. They have a taste to match their appearance, in other words, revolting.

28910.name: pinch of skybuilders' sea salt
28910.col_2: The ocean depths are dark and full of horrors... But also, rather a good location to harvest salt. Just watch out for the horrors.

28911.name: authentic silver Starlight sentinel
28911.col_2: A potted conifer displayed in homes during the Starlight Celebration. Its snowy color will make your décor sumptuous─and your gatherings lively as you argue with friends and neighbors over whether it is superior to the more traditional green. It is not known how long ago it was placed in its ceramic prison, and some attribute its unnatural longevity to it having formed a blood pact with a voidsent, which may be unlikely considering its distinct lack of blood.

28912.name: basket of authentic Starlight donuts
28912.col_2: Festive treats for those who prefer to express their Starlight spirit through eating until they lose consciousness. While one may be forgiven for mistaking these for leftovers from a previous year, that could not be further from the truth, according to their baker.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +2<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28913.name: authentic evercold Starlight snowman
28913.col_2: This indoor frosty snowman will never melt away. He'll be there forever. Watching. Waiting. Authentically.

28914.name: pile of authentic opened twinkleboxes
28914.col_2: The detritus of many happy Starlight Celebration surprises. They may be empty, but at least they are <hex:021A020203>authentically<hex:021A020103> empty.

28915.name: Scions of the Seventh Dawn reproduction
28915.description: Scions of the Seventh Dawn reproductions
28915.col_2: A large-scale reproduction of the piece entitled “Scions of the Seventh Dawn.”
28915.col_3: Scions of the Seventh Dawn Reproduction

28916.name: skybuilders' toad
28916.col_2: What is worse than being born a toad? Being born a toad and then carried against your wishes from your home in western Thanalan to icy Ishgard, where if you don't freeze to death, are likely to be chopped up and boiled in a pot. That is what is worse. Much worse, in fact.

28917.name: ufiti horn
28917.col_2: A horn that emits a primal sound that summons forth your hulking ufiti.

28918.name: dashing Valentione rose chest
28918.col_2: A banded chest containing a complete set of red Valentione's attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

28921.col_2: A banded chest containing a complete set of red Valentione's attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

28924.name: No.2 Type B materiel storage crate
28924.description: No.2 Type B materiel storage crates
28924.col_2: A manufactured crate containing a full set of No.2 Type B attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1.
28924.col_3: No.2 Type B Materiel Storage Crate

28925.name: the Jaws of Undeath
28925.col_2: A king among vicejaws, and lord of the waters of the Isle of Ken (one notable exception aside).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

28926.name: white Ronso
28926.col_2: A king among zebra catfish, and lord of the waters of lower Watts River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

28927.name: ambling caltrop
28927.col_2: A king among thorned lizards, and lord of the Hills of Amber.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

28928.name: fae rainbow
28928.col_2: A capricious queen among spotted blue-eyes, and lady of the waters of the Jealous One.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28929.name: black jet
28929.col_2: A king among black tri-stars, and lord of the waters of the Lozatl.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28930.name: Ondo sigh
28930.col_2: A king among bubble anglers, and lord of the waters of the Flounders' Floor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28931.name: small angler's canvas
28931.col_2: A tiny blank canvas on which an ink print of some aquatic creature or another might be rendered, complete with frame.

28932.name: medium angler's canvas
28932.col_2: A modest blank canvas on which an ink print of some aquatic creature or another might be rendered, complete with frame.

28933.name: large angler's canvas
28933.col_2: A robust blank canvas on which an ink print of some aquatic creature or another might be rendered, complete with frame.

28934.name: extra large angler's canvas
28934.col_2: An imposing blank canvas on which an ink print of a truly enormous aquatic creature might be rendered, complete with frame.

28937.name: Galadion goby
28937.col_2: Amateur anglers are advised to familiarize themselves with the difference between the Merlthor and Galadion gobies as early as possible, as devotees of both varieties tend to become rather heated when one is (understandably) mistaken for the other.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28938.name: Galadion chovy
28938.col_2: “What makes a Galadion chovy distinct from other Lominsan anchovies?” Depends on who's asking.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

28939.name: rosy bream
28939.col_2: The sunset coloring of these inhabitants of Galadion Bay makes them just as appealing to other predators as to anglers, leaving them somewhat beleaguered as a rule.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

28940.name: tripod fish
28940.col_2: Many a seafarer has lain awake contemplating the cursed knowledge that, as its name implies, this fish can indeed stand on its fins. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

28941.name: sunfly
28941.col_2: A brightly colored fish that swims merrily through the Strait of Merlthor...or did.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

28942.name: tarnished shark
28942.col_2: Like a long-neglected antique, perhaps this shark just needs some love to become the perfect addition to afternoon tea parties. Alas, no one has yet volunteered to be the first to find out.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

28947.name: bag of hyacinth bulbs
28947.col_2: Each bulb is the nascent and substantially more hideous form of the many-flowered hyacinth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

28948.name: bouquet of red hyacinths
28948.col_2: A bunch of red hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28949.name: bouquet of blue hyacinths
28949.col_2: A bunch of blue hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28950.name: bouquet of yellow hyacinths
28950.col_2: A bunch of yellow hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28951.name: bouquet of green hyacinths
28951.col_2: A bunch of green hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28952.name: bouquet of orange hyacinths
28952.col_2: A bunch of orange hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28953.name: bouquet of purple hyacinths
28953.col_2: A bunch of purple hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28954.name: bouquet of white hyacinths
28954.col_2: A bunch of white hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28955.name: bouquet of black hyacinths
28955.col_2: A bunch of black hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28956.name: rainbow hyacinth bouquet
28956.col_2: A bunch of multicolored hyacinths, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

28957.name: set of half-timbered cottage walls
28957.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a quaint mercantile establishment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

28958.name: set of half-timbered house walls
28958.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a quaint mercantile establishment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

28959.name: set of half-timbered mansion walls
28959.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a quaint mercantile establishment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

28960.name: rough stone interior wall
28960.col_2: An imposing interior wall of haphazardly arranged hunks of stone.

28961.name: unit of rough stone flooring
28961.col_2: Unpolished flagstone─for everyone's favorite seedy tavern ambience.

28962.name: wooden chandelier
28962.col_2: Ideal for swinging on with roguish grace─though do try not to burn the place down.

28963.name: moogle round table
28963.col_2: A charmingly rustic wooden table, attended by a trio of musical (though unmoving) moogles.

28964.name: modern mogseat
28964.col_2: Those who sit in this chair may be unable to get up again, but consider─will they really need to?

28965.name: cosmetics box
28965.col_2: This enormous case is replete with enough paints and powders to satisfy an entire Eorzean theater troupe─or one Eulmoran dame.

28966.name: Hatching-tide MMXVIII advertisement
28966.col_2: A cheerful hand-painted notice proclaiming the eggcellence of Hatching-tide.

28967.name: wine rack
28967.col_2: Nice vintage you've got there. Be a shame if someone were to...quaff it.

28968.name: rope stanchion
28968.col_2: A set of velvety ropes for your queue management needs.

28970.name: dish rack
28970.col_2: A spacious box in which to dry dishware, with accompanying mat for glasses.

28971.name: garment rack
28971.col_2: Featuring the latest in Ishgardian fashion...which is generally traditional Ishgardian fashion.

28972.name: Amaurot wall lamp
28972.col_2: A metallic fixture of the sort popular in the Amaurot of Emet-Selch's recollection.

28973.name: manor dressing table
28973.col_2: A haunting dressing table custom-made for Haukke Manor. ...In retrospect, Lady Amandine wasn't very subtle about the whole voidsent issue.

28974.name: cheese collection
28974.col_2: Why in the gods' name would a person amass such an amount of cheese? A peculiar obsession? A craving that transcends all reason? Some manner of cheese-related divination known only to a forbidden sect? Whatever the reason, one can only hope that the results are still saleable.

28975.name: oldrose wall planter
28975.col_2: A riot of vibrant red and pale pink blooms within this quaint wall-mounted box.

28976.name: folded futon
28976.col_2: Put it away─quick, before the guests see!

28977.name: the Bismarck
28977.col_2: Impressive enough to bear the name of Limsa's premier culinary establishment as its own, this is the sort of sandwich one eats off of a <hex:021A020203>nice<hex:021A020103> plate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Tenacity Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28978.name: devil's salad bowl
28978.col_2: A pleasant mix of crisp greens topped by satisfying and zesty deviled eggs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28979.name: portrait of the lord commander
28979.col_2: A commissioned portrait of Ser Aymeric entitled <hex:021A020203>The Scion of House Borel<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

28980.name: golden crystal boule
28980.col_2: A mounted sample of the luminous yellow crystals that grow uninhibited on the sea floor.

28981.name: Cosmos partition
28981.col_2: A partition design to evoke the grandeur and magnificence of the Grand Cosmos.

28982.name: wooden table
28982.col_2: Now there is one less tree in the woods, and one more table in your room.

28983.name: picnic basket
28983.col_2: Includes everything required for a sunlit meal in the outdoors.

28984.name: first chair's trumpet
28984.col_2: Designed in homage to a legendary trumpeter, its majesty may someday inspire someone to finally pick up that instrument they have been meaning to learn.

28985.name: sunflower bouquet
28985.col_2: A bouquet sure to brighten any room it is in.

28986.name: cutting board
28986.col_2: Perfect for cutting all manner of vegetables on. Also suitable for placing already cut vegetables on.

28987.name: open book
28987.col_2: Opened to the page revealing the most impressively wordy words entirely by accident.

28988.name: milk carton
28988.col_2: A paper milk carton, fortunately lacking an illustration of someone's face on the side.

28989.name: portrait of the Azure Dragoon
28989.col_2: A commissioned portrait of Ser Estinien entitled simply <hex:021A020203>Azure<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

28990.name: Cosmos decoration
28990.col_2: Be transported to the majestic Grand Cosmos without stepping foot from your room.

28991.name: used banquet table
28991.col_2: There's no telling how many banquets have been eaten off of this table.

28992.name: Steppe bed
28992.col_2: Sleep as soundly as the nomadic peoples of the Azim Steppe do.

28993.name: stuffed rabbit
28993.col_2: This rabbit looks as if he walked straight out of a storybook, and is prepared to keep on walking. (Please contact authorities immediately in the event that the toy actually demonstrates ambulatory capabilities.)

28994.name: Ruby Weapon bust
28994.col_2: The heart of this Garlond Ironworks scale replica of a select portion of the Ruby Weapon pulsates menacingly. Accept no substitutes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

28995.name: apron rack
28995.col_2: Every literally or figuratively butterfingered chef needs a good apron or two.

28996.name: Eastern stage
28996.col_2: The festivities never need come to an end with this stage adorned with peach blossoms.

28997.name: Little Ladies' Day banner
28997.col_2: A princess needs no crown when this banner exists to always remind them how special they are.

28998.name: Dohn trellis
28998.col_2: Make even the fae jealous with this trellis, designed to evoke the verdant splendor of Dohn Mheg.

28999.name: Lakeland elf tree
28999.col_2: Elf trees are in such high demand that some are grown for the express purpose of being cut down and sold.

29000.name: Lakeland flower garden
29000.col_2: Lakeland's most arresting flowers right in your own home.

29001.name: Ruby totem
29001.col_2: A metallic idol forged in the likeness of the Ruby Weapon.

29020.name: helm of golden antiquity
29020.col_2: A winged helmet forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two helms can be traded for special headgear.

29021.name: suit of armor of golden antiquity
29021.description: suits of armor of golden antiquity
29021.col_2: Emblazoned armor forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four suits can be traded for special body gear.

29022.name: pair of gauntlets of golden antiquity
29022.description: pairs of gauntlets of golden antiquity
29022.col_2: Wrought-iron gauntlets forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special arm gear.

29023.name: pair of chausses of golden antiquity
29023.description: pairs of chausses of golden antiquity
29023.col_2: Heavy chausses forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four pairs can be traded for special leg gear.

29024.name: pair of greaves of golden antiquity
29024.description: pairs of greaves of golden antiquity
29024.col_2: Tarnished greaves forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special foot gear.

29025.name: belt of golden antiquity
29025.col_2: An ornamented belt created by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse. Alas, advancements in trouser technology have rendered it worthless.

29026.name: bangle of golden antiquity
29026.col_2: An extravagant bangle forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One bangle can be traded for a special accessory.

29027.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Book of Fulmination<hex:021A020103>
29027.col_2: A short apocryphal tome presumably created by Eden for recordkeeping purposes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same Eden's Verse apocrypha can be traded for special gear.

29028.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Book of Furor<hex:021A020103>
29028.col_2: A short apocryphal tome presumably created by Eden for recordkeeping purposes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same Eden's Verse apocrypha can be traded for special gear.

29029.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Book of Iconoclasm<hex:021A020103>
29029.col_2: A short apocryphal tome presumably created by Eden for recordkeeping purposes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same Eden's Verse apocrypha can be traded for special gear.

29030.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Book of Refulgence<hex:021A020103>
29030.col_2: A short apocryphal tome presumably created by Eden for recordkeeping purposes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same Eden's Verse apocrypha can be traded for special gear.

29031.name: blade of golden antiquity
29031.col_2: A golden blade forged by some ancient civilization, recovered from Eden's Verse. Though such weapons were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

29032.name: flask of crystalline ester
29032.col_2: A sparkling substance produced by the artisans of the Crystalline Mean, used─when resources permit─to enhance the properties of Crystarium weapons such as those used by the guard. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

29033.name: spool of crystalline twine
29033.col_2: A sparkling thread produced by the artisans of the Crystalline Mean, used─when resources permit─to augment Crystarium vestments such as those used by the guard. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

29034.name: phial of crystalline glaze
29034.col_2: A sparkling coating produced by the artisans of the Crystalline Mean, used─when resources permit─to strengthen Crystarium accessories such as those used by the guard. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

29035.name: Mowen's token (allegory)
29035.col_2: A note of promise received from Mowen for the delivery of Allagan tomestones of allegory. However, due to the House of Splendors changing its policies, it is now worth less than the paper on which it is scribed.

29036.name: perdurable tomestone
29036.col_2: A rare and beautiful tomestone made of nigh-indestructible fused quartz. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

29509.name: highland cabbage

29510.name: platinum herring
29510.col_2: Other than the rather fancy name, this species is extraordinarily ordinary.

29511.name: silkie egg
29511.col_2: The breed of chicken that lays these eggs is known for its incredibly voluminous plumage. The eggs, on the other hand, are entirely indistinguishable from that of any other chicken.

29512.name: chunk of shimmering quartz
