29514.name: phial of blessed spring water
29514.col_2: Water collected from a natural fount said to be blessed by Ox'Dalan, guardian of the underworld.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29515.name: kindling crystal
29515.col_2: Translucent stones of this sort are lightly warm to the touch and often employed by the Night's Blessed to aid in starting bonfires.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29516.name: chunk of slough serpentinite
29516.col_2: A hunk of mottled rock covered thick with verdant moss.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29517.name: chunk of splendid iron ore
29517.col_2: High-purity iron ore splendid for making durable mining tools.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29518.name: splendid flint stone
29518.col_2: Just an ordinary flint stone used to strike sparks, but Qhoterl Pasol will surely find it splendid.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29519.name: slab of splendid slate
29519.col_2: This slab of slate is splendid for adding a touch of home to the Stopple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29520.name: splendid ant egg
29520.col_2: Savory-sweet and nourishing, this ant egg will have any Qitari exclaiming “Splendid!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29521.name: splendid scorpion
29521.col_2: Dwelling in rocky areas, this scorpion is splendidly hardy and promises to impart this quality to those who devour it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29522.name: piece of splendid amber
29522.col_2: An ingredient used by the Qitari to make their splendid perfumes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29523.name: splendid chalcanthite cluster
29523.col_2: Though splendid to behold, this mineral is quite toxic─but for Qhoterl Pasol's purposes, that too may be considered splendid.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29524.name: bottle of splendid mineral oil
29524.col_2: Anyone hoping to use this oil in its raw state to close wounds and heal grazes will be left sorely disappointed, and perhaps just sore.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29525.name: lump of splendid purple pigment
29525.col_2: Certain Qitari scholars maintain that this pigment is in fact a shade of mauve, while others argue it is more of a dark lilac hue. The debate rages on.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29526.name: pinch of splendid natron
29526.col_2: While the Qitari use this rare substance as an ingredient in cleansing solutions, some suspect that it merely masks odors rather than eliminating them. Several members of the community rub this on the more pungent areas of the body as a substitute to proper washing, a practice that is largely frowned upon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29527.name: sack of splendid clay
29527.col_2: While clay is a common enough material, only the truly splendid is used in the repair of broken pots and such, as the Qitari tend to be rather fussy about such matters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29528.name: chunk of splendid graphite
29528.col_2: When this rare mineral is ground down and made into ink, it can be used in a variety of artistic pursuits, such as calligraphy and so forth. Unfortunately, this particular sample is destined for a far more mundane purpose: the logging of excavated trinkets. To make matters worse, most Qitari have exceptionally poor handwriting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29529.name: chunk of splendid rock salt
29529.col_2: This splendid rock salt is sprinkled on meat during the smoking process to draw out its natural flavor. The same could, in fact, be said for practically any salt, but the Qitari tend to notice when someone tries to fob them off with anything less than the genuine article, hence the need to seek out this particular variety.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29530.name: pinch of splendid saltpeter
29530.col_2: Not to be confused with salt. Or Peter, whoever that is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29531.name: splendid holey stone
29531.col_2: Countless years of weathering have produced a stone full of holes that produce a most splendid sound when air passes through them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29532.name: handful of splendid gravel
29532.col_2: To maintain the splendid sheen of the stone tablets, one must use stones to polish stone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29533.name: splendid stone
29533.col_2: Suffused with magical energy, this stone can be used to make a trap as deadly as it is splendid.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29534.name: splendid worm
29534.col_2: Packed with splendid nutrients, any who consume this worm will become as hardy as the rocks it dwells within.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29535.name: slab of splendid dense iron ore
29535.description: slabs of splendid dense iron ore
29535.col_2: Only the most splendid picks will suffice for the Stewards, and to make those only the most splendid and densest ore will do.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29536.name: splendid bone fragment
29536.col_2: Bones tend to make splendid lures, especially when one seeks to catch splendid fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29537.name: slab of splendid black rock
29537.col_2: Qhoterl Pasol's magnum opus, a history of Ronka, must be splendid in every respect, as must the tools she will use to write it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29538.name: phial of ancient amber
29538.col_2: This resin harvested from a primeval tree glows faintly with an otherworldly light.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29539.name: spectral cocoon
29539.col_2: Spun by a rare breed of silkworm, this ghostly white casing is said to ward off baleful spirits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29540.name: spiritweed root
29540.col_2: The underground portion of a ghastly-looking shrub, used in offerings to the god of death.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29541.name: sprinkling of serpent pepper
29541.col_2: A pungent spice often used by the Night's Blessed in preparing meals and medicines to warm the body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29542.name: piece of boggy bark
29542.col_2: This slab of bark harvested from an ancient swampland tree is covered thick in verdant moss.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29543.name: clump of splendid flax
29543.col_2: This fibrous plant makes splendidly sturdy rope.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29544.name: bag of splendid seeds
29544.col_2: The oil extracted from these seeds burns splendidly in lamps.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29545.name: length of splendid water ivy
29545.col_2: This length of ivy is splendid for adding a touch of home to the Stopple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29546.name: splendid silkworm
29546.col_2: Succulent and nourishing, this silkworm will have any Qitari exclaiming “Splendid!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29547.name: handful of splendid wild berries
29547.col_2: Fairly bursting with juice, these berries make a truly splendid treat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29548.name: sprig of splendid lavender
29548.col_2: Bold yet soothing, the splendid scent of this herb helps the Qitari to navigate in the dark─while presumably keeping them relaxed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29549.name: splendid tarantula
29549.col_2: The venom of this spider is splendid for concocting a potent poison.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29550.name: sprig of splendid greenwattle
29550.col_2: Named for its likeness to the skin dangling from a chicken's neck, only much greener.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29551.name: lump of splendid turmeric
29551.col_2: Through the work of masters in the ways of spice, this root of decidedly unremarkable appearance is transformed into a bright-orange powder. This would make for a rather impressive magic trick, were it not for the fact the process takes several days to complete, which is somewhat longer than the attention span of the average audience.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29552.name: splendid marimo
29552.col_2: While even the most scholarly of scholars struggle to identify exactly what this mysterious aquatic substance actually <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103>, the Qitari have discovered it to be incredibly useful in the removal of unwanted odors. A few scrubs with a marimo produces a distinctive pond-like fragrance, which is many magnitudes more pleasant than what Qitari usually smell of, which does not bear description.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29553.name: splendid trillium
29553.col_2: Some Qitari will claim that this flower is an essential ingredient in their traditional adhesive formula, while others have the sneaking suspicion that it actually makes no difference whether it is included in the mixture or not. Nevertheless, it continues to be used to this day, as Qitari are content to comply with the teachings of the ancients, no matter how absurd they may be.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29554.name: splendid tarichuk feather
29554.col_2: Fortunately, the former owner was kind enough to molt this fine feather for you to collect without the need to resort to bloodshed, which may explain how it retains its natural splendidness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29555.name: handful of splendid tree bark
29555.col_2: The bark of a tree once barked at by a dog barking up the wrong tree.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29556.name: sprig of splendid mugwort
29556.col_2: Few would suspect that such an innocuous plant could be used in the production of explosives. Culinarians are investigating the connection between its combustive properties and claims that the consumption of mugwort causes indigestion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29557.name: splendid stalk
29557.col_2: This hollow stalk makes the perfect flute, and produces sounds so splendid as to transport one to another world.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29558.name: bundle of splendid broombush
29558.col_2: To keep a place looking splendid, you must have tools equally as splendid. This broombush can be used to sweep away even the most stubborn dust.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29559.name: splendid nut
29559.col_2: Nuts typically are not thought of as traps, but when  they're <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> splendid─and packed with arcane energy─their uses expand exponentially.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29560.name: splendid beehive chip
29560.col_2: The royal honey that can be scraped off this beehive chip can fortify the body and make splendid even the most downcast of spirits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29561.name: bunch of splendid roots
29561.col_2: These splendid roots can endure the harshest of stresses, making them well suited to the extreme conditions the Stewards oft find themselves in.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29562.name: splendid earthworm
29562.col_2: At first glance, this appears to be a common earthworm, but a closer look will reveal just how splendid it actually is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29563.name: tuft of splendid hemp
29563.col_2: This hemp can be woven into splendid paper that can stand the test of time Qhoterl Pasol's masterpiece will have to endure.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

29564.name: glowfish
29564.col_2: The scales of this ancient denizen of the deep exude an unearthly glow.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29565.name: shimmershell
29565.col_2: The faint light given off by this rare mollusk is said to ward off danger.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29566.name: Dalan's claw
29566.col_2: A modestly sized yet fearsome-looking crustacean often used as an offering to Ox'Dalan. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29567.name: magma eel
29567.col_2: A finless fish whose body is oddly warm to the touch. Often used by the Night's Blessed in preparing meals and medicines to warm the body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29568.name: mossy tortoise
29568.col_2: The shell of this ancient swamp-dwelling creature grows thick with verdant moss.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29569.name: splendid clawbow
29569.col_2: The sturdy pincers of this crab are splendid for making tools.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29570.name: splendid trout
29570.col_2: The oil extracted from this fish burns splendidly in lamps.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29571.name: splendid eryops
29571.col_2: The skin of this amphibian is splendid for adding a touch of home to the Stopple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29572.name: splendid robber crab
29572.col_2: Toothsome and nourishing, the flesh of this robber crab will have any Qitari exclaiming “Splendid!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29573.name: splendid piranha
29573.col_2: Though somewhat bony, the flesh of this freshwater fish is splendid for one's vigor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29574.name: splendid pirarucu
29574.col_2: The liver of this enormous fish is used by the Qitari to make their splendid perfumes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29575.name: splendid poison catfish
29575.col_2: The venom found in the fins of this catfish can be used to concoct a poison, and a splendid one at that.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29576.name: piece of splendid pondfrond
29576.col_2: A firm favorite of fruit worms, despite their apparent inability to plumb the depths of the lake where it grows. However, a hook through the belly awakes within them their innate swimming instincts, and they will stop at nothing to locate this elusive pond weed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29577.name: splendid spiralshell
29577.col_2: When these shells are ground into powder, they form the basis for a wide range of dyes. How this method was discovered is a secret lost to the sands of time, although one may assume it involved a fair amount of trial and error, not to mention time and effort that may perhaps have been better spent on more worthwhile pursuits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29578.name: splendid sponge
29578.col_2: The question of whether this enigmatic...thing is flora or fauna has yet to be answered, although from the way the Qitari use it to vigorously scrub the stench from their furry bodies, one can only hope it does not possess any form of sentience.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29579.name: splendid cockle
29579.col_2: Perhaps not the first thing that would spring to mind when discussing potential ingredients for an adhesive, the Qitari nevertheless swear by it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29580.name: splendid silver kitten
29580.col_2: Being a smaller relation to the catfish, this fine specimen possesses whisker-like barbs which may have served some purpose in the days before they devolved into utter uselessness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29581.name: splendid Night's bass
29581.col_2: Even a regular Night's bass acts as though it owns whatever body of water it chooses to inhabit, and the overt splendidness of this particular specimen makes it particularly unpopular within fish circles, whose social hierarchy is remarkably complex. Apparently.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29582.name: splendid magmatongue
29582.col_2: Descended from a long line of similarly monikered fish famous for their distinctive tongues, this breed's coloration resembles that of flowing magma. Its tongue, however, is rumored to melt whatever it licks, which is an oft-used excuse used by fishers who have allowed it to escape after being hooked.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29583.name: splendid treescale
29583.col_2: The shells of these bivalve mollusks have long been favored as percussion instruments by the Qitari for the splendid sound they make when struck.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29584.name: splendid pipira
29584.col_2: The rough teeth of these fish can scour centuries of dirt from the stone tablets, thus making splendid the histories of the Ronkan people.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29585.name: splendid shellfish
29585.col_2: Unbeknownst to many, the pearls slumbering within these splendid shellfish contain potent magical energy, which Qhoterl Pasol intends to use to fend off intruders.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29586.name: splendid egg-bearing trout
29586.col_2: This fish is most splendid when it bears eggs, which are said to strengthen the body against all manner of ailments.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29587.name: splendid diamondtongue
29587.col_2: The rough scales of this fish make it ill-suited for a meal, but they will serve splendidly to make boots which will be used to traverse treacherous terrain.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29588.name: splendid larva
29588.col_2: A larva so plump and splendid that even fishers have been known to eat one or two on occasion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29589.name: splendid mammoth shellfish
29589.col_2: Since ancient times, this shellfish has been prized for its ink sacs, which produce a most splendid shade of black.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Qitari society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29590.name: sack of pelagic clay
29590.col_2: Heavy on eolean dust and the bones of marine creatures─it is generally better to not ask which─this clay is found only in the deepest parts of the sea.

29604.name: pair of professional's fingerless gloves of crafting
29604.description: pairs of professional's fingerless gloves of crafting

29605.name: pair of professional's trousers of crafting
29605.description: pairs of professional's trousers of crafting

29606.name: pair of professional's shoes of crafting
29606.description: pairs of professional's shoes of crafting

29609.name: pair of professional's gloves of gathering
29609.description: pairs of professional's gloves of gathering

29610.name: pair of professional's breeches of gathering
29610.description: pairs of professional's breeches of gathering

29611.name: pair of professional's boots of gathering
29611.description: pairs of professional's boots of gathering

29645.name: oddly specific petrified orb
29645.col_2: A sphere of fossilized wood sanded to exacting specifications.

29646.name: handful of oddly specific rivets
29646.col_2: Far too many painstakingly forged metal bolts.

29648.name: oddly specific whetstone
29648.col_2: Whether this whetstone is materially much different from others or simply much more aesthetically appealing is difficult to discern.

29649.name: square of oddly specific leather
29649.col_2: It is fortunate that the Skysteel engineers provided instructions as to how this leather ought to be tanned, as it is still impossible to tell what manner of creature it came from.

29650.name: spindle of oddly specific moonbeam silk
29650.description: spindles of oddly specific moonbeam silk

29651.name: bundle of oddly specific synthetic resin
29651.description: bundles of oddly specific synthetic resin
29651.col_2: This compound is the result of hours of painstaking experimentation─which likely could have been avoided if the Skysteel engineers who ordered it had thought to provide the ratio of ingredients alongside their excruciatingly detailed description of what the end result ought to look, smell, and taste like.

29652.name: pot of oddly specific seed extract
29652.description: pots of oddly specific seed extract
29652.col_2: An exact quantity of extract produced through an exacting extraction process.

29653.name: oddly specific shaft
29653.col_2: Neillemard doubtless regrets allowing Denys to write out the order sheet for this particular material.

29654.name: oddly specific fitting
29654.col_2: On one hand, it is a relatively simple matter to understand why precision in the measurement and shaping of this joining piece is required. On the other, the instructions also requested that it “smell lightly of La Noscean orange,” so perhaps some skepticism is warranted.

29655.name: oddly specific chainmail sheet
29655.col_2: Far too many painstakingly forged metal links, fastened together equally painstakingly.

29656.name: oddly specific gemstone
29656.col_2: A jewel cut and polished to perfection─or arbitrary preference. One of the two.

29657.name: page of oddly specific vellum
29657.col_2: This page has been trimmed and prepared for its likely use in drafting plans.

29658.name: bolt of oddly specific velvet
29658.col_2: The depth and density of this cloth's plush pile has been measured to 1/1000th of an ilm.

29659.name: sheet of oddly specific glass
29659.col_2: This pane is “see-through, but not <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> see-through,” precisely as ordered.

29660.name: box of oddly specific seed flour
29660.description: boxes of oddly specific seed flour
29660.col_2: A fine powder, ground and sifted with extraordinary─some might even say excessive─precision.

29661.name: oddly specific petrified log
29661.col_2: Whence this fossilized wood is sourced is for Skysteel engineers to specify, and you to never find out.

29662.name: handful of oddly specific iron sand
29662.description: handfuls of oddly specific iron sand
29662.col_2: It is unclear what precise qualities make this particular sort of granulated metal so desirable, but presumably the old blacksmiths' adage, “Don't get iron sand in your eye. Seriously. Don't,” still applies, so probably best not look too closely.

29663.name: chunk of oddly specific iron ore
29663.description: chunks of oddly specific iron ore
29663.col_2: Not your granddad's iron ore. Or perhaps specifically your granddad's iron ore. Who's to say?

29664.name: oddly specific uncut gemstone
29664.col_2: A mineral chunk of the precise luster, color, cleavage, and lumpiness requested.

29665.name: oddly specific skin
29665.col_2: <hex:021A020203>Someone<hex:021A020103> knows what sort of skin this is, and really, isn't that what matters?

29666.name: basket of oddly specific cotton
29666.col_2: If cotton's fluffiness were rated on a scale of one to one thousand, which it absolutely is not─by anyone other than Nimie, at any rate─this would rate exactly nine hundred and eighty-seven.

29667.name: handful of oddly specific quartz
29667.col_2: If you look really, really, <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> close, you can see the difference between this and the sort of quartz that can be bought from a street urchin for a single shiny gil. Maybe.

29668.name: handful of oddly specific seeds
29668.col_2: These seeds have been closely inspected for quality. And other things.

29669.name: pot of oddly specific latex
29669.col_2: It is a relatively simple matter for a skilled botanist to collect latex from a specified plant in a specified vessel by specified means. Excruciating, yes, but simple.

29670.name: pinch of oddly specific fossil dust
29670.description: pinches of oddly specific fossil dust
29670.col_2: Whether naturalists would wholly approve of the Skysteel Manufactory's appropriation of microfossil-rich powder for industrial purposes is a matter probably best not raised in company of said naturalists, as to do so would likely bring about swift confiscation.

29672.name: handful of oddly specific mineral sand
29672.description: handfuls of oddly specific mineral sand
29672.col_2: If Nimie is to be believed, the precise mineral composition by grain is key in sand-related projects.

29673.name: piece of thinker's coral
29673.col_2: Freshwater coral far too pretentious to thrive anywhere but the Thaliak.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

29674.name: piece of oddly specific amber
29674.col_2: A hunk of fossilized resin of <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> particular hue, clarity, and age.

29675.name: oddly specific bauble
29675.col_2: Given the detailed nature of their request, one would think that the Skysteel engineers ought to have been able to come up with a more precise means of referring to this so-called “bauble.”

29676.name: fragment of oddly specific dark matter
29676.description: fragments of oddly specific dark matter
29676.col_2: Darker (and more specific) than your average matter.

29677.name: oddly specific striking stone
29677.col_2: This curious sphere tends to set nearby tinder alight at but a touch, whether such an effect is desired or not.

29678.name: dragonspine
29678.col_2: This spiked shell belies the soft and harmless form of the mollusk within─which itself belies the deranged lethality of said mollusk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

29679.name: Skysteel prototype coffer
29679.col_2: A tool chest containing a Skysteel prototype.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 80. IL: 440. Primary tool type determined by current class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

29680.name: mahogany aqueduct
29680.col_2: Reliable and stylish irrigation well suited to residential properties.

29681.name: crystallized coral
29681.col_2: This crystallized mass of coral matches almost any color scheme one could imagine.

29682.name: white screen
29682.col_2: That this screen always maintains its sterling whiteness speaks to the quality of its construction.

29683.name: siphon coffee brewer
29683.col_2: Many a connoisseur have sworn off all other methods of making coffee after trying a single sip of a cup made with this one.

29684.name: fat cat wall chronometer
29684.col_2: This convenient timekeeping device will always remind you when it is time to eat─unless, of course, it is time for your pets to eat, in which case you will be repeatedly reminded long before you have the chance to consult your timepiece.

29685.name: bomb cauldron
29685.col_2: Crafted with painstaking attention to detail, put this cauldron in any room to terrify guests and pets alike.

29686.name: Ronkan rocking chair
29686.col_2: A rocking chair representing Ronkan resourcefulness and resilience.

29687.name: brick garden wall
29687.col_2: A portion of brick wall that would complement nearly any garden, be it full of flowers or full of more subdued plant life.

29688.name: serving of authentic festive chirashi-zushi
29688.col_2: Almost identical to normal chirashi-zushi, but with markedly more festivity. This serving is guaranteed authentic...and hopefully fresh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Direct Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29689.name: plate of authentic festive sushi balls
29689.description: plates of authentic festive sushi balls
29689.col_2: Put off by the oblongitudinal proportions of regular sushi? Well, your prayers have been answered. All the fresh fish and vinegared rice you love, authentically ham-fisted into semi-sophisticated spheroids perfect for popping.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29690.name: authentic Archon egg pile
29690.col_2: In your (authentically adorned) abode, eggs hide <hex:021A020203>you.<hex:021A020103>

29691.name: authentic eggcentric crown roast
29691.col_2: An authentically artful arrangement of several succulent, spice-rubbed racks of lamb, accompanied by a side of steaming soup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Tenacity Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29692.name: authentic eggcentric chocolate cake
29692.col_2: A staggeringly sweet chocolate cake served with chocolate bunnies and what one can only hope are chocolate eggs, rather than authentic ones that might have been farm-fresh as of last year.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29693.name: Edenchoir weapon coffer (IL 505)
29693.col_2: A banded chest containing an Edenchoir weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 80. IL: 505. Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

29694.col_2: A banded chest containing a piece of Edenchoir attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 80. IL: 500. Head gear type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

29699.name: Edenchoir waist gear coffer (IL 500)
29699.col_2: A banded chest containing a piece of Edenchoir attire. Due to advancements in trouser technology, the belt within this chest is no longer worth the trouble of opening it.

29700.name: Edenchoir earring coffer (IL 500)
