29947.col_2: If you thought catching lightning in a bottle was difficult, catching it in a crystal fragment is even trickier. At least a bottle comes with a handy cap to keep in said lightning when caught, whereas crystal relies on nothing more than the bolt's willing cooperation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can only be gathered during umbral levin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Used in expert crafting recipes.

29958.name: cobalt alloy ingot
29958.col_2: An ingot of smelted cobalt alloy.

29961.name: bolt of duskcourt cloth
29961.col_2: Finely woven cloth with that distinctive duskbloom hue that says, “wealthier than you.”

29962.name: circle of megalania leather
29962.col_2: A large piece of cured megalania skin.

29963.name: bottle of grade 3 strength alkahest
29963.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29964.name: bottle of grade 3 dexterity alkahest
29964.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29965.name: bottle of grade 3 vitality alkahest
29965.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29966.name: bottle of grade 3 intelligence alkahest
29966.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29967.name: bottle of grade 3 mind alkahest
29967.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29968.name: chunk of fireheart cobalt
29968.col_2: Seasoned miners will recognize this as a type of sulfide, its composition lending its surface a permanent sheen that makes it look like a glowing ember in the light.

29969.name: chunk of dwarven chromite
29969.col_2: This ore has a high concentration of naturally occurring chrome─which is presumably why dwarves will under no circumstances divulge where veins of it might be found.

29970.name: Purpure shell chip
29970.col_2: A shiny piece of Purpure carapace.

29971.name: lump of Workbench resin
29971.col_2: Grenoldt's signature resin─whether the result of one of his more inspired moments or creative dry spells, no one can say.

29972.name: merbau log
29972.col_2: A rough-cut log of merbau timber, bearing the wood's distinctive scent.

29973.name: lump of Tempest adhesive
29973.col_2: Another of Grenoldt's creations. Probably best not to ask what's in it.

29974.name: clump of duskblooms
29974.col_2: A flowering plant with tiny purple blooms.

29975.name: basket of caprice fleece
29975.col_2: Hair shorn from the pixies' lovingly─in some sense, at least─raised flock.

29977.name: megalania skin
29977.col_2: The hide of the megalania─a scalekin that has changed little since prehistoric eras.

29978.name: imperial fern
29978.col_2: Presumably named by one of history's many oppressed lower classes, this fern's appellation cannot but refer to the pretentious way in which it curls.

29979.name: pinch of dried hi-ether
29979.col_2: Dry, flaky residue found at the bottom of a bottle of evaporated hi-ether.

29980.name: authentic Valentione lobster platter
29980.col_2: An authentically sumptuous plate of boiled and buttered lobster. Comes complete with a heart-shaped pizza. For reasons...of authenticity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29981.name: authentic Valentione cake pairing
29981.col_2: Rich cake powdered with dark chocolate and paired with a fine wine (now authentically aged for your enjoyment).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29982.name: authentic stuffed mammet
29982.col_2: All the authentic cuddliness of a mammet with all the authentic functionality of a plush doll.

29983.name: bejeweled egg
29983.col_2: This fragile ovoid is even more sumptuously decorated than the Archon eggs of yesteryear.

29989.name: set of apprentice's practice materials
29989.col_2: Eager to reduce pointless, pointless waste, Eorzea's guildmasters organized an assemblage of sacks of low-quality materials such as this one that artisans-in-training may practice their skills (or lack thereof, in many cases). However, advances in crafting tuition have rendered this collection of largely useless components entirely obsolete.

29990.name: set of rank VIII artisan's durable practice materials
29990.description: sets of rank VIII artisan's durable practice materials
29990.col_2: Assorted low-cost materials suited for trying one's hand at master recipes of the 8th level. Durability: 70.
29990.col_3: Rank VIII Artisan's Durable Practice Materials

29991.name: set of rank VIII artisan's fragile practice materials
29991.description: sets of rank VIII artisan's fragile practice materials
29991.col_2: Assorted low-cost materials suited for trying one's hand at master recipes of the 8th level. Durability: 35.
29991.col_3: Rank VIII Artisan's Fragile Practice Materials

29992.name: set of grade 2 expert skybuilders' practice materials
29992.description: sets of grade 2 expert skybuilders' practice materials
29992.col_2: Assorted low-cost materials suited for trying one's hand at expert recipes of the sort used in the Ishgardian restoration.

29993.name: Varis yae Galvus card
29993.col_2: A legendary (★★★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 279

29994.name: grade 2 skybuilders' cloudskipper
29994.col_2: True to its name, this rare species spends its entire life in the firmament (the actual firmament, not the place in Ishgard) where it skips from cloud to cloud. Sadly, its ability to remain airborne relies on the presence of said clouds, without which it falls inelegantly to the ground below.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29995.name: grade 2 skybuilders' meditator
29995.col_2: Like all meditators, this particular variety is capable of surviving out of water. The reason for its superior grading appears to be its ability to get back into water afterwards, which many of its brethren sadly lack.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29996.name: grade 2 skybuilders' coeurlfish
29996.col_2: Coeurlfish fall into the category of species that anglers would rather not have thrashing at the end of their line, and many would rather lose their lure than face its vicious fangs. Only those with nerves of steel would attempt to reel in one of these aquatic abominations, though they are often made to regret it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29997.name: grade 2 skybuilders' garpike
29997.col_2: The skybuilders' primary reason for requesting this especially savage variety of garpike is to limit the havoc it wreaks in whatever body of water it inhabits. There is nothing less welcoming to a school of docile freshwater dwellers looking for a new home than a snapping maw of razor-sharp teeth heading in their general direction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29998.name: grade 2 skybuilders' pirarucu
29998.col_2: The pirarucu's habit of swallowing the lure whole means that most anglers wait until the beast is well and truly dead before they attempt to retrieve it. There is always the option of leaving it in the fish's belly─but that would be a nasty surprise for the poor soul who has to gut it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

29999.name: grade 2 skybuilders' brown bolo
29999.col_2: While this bizarre creature is known to entangle its prey in a manner similar to its namesake, the grade 2 variety can be used as an actual bolo when thrown. Just make sure the thing is dead first or you may find yourself being the one entangled.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30000.name: grade 2 skybuilders' bitterling
30000.col_2: Most creatures tend not to enjoy being pulled to their death via a hook to the mouth, but this poor specimen looks especially miserable when caught.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30001.name: grade 2 skybuilders' caiman
30001.col_2: Though the skybuilders are often willing to take in scalekin captured alive, they have specifically requested that any caiman presented be certifiably dead before being brought to the Firmament. Given its resemblance to a wingless dragon, the less sensible members of the populace may fear a second Dragonsong War is upon them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30002.name: grade 2 skybuilders' cloud cutter
30002.col_2: Often caught accidentally by anglers in mid-cast, due to its habit of flying several fulms above the waterline.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30003.name: grade 2 skybuilders' vampiric tapestry
30003.col_2: Another species that largely fails to live up to its namesake, especially the “vampiric” part. As for “tapestry,” the only similarity appears to be the shared ability to stay stuck to a wall through the use of a series of well-placed pins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30004.name: grade 2 skybuilders' tupuxuara
30004.col_2: The word “fishing” usually implies that some sort of aquatic, or at the very least, amphibious creature is the intended prey, though the paraphernalia used by anglers is equally effective for snagging flying scalekin. Whether one would actually want to or not is a separate matter entirely.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30005.name: grade 2 skybuilders' blind manta
30005.col_2: As this species of manta uses echolocation to find its way around, it can be heard making a series of high-pitched squeals when hoisted out of the water. Many fishers end up feeling sorrow for the poor beast and returning it whence it came, although the more cynically minded suspect it of intentionally wielding a pity-based form of self-defense.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30006.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' rhomaleosaurus
30006.col_2: An aquatic scalekin so enormous that one cannot help but wonder how a mere fishing rod could bear its weight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30007.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' gobbie mask
30007.col_2: According to some sources, several attempts have been made by goblins to convert the carcasses of these cephalopods into masks. Unfortunately, the retch-inducing stench is too much for most to bear, especially when in such close proximity to the face.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30008.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' pterodactyl
30008.col_2: One must take great care when attempting to catch one of these winged scalekin, as they may find themselves lifted from the ground. In such cases, it is normally best to let go of the rod, although the more absent-minded may find themselves clinging on for dear life for reasons that even they cannot comprehend.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30009.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' skyfish
30009.col_2: Sought by collectors as a rare curio rather than for its use in Ishgardian cuisine. Often used to decorate trees during the Starlight Celebration, although the smell does get to be quite noticeable after a few days.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30010.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' cometfish
30010.col_2: Named not for the speed with which it cuts through the water, but for the fact that, much like its namesake, having one fall on your head can be rather painful.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30011.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' anomalocaris
30011.col_2: This airborne cephalopod often dives from above to savage unsuspecting anglers, as it is presumably a follower of the “get your retaliation in first” style of self-defense. However, a well-timed sidestep and a well-placed fishing net can soon turn the tables.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30012.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' rhamphorhynchus
30012.col_2: It is strongly advised not to attempt to spear this particular species, as more often than not, it ends up doing most of the spearing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30013.name: grade 2 artisanal skybuilders' dragon's soul
30013.col_2: While most people are aware by now that this is not the soul of a dragon trapped in the rather pathetic and quite small body of a wavekin, it is nevertheless allowed to keep its incredibly impressive name.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

30014.col_2: True to its name, this rare species spends its entire life in the firmament (the actual firmament, not the place in Ishgard) where it skips from cloud to cloud. 30034.name: sintered whetstone
30034.col_2: A whetstone created through compression and intense heat. Used for sharpening tools.

30045.name: rabbit suit
30045.col_2: Cannot equip gear to hands, legs, or feet.

30046.name: dapper rabbit suit
30046.col_2: Cannot equip gear to hands, legs, or feet.

30065.name: pair of Scion sorceress's high boots
30065.description: pairs of Scion sorceress's high boots

30088.name: sungold Talos
30088.col_2: Guaranteed to make you the envy of collectors and younglings alike.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the sungold Talos minion.

30089.name: Malone
30089.col_2: If it weren't following you around, it would be tearing hapless adventurers apart on the Diadem.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Malone minion.

30090.name: little leafman
30090.col_2: Definitely a leafman. The pixie said so.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the little leafman minion.

30091.name: the Behelmeted Serpent of Ronka
30091.col_2: Tremble, child of man, for a creature of purest divinity wiggleth before thee in all of its behelmeted glory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Behelmeted Serpent of Ronka minion.

30092.name: the Behatted Serpent of Ronka
30092.col_2: Tremble, child of man, for a creature of purest divinity wiggleth before thee in all of its behatted glory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Behatted Serpent of Ronka minion.

30093.name: silver dasher
30093.col_2: Never was there a bird so adorable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the silver dasher minion.

30094.name: paissa patissier
30094.col_2: Currently in training as a culinarian, and looks the part.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the paissa patissier minion.

30095.name: paissa threadpuller
30095.col_2: Currently in training as a weaver, and looks the part.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the paissa threadpuller minion.

30096.name: ancient one
30096.col_2: Small and appearing to be fractured, but whole.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the ancient one minion.

30097.name: the Major-General
30097.col_2: It's a shark. With legs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Major-General minion.

30098.name: wind-up Dulia-Chai
30098.col_2: Complete with asphyxiated Chai-Nuzz.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Dulia-Chai minion.

30099.name: amaro hatchling
30099.col_2: It may make a fine steed if you live long enough to see it reach maturity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the amaro hatchling minion.

30100.name: Laladile
30100.col_2: Because small is beautiful.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Laladile minion.

30101.name: unlucky rabbit
30101.col_2: Has known the bitterest lows and the sweetest highs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the unlucky rabbit minion.

30102.name: Construct 14 identification key
30102.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Construct 14 will magically bring the machine to life.

30103.name: Ronkan flute
30103.col_2: This whistle emits a sublime tone that summons forth the Great Vessel of Ronka, pre-filled with divinity for your worshipping convenience.

30104.name: pteranodon horn
30104.col_2: This horn emits a primitive tone that brings a prehistoric pteranodon soaring to your side.

30105.name: ruby gwiber trumpet
30105.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons an imposing ruby gwiber from its refuge.

30106.name: hybodus horn
30106.col_2: This horn emits a deep and menacing tone that summons forth your fearsome hybodus.

30107.name: Ramuh crystal
30107.col_2: Thrumming with lightning energy, this crystal gives rise to an entity which assumes the form of the Lord of Levin in all of his horse-legged, hulking glory.

30108.name: Rubellite Carbuncle whistle
30108.col_2: A jeweled whistle that emits a heart-melting tone said to summon a Rubellite Carbuncle.

30109.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Defter Digits<hex:021A020103>
30109.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing the myriad ways one may use one's fingers to effectively communicate. Described by critics as a “finger-snapping good read.” Use to learn the /snap emote.

30110.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Well Bread<hex:021A020103>
30110.col_2: An illustrated manual providing instruction in the eating of bread, a deceptively nuanced act that philosophers have likened to a good marriage. Use to learn the /bread emote.

30111.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Intelligent Impressions<hex:021A020103>
30111.col_2: An illustrated manual of how and when to employ books in a social setting so as to appear well-read to those around you. Use to learn the /read emote.

30112.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Emphatic Elucidation<hex:021A020103>
30112.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to speak powerfully and persuasively, drawing upon techniques employed by the finest orators in history. Use to learn the /insist emote.

30113.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Controlled Chaos<hex:021A020103>

30269.name: parasol
30269.col_2: The perfect accessory to protect you from the summer sun, spring showers, and birds seeking to relieve themselves. Use to acquire a parasol.

30270.name: sky blue parasol
30270.col_2: The perfect accessory to protect you from the summer sun, spring showers, and birds seeking to relieve themselves. Use to acquire a sky blue parasol.

30271.name: coffer o' kupos
30271.col_2: This nonsensically named coffer contains a full set of moogle-approved kupo attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1.

30272.name: irregular tomestone of law
30272.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains arguments of dubious legal grounds and tales of their at times horrific, at times hilarious results when used during judicial proceedings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

30273.name: handful of Thavnairian scalepowder
30273.col_2: A fine powder blended in the Near Eastern island nation of Radz-at-Han designed to promote aetherial conductivity.

30278.name: Diadem balloon bug
30278.col_2: Try not to think of all of the sky-spiders that these sky-bugs will attract. Live bait for skyfishing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in the Diadem.

30279.name: Diadem red balloon
30279.col_2: You'd best not set ninety-nine of these free in the skies over Ishgard, lest the knights be very cross indeed. Live bait for skyfishing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in the Diadem.

30280.name: Diadem crane fly
30280.col_2: The veined wings and spindly legs of the crane fly will attract a plethora of skyborne predators in no time. Presumably some part of this situation is desirable to you. Live bait for skyfishing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in the Diadem.

30281.name: Diadem hoverworm
30281.col_2: What is there to say about the Diadem hoverworm? Nothing, so long as they might be listening. Live bait for skyfishing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in the Diadem.

30315.name: pot of carpenter's gobbiegoo
30315.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Tastes of sawdust...not that you would know.

30316.name: pot of highly viscous carpenter's gobbiegoo
30316.description: pots of highly viscous carpenter's gobbiegoo
30316.col_2: Though you naturally understand how paper and the like is made, you cannot fathom how the materials you provided might have become this Skysteel tool coating.

30317.name: pot of blacksmith's gobbiegoo
30317.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Cold to the touch.

30318.name: pot of highly viscous blacksmith's gobbiegoo
30318.description: pots of highly viscous blacksmith's gobbiegoo
30318.col_2: This Skysteel tool coating is of a peculiar shiny black, and you cannot shake the feeling that it is somehow gooier than ever before.

30319.name: pot of armorer's gobbiegoo
30319.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Brittle when spread overthin.

30320.name: pot of highly viscous armorer's gobbiegoo
30320.description: pots of highly viscous armorer's gobbiegoo
30320.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating. Now with extra...goo.

30321.name: pot of goldsmith's gobbiegoo
30321.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Enticingly shiny.

30322.name: pot of highly viscous goldsmith's gobbiegoo
30322.description: pots of highly viscous goldsmith's gobbiegoo
30322.col_2: This thick Skysteel tool coating emits fumes that you recall fondly from the gilding process. You also recall said fumes are highly toxic.

30323.name: pot of leatherworker's gobbiegoo
30323.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Known for its delightful aroma─though perhaps leatherworkers are not best positioned to judge.

30324.name: pot of highly viscous leatherworker's gobbiegoo
30324.description: pots of highly viscous leatherworker's gobbiegoo
30324.col_2: Even practiced leatherworkers are disgusted by the texture of this Skysteel tool coating─which is really saying something.

30325.name: pot of weaver's gobbiegoo
30325.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Not a suitable substitute for medicinal salves, no matter how much your fingers ache.

30326.name: pot of highly viscous weaver's gobbiegoo
30326.description: pots of highly viscous weaver's gobbiegoo
30326.col_2: Generally “viscous” is not high on the list of attributes one associates with delicate needlework, but perhaps the frankly alarming amount of goo that Skysteel engineers will soon apply to your needle will change that.

30327.name: pot of alchemist's gobbiegoo
30327.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by deeply intriguing means.

30328.name: pot of highly viscous alchemist's gobbiegoo
30328.description: pots of highly viscous alchemist's gobbiegoo
30328.col_2: “Does the adjective placement here imply that the alchemist in question is particularly viscous?” is a thought that could only come from the addled mind of one steeped in the alchemical arts─which is precisely the reason that no one trusts those people.

30329.name: pot of culinarian's gobbiegoo
30329.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Incredibly inedible.

30330.name: pot of highly viscous culinarian's gobbiegoo
30330.description: pots of highly viscous culinarian's gobbiegoo
30330.col_2: “But I cook food in that!” you may plead as the Skysteel engineers make to apply this coating to your frypan, but they will not heed your cries.

30331.name: pot of botanist's gobbiegoo
30331.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Minty fresh.

30333.name: pot of highly viscous botanist's gobbiegoo
30333.description: pots of highly viscous botanist's gobbiegoo
30333.col_2: This Skysteel tool coating is deeply weird, but frankly, nature has produced weirder.

30335.name: pot of miner's gobbiegoo
30335.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Tastes of soil, which is a perfectly reasonable thing to know.

30337.name: pot of highly viscous miner's gobbiegoo
30337.description: pots of highly viscous miner's gobbiegoo
30337.col_2: This Skysteel tool coating is darker than the depths of a mineshaft, and more viscous than...regular goo.

30339.name: pot of fisher's gobbiegoo
30339.col_2: A Skysteel tool coating crafted by means that are intriguing─but not quite so intriguing that you would risk finding out what they are. Smells of fish.

30340.name: pot of highly viscous fisher's gobbiegoo
30340.description: pots of highly viscous fisher's gobbiegoo
30340.col_2: Try not to think about the process involved in rendering the “materials” you provided into this gloopy, pinkish Skysteel tool coating.

30374.col_2: A bunch of multicolored cosmos, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

30375.name: set of small smithy walls
30375.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to give their estate hall a smithy-inspired look.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

30376.name: set of medium smithy walls
30376.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to give their estate hall a smithy-inspired look.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

30377.name: set of large smithy walls
30377.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to give their estate hall a smithy-inspired look.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

30378.name: factory interior wall
30378.col_2: An industrial wall resembling those seen in the Copied Factory.

30380.name: factory chandelier
30380.col_2: A rusted metal lighting fixture unlike any to which you are accustomed.

30381.name: trophy of Light
30381.col_2: A wall-mounted sword and shield to mark your victory in a battle of like wills.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

30382.name: Sapphire Weapon bust
30382.col_2: The chest of this Garlond Ironworks scale replica of a select portion of the Sapphire Weapon glows ominously. Accept no substitutes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

30383.name: verdant shelf partition
30383.col_2: A charming open partition with ample shelf space in the middle and overflowing planters above.

30384.name: ironfrog keeper
30384.col_2: This diminutive automaton has ample space for storing the energy-rich crystals of dismembered knockers and other useful objects.

30385.name: wooden staircase bookshelf
30385.col_2: Versatile book storage that doubles as tiered shelving for other knickknacks.

30386.name: gemseeker's pack
30386.col_2: This bag is bursting with unpolished gems and crystals─and as such, may attract spriggans. Homeowners are advised to lock their doors.

30387.name: bluebird mobile
30387.col_2: If one bluebird brings happiness, surely those who adorn their homes with this revolving display have naught to fear─aside from taking a faux bluebird to the eye should they move carelessly.

30388.name: nomad's tent
30388.col_2: A little piece of the Azim Steppe, created by trade-minded Xaela using traditional methods and materials.

30389.name: stage curtain
30389.col_2: This sumptuous curtain impresses upon audiences that what they are about to witness is no two-gil production.

30390.name: floor sofa
30390.col_2: A spacious seating option for those who prefer to remain at floor level.

30391.name: tako-yaki boat
30391.col_2: A steaming and sauce-slathered serving of enough doughy fried octopus to share.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30393.name: barrel table
30393.col_2: This reused cask screams “adventure!” Or perhaps “alcohol,” depending on what sort of tavern patron you are.

30394.name: indoor pond
30394.col_2: Bring the outdoors indoors with this perfect imitation of nature. Toads not included...or are they?

30395.name: giant beaver burger set
30395.col_2: No actual beavers were harmed in the making of this massive burger.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30396.name: red brick kitchen
30396.col_2: This rustic outdoor cooking facility is more than capable of keeping any amount of garden party guests well fed.

30397.name: cracked arch window
30397.col_2: Too competent to smash your own windows? This is the product for you!

30398.name: set of industrial wall pipes
30398.col_2: These decorative pipes were designed by the employees of Garlond Ironworks to make their abodes “feel more like home.”

30399.name: Season Sixteen Lone Wolf trophy
30399.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Sixteen of the Feast.

30400.name: factory grate
30400.col_2: A rusted piece of grating. Watch your toes.

30401.name: factory staircase
30401.col_2: These metallic stairs make a satisfying clunking noise when stepped on. You know the one.

30402.name: factory railing
30402.col_2: An industrial safety rail. Given the visible wear and tear, one of those adjectives may have become less applicable over time.

30404.name: factory automatic door
30404.col_2: The internal mechanisms that allow this door to open and close on its own remain something of a mystery. Luckily, this one was ripped from its surroundings wholesale, and operates regardless.

30406.name: factory wall lamp
30406.col_2: A grimy lamp extracted from the machine graveyard.

30407.name: factory bench
30407.col_2: An iron bench that remains sturdy despite having seen better days.

30408.name: wooden footbridge
30408.col_2: For those who find walking on the ground simply too pedestrian.

30409.name: Gulg planter
30409.col_2: An alpine shrub from the heights of Kholusia.

30410.name: marble alcove bed
30410.col_2: This indulgent bed frame constitutes an entire wall, and will banish any illusions guests might have held regarding your humility.

30411.name: copy of Watts's sketches
30411.col_2: Drawn many, many moons ago by the famed Watts, these illustrations depict a concept for a form of wheeled transportation. Unfortunately, details on the inner workings have been largely omitted, but even in this undeveloped state, the design showed promise.

30412.name: dwarven floor lamp
30412.col_2: A low-lying lamp designed for use in narrow, enclosed spaces─but usable anywhere mineshaft ambience is desired.

30413.name: mandragora table chronometer
30413.col_2: A massive mandragora-themed timepiece, for those who are into that.

30414.name: paissa rug
30414.col_2: What have they <hex:021A020203>seen<hex:021A020103>? What do they <hex:021A020203>know<hex:021A020103>?

30415.name: huggable gaelicat
30415.col_2: This stuffed imitation of the weatherproof gaelicat looks as if it is─rightly─ready to be adored.

30416.name: Ishgardian display stand
30416.col_2: A decorative pedestal in the Coerthan style.

30417.name: Fortemps sofa
30417.col_2: An ostentatious, though elegant, round seat of the sort favored by House Fortemps.

30418.name: stuffed Estinien
30418.col_2: Though cuddlier than the real thing, still decidedly prickly. Please enjoy responsibly.

30419.name: helldiver SD
30419.col_2: An amazingly lifelike model constructed using specially engineered cloth and cotton bolls by Ironworks employees with a particular...enthusiasm for the helldiver variety of machina. Designation: snuggly.

30420.name: Dainsleif SD
30420.col_2: An amazingly lifelike model constructed using specially engineered cloth and cotton bolls by Ironworks employees with a particular...enthusiasm for the Dáinsleif machina. Designation: snuggly.

30421.name: oriental wooden deck
30421.col_2: A slatted deck in the Far Eastern fashion, perfect for quiet contemplation or loud consumption of dango.

30422.name: slanted wall
30422.col_2: This freestanding wall adds fashionable and potentially confounding angles to any interior.

30423.name: slanted skylight
30423.col_2: A freestanding sloped wall with an inbuilt window to let the sun─and only the sun, somehow─in.

30424.name: the Moogle's Paw machine
30424.col_2: Experience the extreme sensory overload of the Gold Saucer in your own home with this authentic the Moogle's Paw machine.

30425.name: Out on a Limb machine
30425.col_2: Experience the heart-exploding excitement of the Gold Saucer in your own home with this authentic Out on a Limb machine.

30426.name: the Finer Miner machine
30426.col_2: Experience the heart-exploding excitement of the Gold Saucer in your own home with this authentic the Finer Miner machine.

30427.name: plate of sliced watermelon
30427.col_2: This juicy, fresh-cut watermelon makes the perfect summer treat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Tenacity Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30428.name: water bomb stand
30428.col_2: Bring home this hallmark of the Moonfire Faire and pelt passersby with aquatic surprises from the comfort of your very own front garden!

30429.name: authentic Moonfire Faire MMXVIII advertisement
30429.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. So authentic, you can practically smell the fireworks, sunburned flesh, and slightly suspect festival snacks.

30430.name: authentic portable pool
30430.col_2: A peculiar rubber enclosure that can be filled with water for purposes of mild entertainment. Maintains an authentic “new rubber” smell many moons after the initial purchase.

30431.name: authentic wind chime stand
30431.col_2: Nothing says “summer” like the dissonant tinkling of half a dozen wind chimes at once. Those in doubt of its authenticity will be pleased to discover that the chimes do in fact ring in response to wafts of air, and are not mechanically controlled, unlike more complex but far less charming devices such as orchestrions.

30432.name: the Sinsteeped
30432.col_2: A king among sinspitters, and lord of the waters of the Quadrivium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

30433.name: Sweetheart
30433.col_2: A queen among albino caimans, and lady of the waters of the Rift of Sighs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

30434.name: giant taimen
30434.col_2: A king among hucho taimen, and lord of the waters of upper Watts River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

30435.name: leannisg
30435.col_2: A king among wimple carp, and lord of the waters of Handmirror Lake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

30436.name: gold hammer
30436.col_2: A king among golden lobsters, and lord of the waters of Saint Fathric's Temple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

30437.name: Recordkiller
30437.col_2: A queen among silver kittens, and lady of the waters of south Mjrl's Regret.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

30438.name: the Mother of All Pancakes
30438.col_2: A queen among pancake octopodes, and lady of the waters of east Caliban Gap.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

30439.name: opal shrimp
30439.col_2: A king among rainbow shrimp, and lord of the waters of the Norvrandt Slope.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

30483.col_2: A sheet of highly durable brashgold plate.

30484.name: bottle of defthand's dissolvent
30484.col_2: When applied to crafting or gathering gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

30485.name: sprig of tender dill
30485.col_2: A small variety of dill characterized by its sweet fragrance. Finds use in both medicinal and culinary applications.

30486.name: chunk of brashgold ore
30486.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock rich in a highly durable, naturally occurring alloy.

30487.name: blue crab
30487.col_2: A small crab that would be otherwise unremarkable if not for its vibrant blue shell.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

30488.name: hoplite
30488.col_2: While the shape of this wavekin's shell may resemble Halone's fabled shield, it is not recommended for use in battle.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

30489.name: hook fish
30489.col_2: Woe betide any who accidentally swallow one of this fish's sharp bones.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

30490.name: cloudweed
30490.col_2: A flavorful weed that has come to have more utility in the kitchen than in the ocean.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

30491.name: fatty herring
30491.col_2: In a blind taste test, three out of four people cannot tell the difference between fatty herring steak and antelope steak.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

30492.name: inkshell
30492.col_2: Perfect for producing ink and hoodwinking those who are hard of hearing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

30592.name: sprig of levin mint

30593.name: fuchsia bloom

30594.name: stuffed paissa patissier

30595.name: stuffed behelmeted serpent

30859.name: chocobo carriage whistle
30859.col_2: A small hand-carved whistle that emits a unique, high-pitched tone discernible only by a chocobo trained from birth to recognize and respond to the sound, carriage and all.

30860.name: Rolling Tankard ignition key
30860.col_2: Inserting this small piece of painted iron will ignite the advanced nine-cylinder radial ethanol engine of your Rolling Tankard. Please refrain from imbibing while driving.

30861.name: Gabriel α identification key
30861.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Gabriel α will magically bring the machine to life.

30862.name: megalotragus horn
30862.col_2: This imposing horn emits a primordial tone that summons forth your megalotragus, a herbivore so intimidating it puts carnivores to shame.

30863.name: gwiber of light trumpet
30863.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons a refulgent gwiber of light from its hiding place.

30864.name: Jibanyan couch medal
30864.col_2: This medal can be used to summon forth the Jibanyan couch, a mysterious piece of furniture designed in the likeness of a Yo-kai named Jibanyan.

30865.name: Incitatus whistle
30865.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon Incitatus, the steed of legend.

30866.name: Ehll Tou whistle
30866.col_2: When blown, this ornate whistle emits a distinct tone that summons to your side Ehll Tou, the young dragon with a passion for crafting.

30867.name: Lalinator 5.H0
30867.col_2: It doesn't feel pity, or remorse, or fear. And it absolutely will not stop, ever, until you have been lali-ho'd.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Lalinator 5.H0 minion.

30868.name: wind-up Mystel
30868.col_2: Modeled upon no one in particular. No, really.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Mystel minion.

30869.name: wind-up Ardbert
30869.col_2: What he lacks in size, he makes up for in heart...and his disproportionately large axe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Ardbert minion.

30870.name: magitek helldiver F1
30870.col_2: Minimal firepower, maximum attitude.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the magitek helldiver F1 minion.

30871.name: weatherproof gaelicat
30871.col_2: Makes you feel toasty warm simply to behold it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the weatherproof gaelicat minion.

30872.name: ephemeral necromancer
30872.col_2: If it could, it would summon forth an army of equally adorable undead.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the ephemeral necromancer minion.

30873.name: Allagan melon
30873.col_2: Capable of movement and tremendously juicy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Allagan melon minion.

30874.name: sand fox
30874.col_2: Will perform tricks for a lick of birch syrup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the sand fox minion.

30875.name: petit pteranodon
30875.col_2: It might be cute now, but wait till it grows and becomes a scourge of the skies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the petit pteranodon minion.

30876.name: Dainsleif F1
30876.col_2: Does not form the head. Or any other part of the body, for that matter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Dáinsleif F1 minion.

30877.name: Lord Enma
30877.col_2: The last in a line of kings who guided the fate of the Yo-kai World.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Lord Enma minion.

30878.name: Lord Ananta
30878.col_2: The new ruler of the Yo-kai World.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Lord Ananta minion.

30879.name: Zazel
30879.col_2: Counselor to generations of Enmas, the Yo-kai kings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Zazel minion.

30880.name: Damona
30880.col_2: The daughter of an Oni pirate king.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Damona minion.

30881.name: 2B automaton
30881.col_2: For when you need the company of a compact version of an advanced combat android dressed in a distinctive subculture style. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the 2B automaton minion.

30882.name: 2P automaton
30882.col_2: For when you need the company of a compact version of an advanced combat android dressed in a distinctive subculture style. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the 2P automaton minion.

30883.name: <hex:021A020203>The Sultana's Seven<hex:021A020103> pane
30883.col_2: A faithful recreation of the stained glass artwork that adorned the main stage at Ul'dah's Rising festival. The historic moment when Nanamo Ul Namo and her seven most trusted followers confronted a baying crowd and restored peace to the city is captured in all its glory. For aesthetic reasons, however, the artist has wisely chosen not to include the angry mob.
