32200.name: sheaf of field notes on Rostik
32200.description: sheaves of field notes on Rostik
32200.col_2: Handwritten notes on the history and character of the master of the gunblade, Rostik.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to add to your field record.

32201.name: piece of Garlean synthetic fabric
32201.col_2: Material shorn from an imperial uniform proven to be exceedingly nonconductive to aether.

32202.name: grilled eel set
32202.col_2: An Eastern delicacy that fills stomachs as quickly as it empties coinpurses. Connoisseurs advise eating only the smallest amount at a time, so as to make it last as long as possible.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Direct Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

32203.name: goobbue lamp
32203.col_2: The elegance of the softly glowing fruit and beautiful verdant leaves is strangely juxtaposed by the gormless expression of the goobbue base.

32204.name: dress form
32204.col_2: Judging by its proportions, it appears to have been modeled after a Roegadyn woman, who have been rather in vogue as of late.

32205.name: tankard
32205.col_2: Contains enough ale to drown at least a couple of sorrows.

32206.name: Emerald Weapon bust
32206.col_2: Includes six floating manipulators, all of which appear to be offering to take one's coat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

32207.name: stuffed Kupka Kupp
32207.col_2: So true to life it may very well be Kupka Kupp himself, albeit stuffed. You hope for his sake it is not.

32208.name: unmelting ice partition
32208.col_2: One of the few furnishings that must rely on mystic energies simply to maintain structural integrity.

32209.name: unmelting ice loft
32209.col_2: Though the ability to defy the laws of gravity and nature is certainly impressive, the best thing about this handy platform is that footprints can be made in the thin layer of snow on top. Go ahead, try it!

32210.name: queen's gunner piece
32210.col_2: Can be strategically placed to deter burglars, providing that they are already inside the building at the time.

32211.name: queen's soldier piece
32211.col_2: Though it appears to be some sort of mammet, it is entirely incapable of independent movement. Considering that it comes equipped with a potentially deadly blade, perhaps that is for the best.

32212.name: shakshouka pot
32212.col_2: Of the many and varied ingredients that comprise this dish, it is the humble hen's egg that takes center stage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

32213.name: stuffed Cait Sith
32213.col_2: Those expecting this stuffed creature to start shouting through a voice amplification device and riding a remarkably burly moogle may be disappointed.

32214.name: antique sink
32214.col_2: If by “antique” one means “very old and likely to break at any moment,” this sink has been accurately described.

32215.name: spring meadow partition
32215.col_2: If one wishes to experience the joys of spring, this partition should be just the ticket. Alternatively, one could try stepping outside, assuming that it is currently the correct season.

32216.name: Ishgardian stove
32216.col_2: Perhaps not quite as stable as one would like, considering that it is likely to contain burning coals and have a pot of boiling liquid balanced precariously on top.

32217.name: extra-stuffed Carbuncle
32217.col_2: How much more stuffed could this be? The answer is none. None more stuffed.

32218.name: pair of Carbuncle house slippers
32218.col_2: “Don't get me wrong, I like Carbuncles. I just don't want them on my feet, that's all.”<hex:02100103>─A bemused arcanist

32219.name: iron torch
32219.col_2: Give your home that authentic “scary castle” feel, but make sure the room is well ventilated to avoid smoke inhalation.

32220.name: Major-General cushion
32220.col_2: It's a shark. With legs. And is also a cushion.

32221.name: rose trellis
32221.col_2: Keeps even the wildest of roses neatly organized.

32222.name: dragon icon
32222.col_2: One may struggle to fit a statue of a large golden dragon wrapped around an expensive-looking indigo orb into their existing décor without spending large amounts of gil on suitably opulent furnishings to match.

32223.name: royal lion
32223.col_2: It may be best to consider this as half of a matching pair, as a single lion statue tends to look a bit lonely by itself.

32224.name: swag valance
32224.col_2: “This room has too much...wall. We should cover some of it in cloth.”<hex:02100103>─Unknown furnishing connoisseur

32225.name: rustic chocobo counter
32225.col_2: Bring the delights of a genuine chocobo stable to the inside of your home, complete with that unmistakable aroma.

32226.name: wood slat partition
32226.col_2: Useful for when one wishes to block something from view while still being able to see it.

32227.name: homemade cookie set
32227.col_2: This decorative ornament is ideal for giving guests the impression that one is an accomplished culinarian. Little will they know that the “dough” is in fact entirely inedible.

32228.name: florist's counter
32228.col_2: For some reason, the name “flowermonger” never quite caught on.

32229.name: paissa swing chair
32229.col_2: For those who wish to be gently rocked by a hanging piece of furniture resembling the most terrifying creature in the known world.

32230.name: showcase
32230.col_2: The lack of shelves makes this case ideally suited to displaying larger objects, unless one prefers to crouch while observing smaller ornaments.

32231.name: shelving showcase
32231.col_2: Ready to be filled with countless trophies, provided one is gifted enough to earn them in the first place.

32232.name: elemental wheel
32232.col_2: Depicts the intrinsic relationships between the six elements, which govern all life on this star, and probably a few other stars to boot.

32233.name: toy showcase
32233.col_2: It appears that stuffed animals have infested this showcase, which is normally reserved for more austere pieces of ornamentation.

32234.name: apparel showcase
32234.col_2: Some people like others to see their items of finery even when they are not being worn.

32235.name: armament showcase
32235.col_2: While such arms are largely displayed for heraldic purposes, they would still come in handy in a pinch.

32236.name: art showcase
32236.col_2: Provides fine pieces of art some degree of protection from the sticky hands of overly curious children.

32237.name: baked goods showcase
32237.col_2: Though some people may be baffled by the idea of using pastries as ornaments, this display case is not for those people.

32238.name: the White Tiger
32238.col_2: Features the fearsome Byakko of Eastern legend. It seems he could leap from the canvas at any moment, and given his near-unlimited powers, he may do just that.

32239.name: queen's warrior piece
32239.col_2: Guarding a queen is certainly not an easy job, but it does come with the unexpected perk of possibly being immortalized in the form of a household ornament.

32240.name: queen's knight piece
32240.col_2: Though knights are known for standing their ground, their ability to remain steadfast is somewhat hindered by the three little wheels at the base, which all seem to want to roll off in a different direction.

32241.name: Season Seventeen Lone Wolf trophy
32241.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Seventeen of the Feast.

32242.name: toymaker's show window
32242.col_2: A perfect demonstration of one's toy-making abilities, or perhaps “toy-buying” abilities.

32243.name: designer's show window
32243.col_2: Placing anything in a glass display case has the effect of making it appear expensive and luxurious, which many designers rely on to justify their ludicrously high prices.

32244.name: smith's show window
32244.col_2: In case of emergency, smash glass and commence hacking and slashing.

32245.name: artist's show window
32245.col_2: Though it is customary to charge for admission to art exhibitions, passersby can experience these works of fine art for free.

32246.name: baker's show window
32246.col_2: When the sunlight hits the glass at the right angle, it has the effect of keeping the bread inside warm.

32247.name: snow-dusted tree
32247.col_2: Few realize the “snow” that rests on the boughs is in fact cake icing.

32248.name: parkside tree
32248.col_2: The parkside quality of this tree does depend rather heavily on its vicinity to a park.

32249.name: square of brick paving
32249.col_2: All these squares make a square.

32250.name: La Noscean grape pergola
32250.col_2: This wooden frame gives grape vines the means to climb to greater heights, in a quite literal sense.

32251.name: fruitful fountain
32251.col_2: Where most fountains would produce an upward-pointing spray of water, this one includes what experts call an “arboreal protrusion.”

32252.name: unit of herringbone flooring
32252.col_2: Most herring would argue that their bones bear little resemblance to this flooring design.

32253.name: skylight chandelier
32253.col_2: This exquisite piece utilizes natural sunlight to provide illumination. How it continues to work at night, however, is a closely guarded secret.

32254.name: varied wood interior wall
32254.col_2: While the wooden pieces may appear to be randomly placed, there is method in the madness. Or possibly madness in the method.

32255.name: set of small florist's walls
32255.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to bedeck their home with an abundance of flowers. Allergy sufferers beware.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

32256.name: set of medium florist's walls
32256.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to bedeck their home with an abundance of flowers─and be forever dusting the pollen from their deck chairs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

32257.name: set of large florist's walls
32257.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to bedeck their home with an abundance of flowers. Note that certain flora are known to attract murderbees.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

32812.name: bag of carnation seeds
32812.col_2: Given the right conditions, these seeds will produce near endless amounts of beautiful carnations. Assuming that is, that the bag has been correctly labeled. If not, they may very well produce man-eating morbols...or worse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

32813.name: bouquet of red carnations
32813.col_2: A bunch of red carnations, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

32814.name: bouquet of blue carnations
32814.col_2: A bunch of blue carnations, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

32817.col_2: A bunch of orange carnations, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

32821.col_2: A bunch of multicolored carnations, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

32822.name: sheet of Emerald plating
32822.col_2: A hunk of verdant metal torn from the Emerald Weapon.

32823.name: set of Emerald barding
32823.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Emerald Weapon.

32824.name: set of queen's guard barding
32824.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor modeled after that worn by a legendary queen's personal guard─willingly and otherwise.

32825.name: set of authentic Starlight barding
32825.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor as worn by those legendary birds said to carry gifts from the stars. In fact, it was borrowed directly from one of the aforementioned legendary birds, making it as authentic as it can possibly be.

32826.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Concealing Meals<hex:021A020103>
32826.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to best conceal Eastern foodstuffs about one's person in the likely event the hors d'oeuvres on offer are insufficient to sate one's hunger. Use to learn the /riceball emote.

32827.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Apples with Aplomb<hex:021A020103>
32827.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Apples with Aplomb<hex:021A020103>
32827.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to enjoy a delicious apple while projecting an air of unassailable dignity in spite of your squirrel-like gnawing. Use to learn the /eatapple emote.

32828.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Good Will Seeking<hex:021A020103>
32828.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Good Will Seeking<hex:021A020103>
32828.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to bring oneself into the good graces of others. Use to learn the /wringhands emote.

32829.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Next, Godliness<hex:021A020103>
32829.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to operate the quaint device known as a “broom” in event of dire circumstances involving the absence of one's servants. Use to learn the /broom emote.

32830.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Decadent Decoration<hex:021A020103>
32830.col_2: An illustrated manual explaining the ideal method for painting over pesky or potentially haunted patterns in one's wallpaper. Use to learn the /paintblack, /paintred, /paintblue, and /paintyellow emotes.

32831.name: forgotten fragment of contention
32831.col_2: A single, unidentified memory of the lost.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Resistance rank required for appraisal: 15<hex:02100103>Potential memories contained: Pure Essence of the Duelist, Lost Rend Armor

32832.name: forgotten fragment of finesse
32832.col_2: A single, unidentified memory of the lost.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Resistance rank required for appraisal: 15<hex:02100103>Potential memories contained: Pure Essence of the Fiendhunter, Lost Dervish

32833.name: forgotten fragment of fortitude
32833.col_2: A single, unidentified memory of the lost.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Resistance rank required for appraisal: 15<hex:02100103>Potential memories contained: Pure Essence of the Indomitable, Lost Aethershield

32834.name: forgotten fragment of divinity
32834.col_2: A single, unidentified memory of the lost.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Resistance rank required for appraisal: 15<hex:02100103>Potential memories contained: Pure Essence of the Divine, Lost Seraph Strike

32835.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Early to Rise<hex:021A020103>
32835.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Early to Rise<hex:021A020103>
32835.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for weaving a simple-yet-elegant braid that can be employed by even those who are not yet fully awake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

32836.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Sharlayan Studies<hex:021A020103>
32836.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this limited edition of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques on transforming yourself into the prominent─some would say <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> prominent─member of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, Alphinaud Leveilleur.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

32837.name: snowman bell
32837.col_2: For some reason, ringing this bell summons forth a behatted and begloved embodiment of festive cheer. With that in mind, it would be rather a shame <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> to ring it.

32838.name: Lunar Whale identification key
32838.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near the Lunar Whale will grant you access to its voluminous belly, which is not nearly as awful as it may sound.

32839.name: Eden crystal
32839.col_2: Raising this enigmatic gem aloft will summon forth a miniaturized version of the progenitor of all sin eaters, which may or may not be a good idea...

32840.name: Cerberus horn
32840.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ominous tone that calls forth a hellacious, three-headed beast.

32841.name: big shell whistle
32841.col_2: This whistle emits a shrill tone that is said to summon a big shell, and presumably some sort of creature inside said shell.

32842.name: Arion horn
32842.col_2: This undeniably divine horn emits a rumbling tone that calls a six-legged steed to your side. Any nearby farriers will be rubbing their hands with glee at the profits they stand to make.

32843.name: emerald gwiber trumpet
32843.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons a gwiber clad in emerald scale from its refuge.

32844.name: prototype roader identification key
32844.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your prototype roader will bring it flailing and thrashing to life.

32845.name: chocorpokkur whistle
32845.col_2: This whistle emits a slightly saccharine tone that is said to summon a creature that defies description, other than the fact it is mostly comprised of chocolate.

32846.name: Gabriel Mark III identification key
32846.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Gabriel Mark III will bring it to life.

32847.name: much-coveted Mora
32847.col_2: Few wavekin have ever been the object of so much anticipation, only to be followed by such crushing disappointment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the much-coveted Mora minion.

32848.name: Syldrion-class insubmersible
32848.col_2: Unlike the craft on which it is modeled, it will break immediately upon coming into contact with water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Syldrion-class insubmersible minion.

32849.name: wind-up Gaia
32849.col_2: Those who think the hammer is just for show had best watch their toes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Gaia minion.

32850.name: wind-up Palom
32850.col_2: Try not to break it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Palom minion.

32851.name: wind-up Porom
32851.col_2: The rosy cheeks and pronounced eyelashes indicate that this is the female half of a matching pair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Porom minion.

32852.name: wind-up Edge
32852.col_2: Based on one of the few people who had the chance to be a prince <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> a ninja, which seems like too much fun to squeeze into one lifetime.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Edge minion.

32853.name: wind-up Rydia
32853.col_2: Not to be confused with a sprig of broccoli.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Rydia minion.

32854.name: wind-up Rosa
32854.col_2: Based on the central corner of a one-sided love triangle, if such a thing is possible.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Rosa minion.

32855.name: Save the Princess
32855.col_2: For every person who has ever dreamed of owning a wheeled, spindly legged, trumpet-blowing mammet, there is this wheeled, spindly legged, trumpet-blowing mammet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Save the Princess minion.

32856.name: Drippy
32856.col_2: With a will to wander the world, one wonders whether said world will welcome this well-meaning watery whelp.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Drippy minion.

32857.name: Trike
32857.col_2: Very affectionate, but be prepared to make a quick sidestep if it comes running to greet you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Trike minion.

32858.name: golden beaver
32858.col_2: Remember: all that glitters is not gold. Sometimes, it is a beaver.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the golden beaver minion.

32859.name: magicked prism (bomb head)
32859.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Gives the impression that one's head is large, orange, and bulbous, which may be an improvement in some cases.

32860.name: magicked prism (numeral 0)
32860.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Causes a large “O” to appear in midair. Or is that an “O”?

32861.name: magicked prism (numeral 1)
32861.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Causes a large “1” to appear in midair.

32862.name: magicked prism (numeral 2)
32862.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Causes a large “2” to appear in midair.

32863.name: magicked prism (numeral 3)
32863.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Causes a large “3” to appear in midair.

32864.name: magicked prism (numeral 4)
32864.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Causes a large “4” to appear in midair.

32865.name: magicked prism (numeral 5)
32865.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Causes a large “5” to appear in midair.

32866.name: mirage gear coffer (IL 400)
32866.col_2: A banded chest containing a full set of mirage gear.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 70. IL: 400. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

32867.name: Whalaqee Angel's Snack totem
32867.col_2: An intricately carved wooden totem imbued with the secrets of a potent healing technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use by blue mages.

32868.name: Whalaqee Dragon Force totem
32868.col_2: An intricately carved wooden totem imbued with the secrets of a defensive technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use by blue mages.

32869.name: Whalaqee Matra Magic totem
32869.col_2: An intricately carved wooden totem imbued with the secrets of a long-ranged offensive technique.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use by blue mages.

32870.name: Heavensturn of the Tiger ticket
32870.col_2: An ornamented piece of parchment recognizing services rendered to this year's bugyo.

32871.name: painting of the New Nest
32871.col_2: A painting of the New Nest based off your own observations.

32872.name: painting of Featherfall
32872.col_2: A painting of Featherfall based off your own observations.

32873.name: painting of the Risensong Quarter
32873.col_2: A painting of the Risensong Quarter based off your own observations.

32874.name: painting of the Firmament
32874.col_2: A painting of the Firmament based off your own observations.

32876.name: suit of ornate exarchic mail of maiming
32876.description: suits of ornate exarchic mail of maiming

32882.name: grade 4 skybuilders' zagas khaal
32882.col_2: To Eorzeans, the name may seem rather exotic, but the fish itself is as plain as can be.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32883.name: grade 4 skybuilders' goldsmith crab
32883.col_2: Though it may be named for the deftness with which it uses its claws as tools to methodically dismantle its prey, perhaps “butcher crab” would be a more fitting appellation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32884.name: grade 4 skybuilders' common bitterling
32884.col_2: Given the exacting standards of the skybuilders, the artisanal grade 4 variety of this species is anything but common.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32885.name: grade 4 skybuilders' skyloach
32885.col_2: The ability to fly puts the skyloach rather higher in the hierarchy of wavekin than its water-bound brethren.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32886.name: grade 4 skybuilders' glacier core
32886.col_2: Despite being an entity of unknown origin and possessed of mysterious powers, it nevertheless has a habit of getting caught on fishers' hooks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32887.name: grade 4 skybuilders' kissing fish
32887.col_2: Its kissing days are over.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32888.name: grade 4 skybuilders' cavalry catfish
32888.col_2: While this catfish may─according to the rumors─be able to split a horse in two, perhaps the ability to cut through a fisher's line would have proved more useful.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32889.name: grade 4 skybuilders' manasail
32889.col_2: Only when the manasail dips below its usual high altitude does it find itself within range of a fisher's line. This probably explains why they do not do it more often.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32890.name: grade 4 skybuilders' starflower
32890.col_2: In the grand scheme of things, perhaps a flying mollusk is not so strange after all.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32891.name: grade 4 skybuilders' cyan crab
32891.col_2: It is common for creatures to be named for their color, but since “blue crab” was already taken, this species was granted somewhat more fanciful nomenclature.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32892.name: grade 4 skybuilders' fickle krait
32892.col_2: It seems the skybuilders seek this particular variety of snake for its deadly venom. Exactly why they require deadly venom is a question best left unanswered, but it is clandestine plots such as these that keep food tasters in work.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32893.name: grade 4 skybuilders' proto-hropken
32893.col_2: These ferocious wavekin have a tendency to scare away more desirable fish. As such, the skybuilders seek to thin their numbers, preferably to zero.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32894.name: grade 4 skybuilders' ghost faerie
32894.col_2: While some wavekin are able to change their color to blend in with their surroundings, the ghost faerie takes this one step further by being almost entirely transparent. In a cruel twist of fate, this also makes it almost impossible for them to find a mate, which goes some way to explaining their scarcity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32895.name: grade 4 skybuilders' ashfish
32895.col_2: When it was first discovered, the ghostly coloration of this species led many to believe it was a waterborne ashkin. It was some time before anyone plucked up the courage to actually try eating one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32896.name: grade 4 skybuilders' whitehorse
32896.col_2: While it may not be a horse, it <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> white, so at least that part of its name is accurate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32897.name: grade 4 skybuilders' ocean cloud
32897.col_2: Before it was first caught, fishers believed it to be a cloud drifting under the water's surface, despite the fact that would be next to impossible.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32898.name: grade 4 skybuilders' black fanfish
32898.col_2: This wavekin's dark coloration serves as camouflage in the ocean depths, but the effect is lost if it ventures into shallower waters. There is also the fact that its internal organs will rupture due to the changes in water pressure, as if any further discouragement were needed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32899.name: grade 4 skybuilders' sunfish
32899.col_2: The legends speak of the sunfish aiding those stranded at sea to shore by letting them ride on its back. The skybuilders have decided to return the favor by catching and eating it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32900.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' sweatfish
32900.col_2: Said to have been created from the beads of sweat that gathered on the Dawn Father and Dusk Mother's foreheads, the unfortunate name has made these delicious little fish rather difficult to sell.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32901.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' sculptor
32901.col_2: The sculptor's sawlike rostrum is often placed next to the meat of the fish for identification purposes at market.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32902.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' little Thalaos
32902.col_2: Though this wavekin is unaware that it was named after the beast of legend, it certainly seems to relish playing the part.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32903.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' lightning chaser
32903.col_2: Like its brethren the storm chaser, this fish uses gas expelled from its rectum as a crude means of propulsion. As its name would suggest, it spends much of its time chasing lightning bolts, though with little success due to the ludicrously slow pace at which it moves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32904.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' marrella
32904.col_2: The heavily armored protrusions that extend from what is presumably its head seem to be entirely at odds with the fact its innards are completely exposed. Some might consider this species to be an evolutionary dead end, yet it continues to survive to this day.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32905.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' crimson namitaro
32905.col_2: Experts believe its enormous dorsal fin is used to repel creatures that enter its territory. This is also the part that often gets caught on a fisher's hook, so perhaps it is more of a hindrance than a help.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32906.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' griffin
32906.col_2: One would be forgiven for assuming the skybuilders were only joking when they requested a griffin be brought to them. Unfortunately─and inexplicably─they were deadly serious.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32907.name: grade 4 artisanal skybuilders' meganeura
32907.col_2: Practically anything with “mega” in its name is bound to be big, and this overgrown dragonfly is no exception.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32933.col_2: Practically anything with “mega” in its name is bound to be big, and this overgrown dragonfly is no exception.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

32936.name: solstice ingot
32936.col_2: A large block of solid crystal, ready to be chiseled into whatever form the craftsman desires.

32937.name: bolt of saffron cloth
32937.col_2: Finely woven cloth dyed a vibrant orange with gardenia fruit, rather than the expensive spice after which the color was named.

32938.name: circle of thylacoleo leather
32938.col_2: A large piece of cured thylacoleo skin.

32939.name: bottle of grade 4 strength alkahest
32939.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32940.name: bottle of grade 4 dexterity alkahest
32940.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32941.name: bottle of grade 4 vitality alkahest
32941.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32942.name: bottle of grade 4 intelligence alkahest
32942.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32943.name: bottle of grade 4 mind alkahest
32943.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32944.name: clump of horsetail
32944.col_2: A robust grass resembling a horse's tail, often used as an abrasive.

32945.name: chunk of aluminum ore
32945.col_2: A sizable piece of rock containing traces of the metal aluminum.

32946.name: pinch of workbench refining sand
32946.col_2: This all-in-one abrasive, created for craftsmen of all disciplines─and even some with no discipline whatsoever─can be used to both sand metals and polish them to a lustrous sheen.

32947.name: gardenia fruit
32947.col_2: Originating in the Far East, the fruit may be dried and used to dye cloth.

32948.name: thylacoleo skin
32948.col_2: The hide of the thylacoleo─a primitive beastkin predator.

32949.name: phial of spirit extract
32949.col_2: The condensed aether of a once-living being. The essence of its essence, so to speak.

32950.name: silver beech log
32950.col_2: A rough-cut log of silver beech timber.

32951.name: chunk of dolomite
32951.col_2: A semi-translucent rock containing the rare mineral dolomite.

32952.name: solstice stone
32952.col_2: A mysterious crystal of purest white.

32953.name: raindrop cotton boll
32953.col_2: The cotton produced by this particular species is said to be as delicate to the touch as a raindrop. Unfortunately, this makes it rather difficult to pick without crushing the boll.

32954.name: handful of wattle petribark
32954.col_2: Though this bark has a number of uses, being in an apparently semi-fossilized state does make it somewhat troublesome to work with.

32955.name: bottle of hard water
32955.col_2: To the layman, hard water may sound like a convoluted way to say “ice,” but experts would disagree. In any case, it is at least soft enough to be poured into and out of a bottle.

32956.name: loathsome memory of the dying
32956.col_2: The loathsome memory of a departed soul, forever trapped in crystal.

32957.name: haunting memory of the dying
32957.col_2: The haunting memory of a departed soul, forever trapped in crystal.

32958.name: vexatious memory of the dying
32958.col_2: The vexatious memory of a departed soul, forever trapped in crystal.

32959.name: timeworn artifact
32959.col_2: The delicate carving on this ancient artifact belies its pre-excavation position amidst so much midden.

32960.name: phial of aetherial sealant
32960.col_2: A compound whose primary ingredient, aetherial siltstone, was said to have been used to fashion crystal foci in ancient Bozja.

32961.name: authentic Starlight Celebration MMXVIII advertisement
32961.col_2: A commissioned painting which depicts the Starlight Celebration choir and their delighted audience. It is so authentic that snow was used instead of white paint, although this soon melted, revealing the white canvas below.

32962.name: authentic Starlight roll cake
32962.col_2: Two cream-filled sponge cakes complete with strawberries on top. While it may not be the most obvious choice for a festive treat, the color scheme certainly conjures up images of the Starlight Celebration. The authenticity extends to the cream inside, which contains actual snow, although this does dilute the flavor somewhat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

32963.name: authentic Starlight goobbue wreath
32963.col_2: A stuffed goobbue sits within a festive wreath, its mouth agape, ready to devour your soul. It is so authentic that the makers claim it is made from genuine goobbue pieces, although it is probably best not to dwell on exactly what that entails.

32964.name: authentic Heavensturn bounty
32964.col_2: A traditional Heavensturn decoration meant to beckon fortune through its depiction of a traditional bumper crop of rice, traditionally infested by mice. In addition to the stuffed mouse included, it also attracts living mice, which some may find to be a nuisance, but it nevertheless adds to the overall authenticity of the piece.

32965.name: authentic chocolate fountain
32965.col_2: Complete with a range of fruit and other sweet treats. Just try not to get any chocolate on the upholstery. While the creators claim that the parts pertaining to the fountain itself are entirely authentic, they make no such claims regarding the chocolate, which raises concerns as to what it actually is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

32966.name: authentic Eastern stage
32966.col_2: The festivities never need come to an end with this stage adorned with peach blossoms. While the exterior is considered to be entirely authentic, the same cannot be said for the interior, but as the saying goes, “It's what's on the outside that counts.”

32967.name: authentic Little Ladies' Day banner
32967.col_2: A princess needs no crown when this banner exists to always remind them how special they are. The feelings of undeniable specialness are─according to the makers, at least─rather authentic.

32968.name: authentic stuffed rabbit
32968.col_2: This rabbit looks as if he walked straight out of a storybook, and is prepared to keep on walking. (Please contact authorities immediately in the event that the toy actually demonstrates ambulatory capabilities.) Although the makers claim it to be extremely authentic, when it comes to stuffed animals, perhaps the less authentic, the better.

32969.name: authentic Hatching-tide MMXVIII advertisement
32969.col_2: A cheerful hand-painted notice proclaiming the eggcellence of Hatching-tide. The feelings of guilt one eggsperiences when making egg-based puns in the vicinity of this poster are eggstremely authentic.

32970.name: chunk of rarefied pyrite
32970.col_2: Though widely disparaged as fool's gold, there are certain obsessive miners who would trade sacks of genuine precious metal for this glorious hunk of iron and sulphur.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32971.name: chunk of rarefied chalcocite
32971.col_2: “If you can't recognize the beauty inherent in its orthorhombic crystal system, then we can't be friends.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32972.name: chunk of rarefied limonite
32972.col_2: Artistic collectors will swoon over the lustrous ochre pigment that can be produced from this seemingly unremarkable rock of iron ore.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32973.name: bottle of rarefied Abalathian spring water
32973.description: bottles of rarefied Abalathian spring water
32973.col_2: Vanu shamans collect spring water to make the paste they apply to their beaks before rituals. Some Vanu shamans are very, <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> particular about their spring water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32974.name: handful of rarefied aurum regis sand
32974.description: handfuls of rarefied aurum regis sand
32974.col_2: When the aether of one's opus must <hex:021A020203>flow<hex:021A020103> unimpeded, one cannot skimp on the conductive component of one's ink.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32975.name: rarefied raw triphane
32975.col_2: The potential value of this uncut stone is obvious to the practiced eye. Especially if you love yellow.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32976.name: rarefied raw star spinel
32976.col_2: Rubies are red. Sapphires are blue. Star spinels are more of a violet, though, and that's the hue glinting from within this promising stone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32977.name: rarefied raw kyanite
32977.col_2: “If I can cut this just so, it will provide the perfect accent for a rather rakish turban I've been weaving...”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32978.name: rarefied raw azurite
32978.col_2: Be sure to don your swimming trunks before losing yourself in the deep, deep blue of this entrancing raw gemstone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32979.name: chunk of rarefied silvergrace ore
32979.col_2: “It's beautiful! Stunning! Magnificent! Now find me three more.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32980.name: chunk of rarefied titancopper ore
32980.col_2: Never has titanium and copper existed in a more harmonious blend of minerals. It promises to make a wonderful teapot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32981.name: rarefied raw lazurite
32981.col_2: One day, this unfinished gemstone of clearest blue could grace an elegant ring or an exquisite necklace or a face-smashing fist weapon. Possibilities!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32982.name: rarefied raw petalite
32982.col_2: Not quite clear and not quite white, you're not quite sure why the jewel hiding in this rock is so valuable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32983.name: pinch of rarefied sea salt
32983.col_2: “Don't you <hex:021A020203>dare<hex:021A020103> throw that over your shoulder. Here, use the table salt.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32984.name: chunk of rarefied reef rock
32984.col_2: They say reef rock has been procured for restoration projects in a certain snowbound city. Perhaps this perfectly porous piece is destined for a structure of “holey” importance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32985.name: rarefied raw onyx
32985.col_2: Even in its rough, natural form, the shimmering blackness of this jewel is almost dangerously captivating. So...pretty...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32986.name: chunk of rarefied tungsten ore
32986.col_2: A truly precious find for one invested in the finest facets of tungsten-based fabrication.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32987.name: pinch of rarefied Gyr Abanian alumen
32987.description: pinches of rarefied Gyr Abanian alumen
32987.col_2: “Well, tan my hide! You must have spent <hex:021A020203>weeks<hex:021A020103> in the mountains of Eastern Aldenard looking for this stuff.” <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32988.name: handful of rarefied mythrite sand
32988.col_2: Unconfirmed rumors tell of an eccentric Lalafell with plans to use these glowing grains to build a private beach. She'll probably need a few more handfuls...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32989.name: bottle of rarefied Gyr Abanian mineral water
32989.description: bottles of rarefied Gyr Abanian mineral water
32989.col_2: Should probably be saved for the concoction of valuable reisui, but it <hex:021A020203>does<hex:021A020103> make for a tasty cup of buckwheat tea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32990.name: chunk of rarefied bluespirit ore
32990.col_2: If this mineral was any aether-richer, it would have to pay taxes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32991.name: handful of rarefied manasilver sand
32991.col_2: The customer requesting this liquid-like sand was oddly specific about the number of grains in the handful.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32992.name: pot of rarefied dark chestnut sap
32992.description: pots of rarefied dark chestnut sap
32992.col_2: Rather than experiment with amusing applications for this superior sticky substance, it's perhaps best to relinquish it to a tree sap professional.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32993.name: rarefied dark chestnut log
32993.col_2: Gazing upon this rough-cut log, you cannot help but wonder if its lustrous lumber is destined for a valiant knight's lance or a bilge-bottomed buccaneer's bar stool. Anyone's guess, really.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32994.name: rarefied dark chestnut branch
32994.col_2: “Aye, 'twould make a fine sentinel's longbow. But see, I have this prior commission to craft a fishing rod. N-No, that's not my penmanship!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32995.name: rarefied dark chestnut
32995.col_2: A champion among chestnuts, predestined for the summit of a Sohm Al tart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32996.name: lump of rarefied dark chestnut resin
32996.description: lumps of rarefied dark chestnut resin
32996.col_2: The viscous lifeblood you extracted from a vigorous yet defenseless chestnut tree. You monster.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32997.name: rarefied larch log
32997.col_2: You wonder if the fact that “larch log” is fun to say has anything to do with its inherent collectability.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32998.name: rarefied shiitake mushroom
32998.col_2: Only the finest fungi are foraged for fancy Far Eastern feast tables.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

32999.name: pot of rarefied larch sap
32999.col_2: Larch...sap. No, not nearly so fun to say as “larch log” but apparently just as collectable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33000.name: pot of rarefied pine resin
33000.col_2: Unsurprisingly, this exceptionally gooey mass is a prime ingredient in certain beetle-based adhesives.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33001.name: rarefied pine log
33001.col_2: Almost unnaturally straight and true, this log will hopefully be processed into lumber for a future masterpiece of carpentry...and not thrown into some chilly lordling's fireplace.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33002.name: rarefied pixie apple
33002.col_2: One bite of this almost unbearably sweet fruit will have you flitting about like a pollen-drunk pixie.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33003.name: rarefied white oak log
33003.col_2: A difficult material to work with, any artisan would nevertheless be eager to craft an enduring handle or lasting piece of furniture from this marvelous hunk of hardwood.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33004.name: rarefied miracle apple log
33004.col_2: The real miracle here is that any of these trees were left standing after a sudden and inexplicable surge in the demand for applewood staves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33005.name: rarefied sandteak log
33005.col_2: After being carved and then covered with exquisitely woven wool, this attractive lump of timber could serve as the elegant display stand for some staggeringly expensive─and rarely worn─neckwear.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33006.name: strip of rarefied kelp
33006.col_2: “Yes, an oriental breakfast is generally a simple affair, but that doesn't mean one should settle for any old seaweed in the sea.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33007.name: sprig of rarefied Amber cloves
33007.col_2: Once dried and enshrined in a sturdy jar, these flavorsome flower buds will take pride of place on a master chef's spice shelf.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33008.name: piece of rarefied coral
33008.col_2: “This is it! The perfect piece of coral to complement my perfect coral butterfly. My aquarium is complete!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33009.name: rarefied urunday log
33009.col_2: Compared to your average cut of timber, the quality of this log is the difference between urunight and urunday.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33010.name: rarefied rainbow cotton boll
33010.col_2: Is it gold? Is it blue? Or mayhap green? Folk will spend all day arguing over the color of a dress made from these prismatic cotton fibers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33011.name: tuft of rarefied bloodhemp
33011.col_2: Either this is the bloodiest bloodhemp you've ever harvested, or some small vermin with terrible situational awareness came between the plant and your scythe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33012.name: clump of rarefied bright flax
33012.col_2: This incredibly hardy plant specimen is able to thrive under almost any conditions...except one populated by single-minded botanists.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33013.name: pinch of rarefied night pepper
33013.col_2: Guaranteed to make you sneeze. Just...aim it away from the cooking pot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

33027.col_2: A large piece of cured calf hide.

33037.name: pleasant dot parasol
33037.col_2: Should the weather prove so inclement, the skies so heavy with rain, that one is forced to rely upon a parasol, can it truly be called pleasant? (Yes. Just look at the name.) Use to acquire a pleasant dot parasol.

33038.name: prim dot parasol
33038.col_2: Whether or not this parasol could be considered prim rather depends on the person holding it at the time. Use to acquire a prim dot parasol.

33039.name: pastoral dot parasol
33039.col_2: It could be argued that any parasol could be made to appear pastoral if set against a suitably bucolic background. Use to acquire a pastoral dot parasol.

33040.name: gold parasaucer
33040.col_2: Nothing exudes an air of both wealth and whimsy as perfectly as a parasol decorated with stars and sabotenders, or so its creators convinced themselves when conjuring up this madcap design. Use to acquire a gold parasaucer.

33041.name: pair of angel wings
33041.col_2: Perhaps a little <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> realistic. It would be wise to look out for a newly wingless angel seeking revenge. Use to acquire a pair of angel wings.

33042.name: set of brand-new Alphinaud's attire

33149.name: sprig of water mint

33150.name: sprig of wild sage

33151.name: sprig of countess tea leaves

33152.name: chunk of dacite
