33162.name: obsolete resplendent carpenter's component A
33162.col_2: The arboreal aroma is admired by accomplished artisans and aspiring aficionados alike. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33163.name: obsolete resplendent blacksmith's component A
33163.col_2: A glowing golden globule. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33164.name: obsolete resplendent armorer's component A
33164.col_2: Far simpler in design than its extravagant name would suggest. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33165.name: obsolete resplendent goldsmith's component A
33165.col_2: Soapy bubbles in block form. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33166.name: obsolete resplendent leatherworker's component A
33166.col_2: The skin of a blue animal. Maybe. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33167.name: obsolete resplendent weaver's component A
33167.col_2: Only an engineer would refer to a length of thread as a component. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33168.name: obsolete resplendent alchemist's component A
33168.col_2: Of all the liquids found in alchemy, this is one of the least suitably named. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33169.name: obsolete resplendent culinarian's component A
33169.col_2: A curious little box that is tangentially related to the culinary arts, or so the Boutique of Splendors would have you believe. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33170.name: obsolete resplendent carpenter's component B
33170.col_2: Like a flute but without the holes. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33171.name: obsolete resplendent blacksmith's component B
33171.col_2: Can be used in place of legal tender, provided the phrase “It's that or nothing!” is uttered with enough conviction. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33172.name: obsolete resplendent armorer's component B
33172.col_2: The term “cock-a-hoop” originates from a game in which competitors throw objects such as these over the neck of a male chicken. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33173.name: obsolete resplendent goldsmith's component B
33173.col_2: Not only are such objects said to be found on the dark side of the moon, they are available in any color you like. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33174.name: obsolete resplendent leatherworker's component B
33174.col_2: A not-so-neatly folded sheet of beast skin. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33175.name: obsolete resplendent weaver's component B
33175.col_2: While not exactly as resplendent as the name would suggest, it is at least clean. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33176.name: obsolete resplendent alchemist's component B
33176.col_2: One of the few substances in alchemy that is as light as it is heavy. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33177.name: obsolete resplendent culinarian's component B
33177.col_2: This mustard is known as Eulmore's hottest yellow paste. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33178.name: obsolete resplendent carpenter's component C
33178.col_2: A hardened lump of the crimson sap known as “tree blood.” The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33179.name: obsolete resplendent blacksmith's component C
33179.col_2: Just another cog in the machine. Or at least it will be once the rest of the machine has been built around it. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33180.name: obsolete resplendent armorer's component C
33180.col_2: Most armorer's tools do not incorporate sheets of chainmail, but try telling the Boutique of Splendors that. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33181.name: obsolete resplendent goldsmith's component C
33181.col_2: It is not yet known whether this resplendent orb will become the centerpiece in a fine item of jewelry or ground down into dust for a far less glamorous purpose. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33182.name: obsolete resplendent leatherworker's component C
33182.col_2: While this incredibly long strap is an impressive example of leatherworking, calling it resplendent may be something of an exaggeration. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33183.name: obsolete resplendent weaver's component C
33183.col_2: A bolt of cloth this luxurious surely warrants a better name. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33184.name: obsolete resplendent alchemist's component C
33184.col_2: A handful of carbon rods. One for each finger, in fact. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33185.name: obsolete resplendent culinarian's component C
33185.col_2: A small vial of unnamed gloopy stuff. The techniques for creating resplendent tools with this material are sadly out of fashion, making it completely useless to any self-respecting artisan.

33186.name: resplendent carpenter's material A
33186.col_2: A sealed package containing carpenter's materials, most likely wood or something vaguely tree-related, at the very least.

33187.name: resplendent blacksmith's material A
33187.col_2: A crate that makes a dull clanking sound when shaken.

33188.name: resplendent armorer's material A
33188.col_2: This box of armorer's supplies is about as heavy as one might expect. The question is: which will give out first, the bottom of the crate or the carrier's back?

33189.name: resplendent goldsmith's material A
33189.col_2: The clinking sound coming from within is suspiciously similar to that of broken glass. This does not bode well.

33190.name: resplendent leatherworker's material A
33190.col_2: A bundle of leather wrapped in leather, bound with a leather strap.

33191.name: resplendent weaver's material A
33191.col_2: Take care when delving into this sack as there are probably needles inside.

33192.name: resplendent alchemist's material A
33192.col_2: The life of an alchemist tends to be something of a mixed bag, much like the manner in which their supplies are delivered.

33193.name: resplendent culinarian's material A
33193.col_2: The strange way in which the package is twitching indicates the freshness of the ingredients inside, if one takes “fresh” to mean “still alive.”

33194.name: resplendent carpenter's material B
33194.col_2: Though it is not entirely clear what is inside this pot─or indeed, what it is for─the members of the Boutique of Splendors trust your ability to work that out for yourself.

33195.name: resplendent blacksmith's material B
33195.col_2: While blacksmiths tend to specialize in smashing hot bits of metal with a hammer, they are not averse to employing little pots of mysterious gunk from time to time.

33196.name: resplendent armorer's material B
33196.col_2: Presumably the oily substance within is used to reduce scraping between the various pieces of metal, or perhaps for the armorer to smear onto their brow to stop sweat from running into their eyes.

33197.name: resplendent goldsmith's material B
33197.col_2: While the final product may indeed turn out to be resplendent, this murky paste is anything but.

33198.name: resplendent leatherworker's material B
33198.col_2: Quite where this unidentified substance fits into the leatherworker's grand schemes is anyone's guess.

33199.name: resplendent weaver's material B
33199.col_2: According to the Boutique of Splendors, this oily substance can be applied to a weaver's needle to help it glide through the fabric with the greatest of ease. In fairness, the needle never had any trouble doing that in the first place, but perhaps it is best not to question the Boutique's methods.

33200.name: resplendent alchemist's material B
33200.col_2: As with many materials used by alchemists, the recommended use for this substance is, “Throw a good dollop into the mixture and see what happens.”

33201.name: resplendent culinarian's material B
33201.col_2: It is said of this viscous paste that a spoonful a day keeps the chirurgeon away, though that may be largely because of the smell.

33203.name: resplendent blacksmith's material C
33203.col_2: Said to contain a child's laughter.

33204.name: resplendent armorer's material C
33204.col_2: Said to contain the sound of one hand clapping.

33205.name: resplendent goldsmith's material C
33205.col_2: Said to contain the breath of a thousand sighs.

33206.name: resplendent leatherworker's material C
33206.col_2: Said to contain the Spirit of Starlight Past.

33208.name: resplendent alchemist's material C
33208.col_2: Said to contain the sound of a heart breaking.

33209.name: resplendent culinarian's material C
33209.col_2: Said to contain the scent of a summer meadow.

33210.name: resplendent carpenter's final material
33210.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with caustic grey slime.

33211.name: resplendent blacksmith's final material
33211.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with putrid ooze.

33212.name: resplendent armorer's final material
33212.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with halitosis in liquid form.

33213.name: resplendent goldsmith's final material
33213.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with murderous intent trapped in jelly.

33214.name: resplendent leatherworker's final material
33214.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with every nightmare you have ever had condensed into a soothing balm.

33215.name: resplendent weaver's final material
33215.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with lingering regret.

33216.name: resplendent alchemist's final material
33216.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with the echo of a bloodcurdling scream.

33217.name: resplendent culinarian's final material
33217.col_2: A resplendent golden pot filled with frozen fire.

33218.name: Landerwaffe flute
33218.col_2: Appearing to operate by way of an elaborate mechanism, this mysterious flute emits a shrill sound that summons forth Landerwaffe, mechanical dragon of legend.

33219.name: Dravanian scallop
33219.col_2: Found in shallow water, this species of scallop is identifiable by its rugged, cream-colored shell.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

33220.name: strip of cloud kelp
33220.col_2: Found growing in the Sea of Clouds, this variety of kelp is known for its disinfecting properties.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

33221.name: scarlet frog
33221.col_2: Native to Gyr Abania, this frog possesses a poison that induces mild paralysis in those predators that fail to heed its telltale hue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

33222.name: white clam
33222.col_2: Boasting a beautiful, pearlescent shell, this small Far Eastern clam is popularly used for decorative purposes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

33223.name: fragrant sweetfish
33223.col_2: Hailing from the Azim Steppe, this variety of sweetfish has taken to consuming water herbs that imbue its flesh with a tantalizing fragrance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

33224.name: assortment of patient necessities
33224.col_2: From bars of soap to dining utensils, the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace have need of myriad items during their stay.

33225.name: assortment of medical supplies
33225.col_2: An infirmary without medical supplies is no infirmary at all.

33226.name: assortment of rehabilitation aids
33226.col_2: No few patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace suffer from debilitating injuries, and rehabilitation aids are needed to help them recover and regain independence.

33227.name: assortment of high tea essentials
33227.col_2: Tea is good and high tea is better. With this assortment of items, the infirmary will be able to host an event the patients will remember.

33228.name: assortment of art supplies
33228.col_2: Painting is at once relaxing and rehabilitative, and these art supplies will do much good for the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33229.name: set of patient necessity materials
33229.col_2: Cleanliness being paramount, the infirmary can never have too many items such as soap─nor the materials with which they are made.

33230.name: set of medical supply materials
33230.col_2: Being a medical facility, Ser Vaindreau's Grace ever has need of─you guessed it─medical supplies, and these materials are suitable for crafting them.

33231.name: set of rehabilitation aid materials
33231.col_2: These strong and sturdy materials should make strong and sturdy rehabilitation aids for the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33232.name: set of high tea ingredients
33232.col_2: No high tea is complete without scrumptious sweets, and the ingredients needed in their creation, such as syrups, never go astray.

33233.name: set of art supply materials
33233.col_2: If art is like salve for the soul, then these materials are the ingredients for said salve.

33234.name: set of patient necessity components
33234.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting daily necessities for the use of the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33235.name: set of medical supply components
33235.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting medical supplies for the treatment of the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33236.name: set of rehabilitation aid components
33236.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting rehabilitation equipment for the use of the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33237.name: set of high tea components
33237.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting items required for hosting high tea at Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33238.name: set of art supply components
33238.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting art supplies for the enjoyment of the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33239.name: listracanthus
33239.col_2: Those fortunate enough to have seen this primitive species of shark patrolling the waters near the Isle of Ken are invariably puzzled by its flowing mane, which seems to serve no practical purpose whatsoever.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

33240.name: aquamaton
33240.col_2: Those hoping to catch their dinner in Seagazer Shoals are in for a shock if they reel in one of these strange, dwarven contraptions. Apparently, they fetch a high price at market, assuming one can find a buyer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

33241.name: cinder surprise
33241.col_2: These bizarre, steaming-hot creatures inhabit the River of Sand, and on rare occasions, find themselves on anglers' hooks. Said anglers are normally bemused by such an apparently inedible catch, but when desperately searching for sustenance in the arid desert, one takes what one can find.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

33242.name: ealad skaan
33242.col_2: Very rarely caught in Longmirror Lake, the fisher is invariably struck by pangs of guilt at having sunk their hook into such a charming, delicate creature.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

33243.name: Greater Serpent of Ronka
33243.col_2: Fishers who succeed in reeling this enigmatic beast in from the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta will almost certainly come to regret it. Whether that is due to its supposed likeness to a particular mythological, godlike creature, or simply because of its unnerving appearance depends entirely on the fisher.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

33244.name: lancetfish
33244.col_2: Those fishing the waters of the northwest Caliban Gorge are advised that, if they attempt to handle this bellicose wavekin, they should avoid the pointy bits. Many will attest, however, that as practically the entire fish fits that description, it is best to simply give it as wide a berth as possible.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

33245.name: set of small forge's walls
33245.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a forge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

33246.name: set of medium forge's walls
33246.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a forge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

33247.name: set of large forge's walls
33247.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a forge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

33248.name: storm blue interior wall
33248.col_2: A blue interior wall for those estate owners who wish to make a simple statement.

33249.name: roll of cream yellow carpet
33249.col_2: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet in a cozy cream yellow.

33250.name: cloud acorn chandelier
33250.col_2: “Quaint” does not begin to describe this chandelier made with cloud acorns still hanging on the branch.

33251.name: cactuar stool
33251.col_2: A stool designed in the likeness of a cactuar. Perfect for those guests whom you don't want getting too comfortable.

33252.name: cactuar round table
33252.col_2: A round table designed in the likeness of a cactuar. Perfect for those guests whom you don't want getting too comfortable.

33253.name: Diamond Weapon bust
33253.col_2: Arguably more shoulders than bust, but undeniably menacing in either case.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

33254.name: Queen's Rest
33254.col_2: A monument fashioned in the likeness of the holy blade Save the Queen, as sealed in its binding stone.

33255.name: assortment of Hatching-tide confections
33255.col_2: A delightful set of bite-sized morsels of baked chocolate fashioned to resemble spriggans.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33256.name: serving of grilled corn
33256.col_2: Sweet millioncorn on the cob, basted with authentic Hingan soy sauce and broiled over an open flame.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33257.name: stuffed Peerifool
33257.col_2: This stuffed Peerifool is so true to life, you can almost smell the cloying stench.

33258.name: Eastern indoor pond
33258.col_2: Constructed in the Eastern fashion, this pond is hemmed in natural stone and comes with carp swimming gracefully.

33259.name: grocery counter cart
33259.col_2: A mobile kitchen counter designed in the likeness of a wagon, laden with a selection of breads and fresh produce.

33260.name: Azim Steppe phasmascape
33260.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the wide, sweeping landscape of the Azim Steppe in vivid detail.

33261.name: blue moon phasmascape
33261.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays a full moon hanging majestically in the night sky.

33262.name: pair of stuffed android units
33262.col_2: As they stood together as comrades, it is only fitting that 2B and 9S stand together as stuffed toys.

33263.name: wooden reel table
33263.col_2: Formerly used to carry ropes and cables, this wooden reel has been repurposed as a table.

33264.name: violin showcase
33264.col_2: A wooden cabinet custom-made for displaying violins. Comes complete with instruments.

33265.name: aetherolectric guitar
33265.col_2: This instrument, quickly adopted by minstrels and now beloved across Hydaelyn, represents the best that musical magitek has to offer.

33266.name: pub signboard
33266.col_2: When it comes to indicating the presence of a pub, nary a word is needed.

33267.name: windowed partition
33267.col_2: Extending to the ceiling, this partition incorporates a wide rectangular window.

33268.name: Hingan windowed partition
33268.col_2: Extending to the ceiling, this partition incorporates a round Hingan-style window.

33269.name: mushroom lamp
33269.col_2: Grown from a ball of moss, this luminescent mushroom gives off a gentle light.

33270.name: sealed letter
33270.col_2: While the contents are a mystery, whoever reads this letter is certain to regret it for the rest of their days.

33271.name: wooden spiral staircase
33271.col_2: Spiral staircases are ideal for situations where there is insufficient space for conventional stairs.

33272.name: approved Ishgardian lunch
33272.col_2: Tasty and wholesome, this lunch set is said to be a favorite among skybuilders.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Control Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33273.name: country dining set
33273.col_2: Enjoy the bucolic life with this wooden dining set for four, finished with a checkered tablecloth.

33274.name: set of Akadaemia prospectuses
33274.col_2: This collection of brochures provides detailed information to prospective students of the Akadaemia Anyder.

33275.name: icebox
33275.col_2: Rather than with magic or magitek, this wooden box keeps its contents chilled the old-fashioned way─with a large block of ice.

33276.name: red brick counter
33276.col_2: For years, academics have sought to explain why such counters of brick and timber enhance the flavor of liquor. Thus far, they have little to show for their research except ferocious hangovers.

33277.name: Necrologos transcription
33277.col_2: While appearing to be gibberish, the words written within this tome fiendishly incorporate a summoning spell. Readers are advised to exercise caution lest they inadvertently unleash an army of voidsent.

33278.name: cup of hand-poured coffee
33278.col_2: Aromatic coffee brewed by the time-honored pour-over method.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Perception Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33279.name: back bar
33279.col_2: A tall wooden shelf commonly used in taverns to store and display liquor.

33280.name: pixie apple basket
33280.col_2: A basket of pixie apples and a bottle of grape juice, perfect as a palate cleanser or simply a snack.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33281.name: philosopher's stone table
33281.col_2: A round table of polished stone with a tree growing at its center, all of which is said to be conducive to enlightened debate.

33282.name: Crystarium wardrobe
33282.col_2: A simple-yet-elegant wardrobe designed in the Crystarium style, complete with an array of outfits.

33283.name: low bookshelf
33283.col_2: A low, wide bookshelf featuring both open and closed compartments.

33284.name: Qiqirn shelf
33284.col_2: Designed in a Qiqirn motif, this wooden shelf is as charming as it is practical.

33285.name: mogbureau
33285.col_2: A writing table with storage designed in a moogle motif. Do not attempt to remove the pom-pom.

33286.name: bar rack
33286.col_2: A wooden rack for holding a selection of drinks and glasses. Hanging the glasses upside down prevents dust from gathering inside while avoiding chips to the rims.

33287.name: portrait of Gestahl
33287.col_2: A beautiful rendering of a sweet little dog who somehow exudes the air of a tyrannical emperor. But look at how adorable he is!

33288.name: pepperoni pizza set

33289.col_2: A compact, stylish pouch with a strap to be slung over the shoulder, designed with an egg motif perfect for the Hatching-tide season.

33290.name: serving of Costa del Hielo
33290.col_2: A delicious chilled dessert created by the confectioner Nekeke, this icy treat is both refreshing and easy on the waistline, as it largely consists of frozen water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33291.col_2: A wall chronometer designed in a goobbue motif, a dazed look upon the creature's face.

33292.name: armor hanger
33292.col_2: Originally designed for ceremonial purposes for those of the Elezen persuasion, the attachments on the side of the helm allow it to be worn without bending the ears out of shape.

33293.name: mounted dinosaur skull
33293.col_2: In a case of the hunter becoming the hunted, the cranium of this ferocious predator is now doomed to spend eternity in ignominy mounted as a trophy on an adventurer's wall. Its headless body must be rolling in its grave.

33294.name: plot of hydrangeas
33294.col_2: Lush hydrangea bushes with flowers blooming in all their vibrant glory.

33295.name: glade gazebo
33295.col_2: A gazebo designed in the glade fashion.

33296.name: garden tool shelf
33296.col_2: A wooden shelf used for storing gardening implements.

33297.name: Eastern wisteria
33297.col_2: A tree native to the Far East that produces hanging clusters of light-purple flowers, pruned to fit in a garden.

33298.name: Moonfire mask stall
33298.col_2: A stall with an assortment of colorful masks on display, as seen during the Moonfire Faire festivities.

33299.name: forging bench
33299.col_2: An outdoor furnishing perfect for those who prefer to do their smithing out in the open. After all, attempting to do so in an enclosed space does come with the rather bothersome side effects brought on by smoke inhalation.

33300.name: garden anvil
33300.col_2: Best placed outdoors, as it tends to leave rather an undesirable impression on all but the most durable of floors.

33301.name: materiel table
33301.col_2: An outdoor furnishing including an assortment of arms and armor. Ideal for those situations where one finds oneself uttering, “Choose your weapon,” to an unruly houseguest.

33302.name: bunch of fête party balloons
33302.col_2: Seen adorning the Firmament during the Skyrise Celebration, this colorful bunch of balloons is guaranteed to fill the air with festive cheer.

33303.name: fête skyrise balloon
33303.col_2: Seen adorning the Firmament during the Skyrise Celebration, this oversized balloon set upon an elegant mount brings a touch of sophistication to any festive occasion.

33304.name: authentic <hex:021A020203>Sultana's Seven<hex:021A020103> pane
33304.col_2: A faithful recreation of the stained glass artwork that adorned the main stage at Ul'dah's Rising festival. The historic moment when Nanamo Ul Namo and her seven most trusted followers confronted a baying crowd and restored peace to the city is captured in all its glory. Those present at the time of the event have described the determined expressions to be particularly authentic. For aesthetic reasons, however, the artist has wisely chosen not to include the angry mob.

33305.name: authentic water bomb stand
33305.col_2: Bring home this hallmark of the Moonfire Faire and pelt passersby with aquatic surprises from the comfort of your very own front garden! The exasperation experienced by your victims is especially authentic.

33306.name: bag of moth orchid seeds
33306.col_2: Disagreement over whether these seeds thrive best in sunlight or lamplight has ended many a friendship between botanist and naturalist.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

33307.col_2: A bunch of red moth orchids, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

33327.name: G-Warrior MG
33327.col_2: A dynamic tabletop statue based on Garlond Ironworks' G-Warrior. The aethersaber emits sufficient light to be used as a bedside reading lamp, but be warned that touching it may result in severed appendages. The “MG” part of its name supposedly stands for “Master Garlond,” or something along those lines.

33329.name: irregular tomestone of pageantry

33330.name: irregular tomestone of lore
33330.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains knowledge of various events both probable and improbable, intertwining historical fact and flights of fancy to simultaneously amuse and confuse the reader.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

33648.name: Menphina's earring
33648.col_2: Increases EXP earned by 30% when level 80 and below. Attributes and item level vary according to class/job and current level when equipped.

33654.name: chicken suit
33654.col_2: Cannot equip with arm, leg, or foot gear.

33672.name: set of Bozjan barding
33672.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor typical of those used by the Bozjan Resistance.

33673.name: set of Diamond barding
33673.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Diamond Weapon.

33674.name: antelope doe horn
33674.col_2: A small and slender horn that, when blown, will bring your antelope doe springing to your side.

33675.name: antelope stag horn
33675.col_2: A large and elongated horn that, when blown, will bring your antelope stag springing to your side.

33676.name: Al-iklil identification key
33676.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Al-iklil will magically bring the machine to life.

33677.name: Cruise Chaser identification key
33677.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Cruise Chaser will magically bring the machine to life.

33678.name: island mandragora
33678.col_2: With just a single exposure to the sunlight outside of your bag, this island mandragora shall be primed to bear you forth like the most cacophonous of steeds.

33679.name: island Onion Prince
33679.col_2: With just a single exposure to the sunlight outside of your bag, this island Onion Prince shall be primed to bear you forth like the most flavorful of steeds.

33680.name: island Eggplant Knight
33680.col_2: With just a single exposure to the sunlight outside of your bag, this island Eggplant Knight shall be primed to bear you forth like the purplest of steeds.

33681.name: island Garlic Jester
33681.col_2: With just a single exposure to the sunlight outside of your bag, this island Garlic Jester shall be primed to bear you forth like the most pungent of steeds.

33682.name: island Tomato King
33682.col_2: With just a single exposure to the sunlight outside of your bag, this island Tomato King shall be primed to bear you forth like the juiciest of steeds.

33683.name: island Mandragora Queen
33683.col_2: With just a single exposure to the sunlight outside of your bag, this island Mandragora Queen shall be primed to bear you forth like the noblest of steeds.

33684.name: deinonychus horn
33684.col_2: This horn of bone emits a primitive sound that summons forth your deinonychus to outwit your prey.

33685.name: diamond gwiber trumpet
33685.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits an ethereal tone that beckons a gwiber clad in diamantine scale from its refuge.

33686.name: polar bear horn
33686.col_2: Though cold to the touch, this horn emits a heartwarming sound that summons your polar bear, all without needing to resort to using its favorite sweets.

33687.name: gilded mikoshi flute
33687.col_2: The trill of this fin-carved flute will summon a squad of gilded Namazu to bear you upon a gilded mikoshi─all of which is as gaudy as it sounds.

33688.name: golden Ronkan flute
33688.col_2: This whistle emits a sublime tone that summons forth the Resplendent Vessel of Ronka, pre-filled with divinity, majestic and blinding, for your worshipping convenience.

33689.name: magicked card
33689.col_2: Crafted by the realm's foremost goldsmith, this enchanted ridable Triple Triad card will take you wonder by wonder, over, sideways, and under.

33690.name: gull
33690.col_2: Has a keen eye for finding schools of fish─and unguarded meals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the gull minion.

33691.name: anteater
33691.col_2: Definitely not a man-eater, otherwise that's what it would be called...right?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the anteater minion.

33692.name: dolphin calf
33692.col_2: Has more intelligence in a single winsome flipper than you do in your whole body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the dolphin calf minion.

33693.name: magitek predator F1
33693.col_2: Comes complete with pilot and stands ready to wreak havoc among the enemy's ranks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the magitek predator F1 minion.

33694.name: Senorita Sabotender
33694.col_2: Like a thousand adorable needles piercing your eyeballs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Senorita Sabotender minion.

33695.name: Benben stone
33695.col_2: For when you need the top stone of a pyramid scampering around after you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Benben stone minion.

33696.name: wanderer's campfire
33696.col_2: Perfect for driving away the darkness and the chill and, most importantly, toasting marshmallows.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wanderer's campfire minion.

33697.name: smaller stubby
33697.col_2: A little rusted but still fit for purpose...whatever that may be.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the smaller stubby minion.

33698.name: wind-up Lyna
33698.col_2: Don't forget to salute, or you're liable to receive a dressing-down.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Lyna minion.

33699.name: wind-up Runar
33699.col_2: Because a single Runar pining for Master Matoya isn't enough.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Runar minion.

33700.name: wind-up Gunnhildr
33700.col_2: Protects her people as a queen, a god, and now a mammet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Gunnhildr minion.

33701.name: 9S automaton
33701.col_2: For when you need the company of a compact version of an advanced combat android dressed in a distinctive subculture style.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the 9S automaton minion.

33702.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Impromptu Performance<hex:021A020103>
33702.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to perform an incredibly elaborate, albeit silent, routine to distract your fellow guests─for good or ill. Use to learn the /pantomime emote.

33703.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Displaying Displeasure<hex:021A020103>
33703.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to project an air of frustration so vivid as to make the emotion itself visible to the naked eye. Use to learn the /vexed emote.

33705.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Pizza & Prejudice<hex:021A020103>
33705.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to stay true to your heart despite society's pretensions. Use to learn the /eatpizza emote.

33706.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Both Ways<hex:021A020103>
33706.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, a hair styling technique which marries a braid and a side ponytail in an exquisite union.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

33707.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Battle-ready Bobs<hex:021A020103>
33707.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for shaping an uncannily perfect bob─like that of your android acquaintance 2B.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

33708.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Scanning for Style<hex:021A020103>
33708.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Scanning for Style<hex:021A020103>
33708.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for attaining an uncannily effortless look─like that of your android acquaintance 9S.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

33709.name: magicked prism (Namazu)
33709.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Releases a floating Namazu head, complete with gormless expression.

33710.name: sachet of Nymeia potpourri
33710.col_2: Made from the alchemically treated petals of Nymeia lilies, this fragrant bundle of potpourri brings a sense of tranquility to even the most troubled souls.

33711.name: red moon parasol
33711.col_2: This elegant parasol features an image of a flaming moon, which seems strangely familiar... Use to acquire a red moon parasol.

33712.name: fat cat parasol
33712.col_2: A charming parasol that's perfect for lounging about in the sun after filling your belly to bursting. Use to acquire a fat cat parasol.

33713.name: great paraserpent
33713.col_2: So lifelike that it appears about to let forth a mighty “scree!” at any moment. Use to acquire a great paraserpent.

33714.name: Faire voucher
33714.col_2: Currency minted and distributed by the Adventurers' Guild for use during the Moonfire Faire.

33757.col_2: A tiny-but-robust metallic spindle coveted by the goblins of Idyllshire, for reasons beyond your comprehension or ability to care.

33758.name: compact spring
33758.col_2: A delicate, metallic coil that was miraculously found undamaged after its previous owner was beaten to submission.

33759.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>A Day in the Life: Battles for the Realm<hex:021A020103>
33759.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>A Day in the Life: Battles for the Realm<hex:021A020103>
33759.col_2: A hero's recollections of battles supposedly fought in the name of freedom. In actuality, said battles were largely motivated by a burning desire to obtain a slightly better weapon through a rather lengthy and complex sequence of transactions.
33759.col_3: A Day in the Life: Battles for the Realm

33760.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>A Day in the Life: Beyond the Rift<hex:021A020103>
33760.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>A Day in the Life: Beyond the Rift<hex:021A020103>
33760.col_2: A hero's recollections of foes felled in another plane of existence. The tales contained within are so fantastical that one would be forgiven for thinking they were merely figments of said hero's imagination. Or perhaps they were?
33760.col_3: A Day in the Life: Beyond the Rift

35554.name: Season Twenty Lone Wolf trophy
35554.col_2: A trophy awarded to those who “left their mark” in Season Twenty of the Feast.

35555.name: orchestrion phonograph
35555.col_2: A tabletop furnishing with a trumpetesque funnel designed to spread sweet melodies around a given space.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One orchestrion of any type per estate only.

35556.name: shoe rack
35556.col_2: A stack of shelves suited for storing shoes.

35557.name: ivy mural
35557.col_2: A plant-patterned wall adornment for those who wish to bring a taste of the outside in.

35558.name: table mat
35558.col_2: A place setting that protects pristine dining surfaces from the grimy undersides of your plates.

35559.name: pair of matching cushions
35559.col_2: A pair of fluffy pillows that support not only your neck and shoulders, but each other as well.

35560.name: marimba
35560.col_2: A mallet-sounded instrument with an intricate design so beautiful as to rival its woody timbre.

35561.name: indoor oriental waterfall
35561.col_2: A fabulous water feature that will bless any space with a touch of Far Eastern flair.

35562.name: round wooden loft
35562.col_2: A circular platform for all of your platforming needs.

35563.name: heavenly ornamental array
35563.col_2: A string of celestial lights for those who wish to gaze upon the night sky without craning their necks upward.

35564.name: woodland chair
35564.col_2: A seat that was lost in the woods, never to be reunited with its original owner.

35565.name: apothecary's workbench
35565.col_2: A wooden workspace filled with enough tonics and tinctures to make one's fire burn and cauldron bubble.

35566.name: set of candlelit sundries
35566.col_2: This trio of potted plant, letter frame, and waxen candle makes for the most charming fire hazard you'll see today.

35567.name: fat cat rug
35567.col_2: A carpet almost as cozy as the fluffy familiar that inspired it.

35568.name: set of walnut flower vases
35568.col_2: A stable set of wooden stands, each adorned with a brightly colored blossom.

35569.name: stack of fluffy pancakes
35569.col_2: A two-tiered treat served with butter, powdered sugar, and a side of maple syrup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

35570.name: stuffed Bom Boko
35570.col_2: A plush toy modeled after a raccoon dog pup honing its transformative skills.

35571.name: set of wooden blinds
35571.col_2: A set of wooden slats designed to keep interiors dim and idle hands a-dusting.

35572.name: dance pole
35572.col_2: Even seasoned adventurers may find that sensually swiveling upon this pole proves a challenge to their balance and brawn alike.

35573.name: antique wall shelf
35573.col_2: A wooden shelf with a somewhat artificial antique appearance. After all, who can afford the real thing?

35574.name: wooden bin
35574.col_2: A container assembled from materials not much greater in quality than the waste that fills it.

35575.name: imitation wooden skylight
35575.col_2: A ceiling fixture for those who prefer their sunlight simulated.

35576.name: square niche partition
35576.col_2: There are two types of people: those who use this divider as storage space for cubic containers, and those who spend their time pretending to be a haunted portrait.

35577.name: pendant wall light
35577.col_2: A chain-strung lamp whose diminutive glow prioritizes fashion over function.

35578.name: loft bed
35578.col_2: A bed-over-desk set for authors whose solution to writer's block is sleeping on it.

35579.name: restaurant showcase
35579.col_2: A cabinet filled with eerily realistic recreations of various dishes.

35580.name: Ruby Sea phasmascape
35580.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays a dazzling sunset over the water betwixt Othard and Hingashi.

35581.name: aurora phasmascape
35581.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays Coerthan snowfields beautifully illuminated by the northern lights.

35582.name: Il Mheg garden fountain
35582.col_2: A petit water feature inspired by the land of the pixies.

35583.name: hanging bench
35583.col_2: A seat strung from a sturdy branch and securely fastened so to assuage any safety concerns.

35584.name: coldbare tree
35584.col_2: A plant bereft of its foliage and thus ill-fit to fend off the elements.

35585.name: poroggo lawn ornament
35585.col_2: An adorable little waterwheel adorned with an even cuter amphibian familiar.

35586.name: miniature antique clock tower
35586.col_2: An outdoor clock that will always tell you the time─so long as you keep it wound.

35587.name: Shirogane pinwheel
35587.col_2: A tiny spinning toy that is quite popular among Hingan children.

35588.name: set of gold plating
35588.col_2: Plating required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35589.name: gold cog
35589.col_2: A cog required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35590.name: gold motor component
35590.col_2: A component required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35591.name: gold mechanical voice box
35591.col_2: A component required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35593.name: aetherial lens
35593.col_2: Allows the starlens to capture aetherial flickers.

35594.name: aetherial amplifier
35594.col_2: Allows one to channel enough magic to operate the starlens.

35595.name: aetherial conductor
35595.col_2: Allows one to project the aether captured by the starlens onto water.

35596.name: jug of panaloaf sweetener
35596.col_2: This sweet concoction is designed to bind together the disparate flavors of the foul-tasting panaloaf.

35597.name: jar of panaloaf yeast
35597.col_2: This special yeast should greatly improve the powdery texture of panaloaf.

35598.name: bottle of panaloaf oil
35598.col_2: This fragrant oil will infuse freshly baked panaloaf with a delicious, savory aroma.

35599.name: pinch of ascorbic additive
35599.col_2: Extracted from coconut milk, this additive has been meticulously crafted to elevate the Mervynbread's ascorbic acid content to acceptable levels.

35600.name: Hannish staple
35600.col_2: A must-have for anyone looking to recreate Hannish culture.

35601.name: Garlean staple
35601.col_2: A must-have for anyone looking to recreate Garlean culture.

35602.name: lunar staple
35602.col_2: A must-have for anyone looking to recreate lunar culture.

35603.name: Elpis staple
35603.col_2: A must-have for anyone looking to recreate the culture of Elpis.

35604.name: giant aetherlouse
35604.col_2: A crustacean that is never far from an underwater aether current.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

35605.name: garjana wrasse
35605.col_2: A tropical fish that emits low amounts of aether and travels as part of a school. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

35606.name: Garlean clam
35606.col_2: A clam commonly found in Garlemald.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

35607.name: smaragdos
35607.col_2: An ancient fish with a green body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

35608.name: highland cottage permit (wood)
35608.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style cottage in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 300 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Small plot of land required.

35609.name: highland cottage permit (stone)
35609.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style cottage in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 300 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Small plot of land required.

35610.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style cottage in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 300 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Small plot of land required.

35611.name: highland house permit (wood)
35611.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style house in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 450 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Medium plot of land required.

35612.name: highland house permit (stone)
35612.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style house in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 450 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Medium plot of land required.

35613.name: highland house permit (composite)
35613.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style house in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 450 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Medium plot of land required.

35614.name: highland mansion permit (wood)
35614.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style mansion in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 600 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Large plot of land required.

35615.name: highland mansion permit (stone)
35615.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style mansion in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 600 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Large plot of land required.

35616.col_2: Allows the construction of a Coerthan-style mansion in Empyreum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can hold up to 600 furnishing items.<hex:02100103>※Large plot of land required.

35617.name: highland chocobo stable
35617.col_2: A simple stable designed in the Coerthan highland style.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once placed.<hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

35618.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Carpenter IX<hex:021A020103>
35618.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced woodworking recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled carpenters.

35619.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Blacksmith IX<hex:021A020103>
35619.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced smithing recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled blacksmiths.

35620.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Armorer IX<hex:021A020103>
35620.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced armorcraft recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled armorers.

35621.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Goldsmith IX<hex:021A020103>
35621.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced goldsmithing recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled goldsmiths.

35622.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Leatherworker IX<hex:021A020103>
35622.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced leatherworking recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled leatherworkers.

35623.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Weaver IX<hex:021A020103>
35623.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced clothcraft recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled weavers.

35624.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Alchemist IX<hex:021A020103>
35624.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced alchemy recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled alchemists.

35625.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Master Culinarian IX<hex:021A020103>
35625.col_2: This esoteric tome─the ninth in an equally esoteric series─contains advanced cooking recipes that can only be learned by esoterically skilled culinarians.

35626.name: rarefied horse chestnut kasa
35626.col_2: Tired of carrying around an umbrella due to a chance of rain? Put this on your head instead and save yourself the trouble!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35627.name: rarefied palm bracelet
35627.col_2: Each one of these accessories comes with a gemstone that is, as one might surmise, not made of palm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35628.name: rarefied red pine spinning wheel
35628.col_2: If this wheel keeps on turning and the red pine smells like burning, you're probably spinning it too fast.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35629.name: rarefied ironwood grinding wheel
35629.col_2: Not especially suitable when you have a bone to pick with someone, but the ideal implement when you have an axe to grind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35630.name: pair of rarefied integral armillae
35630.col_2: Little is known about the trees from which these integral accessories are made, but that air of mystery adds to the appeal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35631.name: rarefied high durium pistol
35631.col_2: This firearm eschews function for fashion, covering the cylinder with an ostentatious metal plate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35632.name: rarefied high durium greatsword
35632.col_2: Some blade wielders believe a weapon of this caliber would be more accurately dubbed an “excellentsword,” but it's a tad cumbersome as far as names go.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35633.name: rarefied bismuth sledgehammer
35633.col_2: This tool wants to be your sledgehammer; why don't you call its name?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35634.name: rarefied manganese cross-pein hammer
35634.col_2: Whoever decided “cross” would be a more easily understood substitute for “perpendicular” really hit the nail on the head.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35635.name: rarefied chondrite culinary knife
35635.col_2: One <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> use this utensil outside of the kitchen, but conventional wisdom advises against bringing a culinary knife to a gunlance fight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35636.name: pair of rarefied high durium knuckles
35636.description: pairs of rarefied high durium knuckles
35636.col_2: Some say one punch from these is all it takes to fell any foe, but only when wielded by expert pugilists.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35637.name: rarefied high durium kite shield
35637.col_2: Great for defending the wielder against incoming enemy attacks; not quite as great for flying on a windy day.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35638.name: rarefied bismuth fat cat frypan
35638.col_2: Though this pan may be feline shaped, using it to fry a fat cat would be morally unacceptable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35639.name: suit of rarefied manganese armor of the behemoth king
35639.description: suits of rarefied manganese armor of the behemoth king
35639.col_2: Perfect for edgy adventurers who want to show off their hunting prowess without sacrificing their dark and brooding image.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.
35639.col_3: Rarefied Manganese Armor of the Behemoth King

35640.name: pair of rarefied chondrite sollerets
35640.col_2: One can quite literally never go chond-wrong with a pair of these leg guards.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35641.name: array of rarefied high durium milpreves
35641.description: arrays of rarefied high durium milpreves
35641.col_2: A word of sage advice: never cross someone with an array of these in their possession.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35642.name: rarefied pewter choker

35644.col_3: Rarefied Manganese Horn of the Last Unicorn

35647.description: pairs of rarefied luncheon toadskin hose
35647.col_2: Some dislike the bumpy texture of these stockings, but comfort is in the legs of the beholder...or however the saying goes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35649.name: pair of rarefied kumbhiraskin shoes

35652.description: pairs of rarefied almasty serge gloves
35652.col_2: These fluffy handwarmers ensure the wearer never gets frostbitten, but their black coloration means one must always be wary of potential staining.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

35744.name: bag of triteleia seeds
35744.col_2: The triteleia is also known as the triplet lily─as the various parts of the flower come in threes─care has been taken to ensure the number of seeds is divisible by three, so as not to ruin the pattern. After all, “three is the mandatory number,” as the saying probably goes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

35745.col_2: A bunch of red triteleia, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

35776.name: array of dzi of the Crimson Lotus
35776.description: arrays of dzi of the Crimson Lotus

35779.name: array of augmented Scaevan magitek wings
35779.description: arrays of augmented Scaevan magitek wings

35791.name: crystal of eternal Darkness
35791.col_2: Brighten up your home with this charming tribute to the god of Darkness.

35792.name: crystal of divine Light
35792.col_2: Includes a unique serial number and certificate of authenticity supposedly signed by Hydaelyn Herself.

35793.name: trophy of eternal Darkness
35793.col_2: An ideal conversation piece and focal point for clandestine rituals. Though it does not possess any arcane properties, it certainly looks the part.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

35794.name: trophy of divine Light
35794.col_2: A somewhat abstract imagining of the god of Light. Perhaps it is best to give it a wide berth to avoid snagging one's clothing─and eyes─on the featherlike projections.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

35796.name: New World burrito lunch
35796.col_2: One of many delicious dishes invented by inhabitants of the New World, this lunch stars a well-seasoned assortment of beans, vegetables, and meats wrapped in soft tortillas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Piety Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

35797.name: Hannish silk rack
35797.col_2: Even in their furled state, these silks bring a splash of color to any abode. Their weavers, however, would insist that they are rather more decorative when unfurled.

35798.name: ancient lamp
35798.col_2: An implausibly accurate recreation of the lamps used in the ancient world.

35799.name: Labyrinthos warning sign
35799.col_2: While there are many similarly designed placards, this particular example reads, “Trespassers will be given a stern talking-to.”

35801.name: nekropolis table
35801.col_2: Anyone who doubts that furniture can be scary has obviously never seen this table.

35802.name: pumpkin flower vase
35802.col_2: What does one call a gourd capable of supporting plant life? A gourden.

35803.name: Starlight mobile
35803.col_2: This decoration remains in perpetual motion even when no wind is present, possibly as the result of some as-yet-undiscovered Ascian machination.

35804.name: Thavnairian striking dummy
35804.col_2: A striking dummy designed in the Thavnairian fashion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

35805.name: collection of Garlean containers
35805.col_2: Give your home all the warmth and comfort of a Garlean military installation with this assortment of delightful metallic crates.

35806.name: Sharlayan lamppost
35806.col_2: Hast thou ever licked a lamppost in winter?

35807.name: Thavnairian dhow
35807.col_2: Nothing impresses the neighbors quite like a massive boat on one's lawn.

35808.name: haunted pumpkin set
35808.col_2: Quite why ghosts would wish to haunt an assortment of prize gourds is anyone's guess. Perhaps they are the vengeful spirits of runners-up in a vegetable-growing contest?

35809.name: Garlean concrete inner wall
35809.col_2: A cold, stark interior wall for those who fear their home is becoming a little <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> cozy.

35810.name: unit of varied wood flooring
35810.col_2: This style of flooring is also known as “carpenters' leftovers.”

35811.name: leafy ceiling lamp
35811.col_2: Ceiling-mounted lighting designed to resemble a ceiling-mounted, glowing bush.

35812.name: set of small cafe walls
35812.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a café.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

35813.name: set of medium cafe walls
35813.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a café.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on medium plots of land.

35814.name: set of large cafe walls
35814.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a café.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on large plots of land.

35815.name: astral totem
35815.col_2: A small statue overflowing with astral energy. It is unclear exactly who crafted it.

35816.name: umbral totem
35816.col_2: A small statue overflowing with umbral energy. It is unclear exactly who crafted it.

35817.name: unsung helm of Asphodelos
35817.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried helmet recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two helms can be traded for special headgear.

35818.name: suit of unsung armor of Asphodelos
35818.description: suits of unsung armor of Asphodelos
35818.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried armor recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four suits can be traded for special body gear.

35819.name: pair of unsung gauntlets of Asphodelos
35819.description: pairs of unsung gauntlets of Asphodelos
35819.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried gauntlets recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special arm gear.

35820.name: pair of unsung chausses of Asphodelos
35820.description: pairs of unsung chausses of Asphodelos
35820.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried chausses recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four pairs can be traded for special leg gear.

35821.name: pair of unsung greaves of Asphodelos
35821.description: pairs of unsung greaves of Asphodelos
35821.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried greaves recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special foot gear.

35822.name: unsung ring of Asphodelos
35822.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried ring recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One ring can be traded for a special accessory.

35823.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Asphodelos Mythos I<hex:021A020103>
35823.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the creatures kept in Asphodelos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Asphodelos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

35824.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Asphodelos Mythos II<hex:021A020103>
35824.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the creatures kept in Asphodelos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Asphodelos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

35826.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Asphodelos Mythos IV<hex:021A020103>
35826.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the creatures kept in Asphodelos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Asphodelos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

35827.name: unsung blade of Asphodelos
35827.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried blade recovered from Pandæmonium. Though such weapons were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

35828.name: flask of Radiant roborant
35828.col_2: A translucent substance produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of weapons borne by the Radiant Host. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

35829.name: spool of Radiant twine
35829.col_2: A translucent thread produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of the Radiant Host's vestments. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

35830.name: jar of Radiant coating
35830.col_2: A translucent substance produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of accessories worn by the Radiant Host. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

35831.name: discal tomestone
35831.col_2: A surpassingly small means of storing knowledge, this style of tomestone never truly caught on amongst the Allagans due to the ease of accidentally dropping, pulverizing, or mistaking the discs for sweets. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

35832.name: pumpkin cookie
35832.col_2: A devilish imp is thought to have made this slightly burnt biscuit shaped like a pumpkin head. One can only wonder what ingredients it contains.

35833.name: bicolor gemstone voucher
35833.col_2: Proof that you have delivered many a bicolor gemstone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same bicolor gemstone voucher can be traded with Edelina in Mor Dhona for special items.

35834.name: irregular tomestone of scripture
35834.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains knowledge of ancient scriptures.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

35835.name: piece of gold core material
35835.col_2: A piece of material required to craft a core to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35836.name: gold core
35836.col_2: A gold core required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35837.name: piece of gold connector material
35837.col_2: A piece of material required to craft a connector to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35838.name: gold connector
35838.col_2: A gold connector required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35839.name: set of writing utensil materials
35839.col_2: Can be used to craft a stellar set of writing utensils.

35840.name: set of writing utensils
35840.col_2: A stellar set of writing utensils.

35841.name: set of starlens wand material
35841.col_2: Can be used to craft a wand capable of channeling magic into the starlens.

35842.name: starlens wand
35842.col_2: A wand capable of channeling magic into the starlens.

35843.name: pouch of golden spice ingredients
35843.col_2: This pouch contains the ingredients necessary to mix a batch of Master Dickon's “golden spice.”

35844.name: jar of golden spice
35844.col_2: With this spice added into the mix, a standard curry dish is transformed into a flavorful culinary masterpiece.

35845.name: set of fishcake ingredient supplies
35845.col_2: This set contains everything necessary to create a key fishcake ingredient.

35846.name: Sharlayan fishcake ingredient
35846.col_2: A key ingredient for making Sharlayan fishcakes.

35847.name: piece of hairpin material
35847.col_2: Can be used to craft a beautiful hairpin in the right hands.

35848.name: piece of eternity ring material
35848.col_2: Can be used to craft a beautiful ring in the right hands.

35849.name: Alnairan salmon
35849.col_2: A migratory fish that is sometimes found wandering the coasts of Alnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

35850.name: lunar lamenter
35850.col_2: An ancient creature that calls Mare Lamentorum home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.
