35962.name: Labyrinthos riding map
35962.col_2: This highly detailed map of Labyrinthos, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by researchers seeking to reduce delivery times of specimens.

35963.name: Thavnair riding map
35963.col_2: This highly detailed map of Thavnair, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by chocobo couriers seeking to reduce delivery times.

35964.name: Garlemald riding map
35964.col_2: This highly detailed map of Garlemald, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by imperial couriers seeking to reduce delivery times.

35965.name: Mare Lamentorum riding map
35965.col_2: This highly detailed map of Mare Lamentorum, including everything from land elevation to the location of large rocks and craters, was originally drafted by the Loporrits to allow for easier travel.

35966.name: Ultima Thule riding map
35966.col_2: This highly detailed map of Ultima Thule, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and twisting spires, was originally drafted by peoples of a lost civilization.

35967.name: Elpis riding map
35967.col_2: This highly detailed map of Elpis, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by couriers seeking to reduce delivery times.

35968.name: wind-up Rudy
35968.col_2: Eager to help, though perhaps not suited to guiding sleighs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Rudy minion.

35969.name: squirrel emperor
35969.col_2: At once more powerful and adorable than a certain simian king.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the squirrel emperor minion.

35970.name: Flag
35970.col_2: A little reindeer with a huge appetite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Flag minion.

35971.name: wee Ea
35971.col_2: Proof that you don't need to be big to think big.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wee Ea minion.

35972.name: wind-up Magus Sisters
35972.col_2: Essentially three minions for one, so it represents great value.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Magus Sisters minion.

35973.name: optimus Omicron
35973.col_2: Minimum proportions, maximum performance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the optimus Omicron minion.

35974.name: wind-up Anima
35974.col_2: Warning: cannot be used to teleport or upgrade weapons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Anima minion.

35975.name: starbird
35975.col_2: Gazing up at the stars in the heavens, it ever sings a song of hope.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the starbird minion.

35976.name: Nagxian cat
35976.col_2: The very soul of grace and nobility, and can see souls to boot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Nagxian cat minion.

35977.name: brave new Urianger
35977.col_2: Despite its diminutive size, its arms are no less weapons than those of the man himself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the brave new Urianger minion.

35978.name: wind-up Vrtra
35978.col_2: Last of his brood but certainly not least.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Vrtra minion.

35979.name: hippo calf
35979.col_2: Heavy. Assisted lift may be required.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the hippo calf minion.

35980.name: crabe de la crabe
35980.col_2: If it were any crabbier, it would...probably still be a crab.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the crabe de la crabe minion.

35981.name: Prince Lunatender
35981.col_2: Use as a decoration at risk of suffering puncture wounds─lots of them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Prince Lunatender minion.

35982.name: tiny troll
35982.col_2: The good kind that makes constructive, well-thought-out comments.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny troll minion.

35983.name: Caduceus
35983.col_2: Won't spit acid at you, so rest easy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Caduceus minion.

35984.name: adventure basket
35984.col_2: Because no one should have to save the world on an empty stomach.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the adventure basket minion.

35985.name: Golden Dhyata
35985.col_2: Is it a bird? Is it a fish? No, it's a translation device!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Golden Dhyata minion.

35986.name: greener gleaner
35986.col_2: Good at hiding, but clearly not good enough.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the greener gleaner minion.

35987.name: wind-up Grebuloff
35987.col_2: Smells vaguely like a rocky shore.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Grebuloff minion.

35988.name: nosferatu
35988.col_2: Nothing if not gentlemanly...and perhaps bloodthirsty.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the nosferatu minion.

35989.name: wind-up herois
35989.col_2: Come on, you know who this hero is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up herois minion.

35990.name: wind-up Daivadipa
35990.col_2: Can discern good and evil─so long as they are at knee height.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Daivadipa minion.

36000.name: lynx of eternal darkness flute
36000.col_2: Emitting a shadowy and stoic tone, this flute summons a lynx of eternal darkness to your side.

36001.name: lynx of divine light flute
36001.col_2: Emitting a bright and hopeful tone, this flute summons a lynx of divine light to your side.

36002.name: Argos horn
36002.col_2: Reaching across time and space, the sound of this horn brings Argos bounding to your side.

36003.name: Calydontis horn
36003.col_2: When blown, this horn produces a feral sound that summons forth Calydontis, scourge of the forest.

36004.name: Victor whistle
36004.col_2: The shrill sound of this hand-carved whistle calls forth Victor, your champion show canis.

36005.name: wivre horn
36005.col_2: When blown, this horn produces a deep, booming sound that summons forth your mighty wivre.

36006.name: dreadnaught identification key
36006.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your dreadnaught will bring it rumbling to life.

36007.name: level checker identification key
36007.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your level checker will bring it blipping and blooping to life.

36008.name: Demi-Phoinix horn
36008.col_2: This grim horn produces an unbridled sound that calls forth your Demi-Phoinix.

36009.name: Papa Paissa whistle
36009.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a blank sound that brings Papa Paissa shuffling to your side.

36010.name: porxie king horn
36010.col_2: Wrought of clay, this horn emits a sound at once regal and soothing that calls the porxie king to your side.

36011.name: set of barding of eternal Darkness
36011.description: sets of barding of eternal Darkness
36011.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor that radiates Darkness.

36012.name: set of barding of divine Light
36012.description: sets of barding of divine Light
36012.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor that radiates Light.

36013.name: set of postmoogle barding
36013.col_2: A festive suit of chocobo armor inspired by hardworking postmoogles everywhere.

36014.name: set of Thavnairian barding
36014.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor inspired by traditional Thavnairian dress.

36206.name: AR-Caean cotton boll
36206.col_2: A rare variety of cotton which has been beloved as long as you can remember...which is not very long, given that your mind goes blank each time you attempt to recall its origins.

36213.name: bolt of golden silk
36213.col_2: A sleek and shining fabric woven from golden cocoons.

36214.name: bottle of potent spice
36214.col_2: Not for the weak of heart or palate, this powdered mixture of natural spices gives any dish a flavorsome kick.

36215.name: bottle of stonehard water
36215.col_2: Water so replete with minerals that drinking it unboiled is inadvisable, regardless of how appealing that may seem.

36216.name: chunk of rime dolomite

36217.name: double-edged herb
36217.col_2: Incredibly potent, but also incredibly hard to find without getting lost in the woods and meeting an untimely end.

36218.name: pinch of alchemical charcoal
36218.col_2: A hot-burning fuel created by destructively distilling raw coal in the forges of the Great Work.

36219.name: pinch of alchemical abrasive
36219.col_2: This all-in-one abrasive, created by alchemists of the Great Work, can be used to both sand metals and polish them to a lustrous sheen─and with only minor risk of fire.

36220.name: clump of Thavnairian horsetail

36221.name: spindle of Thavnairian thread
36221.col_2: Beautiful thread of the sort Ruveydah Fibers prides itself on.

36285.name: handful of lunar quartz

36286.name: ghostly umbral rock
36286.col_2: A rock with an elemental aspect leaning unnaturally towards umbral.

36287.name: chunk of ewer clay
36287.col_2: Clay said to have been used to craft Thaliak's very own ewer.

36288.name: handful of palm chippings
36288.col_2: Bark from a Thavnairian palm tree.

36291.name: chunk of rarefied high durium ore
36291.description: chunks of rarefied high durium ore
36291.col_2: Donning equipment crafted from this elegant emerald alloy is sure to turn onlookers green with envy...right?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36292.name: chunk of rarefied chloroschist
36292.col_2: Some say peering into the murky depths of this stone will reveal secret truths of existence─for instance, that staring at a rock for extended periods causes significant ocular discomfort.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36293.name: rarefied raw ametrine
36293.col_2: This multicolored beauty was born from the fusion of amethyst and citrine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36294.name: chunk of rarefied bismuth ore
36294.col_2: This mineral may look like a shiny rock, but when oxidized, it becomes a <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> shiny rock.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36295.name: chunk of rarefied Sharlayan rock salt
36295.description: chunks of rarefied Sharlayan rock salt
36295.col_2: “Everyone talks so much about how salt <hex:021A020203>tastes<hex:021A020103> and not enough about how it <hex:021A020203>looks<hex:021A020103>.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36296.name: chunk of rarefied Phrygian gold ore
36296.description: chunks of rarefied Phrygian gold ore
36296.col_2: Not everything that glitters is gold─sometimes it is much more valuable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36297.name: rarefied blue zircon
36297.col_2: The brilliance of this sample's blue hue remains nigh unparalleled in the natural world─particularly now that it has been removed from it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36298.name: pinch of rarefied Eblan alumen
36298.col_2: No one would call this alumen “rarefied” were it overabundant in the frozen north─certainly not for marketing purposes. Perish the thought!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36299.name: chunk of rarefied annite
36299.col_2: Handling may cause this mineral to fracture or flake, so best not. What do you mean, “too late”?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36300.name: chunk of rarefied pewter ore
36300.col_2: Pewter? I barely know her!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36301.name: rarefied Thavnairian perilla leaf
36301.col_2: This herb's minty aroma is stronger than that of its perilla brethren, easily separating the Thavs from the Thav-nots.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36302.name: rarefied ironwood log
36302.col_2: More wood than iron...which is to say that it is not really iron at all.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36303.name: rarefied palm log
36303.col_2: The lack of rings makes this lumber impossible to date─or, as particularly aggravating naturalists might say, “stuck in the frond zone.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36304.name: rarefied red pine log
36304.col_2: While this wood is more red-adjacent than truly red, “red-adjacent pine” does not exactly roll off the tongue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36305.name: rarefied coconut
36305.col_2: Though this deceptive drupe does not taste like cocoa and it is not a true nut, culinarians tend to overlook these offenses in light of its deliciousness. It is on thin ice with the botanists, however.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36306.name: rarefied sykon
36306.col_2: A succulent symbol of vitality, this fruit pairs nicely with some honey and stone cheese.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36307.name: sheaf of rarefied dark rye
36307.col_2: This hearty grain is a culinarian's delight─though much more so after the tiresome grinding step is complete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36308.name: handful of rarefied elder nutmeg seeds
36308.description: handfuls of rarefied elder nutmeg seeds
36308.col_2: This sweet-scented spice is proven to help medicine go down. Consuming an entire spoonful, however, is not recommended.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36309.name: head of rarefied iceberg lettuce
36309.col_2: This crisp, refreshing vegetable is often thought to be lacking in flavor, but those who enjoy the flavor of water doubtless find it absolutely overpowering.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36310.name: rarefied AR-Caean cotton boll
36310.col_2: These bolls are so irresistibly soft that some folks can't help but pluck them and pop them in their ears. Caution: under no circumstances should AR-Caean cotton be placed near the ears.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36311.name: resplendent carpenter's component A
36311.col_2: The arboreal aroma is admired by accomplished artisans and aspiring aficionados alike.

36313.name: resplendent armorer's component A
36313.col_2: Far simpler in design than its extravagant name would suggest.

36315.name: resplendent leatherworker's component A
36315.col_2: The skin of a blue animal. Maybe.

36316.name: resplendent weaver's component A
36316.col_2: Only an engineer would refer to a length of thread as a component.

36317.name: resplendent alchemist's component A
36317.col_2: Of all the liquids found in alchemy, this is one of the least suitably named.

36318.name: resplendent culinarian's component A
36318.col_2: A curious little box that is tangentially related to the culinary arts, or so the Boutique of Splendors would have you believe.

36319.name: resplendent carpenter's component B
36319.col_2: Like a flute but without the holes.

36320.name: resplendent blacksmith's component B
36320.col_2: Can be used in place of legal tender, provided the phrase “It's that or nothing!” is uttered with enough conviction.

36321.name: resplendent armorer's component B
36321.col_2: The term “cock-a-hoop” originates from a game in which competitors throw objects such as these over the neck of a male chicken.

36322.name: resplendent goldsmith's component B
36322.col_2: Not only are such objects said to be found on the dark side of the moon, they are available in any color you like.

36323.name: resplendent leatherworker's component B
36323.col_2: A not-so-neatly folded sheet of beast skin.

36324.name: resplendent weaver's component B
36324.col_2: While not exactly as resplendent as the name would suggest, it is at least clean.

36325.name: resplendent alchemist's component B
36325.col_2: One of the few substances in alchemy that is as light as it is heavy.

36326.name: resplendent culinarian's component B
36326.col_2: This mustard is known as Eulmore's hottest yellow paste.

36327.name: resplendent carpenter's component C
36327.col_2: A hardened lump of the crimson sap known as “tree blood.”

36328.name: resplendent blacksmith's component C
36328.col_2: Just another cog in the machine. Or at least it will be once the rest of the machine has been built around it.

36329.name: resplendent armorer's component C
36329.col_2: Most armorer's tools do not incorporate sheets of chainmail, but try telling the Boutique of Splendors that.

36330.name: resplendent goldsmith's component C
36330.col_2: It is not yet known whether this resplendent orb will become the centerpiece in a fine item of jewelry or ground down into dust for a far less glamorous purpose.

36331.name: resplendent leatherworker's component C
36331.col_2: While this incredibly long strap is an impressive example of leatherworking, calling it resplendent may be something of an exaggeration.

36332.name: resplendent weaver's component C
36332.col_2: A bolt of cloth this luxurious surely warrants a better name.

36333.name: resplendent alchemist's component C
36333.col_2: A handful of carbon rods. One for each finger, in fact.

36334.name: resplendent culinarian's component C
36334.col_2: A small vial of unnamed gloopy stuff.

36336.name: set of Omega-M attire
36336.col_2: Cannot equip with arm, leg, or foot gear.

36337.name: set of Omega-F attire
36337.col_2: Cannot equip with arm, leg, or foot gear.

36340.name: pair of fallen angel wings
36340.col_2: The perfect solution for anyone seeking a pair of edgier angel wings. Use to acquire a pair of fallen angel wings.

36341.name: pair of archangel wings
36341.col_2: For those who go gaga for gold. Use to acquire a pair of archangel wings.

36342.name: pair of Diabolos wings
36342.col_2: Highly recommended for those who feel an affinity with voidsent. Use to acquire a pair of Diabolos wings.

36343.name: pair of pixie wings
36343.col_2: Perfect for those who like to indulge their mischievous side. Use to acquire a pair of pixie wings.

36345.name: pair of false oval spectacles
36345.col_2: Wish to look more intelligent with minimal effort? Then look no further than these superb specs. Though these were once considered a fashion accessory, trends are ever changing, and style enthusiasts now classify them as facewear. Use to unlock oval spectacles.

36346.name: Blackbosom weapon coffer
36346.col_2: A banded chest containing six Blackbosom weapons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1.

36380.name: deluxe snow-dusted tree
36380.col_2: Few realize the “snow” that rests on the boughs is in fact cake icing.

36381.name: deluxe unmelting ice partition
36381.col_2: Guaranteed to never melt or your money back.

36382.name: deluxe unmelting ice loft
36382.col_2: Guaranteed to never melt or your money back.

36383.name: deluxe handmade akabeko
36383.col_2: The year of the ox simply would be incomplete without a pair of nodding cattle in every home. May their nodding never cease, even after their appointed year comes to an end.

36384.name: deluxe stuffed Kupka Kupp
36384.col_2: So true to life it may very well be Kupka Kupp himself, albeit stuffed. You hope for his sake it is not.

36385.name: pecten
36385.col_2: A sizable bivalve native to Scholar's Harbor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36386.name: northern herring
36386.col_2: A saltwater fish that serves as a staple in Sharlayan cuisine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36387.name: dog-faced puffer
36387.col_2: A saltwater fish recognized by its dark facial markings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36388.name: cobalt chromis
36388.col_2: This saltwater fish is prized for its brilliant blue hue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36389.name: guitarfish
36389.col_2: A saltwater fish shaped like a stringed instrument.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36390.name: astacus
36390.col_2: A gaudy crustacean commonly found in Old Sharlayan.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36392.name: peacock bass
36392.col_2: A decent-sized fish known for its speckled scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36393.name: academician
36393.col_2: A top-heavy fish commonly found in Oinops serves as a little-heeded warning of the consequences of overzealous study.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36394.name: swordspine snook
36394.col_2: A silver-scaled fish that boasts surprising speed for its size.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36395.name: ponderer
36395.col_2: This fish is the presumed cause of no small amount of failed first-year essays asserting, “I swim, therefore I am.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36396.name: tidal dahlia
36396.col_2: An anthozoan that enshrouds its body with petal-like appendages.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36397.name: butterfly fry
36397.col_2: Labyrinthos researchers are currently studying reproductive patterns via these beautiful freshwater fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36398.name: xenocypris
36398.col_2: This unusually hardy freshwater koi is found throughout Labyrinthos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36399.name: topminnow
36399.col_2: A tiny fish commonly found at Unmoved Source Alpha.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36400.name: tessera
36400.col_2: This cichlid doubles as a mosaic tile to the imaginative minds of Labyrinthos. (No fish were harmed in the making of this secret underground facility.)<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36402.name: fat snook
36402.col_2: A freshwater fish recognizable by its golden brown fins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36403.name: prochilodus luminosus
36403.col_2: A freshwater fish whose scales boast an iridescent shimmer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36404.name: mesonauta
36404.col_2: A freshwater fish marked by the large black stripe on its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36405.name: greengill salmon
36405.col_2: This freshwater wavekin is bred for research purposes at the Mover Alpha.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36407.name: raiamas
36407.col_2: A freshwater fish known for its shimmering emerald scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36408.name: red bowfin
36408.col_2: This ancient freshwater fish is, conveniently, now to be found in Unmoved Source Beta.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36409.name: macrobrachium lar
36409.col_2: This freshwater shrimp was released into the waters near the Mover Beta as part of a biological study.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36410.name: blowgun
36410.col_2: Researchers are currently observing the life-cycle of this freshwater fish at the Mover Beta.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36411.name: darksteel knifefish
36411.col_2: This freshwater fish is known for its considerable size and its charcoal color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36412.name: astacus aetherius
36412.col_2: A variant of astacus prized for its brilliant blue pigmentation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36414.name: Labyrinthos tilapia
36414.col_2: Labyrinthos researchers employ this freshwater wavekin in studying the water quality in Deepmoat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36415.name: trunkblessed
36415.col_2: This freshwater fish boasts a snout reminiscent of a Matanga's trunk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36417.name: seema duta
36417.col_2: If this freshwater fish from Meghaduta seems delicious, it's because it is. Dutifully served with a mega-sized portion of sauce in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36418.name: longear sunfish
36418.col_2: A freshwater fish named for the earlike protrusions on the sides of its face.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36419.name: silver characin
36419.col_2: Only the satrap's family has been permitted to fish this freshwater goliath.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36420.name: Thavnairian goby
36420.col_2: This tiny saltwater fish is commonly found in the oceans surrounding Thavnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36421.name: Qeyiq sole
36421.col_2: This saltwater fish is flatter than many a boat's bottom.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36422.name: gwl crab
36422.col_2: A cast of these crustaceans resembles an underwater rose.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36423.name: pantherscale grouper
36423.col_2: A saltwater fish speckled with chocolate-brown splotches.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36425.name: fate's design
36425.col_2: A tropical fish known for its dazzling coloration and unique scale patterns.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36426.name: shadowdart sardine
36426.col_2: This black-bodied fish makes its home in the seas surrounding Thavnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36427.name: Paksa fish
36427.col_2: This large saltwater fish has been honored with the name of an ancient Arkasodara ruler.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36430.name: golden barramundi
36430.col_2: A saltwater fish known for its large, resplendent scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36431.name: Kadjaya's castaway
36431.col_2: A slim freshwater fish commonly found dancing its heart out at the Giantsgall Grounds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36432.name: marid frog
36432.col_2: This amphibian of unusual size makes its home in Thavnair's jungles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36434.name: bluegill
36434.col_2: This voracious freshwater fish, once indigenous to the island, has long since found its way into Thavnair's water sources.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36435.name: bronze pipira
36435.col_2: A ferocious freshwater fish commonly found at the Giantsgall Grounds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36436.name: green swordtail
36436.col_2: A long-tailed freshwater fish found throughout Thavnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36438.name: ksirapayin
36438.col_2: A freshwater fish that drinks deep of Ksiroda.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36439.name: wakeful watcher
36439.col_2: This freshwater fish is said to be ever-vigilant reincarnation of a guard at the Wakeful Torana.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36440.name: red drum
36440.col_2: A large freshwater fish identifiable by its black spots and crimson flourishes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36441.name: forgeflame
36441.col_2: With its brightly colored fins, this fish evokes the image of metal on its way to becoming something greater.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36442.name: bicuda
36442.col_2: This fish, native to Ksiroda, is surprisingly swift for its size.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36443.name: radzbalik
36443.col_2: A freshwater fish beloved for its resplendent coloration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36444.name: half-moon betta
36444.col_2: This tropical fish is known for its fluttering tail fin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36446.name: banana eel
36446.col_2: A freshwater fish whose coloration, for better or worse, matches that of its fruitier namesake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36447.name: handy hamsa
36447.col_2: This small freshwater fish is named after the Thavnairian fowl it so adorably resembles─according to the Hannish, anyway.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36448.name: flowerhorn
36448.col_2: A colorful freshwater fish with an enormous hump on its head.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36449.name: Thavnairian caiman
36449.col_2: A large scalekin that makes its home in the Font of Maya, much to the area's other would-be residents' horror.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36450.name: fiery goby
36450.col_2: This saltwater fish sputters along like a flickering flame.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36451.name: puff-paya
36451.col_2: A tiny saltwater fish whose catchy name is owed to its resemblance to the tropical fruit. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36452.name: Narunnairian octopus
36452.col_2: A cephalopod commonly found in the ocean around Narunnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36453.name: roosterfish
36453.col_2: A saltwater fish with a spindly dorsal fin that makes its home in the Perfumed Tides.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36454.name: basilosaurus
36454.col_2: This scourge of the seas bears physiological similarities to prehistoric whales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

36456.name: Eblan trout
36456.col_2: A freshwater trout capable of surviving freezing temperatures, and likely the more delicious for it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36457.name: animulus
36457.col_2: A curious sort of creature that calls the Eblan Thaw home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36458.name: cerule core
36458.col_2: An orb of a creature with a penchant for ceruleum-laced water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36459.name: icepike
36459.col_2: A freshwater fish covered with nigh-impenetrable scales that no mere mortal could ever break through─bare-handed, anyway.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36460.name: dark crown
36460.col_2: A fish whose long, beautiful fin ensures it stands out at all times. If it had the cognitive capacity, it would no doubt be <hex:021A020203>so<hex:021A020103> vain.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36461.name: imperial pleco
36461.col_2: A striped fish which can be seen flitting about the waters of the capital, much to its people's chagrin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36462.name: bluetail
36462.col_2: A large fish boasting a color as bracing as ice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36463.name: star-blue guppy
36463.col_2: A terribly small freshwater fish with a color reminiscent of a certain star.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36465.name: lunar cichlid
36465.col_2: A freshwater wavekin that, even when removed from its natural habitat, seems forever kissed by the light of the moon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36466.name: teareye
36466.col_2: This fish cannot help but appear gloomy day in and day out. Whether it actually is or not is a matter of hot debate among fish enthusiasts everywhere.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36467.name: replipirarucu
36467.col_2: An aberration with scales of a pinkish hue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36468.name: feverfish
36468.col_2: Within the aetherochemical pools it calls home, this bizarre wavekin consumes toxic substances like they are going out of style.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36470.name: calicia
36470.col_2: In aetherochemical environments, this wavekin's coloration is reminiscent of a wine-filled chalice. The rest of the time, it is entirely uninteresting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36471.name: protomyke #987
36471.col_2: A variety of fungus identified in the Chlorophospond, and deceptively unintelligent even given the low expectations such a description establishes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36472.name: lunar deathworm
36472.col_2: A menace of a mollusk with a mouth that is not the least bit inviting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

36473.name: fleeting brand
36473.col_2: This lengthy, parasitic fish loves to lurk in regotoise shells, always ducking just out of sight and reach before being plucked.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36475.name: regotoise
36475.col_2: A large turtle who blends so seemlessly into his surroundings, you may not even notice it until you trip over it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36476.name: isle skipper
36476.col_2: These tiny fish spend a deal of time in the open sky, almost as if they wish to have been born birds instead.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36477.name: iribainion
36477.col_2: This freshwater fish creates rainbows whenever it breaches the surface.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36478.name: albino loach
36478.col_2: A freshwater fish whose scales gleam with an uncommon luster.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36479.name: golden shiner
36479.col_2: This fish is best appreciated by gazing upon the water in which it swims, so there is little use in trying to get a good look at it─or even reading this text.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36480.name: mangar
36480.col_2: Some might say this fish is made of money. They would be wrong.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36481.name: dermogenys
36481.col_2: A small, pale fish with a snout that is hard to ignore. Testing to determine whether it is self-conscious has thus far been inconclusive.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36484.name: antheia
36484.col_2: A freshwater fish sporting a fine array of pigments─presumably the maximum amount possible without causing pain to onlookers. That seems like something the ancients would do.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36485.name: colossoma
36485.col_2: This impressive specimen can be found lingering among the aquatic vegetation in the lower Hungering Gardens.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36487.name: superstring
36487.col_2: A creature whose tentacles seem inexplicably alive with cosmic phenomena.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36488.name: star eater
36488.col_2: Typically found within aetherochemical pools, this creature is capable of luring a horrifically wide variety of unsuspecting prey with its luminescent organ.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36489.name: vacuum shrimp
36489.col_2: A cosmic crustacean whose black body blends in with the inky darkness of space.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36491.name: cosmic noise
36491.col_2: These wavekin and their dizzying pattern of scales are oft found in aetherochemical pools.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36492.name: glassfish
36492.col_2: This fish appears dead on arrival to the untrained eye, and thus would be best sold to someone with a trained eye.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36494.name: foun myhk
36494.col_2: A creature with several impressive qualities that have failed to better its life in any meaningful way.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36495.name: dragonscale
36495.col_2: This symbiont is a boon to dragons' grooming habits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36496.name: ypupîara
36496.col_2: This disturbing life-form may have once been bipedal, but those days are long gone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36497.name: eehs forhnesh
36497.col_2: This wavekin's name means “devourer of eggs,” and it fully looks the part.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

36499.name: katoptron
36499.col_2: A mystifying fish whose scales seem to reflect the movement of the stars.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36501.name: comet tail
36501.col_2: This creature appears to be part shooting star, part lungfish─and for all you know, it is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36502.name: aoide
36502.col_2: This wavekin makes up in sound what it lacks in sight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36503.name: protoflesh
36503.col_2: One of many physical test-bodies created by the Ea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36505.name: wandering starscale
36505.col_2: These wavekin behave as if deviating from their invisible track will have dire consequences...which is unfortunate for this one, if true.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36506.name: wormhole worm
36506.col_2: A mollusk whose rainbow shimmer hides inscrutable─and potentially sinister─innards.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36507.name: unidentified flying biomass II
36507.col_2: A tiny, yet highly mobile, life-form.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36508.name: triaina
36508.col_2: This crustacean was an apex predator on its home world. Now...not so much.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36509.name: sophos deka-okto
36509.col_2: A life-form with six eyes, six feelers, and a whole lot of terrifying wisdom to impart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36510.name: Class Twenty-four
36510.col_2: A creature from Ostrakon Hepta with twenty-four legs and twenty spines, which in this context means it is rather full of itself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36511.name: terrifyingway
36511.col_2: This creature of the cosmos might be known for its adorable ears─save for the fact that they are actually legs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36512.name: alien mertone
36512.col_2: A devious alien life-form hailing from an unknown plane, come to our universe to invade even more stars. Maybe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36513.name: monster carrot
36513.col_2: The Loporrits claim this creature resembles their favorite snack─though why they would wish to make that association is anyone's guess.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36514.name: argonaut
36514.col_2: An alien crustacean which traverses the stars by expelling aether.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36515.name: echinos
36515.col_2: This spheroid from the stars is covered not only in spines, but scale-like bone matter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36516.name: space bishop
36516.col_2: This alien life-form appears to have been hung out to dry for a few moons too long.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36517.name: alyketos
36517.col_2: A primordial wanderer capable of walking on land with its stunted legs─presumably for the purpose of harrying other species, but who can say?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

36518.name: horizon event
36518.col_2: This truly incomprehensible creature has likely seen its fair share of cosmic horrors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36519.name: E.B.E.-9318
36519.col_2: An astoundingly alien alien hailing from a dimension beyond our comprehension.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36520.name: unbegotten
36520.col_2: This mysterious entity may well be the spirit of some sentient being, couched in protoplasm and drifting through the cosmos, but there is absolutely no way to know.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36521.name: phallaina
36521.col_2: An enormous cosmic whale that swims through the stars on diffuse currents of aether.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

36522.name: Thavnairian cucumber
36522.col_2: Found on the shoals of Thavnair, it is as if this spiny creature lurks in wait for unsuspecting feet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36523.name: spiny king crab
36523.col_2: A crustacean covered head to pincers in painful spines.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36524.name: Thavnairian eel
36524.col_2: A saltwater eel which slithers about the shoals of Thavnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36525.name: gilled topknot
36525.col_2: A tropical fish with sizable fins that protrude perhaps a little too far from its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36526.name: Purusa fish
36526.col_2: Living off the coast of Thavnair, these fish are capable of creating their own electrical currents.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36527.name: giantsgall jaw
36527.col_2: This carnivorous fish and its peculiar scales trick the eye to appear as naught but stone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36528.name: Akyaali sardine
36528.col_2: This silver wavekin is scooped up by the school in the seas around Thavnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36529.name: spicy pickle
36529.col_2: A peculiar and prickly creature which calls the seas surrounding Thavnair home. Occasionally found inside out.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36530.name: mayavahana
36530.col_2: A saltwater fish with a sail-like fin that acts as a sort of natural dousing mechanism for aether.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36531.name: hedonfish
36531.col_2: Dotted with very fine spots, this saltwater fish appears at first blush to have been caught in some sort of net.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36532.name: satrap trapfish
36532.col_2: Living in the waters around Thavnair, this deep-sea wavekin is so fearsome-looking as to be the source of at least a fable or two.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36533.name: blue marlin
36533.col_2: A large saltwater fish whose lustrous skin seems to shimmer even without sunlight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36534.name: satrap's whisper
36534.col_2: Almost invisible is this jellyfish as it floats serenely through the seas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36535.name: Tebqeyiq smelt
36535.col_2: For every vivid specimen of this species found, there is another far less interesting to look upon─but such is the nature of tropical fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36536.name: shallows cod
36536.col_2: A saltwater fish which tucks itself away in the shadowy portions of shoals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36537.name: Meyhane reveler
36537.col_2: The beauty of this saltwater fish is of great interest to the people of Thavnair─and even greater interest to travelers passing through.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36538.name: Daemir's alloy
36538.col_2: A large saltwater fish which can be found in the Great Runoff.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36539.name: rasa fish
36539.col_2: This wavekin's scales are so beautiful that they appear wrought from copper, and as such it fetches a rather impressive price at market.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36540.name: Agama's palm
36540.col_2: A crustacean found in the Font of Maya.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36541.name: rummy-nosed tetra
36541.col_2: A crimson-faced wavekin which has found a home in the Font of Maya.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36542.name: monksblade
36542.col_2: A wavekin with a body as keen as a polearm's edge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36543.name: Atamra cichlid
36543.col_2: The red of this tropical wavekin is reminiscent of a certain fruit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36544.name: root of maya
36544.col_2: A variety of eel which keeps to the darker depths of the Font of Maya.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36545.name: floral snakehead
36545.col_2: A giant tropical wavekin sporting a fascinating pattern.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36546.name: xiphactinus
36546.col_2: Since time immemorial, this creature has terrorized waterways with its piercing teeth and powerful jaw.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36547.name: dusky shark
36547.col_2: An enormous beast which can be found placidly swimming in warm waters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36548.name: coffer shell
36548.col_2: A bivalve found in the Ruby Sea that practically invites one to slip it into one's pocket.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36549.name: onihige
36549.col_2: Do not let its size fool you─this fish is a terror of the seas. Mainly because of its appearance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36550.name: Onokoro carp
36550.col_2: This otherwise average wavekin would never be caught dead in less temperate climes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36551.name: ruby-spotted crab
36551.col_2: Though this crab advertises its toxicity with its bright and spotted carapace, some people just never learn.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36552.name: marrow-eater
36552.col_2: A bottom-feeder in the most literal sense, this fish can be found on the seafloor munching on all manner of carrion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36553.name: cloudy cat shark
36553.col_2: A variety of two-toned shark that should never be kept as a pet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36554.name: red gurnard
36554.col_2: One always knows when this saltwater fish is coming thanks to its vivid blue-tinged fins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36555.name: dream pickle
36555.col_2: Lucky are the Isari fishermen who can catch and sell this creature.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36556.name: ruby haddock
36556.col_2: One can find schools of these wavekin eking out an existence in the depths of the Ruby Sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36557.name: crown fish
36557.col_2: If one were judging by appearances alone, the marking around this fish's face would make it ruler of the seas. Alas, in the real world, the best it can hope for is to not be confused with the common clown fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36558.name: sword of Isari
36558.col_2: This imposing ancient creature can be found around Isari.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36559.name: blue shark
36559.col_2: A shark with migratory habits that extend from the wide open ocean throughout the Ruby Sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36560.name: barb of exile
36560.col_2: A variety of seahorse living in the deepest part of the Ruby Sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36561.name: smooth lumpfish
36561.col_2: A white saltwater creature with a round body and a texture than can only be described as thoroughly unsettling.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36562.name: hells' cap
36562.col_2: This flat, disc-shaped fish can be found in the hottest parts of the Ruby Sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36563.name: keeled fugu
36563.col_2: Living within the abyssal zone, this fish is much smaller than it leads its predators to believe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36564.name: Eastern seerfish
36564.col_2: A wavekin found swimming the seas of the Far East.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36565.name: false fusilier
36565.col_2: This saltwater fish bears strong resemblance to both true fusiliers and squashed Far Eastern plums, but it is neither.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36566.name: skipping stone
36566.col_2: A diminutive wavekin living in the shallows northeast of Bekko.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36567.name: red-spotted blenny
36567.col_2: This white saltwater wavekin is flecked with spots, as if a painter flicked their brush at it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36568.name: Othardian wrasse
36568.col_2: A saltwater creature known for its beautiful coloration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36569.name: grey mullet
36569.col_2: This sea-dwelling creature is not an uncommon a sight in the waters of the Far East.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36570.name: prayer cushion
36570.col_2: It is something of a marvel to watch these pale wavekin glide effortlessly through the sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36571.name: deepbody boarfish
36571.col_2: These saltwater wavekin are known far and wide for their unique shape and bright color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36572.name: jointed razorfish
36572.col_2: This tiny creature, with its peculiar swimming habits, stands out more than it likely wishes to.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36573.name: pipefish
36573.col_2: A long, red saltwater wavekin embellished with a white underbelly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36574.name: righteye flounder
36574.col_2: A russet-colored kin of the flounder.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36575.name: mini yasha
36575.col_2: A saltwater wavekin with distinctive red and amber coloration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36576.name: sawshark
36576.col_2: With its saw-shaped snout, one would be hard-pressed to consider this shark inconspicuous.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36577.name: Othardian lumpsucker
36577.col_2: A deep-sea wavekin with fins that will cling desperately to just about anything to avoid swimming.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36578.name: shogun's kabuto
36578.col_2: So curious is the shape of this creature's skull, one cannot help but want to wear it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36579.name: bluefin trevally
36579.col_2: The sparkling blue of its fins sets this wavekin apart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36580.name: kitefin shark
36580.col_2: A shark with shining, surreal eyes that stand out like gems against the dull background of its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36581.name: uzumaki
36581.col_2: One would not be alone in saying this primordial beast haunts their dreams.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36582.name: natron puffer
36582.col_2: A wavekin which keeps to the deeper portions of Loch Seld.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36583.name: diamond dagger
36583.col_2: This wavekin enjoys higher levels of salinity than most.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36584.name: queenly fan
36584.col_2: Creatures which adorn themselves with glimmering gems of salt.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36585.name: pale panther
36585.col_2: A variety of eel with a monochrome pattern covering its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36586.name: saltsquid
36586.col_2: A massive squid that calls Loch Seld home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36587.name: platinum hammerhead
36587.col_2: The apex predator of the lochs, this shark can be found skimming the depths in search of prey.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

36588.name: pot of gold salmon roe
36588.col_2: Salmon eggs that glisten in the sunlight. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

36618.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Cosmetics - Clowning Around<hex:021A020103>
36618.col_2: The realm's premier publication on cosmetics─as well as dating advice and, for some reason, politics─this copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Cosmetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for painting an appropriately spooky clown pattern on one's face.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock new face paint at the aesthetician.

36619.name: rarefied integral fishing rod
36619.col_2: Some advise against sparing the rod and spoiling the child, but what about spoiling the child with a fine rod like this one?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36620.name: rarefied chondrite lapidary hammer
36620.col_2: With one of these in hand, one can hammer in the morning─or hammer in the evening─all over this realm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36621.name: rarefied chondrite alembic
36621.col_2: Guaranteed to help one produce the most efficacious elixirs and the most potent potables.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36622.name: rarefied chondrite needle
36622.col_2: Often found in notable weaving establishments; less often found in haystacks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36623.name: pair of rarefied ophiotauroskin halfgloves
36623.col_2: Ideal for adventurers who have no need to cover their fingers or who don't have any fingers to cover in the first place.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36624.name: rarefied AR-Caean velvet work cap
36624.col_2: A simple cap that's soft to the touch and vaguely vocational in its design.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36625.name: rarefied ophiotauroskin magitek codex
36625.col_2: Despite its leather binding, this tome is, in actual fact, a technological wonder─proof that one should not judge a book by its cover.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36626.name: serving of rarefied sykon bavarois
36626.col_2: This jiggly, figgy dessert must be jelly because─famously─jam doesn't shake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

36627.name: sheet of luxurious paper
36627.col_2: Paper of such fine quality, it would be a shame to tarnish it with ink, no matter how skillful the penmanship.

36628.name: bolt of cloth of happiness
36628.col_2: Guaranteed to bring you eternal happiness if its name is anything to go by.

36629.name: phonograph plate
36629.col_2: A specially treated metal sheet used in the construction of phonographs. Even the slightest imperfection can lead to all sorts of ghastly noises being produced.

36630.name: bird of Elpis breast
36630.col_2: The most tender meat this bird has to offer.

36631.name: Valentione mobile
36631.col_2: Dangling decorations crafted into various heart shapes, though none of them are anatomically accurate.

36632.name: mechanical lotus ignition key
36632.col_2: Clearing your mind of impure thoughts while inserting this key into your mechanical lotus will bring it sublimely to life.

36633.name: Chi bolt
36633.col_2: A top-drawer bolt obtained from Chi.

36635.col_2: Awarded to those who have made an outstanding contribution to the realm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Contains a random mount or minion introduced in A Realm Reborn or Heavensward.

36636.col_2: Awarded to those who have made an outstanding contribution to the realm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Contains a random mount or minion introduced in Stormblood.

36639.col_2: Cannot equip gear to hands, legs, and feet.

36656.name: Trophy Crystal
36656.col_2: Handsome─albeit impractically pointy─tokens issued by Eorzea's Grand Companies for use at the Wolves' Den.

36658.name: irregular tomestone of verity
36658.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains a truth so profound, it is said to inspire feelings of deep inadequacy in all those who attempt to comprehend it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

36659.name: inksquid
36659.col_2: Found deep within salt lakes, this cephalopod earned its name by virtue of the copious amounts of ink it produces.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36660.name: seedtoad
36660.col_2: Commonly found in dense forests, this rotund toad camouflages itself as a seed to avoid detection from predators.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36661.name: auroral clam
36661.col_2: Shimmering like an aurora, the unparalleled beauty of these clams have spawned no small few myths among divers in the Far East.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36662.name: holier-than mogpom
36662.col_2: Do not be disturbed by the name of this specimen─it is merely a light-emitting formation of algae that shares a habitat with related species. Nothing more, surely.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36663.name: chalky coral
36663.col_2: It should come as no surprise that a coral of such remarkable writing capacity is often used for marking by merchants in the Near East─the region from which it hails. Indeed, such is its utility that it has come to be considered a tool of the trade.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

36664.name: aetheroconductive quill
36664.col_2: While undoubtedly an excellent writing implement, the aetheroconductive properties of this quill cause one slight brush from its plumage to jolt, rather than tickle.

36665.name: aetheroconductive focus
36665.col_2: One might say─with only the slightest hint of hyperbole─that wielding magicks without a focus is akin to cooking without fire. An aetheroconductive focus, then, should allow one to wield fine spells indeed.

36666.name: luncheon coffer
36666.col_2: A luncheon coffer affixed with a crystal to give it aetherically enhanced insulative properties. It can preserve the temperature of food placed within it for long periods of time.

36667.name: aetheroconductive mammet
36667.col_2: A mammet crafted with materials highly conductive to aether, making it an ideal training tool for fledgling wielders of magicks.

36668.name: assortment of school supplies
36668.col_2: This thoughtful assortment contains myriad school essentials.

36669.name: aetheroconductive feather
36669.col_2: This aetheroconductive feather is destined to become the much-needed quill of a student lacking one.

36670.name: sack of aetheroconductive focus materials
36670.col_2: A sack of rare materials essential in the crafting of aetheroconductive foci.

36671.name: set of luncheon coffer materials
36671.col_2: This may be the most extravagant set of materials you have ever seen used to craft what is essentially a box for one's lunch.

36672.name: set of aetheroconductive mammet materials
36672.col_2: These aetheroconductive materials will make for highly responsive mammets, perfect for any aspiring mage's needs.

36673.name: box of school supply materials
36673.col_2: These materials can be used to craft school supplies─and hopefully a brighter future for the children in need of them.

36674.name: bag of aetheroconductive quill components
36674.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting aetheroconductive quills for students enrolled in the academic homestead program.

36675.name: bag of aetheroconductive focus components
36675.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting aetheroconductive foci for students enrolled in the academic homestead program.

36676.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting luncheon coffers for students enrolled in the academic homestead program.

36677.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting aetheroconductive mammets for the use of students enrolled in the academic homestead program.

36678.name: box of school supply components
36678.col_2: An assortment of components suitable for crafting school supplies for children in need.

36679.name: aetherolectric guitarfish
36679.col_2: A king among guitarfish, and lord of the waters of Scholar's Harbor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

36683.col_2: A king among icepike, and lord of the waters of the Eblan Thaw.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

36915.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Valentione's Dangers<hex:021A020103>

36916.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - An Egg a Day<hex:021A020103>
36916.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - An Egg a Day<hex:021A020103>

36918.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Forearmed Is Well Armed<hex:021A020103>
36918.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Forearmed Is Well Armed<hex:021A020103>

36918.col_3: Ballroom Etiquette - Forearmed Is Well Armed

36919.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Easily at Ease<hex:021A020103>
36919.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Easily at Ease<hex:021A020103>
36919.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing what to do once you have sated your barbaric inclinations and wish to return to civilized society. Use to learn the /sheathe emote.

36920.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Persuasive Perseverance<hex:021A020103>
36920.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to show yourself undaunted by the tasks inevitably set to you by both stranger and acquaintance alike. Use to learn the /determined emote.

36921.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Tea<hex:021A020103>
36921.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to serenely imbibe a steeped beverage, particularly with an all-knowing air. Use to learn the /tea emote.

36922.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Soliciting Applause<hex:021A020103>
36922.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to best introduce persons of repute and particularly large desserts. Use to learn the /showright and /showleft emotes.

37333.description: sets of Susano's rapturous paladin arms

37344.name: set of gingerbread cottage walls
37344.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a delicious gingerbread cottage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

37345.name: set of gingerbread house walls
37345.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a delicious gingerbread house.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

37346.name: set of gingerbread mansion walls
37346.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a delicious gingerbread mansion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

37347.name: classic dresser
37347.col_2: A lavish vanity that hearkens back to days long past.

37348.name: log rack
37348.col_2: A lovely rack to organize your logs.

37349.name: indoor marble fountain
37349.col_2: A fountain carved from deep-sea marble and whimsically decorated with moogle statuettes.

37351.name: ornamental crystal array
37351.col_2: A decorative wall ornament dripping with jewels.

37352.name: log pillar
37352.col_2: A decorative wooden pillar designed to resemble the tree it came from.

37353.name: kweh-kweh clock
37353.col_2: A charming chronometer designed to alert you of the time with a rousing “Kweh-kweh!” at convenient intervals. Recommended to those plagued by unwanted fits of napping.

37354.name: small blackboard
37354.col_2: Experience the joy of slapping two dusty erasers together again and again. And again.

37355.name: Eastern canopy bed
37355.col_2: Sleep in luxury under a canopy of softly blooming flowers from the Far East. Be advised that sleepers may or may not wake up subsumed in petals.

37356.name: wondrous parfait
37356.col_2: A massive dessert layered with plenty of fresh fruit, whipped cream, and frozen confectionary. 37357.col_2: A cushioned settee expressly designed for contemplating one's more opulent sins.

37359.name: ivy curtain
37359.col_2: A natural veil of trailing greenery.

37360.name: luminous wooden loft
37360.col_2: All the fun of a regular wooden loft, now with built-in light fixtures!

37361.name: swinging-door counter
37361.col_2: Be advised not to let the doors of this handsome counter hit you on the way out, as many a barkeep can attest that they pack a punch for both buttocks.

37362.name: Ironworks tool set
37362.col_2: A set of Garlond Ironworks' finest instruments.

37363.name: trick bookshelf partition
37363.col_2: Pull the correct tome from the shelf to trigger the hidden door. Perfect for bibliophiles with a secret agenda.

37364.name: simple arched window
37364.col_2: An arched window lovely in its simplicity.

37365.name: factory pillar
37365.col_2: A rusted metal pillar with an uncanny resemblance to those found in the Copied Factory.

37366.name: curved marble partition
37366.col_2: A gently curved, cream-colored partition with a white marble baseboard.

37367.name: iron chair
37367.col_2: A refined chair wrought with diligence.

37368.name: indoor climbing frame
37368.col_2: A curious, latticelike structure that inspires rampant frolicking and climbing upon contact. Approach with caution.

37369.name: steel locker
37369.col_2: A metal cupboard perfectly suited for stowing cleaning instruments, sundry items, and lithographs of your sweetheart.

37370.name: alpine cabinet
37370.col_2: A decorative cabinet designed in the alpine style.

37371.name: alpine wall lantern
37371.col_2: A wall lantern crafted in the alpine style.

37372.name: Astrologicum star map
37372.col_2: An august chart rich with the secrets of the heavens. Good for study and impressing your guests.

37373.name: imitation highland window
37373.col_2: Who needs a house in the freezing peaks when you can mount a frosty windowpane upon your wall instead?

37374.name: House Fortemps fireplace
37374.col_2: A faithful replica of the fireplace found in Fortemps Manor.

37375.name: alpine doormat
37375.col_2: A welcome mat designed to complement alpine residences.

37376.name: cathedral lectern
37376.col_2: An uncanny recreation of the lectern used in Saint Reymanaud's Cathedral.

37377.name: scholasticate table
37377.col_2: A long desk much like those found at Saint Endalim's Scholasticate.

37378.name: scholasticate chair
37378.col_2: A wooden chair much like those found at Saint Endalim's Scholasticate.

37379.name: scholasticate bookshelf
37379.col_2: A laden bookshelf much like those found at Saint Endalim's Scholasticate.

37380.name: bluefeather astrolabos
37380.col_2: A hauntingly beautiful model of the universe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

37381.name: Royal Menagerie phasmascape
37381.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the splendor of Ala Mhigo's Royal Menagerie under a dying sun.

37382.name: Sea of Clouds phasmascape
37382.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the bevy of isles floating above Abalathia's Spine.

37383.name: stuffed Sanduruva
37383.col_2: Said to bring prosperity to the one who displays it. Any rumors that great wealth is hidden within are certainly exaggerated.

37384.name: stuffed Minduruva
37384.col_2: Said to bestow talent in the arts to the one who displays it. Any reports of it crafting shoes by night are likely exaggerated.

37385.name: stuffed Cinduruva
37385.col_2: Said to bless the one who displays it with wisdom. Any reports of its eyes moving on their own accord are greatly exaggerated. Probably.

37386.name: moogle balloon
37386.col_2: That adorable moogle balloon from the Gold Saucer that you've always desired─now yours!

37387.name: eggsemplary basket
37387.col_2: An elegant and enticing example of exceptional egg-hunting.

37388.name: Hatching-tide mobile
37388.col_2: The twirl and bob of this Hatching-tide mobile reminds you of all the hidden eggs you have yet to find...

37389.name: Emperor portrait
37389.col_2: A commissioned portrait of the Garlean Empire's founding father, Solus zos Galvus, entitled <hex:021A020203>Beyond the Horizon<hex:021A020103>. Original artist unknown.

37390.name: Heavensturn crane banner
37390.col_2: A resplendent Heavensturn decoration bedecked with auspicious cranes.

37391.name: azure banner of conflict
37391.col_2: A brilliant blue banner distributed at the Wolves' Den.

37392.name: crimson banner of conflict
37392.col_2: A fierce red banner distributed at the Wolves' Den.

37393.col_2: A delightful set of bite-sized morsels of baked chocolate fashioned to resemble spriggans. 37395.name: serving of authentic Costa del Hielo
37395.description: servings of authentic Costa del Hielo
37395.col_2: A delicious chilled dessert created by the confectioner Nekeke, this icy treat is both refreshing and easy on the waistline, as it largely consists of frozen water. 37398.col_2: A stone bridge tastefully hemmed with tendrils of creeping ivy.

37399.name: snowy red brick bench
37399.col_2: Someone might have sat here, alone in the snow, thinking of warmer days since passed...

37400.name: raised wooden deck
37400.col_2: An elevated platform designed for access by only those who dare to hop, skip, or jump.

37401.name: garden gate
37401.col_2: Curious what lies beyond the garden wall? The garden gate is here to help.

37402.name: planter set
37402.col_2: A vibrant arrangement of plant life bursting from a cluster of sturdy planters.

37403.name: set of sweet lawn ornaments
37403.col_2: Giant, lifelike lawn ornaments that look tasty enough to lick. (Be advised that this item is for decorative purposes only and should not be licked or otherwise consumed under any circumstances.)

37404.name: damaged Ishgardian wall
37404.col_2: A damaged wall preserved for posterity during the Ishgardian Restoration.

37405.name: Ishgardian lamppost
37405.col_2: A lamppost of steel such as one might see lining an Ishgardian street. Authentically frigid!

37406.name: summer bonfire
37406.col_2: A roaring bonfire perfect for activities such as celebrating the Moonfire Faire and establishing a solid alibi.

37407.name: authentic Moonfire mask stall
37407.col_2: A stall with an assortment of colorful masks on display, as seen during the Moonfire Faire festivities. While a simple novelty item at first glance, each mask has, in truth, been expertly crafted by the hands of a master.

37408.name: Amaurotine interior wall
37408.col_2: An interior wall recreated from the memory of a city long since destroyed.

37409.name: unit of Amaurotine flooring
37409.col_2: Elegant stone flooring recreated from the memory of a city long since destroyed.

37410.name: Amaurotine spire chandelier
37410.col_2: A breathtaking light fixture resembling the once-proud spires of a city long since destroyed.
