37482.name: set of authentic egg barding
37482.col_2: An egg-themed chocobo harness created in celebration of Hatching-tide. The authentic hat is rumored to have highly advanced egg-detection functionalities.

37483.name: set of authentic paramour barding
37483.col_2: A gaudy suit of chocobo armor designed for use during Valentione's Day celebrations. While some─including your steed─may question your fashion sense, the authenticity of your passion will be indisputable to all.

37484.name: white lace parasol
37484.col_2: A frill-rimmed umbrella perfect for any weather except rain. Use to unlock a white lace parasol.

37485.name: blue blossom parasol
37485.col_2: A white umbrella printed with a charming pattern of blue flowers, moogles, chocobos, and more. Use to unlock a blue blossom parasol.

37486.name: pair of false shaded spectacles
37486.col_2: These tinted lenses will place you at the forefront of trendiness─so long as you avoid bumping into anything while wearing them. Though these were once considered a fashion accessory, trends are ever changing, and style enthusiasts now classify them as facewear. Use to unlock shaded spectacles.

37487.name: pair of false classic spectacles
37487.col_2: Wear these for a classic look of intelligence.*<hex:02100103>* Glasses have no effect on actual intelligence. Generous bouts of silence may be advised. Though these were once considered a fashion accessory, trends are ever changing, and style enthusiasts now classify them as facewear. Use to unlock classic spectacles.

37488.name: spindle of exciting fiber
37488.col_2: Synthetic material invented and woven by the Loporrits. The texture is exhilaratingly different on either side.

37489.name: chunk of deep-sea marble
37489.col_2: Stone pulled from the bottom of the Sirensong Sea.

37490.name: bag of driftseeds
37490.col_2: A myriad assortment of seeds harvested from natural flotsam.

37491.name: resplendent feather
37491.col_2: This highly collectable feather appears to be larger and more beautiful than that of any documented fauna.

37492.name: blue feather
37492.col_2: A feather the color of a deep night sky yearning for dawn.

37493.name: appointed attire coffer
37493.col_2: A banded chest containing a complete set of appointed attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

37551.name: island palm leaf
37551.col_2: A fibrous frond from a palm tree native to the Cieldalaes.

37552.name: island apple
37552.col_2: A variety of apple selectively bred to not only survive, but flourish in the hot and humid climes of the southern isles.

37553.name: island branch
37553.col_2: An extra rest cycle is recommended for any mammets found using this small branch to charge down nearby windmills.

37554.name: island stone
37554.col_2: This stone has not gone unturned. Now for the rest...

37555.name: island clam
37555.col_2: A clam native to the Rhotano Sea, scooped from island sands despite its best efforts.

37556.name: island laver
37556.col_2: One can convert this seaweed into black salt by burning it to a crisp, providing additional salt variety when the entirety of the ocean simply will not suffice.

37557.name: piece of island coral
37557.col_2: A fragment of coral native to the Rhotano Sea, commonly found along the coasts of isles in the Cieldalaes.

37558.name: sprig of islewort
37558.col_2: This common grass found growing throughout the Cieldalaes can be used as an ingredient in delicious salads and markedly less delicious potions.

37559.name: sack of island sand
37559.col_2: A sack of rough and coarse sand gathered from an isle in the Cieldalaes. Some say it has a mind of its own, with the charming proclivity to get anywhere─and everywhere─it possibly can.

37560.name: island log
37560.col_2: A freshly cut log of timber that mammets have helpfully identified as “from a tree.”

37561.name: island palm log
37561.col_2: A fragrant, freshly cut log of timber from a palm tree native to the Cieldalaes.

37562.name: bundle of island vine
37562.col_2: Highly elastic vine harvested on an isle in the Cieldalaes.

37563.name: pot of island sap
37563.col_2: A sweet, sticky substance harvested from trees in the Cieldalaes.

37564.name: chunk of island copper ore
37564.col_2: A sizable chunk of metallic ore mined in the Cieldalaes.

37565.name: slab of island limestone
37565.col_2: This sedimentary rock does not, in fact, taste of refreshing lime. Not that you would know.

37566.name: chunk of island rock salt
37566.col_2: This red-hued salt is prized by islekeeps for its role in the creation of homemade frozen treats and myriad practical uses. By contrast─and for reasons unknown to the locals─certain Cieldalaes tourists insist upon licking it directly.

37567.name: stalk of island sugarcane
37567.col_2: The sturdy and stout stalk of this native flora is rich in sugar, making it far superior to other island plants. Especially that salad one.

37568.name: island cotton boll
37568.col_2: The fluffy flower of a cotton plant, buffeted by Rhotano breezes no more.

37569.name: tuft of island hemp
37569.col_2: The stalk of this sun-kissed plant contains fibers used for weaving─and only weaving, in case anyone asks.

37570.name: sack of island clay
37570.col_2: Natural clay of the Cieldalaes variety, which is to say, “excessively and perennially damp.”

37571.name: pinch of island tinsand
37571.col_2: This sand sourced from Cieldalaes waters contains a high concentration of tiny grains of tin.

37572.name: chunk of island iron ore
37572.col_2: A sizable chunk of iron-imbued ore mined in the Cieldalaes.

37573.name: chunk of island quartz
37573.col_2: What distinguishes this translucent mass of unpolished quartz from others is the novelty of its source in the Cieldalaes...so very little, all told.

37574.name: chunk of island leucogranite
37574.col_2: Attempting to say the name of this pale igneous rock three times in a row without severing one's tongue is a tried-and-true islekeep's pastime.

37575.name: islefish
37575.col_2: Much like any wavekin, the islefish loves a nice body of water on a hot day, and also all other days.

37576.name: island squid
37576.col_2: A traveling culinarian once claimed that such squid offer a uniquely “tropical” flavor, but failed to mention how it was seasoned before her passing, thus accidentally spawning a culinary controversy that continues to this day. Let this be a warning.

37577.name: island jellyfish
37577.col_2: Innocuous though it may seem, this species of jellyfish makes a habit of swarming island coasts during the summer season, and has not proven particularly reticent to sting those who risk a dip in the water.

37578.name: stalk of island alyssum
37578.col_2: A rare species of alyssum found only in the Cieldalaes. Though it possesses a sweet honey fragrance, the flavor leaves much to be desired.

37579.name: raw island garnet
37579.col_2: This dark red garnet is hard enough to sharpen a dagger─a strange priority to have, come to think of it, but here we are.

37580.name: island spruce log
37580.col_2: A freshly cut log of timber from a spruce native to the Cieldalaes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>...That wasn't so hard, now was it, mammets?

37581.name: island hammerhead
37581.col_2: The thalassocracy advises its islekeeps to seek shade and a tall glass of water immediately should they find themselves muttering, “There must be a nailhead out there somewhere”─a suspected early symptom of islestroke.

37582.name: chunk of island silver ore
37582.col_2: A sizable chunk of shining ore mined in the Cieldalaes.

37583.name: island popoto set
37583.col_2: A bag chock-full of island popoto pieces that can be used to grow more popotoes, perpetuating an infinite popoto cycle that likely predates the advent of agriculture.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37584.name: bag of island cabbage seeds
37584.col_2: A bag containing countless cabbage seeds, to be planted by those who enjoy their greens pale and tasting of flatulence.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37585.name: bag of isleberry seeds
37585.col_2: A bag plump with isleberry seeds. Plant them, grow them, weather an intense battle with the local birds, eat them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37586.name: bag of island pumpkin seeds
37586.col_2: One might say this is a bag full of pump's kin. Or one might not.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37587.name: island onion set
37587.col_2: A bag of onion cuttings. They can be planted as is, and will quickly mature into large onion bulbs─unless the gardening mammets get hungry.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37588.name: bag of island tomato seeds
37588.col_2: Though one may be unable to facilitate peace between those who call them toe-may-toes versus toe-mah-toes ere these seeds ripen, there is certainly time to cultivate a robust sunburn in solidarity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37589.name: bag of island wheat seeds
37589.col_2: You <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> get wheat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37590.name: bag of island corn seeds
37590.col_2: There was once a La Noscean farmer who insisted the growth of this crop was powered by puns. He has since been shipped off to a sanctuary, where he may do the world no more harm. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37591.name: bag of island parsnip seeds
37591.col_2: With a whole bag of these seeds, there is ample opportunity to cultivate the perfect parsnip─and carve it into a horrific visage to ward off island spirits, should the mood strike.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37592.name: bag of island radish seeds
37592.col_2: Rumor has it that these seeds grow into ravishingly redolent radishes. Rumor also has a startlingly suggestive way with words.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

37593.name: island popoto
37593.col_2: A popoto a day keeps the Lalafells away...or was it the opposite?

37594.name: island cabbage
37594.col_2: Crisp and crunchy cabbage cultivated in the Cieldalaes.

37595.name: isleberry
37595.col_2: A verifiably nonlethal berry found in the Cieldalaes.

37597.name: island onion
37597.col_2: Like its inland cousins, this round onion bulb does not take kindly to knives.

37598.name: island tomato
37598.col_2: A ripe tomato cultivated in the Cieldalaes. Goes well with onions, should one be willing to risk it.

37601.name: island parsnip
37601.col_2: A perfect parsnip cultivated in an island paradise.

37602.name: island radish
37602.col_2: A robust radish ready to add a spicy kick to what will inevitably be dubbed “island salad.”

37603.name: basket of sanctuary fleece
37603.col_2: A basket of wool sheared from a sheep that really, <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> needed the trim.

37604.name: sanctuary claw
37604.col_2: A stray claw shed by an animal in the sanctuary pasture.

37605.name: basket of sanctuary fur
37605.col_2: Clumps of fur shed by an animal in the sanctuary pasture.

37606.name: sanctuary feather
37606.col_2: A white feather shed by a cloudkin in the sanctuary pasture.

37607.name: sanctuary egg
37607.col_2: An egg laid by an animal in the sanctuary pasture.

37608.name: sanctuary carapace
37608.col_2: A stray carapace shed by an animal in the sanctuary pasture.

37609.name: sanctuary fang
37609.col_2: A stray fang removed from an animal in the sanctuary pasture during routine dental care.

37610.name: sanctuary horn
37610.col_2: A stray horn shed by an animal in the sanctuary pasture.

37611.name: can of sanctuary milk
37611.col_2: This unlabeled liquid was freshly milked from a beast in the sanctuary pasture. Which one, who can recall?

37612.name: serving of island sweetfeed
37612.col_2: Scrumptious bite-sized fruit pieces prepared as feed for animals in the sanctuary pasture. Satisfactorily filling, a serving of this treat will brighten any hungry critter's mood.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Improves mood up to: Content]

37613.name: serving of island greenfeed
37613.col_2: A healthy assortment of vegetables prepared as feed for animals in the sanctuary pasture. Pleasantly filling, a serving of this tasty fodder will have animals jumping for joy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Improves mood up to: Chipper]

37614.name: serving of premium island greenfeed
37614.col_2: This assortment of vegetables is the veritable cream of the crop, prepared as feed for animals in the sanctuary pasture. Perfectly filling, a serving of this exquisite fodder will leave animals feeling jubilant and revitalized.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Improves mood up to: Gleeful]

37615.name: makeshift net
37615.col_2: A crude net made by attaching elastic vines to a branch of fleeting sturdiness. Breaks after a single use due to its frail construction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be used to catch small animals.]

37616.name: makeshift restraint
37616.col_2: A rudimentary restraint made by attaching metallic weights to each end of a hempen rope. Breaks after a single use due to its frail construction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be used to catch average-sized animals.]

37617.name: makeshift soporific
37617.col_2: A sleep-inducing pellet made by grinding an assortment of raw materials into a fine powder, before kneading them into a ball with bits of clay. A single pellet may only be used once.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Can be used to catch large animals.]

37618.name: serving of isleworks sauerkraut
37618.col_2: This fermented cabbage dish has a distinctive sour flavor, and can be preserved for however long one is willing to tempt fate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Preserved Food<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37619.name: serving of isleworks baked pumpkin
37619.col_2: Despite being a homemade recipe cobbled together with ingredients scrounged up in the Cieldalaes, this savory stone oven-baked pumpkin dish is a dainty delight.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37620.name: isleworks tunic
37620.col_2: A simple hempen tunic woven in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Attire/Textiles<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37621.name: isleworks culinary knife
37621.col_2: A knife made from a sanctuary claw. Can cut a mean vegetable, and nice ones too.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37622.name: isleworks brush
37622.col_2: A basic brush assembled in the sanctuary workshop, fashioned from wood. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Woodworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37623.name: isleworks boiled egg
37623.col_2: Boiled using fresh water from a sanctuary spring. Add a sprinkle of salt and a pinch of pepper for peak delectability.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37624.name: pair of isleworks hora
37624.col_2: A pugilist's weapon made from a sanctuary carapace.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Arms/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37625.name: pair of isleworks earrings
37625.col_2: A pair of earrings fashioned from a sanctuary fang.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37626.name: slab of isleworks butter
37626.col_2: A slab of butter churned from sanctuary milk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Ingredients/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37627.name: isleworks wooden chair
37627.col_2: A wooden chair assembled in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Furnishings/Woodworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37628.name: isleworks potion
37628.col_2: A simple restorative concoction made in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Concoctions<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37629.name: isleworks necklace
37629.col_2: A simple wooden necklace made in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Woodworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37630.name: isleworks grilled clam
37630.col_2: A fresh island clam grilled over an open flame until its shell has opened, then seasoned with a simple mixture of rock salt and butter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37631.name: isleworks coral ring
37631.col_2: A sanguine ring made of coral, constructed in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37632.name: isleworks barbut
37632.col_2: A copper helm constructed in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Attire/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37633.name: pinch of isleworks firesand
37633.col_2: A highly flammable substance made in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Concoctions/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37634.name: isleworks macuahuitl
37634.col_2: A blunt wooden weapon affixed with jagged obsidian shards. Occasionally used by practitioners of the sword.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Arms/Woodworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37635.name: isleworks brick counter
37635.col_2: Built with bricks formed from dried island clay, this counter is of nearly professional construction. Nearly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Furnishings/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37636.name: bronze sheep
37636.col_2: A stupendous sheep statue sculpted from copper.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Furnishings/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37637.name: bottle of isleworks growth formula
37637.col_2: A chemical solution capable of increasing the fertility of soil and promoting the growth of fauna.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Concoctions<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37638.name: isleworks garnet rapier
37638.col_2: A rapier crafted with an accompanying garnet focus in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Arms/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37639.name: isleworks spruce round shield
37639.col_2: A wooden shield made in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Attire/Woodworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37640.name: bottle of isleworks shark oil
37640.col_2: According to an old wives' tale, the shock of losing its mother shortly after birth will induce a shark's offspring to follow her scent until its dying day─or until it finds the individual holding what remains of her.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37641.name: pair of isleworks silver ear cuffs
37641.description: pairs of isleworks silver ear cuffs
37641.col_2: A pair of ear cuffs forged from silver ore in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37642.name: isleworks sweet popoto
37642.col_2: Delicious and easily prepared, this sweet variant of popotoes makes for the perfect snack.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Confections<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37643.name: serving of isleworks parsnip salad
37643.col_2: Thinly cut slices of fried island parsnips lend a refreshingly sweet flavor to this salad.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37644.name: plate of isleworks caramels
37644.col_2: This sublime treat is created from caramelized sugar mixed with fresh milk and butter. Best enjoyed with a cup of unsweetened tea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Confections<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37645.name: isleworks ribbon
37645.col_2: A charming ribbon woven in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Textiles<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37646.name: coil of isleworks rope
37646.col_2: A reliable rope woven in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Textiles<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37647.name: isleworks cavalier's hat
37647.col_2: A refined hat for the refined personage, woven in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Attire/Textiles<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37648.name: isleworks horn
37648.col_2: A horn made from─wait for it─a horn.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37649.name: isleworks salt cod
37649.col_2: This salted fish, though delicious, must be soaked in water for several hours before being cooked, lest one's taste buds be overwhelmed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Preserved Food/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37650.name: jar of isleworks squid ink
37650.col_2: A jar of freshly extracted ink often used as an ingredient in dishes, or, when squirted into a witless assailant's eyes, as a means of self-defense.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Ingredients/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37651.name: bottle of isleworks essential draught
37651.col_2: This unusual concoction of venom extracted from jellyfish and blended with palm leaves and seaweed makes for the perfect morning mixture, sure to put a pep in one's step. Mildly deadly if not taken in small doses.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Concoctions/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37652.name: jar of isleberry jam
37652.col_2: The best jam in the business. It's truly berry good.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Ingredients<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37653.name: bowl of isleworks onion soup
37653.col_2: No tears were shed in the making of this soup─a boon of mammet-based labor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37654.name: bowl of isleworks tomato relish
37654.col_2: The perfect ingredient for those who relish tomatoes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Ingredients<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37655.name: serving of islefish pie
37655.col_2: This unusual recipe comprised of an islefish baked in wheat and topped with cane sugar has its fans. Surely.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Confections/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37656.name: bowl of isleworks corn flakes
37656.col_2: Though this dish of toasted corn flakes mixed with sanctuary milk is normally quite nutritious, it is decidedly less so when a rogue mammet sneakily adds several lumps of sugar to “enhance” its flavor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Preserved Food<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

37657.name: serving of isleworks pickled radish
37657.col_2: This ravishing radish-turned-pickle adds an additional layer of flavor to salads and sandwiches, and can also be enjoyed as a side dish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Preserved Food<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37658.name: isleworks iron axe
37658.col_2: A sturdy two-handed axe forged in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Arms/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37659.name: isleworks quartz ring
37659.col_2: A ring forged from iron, affixed with a small chunk of quartz.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37660.name: isleworks porcelain vase
37660.col_2: An astoundingly ornate─and unquestionably fragile─porcelain vase that ought to make one pause and consider whether the mammets in one's employ are being paid enough for their services. And also when and why they learned to make porcelain vases.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

37661.name: glass of isleworks vegetable juice
37661.col_2: For those who love the taste of vegetables so much they would see them blended together to be enjoyed all at once. Alternatively, for those who hate vegetables so much they would see them blended until only their barest essence remains, to be imbibed solely for their nutrients.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Concoctions<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37662.name: serving of isleworks pumpkin pudding

37663.name: isleworks sheepfluff rug
37663.col_2: A rug of such pure fluffiness, even the wildest wolf would whimper in sheer disbelief at its softness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Furnishings/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

37664.name: isleworks garden scythe

37679.name: islekeep's stone hatchet

37680.name: islekeep's stone hammer
37680.col_2: A roughly hewn mallet useful for hitting things and collecting additional materials from designated resources.

37681.name: islekeep's shovel
37681.col_2: A true adventurer shovels responsibly. Use this tool to collect additional materials from designated resources.

37682.name: islekeep's copper scythe
37682.col_2: This curved blade is both pointy and dangerous, but will help you collect additional materials from designated resources so long as you mind your toes.

37683.name: islekeep's bronze gig
37683.col_2: Skewer additional materials when gathering from designated resources and hone your stabbing skills with this spear.

37684.name: islekeep's bronze beakaxe
37684.col_2: No birds were harmed in the making of this beakaxe. Use to collect additional materials from designated resources with a clear(ish) conscience.

37685.col_2: Gardening equipment specifically crafted for the tiny, industrious hands of mammets.

37686.name: set of mammet-sized pastureworker's tools
37686.col_2: Creature caretaking tools specifically crafted for the tiny, industrious hands of mammets.

37687.name: set of basic mammet-sized builder's tools
37687.description: sets of basic mammet-sized builder's tools
37687.col_2: With these tools, any skilled mammet can enact noticeable change upon an island.

37688.name: set of better mammet-sized builder's tools
37688.description: sets of better mammet-sized builder's tools
37688.col_2: With these tools, any hardworking mammet can enact noteworthy change upon an island.

37689.name: set of best mammet-sized builder's tools
37689.description: sets of best mammet-sized builder's tools
37689.col_2: With these tools, any enthusiastic mammet can enact unbelievable change upon an island.

37690.name: set of bestest mammet-sized builder's tools
37690.description: sets of bestest mammet-sized builder's tools
37690.col_2: With these tools, any mammet at all can become an enlightened genius of development, and pave the way to a paradise of vitality and affluence.

37691.name: prime crystalbloom
37691.col_2: This sap-coated plant has taken on a glossy, crystalline appearance, but it is yet in flux. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

37692.name: sublime crystalbloom
37692.col_2: This peerless crystalbloom has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

37693.name: phial of verdurous glioaether
37693.col_2: Rich green oil refined by aetherial reduction to a highly concentrated state.

37694.name: prime siderite
37694.col_2: A ferrous meteorite in apparent flux. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

37695.name: sublime siderite

37696.name: phial of igneous glioaether

38261.name: melon pie
38261.col_2: The flaky crust serves as a perfect complement to the thundermelon's sweet-yet-electrifying flesh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38262.name: bottle of melon juice
38262.col_2: Paralyzingly delicious juice freshly squeezed from thundermelons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38263.name: serving of sunset carrot nibbles
38263.col_2: Ribbons of thinly sliced sunset carrots dressed with vinegar make for a healthful and serenely wholesome dish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38264.name: serving of carrot pudding
38264.col_2: To freeze, shred, steam, and bake carrots into this smooth pudding requires both time and skill, but the mouthwatering results are well worth the effort.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38265.name: serving of gyros
38265.col_2: A slice of slow-cooked loaghtan meat wrapped in leafy greens and tucked into a pocket of freshly baked bread.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38266.name: serving of loaghtan rump steak
38266.col_2: If this loaghtan had a heart as tender as its rump, its passing was a tragedy indeed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38267.name: serving of piennolo tomato salad
38267.col_2: A bright tomato salad lightly tossed in perilla oil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38268.name: Garlean pizza
38268.col_2: Heaped with Garlean cheese and baked to perfection, this flatbread may well rival certain soups in its ability to move partakers to tears.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38269.name: serving of urchin pasta
38269.col_2: Pasta simmered in cream sauce and topped with a generous portion of king urchin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38270.name: king urchin loaf
38270.col_2: King urchin corals mixed with mushrooms and herbs, then returned to the urchin shell and baked until delightfully spongy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38271.name: thundermelon
38271.col_2: This fruit is sweet, but its rich and electrifying acidity numbs the tongue.

38273.name: cut of prime loaghtan rump
38273.col_2: A sumptuous slice of meat cut from a loved and nurtured loaghtan.

38274.name: piennolo tomato
38274.col_2: A juicy, thick-skinned tomato brimming with essential minerals.

38275.name: king urchin
38275.col_2: A particularly large and meaty urchin, the harvest of which is currently monopolized by a certain fishing association.

38276.name: sprig of wild liverwort
38276.col_2: So wild, in fact, that it grows exclusively in the farthest reaches of the universe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38277.name: pinch of star sea salt
38277.col_2: From a beach that is no longer a beach on a star that is no longer a star.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38278.name: pinch of stellar magnesium
38278.col_2: Hopefully this is not a “seasoning” in the same sense that machine oil is a “meal”...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38279.name: chunk of pure green quartz
38279.col_2: As colorful and lustrous as the mountains of the Dragonstar─or so Midgardsormr told Hraesvelgr told Vidofnir, anyway.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38280.name: methane egg
38280.col_2: All right, then.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38281.name: chunk of trona ore
38281.col_2: A salt-rich mineral to be used in the synthesis of low-grade herbicide.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38282.name: mineral sample
38282.col_2: A sample of minerals which will be tested to determine the purity of water from the wellspring of regret.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38283.name: chunk of nutrient-rich ore
38283.col_2: Ore filled with nutrients that are alien to the environment of Elysion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38284.name: chunk of clear rock salt
38284.col_2: Salt is not commonly known as a coffee additive, but connoisseurs insist that it brings out the beverage's natural sweetness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38285.name: piece of limestone coral
38285.col_2: A sample of coral taken from the ocean waters of Elysion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38286.name: chunk of weighted agalmatolite
38286.col_2: A heat- and water-resistant stone said to be used for artistic carvings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38287.name: clump of bryophyte
38287.col_2: A variety of moss rich with nutrients suitable for aquaculture.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38288.name: chunk of Elysian rock salt
38288.col_2: Naturally occurring salt crystals found in the waters of Elysion. They can be ground to use as seasoning in a variety of dishes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38289.name: diatom cluster
38289.col_2: A variety of algae believed to be suited to the Karellian palate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38290.name: handful of Karellian black salt
38290.col_2: A clouded sodium compound harvested from Elysion. Whether its coloring is due to simple environmental factors or the lingering despair of a lost civilization is unclear, though this may be a difference without a distinction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38291.name: chunk of salt-like rock
38291.col_2: Unlike its cousin rock-like salt, this mineral is entirely unfit for consumption.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38292.name: supremest space oyster
38292.col_2: A mollusk that exceeds all expectations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38293.name: mashable worm
38293.col_2: This soft-bodied creature is only a mortar and pestle away from becoming a tasty treat for a Miw Miisv.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38294.name: sack of pillowy cosmoclay
38294.col_2: Earthlike substance guaranteed to provide comfort to all squishy corporeal organisms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38295.name: clump of bioluminescent rock moss
38295.col_2: A bit of light can do wonders for the mood. Even a dragon's.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38296.name: delectable worm
38296.col_2: A tasty worm for hungry wyrms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38297.name: monumental whetstone
38297.col_2: A whetstone presumably effective in sharpening the claws of dragons, though the Ea may not appreciate the source used for its extraction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38298.name: sack of metalsand
38298.col_2: Grains of sand rich in metallic minerals, to be mixed into a soil-purifying concoction.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38299.name: porous stone
38299.col_2: According to Stigma-4's infallible calculations, this permeable stone is perfectly suited to the task of polishing dragon fangs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38300.name: prime alien onion
38300.col_2: A fresh, pungent vegetable primed to conquer the palate of unwitting life-forms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38301.name: pod of dragonseye beans
38301.col_2: Replete with amino acids, these legumes smell of the sea...and perhaps slightly of eyeball.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38302.name: pinch of stellar cumin
38302.col_2: Despite its alien scent and outerworldly location, this rare spice could not possibly be toxic to mankind...right?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38303.name: Sohm Al bloom
38303.col_2: A flower of the seventh heaven species, bound to provoke nostalgia in particularly ancient dragons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38304.name: methane blossom
38304.col_2: Those particularly prone to either euphemism or mischief might deem this flower “fragrant.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38305.name: clump of celestial grain
38305.col_2: Grain which can only be found among the cosmos. To be used in the synthesis of low-grade herbicide.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38306.name: plant life sample
38306.col_2: A sample of plant life which will be tested to determine the purity of water from the wellspring of regret.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38307.name: clump of withered grass
38307.col_2: While this grass is nothing to look at, it may hold the key to enriching Elysian soil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38308.name: bottle of sweet nectar
38308.col_2: Sugary nectar is said to dull the natural bitterness of coffee while adding another dimension to its rich flavor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38309.name: Elysian cucumber
38309.col_2: A peculiar sluglike creature found in the ocean waters of Elysion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38310.name: bunch of fragrant greens
38310.col_2: A redolent plant Stigma-4 is 90% certain will satisfy the Grebuloffs, meaning there's a 10% chance you will incur their wrath.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38311.name: bunch of Elysian seaweed
38311.col_2: A nutrient-rich algae commonly used in aquaculture.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38312.name: strip of Elysian kelp
38312.col_2: This saltwater weed can be eaten raw, cooked, or powdered, making it the all-purpose ingredient of choice for many a seafood dish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38313.name: clump of rock moss
38313.col_2: It is unclear why anyone would consider rock scrapings to be a delicacy, but to argue its delectability would likely fan the flames of another Karellian war.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38314.name: sheaf of Karellian prismatic wheat
38314.col_2: This brilliant, multicolored crop radiates hope for the future.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38315.name: puantplant
38315.col_2: No one likes to say its name and no one wants to eat it. Leave this plant alone for gods' sake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38316.name: strip of supremest kelp
38316.col_2: A sample of seaweed scientifically proven to be too good for this universe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38317.name: bundle of softmoss
38317.col_2: Lichen lickerous to the likes of little Miw Miisv.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38318.name: branch of supple cosmowood
38318.col_2: Wood as soft as the delicate fluttering of a baby Miw Miisv.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38319.name: lucent flower
38319.col_2: A beautiful, radiant flower that may serve as a beacon of hope for dragons residing in Reah Tahra.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38320.name: true dragon fruit
38320.col_2: Not the other kind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38321.name: cotton-like plant
38321.col_2: Though the soft thistledown of this plant could, in theory, be used to provide a bed for dragons, the sheer amount that would be required is surely unsustainable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38322.name: sprig of Elysian herb
38322.col_2: This plant has medicinal properties that, when mixed with the appropriate ingredients, may create a mixture capable of producing fertile soil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38323.name: strip of fibrous kelp
38323.col_2: A stringy seaweed theoretically capable of cleaning the interdental spaces of a dragon's mouth─assuming one were brave enough to climb inside of it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

38324.name: strip of soggy alien kelp
38324.col_2: So moist it couldn't possibly be less than fresh!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38325.name: stellar herring
38325.col_2: This fish still smells of the sea, even after all this time. Or perhaps it was the sea that smelled of fish... Yes, definitely the second one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38326.name: meteoric bonito
38326.col_2: With any luck, this inordinately unsupple fish can at least be boiled for stock without releasing toxic fumes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38327.name: copperscale
38327.col_2: The nigh-luminous green of this wavekin's scales is as beautiful as the peaks of the Dragonstar─assuming the beholder's eye belongs to a dragon, of course.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38328.name: methane puffer
38328.col_2: Of the universe's many unfortunate fish, this is perhaps the worst off.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38329.name: chemically rich fish
38329.col_2: A species of fish only found out amongst the cosmos─which may be for the best. To be used in the synthesis of low-grade herbicide.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38330.name: wildlife sample
38330.col_2: A sample of wildlife which will be tested to determine the purity of water from the wellspring of regret.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38331.name: nondescript fish
38331.col_2: Hardly a catch worth noting in its own environment, this unremarkable fish may be the key to enriching Elysian soil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38332.name: clump of fresh seaweed
38332.col_2: The salty tang of dried seaweed is favored by coffee connoisseurs of discerning tastes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38333.name: Elysian nudibranch
38333.col_2: A soft-bodied mollusk found in the ocean waters of Elysion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38334.name: sticky fingers
38334.col_2: This fish is highly valued for the viscous film secreted over its scales that is said to have shock-absorbing properties.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38335.name: Elysian stickleback
38335.col_2: A nutrient-dense saltwater fish often used in aquaculture.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38336.name: saltwater fish
38336.col_2: Despite the myriad flavors to be found in the sea, this fish chose to be salty.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38337.name: seaweed snapper
38337.col_2: Despite its sickly green color, this saltwater fish is considered a delicacy among Karellians, proving even hideous things can be tasty on the inside.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38338.name: Karellian fishy fish
38338.col_2: An aquatic organism that truly embodies the maxim “be yourself.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38339.name: paraichthyoid
38339.col_2: This creature transcends the concept of “fish,” its chilling gaze daring only the most foolish to consume its flesh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38340.name: supremest crustacean
38340.col_2: A magnificent shelled organism to be envied and admired.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38341.name: babycray
38341.col_2: These crayfish are named both for their miniature appearance and the delightful paste their creamed bodies make for infant Miw Miisv.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38342.name: piece of silky cosmocoral
38342.col_2: A smooth and powdery calcareous deposit perfect for corporeal snuggling.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38343.name: chromatic fish
38343.col_2: This crimson-finned fish is sure to provide some vibrancy to the murky waters of Reah Tahra.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38344.name: dragon's delight
38344.col_2: Research indicates dragons cannot resist the crunchy texture of this bony fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38345.name: clump of astral algae
38345.col_2: Though you cannot be certain how this otherworldly clump of algae will prove beneficial to dragons, it's the thought that counts.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38346.name: weird fish
38346.col_2: An entirely alien species of fish containing nutrients that may or may not improve the health of soil.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38347.name: cosmic sponge
38347.col_2: This still very much alive and wriggling sponge can be scrubbed against a dragon's fangs for a proper cleaning, but probably shouldn't be for the sake of both parties involved.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Omicron society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

38374.name: windswept archfiend totem
38374.col_2: A tiny idol of Barbariccia carved by a lesser voidsent─presumably against its will.

38375.name: unsung helm of Abyssos
38375.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried helmet recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two helms can be traded for special headgear.

38376.name: suit of unsung armor of Abyssos
38376.description: suits of unsung armor of Abyssos
38376.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried armor recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four suits can be traded for special body gear.

38377.name: pair of unsung gauntlets of Abyssos
38377.description: pairs of unsung gauntlets of Abyssos
38377.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried gauntlets recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special arm gear.

38378.name: pair of unsung chausses of Abyssos
38378.description: pairs of unsung chausses of Abyssos
38378.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried chausses recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four pairs can be traded for special leg gear.

38379.name: pair of unsung greaves of Abyssos
38379.description: pairs of unsung greaves of Abyssos
38379.col_2: Stunning but sadly unstoried greaves recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special foot gear.

38380.name: unsung ring of Abyssos
38380.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried ring recovered from Pandæmonium.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One ring can be traded for a special accessory.

38381.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos I<hex:021A020103>
38381.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the experiments secreted in Abyssos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

38382.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos II<hex:021A020103>
38382.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the experiments secreted in Abyssos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

38383.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the experiments secreted in Abyssos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

38384.name: copy of the <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos IV<hex:021A020103>
38384.col_2: A record of truths and somewhat exaggerated stories surrounding the experiments secreted in Abyssos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Copies of the same <hex:021A020203>Abyssos Mythos<hex:021A020103> volumes can be traded for special gear.

38385.name: unsung blade of Abyssos
38385.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried blade recovered from Pandæmonium. Though such weapons were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

38386.name: flask of moonshine brine
38386.col_2: A luminous substance produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya. One is probably better off not asking how the alchemical process of enhancing lunar envoy's weapons involves pickling. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

38387.name: spool of moonshine twine
38387.col_2: A luminous thread produced at the High Crucible of<hex:02100103>Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of lunar envoy's vestments in a thoroughly normal fashion. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

38388.name: pot of moonshine shine
38388.col_2: A luminous substance produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to polish lunar envoy's accessories to transcendent perfection. Through copious trial and error, the chances of accoutrements enhanced in such a manner blinding those who look upon them has been reduced to nearly zero. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

38389.name: ultralight tomestone
38389.col_2: A surpassingly small means of storing knowledge, this tomestone was clearly devised as a cost-saving measure, and accordingly lacks durability. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

38390.name: Abyssos weapon coffer (IL 635)
38390.col_2: A stygian chest containing an Abyssos weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 635. Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38391.name: Abyssos head gear coffer (IL 630)
38391.col_2: A stygian chest containing a piece of Abyssos attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 630. Head gear type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38392.name: Abyssos chest gear coffer (IL 630)

38394.col_2: A stygian chest containing a piece of Abyssos attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 630. Leg gear type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38396.col_2: A stygian chest containing an Abyssos accessory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 630. Earring type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38397.col_2: A stygian chest containing an Abyssos accessory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 630. Necklace type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38398.col_2: A stygian chest containing an Abyssos accessory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 630. Bracelet type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38399.name: Abyssos ring coffer (IL 630)
38399.col_2: A stygian chest containing an Abyssos accessory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 630. Ring type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38420.name: chunk of manderium meteorite
38420.col_2: This fist-sized hunk of meteorite contains rich deposits of exceedingly rare manderium ore. Provides a small quantity of mineral oil when subjected to a unique extraction and refinement process.

38428.name: magicked prism (korpokkur noggin)
38428.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Releases a floating korpokkur, replete with realistic dampness.

38595.name: Sharlayan sink
38595.col_2: A large washbasin of the sort popular in the Northern Empty.

38596.name: Sharlayan chair
38596.col_2: A dignified chair for the dignified arse.

38597.name: Sharlayan desk
38597.col_2: A scholarly furnishing of the pretenti─er, elegant Sharlayan style.

38598.name: Sharlayan rug

38600.name: Sil'dihn chair

38601.col_2: A Sil'dihn-style shelving unit for storing kitchenware and utensils.

38602.name: Sil'dihn side table
38602.col_2: A small table crafted in the Sil'dihn style.

38603.name: Sil'dihn banner
38603.col_2: A striking banner emblazoned with the symbol of the once-prosperous city-state of Sil'dih.

38604.name: caged wisp
38604.col_2: This imprisoned orb of flickering blue flame is not leading anyone astray.

38605.name: korpokkur chronometer

38606.name: natural wooden beam

38607.col_2: Where these stone stairs lead is entirely up to you.

38608.name: flagstone loft
38608.col_2: This heavy stone platform requires surprisingly little in the way of support.

38609.name: exciting neon wall light
38609.col_2: The incessant flashing of these lights keeps you alert and on your toes─just like the Excitatron 6000.

38610.name: farmer's straw bed
38610.col_2: A comfy pile to lay back on and dream of swaying fields of wheat.

38611.name: Valentione's heart desk
38611.col_2: A heart-shaped table crafted to commemorate the celebration of love that is Valentione's Day.

38612.name: Storm's Crown sword stand

38617.name: countertop coffee service
38617.col_2: An elegantly simple coffee service designed to complement any décor.

38618.name: camping tent
38618.col_2: Camp out under the stars in the privacy of your own backyard.

38619.name: damaged highland turret
38619.col_2: The ruined shell of a watchtower, transported stone by stone from the wilds of Coerthas.

38620.name: pile of shoveled snow
38620.col_2: A never-melting pile of pristine white snow. Snow shovels included.

38621.name: blooming garden table
38621.col_2: Bask in the beauty of spring year-round with this quaint outdoor table.

38622.name: bamboo fence
38622.col_2: A garden partition evoking a distinctly Far Eastern aesthetic.

38623.name: set of camping furniture
38623.col_2: A set of outdoor furniture constructed of weather-resistant materials.

38624.name: illuminated tree
38624.col_2: A tree adorned with decorative lights in honor of the Starlight Celebration. Popular with the neighborhood children (and the children at heart).

38625.name: Far Eastern well
38625.col_2: A well of wood and stone that wouldn't look out of place in some remote Far Eastern settlement.

38626.name: Far Eastern lamppost
38626.col_2: A tile-roofed lamppost such as one might find on the streets of Kugane.

38627.name: Elpis stone pillar
38627.col_2: Crowned with lush greenery, this pillar puts one in mind of ancient gardens.

38628.name: set of chocobo stable essentials

38753.col_2: A bolt of fabric woven from scarlet moko grass, selected for its quality by a Boutique of Splendors procurer.

38754.col_2: The thin, twitching leaf of a hoptrap, selected for its quality by a Boutique of Splendors procurer.

38755.col_2: A dainty and delectable pixieberry, selected for its quality by a Boutique of Splendors procurer.

38756.name: connoisseur's chair
38756.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Despite its simple design, this chair still exudes a sense of being terribly expensive.

38757.name: connoisseur's wall lantern
38757.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector...and as bright as this lantern is, quite possibly blind it as well.

38758.name: connoisseur's ornate door
38758.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The wind will find no gaps to whistle through with this perfectly fitted portal.

38759.name: connoisseur's vanity mirror
38759.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its flawless surface faithfully reflects the truth, fair or foul.

38760.name: connoisseur's rug
38760.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. No toes will ever feel a chill through this thick, luxurious rug.

38761.name: connoisseur's swag valance
38761.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. This wall hanging immediately brings a touch of class to any chamber.

38762.name: connoisseur's cosmetics box
38762.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Destined to become a beloved heirloom fought over by covetous descendants.

38763.name: cup of connoisseur's pixieberry tea
38763.col_2: A beverage concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. Simultaneously sweet and tart, this tea almost takes the place of dessert. Almost.

38764.name: connoisseur's marimba
38764.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Each note sounds with a delightfully deep and resonant timbre.

38765.name: connoisseur's coffee brewer
38765.col_2: A device crafted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. Draws forth every last onze of flavorful goodness from the bean.

38766.name: connoisseur's bench
38766.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector, as well as the most particular of posteriors.

38767.name: connoisseur's astroscope
38767.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Sure to find a loving home amidst the sudden swell of Vrandtic stargazing enthusiasts.

38768.name: connoisseur's leather sofa
38768.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. So dreamily soft and comfortable, it should come with a warning.

38769.name: connoisseur's red carpet
38769.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. To walk down this elegant stretch of scarlet is to feel the glow of success─whether it was earned or not.

38770.name: connoisseur's elixir bottle
38770.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Rather more costly than the typical specimen in a jam jar collection.

38771.name: connoisseur's pixieberry tart
38771.col_2: A dessert concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. One nibble is enough to fall under the spell of this tart's fae enchantment.

38788.col_2: A material harvested with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind. This semi-fossilized bark is guaranteed to survive being forgotten for several decades in the back of a reagent drawer.

38789.name: splendorous earth shard
38789.col_2: A particularly splendorous manifestation of aetheric earth energy.

38790.name: chunk of connoisseur's prismstone
38790.col_2: A mineral excavated with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind. All the colors of the rainbow dance within this mesmerizing rock.

38791.name: splendorous water shard
38791.col_2: A particularly splendorous manifestation of aetheric water energy.

38792.name: platinum seahorse
38792.col_2: Gleaming like a precious, silvery trinket, this elusive variety of seahorse drifts largely unseen─and unappreciated─beneath the surface of the Source.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38793.name: clavekeeper
38793.col_2: This territorial species of moray patrols an area stretching from Seagazer Shoals to the coast of the Clave.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

38794.name: sprig of connoisseur's levin mint
38794.col_2: A material harvested with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind. Even the aroma from this mint is enough to set one's tongue to tingling.

38795.name: adaptive lightning crystal
38795.col_2: A particularly malleable manifestation of aetheric lightning energy.

38796.name: connoisseur's red malachite
38796.col_2: A mineral excavated with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind. Once ground, this gemstone should provide a striking crimson pigment for use in dyes.

38797.name: adaptive fire crystal
38797.col_2: A particularly malleable manifestation of aetheric fire energy.

38798.name: mirror image
38798.col_2: Legend has it that after being reflected in the waters of Handmirror Lake, the pattern of a princess's dress lives on in the form of this colorful fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38799.name: spangled pirarucu
38799.col_2: Seemingly clad in a skin of metallic discs, this glimmering wavekin has been called the living treasure of Lake Tusi Mek'ta.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

38808.name: select bait ball
38808.col_2: A specialized bait ball procured by the Boutique of Splendors. This unique paste has been designed to attract a highly specific type of catch.

38809.name: splendorous coffer
38809.col_2: A tool chest containing a splendorous tool.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 570. Primary tool type determined by current class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

38810.name: strip of Ondo kelp
38810.col_2: This nutrient-rich seaweed is thought to have been introduced to the coast of Kholusia by the Ondo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38811.name: Ken kiln
38811.col_2: A species of large trout known for its ability to remain snug and warm at all times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

38812.name: Purpure cod
38812.col_2: This delicious, fatty fish is particularly coveted by denizens of the ocean floor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38813.name: Glorianda's tear
38813.col_2: Named for the legendary Forebear of Pixies, this small shellfish is so beautiful it oft brings literal tears to the beholder's eyes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38814.name: Il Lydha
38814.col_2: It is said that Bismarck himself dubbed this bivalve mollusk “Flower of the Rainbow.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38816.name: set of mountain garb
38816.col_2: Fur-lined clothing guaranteed to keep its wearer toasty in even the harshest climes.

38817.name: serving of classic Voeburtite cuisine
38817.col_2: A steaming pot of homemade cooking to fill the stomach and warm the cockles.

38818.name: traditional Voeburtite handicraft
38818.col_2: This expertly crafted statue reflects what the Voeburtite people truly valued: sheep.

38819.name: lovely box of pretty things
38819.col_2: This gift bursting with charming objects is said to be wildly popular amongst pixies. Funnily enough, the ones saying this are also pixies.

38821.name: bundle of combustible fuel
38821.col_2: This bundle of flammable material is one spark away from a roaring fire─for better or worse.

38822.name: bottle of natural ingredients
38822.col_2: The precise nature of these ingredients is unknown, but their addition to Voeburtite cuisine has undeniably delicious results.

38823.name: tin of crafters' supplies
38823.col_2: Material ideal for the construction of Voeburtite handicrafts, including (but not limited to) sheep paraphernalia.

38824.name: set of lovely knickknacks
38824.col_2: An offering of whimsical miscellanea coveted by any pixie.

38825.name: set of sheep equipment materials
38825.col_2: An assortment of supplies that, when properly assembled, create tools perfect for tending sheep.

38826.name: set of mountain garb materials
38826.col_2: An assortment of supplies that, when properly assembled, create clothing ideal for weathering harsh climes.

38827.name: sack of classic Voeburtite ingredients
38827.col_2: An assortment of raw ingredients that, when properly prepared, create a delicious meal in the Voeburtite tradition.

38828.name: set of Voeburtite handicraft materials
38828.col_2: An assortment of supplies that, when properly assembled, create a statue of deep cultural significance.

38829.name: set of moderately pretty things
38829.col_2: With a little care and arrangement, these objects may well become a gift wildly popular amongst pixies.

38830.name: catastrophizer
38830.col_2: A king among ponderers, and lord of the waters of the reflecting pool.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38831.name: mossgill salmon
38831.col_2: A king among greengill salmon, and lord of the waters of the Mover Alpha.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

38832.name: vidyutvat wrasse
38832.col_2: A king among garjana wrasse, and lord of the waters of the Great Runoff.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

38833.name: browned banana eel
38833.col_2: A king among banana eels, and lord of the waters of Pavana's Remorse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

38834.name: frozen regotoise
38834.col_2: A king among regotoises, and lord of the Frozen Fissure.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

38835.name: cosmic haze
38835.col_2: A king among cosmic noises, and lord of apohelos 18<hex:021F0103>γ.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

38836.name: antheian dahlia
38836.col_2: A king among antheia, and lord of the waters of Lethe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38837.name: lakeskipper
38837.col_2: This small freshwater fish is aptly named for its unique, prancing movement across the bottom of Bronze Lake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38838.name: bronze eel
38838.col_2: Despite having achieved a perfect shade of bronze, this slender and snakelike fish understands better than anyone that there is always room for improvement.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

38839.name: striped peacock bass
38839.col_2: Whether the stripes are meant to be attributed to the peacock or bass is still largely up for debate amongst many ichthyologists. Regardless, this moderately sized and greenish fish is quite lovely.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

38840.name: bronze trout
38840.col_2: This large freshwater fish has indeed come to resemble its eponymous lake after long years of inhabiting its waters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

38841.name: nosceasaur
38841.col_2: This huge scalekin is believed to have inhabited the waters of La Noscea since time immemorial.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

38842.name: set of musicking station component materials
38842.description: sets of musicking station component materials
38842.col_2: Raw materials that will soon become components─not materials─as per Managingway's extremely specific request (for components).<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38843.name: musicking station component
38843.col_2: This soon-to-be element of Dreamingway's dream stage has been carefully crafted to prevent injury to frolicking Loporrits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38844.name: set of machining supply materials
38844.col_2: Materials fit to create supplies fit for a befittingly named Inventingway.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38845.name: set of machining supplies
38845.col_2: These handcrafted items─provided in bulk─will hopefully result in the creation of inventive machines without any Loporrits being harmed in the process.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38846.name: set of restaurant-grade supply materials
38846.col_2: Raw materials for certain supplies included in Dickon's list.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38847.name: set of restaurant-grade supplies
38847.col_2: Supplies indispensable to the sophisticated and sanitary serving of cuisine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38848.name: set of painting supply materials
38848.col_2: A convenient package of components necessary to create tools for enthusiastic amateur artists.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38849.name: set of painting supplies
38849.col_2: Judging by the requested volume, Loporrits really go through art supplies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38850.name: set of radio equipment materials
38850.col_2: Components apparently vital to the creation of inscrutable equipment. You don't know─you just work here.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38851.name: box of radio equipment
38851.col_2: Delicate supplies for the broadcasting station, carefully packaged so as to sustain minimal damage from inevitable Loporrit excitement.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38852.name: sack of audio materials
38852.col_2: An assortment of pieces compatible with Loporrit-made sound systems.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38853.name: set of audio spare parts
38853.col_2: Useful parts for Loporrits who prefer surround sound.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38854.name: set of wind instrument component materials
38854.description: sets of wind instrument component materials
38854.col_2: An assortment of materials necessary for creating a wind instrument component.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38855.name: wind instrument component
38855.col_2: “Why settle for humming when you could be piping!”<hex:02100103>─Pipingway<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38856.name: set of coin manufacturing component materials
38856.description: sets of coin manufacturing component materials
38856.col_2: Materials for a component used in the manufacture of Loporrit carats, Coiningway's monetary invention.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38857.name: coin manufacturing component
38857.col_2: This component will allow the Loporrits to manufacture more of their new currency, thereby paving the way to prosperity─or rampant inflation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38858.name: sack of memorabilia materials
38858.col_2: An assortment of supplies useful for the production of self-gratifying paraphernalia.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38859.name: set of signed memorabilia
38859.col_2: A box of mementos personally crafted and signed by none other than Etheirys's Warrior of Light.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38860.name: sack of lighting materials
38860.col_2: An assortment of supplies compatible with Loporrit-made lighting arrays.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38861.name: set of lighting parts
38861.col_2: Spare parts used for the upkeep of lights both dazzling and glaring.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38862.name: sack of carrotlight materials
38862.col_2: An assortment of materials compatible with carrotlights.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38863.name: set of carrotlight pieces
38863.col_2: A set of pieces used for the assembly of delicious-looking luminescent carrotlights. Do not consume.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.
