38864.col_2: Materials for a component needed to upgrade the cleaner machina.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38865.name: cleaner upgrade component
38865.col_2: Designed to enhance the effectiveness of the cleaner machina, this component will ensure that the Loporrits continue to have good, clean fun─the kind they love best.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38866.name: set of audio recording component materials
38866.description: sets of audio recording component materials
38866.col_2: Materials for a component needed to grant a supporter machina audio recording capabilities.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38867.name: audio recording component
38867.col_2: When installed, this component will grant a supporter machina audio recording capabilities, thus allowing the Loporrits to experience the weirdness of hearing their own voice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38868.name: set of parasital infection protection suit component materials
38868.description: sets of parasital infection protection suit component materials
38868.col_2: An assortment of materials to be used in the assembly of an airtight protective suit component.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.
38868.col_3: Parasital Infection Protection Suit Component Materials

38869.name: parasital infection protection suit component
38869.col_2: Once implemented into the PIPS, this airtight component will serve to keep Loporrits safe from infectious spores─assuming any choose to wear the thing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38870.name: collection of occult paraphernalia materials
38870.col_2: An assortment of strange and hazardous materials to be used in the construction of occult paraphernalia.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38871.name: article of occult paraphernalia
38871.col_2: What Thrillingway intends to do with this bizarre instrument is a question best left unanswered.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38872.name: set of cookbook printing paraphernalia materials
38872.description: sets of cookbook printing paraphernalia materials
38872.col_2: An assortment of materials to be used in the grand pursuit of printing additional copies of Cookingway's highly sought-after cookbook.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38873.name: set of cookbook printing paraphernalia
38873.col_2: At the rate his cookbooks are being printed, Cookingway's authorial exploits may soon eclipse his culinary achievements.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38874.name: set of carrot chiller component materials
38874.description: sets of carrot chiller component materials
38874.col_2: An assortment of materials compatible with the cooking station's carrot chiller.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38875.name: carrot chiller component
38875.col_2: This component will serve to repair the cooking station's cherished carrot chiller─until it inevitably breaks down again.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38876.name: set of Loporrit's gathering tool component materials
38876.description: sets of Loporrit's gathering tool component materials
38876.col_2: An assortment of materials compatible with Loporrit-made gathering equipment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38877.name: Loporrit's gathering tool component
38877.col_2: A much-needed component for a Loporrit-sized tool capable of slicing and dicing even the sturdiest of fungi.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38878.name: sack of kitchen materials
38878.col_2: A myriad array of kitchen supplies awaiting proper assembly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38879.name: set of popular kitchen goods
38879.col_2: Perfect kitchen items for the fuzzy, small-handed chef.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38880.name: sack of potentially body-enhancing materials
38880.col_2: Materials theoretically handy for creating items to tone, bulk, and provide satisfying gains to Loporrit bodies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38881.name: set of “exercise equipment”
38881.col_2: Anything can be used to bolster fitness if you put your mind to it...right?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38882.name: sack of artistic materials
38882.col_2: An assortment of materials to aid in the creation of paint─the brighter and sparklier, the better.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38883.name: paint-mixer's toolbox
38883.col_2: A crate of elements essential to the Loporrit who keeps the paint abundant, bright, and sparkly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38884.name: sack of sudsy soap supplies
38884.col_2: An assortment of materials that will yield a highly effective, nontoxic cleaner.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38885.name: set of super sudsy soap bars
38885.description: sets of super sudsy soap bars
38885.col_2: Cleansing material guaranteed to magically dissolve any and all unwanted smudges. Gentle on fur and whiskers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38886.name: sack of fungi fighter materials
38886.col_2: An assortment of pieces that may be assembled into a weapon debilitating to menacing mushrooms.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38887.name: fungi fighter
38887.col_2: Mushrooms will die.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38889.col_2: Objects meant to dazzle with individuality. Whether they are successful depends on the eye of the beholder.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38929.name: serving of jhinga biryani
38929.col_2: A mouthwatering dish of bomba rice seasoned with hearty spices and baked with Thavnairian prawns.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

38930.name: serving of jhinga curry

38932.name: bottle of craftsman's alkahest
38932.col_2: When applied to items such as crafting and gathering gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to detrimental elements, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

38933.name: handful of Mornveil tree bark
38933.col_2: The quality of this bark is undeniable and likely due to the hospitable surrounds of Labyrinthos.

38934.name: raw zoisite
38934.col_2: An uncut, unpolished stone containing what appears to be zoisite.

38935.name: jhinga
38935.col_2: The rusty red carapace of this Near Eastern prawn protects tender flesh that is a mainstay of popular Thavnairian cuisine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38936.name: handful of earthbreak aethersand
38936.col_2: This coarse-grained, highly concentrated aetherially reduced mineral matter carries the distinctive scent of soil.

38937.name: handful of earthen quartz
38937.col_2: A rock with an elemental aspect leaning heavily towards earth.

38938.name: handful of sophora roots
38938.col_2: Tendrils of a perennial plant replete with earth aether.

38939.name: verdigris guppy
38939.col_2: A fish prized not only for its green mottled beauty, but for the rarity of materials its body provides.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

38940.name: chunk of complementary chondrite
38940.col_2: This rare form of chondrite contains spherule groupings which greatly amplify aetherial conductivity when synthesized with manderium─an advanced process which demands a heightened state of battle-based enlightenment.

38941.name: Orthos aetherpool fragment
38941.col_2: A fragment of aetherpool gear found in Eureka Orthos.

38942.name: Orthos tomestone
38942.col_2: Containing information on the Allagan Empire's most clandestine research, these tomestones were strictly prohibited from leaving the halls of Eureka Orthos.

38943.name: Orthos aetherpool grip
38943.col_2: A sturdy grip designed for Orthos aetherpool arms.

38944.name: Orthos potion
38944.col_2: Grants the effect of Rehabilitation (HP regeneration) to self.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30s<hex:02100103>※Only available for use in Eureka Orthos.

38945.name: bronze-tinged sack
38945.col_2: This cumbersome bag containing a portion of Eureka Orthos's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only an appraiser who has devoted their lives to studying Allagan relics might be able to undo such a seal.

38946.name: silver-tinged sack
38946.col_2: This cumbersome bag containing a portion of Eureka Orthos's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only an appraiser who has devoted their lives to studying Allagan relics might be able to undo such a seal.

38947.name: gold-tinged sack
38947.col_2: This cumbersome bag containing a portion of Eureka Orthos's Accursed Hoard has been sealed with powerful magicks. Only an appraiser who has devoted their lives to studying Allagan relics might be able to undo such a seal.

38948.name: special midnight Archon egg
38948.col_2: The dark enamel finish of this prophetic egg is singularly captivating to behold.

38949.name: flamecloaked archfiend totem
38949.col_2: A small idol of Rubicante carved by a voidsent. The admiration with which it was created is palpable.

38950.name: Euphrosyne coin
38950.col_2: An age-worn artifact recovered from Euphrosyne. Once considered to be of great religious significance, a sudden influx caused their value to plummet, rendering them almost worthless.

38951.name: Omega totem
38951.col_2: This mechanical idol was created with technology beyond both the capabilities and understanding of mankind.

38953.name: set of sukiya-zukuri cottage walls
38953.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a stylish Far Eastern residence with attached onsen.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

38954.name: set of sukiya-zukuri house walls
38954.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a stylish Far Eastern residence with attached onsen.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

38955.name: set of sukiya-zukuri mansion walls
38955.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to transform their estate into a stylish Far Eastern residence with attached onsen.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with mansions on large plots of land.

38956.col_2: This highly concentrated concoction instantly restores a prodigious amount of HP.

39224.name: lump of island resin
39224.col_2: It may be resinable to assume that handicrafts created with this natural polymer will resinate with the beholder.

39225.name: island coconut
39225.col_2: Lalafells must undergo special training to harvest this drupe, as it is larger, heavier, and altogether far more formidable than any other species of coconut.

39226.name: island beehive chip
39226.col_2: A sweet fragment of an innocent bee's former abode. Well done, you monster.

39227.name: island wood opal
39227.col_2: This opal was once a shard of petrified wood, proving that you can become anything you set your mind to so long as you have dedication and millions of years at your disposal.

39228.name: bunch of multicolored isleblooms
39228.col_2: Beautiful island flowers of various species native to the Cieldalaes.

39229.name: bag of island paprika seeds
39229.col_2: Plant these seeds to grow bushels of healthy red peppers that may or may not taste like absolutely nothing once you grind them into dust.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

39230.name: island leek set
39230.col_2: Bury your leeks. Never look back.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

39231.name: island paprika
39231.col_2: A plump and healthy pepper, ready to be ruthlessly dried and ground into powder.

39232.name: island leek
39232.col_2: A vegetable once buried and abandoned. If only it had eyes with which to gaze woefully, tears would surely be leaking from them.

39233.name: islekeep's iron hatchet
39233.col_2: An iron iteration of your very first island tool. Heavy in your hand, it promises to be useful in collecting additional materials from designated resources. “I know,” you whisper back.

39234.name: prime sphongos
39234.col_2: A spongy mushroom imbued with fascinating life energy. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

39235.name: sublime sphongos
39235.col_2: This magnificent sphongos has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

39236.name: phial of pure verdurous glioaether
39236.col_2: Rich green oil refined by aetherial reduction to an extremely concentrated state.

39237.name: chunk of prime achondrite
39237.col_2: A meteorite primarily comprised of olivine and pyroxene. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

39238.name: chunk of sublime achondrite
39238.col_2: This superior chunk of achondrite has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

39239.name: phial of pure igneous glioaether
39239.col_2: Vibrant red oil refined by aetherial reduction to an extremely concentrated state.

39240.name: phyllinos
39240.col_2: This ingenious creation traverses the fine line between plant and fish in a way that none have before nor ever will again.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

39241.name: phial of pure aqueous glioaether
39241.col_2: Soothing blue oil refined by aetherial reduction to an extremely concentrated state.

39242.description: lengths of smaller water otter fountain lumber

39243.description: sets of smaller water otter fountain hardware
39243.col_2: Attempting to say “odder otter metal” several times aloud demonstrates some manner of mettle indeed. Components crucial to the successful construction of the smaller water otter fountain.

39244.description: bundles of smaller water otter fountain resin
39244.col_2: Odder otters that stick together, stay together, and don't leak all over your garden. Components crucial to the successful construction of the smaller water otter fountain.

39351.col_2: Thick and lickerous syrup obtained by shamelessly exploiting the hard work of bees.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Confections/Ingredients<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

39352.name: isleworks seashine opal
39352.col_2: A natural opal polished to a dazzling shine by tiny mammet hands.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

39353.name: bunch of isleworks dried flowers
39353.col_2: These island flowers are still beautiful, even in death.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Furnishings<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

39354.name: pinch of isleworks powdered paprika
39354.col_2: Peppers ground to a fine, bright red powder. Can be sprinkled on food to impress fellow islekeeps with the appearance of sophistication.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Ingredients/Concoctions<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

39355.name: bowl of isleworks cawl cennin
39355.col_2: Thick soup developed from a base of leeks fried in butter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Concoctions/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

39356.name: isleworks isloaf
39356.col_2: While technically bursting with essential nutrients, this bread is about as flavorful as damp parchment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs/Concoctions<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

39357.name: serving of isleworks popoto salad
39357.col_2: This delightful mash of popotoes and apples is rumored to have been seasoned with the tears of mammets unable to partake in its delicious glory.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

39358.name: bottle of isleworks dressing
39358.col_2: Not to be confused with a different sort of island dressing, this onion-based condiment is clearly the superior version as mammets were involved in its creation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Ingredients<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

39364.name: false monarchy attire coffer
39364.col_2: A banded chest containing a full set of false monarchy attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

39365.name: irregular tomestone of mendacity
39365.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains falsehoods so compelling, it can sway even the most discerning minds from the path of knowledge.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

39366.name: set of paladin's flamecloaked arms (IL 625)
39366.col_2: A set of arms containing a flamecloaked broadsword and flamecloaked scutum.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 625.

39378.name: simple low table
39378.col_2: A quaint and practical addition to any room.

39379.name: flower boucage
39379.col_2: Beautiful addition to home décor or archaic punishment for offending flora? Perhaps it is both.

39380.name: faerie door
39380.col_2: This sweet little door is believed to be used by the fae. Where it leads, none may ever know...

39381.name: rattan sofa
39381.col_2: A wicker couch painstakingly woven from climbing palm.

39382.name: charcoal iron
39382.col_2: This household instrument will smooth the wrinkles from your clothing, thereby smoothing the wrinkles from your forehead. Do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> apply directly to the forehead.

39383.name: grounded cactuar
39383.col_2: A potted cactus lauded for its level head and firm grip on reality.

39384.name: Far Eastern stained crystal roundel
39384.col_2: A beautiful, circular pane of stained crystal designed in the style of the Far East.

39385.name: timeworn thaumaturgic array
39385.col_2: This intimidating set of instruments is mysteriously distilling sinister and arcane liquids all by itself. While this fact is unnerving to say the least, it may be best to let it brew...

39386.name: darkest hourglass
39386.col_2: An old chronometer that measures silence as much as time.

39387.name: classical water jug
39387.col_2: A simple-yet-handsome pitcher with a timeless design.

39388.name: Allagan terminal alpha
39388.col_2: An N-shaped device created to access ancient Allagan systems. Though no longer functional, the light-up display is still hauntingly beautiful.

39389.name: Allagan terminal beta
39389.col_2: An L-shaped device created to access ancient Allagan systems. Though no longer functional, the light-up display is still hauntingly beautiful.

39390.name: toy cooking set
39390.col_2: A whimsical set of chocobo-themed toys guaranteed to thrill any aspiring chef.

39391.name: Lalafell lifter
39391.col_2: Tired of being forgotten in conversation and hitting the edge of the table with your nose? No longer with the Lalafell Lifter, the chair specifically designed to uplift even the smallest of heroes.

39392.name: highland partition
39392.col_2: This sturdy partition designed in the highland fashion is partially customizable.

39393.name: highland partition door
39393.col_2: A partition with a built-in door designed to complement highland residences.

39394.name: alpine pillar
39394.col_2: A decorative pillar designed in the alpine fashion.

39395.name: Enigma wall chronometer
39395.col_2: A chronometer devised by the Illuminati, particularly abundant with whirlycogs.

39396.name: rainbow hopping rug
39396.col_2: A multicolored mat perfect for vigorous and rhythmic bouncing.

39397.name: Loporrit material supplier permit
39397.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Loporrit material suppliers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

39398.name: Loporrit junkmonger permit
39398.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Loporrit junkmongers on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

39399.name: Loporrit mender permit
39399.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Loporrit menders on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

39400.name: Loporrit servingway permit
39400.col_2: This permit allows the hiring of Loporrit manservants on the estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 vendors, respectively.

39401.name: Hannish pendant wall light
39401.col_2: A wall lantern crafted in the Hannish style.

39402.name: Hannish screen
39402.col_2: A resplendent portable partition of Hannish design.

39403.name: Hannish bed
39403.col_2: A roomy bed embellished with gold in the Hannish style.

39404.name: Hannish chair
39404.col_2: A low-seated chair of Hannish design.

39405.name: Hannish round table
39405.col_2: An intricately patterned round table designed in the Hannish fashion.

39406.name: Hannish table lamp
39406.col_2: As much a decorative display of masterful Hannish metalwork as practical lantern.

39407.name: Hannish bookshelf partition
39407.col_2: A partition designed in the Hannish fashion, boasting a small library on one side.

39408.name: Hannish rug
39408.col_2: A rectangular rug woven in the Hannish fashion.

39409.name: waterfall partition
39409.col_2: A partition of softly falling water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to twenty may be placed in a single estate.

39410.name: infernal archfiend cloak
39410.col_2: Smoldering with arcane power, this dark tapestry is perpetually warm to the touch.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

39411.name: faerie round table
39411.col_2: The glass tabletop presents the illusion of solid water, but the claims that faeries assemble here for meetings has yet to be satisfyingly explained.

39412.name: pudding pudding
39412.col_2: Delicious pudding in the shape of pudding. What's not to understand?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39413.name: exciting balloon
39413.col_2: The unblinking stare of this balloon is reminding you what a great time you're having─just like in the Excitatron 6000.

39415.name: Crystal Tower phasmascape
39415.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the haunting majesty of the Crystal Tower at nighttime.

39416.name: Urth's Fount phasmascape
39416.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the electrifying stillness of Urth's Fount.

39417.name: Hatching-tide MMXXII advertisement
39417.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the hippity-hoppity Hatching-tide festivities of a year gone by.

39418.name: Little Ladies' Day MMXXI advertisement
39418.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising a lovely Little Ladies' Day of a year gone by.

39419.name: low garden hedge
39419.col_2: A stand of shrubbery cut to optimal height for confounding local Lalafells.

39420.name: Orthos display stand
39420.col_2: An Allagan hologram which depicts a legendary weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

39421.name: smaller water otter fountain
39421.col_2: A water otter fountain that is smaller and somehow odder than the water otter fountain found in island sanctuaries.

39422.name: Hannish lamppost
39422.col_2: A lamppost of steel such as one might see lining a Hannish street.

39423.name: simple fountain
39423.col_2: A basic stone contraption from which water pours forth. May the sound of its splashing soothe unsettled souls.

39424.name: jinrikisha
39424.col_2: A Far Eastern cab designed to be manpowered, not bird-powered─and <hex:021A020203>definitely<hex:021A020103> not Namazu-powered.

39425.name: lemonade stand
39425.col_2: When life gives you lemons, create a lemonade empire from but a humble stall like this one.

39426.name: dorpokkur kiln
39426.col_2: A charming woodstove topped with a decorative dorpokkur, incidentally colored a striking shade of “burnt.”

39427.name: stone garden wall
39427.col_2: Someone painstakingly fitted these stones into a rustic wall for your garden. You didn't, but somebody did.

39428.name: colorful flower patch
39428.col_2: A burst of blossoms that will bring a smile to any face.

39429.name: Hannish interior wall
39429.col_2: An interior wall designed to complement Hannish residences.

39430.name: unit of Hannish tile flooring
39430.col_2: Dark, resplendent tiling detailed in gold.

39431.name: Hannish ceiling lamp
39431.col_2: A hanging light fixture of undeniably Hannish design.

39432.name: stuffed Loporrit
39432.col_2: Alas, poor Stuffingway! I knew him...

39433.name: authentic Valentione mobile
39433.col_2: Though none of them are anatomically accurate, these dangling decorations crafted into various heart shapes are undeniably authentic.

39434.name: authentic eggsemplary basket
39434.col_2: An elegant, enticing, and authentic example of exceptional egg-hunting.

39435.name: authentic Hatching-tide mobile
39435.col_2: The authentic twirl and bob of this Hatching-tide mobile reminds you of all the hidden eggs you have yet to find...

39460.col_2: If given even a modicum of attention, these seeds will grow into delicate, twining flowers that greet each day in full blossom─which is more than can be said of most people.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

39461.name: bouquet of red morning glories
39461.col_2: A bunch of red morning glories, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

39462.name: bouquet of blue morning glories
39462.col_2: A bunch of blue morning glories, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

39463.name: bouquet of yellow morning glories
39463.col_2: A bunch of yellow morning glories, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

39469.col_2: A bunch of multicolored morning glories, selectively fertilized to achieve a variety of vibrant colors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

39470.name: set of flamecloaked barding
39470.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Rubicante, the archfiend of fire.

39471.name: set of Allagan barding
39471.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor that may or may not be an authentic and precious relic of an ancient civilization.

39472.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Sharlayan Rebellion<hex:021A020103>
39472.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this limited edition of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques on transforming your style into that of the prominent─some would say not prominent <hex:021A020203>enough<hex:021A020103>─member of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, Alisaie Leveilleur.<hex:02100103>* Please note that, while bearing certain similarities, this edition is decidedly <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> a rerun of a previous edition. We thank you for your understanding.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.

39473.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - A Close Shave<hex:021A020103>
39473.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - A Close Shave<hex:021A020103>
39473.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for cropping one's locks so as to improve aerodynamics in the face of impending danger, whilst still remaining at the height of trendiness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.

39474.name: corgi
39474.col_2: Fluffy, full of beans, and fit for a queen.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the corgi minion.

39475.name: sky blue back
39475.col_2: Born in the Cieldalaes. It was born in the Cieldalaes. It was born in the Cieldalaes. Born in the Cieldalaes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the sky blue back minion.

39476.name: suzusaurus
39476.col_2: Might be able to tow a rowboat to safety if not a galleon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the suzusaurus minion.

39477.name: Mama automaton
39477.col_2: Mama knows best. Listen to Mama.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Mama automaton minion.

39478.name: wind-up Cagnazzo
39478.col_2: The puddles and ponds are his to command.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Cagnazzo minion.

39479.name: Findingway
39479.col_2: Can find his own way without you, but chooses to tag along.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Findingway minion.

39480.name: private pachypodium
39480.col_2: Its detonating days are thankfully over.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the private pachypodium minion.

39481.name: wind-up Halone
39481.col_2: For those who like it icy cold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Halone minion.

39482.name: bantam train
39482.col_2: It choo-choo-chooses to haunt you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bantam train minion.

39483.name: wind-up Godbert
39483.col_2: No less gentlemanly for its compact size, this mammet stands ever ready to do what only a Manderville can.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Godbert minion.

39484.name: wind-up Aidoneus
39484.col_2: If sighs could kill, you'd be dead a thousand times over.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Aidoneus minion.

39485.name: moon-hopper identification key
39485.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your moon-hopper will magically bring the machine to life.

39486.name: aeturna horn
39486.col_2: Wrought of bone, this horn emits a vigorous sound that summons the aeturna to your side.

39487.name: set of ceruleum balloons
39487.col_2: Filled with gasified ceruleum, this festive assortment of balloons will carry you sky-high in high spirits.

39488.name: Anden III horn
39488.col_2: When blown, this sheep's horn emits a muted (and somewhat confused) sound that brings Anden III rustling to your side.

39489.name: <hex:021A020203>Blackjack<hex:021A020103> identification key
39489.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near the <hex:021A020203>Blackjack<hex:021A020103> will magically bring the vessel to life.

39490.name: Phaethon horn
39490.col_2: Hot to the touch, this horn emits a furious sound that summons forth Phaethon.

39491.name: Pinky identification key
39491.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Pinky will magically bring the elephantine machine trumpeting to life.

39492.name: lynx of righteous fire flute
39492.col_2: Emitting an ardent and dignified tone, this flute summons a lynx of righteous fire to your side.

39493.name: magitek avenger G1 identification key
39493.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your magitek avenger G1 will magically bring the machine to life.

39494.name: Chrysomallos horn
39494.col_2: When blown, this garish horn emits an ostentatious sound that summons forth Chrysomallos, the golden ram of legend.

39495.name: island alligator horn
39495.col_2: Scaly to the touch, the sound of this horn brings your island alligator strutting to your side.

39583.name: pearl of flames
39583.col_2: The might of an archfiend is trapped within this precious jewel. If taken in hand, one can still feel the heat of eternal flames pulsing within...

39584.name: flamecloaked weapon coffer (IL 625)
39584.col_2: A slightly smoking chest containing a flamecloaked weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 625. Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

39585.name: sack of timeworn thaumaturgic instruments
39585.col_2: These arcane tools were recovered from the ocean floor and quiver as though desiring to be reassembled.

39586.name: enigmatic gear
39586.col_2: At first glance a stray part from some ship, this gear seems equipped with complicated infrastructure.

39587.name: chunk of white granite
39587.col_2: Strong, white stone pulled from the bottom of the ocean.

39588.name: sheet of ominous plating
39588.col_2: A somehow unnerving sheet of metal recovered from the ocean floor. If you press your ear flat against its surface, you can hear the screech of a train whistle in the distance.

39589.name: bolt of hagnos cloth
39589.col_2: Created in a stroke of pure brilliance, this soft, versatile fabric is incapable of being soiled in any way.

39590.name: bottle of exciting tonic
39590.col_2: An exciting pink liquid available in the Excitatron 6000. So exciting, in fact, that some collectors will even barter goods for just another bottle.

39591.name: timeworn ophiotauroskin map
39591.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 15 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 90 full party (eight players) recommended.

39592.name: burning horn
39592.col_2: A fragment of horn that is uncomfortably hot to the touch. Surely someone collects these...

39593.name: potentially special timeworn map
39593.col_2: This bottle is holding what appears to be a singularly valuable leather map.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 90 full party (eight players) recommended.<hex:02100103>※Guaranteed to summon a teleportation portal.

39705.col_2: A rough-cut log of dark cherry timber.

39706.name: chunk of softsilver ore
39706.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing a naturally occurring mix of silver and quicksilver.

39707.name: raw spodumene
39707.col_2: An uncut, unpolished stone containing what appears to be spodumene.

39708.name: pinch of maghemite
39708.col_2: Originating in Thavnair, this iron oxide is often utilized as a pigment for its rusty red hue.

39709.name: sprig of field mustard
39709.col_2: The oil extracted from the seeds of this vivid yellow flower has various practical applications, not the least of which is as a reagent for curing skins and hides.

39710.name: lovingbloom
39710.col_2: A prize “flower” grown in the nightmare fungal garden of Lovingway's Darlings.

39711.name: phial of liquid glass
39711.col_2: This coating of remarkable clarity was produced by alchemical means, and is particularly suited to enhancing the durability of wooden surfaces.

39712.name: bottle of Thavnairian flux
39712.col_2: Used to both soften and purify raw metals extracted from ore, this chemical agent is an invaluable addition to the metallurgical process. Hannish alchemists remain blissfully unaware of why its name gives potential buyers pause.

39713.name: bottle of grinding fluid
39713.col_2: In the hands of a goldsmith, this lubricant is more valuable than the gems it is used to polish. In the hands of anyone else, it is the source of oily residue.

39714.name: square of Hannish cotton
39714.col_2: Woven with techniques perfected over generations on Thavnair, this cotton is durable, dyeable, and─perhaps most importantly─affordable.

39715.name: deinosuchus skin
39715.col_2: The skin of an enormous variety of crocodile that has remained unchanged since ancient times.

39716.name: bottle of alche-mist
39716.col_2: Though to the layman's eye “alche-mist” appears to be little more than fancy purified water, the alchemically inclined folk of Thavnair insist that naught else will do.

39720.name: square of garnet cotton
39720.col_2: A cloth woven with traditional techniques and dyed a deep red.

39721.name: circle of deinosuchus leather
39721.col_2: A large piece of cured deinosuchus skin.

39722.name: bottle of grade 8 strength alkahest
39722.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

39723.name: bottle of grade 8 dexterity alkahest
39723.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

39724.name: bottle of grade 8 vitality alkahest
39724.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

39725.name: bottle of grade 8 intelligence alkahest

39773.name: connoisseur's picture frame
39773.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its fine detailing subtly directs the viewer's gaze toward the picture housed within.

39774.name: connoisseur's samurai blade
39774.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its elegant blade forged of bismuth is a delight to any aficionado of swordsmithery.

39775.name: connoisseur's aquarium
39775.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector, as well as the fish who would dwell within it.

39776.name: pair of connoisseur's glaives
39776.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. With translucent blades forged of purest bluespirit, such a refined work of craftsmanship is more art than arm.

39777.name: pair of connoisseur's varsity shoes
39777.col_2: Footwear crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Indeed, a single glance confirms both the luxuriousness of its materials and undeniable fashionability.

39778.name: connoisseur's linen parasol
39778.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector─and more crucially, shade them from the sun.

39779.name: connoisseur's topiary moogle
39779.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its verdant raised pom and realistically rounded pate attest to its creator's skill in sculpting spheroids.

39780.name: connoisseur's squid baguette
39780.col_2: A sandwich concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. Having been slathered with squid ink, this baguette carries the pungent smell of the sea to one's nostrils with each bite. Yum.

39781.name: connoisseur's bookshelf
39781.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector, whose library of rare works will find a fitting home on this handsome bookshelf.

39782.name: connoisseur's chandelier
39782.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. It is certain to become the highlight of any room.

39783.name: connoisseur's escutcheon
39783.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. With its distinctive coat of arms, this shield will undoubtedly become an heirloom treasured for generations.

39784.name: pair of connoisseur's baghnakhs
39784.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The reflective surfaces of its bluespirit claws shine when held under light.

39785.name: connoisseur's drinking apkallu
39785.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The apkallu's unquenchable thirst mirrors the insatiable desires of its destined owner.

39786.name: connoisseur's jacket
39786.col_2: An outerwear set tailored to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector, as well as the glazed eye of any fellow attendee at belabored ceremonies.

39787.name: connoisseur's planter partition
39787.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. When gazing upon it, one can almost hear a faint “la-hee” in the distance.

39788.name: serving of connoisseur's spaghetti al nero
39788.description: servings of connoisseur's spaghetti al nero
39788.col_2: A dish concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. It shines with the luster of a resplendent black pearl, though is blessedly more chewable.

39805.col_2: A material harvested with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind, and well suited to aetherial reduction. Whether the layer of filth is truly required for it to maintain this property remains unclear, but why take the risk?

39806.name: custom ice crystal
39806.col_2: A superior manifestation of aetheric ice energy obtained from Qeshi-Trao's hidden resources. Its unique makeup is ideal for enhancing a crystalline tool.

39807.name: connoisseur's miracle apple
39807.col_2: A fruit harvested with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind, and well suited to aetherial reduction (or consumption by hungry artisans).

39809.name: gold dustfish
39809.col_2: Much as it may try to stay hidden beneath the billows of sand which cover the Nabaath Severance's depths, the golden sheen which radiates from this fish will not escape the gaze of a keen-eyed fisher.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

39810.name: forgiven melancholy
39810.col_2: Found near the Isle of Ken, this death-white fish is a subject of curiosity─and some suspicion─amongst Kholusians.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

39811.name: chunk of connoisseur's aurum regis ore
39811.description: chunks of connoisseur's aurum regis ore
39811.col_2: A mineral harvested with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind, and royally suited to aetherial reduction.

39812.name: brilliant lightning cluster
39812.col_2: A particularly brilliant manifestation of aetheric lightning energy. Due to its unique makeup, it can only be utilized by a master artisan.

39813.name: sprig of connoisseur's cloves
39813.col_2: A material harvested with the discerning standards of an avid collector in mind, and well suited to aetherial reduction. Also, pies.

39815.name: oil slick

39816.name: Gonzalo's grace

39864.name: dragonfruit
39864.col_2: This milky white fruit is shielded by scaly skin not entirely unlike that of dragonkind, though whether any member of the race approves of this comparison to vividly pink produce remains an open question.

39865.name: dark eggplant
39865.col_2: When asked to explain its flavor profile, a culinarian claimed that this subtropical eggplant is “a little, hmm...richer?” than the average wizard eggplant. This presumably means something to those versed in the inscrutable art of cuisine, who employ this nightshade in a wide variety of dishes.

39866.name: pinch of pure cumin
39866.col_2: This bright, earthy spice is prized for its versatility both culinary and otherwise, appearing in all manner of medicinal tinctures and beauty treatments.

39867.name: caviar sturgeon
39867.col_2: As its name implies, the eggs produced by this incredibly rare freshwater fish are considered something of a culinary miracle when salted and served as caviar.

39868.name: head of broccoflower
39868.col_2: A unique vegetable boasting a fractal form that has baffled botanists for generations. Though tempting, it is best not to stare directly at its illusory buds.

39869.name: serving of honeyed dragonfruit
39869.col_2: A generous serving of dragonfruit slathered with a silky sweet layer of golden honey and a few sour drops of lemonette juice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39870.name: pitcher of dragonfruit blend
39870.col_2: Mashed dragonfruit is blended together with cloud banana and coconut milk to create this creamy, refreshing drink.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39871.name: serving of baba ghanoush
39871.col_2: A traditional Thavnairian appetizer of finely chopped dark eggplant spiced with ground cumin and a tantalizing hint of garlic.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39872.name: serving of baked eggplant
39872.col_2: Topped with sliced vegetables and a healthy coating of melted Garlean cheese, these rich eggplants have been roasted to tender perfection.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39873.name: bowl of spicy stellar soup
39873.col_2: Simmered with diced alien onions and carrots of happiness aplenty, this stellar soup's flavor is quite literally out of this world.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39874.name: serving of tandoori raptor
39874.col_2: A Near Eastern staple consisting of tender chunks of baked raptor meat marinated in mouthwatering spices and creamy yoghurt.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39875.name: caviar sandwich
39875.col_2: Its every bite extraordinary enough to render one speechless, this sandwich incorporates eggs from the caviar sturgeon and bird of Elpis both. Given the further inclusion of alligator pear slices, one cannot help but wonder at its inventor's obvious preference for ovoid foodstuffs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39876.name: serving of caviar canapes
39876.col_2: Perennial party favorites, these hors d'oeuvres feature delightfully bite-sized bread topped with cheese, vegetables, and salted caviar sturgeon eggs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39877.name: serving of marinated broccoflower
39877.col_2: A biting dish of broccoflower, paprika, and onion steeped in oil and dark vinegar.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39878.name: serving of broccoflower stew
39878.col_2: Broccoflower slices boiled in a savory broth alongside tender poultry and root vegetables.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39879.name: onyx knifefish
39879.col_2: A king among darksteel knifefish, and lord of the waters of the Mover Beta.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

39880.name: wakeful warden
39880.col_2: A king among wakeful watchers, and lord of the waters of the Wakeful Torana.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

39881.name: basilosaurus rex
39881.col_2: A king among basilosaurs, and lord of the waters of the Perfumed Tides.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

39882.name: eehs fan
39882.col_2: A king among eehs forhnesh, and lord of apohelos 18-α.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

39883.name: gilt dermogenys
39883.col_2: A king among dermogenys, and lord of the waters of the lower Hungering Gardens.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

39884.name: Rokkon potsherd
39884.col_2: A relic of Mount Rokkon valuable enough to be sold to a collector, but not so valuable that Hancock might insist upon keeping it for his own.

39886.name: Rokkon manuscript
39886.col_2: A thin tome recovered from Mount Rokkon. Though the Hingan script within is of an antiquated style that you could not hope to decipher, scholars would doubtless jump at the chance to acquire such a text.

39887.name: lump of island coal
39887.col_2: What naughty island mammets can expect to receive come the Starlight Celebration.

39888.name: chunk of island shale
39888.col_2: A sedimentary rock believed to contain fossilized matter, the specific origin of which is unknown.

39889.name: island glimshroom
39889.col_2: A faintly glowing green fungus lit from within by moonlight.

39890.name: chunk of island marble
39890.col_2: This marble is, by all objective standards, very tropical.

39891.name: chunk of island mythril ore
39891.col_2: The precious metal contained in this rock is unique to islands of the Cieldalaes.

39892.name: bottle of island effervescent water
39892.col_2: Naturally sparkling water bottled at the source and particularly delicious in mammet-concocted cocktails.

39893.name: chunk of island spectrine
39893.col_2: Gaze into this pale silky stone to witness its natural patterns of unmarred beauty. Then grind it up and make it into commercially profitable <hex:021A020203>stuff<hex:021A020103>.

39894.name: island cave shrimp
39894.col_2: A shrimp that happily made its home in the deepest, most solitary recesses of a deserted island─until you came along, that is.

39895.name: bag of island runner bean seeds
39895.description: bags of island runner bean seeds
39895.col_2: A sack swollen with seeds that will grow into particularly athletic beans.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

39896.name: bag of island beet seeds
39896.col_2: A bag bursting with itty-bitty beet babies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

39897.name: bag of island eggplant seeds
39897.col_2: Plant eggplant seeds, not eggs, for eggplants and thus avoid egg on your face or face-plants.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

39898.name: bag of island zucchini seeds
39898.col_2: These seeds will grow into zucchini whether you like it or not.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

39899.name: pod of island runner beans
39899.col_2: These beans are a flight risk. You have been warned.

39900.name: island beet
39900.col_2: No other beet can beat these beets, unless these beets are brutally bruised.

39901.name: island eggplant
39901.col_2: Why not “island aubergine”? Why not, indeed.

39902.name: island zucchini
39902.col_2: Zucchini is as zucchini does. Which is to say, not much.

39903.name: islekeep's steel hammer
39903.col_2: A strong and heavy mallet with formidable destructive power. It will no doubt collect you additional materials from designated resources, but remember─with great hammers come great responsibility.

39904.name: set of mammet-sized spelunking tools
39904.col_2: Excavation and exploratory tools crafted to fit tiny, desperate hands.

39905.name: set of bestestest mammet-sized builder's tools
39905.description: sets of bestestest mammet-sized builder's tools
39905.col_2: With these tools, any mammet may transcend their manufactured limits to become a metaphorical (and literal) machine of productivity.

39906.name: sprig of prime haritaki
39906.col_2: A lustrous leaf of the plant born from the popular Thavnairian nut. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

39907.name: sprig of sublime haritaki
39907.col_2: This spectacular sprig of haritaki has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

39908.name: phial of concentrated verdurous glioaether
39908.col_2: Rich green oil refined by aetherial reduction to a state so concentrated that it cannot possibly get any greener...or can it?

39909.name: chunk of prime chloroschist
39909.col_2: A crystalline sample cultivated in the exacting environment of Labyrinthos. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

39910.name: chunk of sublime chloroschist
39910.col_2: This glorious chunk of chloroschist has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

39911.name: phial of concentrated igneous glioaether
39911.col_2: Vibrant red oil refined by aetherial reduction to a state so concentrated that it cannot possibly get any redder...or can it?

39912.name: the Fury's aegis
39912.col_2: One must wonder whether this thick-shelled crustacean's name was approved by the Ishgardian Orthodox Church.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

39913.name: phial of concentrated aqueous glioaether
39913.col_2: Soothing blue oil refined by aetherial reduction to a state so concentrated that it cannot possibly get any bluer...or can it?

39914.name: length of uncharted course lumber
39914.col_2: This unremarkable lumber is earmarked for the construction of an uncharted course.

39915.name: set of uncharted course hardware
39915.col_2: Metal components required for the construction of a sturdy uncharted course.

39916.name: lump of uncharted course resin
39916.col_2: A versatile compound that the mammets insist is needed to seal your already-sunken ship against the elements.

39917.name: uncharted course construction permit
39917.col_2: Written permission for the construction of a sanctuary landmark. Use to unlock the uncharted course.

39918.name: conceivably special timeworn map
39918.col_2: This bottle is holding what appears to be an unusually valuable leather map.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 90 full party (eight players) recommended.<hex:02100103>※Guaranteed to summon a teleportation portal.

39919.name: irregular tomestone of tenfold pageantry
39919.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains knowledge of festivities for all manner of occasions, but especially those that endure year after year.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

39921.name: pair of majestic Manderville fists
39921.col_2: Majestic Manderville weapon.<hex:02100103>※Weapon appearance may take precedence over the display of hand gear.

40295.name: voidcast archfiend totem
40295.col_2: A small idol of Golbez. Judging by the painstaking details carved into it, this statuette was likely fashioned by his most devout followers.

40317.name: unsung blade of Anabaseios
40317.col_2: A stunning but sadly unstoried blade recovered from Pandæmonium. Though such weapons were once considered highly valuable, demand has dried up and they are now essentially worthless.

40318.name: flask of divine solvent
40318.col_2: A gleaming substance produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of rare and unconventional weapons. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

40319.name: spool of divine twine
40319.col_2: A silvery, silklike thread produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of credendum attire. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

40320.name: pot of divine shine
40320.col_2: A dazzling substance produced at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, used to enhance the properties of credendum accessories. Why it smells slightly of rotten fish and amra is a mystery better left unsolved. However, advances in crafting technology have rendered it obsolete.

40321.name: hermetic tomestone
40321.col_2: While it is a surpassingly small means of storing knowledge, the information deposited on this relic of Allagan society was compressed with heretofore unseen efficiency. Such a wealth of knowledge would not come without a sacrifice to portability, however, and this tomestone is unfathomably heavy as a result. This particular variety is not as highly sought as it once was, and may no longer be exchanged for other wares.

40322.name: chunk of amplifying achondrite
40322.col_2: This hunk of meteorite contains deposits of a rare form of pyroxene. When subjected to an advanced extraction process, the achondrite produces mineral oil which can be used to manipulate the pathways of aetherial conductivity.

40363.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to effectively employ reference materials to support one's assertions in civilized debate. Use to learn the /reference emote.

40364.name: pair of rose-colored spectacles
40364.col_2: Wear these lenses to feel and exude optimism.*<hex:02100103>* Optimism may or may not be warranted. Please act according to actual conditions. Though these were once considered a fashion accessory, trends are ever changing, and style enthusiasts now classify them as facewear. Use to unlock rose-colored spectacles.

40365.name: tsukumogami parasol
40365.col_2: Designed in the likeness of a Far Eastern umbrella spirit, this parasol is certain to attract quizzical eyes (and slobbery tongues). Use to unlock a tsukumogami parasol.

40366.name: tactful taskmaster umbrella
40366.col_2: A handy accessory to have when you need a large visual reminder that there is work to be done and schedules to keep. Use to acquire a tactful taskmaster umbrella.

40367.name: set of voidcast barding
40367.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Golbez.

40368.name: set of felicitous barding
40368.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the felicitous furball.

40369.name: puffin
40369.col_2: Wants to work smarter, not harder.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the puffin minion.

40370.name: mossasaurus
40370.col_2: It's adorable now, but wait till it grows up.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mossasaurus minion.

40371.name: okuri chochin
40371.col_2: For those who like a little fright with their light.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the okuri chochin minion.

40372.name: posher otter
40372.col_2: Part futuristic, part antiquated, all class.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the posher otter minion.

40373.name: Rubellite Weapon
40373.col_2: Scaled down or no, it can scratch you up good.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Rubellite Weapon minion.

40374.name: chimpanzee
40374.col_2: This adorable critter will make you love every ape that you see, from chimpan-a to chimpan-z.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the chimpanzee minion.

40375.name: exciting dynamite
40375.col_2: For those who love the threat of death or serious injury to follow their every step.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the exciting dynamite minion.

40376.name: mikra Lyssa
40376.col_2: Definitely meant to be a wolf─the ancients said so.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mikra Lyssa minion.

40377.name: Shiromaru
40377.col_2: Because the only thing that's better than a dog is a <hex:021A020203>ninja<hex:021A020103> dog.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Shiromaru minion.

40378.name: Kuromaru
40378.col_2: Because the only thing that's better than a dog is a <hex:021A020203>ninja<hex:021A020103> dog.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Kuromaru minion.

40379.name: wind-up Athena
40379.col_2: To follow you everywhere─<hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> is her wish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Athena minion.

40380.name: wind-up Barbariccia
40380.col_2: Will blow you away─figuratively speaking.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Barbariccia minion.

40381.name: goggle-eyed dogu
40381.col_2: Guaranteed to win any staring contest.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the goggle-eyed dogu minion.

40382.name: island buffalo horn
40382.col_2: When blown, this horn emits a deep and languorous sound that summons your island buffalo.

40383.name: traveling supporter identification key
40383.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your traveling supporter will magically bring the machine to life.

40384.name: Garlond GL-IS ignition key
40384.col_2: A thin key that ignites your Garlond GL-IS's ceruleum engine, bringing the sidecar-equipped vehicle rumbling to life.

40385.name: megaloambystoma horn
40385.col_2: Moist to the touch, this horn produces a carefree sound that brings your megaloambystoma floating to your side.

40386.name: Rising Phoenix whistle
40386.col_2: Hot to the touch, this hand-carved whistle emits a lively shrill that summons your Rising Phoenix.

40387.name: burabura chochin whistle
40387.col_2: A hand-carved whistle that, when played, emits an eerie tone that beckons your burabura chochin to your side.

40388.name: Shishioji flute
40388.col_2: The spirited song of this flute is said to summon Shishioji, a princely fragment of Shishio, legendary auspice and king of the nue.

40389.name: shadow wolf horn
40389.col_2: Steeped in shadow, this horn of bone emits a spine-chilling sound that brings your shadow wolf to your side.

40390.name: magicked children's bed
40390.col_2: For as long as beds have existed, children have dreamed of having one that flies. Thanks to this winsome piece lovingly crafted for younglings─and the young at heart─that dream is now a reality.

40391.name: lynx of fallen shadow flute
40391.col_2: Emitting a grim and melancholic tone, this flute summons a lynx of fallen shadow to your side.

40392.name: magicked prism (onibi)
40392.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Casts an eerie aura around the user.

40393.name: seacracker
40393.col_2: An otherworldly item of celebration that unleashes a blast of streamers, confetti, and assorted marine life.

40394.name: magicked prism (Loporrit head)
40394.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Envelops the user's head with the visage of an enormous-yet-endearing Loporrit.
