40522.name: Sirensong mussel
40522.col_2: A razor-sharp mollusk found in the Sirensong Sea. Those averse to paper cuts are advised not to touch the edges of its shell without proper protection.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40523.name: arrowhead
40523.col_2: In eras past, squid of this sort were used as lethal projectiles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40524.name: deepshade sardine
40524.col_2: A dark-scaled fish that thought it could surreptitiously sneak through the shadows of a fishing boat and remain unnoticed. Alas, it thought wrong.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40525.name: Sirensong mullet
40525.col_2: Business in the front. Sirensong in the back.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40526.name: selkie puffer
40526.col_2: Perhaps this puffer could equip a racket and fur armguards and depart on a grand adventure. Or perhaps it's just a fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40527.name: poet's pipe
40527.col_2: Warning: not an actual musical instrument. Do not attempt to blow on it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40528.name: marine Matanga
40528.col_2: Proof that anything looks friendlier when it has Matanga features, even sharks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40529.name: spectral coelacanth
40529.col_2: This coelacanth took to the spectral currents out of dissatisfaction with the evolutionary hand it was dealt─including, perhaps, its distinct lack of hands.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40530.name: dusk shark
40530.col_2: While known to scavenge the flesh of the drowned, this large grey shark will as surely feast upon the living.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40531.name: mermaid scale
40531.col_2: These rainbow-colored mollusks are believed to come from mermaids. Alas, not a one has ever been sighted, suggesting they have no desire to explore up where we walk, up where we run, up where we stay all day in the sun.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40532.name: broadhead
40532.col_2: A squid whose head and mind are both as sharp as an arrow. It puts little thought into its diet, however, and will eat anything it can sink its barbed beak into.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40533.name: vivid pink shrimp
40533.col_2: A shrimp known for its vibrant and resilient pink shell, as well as its long, sharp pincers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40534.name: sunken coelacanth
40534.col_2: A long-lived fish that makes its home in the deepest recesses of the ocean.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40535.name: siren's sigh
40535.col_2: A variety of anglerfish thought to be breath spilled from a siren's lips.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40536.name: black-jawed helicoprion
40536.col_2: Though this ancient sea-dweller lacks a powerful bite, it makes up for it with the ability to bludgeon and grind its prey against rocks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40537.name: impostopus
40537.col_2: This doppelganger of the deep is able to mimic prey using its tentacles as it approaches. The psychological trauma of being attacked by oneself─or perhaps a loved one that relatives would jokingly call one's twin─often paralyzes the victim as the impostopus feeds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40538.name: jade mantis shrimp
40538.col_2: A beautiful jade-colored crustacean that is the envy of many a sea creature.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40539.name: Nymeia's wheel
40539.col_2: An ancient wavekin allegedly born of divine error─or divine clumsiness, at the least.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40540.name: taniwha
40540.col_2: Respected and feared by the peoples of the south sea isles, this ancient sea creature is the subject of myriad myths and legends.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

40541.name: Ruby herring
40541.col_2: Hingan merchants will offer fragrant samples of these toothsome fish when they do not care to haggle with their patrons, and thus its name has entered the local lexicon to refer to a misleading statement.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40542.name: whirlpool turban
40542.col_2: Legend has it that this spiral wavekin possesses dominion over water, whipping up violent whirlpools and lacerating fishing vessels to shreds...but it is, at least, a very charming little shell.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40543.name: leopard prawn
40543.col_2: The unpredictable patterns on this crustacean's carapace indicate its freshness and depth of flavor when cooked.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40544.name: spear squid
40544.col_2: In recent days, dried varieties of this squid have gained popularity as a convenient snack for traveling lancers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40545.name: floating lantern
40545.col_2: An elegant jellyfish that emits a warm, gentle glow akin to its namesake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40546.name: rubescent tatsunoko
40546.col_2: Despite being maybe, possibly, improbably the juvenile form of a Ruby Dragon, this wavekin prefers hiding amongst colonies of leopard prawns to confrontation, and is thus the envy of introverted naturalists across the realm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40547.name: hatatate
40547.col_2: With a dorsal fin that makes it look like a standard-bearer, this saltwater fish is ready to charge bravely into a pitched battle under the sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40548.name: silent shark
40548.col_2: A species of shark that is silent but deadly─in the literal sense, children. In the literal sense.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40549.name: spectral wrasse
40549.col_2: Though this wavekin may be small, it attempts to remedy such shortcomings by sporting splendidly spectral scales. In doing so, however, it has become more vulnerable to predators and skilled anglers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40550.name: mizuhiki
40550.col_2: A fish of good fortune, said to strongly resemble white and red cords commonly used to wrap gifts in Hingashi.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40551.name: snapping koban
40551.col_2: This wavekin's golden fins and mouth appear as coins floating in the ocean, giving the impression that sailors of the Kugane coast are quite cavalier with their finances.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40552.name: silkweft prawn
40552.col_2: Some have spent fortunes to have a single taste of this succulent shrimp.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40553.name: stingfin trevally
40553.col_2: If the poisonous sacs of this stingfin are carefully removed, the meat can make for a perfectly adequate meal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40554.name: swordtip squid
40554.col_2: True to its name, the head of this squid is sharp enough to pierce straight through plate armor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40555.name: mailfish
40555.col_2: A school of these fish creates a striking sheet of silver, like an enormous suit of chainmail drifting through the ocean blue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40556.name: Idaten's bolt
40556.col_2: Said to be blessed by the gods with blinding speed, sometimes these fish tire of water and propel themselves into the sky on the back of a spectral current.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40557.name: maelstrom turban
40557.col_2: The presence of these shellfish in shallow waters is considered to be an ill omen, for they are believed to be the harbinger of storms, violent winds, and worse.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40558.name: shoshitsuki
40558.col_2: The fleetness of these sharks is enough to tire even a god, but where divinity sees a menace, a fisher sees opportunity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40559.name: spadefish
40559.col_2: Which came first, the fish or the spade?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40560.name: glass dragon
40560.col_2: Thought to be the counterpart of the Ruby Dragon, this legendary creature is far less fragile than its name implies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

40561.name: strip of crimson kelp
40561.col_2: Found in every corner of the Ruby Sea, this kelp is known and loved for its culinary versatility.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40562.name: reef squid
40562.col_2: A cephalopod that lays its eggs on the Ruby Sea's rocky reefs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40563.name: pinebark flounder
40563.col_2: If a pinebark flounder splashes in the Ruby Sea and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound? Far Eastern philosophers have yet to determine a definitive answer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40564.name: mantle moray
40564.col_2: A moray that resembles an ethereal raiment worn by the Ruby Princess...if ethereal raiments looked as though they were about to utter the punchline to a groan-worthy joke.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40565.name: Shisui goby
40565.col_2: With its fondness for migratory journeys, this saltwater fish puts the “go” in “goby.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40566.name: sanbaso
40566.col_2: Said to be an omen of ample harvests, this wavekin is named for a traditional dance passed down in the Far East.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40567.name: barded lobster
40567.col_2: If one were to liken the spiny lobster to a valiant knight, then the barded lobster─nearly twice the size of its counterpart─would serve as its seaworthy steed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40568.name: violet sentry
40568.col_2: As dreadful as it is, people would be forgiven for mistakenly calling this seabeast the “violent sentry.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

40569.name: spectral snake eel
40569.col_2: Now that its spectral nature has taken precedence, the question of whether this wavekin is a snake or an eel has become irrelevant.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40570.name: heavensent shark
40570.col_2: This shark is believed to be the reincarnation of a tiger descended from Heaven-on-High.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40571.name: fleeting squid
40571.col_2: When winter descends upon Kugane and its vibrant flora wilts, some look to the sea, where the skin of this cephalopod reminds them of warmer seasons.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40572.name: bowbarb lobster
40572.col_2: The long whiskers of this massive lobster curve like a bow, and some Kugane children cannot resist playing at imaginary war around the dinner table.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40573.name: pitch pickle
40573.col_2: Biting into the flesh of this wavekin will stain one's entire mouth black, which is useful if you have occasion to disguise yourself as ancient Far Eastern nobility.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40574.name: senbei octopus
40574.col_2: This wavekin resembles a popular Kugane treat outside of the water, causing sailors to look twice when rummaging through supplies for a late-night snack.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40575.name: tentacle thresher
40575.col_2: Displaying an almost exclusive predilection for preying on octopodes, this wavekin shows that even nature's deadliest predators can be picky eaters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

40576.name: bekko rockhugger
40576.col_2: The round body of this wavekin allows it to be carried swiftly through the ocean's currents, which might explain why it clings so desperately to the ocean's rocks.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40577.name: yellow iris
40577.col_2: Like its namesake flower, this fish has put many local ecosystems at risk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40578.name: crimson sentry
40578.col_2: It takes little imagination to guess how this shark, one of two guardians keeping vigil over Shisui of the Violet Tides, got its name.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40579.name: flying squid
40579.col_2: What dried flying squid lacks in flavor, it makes up for in sheer quantity, and it is a staple in the diets of the Kugane commonfolk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40580.name: hells' claw
40580.col_2: Protected by a thick layer of volcanic rock, this crustacean swims through the depths of the Ruby Sea to keep the flesh inside its shell from cooking.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40581.name: catching carp
40581.col_2: If only it knew where to find a pitching carp.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40582.name: Garlean bluegill
40582.col_2: Though this invasive wavekin may appear harmless at first glance, the Yanxians will stop at nothing to hunt these tiny blue terrors down.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40583.name: Yanxian softshell
40583.col_2: The world may be hard and cold, but this turtle's shell is soft...and questionably warm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40584.name: princess salmon
40584.col_2: Not deigning to leave her domain, the princess salmon always remains in the waters of the One River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40585.name: calligraph
40585.col_2: When told the tale of this fish's creation, a Doman boy is said to have attempted to create more fish with inky scales. It did not end well for the carp in his father's prized pond.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40586.name: singular shrimp
40586.col_2: A small shrimp whose deep green hue is said to be a reflection of the One River. But more importantly, it's delicious.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40587.name: brocade carp
40587.col_2: Beautifully patterned and vibrantly hued, this freshwater fish has long been farmed in the One River for ornamental purposes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40588.name: Yanxian sturgeon
40588.col_2: A large freshwater fish whose eggs are considered so delicious, it gave rise to the saying “hoes before roe”─a reminder that work precedes pleasure.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40589.name: spectral kotsu zetsu
40589.col_2: The bone-like tongues of these spectral wavekin are surprisingly sturdy despite their crystalline appearance, and are often used by highly skilled artisans to craft priceless accessories.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40590.name: fishy shark
40590.col_2: A large shark that, despite its size, prefers living among the reeds of the One River.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40591.name: Gensui shrimp
40591.col_2: The green carapace of this shrimp is said to be the same emerald hue as the sweeping hills that make up the Gensui Chain.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40592.name: yato-no-kami
40592.col_2: This wavekin makes an appearance in the folklore of Yanxia, where it is depicted as a demon who leaves the land fallow. Best eat it to prevent the tales coming true.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40593.name: Heron's eel
40593.col_2: Although their early life is spent in Heron's Way, these eels eventually make their way to bigger ponds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40594.name: crowshadow mussel
40594.col_2: A bivalve mollusk whose pitch-black shell hides a dazzling interior.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40595.name: Yanxian goby
40595.col_2: Drawn down the One River from the Azim Steppe, these fish grow fat upon the smaller specimens inhabiting spectral currents.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

40596.name: iridescent trout
40596.col_2: The scales of these fish are highly sought after by artisans in Kugane and beyond.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40597.name: un-Namazu
40597.col_2: Believed to be a Namazu fallen from grace, this fish can not so much as affirm or deny the claim.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40598.name: gakugyo
40598.col_2: Once the subject of a Far Eastern faerie tale, this wavekin may or may not seek revenge after being used by an adventurous rabbit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

40599.name: ginrin goshiki
40599.col_2: Valued for its vibrant scales, this variety of carp is occasionally mistaken for a gold ingot when viewed from above the water's surface.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40600.name: jewel of Plum Spring
40600.col_2: Thought to be birthed from the gnarled trunk of an ancient plum tree, the blossoms atop this legendary turtle's shell neither wither nor fade with the passage of time.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

40601.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Ambitious Ends<hex:021A020103>
40601.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, styling techniques used to mixed success since the time of the ancients.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.

40602.name: Okuri Chochin card
40602.col_2: A common (★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 369

40603.name: Gorai the Uncaged card
40603.col_2: An uncommon (★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 370

40604.name: Moko the Restless card
40604.col_2: An uncommon (★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 371

40605.name: Octomammoth card
40605.col_2: A rare (★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 364

40606.name: Proto-Carbuncle card
40606.col_2: A rare (★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 365

40607.name: Goldor card
40607.col_2: A rare (★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 372

40608.name: Shishio card
40608.col_2: A rare (★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 373

40609.name: Themis card
40609.col_2: An epic (★★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 366

40610.name: Enenra card
40610.col_2: An epic (★★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 374

40611.name: Golbez card
40611.col_2: A legendary (★★★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 367

40612.name: Athena card
40612.col_2: A legendary (★★★★★) card used in the game Triple Triad.<hex:02100103>Card No. 368

40620.name: Watcher's Palace interior wall
40620.col_2: An interior wall crafted to mimic the design of the Watcher's Palace.

40621.name: unit of Watcher's Palace flooring
40621.col_2: A section of flooring crafted to mimic the design of the Watcher's Palace.

40622.name: Watcher's Palace ceiling lamp
40622.col_2: A chandelier crafted to resemble the lamps found in the Watcher's Palace.

40623.name: botanist's work table
40623.col_2: A work station custom-made for the botanically inclined.

40624.name: imitation curtained window
40624.col_2: A clever semblance of a window to the outside. One can almost hear the birds chirping.

40625.name: platter of assorted cookies
40625.col_2: A delectable assemblage of cookies catering to various tastes. Sure to satisfy any and every sweet tooth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

40626.name: botanical candle display
40626.col_2: Similar to a normal candle display, but with considerably more dried flora.

40627.name: Cieldalaes planter
40627.col_2: A tall pot featuring an even taller plant native to the Cieldalaes.

40628.name: Chair Hena
40628.col_2: An elegant piece of furniture named for the tragic civilization which produced its original design.

40630.name: imitation moonlit window
40630.col_2: The soft, lunar light of this deceptive window is best appreciated in near darkness.

40631.name: metal pipe wall shelf
40631.col_2: The exposed pipes and pressure gauges of this shelving system provide a distinct “boiler room” aesthetic.

40632.name: basket of steamed shumai
40632.col_2: Wrapped in a wafer-thin skin and steamed to perfection, these bite-sized dumplings are a Far Eastern favorite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Determination Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

40633.name: plate of fried gyoza
40633.col_2: While boiling is the norm in Yanxia, Kugane culinarians prefer to crisp these crescent-shaped dumplings in a pan before serving.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Critical Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

40634.name: floating kitchen cabinet
40634.col_2: A wall-mounted kitchen cabinet. For those expecting a levitating cupboard, prepare to be disappointed.

40635.name: azure sky phasmascape
40635.col_2: An imitation skylight with illusory properties. Gaze upwards to appreciate this portal to an inviting blue sky.

40636.name: starry sky phasmascape
40636.col_2: An imitation skylight with illusory properties. Gaze upwards to appreciate this portal to a star-studded expanse.

40637.name: freestanding rattan hammock
40637.col_2: Based on a southern seas furnishing, this freestanding hammock allows you to laze in the location of your choice.

40638.name: set of classic tableware
40638.col_2: A tableware set of simple, antique design.

40639.name: classic umbrella stand
40639.col_2: An understated period piece that one might see in a grandsire's entryway.

40640.name: rustic log table
40640.col_2: A plain table hewn from a single log.

40641.name: rustic log bench
40641.col_2: A modest bench hewn from a single log.

40642.name: array of scattered tomes
40642.col_2: Create an impression of scholarly study with this artfully disordered pile of reference materials.

40643.name: vintage side table
40643.col_2: A circular side table of unobtrusive design.

40644.name: short pillar bookshelf
40644.col_2: A pillar to support your academic pursuits. Not so much your ceiling.

40645.name: imitation vault
40645.col_2: For those with more money than sense, yet less money than requires an actual vault.

40646.name: ivy pendant wall light
40646.col_2: A trio of lamps hanging from an ivy-covered, wall-mounted branch.

40647.name: Crystarium pendant wall light
40647.col_2: A wall-mounted trio of hanging lamps crafted in the Crystarium style.

40648.name: fishing rod rack
40648.col_2: A decorative display stand for the fishing gear enthusiast.

40649.name: Far Eastern indoor bamboo fountain
40649.col_2: A masterfully crafted indoor fountain wrought from bamboo and stone.

40650.name: cactuar colony planter
40650.col_2: A large pot containing an assortment of cacti fashioned to resemble a colony of cactuars. Their empty gaze is somehow unsettling.

40651.name: verdant pillar
40651.col_2: A pillar crafted to resemble a natural tree. Squirrels not included.

40652.name: rattan partition
40652.col_2: The division provided by this southern seas partition is more of a suggestion.

40653.name: oyoroi display
40653.col_2: A set of Far Eastern armor arranged to resemble a stern─yet comfortably seated─warrior.

40654.name: Far Eastern brazier
40654.col_2: The dancing flames atop this Far Eastern-styled brazier warm the heart and soul.

40655.name: imitation closed door
40655.col_2: The sign on this mock wooden door forbids entry. Please respect its authority.

40656.name: wall-mounted pot rack
40656.col_2: A handy circular rack for hanging stovetop utensils.

40657.name: serving barrel
40657.col_2: A wooden barrel for storing your favorite alcoholic beverage. Complete with spigot for easy serving.

40658.name: classic secretaire
40658.col_2: An elegant desk perfect for penning what the less dignified might consider an excessive amount of missives.

40659.name: raw log half partition
40659.col_2: A rustic fence constructed of unrefined logs and branches.

40660.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Forever at Your Side<hex:021A020103>
40660.col_2: A commissioned portrait of a former imperial officer and his adopted children entitled <hex:021A020203>Forever at Your Side<hex:021A020103>.

40661.name: blighted earth sword stand
40661.col_2: Cloaked in loam and enough ominous power to make the land tremble, this greatsword evokes memories of a fallen despot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

40662.name: Drowned King sculpture
40662.col_2: This statue emanates the menace of a deadly undertow.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

40663.name: eventide sword stand
40663.col_2: It is uncertain what is on display here: the greatsword, or the shadowy energies which crackle and writhe along its length.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

40664.name: the Rising MMXXIII advertisement
40664.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of a realm-wide celebration of hope and rebirth.

40665.name: colony of wall-mounted vampire bats
40665.col_2: Spookify a plain wall with this cloud of tiny bloodthirsty beasts.

40666.name: springtide fan stand
40666.col_2: A verdantly decorated pair of folding fans displayed at Heavensturn to beckon winds of fair fortune in the seasons to come.

40667.name: Valentione's heart chair
40667.col_2: This charming wooden chair bears an adorable heart motif, making it clear not only by the comfort of its fluffy pink cushions but its very form factor that it is a product of love.

40671.name: island garden fence
40671.col_2: A rudimentary wooden fence, designed to complement the simple lifestyle of the Cieldalaes.

40672.name: island parasol table
40672.col_2: An understated outside table, designed to complement the simple lifestyle of the Cieldalaes.

40673.name: island wooden chair
40673.col_2: A modest wooden chair, designed to complement the simple lifestyle of the Cieldalaes.

40674.name: set of railway sleepers
40674.col_2: A rustic ground covering made from repurposed railway sleepers.

40675.name: garden creek
40675.col_2: Complete with running water, this soothing stonebound creek is the perfect place to dip your toes on a hot summer's day.

40676.name: mushroom medley lamp
40676.col_2: Illuminate your garden with this three-tiered collection of fungal furniture.

40677.name: illuminated topiary chocobo
40677.col_2: Trimmed into the shape of a sitting chocobo, this shrubbery is liberally strung with glowing adornments in the style of the Starlight Celebration.

40678.name: country swing seat
40678.col_2: Escape the midday sun beneath the roof of this charming wooden swing seat.

40679.name: ornate fountain
40679.col_2: Decorated with delicate designs and crystal panels, this water feature gushes elegance.

40680.name: smashed flower pot
40680.col_2: Let the resilience of the flowers which persevere in the soil of this damaged pot serve as a reminder that hope springs eternal.

40681.name: well pump
40681.col_2: This working well pump provides a reliable─and apparently endless─source of clean water.

40682.name: ivy-canopied deck
40682.col_2: The ivy strung atop this wooden deck throws the seating area below into an idyllic dappled shade.

40683.name: komainu statue
40683.col_2: Ward off malevolent spirits with this dignified statue.

40684.name: stone toro lantern
40684.col_2: A moss-covered stone lantern constructed in the Far Eastern style. Its base is attached to a thick stone slab for support.

40685.name: planted toro lantern
40685.col_2: A moss-covered stone lantern constructed in the Far Eastern style and driven directly into the earth, the better to blend in with natural surrounds.

40686.name: bag of chrysanthemum seeds
40686.col_2: These seeds will grow into spectacular blooms, commonly held as the symbol for friendship, happiness, and well-being.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

40687.name: bouquet of red chrysanthemums
40687.col_2: A bunch of red chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40688.name: bouquet of blue chrysanthemums
40688.col_2: A bunch of blue chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40689.name: bouquet of yellow chrysanthemums
40689.col_2: A bunch of yellow chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40690.name: bouquet of green chrysanthemums

40691.name: bouquet of orange chrysanthemums
40691.col_2: A bunch of orange chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40692.name: bouquet of purple chrysanthemums
40692.col_2: A bunch of purple chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40693.name: bouquet of white chrysanthemums
40693.col_2: A bunch of white chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40694.name: bouquet of black chrysanthemums
40694.col_2: A bunch of black chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40695.name: rainbow chrysanthemum bouquet
40695.col_2: A bunch of multicolored chrysanthemums, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

40696.name: weathered fitting
40696.col_2: Despite weathering a stint on the ocean floor, this metal fitting should still serve as a suitable connecting piece for other building materials.

40697.name: length of iroko lumber
40697.col_2: A processed length of highly durable and water-resistant iroko lumber.

40698.name: mossy log
40698.col_2: This moss-covered log is clearly the deliberately cut remnant of a towering tree. Less clear is how it came to be lodged at the bottom of the sea.

40699.name: damaged side table
40699.col_2: Seemingly a furnishing from some sunken galleon, this brine-soaked table might still serve its purpose with a little restorative woodworking.

40700.name: bolt of malake karpasos
40700.col_2: The method used to weave this luxuriously soft cotton fabric defies identification.

40740.name: isleworks stove
40740.col_2: An iron stove forged in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Furnishings/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

40741.name: isleworks lantern
40741.col_2: Tragically, this lantern emits only a faint green light and is thus best used for decorative purposes, much to the disappointment of its mammet creators.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

40742.name: pinch of isleworks natron
40742.col_2: A mixture commonly used for its effectiveness at removing even the most stubborn of oil stains.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Concoctions<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

40743.name: bowl of isleworks bouillabaisse
40743.col_2: A hearty soup consisting of various seafood procured in the Cieldalaes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs/Marine Merchandise<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

40744.name: isleworks fossil display
40744.col_2: A mysterious fossil cleaned and then framed by the island mammets. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Creature Creations/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

40745.name: isleworks bathtub
40745.col_2: A bathtub large enough to fit four mammets, maybe five. Possibly six at a pinch, and certainly no more than seven. Probably.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Furnishings/Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

40746.name: pair of isleworks spectacles
40746.col_2: A spectacular pair of spectacles. Exceedingly durable, being forged of mythril.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Attire/Sundries<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

40747.name: sheet of isleworks cooling glass
40747.col_2: When the weather is unbearably hot, do not be alarmed should you find the island mammets rubbing themselves against the surface of this glass for a moment's respite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Unburied Treasures<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

40748.name: serving of isleworks runner bean saute
40748.description: servings of isleworks runner bean saute
40748.col_2: “Try to run away now.”<hex:02100103>─Peeved island mammet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

40749.name: bowl of isleworks beet soup
40749.col_2: Beets boiled into a very, very purple soup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

40750.name: serving of isleworks imam bayildi
40750.col_2: A dish said to be so delectable as to cause one to faint from sheer euphoria.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

40751.name: jar of isleworks pickled zucchini
40751.col_2: These sweet and sour pickles are best enjoyed on their own or in sandwiches.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Preserved Food<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

40752.name: voidcast pauldron
40752.col_2: A shoulder plate worn by a lordly voidsent. The stain of Darkness is sunk deep into its twisted whorls.

40753.name: pearl of fissures
40753.col_2: The might of an archfiend is trapped within this precious jewel. It carries a scent of soil not unlike that of a fresh-dug grave.

40754.name: pearl of tides
40754.col_2: The might of an archfiend is trapped within this precious jewel. Its glistening surface is ever slick with salt-tinged moisture.

40755.col_3: Pom from the Heavens Orchestrion Roll

40756.name: Shishu reiseki
40756.col_2: A mystical stone quarried from the isle of Shishu.

40757.name: Seiryu sculpture
40757.col_2: An imposing rendition of the serpentine auspice Seiryu. Place eastward for best results.

40758.name: Suzaku sculpture
40758.col_2: An imposing rendition of the fiery auspice Suzaku. Place southward for best results.

40759.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Newfound Adventure<hex:021A020103>
40759.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of a hero embarking on a new chapter of thrilling adventure.

40760.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Buried Memory<hex:021A020103>
40760.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of an ancient dungeon and the wardens charged with keeping its occupants chained.

40761.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Gods Revel, Lands Tremble<hex:021A020103>
40761.description: authentic copies of <hex:021A020203>Gods Revel, Lands Tremble<hex:021A020103>
40761.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of two black-clad figures stood astride the boundary of two worlds.
40761.col_3: Authentic Copy of Gods Revel, Lands Tremble

40762.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>The Dark Throne<hex:021A020103>
40762.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of an armored lord upon his shadowed throne. The mysterious orb and coiling dragon bespeak a mastery over dark powers.
40762.col_3: Authentic Copy of the Dark Throne

40764.col_2: An authentic roaring bonfire perfect for activities such as celebrating the Moonfire Faire and establishing a solid alibi.

41032.name: chunk of cosmic crystallite
41032.col_2: This extremely rare form of crystal-based achondrite is infused with aether from its journey through the cosmos. Theoretically, its energies can be extracted in the form of a highly refined liquid essence.

41053.name: voidvessel totem
41053.col_2: A small idol of Zeromus. It is unclear exactly who crafted it.

41054.name: voidvessel weapon coffer (IL 655)
41054.col_2: A heavy chest containing a voidvessel weapon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 655. Weapon type determined by current job or class at time of opening. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.

41055.name: set of paladin's voidvessel arms (IL 655)
41055.col_2: A set of arms containing a voidvessel bastard sword and voidvessel kite shield.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 90. IL: 655.

41056.name: abyssal diamond
41056.col_2: The might of a great and terrible voidsent is trapped within this precious jewel. A darkness beyond blackest pitch emanates from its core.

41057.name: set of abyssal barding
41057.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Zeromus.

41058.name: ossicula
41058.col_2: A fish as nutritious as it is filled with bones, which sadly make the acquisition of said nutrients all the trickier.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41059.name: kitty herring
41059.col_2: Notably dined upon by the Empire's most pampered pusses.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41060.name: empyreal spiral
41060.col_2: Though equally beautiful intact, this conch shell becomes an in-demand pigment when ground to pieces, so pulverized it shall be.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41061.name: sarikuyruk
41061.col_2: This species of yellowtail is particularly valued for its rich vitamin content.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

41062.name: opal tetra
41062.col_2: Named for its scales' resemblance to the multicolored gemstone, this freshwater fish is enchanting to behold. Whether it is aware of its own beauty has yet to be determined.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41063.name: cushion care package
41063.col_2: A set of soft and profoundly healing pillows ideal for relieving back pain.

41064.name: feline recreational device
41064.col_2: This apparatus has been guaranteed by science to entertain cats. Whether cats care to entertain the notion of said science, however, is another matter entirely.

41065.name: mesmerizing miniature
41065.col_2: A carefully handcrafted replication of a monstrous creature. The longer you stare at it, the longer it stares at you...

41066.name: energizing eye-lixir
41066.col_2: Apply directly to the eyeball for optimal exhaustion relief. If you experience side effects such as loss of vision, dizziness, nausea, or death, stop use immediately and seek the counsel of your nearest chirurgeon.

41067.name: researcher's relaxation kit
41067.col_2: A delightful box brimming with relaxation implements of notable quality.

41068.name: handful of cushion care package materials
41068.description: handfuls of cushion care package materials
41068.col_2: Simply by holding this miraculous substance in hand, you feel the lingering strain from collecting it fade from your fingers...

41069.name: bundle of feline fascinators
41069.col_2: But a whiff of this plain material is liable to show any kitty cat a glimpse of kitty heaven.

41070.name: kit of mesmerizing miniature materials
41070.col_2: Everything a monster-lover requires to replicate the horrors of their dreams. Or nightmares, as it were.

41071.name: pinch of energizing eye-lixir materials
41071.col_2: Powder that promises to relieve eyestrain once properly prepared. Applying directly to the eyeball is likely to exacerbate ocular discomfort and is highly discouraged.

41072.name: set of researcher's relaxation kit materials
41072.description: sets of researcher's relaxation kit materials
41072.col_2: Relaxation implements of notable quality, sans the delightful box.

41073.name: set of cushion care package components
41073.description: sets of cushion care package components
41073.col_2: This mysteriously sourced gelatin is indeed quite soft to the touch, if fundamentally unnerving in nature...

41074.name: set of feline recreational device components
41074.description: sets of feline recreational device components
41074.col_2: All you require to create a scientifically certified device for entertaining any cat.

41075.name: set of mesmerizing miniature components
41075.col_2: A bag of limbs, eyes, torsos, heads, tails, horns, and claws, mercifully bloodless and in the miniature.

41076.name: set of energizing eye-lixir components
41076.col_2: Substances that should create eye drops with a high rate of alleviating ocular stress and a low rate of mortality upon contact.

41077.name: set of researcher's relaxation kit components
41077.description: sets of researcher's relaxation kit components
41077.col_2: Materials required to create relaxation implements of notable quality. Delightful box included.

41078.name: Aloalo potsherd
41078.col_2: A relic of Aloalo Island surely possessed of immense cultural and anthropological worth.

41080.name: Aloalo manuscript
41080.col_2: This esoteric tome discovered on Aloalo Island is a trove of historical knowledge─to those who can decipher it.

41081.name: pair of Azeyma's earrings
41081.col_2: Increases EXP earned by 30% when level 90 and below. Attributes and item level vary according to class/job and current level when equipped.

41082.name: fern interior wall
41082.col_2: An interior wall delicately stenciled with a cascading leafy design.

41083.name: greige carpet
41083.col_2: For the ambivalent designer who cannot commit to grey or beige. Guaranteed unremarkable!

41084.name: seabed ceiling lamp
41084.col_2: Simply install this light fixture to be immersed in the magic of the deep. Unsettling fish sold separately by popular request.

41085.name: hanging lure display
41085.col_2: An aesthetic arrangement of angling accoutrements.

41086.name: abyssal wings display
41086.col_2: A sculpture incorporating several of Zeromus's key features, the power to destroy life as we know it thankfully not among them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

41087.name: Crystarium wall canopy
41087.col_2: An elegant fixture reminiscent of Crystarium sensibilities.

41088.name: nursery canopy
41088.col_2: Lounge like a highborn tot with this elegant and cozy nursery canopy.

41089.name: Ronkan fireplace
41089.col_2: A solid stone hearth rendered in the Ronkan architectural style.

41090.name: tomestool
41090.col_2: Features a nook beneath the seat for all manner of tomes, dusty or otherwise.

41091.name: magazine display rack
41091.col_2: An easily perusable collection of popular periodicals and other publications.

41092.name: celestial screen
41092.col_2: This rounded screen designed to resemble the heavens above is a must-have for astrologians, astrologists, astronomers, and whoever decides to prefix their vocation with “astro” next.

41094.name: imitation trapdoor
41094.col_2: All of the excitement of a true trapdoor, with none of the deadly pits below.

41095.name: complete breakfast of Manderville's Adventurer Flakes
41095.description: complete breakfasts of Manderville's Adventurer Flakes
41095.col_2: Manderville & Manderville's lovingly crafted Manderville's Adventurer Flakes (Manderville Mark Certified) supplement the diets of growing adventurers with the nutrients they need, while providing the convenience and non-perishability they crave. Now with flavor!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Direct Hit Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

41096.name: cluster lamp
41096.col_2: This artificial crystal formation produces a gentle glow certain to give heart to longtime adventurers.

41097.name: Lapis Manalis banner
41097.col_2: A fraying banner emblazoned with the symbol of the reapers.

41099.name: Hyperboreia bench
41099.col_2: This circular bench imitates a design seen in Ktisis Hyperboreia, complete with planted vegetation.

41100.name: Aitiascope desk
41100.col_2: Simple, unadorned work desks such as this are used to make observations in the Aitiascope. Includes a monitor for keeping track of aetheric fluctuations.

41101.name: Aitiascope lamp
41101.col_2: A softly glowing lamp of the kind used to provide illumination in the depths of the Aitiascope.

41102.name: throne of the foremost
41102.col_2: This artifact recovered from the Fell Court of Troia has the distinct air of a furnishing designed for only the greatest of individuals, but technically nothing can stop you from sitting on it.

41103.name: wood slice loft
41103.col_2: This whimsical loft was hewn from a centuries-old tree.

41104.name: faerie pendant wall light
41104.col_2: No pixies were harmed in the making of these whimsical floral lights, and thus none will be lurking in wait to exact revenge during your next visit to Il Mheg. For this, anyway.

41105.name: portaled partition
41105.col_2: This partition features a quaint circular opening certain to invite the sort of guest who is keen on breakfast.

41106.name: korpokkur moss ball
41106.col_2: So lifelike is this ornamental moss ball, it looks as though it could up and walk off at any moment, miniature tree and all.

41107.name: sealing wax & letter set
41107.col_2: When one pens a missive upon stationery of this caliber, coherency is optional.

41108.name: bubbly mogfloat
41108.col_2: A tall glass of pom fizz topped with a heaping scoop of frosty ice cream.  <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

41109.name: royal leather sofa
41109.col_2: Lounge like royalty on this plush leather three-seater. Advisors and attendants not included.

41110.name: wall cabinet
41110.col_2: This towering feat of carpentry is replete with more tiny drawers than anyone could possibly need.

41111.name: field of hope rug
41111.col_2: Walk free, and bear the light for others to follow.

41112.name: sake barrel
41112.col_2: This barrel of sake is wrapped in a mat of woven rice straw. A specialty product of Hingashi.

41113.name: colossal chronometer window
41113.col_2: A looming reminder of the inexorable march of time.

41114.name: Hyper Hustle trophy
41114.col_2: A trophy that represents the power of teamwork, friendly competition, shared cuisine, hope, dreams, purpose...and batteries.

41115.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of the Allagan atrocities sealed within the Crystal Tower.
41115.col_3: Authentic Copy of A Realm Awoken

41124.description: authentic copies of <hex:021A020203>The Far Edge of Fate<hex:021A020103>
41124.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of five Scions who defended the Twelveswood from the threat of war.
41124.col_3: Authentic Copy of The Far Edge of Fate

41125.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty<hex:021A020103>
41125.description: authentic copies of <hex:021A020203>Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty<hex:021A020103>
41125.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of a self-styled “android” deep in the ruins of a forgotten factory.
41125.col_3: Authentic Copy of Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty

41126.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Echoes of a Fallen Star<hex:021A020103>
41126.description: authentic copies of <hex:021A020203>Echoes of a Fallen Star<hex:021A020103>
41126.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of two warriors, an emissary, and a most convincing illusion.
41126.col_3: Authentic Copy of Echoes of a Fallen Star

41127.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Reflections in Crystal<hex:021A020103>
41127.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of the Crystal Exarch and a vessel of hope for mankind.
41127.col_3: Authentic Copy of Reflections in Crystal

41128.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Futures Rewritten<hex:021A020103>
41128.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of two brave young women who together traversed myriad memories.

41129.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Death Unto Dawn<hex:021A020103>
41129.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of Eorzea's many great leaders, united to defend their homeland.
41129.col_3: Authentic Copy of Death Unto Dawn

41130.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Growing Light<hex:021A020103>
41130.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of a figure blazing her path towards hope.

41131.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Builder<hex:021A020103>
41131.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Byregot, god of architecture and industry.

41132.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Destroyer<hex:021A020103>
41132.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Rhalgr, god of destruction.

41133.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Warden<hex:021A020103>
41133.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Azeyma, keeper of the sun and goddess of inquiry.

41134.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Traders<hex:021A020103>
41134.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Nald'thal, overseer of the underworld and god of commerce.

41135.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Matron<hex:021A020103>
41135.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Nophica, tender of soils and harvests and goddess of abundance.

41136.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Keeper<hex:021A020103>
41136.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Althyk, surveyor of change and space and god of time.

41137.name: Il Mheg arbor
41137.col_2: The vibrant flowers of this elegant garden decoration put one in mind of the faeries' colorful homeland. Pixies thankfully not included.

41138.name: flight of mobile garden stairs
41138.col_2: The portability and convenience of this full flight of stairs ultimately render the age-old argument of “ladder versus stepladder” moot.

41139.name: flower-wreathed gazebo
41139.col_2: A charming and romantic pavilion for all those without allergies.

41140.name: Alzadaal's garden lamp
41140.col_2: An outdoor lighting fixture of the same ancient Hannish design encountered in the remnants above Alzadaal's Legacy.

41141.name: Elpis garden fountain
41141.col_2: A serene decoration fashioned after those thought to exist in ancient times.

41142.name: wildflower bed
41142.col_2: A vibrant patch of various wild-growing flora.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

41143.name: bluecap mushroom lamp
41143.col_2: A quaint fungal lamp that emits a pale blue glow.

41144.name: imitation magitek repair station (wall unit)
41144.col_2: Appearing as though it came straight from a Garlean castrum, one would be forgiven for attempting to maintain magitek armor with this repair station.<hex:02100103>* Not an actual repair station; cannot be used in the maintenance of magitek armor.

41145.name: Labyrinthos grape lamppost
41145.col_2: Seeking to make grapes more transportable, a researcher at Meryall Agronomics is rumored to have produced a variety that grew in blocky clusters. Although complaints that they looked unappetizing led to a new strain with rounder edges, the original was regarded fondly by some, and so it was immortalized in the form of this lamppost.

41146.name: Hingan rock garden
41146.col_2: Designed to resemble a Far Eastern landscape, this carefully studied arrangement of sand, stone, and flora seems to invite quiet contemplation.

41147.name: Sharlayan reflecting pool
41147.col_2: A shallow decorative pool constructed in accordance with Sharlayan sensibilities.

41149.name: authentic caged wisp
41149.col_2: This imprisoned orb of flickering blue flame is authentic by nature, and would therefore never lead anyone astray.

41150.name: authentic illuminated tree

41254.name: connoisseur's bamboo fence
41254.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Though the Far Eastern regions of the First were lost to the Flood, this priceless hedge carries on its legacy.

41255.name: connoisseur's rousing chronometer
41255.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Even the heaviest of sleepers will wake up to this chronometer's clarion call.

41256.name: connoisseur's trumpet
41256.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its melodious timbre will soothe the souls of all who hear it...unless the souls in question are standing directly in front of it.

41257.name: connoisseur's washbasin
41257.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. This immaculately sculpted basin dispenses only the finest artisanal water, presumably for washing the finest artisanal faces.

41258.name: connoisseur's targe
41258.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The patterns carved into it are so painstakingly detailed, it may be more suited to a gallery than a battlefield.

41259.name: connoisseur's petasos
41259.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Stitched with care, this hat was made with mages in mind.

41260.name: connoisseur's lunar curtain
41260.col_2: A reagent crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Though this powder can supposedly resist formidable magicks and repel otherworldly flares, it can also be imbibed to reduce bouts of morning drowsiness.

41261.name: serving of connoisseur's crab cakes
41261.col_2: A meal concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. Under the golden brown crust of this entrée lies a savory-yet-fluffy crab filling that could win over the pickiest of eaters.

41262.name: connoisseur's shishi-odoshi
41262.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Eulmoran elites would pay unthinkable sums of coin for this relic of lands long lost.

41263.name: connoisseur's retainer bell
41263.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Ringing the bell several times in a row may attract itinerant pixies.

41264.name: connoisseur's marching horn
41264.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The rich, baritone notes that echo from its bell must be heard to be believed.

41265.name: connoisseur's marble fountain
41265.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Why build a fountain from any old stone when it could be marble-ous instead?

41266.name: connoisseur's leather jacket
41266.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Despite its antique appearance, the leather is durable enough to withstand all manner of inclement weather.

41267.name: connoisseur's fat cat sofa
41267.col_2: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Few can resist its charmingly cozy cushioning.

41268.name: connoisseur's tincture of vitality
41268.col_2: A reagent crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Drinking this concoction allegedly promotes growth. Allegedly.

41269.name: serving of connoisseur's chili crab
41269.col_2: A meal concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. The tender crab flesh has been spiced to perfection, providing an intense heat while complementing the dish's milder flavors.

41298.name: deadwood shadow

41299.name: Ronkan bullion
41299.col_2: Due to its gilded scales and massive girth, this inhabitant of Mjrl's Tears is thought to be an ancient Ronkan treasure, transformed into a living creature.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41300.name: little Bounty
41300.col_2: The Crystal Exarch once remarked that this wavekin of Saint Fathric's Temple resembled the seas of his faraway homeland, and thus the name stuck.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41301.name: Saint Fathric's face
41301.col_2: This hulking creature's unnaturally sturdy head and stubborn nature won it the namesake of a famed Voeburtite saint.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41302.name: golding
41302.col_2: Often likened to a pile of sunken gold coins, this wavekin has sentenced no few greedy souls to a watery demise in Mjrl's Tears.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41401.name: Circuit tilapia
41401.col_2: A king among Labyrinthos tilapia, and lord of the waters of Deepmoat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41402.name: Durdina fish
41402.col_2: A king among Paksa fish, and lord of the waters of the Thavnairian coast.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41403.name: Mayaman
41403.col_2: A king among Thavnairian caimans, and lord of the waters of the Font of Maya.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41404.name: Chlorophos deathworm
41404.col_2: A king among lunar deathworms, and lord of the Chlorophospond.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

41405.name: starscale ephemeris
41405.col_2: A king among wandering starscales, and lord of the abode of the Ea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41406.name: E.B.E.-852738
41406.col_2: A king among E.B.E.s-9318, and lord of limne 3-β.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

41407.name: hyphalosaurus
41407.col_2: A slippery reptile that can steer its way through Deepmoat's currents with a swish of its sizable tail.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

41408.name: Gharlichthys
41408.col_2: This colossal inhabitant of the Perfumed Tides is thought to be one of the largest living fish on the star, growing nearly twenty fulms long. Those who miraculously haul one up from the depths should either be commended for their bravery or scolded for their folly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

41409.name: snowy Parexus
41409.col_2: Armored with spiny growths and aetheric crystal camouflage, this unique wavekin of the Eblan Thaw was primed and ready for survival against its natural predators, save for the avid angler.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

41410.name: Furcacauda
41410.col_2: Named for its forked tail, this elusive inhabitant of Lethe sports a remarkable bone structure rarely found among wavekin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

41411.name: Lopoceras elegans
41411.col_2: Despite the sharp and dangerously pointed nature of its shell, this docile resident of the Chlorophospond is recognized as an honorary Loporrit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

41412.name: sidereal whale
41412.col_2: Legend has it that this ethereal whale of limne 3-β was born from the yawning maw of a great dragon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

41413.name: prime kukuru bean
41413.col_2: This bean is born of a kukuru tree cultivated within Labyrinthos's precisely controlled climate. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

41414.name: sublime kukuru bean
41414.col_2: This wondrous kukuru bean has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

41415.name: phial of potent verdurous glioaether
41415.col_2: Rich green oil refined by aetherial reduction to an intensely concentrated state.

41416.name: prime fossilized dragon's scale
41416.col_2: This remnant of ancient draconic life was unearthed in Ultima Thule. Under the right conditions, it could become sublime.

41417.name: sublime fossilized dragon's scale
41417.col_2: This uncanny fossilized dragon's scale has gone from prime to sublime through a process you don't understand and aren't going to worry about. What's important is that it promises an impressive yield from aetherial reduction.

41418.name: phial of potent igneous glioaether
41418.col_2: Vibrant red oil refined by aetherial reduction to an intensely concentrated state.

41419.name: stargilt lobster
41419.col_2: Uniquely well suited to survival in Ultima Thule. Uniquely poorly suited to survival on a star where most races enjoy the taste of lobster and laying claim to shiny objects.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

41420.name: phial of potent aqueous glioaether
41420.col_2: Soothing blue oil refined by aetherial reduction to an intensely concentrated state.

41421.name: length of aetherial arbor lumber
41421.col_2: Fundamental material used in the construction of an aetherial arbor.

41422.name: set of aetherial arbor hardware
41422.col_2: Metal components used in the construction of an aetherial arbor.

41423.name: lump of aetherial arbor resin
41423.col_2: A versatile compound used in the construction of an aetherial arbor.

41424.name: aetherial arbor permit
41424.col_2: Written permission for the construction of a sanctuary landmark. Use to unlock the aetherial arbor.

41425.name: goobbue table chronometer
41425.col_2: Is it a potted plant, timepiece, or adorable replication of a giant lumbering beast? The answer is yes.

41426.name: cactuar dining table
41426.col_2: A communal surface ideal for breaking bread with your comrades and getting poked in the knee by spines.

41427.name: minute mindflayer sprinkler
41427.col_2: Rest assured that this inanimate baby monster will spray you with water instead of the blood of its enemies.

41428.name: Senor Sabotender chronometer
41428.col_2: The ruthless progression of time cannot be altered─but its cruel effects on one's countenance can be mollified somewhat by the charms of Senor Sabotender.

41429.name: imitation magitek repair station (floor unit)
41429.col_2: Appearing as though it came straight from a Garlean castrum, one would be forgiven for attempting to maintain magitek armor with this repair station.<hex:02100103>* Not an actual repair station; cannot be used in the maintenance of magitek armor.

41430.name: Aloalo pendant wall lamp
41430.col_2: The design of this wall-mounted light was inspired by similar relics discovered on Aloalo Island.

41431.name: forgotten figure
41431.col_2: A stunning replica of a statue once lost to the ages─but no longer.

41432.name: Aloalo faerie cushion
41432.col_2: A rude surprise awaits all those who dare plant their buttocks upon the image of Aloalo Island's most mischievous faerie.

41433.name: south seas coelacanth display
41433.col_2: Proudly boast of this beautiful fish to your closest friends, or whomever else will forgive you for forcing them to admire a hanging fish.

41434.name: sagely sparrow statue
41434.col_2: This replica of the avian figures enshrined on Aloalo Island is rather reminiscent of someone you know...

41435.name: Aloalo Island palm
41435.col_2: This tree was imported from the balmy climes of Aloalo Island to brighten your abode with tropical whimsy. Pay no heed to the leaves it drops in homesickness.

41436.name: Aloalo roselle hedge
41436.col_2: Beautiful blooms of the south sea isles curated into a garden-friendly shrubbery.

41437.name: Blunderville crown
41437.col_2: Heavy is the head─or the side table─that wears the crown.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to twenty may be placed in a single estate.

41438.name: Blunderville flag
41438.col_2: A colorful ornament that can add a hint of Blunderville charm to a room or residence.

41439.name: Blunderville donut bumper
41439.col_2: Any attempts to take a bite of this bumper may result in disaster. Or a very bad stomachache. Or both.

41440.name: Blunderville padded wall
41440.col_2: Perfect for those who often stub their toes on pointier partitions.

41441.name: Blunderville rainbow
41441.col_2: Because every room could use a rainbow.

41442.name: Blunderville hammer
41442.col_2: A pastel hammer modeled after those in Blunderville.

41455.name: Soul of the Pictomancer
41455.col_2: Upon the surface of this multi-aspected crystal are carved the myriad deeds of pictomancers from eras past.

41456.name: Soul of the Viper
41456.col_2: Upon the surface of this multi-aspected crystal are carved the myriad deeds of vipers from eras past.

41457.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Lop Hop<hex:021A020103>
41457.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Lop Hop<hex:021A020103>
41457.col_2: An illustrated manual of the various steps that comprise the Lop Hop, the Loporrits' irrepressibly jolly dance. Use to learn the /lophop emote.

41458.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Greasy Delights<hex:021A020103>
41458.col_2: An illustrated manual of the proper method for consuming a bucket of deep-fried chicken in polite company. Use to learn the /eatchicken emote.

41459.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Apocalyptic Charades<hex:021A020103>
41459.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing the steps required to produce a convincing facsimile of Hydaelyn's world-ending strike. Use to learn the /sundering emote.

41460.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Defeatist Attitude<hex:021A020103>
41460.col_2: An illustrated manual showing the exact angle at which to hang one's head to express a sentiment of utter defeat. Use to learn the /slump emote.

41461.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Projecting Affection<hex:021A020103>
41461.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to secure the adoration of all who behold you. Use to learn the /loveheart emote.

41462.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Humble Triumph<hex:021A020103>
41462.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to celebrate your victories without inciting the jealousy of rivals. Use to learn the /humbletriumph emote.

41463.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Embracing Blunders<hex:021A020103>
41463.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to thoroughly bask in triumph and demand the praise of one's social rivals. Use to learn the /victoryreveal emote.

41464.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Eggcellent Host<hex:021A020103>
41464.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - The Eggcellent Host<hex:021A020103>
41464.col_2: A detailed manual of how to graciously prepare breakfast for guests who overindulged in the wine. Use to learn the /fryegg emote.

41465.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - The Bold and the Braid<hex:021A020103>
41465.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - The Bold and the Braid<hex:021A020103>
41465.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for braiding unruly locks into line─while allowing others to flow free in defiance of expectation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.<hex:02100103>Unavailable to female Hrothgar.
41465.col_3: Modern Aesthetics - The Bold and the Braid

41466.name: pair of Statice's wings
41466.col_2: For those who have indulged their mischievous side and now long for something <hex:021A020203>stronger<hex:021A020103>. Use to acquire a pair of Statice's wings.

41467.name: giant leaf parasol
41467.col_2: This is a crafted <hex:021A020203>imitation<hex:021A020103> of plant life, not simply errant vegetation cleverly pruned for capitalistic purposes. Honest. Use to acquire a giant leaf parasol.

41468.name: colorful carrotsol
41468.col_2: Nine out of ten Loporrits agree─this parasol is without flaw. The tenth could not be reached for comment due to a carrot-induced stomachache. Use to acquire a colorful carrotsol.

41469.name: knapsack
41469.col_2: Research has proven that wearing a knapsack or similar greatly reduces the likelihood of being pestered with questions about how you can carry so many items. Use to acquire a knapsack.

41470.name: set of wayfarer's barding
41470.col_2: A suit of bespoke chocobo armor lovingly handcrafted by Tataru Taru.

41471.name: uolosapa
41471.col_2: To fly after you and perch prettily on your head is its divine calling.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the uolosapa minion.

41472.name: the Great White Tsuchinoko
41472.col_2: Delightfully squidgy, and a veritable fountain of good fortune to boot.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Great White Tsuchinoko minion.

41473.name: Tourmaline Weapon
41473.col_2: Stands ready to lend you a helping hand or six.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Tourmaline Weapon minion.

41474.name: wind-up Oschon
41474.col_2: Guaranteed not to wander off on you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Oschon minion.

41475.name: Kydonia Strolls
41475.col_2: For when you need a stony face to stare at you unflinchingly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Kydonia Strolls minion.

41476.name: vicarious vacationer
41476.col_2: A lean, mean, holidaying machine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the vicarious vacationer minion.

41477.name: wind-up Golbez
41477.col_2: Too small to conceive of and carry out a mass invasion of the Source...or is he?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Golbez minion.

41478.name: Torgal pup
41478.col_2: Go on, you know you want to pet the adorable fellow. What could possibly go wrong...?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Torgal pup minion.

41479.name: pink Bean
41479.col_2: Three, two, one...GO!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the pink Bean minion.

41480.name: Pegwin
41480.col_2: You chased after it; now it chases after you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Pegwin minion.

41481.name: Hydaelyn idol
41481.col_2: When you ask your mother if you can have Hydaelyn, but she says you already have Hydaelyn at home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Hydaelyn idol minion.

41482.name: Zodiark idol
41482.col_2: When you ask your mother if you can have Zodiark, but she says you already have Zodiark at home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Zodiark idol minion.

41483.name: wind-up Fourchenault
41483.col_2: Don't even think about dragging it into conflict, or it shall give you a look of sternest disapproval.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Fourchenault minion.

41484.name: wind-up Zidane
41484.col_2: Despite appearances, he isn't one for monkeying around.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Zidane minion.

41485.name: wind-up Garnet
41485.col_2: She's not alone─she's following you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Garnet minion.

41486.name: repulu
41486.col_2: Comes complete with a fetching bow tie to prevent misplacement.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the repulu minion.

41487.name: Torgal whistle
41487.col_2: This horn-carved instrument emits a steadfast tone that calls the trusty Torgal to your side.

41488.name: Ark identification key
41488.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near the Ark will magically bring the advanced transforming machine to life.

41489.name: apocryphal Bahamut horn
41489.col_2: When blown, this horn of bone emits an unbridled tone that calls your apocryphal Bahamut to your side.

41490.name: crescent moon
41490.col_2: With this dreamy magicked gondola, there is finally a moon that one can ask for─<hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> sit on.

41491.name: Rhiyes identification key
41491.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your Rhiyes will magically bring the machine to life.

41492.name: oppressor identification key
41492.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near the oppressor will magically bring the luxuriously appointed warmachina to life.

41493.name: lynx of abyssal grief flute
41493.col_2: Emitting a tone of irrepressible longing, this flute summons a lynx of abyssal grief to your side.

41494.name: sabotender de la luna whistle
41494.col_2: When blown, this flute emits an adventurous sound that summons forth your sabotender de la luna.

41495.name: spectral Statice whistle
41495.col_2: This whistle emits a playful tone that brings spectral Statice fluttering to your side.

41496.name: Garlond GL-IIT ignition key
41496.col_2: A thin key that ignites your Garlond GL-IIT's ceruleum engine, bringing the tiller-equipped vehicle rumbling to life.

41497.name: Peatie horn
41497.col_2: A curved horn that, when blown, emits a flowery tone that brings Peatie, the goobbue maiden, lumbering to your side.

41498.name: Alsvid whistle
41498.col_2: This ornate whistle produces a veritable rainbow of sounds that brings the steed Alsvid galloping to your side.

41499.name: quaqua horn
41499.col_2: When blown, this horn produces a woody sound that summons forth your quaqua.

41500.name: magicked prism (uolosapa)
41500.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Casts a cloud of chittering island birds around the user.

41501.name: islecracker
41501.col_2: An otherworldly item of celebration that unleashes a blast of streamers, confetti, and magicked projections of your island mammets.

41502.name: magicked prism (doll head)
41502.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Envelops the user's head with the visage of an adorable, terrible doll.

41523.col_2: A banded chest containing a full set of fierce tyrant's attire.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Required level: 1. IL: 1. Cannot be opened in instanced areas such as dungeons, PvP areas, or raids.
