41630.name: handful of island durium sand
41630.col_2: A jolly jade-colored sand found in the Cieldalaes.

41631.name: chunk of island yellow copper ore
41631.description: chunks of island yellow copper ore
41631.col_2: What if copper was yellow? Yellow copper, that's what.

41632.name: chunk of island gold ore
41632.col_2: The Cieldalaes are rife with golden opportunities...and literal gold.

41633.name: handful of island hawk's eye sand
41633.description: handfuls of island hawk's eye sand
41633.col_2: Some experts claim that the only way to obtain this sand is by alchemical processes. It is plain, then, that those experts have never been to the Cieldalaes.

41634.name: island crystal formation
41634.col_2: This naturally occurring crystal from the Cieldalaes contains trace amounts of corrupted aether.

41635.name: island watermelon
41635.col_2: Can be sliced, diced, or crushed with one's limbs for sport.

41636.name: island sweet popoto
41636.col_2: It is not known who first referred to this tuber as “nature's candy,” but whoever did was correct in doing so.

41637.name: island broccoli
41637.col_2: The littlest tree. Or the most tree-like vegetable.

41638.name: handful of island buffalo beans
41638.col_2: To bean, or not to bean... That is the question.

41639.name: bag of island watermelon seeds
41639.col_2: These tiny seeds will grow into refreshing summer treats.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

41640.name: island sweet popoto set
41640.col_2: Ideal for pie. Just not yet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

41641.name: bag of island broccoli seeds
41641.col_2: These seeds will grow to be beloved by clever younglings and despised by the unenlightened.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

41642.name: bag of island buffalo bean seeds
41642.description: bags of island buffalo bean seeds
41642.col_2: These beans grow buffalos. No really. They will.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Growth Period: Two days]

41643.name: flawless net
41643.col_2: An elite net that redefines the meaning of capture. Run...if you dare.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Guaranteed to catch small animals.]

41644.name: flawless restraint
41644.col_2: The creatures roaming your island have never known restraint until now.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Guaranteed to catch average-sized animals.]

41645.name: flawless soporific
41645.col_2: A pellet that will convince even the largest and most monstrous of creatures to close their eyes and accept their fate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Guaranteed to catch large animals.]

41646.name: islekeep's mythril pickaxe
41646.col_2: This shiny pickaxe will realize your dreams, if your dreams are to gain new materials with shiny pickaxes.

41647.name: islekeep's chisel
41647.col_2: This shiny chisel will chip away at substances heretofore unchippable. Please do not use on mammets.

41648.name: set of splendiferous mammet-sized spelunking tools
41648.description: sets of splendiferous mammet-sized spelunking tools

41649.name: island Peerifool whistle
41649.col_2: This whistle emits a flighty tone that calls your island Peerifool to bear you forth like the most foolish of steeds.

41650.name: island adenium whistle
41650.col_2: This whistle emits a florid tone that calls your island adenium to bear you forth like the floweriest of steeds.

41651.name: Alzadaal's treasure rug
41651.col_2: This beautiful replication of the cloth draped across the bounties of Alzadaal's Legacy will remind you of all the coin you yet stand to gain.

41652.name: lump of deep-sea umbrite
41652.col_2: An uncommon variety of umbrite gathered from the darkest depths of the ocean.

41653.name: bolt of athletikos cloth
41653.col_2: Supple fabric with give enough to accommodate a wide range of vigorous movement.

41654.description: faded copies of <hex:021A020203>FINAL FANTASY IV: The Final Battle (Endwalker)<hex:021A020103>
41654.col_2: Timeworn pages of sheet music containing the full score for <hex:021A020203>FINAL FANTASY IV: The Final Battle (Endwalker)<hex:021A020103>.
41654.col_3: Faded Copy of FINAL FANTASY IV: The Final Battle (Endwalker)

41669.name: bowl of isleworks fruit punch
41669.col_2: An assortment of fresh fruits blended together to delicious effect.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Confections<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

41670.name: serving of isleworks sweet popoto pie
41670.description: servings of isleworks sweet popoto pie
41670.col_2: The sweet variant of popotoes made even sweeter and delectable as an oven-baked pie. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Confections/Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

41671.name: serving of isleworks peperoncino
41671.col_2: Sauteed island broccoli joins freshly prepared peperoncino to make for a delightfully savory dish.  <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

41672.name: serving of isleworks buffalo bean salad
41672.description: servings of isleworks buffalo bean salad
41672.col_2: A salad not so much delicious as it is nutritious.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Foodstuffs/Creature Creations<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

41673.col_2: A pair of durium tathlums forged in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Arms/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 6 hours

41674.col_2: A fancy dish for fancy people, fashioned in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Sundries/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 4 hours

41675.col_2: A glamorous hairpin forged from gold ore in the sanctuary workshop.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Category: Accessories/Metalworks<hex:02100103>Required Time: 8 hours

41801.col_2: Dehydrated adventurers, rejoice─this crisp, bubbly beverage boasts an invigorating citrus kick that will thoroughly quench one's thirst on the road. Guaranteed to make even the most arduous trials feel like a tropical vacation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4%  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

41803.name: Ttokrrone scale
41803.col_2: A thick, hardy scale that once belonged to Ttokrrone, the serpentine tural vidraal.

41804.name: Mica magicog
41804.col_2: A gear torn from the mechanical heart of Mica the Magical Mu.

41805.name: twilight gemstone
41805.col_2: A highly sought-after gem whose gentle gradation bears a striking resemblance to an early evening sky.

41806.name: length of high-density fiberboard
41806.col_2: Countless wood fibers are bound together and highly compressed to create this manufactured board.

41807.name: mount token
41807.col_2: A pile of these certificates can be traded to certain splendors vendors for impressive tamed beasts.

41810.name: set of country cottage walls
41810.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to give their estate a quaint, rural look.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with cottages on small plots of land.

41811.name: set of country house walls
41811.col_2: A set of four walls designed for those who wish to give their estate a quaint, rural look.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Can only be used with houses on medium plots of land.

41815.name: Resilient sword stand
41815.col_2: Twin blades that tell a story of ambition, domination, and loss.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

41816.name: kitchen cabinet
41816.col_2: This wooden cabinet has a near-infinite capacity for storing utensils and knickknacks. Makes an excellent partition due to its imposing size and sturdy construction.

41817.name: slovenly chair
41817.col_2: Now cluttered with an ever-present collection of household odds and ends, this chair's transformation from seat to shelf was a gradual affair.

41818.name: stuffed axolotl eft
41818.col_2: Although equally endearing, this stuffed ornament is considerably less slimy than its live counterpart.

41819.name: stuffed Flag
41819.col_2: Modeled after a certain reindeer calf, this plush toy thankfully lacks the real Flag's prodigious appetite.

41820.name: fluffy-wuffy stuffed Drippy
41820.col_2: Crafted to resemble a splishy-wishy young nixie, and infused with levitation magicks, this whimsical plushie floats like a balloon.

41821.name: stuffed punutiy
41821.col_2: A cuddly punutiy lovingly rendered in fluffy fabric.

41822.name: decorative Hingan door
41822.col_2: A window crafted to resemble a Hingan-style sliding door.

41823.name: sunset phasmascape
41823.col_2: An imitation skylight with illusory properties. Gaze upwards to appreciate this portal to a striking crimson sky.

41824.name: Goblet phasmascape
41824.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays a breathtaking view of the Goblet in all its splendor.

41825.name: Lavender Beds phasmascape
41825.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays a picturesque cluster of hillside houses at the Lavender Beds.

41826.name: Mist phasmascape
41826.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the community of Mist and the stunning stretch of coastline it sits atop.

41827.name: Shirogane phasmascape
41827.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the vibrant rooves and tree-topped outcrops of Shirogane.

41828.name: Empyreum phasmascape
41828.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the ornate, pointed spires that punctuate the Empyreum skyline.

41829.name: twintop table

43539.name: Skyruin totem
43539.col_2: A small idol of Valigarmanda that emanates aether of varying elements.

43540.name: Resilient totem
43540.col_2: A small idol of Zoraal Ja, forged primarily with electrope.

43541.name: light-heavy holohelm
43541.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic helmet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two helms can be traded for special headgear.

43542.name: suit of light-heavy holoarmor
43542.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic suit of armor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four suits can be traded for special body gear.

43543.name: pair of light-heavy hologauntlets
43543.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic pair of gauntlets.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special arm gear.

43544.name: pair of light-heavy holochausses
43544.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic pair of chausses.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Four pairs can be traded for special leg gear.

43545.name: pair of light-heavy hologreaves
43545.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic pair of greaves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Two pairs can be traded for special foot gear.

43546.name: light-heavy holoearring
43546.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic earring.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>One earring can be traded for a special accessory.

43547.name: light-heavy holoblade
43547.col_2: When activated, this electrope-powered device from the Arcadion projects a holographic blade.

43548.name: universal tomestone
43548.col_2: Researchers of a long-gone age supposedly constructed this peculiar variety of tomestone with a focus on versatility. When said versatility resulted in limited data storage and transfer capacity, however, they abandoned all hope─and these tomestones with it.

43553.name: pot of surgelight solvent
43553.col_2: A fulminous chemical mixture synthesized with advanced Everkeep technology. Applying it to Quetzalli weapons enables full optimization of the gear's offensive properties.

43554.name: spool of surgelight twine
43554.col_2: A fulminous thread synthesized with advanced Everkeep technology. Applying it to Quetzalli vestments enables full optimization of the gear's defensive properties.

43555.name: flask of surgelight glaze
43555.col_2: A fulminous coating agent synthesized with advanced Everkeep technology. Applying it to Quetzalli accessories enables full optimization of the gear's defensive properties.

43556.name: timeworn loboskin map
43556.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 16 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 100 recommended.

43557.name: timeworn br'aaxskin map
43557.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 17 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 100 full party (eight players) recommended.

43558.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Spinner<hex:021A020103>
43558.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Nymeia, watcher of celestial bodies and goddess of fate.

43559.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Fury<hex:021A020103>
43559.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Halone, mover of glaciers and goddess of war.

43560.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Lover<hex:021A020103>
43560.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Menphina, keeper of the twin moons and the goddess of love.

43561.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Scholar<hex:021A020103>
43561.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Thaliak, ruler of rivers and wisdom and god of knowledge.

43562.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Navigator<hex:021A020103>
43562.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Llymlaen, watcher of the seas and goddess of navigation.

43563.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>The Wanderer<hex:021A020103>
43563.col_2: A heavenly portrait of Oschon, ruler of the mountains and god of wanderers and vagrants.

43564.name: company seal voucher
43564.col_2: This voucher jointly issued by the Grand Companies of Eorzea is redeemable for 10,000 company seals.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to acquire the stated amount of company seals for the Grand Company you are enlisted in.

43565.name: Volcanic Heart framer's kit
43565.col_2: Tools for enhancing a portrait. Use to unlock embellishments fit for a champion of the Volcanic Heart.<hex:02100103>[Includes: Background/Frame/Accent]

43566.name: Clockwork Castletown framer's kit
43566.col_2: Tools for enhancing a portrait. Use to unlock embellishments fit for a champion of the Clockwork Castletown.<hex:02100103>[Includes: Background/Frame/Accent]

43569.name: petit punutiy
43569.col_2: Leading scientists agree: gazing upon a punutiy daily enhances one's sense of well-being.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the petit punutiy minion.

43570.name: air-wheeler M9
43570.col_2: Will whoosh, vroom, and zoom its way into your inner child's heart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the air-wheeler M9 minion.

43571.name: alpaca cria
43571.col_2: Rest assured its spit isn't smelly. Yet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the alpaca cria minion.

43572.name: honeysuckler
43572.col_2: Doesn't have a taste for blood...yet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the honeysuckler minion.

43573.name: not-so-bighorn
43573.col_2: The bigger the horns, the brighter the future.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the not-so-bighorn minion.

43574.name: Ilyikty'i
43574.col_2: A little cub that has aspirations to be a great hunter.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Ilyikty'i minion.

43575.name: quetzal
43575.col_2: Do not be fooled by its winsome appearance─you are in the presence of <hex:021A020203>divinity<hex:021A020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the quetzal minion.

43576.name: Squeak the Coyote
43576.col_2: Quiet as a cloud and swift as a lightning bolt when on the prowl.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Squeak the Coyote minion.

43577.name: Rororrlo Teh
43577.col_2: Caution: staring directly at its head may result in temporary blindness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Rororrlo Teh minion.

43578.name: the Cornservant
43578.col_2: Will never let you go hungry.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Cornservant minion.

43579.name: tankardtender
43579.col_2: Rather more manageable than a barrel.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tankardtender minion.

43580.name: bluecoat cat
43580.col_2: Surprisingly sweet-tempered despite its regal bearing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the bluecoat cat minion.

43581.name: speaking stone
43581.col_2: Don't even think about getting it started.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the speaking stone minion.

43582.name: wind-up Mamool Ja
43582.col_2: Innocence never looked so adorable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Mamool Ja minion.

43583.name: mischief maker
43583.col_2: Should only make mischief and not do you one, if the name is to be believed...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mischief maker minion.

43584.name: tin sentry T1
43584.col_2: It's your own fault if you get hit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tin sentry T1 minion.

43585.name: Ambrose the Unfinished
43585.col_2: Unfinished it may be, but it is certainly not unwilling.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Ambrose the Unfinished minion.

43586.name: Black Kitten
43586.col_2: Can you hold your own against her feline ferocity!?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Black Kitten minion.

43587.name: brushed-up Krile
43587.col_2: She is not to be brushed off in the face of danger.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the brushed-up Krile minion.

43588.name: wind-up Zero
43588.col_2: And thus she is returned.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Zero minion.

43589.name: wind-up Erenville
43589.col_2: Happy to follow rather than guide you for a change.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Erenville minion.

43590.name: ty'aitya whistle
43590.col_2: This whistle emits a sprightly tone that brings your ty'aitya gliding to your side.

43591.name: air-wheeler A9 identification key
43591.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be electrope. Placing it near your air-wheeler A9 will magically bring the vehicle to life.

43592.name: alpaca whistle
43592.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a snug and steady tone that calls your alpaca to your side.

43593.name: pair of wings of ruin
43593.col_2: Manifest your wings of ruin and soar the skies with an aura of irrepressible might.

43594.name: pair of wings of resolve
43594.col_2: Manifest your wings of resolve and soar the skies with an aura of undying pride.

43595.name: outrunner identification key
43595.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be electrope. Placing it near your outrunner will magically bring the machine to life.

43596.name: mehwapyarra whistle
43596.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a laid-back tone that calls your mehwapyarra to your side.

43597.name: monowheel S1 identification key
43597.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be electrope. Placing it near your monowheel S1 will magically bring the vehicle to life.

43598.name: rroneek horn
43598.col_2: A curved horn that, when blown, emits a stout tone that summons forth your rroneek.

43599.name: Ullr horn
43599.col_2: This heavy horn emits a dulcet tone that summons Ullr, the dragon with a love of song.

43600.name: qeziigural horn
43600.col_2: A curved horn that, when blown, emits an implacable sound that summons forth your qeziigural.

43601.name: set of Turali barding
43601.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed for travel across a vast continent.

43602.name: set of Skyruin barding
43602.col_2: Rest assured that equipping your chocobo with this suit of armor will not <hex:021A020203>actually<hex:021A020103> transform it into a vicious tural vidraal.

43603.name: set of electrope barding
43603.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor created by means of otherworldly technology.

43604.name: set of wild ride barding
43604.col_2: A bright suit of chocobo armor for the adventurous and fashionable.

43605.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Easterly Winds<hex:021A020103>
43605.col_2: An illustrated manual depicting the most efficient Far Eastern fanning methods to stave off sweltering summer heat. Use to obtain the /uchiwasshoi emote.

43606.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - It Takes Two<hex:021A020103>
43606.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - It Takes Two<hex:021A020103>
43606.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for shaping shorter locks into two feathery, distinct parts that softly frame one's visage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

43607.name: Urqopacha riding map
43607.col_2: This highly detailed map of Urqopacha, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by Pelupelu merchants seeking to reduce delivery times.

43608.name: Kozama'uka riding map
43608.col_2: This highly detailed map of Kozama'uka, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by Pelupelu merchants seeking to reduce delivery times.

43609.name: Yak T'el riding map
43609.col_2: This highly detailed map of Yak T'el, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by the Yok Huy during their campaign of conquest.

43610.name: Shaaloani riding map
43610.col_2: This highly detailed map of Shaaloani, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by the Yok Huy during their campaign of conquest.

43611.name: Heritage Found riding map
43611.col_2: This highly detailed map of Heritage Found, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by local couriers seeking to reduce delivery times.

43612.name: Living Memory riding map
43612.col_2: This highly detailed map of Living Memory, including everything from land elevation to the location of exposed rocks and roots, was originally drafted by tour guides to prevent visitors from losing their way.

43631.name: pair of augmented lunar envoy's saberfangs
43631.description: pairs of augmented lunar envoy's saberfangs

43664.name: mosquito fish
43664.col_2: This inhabitant of Downripple was once utilized as a means of natural pest control.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43665.name: pel frog
43665.col_2: Prized by the Pelupelu, these tiny frogs are often seen traversing the shallow waters of Downripple.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43666.name: petticoat tetra
43666.col_2: Native to Downripple, this freshwater fish is readily identified by its black skirt-like fins. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43667.name: reasonscale silverside
43667.col_2: After being introduced to the Stardust Sea, this striking silver fish soon began to thrive.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43668.name: stardust shrimp
43668.col_2: This toothsome resident of the Stardust Sea often features in Tuliyollan cuisine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43669.name: shallows sot
43669.col_2: This saltwater fish can be found lurking in the shallows beneath the For'ard Cabins, where it tries to avoid the attention of predators and inquisitive anglers besides.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43670.name: ghostfish
43670.col_2: Calling the shallow waters of the For'ard Cabins home, this wavekin appears all but translucent.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43671.name: permit
43671.col_2: This large saltwater fish roams the waters near the For'ard Cabins, where it enjoys a diet of crustaceans and smaller, slower sea creatures.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43672.name: floating fife
43672.col_2: Though its name may imply otherwise, attempting to play lovely little ditties with this wavekin is ill-advised.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43673.name: blue purse
43673.col_2: The dark body of this saltwater fish contrasts with the golden yellow margins of its fine scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43674.name: goldfin cavalli
43674.col_2: This domineering wavekin possesses powerful, gold-tinged fins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43675.name: sea alpaca
43675.col_2: A peculiar wavekin that faintly resembles an alpaca. Thankfully, it does not share its landbound counterpart's penchant for spitting.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43676.name: marbled hatchetfish
43676.col_2: According to Yok Huy myth, this wavekin was once a mighty warrior's axe, transformed by its wielder's grief.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43677.name: starsnipper
43677.col_2: Found among the rocky shallows of the Sunken Stars, this miniscule crustacean partially burrows into the gritty substrate to evade predators. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43678.name: urqotrout
43678.col_2: The flesh of this trout species is naturally salty.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43679.name: Yok Huy stonecutter
43679.col_2: This flatfish calls the still pool of the Sunken Stars its home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43680.name: Chirwagur loach
43680.col_2: An elongated wavekin capable of thriving in the briny waters of Chirwagur Lake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43681.name: alright alright alright
43681.col_2: Cautionary tales passed down among the Pelupelu suggest that upon learning of this creature's status as an apex predator, an itinerant Eorzean naturalist issued the confusing statement that it “certainly has the milquetoast countenance of a champion,” and began muttering a slew of potential appellations. Some of these sounded like “dirklander” or possibly “burpswimmer,” and so, in an attempt to save the poor fish's reputation abroad, the local Pelupelu kindly informed him of its indigenous name ere setting off in search of a stiff drink.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43682.name: Zorlortor
43682.col_2: An endearing amphibian with pale silver coloration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43683.name: shooting starscale
43683.col_2: This moderately sized fish can be found plying the waters of Chirwagur Lake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43684.name: first feastfish
43684.col_2: A vaguely egg-shaped freshwater fish found in the depths of Karvarhur the First.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43685.name: urqofrog
43685.col_2: This bulbous amphibian inhabits the ample waters of Karvarhur the First.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43686.name: Zeh Tortoh
43686.col_2: Often likened to flower petals, these resplendent fish are sought after by aesthetically minded anglers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43687.name: morsel trout
43687.col_2: This fair-sized freshwater fish is a popular source of sustenance in Urqopacha.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43688.name: deepwarden
43688.col_2: An ancient wavekin that lurks in depths unfathomable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43689.name: Kozama'uka skipper
43689.col_2: A small freshwater fish distributed throughout the shallows of Kozama'uka.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43690.name: bopo'u sleeper
43690.col_2: This sizable wavekin is primarily found in the wetlands of Bopo'uihih.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43691.name: poison dyefrog
43691.col_2: A colorful frog endowed with deadly toxins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43692.name: pleated matamata
43692.col_2: Replete with thorny protusions, the triangular heads of these turtles call to mind fallen leaves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43693.name: uyuy xage
43693.col_2: As lethal as it is large, this monstrous scalekin calls the shallows of Bopo'uihih home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43694.name: plattershell
43694.col_2: Beneath this mottled crustacean's shell lies a hearty helping of delicious meat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43695.name: candiru
43695.col_2: The waters of Miyakabek'zu are rife with these fierce, carnivorous wavekin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43696.name: trahira
43696.col_2: A somewhat sizable fish that plies the muddy currents of Miyakabek'zu.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43697.name: driftwood catfish
43697.col_2: This species' resemblance to waterborne wooden debris gives it the edge when pursuing its prey.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43698.name: oho hunu
43698.col_2: This diminutive wavekin is known as one of the swiftest swimmers in Ihuykatumu.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43699.name: bronze pleco
43699.col_2: A rather timid freshwater fish that prefers to lurk among rocks and submerged timber.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43700.name: crenicichla
43700.col_2: Found in the fast-flowing waters that cut through the Dewspun Bank, this wavekin is adorned with finely patterned scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43701.name: hunu peacock bass
43701.col_2: This member of the peacock bass family is readily identified by its fiery lateral markings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43702.name: Pelubane
43702.col_2: With its razor-sharp teeth and insatiable hunger, this vicious wavekin is as much a threat on land as it is at sea. <hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43703.name: giant trahira
43703.col_2: Native to the waters of Ihuykatumu, this predatory freshwater fish can grow to an impressive size.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43704.name: Ku'uxage bitterling
43704.col_2: This variety of bitterling has a habit of leaping through the waterfalls of Ku'uxage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43705.name: tonguesnatcher
43705.col_2: An ancient crustacean equipped with impressively sharp pincers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43706.name: corn dace
43706.col_2: A fair-sized freshwater fish said to resemble an ear of the finest Turali corn.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43707.name: ka puyhu
43707.col_2: A multitude of colors adorn the scales of this aesthetically pleasing wavekin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43708.name: Ligaka guppy
43708.col_2: Commonly found in Marsh Ligaka, this species of freshwater fish is known for its striking hue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43709.name: dumplingfish
43709.col_2: Easily identified by its outsized dorsal fin, this wavekin of Marsh Ligaka is a staple food among the Hanuhanu.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43710.name: banded candiru
43710.col_2: A deceptive wavekin that utilizes its striking scales to deter predators.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43711.name: oxydoras
43711.col_2: If it looks like a bludgeon in the water, and floats like a bludgeon in the water...it may not be a bludgeon in the water. It might be this catfish instead.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43712.name: spotted stingray
43712.col_2: This ray of Marsh Ligaka is covered with a perplexing pattern, ideal for repelling potential predators.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43713.name: yellow peacock bass
43713.col_2: The banded markings of this moderately large wavekin set it apart from other varieties of peacock bass.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43714.name: shovelnose catfish
43714.col_2: This catfish's tapered snout lends it a lithe, sleek appearance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43715.name: shimmering shadow
43715.col_2: A small freshwater fish whose scales are capable of producing optical illusions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43716.name: Ut'ohmu dawnfish
43716.col_2: The scales of this wavekin appear as if dappled with the soft light of dawn.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43717.name: belonesox
43717.col_2: This brownish wavekin is a relative of the killifish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43718.name: Xd'aa Talat cichlid
43718.col_2: A charming freshwater fish that inhabits the still depths of Xd'aa Talat Tsoly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43719.name: Iq Br'aax sailfin
43719.col_2: An elegant freshwater fish of the Iq Br'aax reservoir that sports a splendid, flowing dorsal fin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43720.name: hunmu ob
43720.col_2: This boldly striped wavekin calls the waters of the Iq Br'aax reservoir home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43721.name: apoda
43721.col_2: An elongated amphibian often likened to a legless newt.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43722.name: mirror carp
43722.col_2: The scales of this gentle giant glint with a reflective sheen.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43723.name: tsoly mu
43723.col_2: A round red freshwater fish known to inhabit the emerald waters of Iq Rrax Tsoly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43724.name: Iq Rrax leaffish
43724.col_2: Able to disguise itself as a dead leaf, this wavekin plies the cenote in search of prey.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43725.name: archmatron angelfish
43725.col_2: This majestic freshwater fish is commonly found in the still waters of Iq Rrax Tsoly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43726.name: Yak T'el salamander
43726.col_2: Native to Iq Rrax Tsoly, this large amphibian is at home in the murkier depths of the cenote.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43727.name: shadowtongue
43727.col_2: When caught in the light, the scales of this ancient wavekin glint with a dark luster.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43728.name: cloud-eye carp
43728.col_2: Only recently discovered, the traits of this peculiar freshwater fish are yet to be thoroughly studied.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43729.name: Xobr'it lobster
43729.col_2: This pale-shelled crustacean supposedly gained its coloration from the Xobr'it Cinderfield's excess ash.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43730.name: sunbright axolotl
43730.col_2: A frilled golden amphibian that calls the deep waters of Xobr'it Tsoly home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43731.name: horned frog
43731.col_2: The appendages that protude above its eyes earned this frog its rather unimaginative appellation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43732.name: mudfish
43732.col_2: A small freshwater fish that dwells in lakes and ponds around the Ja Tiika Heartland.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43733.name: Turali beaded lizard
43733.col_2: Easily identified by the round, bumpy scales that inspired its name, this venomous amphibian can be spotted in every corner of Tural.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43734.name: Yak T'el catfish
43734.col_2: This widely adored wavekin can be found all across the lowlands of Yak T'el.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43735.name: Ankledeep catfish
43735.col_2: A gregarious catfish that prowls the shallow waters of Ankledeep, feeding on worms and algae.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43736.name: checkered cichlid
43736.col_2: This small, shy fish is named for the rows of square dark spots on its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43737.name: Moxutural gar
43737.col_2: Native to Cenote Moxutural, this wavekin's scales are hard enough to serve as arrowheads.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43738.name: variatus
43738.col_2: A colorful freshwater fish prized for its striking red and yellow scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43739.name: welkin catfish
43739.col_2: This catfish is often likened to the night sky due to the smattering of white splotches on its dark scales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43740.name: flawless saucer
43740.col_2: With a body so round and flat, one might mistake this stingray for tableware.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43741.name: glittergill
43741.col_2: Renowned for its ethereal shine, this small freshwater fish calls the Sapsweet Cenote home.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43742.name: twig catfish
43742.col_2: This long, bony catfish is commonly found nibbling on algae and other plants.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43743.name: blind brotula
43743.col_2: As the name suggests, this small, scaleless fish is utterly sightless as well.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43744.name: Yak T'el caiman
43744.col_2: This large reptile prowls Bitterbark Cenote in search of its next meal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43745.name: Ut'ohmu tiika
43745.col_2: Like a tiny tree, this saltwater fish sports a multitude of green, leaf-like fins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43746.name: sharknose goby
43746.col_2: Some speculate that this small saltwater fish may have migrated to the cenote from the sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43747.name: Yak T'el crab
43747.col_2: A blue-shelled crab that inhabits the deep, dark waters of Xty'iinbek Tsoly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43748.name: Xty'iinbek sleeper
43748.col_2: Named for its unusual habit of migrating all the way from the sea to hibernate at the bottom of this specific caldera.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43749.name: chain shark
43749.col_2: Found in Xty'iinbek Tsoly, this species of shark is identified by the distinctive chain-link patterns on its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43750.name: bonytail chub
43750.col_2: A small, elusive freshwater fish that lurks in the waters of Niikwerepi.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43751.name: Niikwerepi trout
43751.col_2: A nomadic variety of trout known to migrate up and down the river for which it is named.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43752.name: Pyariyoanaan cichlid
43752.col_2: This particular species of cichlid has never been documented outside of the Pyariyoanaan Plain.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43753.name: Shaaloani salmon
43753.col_2: Each year, this species of salmon travels upstream across the region of Shaaloani to spawn, hence its name.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43754.name: trailtrout
43754.col_2: Coveted for its fatty flesh, this type of trout dwells in the depths of Lake Toari.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43755.name: Toari sucker
43755.col_2: Native to Lake Toari, this large freshwater fish boasts a prominent triangular dorsal fin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43756.name: Turali paddlefish
43756.col_2: A variety of sturgeon prized by the locals for its delicious roe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43757.name: Zorgor core
43757.col_2: A mysterious spherical organism sometimes found floating near the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43758.name: cloudribbon
43758.col_2: This long and slender cloudfish inhabits the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43759.name: Zorgor scorpion
43759.col_2: A type of carnivorous flying shrimp native to the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43760.name: vagrant cascade
43760.col_2: This cone-shaped tunicate colony dwells within the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43761.name: Zorgor condor
43761.col_2: A large scavenger bird often seen gliding among the clouds of mist that rise from the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43762.name: cloud wasp
43762.col_2: This variety of cloudfish flaps its tiny wings to navigate the clouds of mist over the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43763.name: azure glider
43763.col_2: A species of flying squid that inhabits the waterfalls of Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43764.name: hellsnow shark
43764.col_2: Those who lay eyes upon this Turali tornado shark tend to utter obscenities in fear of it─which may well be how it obtained its modern moniker.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43765.name: Heritage loach
43765.col_2: Located in Heritage Found, this highly adaptive species has survived countless catastrophes over the years.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43766.name: outskirts sniffer
43766.col_2: Although peculiar in appearance, this wavekin is as hardy and tenacious as the people of the outskirts themselves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43767.name: pumpkin perch
43767.col_2: Found in the outskirts shallows, this freshwater fish has a remarkably high reproductive rate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43768.name: tiger muskellunge
43768.col_2: A tough hybrid species that is unable to propagate itself, despite its advantageous traits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43769.name: moon croppie
43769.col_2: A popular food source, this driftdowns native is known for its tender white flesh.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43770.name: driftdowns trout
43770.col_2: This blighted wavekin ekes out an existence in the depths of the driftdowns, where it hunts for prey in the polluted substrate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43771.name: electrobetta
43771.col_2: This betta's shocking purple glow is caused by an abundance of electrope in the environment.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43772.name: thundering redbelly
43772.col_2: The flashes of red adorning this diminutive wavekin's belly bring to mind raging thunderstorms─according to the scholar that named this species, at the very least.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43773.name: Yyasulani bowfin
43773.col_2: This dusty brown specimen blends in effortlessly with its surroundings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43774.name: crackling flounder
43774.col_2: This flat wavekin can be found in the depths of the crackling canyons, although seeking it out in such treacherous conditions is ill-advised.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43775.name: goldgrouper
43775.col_2: Native to Heritage Found, this golden freshwater fish owes its metallic sheen to the lightning energy that infuses the area.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43776.name: Everkeep yabby
43776.col_2: The waterways of Everkeep abound with these delectable crustaceans.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43777.name: stickleback
43777.col_2: This moderately sized wavekin is easily identified by its prickly spines.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43778.name: custodian carp
43778.col_2: Often seen in the ponds of Solution Nine's residential sector, this omnivorous freshwater fish was initially released as a means of pest control.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43779.name: Mosaic loach
43779.col_2: The baristas of Mosaic are said to be rather fond of this mottled wavekin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43780.name: rosebud frog
43780.col_2: Legend has it that this ruby red frog was born from a delicate rosebud.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43781.name: knight goby
43781.col_2: This fish is named after Alexandria's proud, armor-clad knights of yore.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43782.name: Windspath eel
43782.col_2: Found in the Knowable, this sleek wavekin differs in color to its wild kin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43783.name: harlequin lancer
43783.col_2: One of several species kept in the Cleyra Museum of Nature for the sake of future generations, this colorful wavekin is highly poisonous.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43784.name: Cleyran carp
43784.col_2: The few specimens that inhabit Windspath Gardens are all that remain of this striking carp species.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43785.name: giant snakehead
43785.col_2: Easily mistaken for a mighty scalekin, this vibrant fish can be found in Mu Springs Eternal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43786.name: datnioides
43786.col_2: This predatory wavekin is often seen circling the waters near leynode aero.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43787.name: neo arowana
43787.col_2: This wavekin was once reared by Alexandrian aquarists, who prized the fish for its majestic size and stunning coloration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43788.name: canal bream
43788.col_2: A small saltwater fish found in the waterways of Canal Town. Its saucer-like eyes seem somewhat disproportionate to its size.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43789.name: iris wrasse
43789.col_2: These floral fish were once popular with the Endless residents of Canal Town.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43790.name: canal drum
43790.col_2: A girthy wavekin named after the drums used by Canal Town street performers of old.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43791.name: butterfly ray
43791.col_2: Sadly, the tiresome scholarly squabbles about which winged insect these oversized rays actually resemble continue apace.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43792.name: hydro louvar
43792.col_2: This hulking, formerly migratory species thrives in temperate seas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

43793.name: devotion clam
43793.col_2: A former staple of Alexandrian household cuisine, this sandy colored clam can now be found in the waters of Canal Town.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43794.name: forgotten one
43794.col_2: A mysterious saltwater fish, about which next to nothing is known.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43795.name: copper shark
43795.col_2: While this giant shark may look like a ferocious apex predator, this particular species is, in fact, surprisingly mild-mannered.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

43796.name: golden day
43796.col_2: One can't help but feel wistful when watching this faded gold wavekin weave through the water.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43797.name: starglass gibel
43797.col_2: Likened to stars glistening in the firmament, these freshwater fish provided a welcome diversion in a world devoid of a true night sky.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43798.name: scarlet queen
43798.col_2: This wavekin's beauty is the product of generations of selective breeding to further enhance its aesthetic appeal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43799.name: ultimoat carp
43799.col_2: In Alexandria, this impressive fish could once be seen feeding on the vegetation that flourished in the castle moat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43803.name: Turali loach
43803.col_2: This tubular wavekin inhabits the waters of Karvarhur the First, where it can often be seen burrowing in the silt at the bottom of the lake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43804.name: Yok Huy toad
43804.col_2: Owing, perhaps, to its large eyes, this amphibian is said to bear more than a passing resemblance to the mountain giants it shares its name with.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43805.name: stone pleco
43805.col_2: This slate-hued wavekin is commonly found in the waters of Karvarhur the First.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43806.name: shark catfish
43806.col_2: The imposing dorsal fin of this freshwater fish earned this fish its fearsome appellation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43807.name: Zeh Lar Dor
43807.col_2: The body of this large wavekin is wreathed with an array of complex markings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43808.name: Karvarichthys
43808.col_2: This looming wavekin has inhabited the depths of Karvarhur the First since ancient times, remaining, for the most part, unchanged.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43809.name: severum
43809.col_2: The dark, vertical banding present on this small freshwater fish make it easily identifiable.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43810.name: Ligaka blossom
43810.col_2: The deeper parts of Marsh Ligaka teem with these pastel-hued wavekin.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43811.name: potglaze stingray
43811.col_2: The orange splotches adorning this freshwater ray contrast with its otherwise inky coloration.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43812.name: emberwisp
43812.col_2: This wavekin is said to be a discarded torch come to life, fated to roam the waters forevermore.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43813.name: Ihuyka colossoma
43813.col_2: A hefty fish native to the waters of Ihuykatumu.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43814.name: torchtail
43814.col_2: Despite the physical unlikelihood of such a thing, many have mistaken the tail fin of this wavekin for a burning flame.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43815.name: variegated sisterscale
43815.col_2: With resplendent rainbow scales and pink fins, this pretty fish has many admirers in the angler community.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43816.name: Kozama'uka characin
43816.col_2: This characin sports a characteristically puckered mouth that functions as a natural suction cup.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43817.name: charcoal eel
43817.col_2: Fading through bright red to mellow orange, the striped markings that adorn this eel bring to mind glimmering charcoal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43818.name: rainbow pipira
43818.col_2: This voracious freshwater fish menaces the deeper regions of Marsh Ligaka.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43819.name: lau lau
43819.col_2: This catfish species can often be found scouring the lakebed for its next meal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43820.name: Ligaka pirarucu
43820.col_2: A species of pirarucu identified by its distinctive coloration─akin to countless flowers adrift on the currents.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43821.name: piraputanga
43821.col_2: A medium-sized freshwater fish with a faded black stripe emanating from its tail.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43822.name: purussaurus
43822.col_2: This hulking caiman is held to be the apex predator of Marsh Ligaka. A mere glance at its powerful jaw and rows of glistening teeth is surely all the evidence required to back up such a claim.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43823.name: Turali land crab
43823.col_2: These brilliant blue crabs make for a filling feast when cooked.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43824.name: crested goby
43824.col_2: This small freshwater fish takes its name from the comb-like dorsal fin that adorns its back.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43825.name: tsoly turtle
43825.col_2: A large turtle that inhabits the depths of water-filled calderas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43826.name: viperfish
43826.col_2: A freshwater fish identified by its long whiskers and eye-catching stripes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43827.name: horizon crocodile
43827.col_2: This sizable reptile lurks in the deep waters of the caldera lakes, but will occasionally climb ashore to hunt.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43828.name: tsoly gar
43828.col_2: A large, long-nosed freshwater fish indigenous to the waters of Yak T'el.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43829.name: sunlit prism
43829.col_2: This small freshwater fish is drawn to shallow, well-lit waters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43830.name: fategazer
43830.col_2: The wisdom of the world is said to be contained within the enormous eyes of this little freshwater fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43831.name: frillfin goby
43831.col_2: This freshwater fish got its name from the almost decorative elegance of its fins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43832.name: black ibruq
43832.col_2: A large catfish with a face that arguably resembles an ibruq.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43833.name: speckled peacock bass
43833.col_2: This hefty fish is typically identified by its red-brown body and distinctive speckled pattern.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43834.name: golden characin
43834.col_2: Legend has it this gilded fish will guide you to the fabled city of gold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43835.name: deadleaf minnow
43835.col_2: This tiny freshwater fish is reminiscent of a fallen jungle leaf.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43836.name: glistening discus
43836.col_2: A small freshwater fish said to radiate the light of the sun.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43837.name: lightning eel
43837.col_2: This long, slinky fish stores potent lightning energy within a special gland in its body.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43838.name: longwhisker lungfish
43838.col_2: This freshwater fish can be found in the waters of Yak T'el. Some scholars have taken umbrage to the locals that consider its long fins to be whiskers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43839.name: minted arowana
43839.col_2: Prized for both their appearance and their sturdy scales, these arowanas are a favorite among the Xbr'aal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43840.name: br'aaxfish
43840.col_2: The fangs of these deadly predators rival the br'aax in terms of sheer prey-shredding power.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43841.name: Iq Rrax crab
43841.col_2: The claws of this freshwater crustacean glisten blood red. This is likely a side effect of its overwhelmingly sanguineous diet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43842.name: wivre cod
43842.col_2: This wavekin's likeness to the beasts of burden used by the Mamool Ja earned it the appellation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43843.name: warmouth
43843.col_2: Using the aether stored within its body, this fish can manipulate the water around it at will.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43844.name: Shaaloani goby
43844.col_2: This small freshwater wavekin is found in still waters across Shaaloani.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

43845.name: sauger
43845.col_2: Revered by the Hhetsarro, this wavekin migrates across Xak Tural to lay its eggs in waters anew.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43846.name: Niikwerepi bass
43846.col_2: A vigorous bass species that thrives in the currents of Niikwerepi, providing anglers with a great deal of sport.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

43847.name: longnose gar
43847.col_2: This streamlined species is adept at cutting through the waters. Unfortunately for the fish, its aerodynamic form has invited some novel uses over the years.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43848.name: midnight carp
43848.col_2: This timid wavekin would rather you <hex:021A020203>didn't<hex:021A020103> find it lurking in the depths of Lake Toari.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

43849.name: golden stonefly nymph
43849.col_2: Boasting an aurulent outer shell, these vilekin are said to make their habitats exclusively in clean, limpid streams. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

43850.name: crimson lugworm
43850.col_2: A brightly colored marine worm that lives under beach sand. Live bait for ocean fishing.

43851.name: silkmoth pupa
43851.col_2: Wrapped in soft, pillowy layers of white, the silkmoth larva contained within this pupa is a morsel few fish can refuse. Live bait for salt lake fishing.

43852.name: honeybee
43852.col_2: A worker with unmistakable black and yellow coloring. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

43853.name: cactuar jig
43853.col_2: A specialized plug lure, carefully weighted to emulate the wiggling, jiggling motions characteristic of cactuars. Effective in skyfishing.

43854.name: white worm
43854.col_2: A monochromatic marine worm that thrives in deep, briny waters. Live bait for salt lake fishing.

43855.name: popper lure
43855.col_2: The large mouth of this plug lure creates both a stream of bubbles and percussive sounds when underwater. Effective in freshwater fishing.

43856.name: shucked clam
43856.col_2: The plump, meaty flesh of a clam, thoroughly boiled and cleaned of detritus. Live bait for ocean fishing.

43857.name: dragonfly
43857.col_2: This insect's four delicate wings allow it to glide through the air with ease. Live bait for skyfishing.

43858.name: basket of red maggots
43858.col_2: A basket full of wriggling fly larvae, ideal for catching the attention of hungry aquatic life. Live bait for freshwater fishing.

43859.name: ghost nipper
43859.col_2: Contrary to popular belief, these soft-shelled, semi-transparent crustaceans do not, in fact, nip at supernatural entities. But they would if they could. Live bait for ocean fishing.

43878.name: tome of geological folklore - Yok Tural
43878.description: tomes of geological folklore - Yok Tural

43878.col_3: Tome of Geological Folklore - Yok Tural

43879.name: tome of geological folklore - Xak Tural
43879.description: tomes of geological folklore - Xak Tural
43879.col_2: Tales gathered from Shaaloani's local miners regarding the location of legendary ore veins and gem deposits.
43879.col_3: Tome of Geological Folklore - Xak Tural

43880.name: tome of geological folklore - Alexandria
43880.col_2: Tales gathered from miners regarding the location of legendary ore veins and gem deposits.

43881.name: tome of botanical folklore - Yok Tural
43881.description: tomes of botanical folklore - Yok Tural
43881.col_2: Tales gathered from local Yok Turali botanists regarding the location of rare trees and herbs.
43881.col_3: Tome of Botanical Folklore - Yok Tural

43882.name: tome of botanical folklore - Xak Tural
43882.description: tomes of botanical folklore - Xak Tural
43882.col_2: Tales gathered from Shaaloani's local botanists regarding the location of rare trees and herbs.
43882.col_3: Tome of Botanical Folklore - Xak Tural

43883.name: tome of botanical folklore - Alexandria
43883.col_2: Tales gathered from botanists regarding the location of rare trees and herbs.

43884.name: tome of ichthyological folklore - Yok Tural
43884.description: tomes of ichthyological folklore - Yok Tural
43884.col_2: Tales gathered from local Yok Turali fishers regarding the location of legendary fish.
43884.col_3: Tome of Ichthyological Folklore - Yok Tural

43885.name: tome of ichthyological folklore - Xak Tural
43885.description: tomes of ichthyological folklore - Xak Tural
43885.col_2: Tales gathered from Shaaloani's local fishers regarding the location of legendary fish.
43885.col_3: Tome of Ichthyological Folklore - Xak Tural

43886.name: tome of ichthyological folklore - Alexandria
43886.col_2: Tales gathered from fishers regarding the location of legendary fish.

43887.name: reed scythe
43887.col_2: A scythe for harvesting reeds, specially designed to fit the hands of the Hanu.

43888.name: tortilla press
43888.col_2: A durable tortilla press contrived for Aunt Tii's Tacos.

43889.name: lightweight lantern
43889.col_2: A durable-yet-light lantern designed with the diminutive Pelupelu in mind.

43890.name: ceremonial censer
43890.col_2: A censer designed for the ceremonial rites practiced within the palace.

43891.name: set of handcrafted cover components
43891.col_2: A varied assortment of boards, covers, and cords necessary to bind a book of local folklore.

43892.name: set of Pelupelu cover components
43892.col_2: A collection of colorful components from Urqopacha, ideal for binding a book of Pelupelu tales.

43893.name: set of Moblin cover components
43893.col_2: A variety of Earthenshire-inspired components, tailor-made to bind a book of Moblin tales.

43894.name: set of Mamool Ja cover components
43894.description: sets of Mamool Ja cover components
43894.col_2: Crafted with the azure forests of Yak T'el in mind, these components are fit for binding a book of Mamool Ja myths.

43895.name: glass of cherimoya juice
43895.col_2: This blended beverage contains essential vitamins that moisturize Mamool Ja scales and relieve itching.

43896.name: glass of fermented aloe juice
43896.col_2: The pungent, oddly fruity smell is guaranteed to lure out Moblins from malms away.

43897.name: glass of Ja Tiika juice
43897.col_2: This bright green refreshment is the perfect pick-me-up for a Hanuhanu whose energy is flagging.

43898.name: glass of prickly pear juice
43898.col_2: As any Pelupelu will tell you, this curative tonic is made with tunas from Shaaloani... No, not <hex:021A020203>those<hex:021A020103> tunas!

43899.name: Shunye's Apothecary staple
43899.col_2: A naturally sourced material that promotes a healthy body. Sold for a reasonable price at Shunye's Apothecary.

43900.name: Shunye's Apothecary spiritual supplement
43900.col_2: Guaranteed to lift the spirits and ward off malevolent humours, these are one of the most popular wares sold at Shunye's Apothecary.

43901.name: set of household cleansing supplies
43901.col_2: A set of supplies commonly used by the Shetona to maintain their home's connection to nature even in the midst of bustling cities.

43902.name: deep earth fragment
43902.col_2: The ancient mud and sand found in the Cexudross crater has solidified into stone-like fragments, which may contain traces of materials left behind in the meteorite impact.

43903.name: king puffer
43903.col_2: A satisfyingly spherical and perilously prickly fish native to the waters of Tuliyollal's harbor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

43904.name: Yok Huy pleco
43904.col_2: This freshwater fish has scales as enduring as the Yok Huy's architectural legacy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

43905.name: Qor pirarucu
43905.col_2: Three yalms of freshwater fish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

43906.name: raging Hanuhead
43906.col_2: Between its bright coloring and twisted expression, this cloudfish resembles a sincerely ruffled Hanuhanu.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

43907.name: fulcrum
43907.col_2: Though it will surely restore the scales' balance, there is more that hinges on the success of this replacement fulcrum...

43908.name: solar reflector
43908.col_2: A complex device capable of reflecting sunlight at such intensity as to produce a flame, specially designed for the Vows.

43909.name: Yok Huy cover
43909.col_2: A durable book cover fashioned in Yok Huy stone.

43910.name: set of Tonawawtan cover components
43910.col_2: An assemblage of components and props reminiscent of Xak Tural.

43911.name: glass of kukuru pulp juice
43911.col_2: A sweet and tangy drink with a texture that is ever so faintly pulpy.

43912.name: keg of Boonewa soda
43912.col_2: Invented by a Mamool Ja juicecrafter, this bubbly brew is a traveler's treat.

43913.name: precious material
43913.col_2: Primarily used for decorative purposes, this precious material was found in Urqopacha. It can be purchased from Shunye's Apothecary at a competitive price.

43914.name: azure fragment
43914.col_2: Found at the bottom of Iq Rrax Tsoly, this tear-shaped fragment has a faint blue glow.

43915.name: cenote shark
43915.col_2: This enormous creature commutes between cenote and ocean every day to support its loving family. Or, at least, it did.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

43916.name: fulmisturgeon
43916.col_2: When faced with shocking changes to its environment, this large freshwater fish became shocking itself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

43917.name: rarefied raw ihuykanite
43917.col_2: You don't need to have a green thumb to get your hands on this valuable raw ihuykanite. You will likely need a pickaxe, however.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43918.name: chunk of rarefied artificial volcanic rock
43918.description: chunks of rarefied artificial volcanic rock
43918.col_2: This stone has been painstakingly sculpted to resemble an impressive find.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43919.name: rarefied raw dark amber
43919.col_2: The gemstone of choice for dark goldsmiths.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43920.name: chunk of rarefied titanium gold ore
43920.description: chunks of rarefied titanium gold ore
43920.col_2: There's gold in these hills! Titanium gold, that is.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43921.name: chunk of rarefied magnesite ore
43921.col_2: In addition to its crafting purposes, this ore can be used to deter burglars, provided your aim is true.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43922.name: chunk of rarefied Ra'Kaznar ore
43922.col_2: The perfect smithing material for someone with a penchant for black and purple color schemes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43923.name: handful of rarefied ash soil
43923.col_2: This faintly warm mixture of ash and soil was harvested from an active volcano by a true daredevil of a gatherer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43924.name: sprig of rarefied Kozama'uka chamomile
43924.col_2: You could keep it in reserve for the next time you require a gemdraught...<hex:021A020203>or<hex:021A020103> have yourself a cozy bedtime beverage. Decisions, decisions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43925.name: rarefied wild agave leaf
43925.col_2: If you think this agave is wild, just wait until you taste the mezcal distilled from it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43926.name: stalk of rarefied mountain flax
43926.col_2: With this, perhaps you can craft yourself a nice pair of hiking boots to replace the ones you wore out climbing this mountain in the first place.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43927.name: rarefied sweet kukuru bean
43927.col_2: A true chocolate connoisseur will accept no less than this, the sweetest of all kukuru beans, for their sinfully indulgent sachertortes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43928.name: rarefied dark mahogany log
43928.col_2: “Bring me the darkest mahogany you have! Darker, I say! <hex:021A020203>Darker<hex:021A020103>!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43929.name: rarefied acacia log
43929.col_2: Take this to a skilled carpenter to be processed, and by day's end, you could be the proud owner of a first-rate fork.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43930.name: rarefied windsbalm bay leaf
43930.col_2: A tisane brewed from this exceptional bay leaf would afford a weaver enough energy to sew nearly three dozen muffed mets. Enjoy in moderation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

43931.name: chunk of electrocoal
43931.col_2: An ore containing trace amounts of electrope.

43932.name: chunk of brightwind ore
43932.col_2: Prolonged exposure to wind and sunlight has allowed this stone to absorb a great deal of aether.

43933.name: goldbranch
43933.col_2: Though it appears withered at first glance, this glimmering branch is very much alive─or rather, it <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103>, before being torn from its natural environment.

43934.name: bunch of volcanic grass
43934.col_2: Raised in nutrient-rich volcanic loam, this rare herbage is densely packed with aether.

43935.name: set of fulcrum components
43935.col_2: A set of components for crafting a fulcrum.

43936.name: set of solar reflector components
43936.col_2: A set of assorted components which can be used to create the solar reflector you behold in your mind's eye.

43937.name: bundle of Yok Huy supplies
43937.col_2: An organized selection of Urqopacha stones and other resources commonly used by the Yok Huy.

43938.name: bundle of Xak Tural miscellany
43938.col_2: A batch of leaves, feathers, and other naturally occurring materials from Xak Tural, handpicked by Zemoweni.

43939.name: Yok kukuru pod
43939.col_2: A rather hefty pod harvested from a kukuru tree in Yok Tural. The value is in the beans, but the pulp has its own uses.

43940.name: pinch of Turali spice blend
43940.col_2: An expertly balanced mixture of medicinal herbs and flavorings local to the continent of Tural.

43941.name: <hex:021A020203>Legacies<hex:021A020103> reproduction
43941.col_2: A large-scale reproduction of a piece entitled <hex:021A020203>Legacies<hex:021A020103>.

43962.name: bag of garden sunflower seeds
43962.col_2: The perfect seeds for novice gardeners. If at first you don't succeed, you can simply give up and eat the rest.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For use in planters.

43963.col_2: A bunch of red sunflowers, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.
