43972.name: bottle of cooking mezcal
43972.col_2: Distilled from the fermented pulp of megamaguey pineapples.

43973.name: pot of Ut'ohmu chili sauce
43973.col_2: A sweet and spicy condiment crafted from the paste of Ut'ohmu tomatoes.

43974.name: pot of royal maple syrup
43974.col_2: A viscous, sugary reduction of royal maple sap.

43975.name: can of whipped cream
43975.col_2: A fluffy and faintly sweet plant-based cream made with oilseed extract.

43976.name: bottle of Turali corn oil
43976.col_2: Extracted from the dried germ of Turali corn, this oil is perfect for frying.

43977.name: pinch of mountain salt
43977.col_2: Fine grains of “divine blessing” mined from the mountains of Urqopacha.

43978.name: Ut'ohmu tomato
43978.col_2: Cultivated under the harsh sun of the Ut'ohmu Horizon, these ruby-red tomatoes are prized for their sweetness.

43979.name: pot of royal maple sap
43979.col_2: A clear, sticky substance extracted from royal maple trees.

43980.name: handful of Shaaloani oilseeds
43980.col_2: Indigenous to the wilds of Shaaloani, these robust seeds are developed over a period of months, then processed into oil for cooking.

43981.name: ear of Turali corn
43981.col_2: A superb species of grain native to the continent of Tural.

43982.name: chunk of mountain rock salt
43982.col_2: Naturally occurring crystals of mineral-rich meltwater that flows down from the peaks of Urqopacha.

43983.name: stalk of broccoli
43983.col_2: A cruciferous vegetable whose many florets form a distinct tree-like shape.

43984.name: bell pepper
43984.col_2: This faintly bitter Turali vegetable is also sometimes used in medicines and perfumes.

43985.name: bulb of Yyasulani garlic
43985.col_2: What this Tural-grown garlic lacks in size, it makes up for with richness of aroma and nutrients.

43986.name: pinch of white pepper
43986.col_2: An aromatic spice with a comparatively milder, sweeter heat.

43987.name: pod of mesquite beans
43987.col_2: Prized for their adaptability, these beans can be planted even in the most arid of environs.

43988.name: Turali pineapple
43988.col_2: This sweet and tangy Turali fruit is protected by a tough, spiky rind.

43989.name: Turali aloe leaf
43989.col_2: Distantly related to the strain that grows in Meracydia, this hardy succulent stores water in its leaves to survive in dry climates.

43990.name: bunch of wild Ja Tiika bananas
43990.description: bunches of wild Ja Tiika bananas
43990.col_2: These luminescent blue bananas are the direct predecessor of the selectively crossbred strain now grown in Golmajiik Grove. Under the peel, the fruit is mild in color and flavor both.

43991.name: sweet kukuru bean
43991.col_2: An overpoweringly sweet variety of kukuru bean indigenous to Tural.

43992.name: chunk of mountain chromite ore
43992.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing the precious metal mountain chromite.

43993.name: chunk of ruthenium ore
43993.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing the precious metal ruthenium.

43999.col_2: An ingot of smelted cobalt tungsten.

44001.name: Ra'Kaznar ingot
44001.col_2: An ingot of smelted Ra'Kaznar darksteel.

44002.name: chunk of Lar ore

44011.name: white gold ingot
44011.col_2: An ingot of smelted white gold.

44012.name: black star
44012.col_2: A black jewel that shines with the radiance of the heavens.

44013.name: magnesia whetstone
44013.col_2: A whetstone carved from magnesia. Its endothermic properties make it ideal for sharpening metal.

44014.col_2: A rough-cut log of ginseng timber.

44016.col_2: A rough-cut log of dark mahogany timber.

44017.col_2: A rough-cut log of acacia timber.

44018.name: claro walnut log
44018.col_2: A rough-cut log of claro walnut timber.

44024.name: basket of snow cotton
44024.col_2: The frosty flower of a cotton plant. Soft to the touch like a blanket of fresh snow upon the peaks of Urqopacha.

44025.name: stalk of mountain flax
44025.col_2: Sourced from the lofty mountains of Urqopacha.

44026.name: ball of sarcenet
44026.col_2: Compared to thread spun from ordinary cocoons, sarcenet is nearly invisible when held between the fingers.

44027.name: basket of rroneek fleece
44027.col_2: Thick, heavy hair shorn from a rroneek.

44028.name: ball of levinsilk
44028.col_2: The dainty purple cocoon of a lightning-aspected silkworm.

44029.name: bolt of snow cotton cloth
44029.col_2: Several yalms of snow cotton cloth wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

44030.name: bolt of mountain linen
44030.col_2: Several yalms of mountain linen wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

44031.name: bundle of sarcenet cloth
44031.col_2: Finely textured fabric painstakingly woven in the traditional Pelupelu style.

44032.name: bolt of rroneek serge
44032.col_2: Durable fabric woven from the hair of a rroneek.

44033.name: bolt of Thunderyards silk
44033.col_2: This silk is spun from the crackling cocoons found in Yyasulani.

44034.name: bottle of Yak T'el spring water
44034.description: bottles of Yak T'el spring water
44034.col_2: Clear water bottled at a secluded spring deep in the heart of Yak T'el. Has a distinct earthy aftertaste.

44035.name: handful of sungilt aethersand
44035.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced matter. This coarse sand glitters most perceptibly in direct sunlight.

44036.name: handful of mythloam aethersand
44036.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced mineral matter.

44037.name: handful of mythroot aethersand
44037.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced floral matter.

44038.name: handful of mythbrine aethersand
44038.col_2: The elementally aspected remnants of aetherially reduced sea life.

44039.name: sprig of wind parsley
44039.col_2: A medicinal herb with a crisp, fresh scent.

44040.name: sprig of Kozama'uka chamomile
44040.col_2: A flowering herb found growing throughout Kozama'uka and other hot, humid environs.

44041.name: windsbalm bay leaf
44041.col_2: An especially fragrant herb used in medicinal tinctures.

44042.name: sprig of eucalyptus
44042.col_2: The tough, leathery leaves release a minty-smelling oil when crushed.

44043.name: sprig of pearl grass
44043.col_2: An aquatic plant with small, arched leaves. Though it has no culinary value, it is a desirable ingredient in many medicines.

44044.name: bottle of grade 1 gemsap of strength
44044.description: bottles of grade 1 gemsap of strength
44044.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Turali gemsap will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

44049.col_2: This alchemically formulated potation accelerates the growth of foliage.

44050.name: bottle of tungsten ink
44050.col_2: Colorful ink fortified with cobalt tungsten sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

44051.name: bottle of sanctified water
44051.col_2: Water believed to be blessed by the will of the land. Used to exorcise evil spirits from worldly items.

44052.name: handful of acacia bark
44052.col_2: This bark, when boiled down, produces large amounts of tannin─a substance used by leatherworkers to tan hides.

44053.name: silver lobo hide
44053.col_2: The heavy hide of a silver lobo.

44054.name: hammerhead crocodile skin
44054.col_2: The smooth hide of a hammerhead crocodile.

44055.name: br'aax hide
44055.col_2: The majestic hide of a br'aax.

44056.name: gomphotherium skin
44056.col_2: The thick hide of a gomphotherium.

44057.name: gargantua hide
44057.col_2: The fluffy hide of a gargantua.

44058.name: circle of silver lobo leather
44058.col_2: A large piece of cured silver lobo skin.

44059.name: circle of hammerhead crocodile leather
44059.col_2: A large piece of cured hammerhead crocodile skin.

44060.name: circle of br'aax leather
44060.col_2: A large piece of cured br'aax skin.

44061.name: circle of gomphotherium leather
44061.col_2: A large piece of cured gomphotherium skin.

44062.name: circle of gargantua leather
44062.col_2: A large piece of cured gargantua skin.

44063.name: alpaca fillet
44063.col_2: A choice cut of alpaca meat commonly reserved for celebratory banquets.

44064.name: swampmonk thigh
44064.col_2: A moist, tender slice of meat taken from the leg of a swampmonk.

44065.name: branchbearer fruit
44065.col_2: Harvested from the body of a branchbearer. The green flesh is exceedingly sour.

44066.name: nopalitender tuna
44066.col_2: Harvested from the body of a nopalitender. Its flesh is watery, yet sweet.

44067.name: megamaguey pineapple
44067.col_2: Harvested from the body of a megamaguey. Like agave, it can be used to produce mezcal with a rich and full-bodied flavor.

44068.name: bottle of poison frog secretions
44068.col_2: The viscous secretions of a poison frog.

44069.name: lesser apollyon shell
44069.col_2: The chitinous exoskeleton of a lesser apollyon.

44070.name: ty'aitya wingblade
44070.col_2: The sharp keratin barb of a ty'aitya.

44071.name: clump of tumbleclaw weeds
44071.col_2: Dried plant matter typically wrapped around the body of a tumbleclaw. May sometimes be seen rolling along in the breeze, divested of its owner.

44072.name: Alexandrian axe beak wing
44072.col_2: The large, leathery wing of an Alexandrian axe beak.

44073.name: serving of boiled alpaca steak
44073.col_2: Premium alpaca meat stewed to perfection in a tangy mezcal and lemon sauce.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

44074.name: serving of mezcal-marinated swampmonk
44074.col_2: Tender swampmonk thigh soaked overnight in mezcal, then grilled over an open flame.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

44172.col_2: Slowly and carefully grown at mountainous altitudes, these fresh coffee beans are known to produce more complex flavors than most.

A simple process that brings out the flavor of the main ingredient.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3% <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

44185.col_2: Essential to complete your collection of unwearable wooden jewelry.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44186.name: rarefied ceiba spear
44186.col_2: The detailed etchings in the blade make this polearm ideal for displaying on walls, tables, or perhaps leaning upright in the corner of the lavatory to confuse your guests.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44187.name: rarefied dark mahogany necklace
44187.col_2: Dark mahogany─for when regular mahogany just isn't foreboding enough.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44188.name: rarefied acacia rod
44188.col_2: The glowing gem can also double as a lantern for your bedchambers, in case you happen to be deathly afraid of black mages hiding in your closet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44189.name: rarefied claro walnut grinding wheel
44189.col_2: Here's a riddle: what is black when you get it, red while you use it, and white when you discard it? Hopefully not this grinding wheel.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44190.name: rarefied claro walnut fishing rod
44190.col_2: If you've ever wished your fishing rod could be mistaken for a crooked firearm, this might just be your lucky day.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44191.name: pair of rarefied mountain chromite fists
44191.description: pairs of rarefied mountain chromite fists
44191.col_2: Wearing these, you will surely feel as though you could punch a mountain. Note that punching a mountain is not recommended.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44192.name: rarefied ruthenium war axe
44192.col_2: Fit for only the most ruthless of warriors. Or miners, if you pretend it's a pickaxe.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44193.name: pair of rarefied cobalt tungsten scimitars
44193.description: pairs of rarefied cobalt tungsten scimitars
44193.col_2: Unlike other tungsten scimitars, these are ferromagnetic, which may prove disastrous should your opponent's weapon be made of manganese.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44194.name: rarefied titanium gold mortar
44194.col_2: This mortar is made of titanium gold...which is assumed to be far better than regular gold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44195.name: rarefied Ra'Kaznar war scythe
44195.col_2: The automated saw chain makes this scythe an excellent choice for cutting down trees, branches, and other dastardly foes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44196.name: rarefied Ra'Kaznar round knife
44196.col_2: Perfect for bored leatherworkers who would enjoy the added thrill of accidentally stabbing themselves with the little metal feather on the pommel.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44197.name: rarefied mountain chromite alembic
44197.col_2: “I'm not here to hike─I'm here to do <hex:021A020203>science<hex:021A020103>!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44198.name: pair of rarefied ruthenium sabatons
44198.col_2: Guaranteed to win you a saba-<hex:021A020203>ton<hex:021A020103> of envious looks from everyone in your vicinity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44199.name: rarefied cobalt tungsten chocobo frypan
44199.col_2: “You mean to tell me a chocobo fried this pan?”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44200.name: rarefied titanium gold thorned corselet
44200.col_2: As if this corselet wasn't already daunting enough, you will have to ask a friend to lace up the strings in the back for you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44201.name: pair of rarefied Ra'Kaznar greaves
44201.col_2: A valuable rarefied addition to any greave enthusiast's collection...assuming there is such thing as greave enthusiasts.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44202.name: rarefied Ra'Kaznar ring
44202.col_2: “You hung it on a tree branch!? Well, now I'll never find it!”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44203.name: rarefied Lar longbow
44203.col_2: When the House of Splendors conducted a survey among archers to gauge their clientele's ideal features on a longbow, an overwhelming majority answered with “little feather tassels.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44204.name: rarefied ihuykanite circlet
44204.col_2: Remember to coordinate your other accessories when you wear this to formal functions. Gold and silver simply do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> mix.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44205.name: rarefied cobalt tungsten tuck
44205.col_2: Outside of combat, the serrated edge is perfect for slicing through particularly stale bread.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44206.name: rarefied white gold choker
44206.col_2: “Are you quite sure this is genuine white gold? Because to me it looks more...red and glowy.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44207.name: rarefied Ra'Kaznar orrery
44207.col_2: Ask your local astrologian whether buying this orrery is in the cards for you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44208.name: pair of rarefied black star earrings
44208.description: pairs of rarefied black star earrings
44208.col_2: For those optimistic collectors who wish to be starry-eyed <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> starry-eared.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44209.name: pair of rarefied loboskin fingerless gloves
44209.description: pairs of rarefied loboskin fingerless gloves
44209.col_2: Many silver lobos perished so that you might feel the breeze against your fingers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44210.name: pair of rarefied crocodileskin leggings
44210.col_2: “As I have always said, the ideal footwear has no fewer than five belts on each shoe.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44211.name: pair of rarefied br'aaxskin armlets
44211.col_2: For reasons unknown, avid collectors insist upon the inclusion of matching rings for these armlets.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44212.name: pair of rarefied gomphotherium brais
44212.col_2: Do take care not to sit too close to your friends while wearing these. The little spikes are very sharp.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44213.name: pair of rarefied gargantuaskin trousers
44213.col_2: The glossy fabric is surprisingly water-resistant, for those who tend to spill beverages directly onto their lap.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44214.name: rarefied gargantuaskin hat
44214.col_2: A single gargantua hide could theoretically produce a dozen of these hats, assuming the beast doesn't make <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> into a hat first.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44215.name: rarefied snow cotton beret
44215.col_2: Should the fetching feather accents fall off, you need only ask the nearest Hanuhanu for a suitable replacement.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44216.name: rarefied mountain linen top
44216.col_2: In order to try it on, you'll have to figure out which of its many belts are functional and which are purely decorative.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44217.name: pair of rarefied sarcenet kecks
44217.col_2: The elastic waistband offers great succor to those attending fancy dinner parties with six or more courses.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44218.name: rarefied rroneek serge hat
44218.col_2: Tragically, this hat is nowhere near as adorable as the rroneek whose hide was used to make it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44219.name: pair of rarefied Thunderyards silk gloves
44219.description: pairs of rarefied Thunderyards silk gloves
44219.col_2: Do note that these are not one size fits all, or else you may soon end up with rarefied <hex:021A020203>fingerless<hex:021A020103> gloves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44220.name: pair of rarefied Thunderyards silk culottes
44220.description: pairs of rarefied Thunderyards silk culottes
44220.col_2: Gives new meaning to the phrase “fancy pants.”<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44221.name: rarefied loboskin grimoire
44221.col_2: The feather doubles as a bookmark in case you need to take a mid-summon bathroom break.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44222.name: bottle of rarefied gemsap of dexterity
44222.description: bottles of rarefied gemsap of dexterity
44222.col_2: Once you've tried this superior gemsap, you'll wonder how you ever aimed a gun without it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44223.name: rarefied br'aaxskin codex
44223.col_2: You'll feel like a wild br'aax in the jungle, wielding this codex in the comfort of your luxury estate.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44224.name: cup of rarefied cunning craftsman's tisane
44224.description: cups of rarefied cunning craftsman's tisane
44224.col_2: Perfect for the night before a major social function when you've just realized you forgot to craft your costume.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44225.name: bottle of rarefied gemdraught of vitality
44225.description: bottles of rarefied gemdraught of vitality
44225.col_2: One sip and you'll feel as though every ilm of your body has been made steel, impervious to the feeble blows of mortal men─not altogether different from a night at the pub.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44227.name: serving of rarefied boiled alpaca steak
44227.description: servings of rarefied boiled alpaca steak
44227.col_2: Tastes so good, you'll feel lightheaded...or perhaps that's just the rarefied air of Urqopacha. Hard to say.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44228.name: rarefied banana ponzecake
44228.col_2: Only the finest Ja Tiika bananas were allowed to overripen in order to make this exquisite dessert.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44229.name: rarefied Turali pineapple ponzecake
44229.col_2: Normally this ponzecake is reserved for large festivals, but when has that ever stopped anyone? Every day is a celebration where cake is involved.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44230.name: serving of rarefied salmon jerky
44230.col_2: After you've had a taste of this jerky, you may find yourself strangely compelled to swim upstream in search of more.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44231.name: serving of rarefied stuffed peppers
44231.col_2: These roasted bell peppers have been stuffed to bursting with deliciousness─a feeling you will surely relate to when you eat them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44232.name: serving of rarefied tacos de carne asada
44232.description: servings of rarefied tacos de carne asada
44232.col_2: These toothsome tacos are sure to steal the hearts of even the most stalwart Studium scholars.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44233.name: chunk of rarefied white gold ore
44233.description: chunks of rarefied white gold ore
44233.col_2: For those who seek to smelt only the whitest and goldest of white gold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※For collectable submissions only.

44257.name: ribboned parasol

44258.col_2: A dazzling paper parasol bedecked with bombs of all sizes. Whether or not it is bomb-<hex:021A020203>proof<hex:021A020103>, however, is a different story. Use to unlock a bomb parasol.

44483.col_2: The land probably won't tremble before his might.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Nano Lord minion.

44484.name: uma-no-unicolt
44484.col_2: Wishes to embark on a journey with one who is pure of heart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the uma-no-unicolt minion.

44485.name: Adamant Weapon
44485.col_2: A diamond by any other name would shine as bright─at least when scale is accounted for.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Adamant Weapon minion.

44486.name: toco toquito
44486.col_2: A tropical bird that is all beak and has a squawk to match.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the toco toquito minion.

44487.name: shshuye
44487.col_2: One day it may become a dread tural vidraal, but it is not this day.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the shshuye minion.

44488.name: spinettesaurus
44488.col_2: Small though it may be, never let it be said that it has no spine.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the spinettesaurus minion.

44489.name: wind-up Pelupelu
44489.col_2: The perfect souvenir, if it does say so itself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Pelupelu minion.

44490.name: tin soldier S3
44490.col_2: The toy with a body of tin and a heart of gold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tin soldier S3 minion.

44491.name: the Deathservant
44491.col_2: Literally has a taste for life.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Deathservant minion.

44492.name: wisp of Darkness
44492.col_2: What it cannot smother, it nibbles. What it cannot nibble, it tickles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wisp of Darkness minion.

44493.name: wind-up Themis
44493.col_2: A minion as loyal as your star is bright─a minion not bound by the confines of this world, or any other.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Themis minion.

44494.name: the Lawnblazer
44494.col_2: Railroad not required.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Lawnblazer minion.

44495.name: set of eternal barding
44495.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Queen Eternal.

44496.name: set of Starlight Stalls barding
44496.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed and crafted by the Saint of Nymeia himself in order to help spread warmth and cheer at the Starlight Stalls.

44497.name: punutiy horn
44497.col_2: This horn of bone produces a languid sound that calls your trusty punutiy to your side.

44498.name: hovering hot pot whistle
44498.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a divine tone that summons your hovering hot pot.

44499.name: pair of wings of eternity
44499.col_2: Manifest your wings of eternity and soar the skies with an aura of unwavering determination.

44500.name: dais of Darkness
44500.col_2: Take to the skies on this piece of the battlefield created by the Cloud of Darkness, safe in the knowledge that it will not suddenly phase from existence.

44501.name: shroud of Darkness
44501.col_2: Envelop yourself in this sliver of the Cloud of Darkness's raiment, and know the feeling of being the dread voidsent queen. All-consuming powers of Darkness not included.

44502.name: barreltender whistle
44502.col_2: This whistle emits a lusty tone that calls your barreltender flexing to your side.

44503.name: eggeater horn
44503.col_2: A horn that, when blown, brings the eggeater scrambling to your side.

44504.name: Alexandrian axe beak horn
44504.col_2: A horn that, when blown, brings an Alexandrian axe beak lumbering to your side.

44505.name: vacuum suit identification key
44505.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your vacuum suit will magically bring the machine to life.

44506.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Doing the Wave<hex:021A020103>
44506.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Doing the Wave<hex:021A020103>
44506.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for achieving an effortlessly textured bob suitable for all occasions.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

44507.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - A Half Times Two<hex:021A020103>
44507.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - A Half Times Two<hex:021A020103>
44507.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for taming tresses into two perfectly plaited halfbraids, replete with ribbons and all.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.
44507.col_3: Modern Aesthetics - A Half Times Two

44508.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Awaiting Orders<hex:021A020103>
44508.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing the optimal stance in which to await further instruction. Use to learn the /attend emote.

44510.col_2: An illustrated manual of the rhythmic motions required to produce any number of sophisticated beverages. Use to learn the /shakedrink emote.

44511.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Flowerbed Maintenance<hex:021A020103>
44511.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to bring back neglected flowers from the brink of dry demise. Use to learn the /water emote.

44512.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Bubbly Diversions<hex:021A020103>
44512.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to embrace your inner child and brew up an iridescent barrage of whimsy. Use to learn the /blowbubbles emote.

44513.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Floral Presentations<hex:021A020103>

44845.name: chunk of Alexandrian ore
44845.col_2: A decent-sized piece of rock containing metal composites unique to Alexandria.

44846.name: loop of optical nanofiber
44846.col_2: A bundle of light-transmitting fibers hewn together into a length of curious cord.

44847.name: sheet of Alexandrian plate
44847.col_2: A remarkably durable metal sheet that glows with a twilight luster.

44848.name: phial of condensed solution
44848.col_2: A highly condensed and potent alchemical solution. Highly effective, but at what exactly remains to be seen.

44849.name: eternal queensguard
44849.col_2: A remnant of one of the units deployed in battle by Queen Eternal.

44850.name: bottle of locomotive lubricant
44850.col_2: A single thick coat of this oil will greatly reduce friction between the many moving parts of a train.

44851.name: box of carriage furnishing supplies
44851.col_2: Packed with cushions, lighting fixtures, and other materials intended to enhance the train riding experience.

44852.name: pinch of mapmaking pigment
44852.col_2: Once properly processed, this colorant is applied to a map to add depth and detail.

44853.name: pot of industrial sanitizing fluid
44853.col_2: The chemicals contained herein are used to create a powerful cleaning agent popular among locomotive engineers.

44854.name: handful of trackbed repair materials
44854.col_2: An assortment of stone yet to be crushed into railroad ballast.

44855.name: rail grindstone
44855.col_2: When used to polish the rails and castings, the subsequent reduction in friction offers a much quieter train ride.

44856.name: row of plush carriage seating
44856.col_2: These luxurious cushioned seats offer superior comfort for train rides of any duration.

44857.name: set of map printing essentials
44857.col_2: Includes everything required to print painstakingly detailed maps, without which Tuliyollan citizens would surely struggle to navigate Vanguard.

44858.name: engineer's supply kit
44858.col_2: These toolboxes hold a full set of supplies favored by the engineers of Xak Tural Railing.

44859.name: railroad repair kit
44859.col_2: Packed neatly with spikes, ties, and other sturdy components used to lay rail.

44860.name: sack of rail grindstone components
44860.col_2: This heavy sack holds everything needed to assemble a grindstone that will polish your rails to silent perfection.

44861.name: set of carriage seat components
44861.col_2: Contains just enough fabric and cushioning to build a single row of comfortable, durable train seats. Instructions not included.

44862.name: set of map printing components
44862.col_2: An assortment of raw materials needed to create paper and ink for use in printing.

44863.name: set of engineer's supply kit components
44863.description: sets of engineer's supply kit components
44863.col_2: Used in the construction of various implements a locomotive engineer may need on the job.

44864.name: box of railroad repair kit components
44864.description: boxes of railroad repair kit components
44864.col_2: Once the included steel has been used to construct spikes and joints, the wooden box may be repurposed into ties for maximum efficiency.

44865.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Head Hound<hex:021A020103>
44865.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for coaxing one's locks into a rambunctious side braid and ponytail combination.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

44866.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Scion Special Issue IV<hex:021A020103>
44866.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Scion Special Issue IV<hex:021A020103>
44866.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this limited edition of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for emulating the style of G'raha Tia─definitively the dreamiest Scion of the Seventh Dawn, despite what previous editions may purport.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.
44866.col_3: Modern Aesthetics - Scion Special Issue IV

44867.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Voidswept Strands<hex:021A020103>
44867.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for achieving a perfectly unbalanced asymmetric bob.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

44868.name: clouddark demimateria I
44868.col_2: A crystallized mass of residual spiritbond energies transferred to an article of weaponry or armor by the Cloud of Darkness during its creation.

44869.name: clouddark demimateria II
44869.col_2: A crystallized mass of residual spiritbond energies transferred to an article of weaponry or armor by the Cloud of Darkness during its creation.

44870.name: pure white interior wall
44870.col_2: An interior wall of plain, pristine white for maximum versatility.

44871.name: unit of light wood flooring
44871.col_2: Flooring made from rustic planks in an unpretentious pale shade.

44872.name: flat ceiling lamp
44872.col_2: This unobtrusive lighting fixture is ideal for those who would rather not draw attention to the ceiling.

44873.name: wood-fired range
44873.col_2: This multi-purpose brick oven doubles as a charming fireplace.

44874.name: holodisplay
44874.col_2: Activate (and deactivate) projections of important-looking graphs with the press of a button. The future is now.

44875.name: storybook bench
44875.col_2: Beloved by the orphans of Menphina's Arms, this bench is perfect for reading stories aloud to friends.

44876.name: sweet Dreamer's stall
44876.col_2: Packed chock-full of sweets and treats, this stall is guaranteed to delight children and inner children alike.

44877.name: set of frilly curtains
44877.col_2: The lace hem of the top treatment adds a delicate touch to these cutesy curtains.

44878.name: set of botanist's wall frames
44878.col_2: A collection of wall hangings that celebrate flora and fauna. A painting of one's choosing may be placed in the center frame.

44879.name: botanical loft
44879.col_2: Lush green ivy dangles through the slats of this wood lattice fixture.

44880.name: patchwork sofa
44880.col_2: Stitched together using a hodgepodge of leather scraps, this sofa has a uniquely colorful charm.

44881.name: gleaner's knapsack
44881.col_2: Used to carry both supplies and commissions, the knapsack is arguably the most vital item among a gleaner's possessions.

44882.col_2: Thin slices of popoto, fried to a golden crisp and lightly salted to create the perfect snack.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Spell Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

44883.col_2: Clues and clippings linked together with thread in the fashion of a master sleuth. It probably doesn't mean anything.

44884.name: apothecary mortar
44884.col_2: Includes a selection of wild herbs commonly ground into medicine.

44885.name: grassy rug
44885.col_2: Brings new meaning to the phrase “home turf.”

44886.name: royal bed
44886.col_2: Rumor has it a royal family in the world of Vana'diel sleeps on resplendent beds such as these.

44887.name: eternal cenotaph
44887.col_2: This monument stands as a solemn reminder of a queen who placed her beloved people above all else.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

44888.name: Skydeep lamp
44888.col_2: Recovered from the Skydeep Cenote's innermost chamber, this lamp gives any room an ethereal purple tinge.

44889.name: Origenics monitor desk
44889.col_2: A spacious work desk taken from a storage room in the soul processing division. Additional monitors not included.

44890.name: Origenics chair
44890.col_2: This office chair was designed to facilitate hours of soul-sucking work.

44891.name: Strayborough wall lamp
44891.col_2: The eerie glow of this three-light fixture brings to mind a haunted mansion.

44892.name: Traumerei floor stencil
44892.col_2: This whimsical floor stencil depicts a decidedly cuter interpretation of the Lord of Nightmares.

44895.name: climbing wall partition
44895.col_2: Colorful footholds have been added to this partition to create an indoor climbing fixture.

44896.name: billiard table
44896.col_2: Upon this finely crafted table, a pole is used to strike a ball at other balls to knock them into the side pockets. Except <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> one.

44897.name: imitation closet
44897.col_2: For those who only want the <hex:021A020203>appearance<hex:021A020103> of storage space.

44898.name: fighting ring
44898.col_2: A scaled-down version of the type commonly used in martial arts competitions, this arena still gives you plenty of room to maneuver.

44899.name: dartboard cabinet
44899.col_2: Unlike archery or javelin throwing, this game may safely be played indoors.

44900.name: laboratory counter
44900.col_2: The inclusion of a sink makes this table well suited to experiments that involve dangerous chemicals.

44901.name: serving of Kugane-yaki
44901.col_2: The official name of this Far Eastern snack is hotly contested, with some insisting upon “blade buns” as a nod to the fan-like pattern traditionally stamped on top with a branding iron. 44903.name: classroom chair
44903.col_2: This sturdy chair was built to accommodate young students throughout their educational journey.

44904.name: classroom blackboard
44904.col_2: Large enough to fit a single day's lesson in any one subject. Chalk and duster included.

44905.name: contemporary iron shelf
44905.col_2: The metal framework will support even the heaviest of potted plants.

44906.name: Starlight Celebration MMXXIII advertisement
44906.col_2: A festive hand-painted notice advertising the Starlight Celebration of a year gone by.

44907.name: Valentione's Day MMXXIV advertisement
44907.col_2: A heartwarming and hand-painted notice advertising the Valentione's Day of a year gone by.

44908.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Crossroads<hex:021A020103>
44908.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of a two-headed champion, an otherworldly visitor, and three agents of darkness, each with their own aims and agendas.

44909.name: mug of Starlight kinderpunsch
44909.col_2: A steaming-hot spiced beverage served in a decorative mug. 44911.name: weathered porthole
44911.col_2: Relax below deck and enjoy smooth sailing, all from the comfort of your estate.

44912.name: rail-and-stile partition
44912.col_2: With no panes of glass, what's to stop you from climbing straight through?

44913.name: tea caddy cabinet
44913.col_2: A professional tea drinker must always keep their estate well stocked.

44914.name: indoor awning

44925.name: authentic Valentione's heart chair
44925.col_2: This charming wooden chair bears an adorable heart motif, making it clear not only by the comfort of its fluffy pink cushions but its very form factor that it is a product of love. And the passage of time has not made that love any less authentic.

44926.name: cactus patch
44926.col_2: Rest assured, these spiky succulents will stay right where you plant them. Don't worry about how many needles they have.

44927.name: garden palm tree
44927.col_2: Add a tropical touch to your backyard with these leafy fronds.

44928.name: Far Eastern gazebo
44928.col_2: A gazebo designed in the Far Eastern fashion.

44929.name: set of square stepping stones
44929.col_2: Square stones of varying sizes, carefully placed so as to avoid crushing the flowers.

44930.name: electrope turret
44930.col_2: As formidable as it looks, it's merely a lawn decoration─but your neighbors don't need to know that.

44931.name: lesser pillar of Tural
44931.col_2: Recovered from Xak Turali ruins, this statue depicts an urn containing a serpentine entity of diminutive size.

44932.name: Ihuykatumu flower plot
44932.col_2: You don't know the name of these grotto flowers, but looking at them makes you feel a bit drowsie.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

44933.name: Zormor stone lantern
44933.col_2: Since olden times, this lantern has illuminated the rocky mountain path at the Summit of Zor─but no more.

44934.name: Ja Ja Gural tree
44934.col_2: Originating in the depths of Cenote Ja Ja Gural, this luminescent tree lights up your lawn quite vividly.

44935.name: authentic illuminated topiary chocobo
44935.col_2: Trimmed into the shape of a sitting chocobo, this shrubbery is liberally strung with glowing adornments in the style of the Starlight Celebration. This holiday season, give the gift of authenticity.

44959.col_2: This peculiar contraption creates illusions by weaving together myriad shades of light. Envelops the user's head with the visage of an exceptionally brawny sabotender.

44970.name: cushioned bench
44970.col_2: A wooden bench fitted with a sumptuously soft seat.

44971.name: tropical canopy bed

44972.name: Wachumeqimeqi balloon

44996.name: mandragora parasol
44996.col_2: Whether you want to blend in amongst potentially sentient seedkin, or simply keep your head dry, this parasol quite literally has you covered. Use to unlock a mandragora parasol.

44997.name: Archon egg parasol
44997.col_2: Finished in a striking yellow and golden trim, this accessory provides eggceptional protection against all but the worst of downpours. Use to unlock an Archon egg parasol.

44998.name: Pelupack
44998.col_2: A rustic receptacle for all your Pelupossessions. Use to unlock a Pelupack.

45979.description: bottles of grade 3 gemsap of strength
45979.col_2: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Turali gemsap will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

46094.col_2: A robust bench designed in the Tuliyollan style.

46095.col_2: A painted wooden partition of Tuliyollan design.

46096.col_2: A cloth-covered table designed in the Tuliyollan style.

46097.col_2: A sturdy round stool designed in the Tuliyollan style.

46098.col_2: An ornate censer of Tuliyollan design.

46099.name: Tuliyollan rug
46099.col_2: A rectangular rug woven in the Tuliyollan fashion.

46100.name: cabin half-moon rug
46100.col_2: A rug decorated with a traditional Turali pattern and well suited for adorning thresholds.

46101.name: cabin bed
46101.col_2: At once recognizable to visitors of Tuliyollal, this bed incorporates woven reeds lovingly raised in Yok Tural.

46102.name: cabin sofa
46102.col_2: An elegant woven seat of the sort commonly found in Tuliyollan dwellings.

46103.name: cabin sideboard
46103.col_2: The expansive shelves of this freestanding furnishing are perfect for displaying souvenirs from across the salt.

46104.name: overhead studio light
46104.col_2: This simple fixture casts ample light for portraiture when ceiling lamps fail to suffice.

46105.name: dumbbell rack
46105.col_2: Storage for one-armed weights of ascending heft, to be lifted until one can lift no more.

46106.name: training bench
46106.col_2: A bench from which to pose what will surely one day become an age-old question: “Dost thou even lift?”

46107.name: training mat
46107.col_2: A mat to prevent weights damaging the flooring during intense training sessions.

46108.name: pot of old fishwife's paella
46108.col_2: Though this rice dish rich with fresh seafood and vegetables is so good as to be legendary, it is assuredly real and quite hot to the touch.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Cannot be retrieved once used.<hex:02100103>※Can be used up to 10 times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Meal benefits when used:<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Skill Speed Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +4% (Max 10)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>VIT Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +5% (Max 12)<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Gear Durability Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>EXP Bonus:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> +3%<hex:02100103>  <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 30m<hex:02100103>  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

46109.name: lattice planter partition
46109.col_2: This elegant latticework partition decorated with planters brings new meaning to the word “wallflower.”

46110.name: scroll cabinet
46110.col_2: A wooden shelving structure custom-made for storing scrolls. Comes complete with material to inflate your to-read list.

46111.name: minimalist glade partition door
46111.col_2: A simple partition affixed with a single door, designed to complement glade residences.

46112.name: minimalist oasis partition door
46112.col_2: A simple partition affixed with a single door, designed to complement oasis residences.

46113.name: minimalist riviera partition door
46113.col_2: A simple partition affixed with a single door, designed to complement riviera residences.

46114.name: minimalist highland partition door
46114.col_2: A simple partition affixed with a single door, designed to complement highland residences.

46115.name: minimalist Hingan partition door
46115.col_2: A simple partition affixed with a single door, designed to complement Hingan residences.

46116.name: death's halo
46116.col_2: An unsettling monument inspired by the rings Necron wielded to such chilling effect. Dark desires seem to emanate from within.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

46117.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>The Promise of Tomorrow<hex:021A020103>
46117.description: authentic copies of <hex:021A020203>The Promise of Tomorrow<hex:021A020103>
46117.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of allies from two nations learning to walk side by side, as their gaze turns towards the future.
46117.col_3: Authentic Copy of The Promise of Tomorrow

46118.name: Far Eastern odder otter seater
46118.col_2: A seat ideal for otters, odder or not, and also preferred by the floor-sitting lot.

46119.name: All Saints' Wake MMXXIV advertisement
46119.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the mischief and mayhem of an All Saints' Wake past, when fiends feasted freely.

46120.name: La Noscean orange tree
46120.col_2: This tree has been tastefully pruned for ornamental use─but there is naught stopping a theoretical homeowner from eating oranges until they pass out.

46121.name: imitation battlefield
46121.col_2: Rusted weapons and torn banners stud a patch of scorched earth in this lifelike replica of a grim battlefield.

46122.name: frosted topiary
46122.col_2: A closely cropped shrub topped with a thick layer of snow.

46123.name: frozen garden pond
46123.col_2: The waters of this snow-dusted pond are frozen still as the depths of winter.

46124.name: Guardian Arkveld's Windward Plains phasmascape
46124.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays a harrowing battle with the dread Guardian Arkveld.

46125.name: Rey Dau's Windward Plains phasmascape
46125.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the wide, sweeping landscape of the Windward Plains.

46126.name: Uth Duna's Scarlet Forest phasmascape
46126.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the tumultuous waters and woods of Uth Duna's Scarlet Forest.

46127.name: Omega's Iceshard Cliffs phasmascape
46127.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the ultimate weapon, Omega, atop the Iceshard Cliffs.

46128.name: Jin Dahaad's Iceshard Cliffs phasmascape
46128.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the serpentine menace, Jin Dahaad, atop the Iceshard Cliffs.

46129.name: Nu Udra's Oilwell Basin phasmascape
46129.col_2: This advanced magitek contraption displays the six-limbed terror, Nu Udra, in the sweltering heat of the Oilwell Basin.

46130.col_2: A steaming-hot spiced beverage served in a decorative Starlight mug. 46161.name: outdoor hunter's grill
46161.col_2: A portable grill used by hunters to cook raw meat and other ingredients.

46162.name: wilds great sword stand
46162.col_2: A simple weapon stand bearing a crude but surprisingly powerful blade.

46163.name: wilds banner
46163.col_2: A banner said to be adored by hunters of another world.

46164.name: wilds pendant lamp
46164.col_2: A pendant lamp inspired by tales of hunters from another world.

46165.name: makeshift camp
46165.col_2: A hastily assembled camp for the hunter who cares little and less for comfort.

46166.name: pop-up camp
46166.col_2: A pop-up facility used by hunters on the go to quickly change equipment.

46167.name: palanx striking dummy
46167.col_2: A striking dummy designed to resemble a stalwart Felyne friend.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

46168.name: Lyhe Ghiah stained crystal ornament
46168.col_2: An iridescent, intricately detailed wall ornament modeled after the windows that adorn the twinkling edifice of Lyhe Ghiah.

46169.name: traverse clocktower
46169.col_2: Crafted to resemble the clocktower awaiting adventurers who tread the furthest reaches of Pilgrim's Traverse, this timepiece makes an imposing, somewhat hypnotic addition to any garden.

46170.name: traverse tree
46170.col_2: Native to the environs of Pilgrim's Traverse, this bulbous arboreal bloom casts an otherworldly glow.

46171.name: Everkeep lamppost
46171.col_2: The neon glow of this Everkeep fixture has been softened for indoor use.

46172.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Legends of Ivalice<hex:021A020103>
46172.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of legendary Ivalician figures from a tumultuous age.

46173.name: cosmoseat
46173.col_2: A futuristic bench developed for use on distant stars. Though visually appealing, its unyielding surface has led more than one overworked initiative member to question whether the future must needs be “such a pain in the arse.”

46174.name: cosmokitchen partition
46174.col_2: This futuristic partition incorporates a compact pantry and sink, as well as a helpful memo reminding users that even in the great expanse, everyone can smell your unwashed dishes.

46175.name: portable exoterminal
46175.col_2: Developed by the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this device was designed for the purpose of easily sending mass updates to exotablets whether at camp or in the field─though some Loporrits have been caught red-pawed using it to design frivolous games.

46176.name: docking station cover
46176.col_2: A freestanding roof to shelter one's rover from natural hazards.

46177.name: cosmic circumferbench
46177.col_2: A marvel of space-saving public infrastructure, this lamppost incorporates 360-degree seating area.

46179.name: irregular tomestone of revelation
46179.col_2: One of only a few in existence, this Allagan tomestone contains apologues so absurd they can scarcely be understood by the modern mind.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Can be exchanged with itinerant moogles for certain items.

46185.name: timeworn gargantuaskin map
46185.col_2: This bottle holds a timeworn map classified as risk-reward grade 18 among treasure hunters.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Use the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to extract the map and examine its contents.<hex:02100103>※Level 100 full party (eight players) recommended.

46186.name: fragment of illumed aetherpool glass
46186.col_2: A fragment of aetherpool gear found in Pilgrim's Traverse.

46187.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Illumed Invocations<hex:021A020103>
46187.col_2: An ancient tome found in Pilgrim's Traverse.

46188.name: goldentail
46188.col_2: A freshwater fish whose glinting golden form is infused with lightning energy.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

46189.name: prime adjudicator
46189.col_2: A king among deepwardens, and lord of the waters of Karvarhur the First.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

46190.name: crenicichla Miyaka
46190.col_2: A king among crenicichla, and lord of the waters of the Dewspun Bank.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

46191.name: iron shadowtongue
46191.col_2: A king among shadowtongues, and lord of the waters of Iq Rrax Tsoly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

46192.name: lotl-in-waiting
46192.col_2: A king among sunbright axolotls, and lord of the depths of Xobr'it Tsoly.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

46193.name: azure diver
46193.col_2: A king among azure gliders, and lord of the mists of Eastbound Zorgor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

46194.name: sprouting perch
46194.col_2: A king among pumpkin perch, and lord of the waters of the outskirts shallows.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

46195.name: gigagiant snakehead
46195.col_2: A king among giant snakeheads, and lord of the waters of Mu Springs Eternal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

46196.name: gondola louvar
46196.col_2: A king among hydro louvars, and lord of the waterways of Canal Town South.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

46197.name: sack of Warmth repair supply materials
46197.description: sacks of Warmth repair supply materials
46197.col_2: A sack of materials required to craft supplies which will be used to repair the living quarters in Zirgorteh the Open-armed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46198.name: set of Warmth repair supplies
46198.col_2: A set of supplies required to make the living quarters in Zirgorteh the Open-armed cozy and warm.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46199.name: sack of master mason's tool materials
46199.description: sacks of master mason's tool materials
46199.col_2: A sack of materials required to create a set of high-quality stonemasonry tools.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46200.name: set of master mason's tools
46200.col_2: A set of mason's tools worthy of the deftest hand.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46201.name: sack of ice removal tool materials
46201.description: sacks of ice removal tool materials
46201.col_2: A sack of materials required to craft enough ice removal tools for every pair of Yok Huy hands.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46202.name: set of ice removal tools
46202.col_2: A set of tools and materials required for the delicate removal of stubbornly frozen ice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46203.name: sack of conductive golem component materials
46203.description: sacks of conductive golem component materials
46203.col_2: A sack of materials required to craft components used to conduct aether throughout the stone frame of a golem.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46204.name: set of conductive golem components
46204.col_2: A set of components required to get aether flowing through a golem's stone body, blessing it with locomotion.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46205.name: sack of living sepulchre supply materials
46205.description: sacks of living sepulchre supply materials
46205.col_2: A sack of materials required to craft supplies to help put the finishing touches on the living sepulchre devoted to the snow spirits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46206.name: set of living sepulchre supplies
46206.col_2: A set of magically imbued tools and supplies required to help the snow spirits understand the meaning of the living sepulchre dedicated to them.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46207.name: set of snow removal tool materials
46207.description: sets of snow removal tool materials
46207.col_2: A set of materials required to craft snow removal tools.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

46208.name: snow removal tool
46208.col_2: A tool required for the never-ending task of snow removal at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Yok Huy society quests.

47960.col_2: May sound like a generous creature, but don't expect any favors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the boon baboon minion.

47961.name: clockwork oppressor
47961.col_2: Painted a rugged shade of green, this miniature machina is a scale replica of the full-size model deployed in military training exercises.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the clockwork oppressor minion.

47962.name: Ja Tiika leafkin
47962.col_2: What lies beneath its glowing blue leaves is best left a mystery.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Ja Tiika leafkin minion.

47963.name: wind-up Gulool Ja Ja
47963.col_2: It watches your progress with great interest.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Gulool Ja Ja minion.

47964.name: mini yan
47964.col_2: A sheep spirit whose child-pleasing form and diminutive size belie its might.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the mini yan minion.

47965.name: gimme kitten
47965.col_2: An ill-mannered winged feline fiend that wants everything.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the gimme kitten minion.

47966.name: micro rover
47966.col_2: Won't be moving mountains, but can handle pebbles with aplomb.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the micro rover minion.

47967.name: Psamathe
47967.col_2: An entity born of the fire-wielding familiar Triton. That's the red one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Psamathe minion.

47968.name: Naiad
47968.col_2: An entity born of the ice-wielding familiar Nereid. That's the purple one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Naiad minion.

47969.name: Deimos
47969.col_2: An entity born of the poison-wielding familiar Phobos. That's the green one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Deimos minion.

47970.name: tipping tortoise
47970.col_2: Would be a generous tipper if its coins were real.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tipping tortoise minion.

47971.name: royal hound
47971.col_2: As loyal as it is royal.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the royal hound minion.

47972.name: Skallic uolosapa
47972.col_2: A winsome bird with pure white feathers and a pink beak.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Skallic uolosapa minion.

47973.name: warp loader identification key
47973.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your warp loader will magically bring the machine to life.

47974.name: air-wheeler C9 identification key
47974.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be electrope. Placing it near your air-wheeler C9 will magically bring the vehicle to life.

47975.name: ancient airship identification key
47975.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your ancient airship will magically bring the vessel to life.

47976.name: pair of wings of the knighthood
47976.description: pairs of wings of the knighthood
47976.col_2: Manifest your wings of the knighthood and soar the skies with an aura of chivalrous passion.

47977.name: branchbearer horn
47977.col_2: A curved horn that, when blown, emits a verdant tone that brings a branchbearer gliding to your side.

47978.name: demon haul horn
47978.col_2: When blown, this horn of bone emits a ghastly sound that manifests your demon haul.

47979.name: petalodus whistle
47979.col_2: This tiny flute emits a friendly tone that calls your petalodus stampeding to your side.

47980.name: His Royal Headness on Parade whistle
47980.description: His Royal Headness on Parade whistles
47980.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a heady tone that brings His Royal Headness on Parade shuffling to your side.
47980.col_3: His Royal Headness on Parade Whistle

47981.name: set of queen's knight barding
47981.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed in the image of a dedicated servant to her sovereign.

47982.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Demure Dramatics<hex:021A020103>
47982.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how best to express oneself emotionally in less-than-polite society. Use to learn the /overreact emote.

47983.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Fashion Forward<hex:021A020103>
47983.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing proper methods of flaunting one's favorite fashions at every angle with a delightful pirouette. Use to learn the /twirl emote.

47984.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Feigning Fainting<hex:021A020103>
47984.col_2: An illustrated manual of a weakened stance meant to incite pity, or potentially triumph, in the beholder. Use to learn the /dazed emote.

47985.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Bearing Insult<hex:021A020103>
47985.col_2: An illustrated manual of how to effectively demonstrate disapproval of offensive comments without resorting to unbridled violence─which any lady knows is always the second resort, never the first. Use to learn the /rage emote.

47986.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - The Warden<hex:021A020103>
47986.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this legendary edition of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, the cascading coiffure required to emulate the goddess Azeyma Herself.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

47987.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics - Fulsome Forelocks<hex:021A020103>
47987.col_2: The realm's premier publication on beauty and fashion, this specific copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Aesthetics<hex:021A020103> covers, in detail, techniques for concealing one's visage with a luscious curtain of locks that fall past the eyes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use to unlock a new hairstyle at the aesthetician.

47988.col_2: A king among permits, and lord of the shallows beneath the For'ard Cabins.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.]<hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

48008.name: voidsent contract

48009.name: pinch of Xobr'it charcoal

48010.name: sack of charred bark

48012.name: bottle of glowing mineral water

48039.name: vial of energy-imbued water

48076.name: pinch of spicy white pepper

48077.name: clump of freshwater algae
48077.col_2: Once dried and ground into a powder, this algae is said to make a delicious seasoning for soup and the like.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Mamool Ja society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the fish guide.

48081.name: bottle of Yak Awak spring water
48081.description: bottles of Yak Awak spring water
48081.col_2: Rich in mineral nutrients, this spring water is nevertheless known for its smooth and clear taste.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Only for use in Mamool Ja society quests.<hex:02100103>※Not included in the gathering log.

48082.name: basket of leopardfang tea leaves

48083.name: frond of tsoly tea grass

48097.name: herringbone interior wall
48097.col_2: An interior wall perfect for those who can't decide which diagonal they prefer.

48098.name: roll of teal carpet
48098.col_2: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet in a rich blue-green.

48099.name: fluorescent tube chandelier
48099.col_2: Elegant meets mundane in this tasteful ceiling decoration that emits wholly practical light.

48100.name: East End tree
48100.col_2: This specimen transplanted from a disputed forest lends a touch of ennui to any lawn.

48101.name: gardener's gate
48101.col_2: Four out of five gardeners agree that this gate is, in design and practicality, perfect for any garden. (The fifth gardener was gardening during the vote.)

48102.name: hewn stone circle
48102.col_2: Rocks carefully placed for purposes of aesthetics, social gatherings, or potentially arcane rituals.

48103.name: hedge-trimmed flower bed
48103.col_2: A circular hedge tenderly blossoming and primly kept.

48104.name: chocobo chick fountain
48104.col_2: Darling yellow birds float whimsically in this tiered fountain, providing decoration for the garden and succor for the soul.

48105.name: occult epitaph
48105.col_2: A replica of a sizable stone engraved with esoteric carvings found on the Occult Crescent.

48139.col_2: Though it may be difficult to explain how this elegantly sculpted trophy proves that you have visited Shades' Triangle and lived to tell of it, it will come in useful should any naysayers doubt the veracity of your claims to know the names of basic shapes.

48140.name: occult table
48140.col_2: This table is well suited to spreading one's copious notes.

48141.name: occult chair
48141.col_2: A plush seat undoubtedly filled with secrets. And dust.

48142.name: pile of occult tablets
48142.col_2: The inscriptions upon these stone tablets defy any attempt to decipher them, but perhaps taking them home without regard for historical preservation protocols will help.

48143.name: knowledge crystal replica
48143.col_2: An inert reproduction of the crystals found across the Occult Crescent.
