51198.col_2: A bunch of multicolored cornflowers, selectively fertilized to achieve their vibrant color.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Bouquets can be placed within select vases for display in estates.

51208.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Maxims of Mahjong - Zero<hex:021A020103>
51208.col_2: A record of aphorisms shared while witness to triumphant victories and crushing defeats at the game table. Use to unlock voiced lines from Zero during Doman mahjong.

51209.name: first mate's finger
51209.col_2: Among sailors, this curious crustacean is jokingly likened to a Roegadyn's girthy fingers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51210.name: specterfish
51210.col_2: These moderately sized wavekin are so eerily pale as to be mistaken for water-bound spirits of the dead.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51211.name: Rhotano permit
51211.col_2: These large saltwater fish are known to roam the endless expanse of the Indigo Deep.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51212.name: Rhotano dahlia
51212.col_2: This highly venomous species of anemone is native to the Rhotano Sea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51213.name: lodesmate's pen
51213.col_2: These slender wavekin have the dubious honor of being used as writing implements by those at sea bereft of actual pens.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51214.name: Rhotano roosterfish
51214.col_2: Bright of scale and ferocious in temperament, this large saltwater specimen is a common sight between Thavnair and Eorzea.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51215.name: rhotanosaurus
51215.col_2: These vicious ancient scalekin have dominated the realm's oceans for millennia.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

51216.name: royal handmaiden
51216.col_2: Allegedly, this many-hued wavekin began its existence as an envoy's attendant who took an unfortunate plunge overboard.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51217.name: spectral starfish
51217.col_2: Exposure to spectral currents has endowed the flesh of this rare starfish with crystalline properties.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51218.name: frolicsome fish
51218.col_2: Given their name by island mammets, these colorful striped wavekin are just as playful as the appellation suggests.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51219.name: captain's finger
51219.col_2: Ignoring their segmented carapace and plethora of other distinguishing features, these substantial crustaceans could, just about, be mistaken for a captain's missing digit.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51220.name: piece of bright red coral
51220.col_2: Bathing in the flows of spectral currents has dyed this coral a startling crimson.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51221.name: royal favorite
51221.col_2: Legends say this vibrantly patterned wavekin was once a royal attendant sadly swallowed up by the waves.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51222.name: pirate's purse
51222.col_2: These glittering wavekin are often mistaken for pouches of ill-gotten gold.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51223.name: captain's pen
51223.col_2: The observant will note that this slender cylindrical wavekin is roughly the same dimensions as a pen. The insatiably curious will seek to verify whether these poor fish can be used as one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51224.name: tylosaurus
51224.col_2: Comparable to whales in terms of size, this colossal scalekin has endured since ancient times.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51225.name: Cieldalaes roosterfish
51225.col_2: These large saltwater fish are a common sight in the vicinity of the Cieldalaes, their distinctively spiny fins on full display.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51226.name: renegade rhotanosaurus
51226.col_2: This exceptionally aggressive subspecies of rhotanosaurus is often seen riding spectral currents─its vast shadow inspiring awe and dread in equal measure.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

51227.name: red boarfish
51227.col_2: This resplendent red wavekin is no less brilliant than the spectral currents it plies.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51228.name: akupara
51228.col_2: Hosting entire ecosystems on their expansive shells, these living islands are the subject of myriad folktales.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

51229.name: red mantis
51229.col_2: These nimble crustaceans are red. Unmistakably, undeniably, resoundingly red.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51230.name: datli gwl
51230.col_2: Prized for their sweet, scrumptious flesh, these crabs must be cooked before consumption, lest one wishes to ingest a bellyful of potent poison.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51231.name: Agama's strand
51231.col_2: Some believe these pale, tubular specimens to have once been strands of Saint Agama's stark white hair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51232.name: Palaka's blade
51232.col_2: Said to resemble the daggers favored by Thavnairian temple guards, these diminutive wavekin are revered as symbols of good fortune.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51233.name: parjanya wrasse
51233.col_2: Along with dark clouds on the horizon and the sudden pitter-patter of raindrops, sightings of this species are often interpreted as a sign of impending precipitation.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51234.name: simolestes
51234.col_2: This monstrous scalekin has a notably strong skull─one of many evolutionary advantages that include razor-sharp teeth and unparalleled bulk.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

51235.name: thavnasaurus
51235.col_2: Much loved by the local populace, these surprisingly gentle scalekin inhabit the waters around Thavnair.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51237.name: spectral grouper
51237.col_2: This species of grouper is commonly sighted riding spectral currents. The aether it thus absorbs has transformed its flesh into a near-crystalline state.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51238.name: silkfin
51238.col_2: Revered by inhabitants of fishing villages throughout Thavnair, the distinctive splotches that speckle this graceful wavekin make it easy to spot from a distance.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51239.name: great red mantis
51239.col_2: These nimble crustaceans are redder than their lesser cousins. Unmistakably, undeniably, resoundingly redder.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51240.name: guzel gwl
51240.col_2: A regular feature of banquets at the satrap's palace, these rare crabs are prized for their exquisite flavor.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51241.name: darpana
51241.col_2: Clad in scales so shiny as to be reflective, this wavekin's name means “mirror” in the common tongue.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51242.name: silverdart
51242.col_2: The snouts of these aerodynamic wavekin are painfully sharp─so much so that they are occasionally used as darts when dried.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

51243.name: satrapsaurus
51243.col_2: Understood to have persisted in Thavnair since ancient times, this scalekin is currently the subject of feverish Sharlayan scholarship.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51244.name: tiger mantis
51244.col_2: Though its striped carapace evokes a sense of feline ferocity, these mantis shrimp are in actual fact almost hilariously timorous.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

51245.name: mehi-mahi
51245.col_2: There are few creatures known to science that move with the same stubborn lack of urgency as the mehi-mahi.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

51246.name: pliosaurus
51246.col_2: Of countless species understood to ride spectral currents, this gargantuan scalekin must surely be counted among the largest and most dangerous.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

51247.name: Manasvin
51247.col_2: A prominent figure in Thavnairian mythology, this mighty tusked scalekin is said to ward off evil spirits.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

51248.name: charcoal interior wall
51248.col_2: An interior wall that can be left bare or laden with decorations, depending on one's mood.

51249.name: unit of dark wood flooring
51249.col_2: This dark wood lends an intimate air to any room while also making inevitable blemishes on the floor less apparent.

51250.name: square ceiling lamp
51250.col_2: This unobtrusive lighting fixture brightens a room without drawing the eye upward.

51251.name: lattice window seat
51251.col_2: The large window behind this seat provides a luxurious view of the world without.

51252.name: rod of nihility display
51252.col_2: A pitch-dark display stand. The tenebrous aura of a powerful voidsent emanates from within.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※One per estate only.

51253.name: minimalist poplar partition
51253.col_2: A simple partition which is perfectly functional without any adornments at all.

51254.name: minimalist poplar partition door
51254.col_2: A partition equipped with the minimum number of doors required to allow passage.

51255.name: Everkeep platform bed
51255.col_2: These low beds are a common sight in the homes of Everkeep.

51256.name: Everkeep sofa
51256.col_2: Despite its utilitarian look, this sofa is the perfect place for long hours of lounging.

51257.name: curved Everkeep sofa
51257.col_2: A curved sofa which allows for face-to-face conversations more easily than traditional shapes.

51258.name: Everkeep dining table
51258.col_2: A sleek dining table whose dark surface hides traces of any food-related mishaps.

51259.name: Everkeep round table
51259.col_2: A simple round table that can be found in dining rooms across Everkeep.

51260.name: Everkeep sideboard
51260.col_2: A spacious sideboard favored by many an Everkeep resident for its stylish design.

51261.name: Everkeep chest
51261.col_2: A chest popular in Everkeep for its relatively compact size and generous storage.

51262.name: Everkeep monitor
51262.col_2: Ubiquitous within Everkeep, these monitors are an essential part of day-to-day life in the city.

51263.name: Everkeep stereo
51263.col_2: Debates abound as to whether the quality of the sound these devices emit justifies their cost.

51264.name: Everkeep wall decoration
51264.col_2: A decoration sometimes found in the homes of Everkeep's more discerning residents, who insist they understand its meaning.

51265.name: Everkeep rug
51265.col_2: A large rug woven with a pattern that has become the talk of Everkeep.

51266.name: Everkeep kitchen counter
51266.col_2: A wide kitchen counter equipped with enough drawers to accommodate culinarians of all persuasions.

51267.name: Everkeep partition
51267.col_2: A simple partition with slits that allow people on either side to peer at each other playfully.

51269.name: string of garden mood lighting
51269.col_2: Perfect for setting a festive mood far past the point when everyone should have gone home.

51270.name: garden canal
51270.col_2: Proper drainage is key to healthy soil.

51271.name: semicircular outdoor stage
51271.col_2: For thespians whose brilliance cannot be bound by the stifling walls of a theater.

51272.name: crumbling aqueduct
51272.col_2: Despite the Nymian ambience, this aqueduct is unlikely to be thousands of years old.

51273.name: beastmaster display crystal
51273.col_2: Designed for those who take great pride in their work, this purely decorative crystal bespeaks enthusiastic commitment to the path of the beastmaster.

51275.name: <hex:021A020203>Galactic Way<hex:021A020103> miniature
51275.col_2: A made-to-scale model of the <hex:021A020203>Galactic Way<hex:021A020103> starship, expertly crafted by Garlond Ironworks engineers on behalf of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.

51276.name: Auxesian tower replica
51276.col_2: Crafted by an artisan of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this miniature model is used to analyze Auxesian architecture.

51277.name: cosmic metal shelf
51277.col_2: This simple metal shelf can hold approximately ten Loporrits.

51278.name: flight of cosmic steps
51278.col_2: Access the very top of your cosmic shelves, whether gravity likes it or not.

51279.name: cosmic partition
51279.col_2: A partition designed to cordon off potentially unsafe areas on distant stars.

51280.name: Auxesian waygate
51280.col_2: Crafted by an artisan of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative to resemble the gallant gantries of Auxesia.

51281.name: Auxesian waylight
51281.col_2: Crafted by an artisan of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative to resemble the roadside illuminations of Auxesia.

51282.name: winged scalekin fossil
51282.col_2: The species of scalekin immortalized here has yet to be identified.

51283.name: Crescent stone pillar
51283.col_2: This timeworn pillar once decorated the highest floor of the Tower of Magic.

51284.name: Crescent wall rack
51284.col_2: This ornate shelf once decorated the highest floor of the Tower of Magic.

51285.name: Crescent display case
51285.col_2: This wooden case once contained some manner of specimen on the highest floor of the Tower of Magic.

51286.name: blue Crescent moon
51286.col_2: An ethereal stone sculpture recovered from the ruins of the Occult Crescent.

51287.name: yellow Crescent cube
51287.col_2: An austere stone sculpture recovered from the ruins of the Occult Crescent.

51288.name: red Crescent crystal
51288.col_2: A vibrant stone sculpture recovered from the ruins of the Occult Crescent.

51289.name: wibbly-wobbly Jibanyan
51289.col_2: Shaped like the head of the Yo-kai Jibanyan. It wibbles. It wobbles. Sometimes, it does both at once.

51290.name: wibbly-wobbly Komasan
51290.col_2: Shaped like the head of the Yo-kai Komasan. It wibbles. It wobbles. Sometimes, it does both at once.

51291.name: wibbly-wobbly USApyon
51291.col_2: Shaped like the head of the Yo-kai USApyon. It wibbles. It wobbles. Sometimes, it does both at once.

51292.name: smiling Wakeshroom
51292.col_2: This toothy grin is fitting of most any season, but All Saints' Wake especially.

51293.name: staring Wakeshroom
51293.col_2: Nothing says All Saints' Wake like a baleful gaze glowing in the darkness. Sleep tight!

51294.name: Wakesoul buggy
51294.col_2: A delightfully witchy wagon with a phantom passenger dressed for All Saints' Wake.

51295.name: Starlight sled
51295.col_2: Hitch it to a Starlight steed, and you'll have these presents delivered in no time.

51298.name: authentic copy of <hex:021A020203>Trail to the Heavens<hex:021A020103>
51298.description: authentic copies of <hex:021A020203>Trail to the Heavens<hex:021A020103>
51298.col_2: A masterfully rendered oil depiction of a golden key, seven resolute faces illuminated by its warm glow.
51298.col_3: Authentic Copy of Trail to the Heavens

51299.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the Rising of yesteryear, depicting a merry medley of familiar Turali faces.

51300.name: tabletop Rising MMXXV advertisement
51300.col_2: A conveniently sized notice, ideal for lending a festive air to household surfaces. Advertising the Rising of yesteryear, it depicts a merry medley of familiar Turali faces.

51301.name: the Rising MMXXIV advertisement
51301.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising the Rising of yesteryear, depicting the pirates of Limsa Lominsa at sundown.

51302.name: All Saints' Wake MMXXV advertisement
51302.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising an All Saints' Wake gone by, depicting a pumpkin-headed trickster fleeing a band of bemused Turali tourists.

51305.name: Starlight Celebration MMXXV advertisement
51305.col_2: A hand-painted notice advertising a Starlight Celebration gone by, depicting a dream of a hot drink shared on a cold night.

51314.name: authentic gilded screen
51314.col_2: A gorgeous, authentic folding screen designed for display during Heavensturn.

51687.name: junior jinbei
51687.col_2: A baby whale shark by any other name would be just as calm and carefree.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the junior jinbei minion.

52008.col_2: The crystalline spines of this scalekin shine emerald green in the dim light of its riverbed habitat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

52009.name: skyfrond
52009.col_2: Native to Cenote Jayunja, this rare ray is revered by the Mamool Ja as a symbol of the sky.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

52010.name: rroneek bichir
52010.col_2: Found in the waters of Lake Toari, this colossal wavekin is readily identified by its impressive curved horns.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

52011.name: triple threat

52012.name: pote'uka

52014.name: iq ebaji

52091.name: Auxesia token booklet
52091.col_2: A thick albeit cheaply bound collection of 100 Auxesia exploration tokens, exchangeable for rare incentives prepared by the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.

52092.name: Auxesia exploration token
52092.col_2: A slip awarded in exchange for successful completion of high-difficulty missions on Auxesia, and exchangeable for rare incentive items prepared by the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. These things don't grow on trees, you know.

52093.name: botanic gold ancient record
52093.col_2: A data repository found while analyzing an ancient relic on Auxesia. The information sealed within promises to shed light on the star's esoteric former inhabitants.

52094.name: civic silver ancient record
52094.col_2: A data repository found while analyzing an ancient relic on Auxesia. The information sealed within promises to shed light on the star's urban environment.

52095.name: arboreal bronze ancient record
52095.col_2: A data repository found while analyzing an ancient relic on Auxesia. The information sealed within promises to shed light on the star's flora.

52254.name: pot of standard spectrum dye
52254.col_2: Capable of producing a wide range of standard hues, this versatile dye is used for coloring anything from cloth to metal.

52255.name: pot of wide spectrum #1 dye
52255.col_2: Capable of producing a wide range of additional hues, this versatile dye is used for coloring anything from cloth to metal.

52257.name: interstellar leafkin whistle
52257.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a verdant tone that calls your interstellar leafkin rustling to your side.

52258.name: inflatable mograft
52258.col_2: Once filled with air, this festive flotation device will be ready to bear you forth in comfort, be it on the water or in the sky.

52259.name: array of wings of legacy
52259.col_2: Manifest your wings of legacy and soar the skies with an aura of irrepressible heroism.

52260.name: Night Stallion activation key
52260.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be electrope. Placing it near your Night Stallion will magically bring the vehicle to life.

52261.name: magitek scorpion identification key
52261.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your magitek scorpion will magically bring the machine to life.

52262.name: rocket punch identification key
52262.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of what appears to be cermet. Placing it near your rocket punch will magically bring the machine to life.

52263.name: Cu Sith horn
52263.col_2: A curved horn that, when blown, emits an unfaltering note that summons forth your faithful Cu Sith.

52264.name: colibri callado whistle
52264.col_2: This whistle emits a sprightly tone that calls your colibri callado flapping to your side.

52265.name: hydra horn
52265.col_2: When blown, this timeworn horn produces a terrible sound that calls forth your hydra.

52266.name: duck-billed porter whistle
52266.col_2: When blown, this whistle emits a dependable tone that summons your duck-billed porter to your side.

52267.name: cosmic armored weapon beta identification key
52267.description: cosmic armored weapon beta identification keys

52268.name: cosmic predator identification key
52268.col_2: A thin, rectangular piece of some unknown material. Placing it near your cosmic predator will magically bring the machine to life.

52270.name: pair of wings of nihility
52270.col_2: Manifest your wings of nihility and soar the skies with an aura of all-consuming nothingness.

52273.col_2: Formerly red and vicious.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the little blue viking minion.

52274.name: little red viking
52274.col_2: Formerly blue and ruthless.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the little red viking minion.

52275.name: lite-loader
52275.col_2: Can move huge loads, a little at a time.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the lite-loader minion.

52276.name: caprino
52276.col_2: So adorable you'll let it get away with anything.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the caprino minion.

52277.name: tiny omniscient
52277.col_2: Knows a tiny little bit about all things.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the tiny omniscient minion.

52278.name: puny mage
52278.col_2: If you think it weak...you would be right.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the puny mage minion.

52279.name: wind-up Wuk Lamat
52279.col_2: An adventurer like you could hardly resist, no?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Wuk Lamat minion.

52280.name: wind-up Prishe
52280.col_2: Ya ready for this?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Prishe minion.

52281.name: wind-up köttr
52281.col_2: Because you can never have too many bipedal felines.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up köttr minion.

52282.name: budvi
52282.col_2: A bud, buddy, and Nagylvi rolled into one.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the budvi minion.

52283.name: wind-up Barret
52283.col_2: There ain't no gettin' offa this train we on!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the wind-up Barret minion.

52284.name: Nymian uolosapa
52284.col_2: A winsome bird with cinnamon markings on a canvas of white.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Use item to acquire the Nymian uolosapa minion.

52285.name: set of barding of naught
52285.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Enuo.

52286.name: set of picnicker's barding
52286.col_2: A suit of chocobo armor fit for an outdoor feast.

52287.name: Avalanche Gatling gun
52287.col_2: A sleek, rapid-fire weapon, modeled after the one wielded by a fearless hero of legend. Use to acquire an Avalanche Gatling gun.

52288.name: shovel
52288.col_2: A sturdy wooden shovel designed for the stylish adventurer seeking to dig themself out of a fashion crisis. Use to unlock a shovel.

52289.name: antique lantern
52289.col_2: Old enough to be considered an antique, yet functional enough to light your way forward. Use to acquire an antique lantern.

52290.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Geographic Guesswork<hex:021A020103>
52290.col_2: An illustrated manual of common cartographic symbols and their meanings─perfect for wayfaring adventurers, treasure hunters, or simply those who would rather not ask for directions. Use to learn the /navigate emote.

52291.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Intrepid Inputs<hex:021A020103>
52291.col_2: An illustrated manual that aims to educate its readers with step-by-step exercises (and, mysteriously, a few mini-games) on the art of accurate typing. Use to learn the /magitype emote.

52292.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Dignified Derision<hex:021A020103>
52292.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to emit a dainty-yet-bloodcurdling fit of laughter that will strike fear into the hearts of your foes─and perhaps even your allies. Whoever knows? Use to learn the /cackle emote.

52293.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Orchestral Operations<hex:021A020103>
52293.col_2: An illustrated manual depicting the appropriate posture and strict timekeeping required to conduct a proper orchestra. Use to learn the /conduct emote.

52294.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Trial by Taco<hex:021A020103>
52294.description: copies of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Trial by Taco<hex:021A020103>
52294.col_2: An illustrated manual providing step-by-step instructions on the consumption of a slightly oversized, yet mouthwatering Turali delicacy─one that some gastronomic experts might consider a “big fat taco.” Use to learn the /eattaco emote.

52295.name: copy of <hex:021A020203>Ballroom Etiquette - Rearward Regards<hex:021A020103>
52295.col_2: An illustrated manual detailing how to glamorously gaze upon the world behind you during fond farewells or other bittersweet occasions. Use to unlock the /lookback emote.

52297.name: great ball of lightning
52297.col_2: These spheroid specimens harbor frightening quantities of energy within their crackling membranes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

52298.name: occult apocrytaph
52298.col_2: A massive monument faithfully recreated, right down to the inscrutable inscriptions.

52321.name: mad harlequin's totem
52321.col_2: A small-yet-handsomely crafted idol of Kefka, fashioned by himself on a whim. A message addressed to you is hand-carved into the base:<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>“Well? What're you waiting for? Buy yourself a nice weapon, why don't you!”
